dab nyar bzha pa' dkar chag no rgyud/ /9/ )/ (47)0826 gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 3rnal 'byor/ ༷ 3rjes su rnal 'byor/ 6shin tu rnal 'byor/ ༷ 8rnal 'byor chen po/ 12slob dpon dpang 'dzin gyis mdzad/pa/ṇḍi ta dā na tīrti/ dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/bsdur mchan/(18) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(19)0827 gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ 20slob dpon mkhas pa dang/la 'dzin gyis mdzad / 1

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na tīrti dang /lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(60) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(63)0828 rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa/ 64slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad/paṇḍi ta su ma ti tīrti dang / lo tsā ba mar do chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(66) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(66)0829 gshin rje dgra'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gshin rje gshed 'byung /ba zhes bya /ba/ ༷ ( 77slob dpon chen po la li ta badzra'i zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badzra dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba cog gru shes rab bla mas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(101) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(103)0830 mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ 104rgya gar gyi mkhan po la li ta badzras mdzad— bsdur mchan/(106) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(106)0831 srung ba'i 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs 107dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/bsdur mchan/(110) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(111)2

0832 gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs 112slob dpon nyin mor byed pa'i grags pas mdzad/zhu rsā gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis/rgya gar gyi dpe phyi mo dang gtugs te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(118) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(119)0833 gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs 120slob dpon gho ṣa badzras mdzad/bal po'i mkhan po su ma ti tsand+ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba bande tshogs chag chung bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(123) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(123)0834 dpal gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs 'khor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa dang bcas pa 1241sngon du bsnyen pa (3 0ba/ 124/ra(bye/ba /ra/botshang —1/ba /ba/ 126gzhi sogs gtan la dbab pa/ 126ga:de gtan bab tshodabab pa/ 126byang chub kyi sems gtan la dbab pa/ 126gnas gtan la dbab pa/ ༷ 126zla grogs gtan la dbab pa/ 127:sdobasgyu bkatacad (ba tshodabapas ngas/ 127'khor /sgo zi ba zabags/ 1273

'khor lo bri ba/ 127ling ga bca' ba/ ༷ 128ga'ur gzhug pa/ ༷ 128ga'u bsro ba/ 129gshin rje la gtad pa/ 129nang gi rnal 'byor/ 129'khor lo sba ba/ 130rjes kyi rnal 'byor/ 136slar dbyung ba'i cho ba 137las kyi sngags kyi bya ba mdor bstan pa/ ༷ 137snying po'i sngags la gnas pa'i bya ba bshad pa/ 139'chi ba'i dus su yid la bya ba'i man ngag bstan pa/ 139slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya bi nā ya tsand+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(141) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(143)0835 gshin rje'i gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs 144rnal 'byor/ 144rjes kyi rnal 'byor/ 150shin tu rnal 'byor/ 153rnal 'byor chen po/ 157sngags bzlas pa/ 160

sngags bzlas pa'i che ba'i bdag nyid dang gtor ma nye bar bstan pa/ 161dge slong bsod snyoms pa ka ma la rakṣi tas bsdus/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(164) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(166)0836 maṇḍa'/ (1 cho ga 167bla ma'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga 167klog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 168yi dam lha'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga 169slob dpon chen po dpal rnyog med rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po a du la dha sa dang /lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(169) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(169)0837 maṇḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 170rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo/ ka ma la radzee tas mdzad / lo tsā ba shrī pradzñā dzñā na tīrtis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(172) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(172)0838 gshin rje'i dgra nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs ku mu da kha bye ba cesab dram ngab 1735

slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad/ā tsārya bi na tsand+ra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(182) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(183)0839 dpal gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 184bsdur mchan/(186) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(187)084༷ khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed nag po dus mthar phyin ngas/re (1/ba shā /bathag cesathag (1 /ba 188rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī paṇḍi tas mdzad/rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī tshwa na tīrtis rang 'gyur du bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(193) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(193)0841 gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 194slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/rnal 'byor pa pratshwa shrī tshwa na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(196) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(196)0842 gshin rje gshed rnam par snang mdzad kyi mngon par rtogs /pa zhe/ma bya /ba 1940rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas par grags pa 6

dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/rnal 'byor pa pra1 shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(199) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(199)0843 gshin rje gshed rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rtenarjo rte slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(202) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(202)༷844 'od dpag tu rnged pa'i snying po 'dod chags gshin rje gshed (1ngab pa//re tha'ababag stugabag (1 ngab ༷ 203slob dpon mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(205) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(205)0845 gshin rje gshed rdo rje rnon po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 206slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(208) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(208)0846 rdo rje sems ma bde ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 209slob dngo/na mkhas pa chen po mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/7

rnal 'byor pa pratshwa shrī tshwa na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(211) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(211)0847 rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 212slob dpon mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(214) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(214)0848 rdo rje bde rgyas dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 215basbur mchan/(217) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(217)08go las kyi rdo rje gau rī'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 218bsdur mchan/(220) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(220)0850 rje btsun 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mchod pa'i cho ga'i (sde/ma /pa /zhe/ma /bya /ba 221slob dpon chen po kriṣṭa paṇḍi tas mdzad/basbur mchan/(225) basbur 'bras re'u mig(225)0851 sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba rtenarten6mkhas pa chen po rnal 'byor pa nag po zhabs kyis mdzad/rnal 'byor pa pratshwa shrī tshwa na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(229) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(230)

0852 gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 231rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po ka ma la rakṣi tas mdzad/rnal 'byor pa bsod stoms pa pradzñā shrī tshwa na krirtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(236) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(236)0853 khro bo tho ba gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 237rgya gar gyi mkhan po mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(239) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(239)0854 dbyug pa gshin rje gshed rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 2zheng0slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ras mdzad/rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī tshwa na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(242) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(242)0855 ral gri gshin rje gshed gtum po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 243bsdur mchan/(245) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(245)0856 padma gshin rje gshed shes rab bde ba can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rtenatsam(3rgya gar gyi mkhan po/ dī paṃ ka ras mdzad/rnal 'byor pa dra dzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad/9

bsdur mchan/(2rga) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(2na)0857 gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi maṇḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba 2gobasod snyoms pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(252) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(253)0858 chos kyi sgu'i snang ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 254rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka lā pa ma hās mdzad/rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā nas rang 'gyur du byas/basbur mchan/(258) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(259)0859 gshin rje gshed kyi ro sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 260slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(263) basbur 'bras re'u mig(263)0860 tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 264slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(271) basbur 'bras re'u mig(271)0861 gshin rje gshed nag po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba 272bla ma nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad/rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī tshwa na krirtis rang 'gyur du byas/bsdur mchan/(275) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(275)0

0862 yi dwags thams cad rdo rjes bcings pa 276slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad/rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī tshwa na krirti'i rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(278) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(279)0863 gshin rje gshed nag po'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa 280rnal 'byor/ ༷ 280rjes su rnal 'byor/ 283shin tu rnal 'byor/ 285rnal 'byor chen po/ 288slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal rdo rje'i blos mdzad/bsdur mchan/(292) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(293)0864 dpal gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga bzhugs / 294bsdur mchan/(300) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(300)0865 gshin rje dgra nag po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs 301rnal 'byor/ 301rjes su rnal 'byor/ 304shin tu rnal 'byor/ 306rnal 'byor chen po/ 310slob dpon kun du bzang ngo 'i zhal snga nas mdzad/ 11

slob dpon don yod rdo rjes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(317) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(318)0866 ga/sgon rje gshed spyo) sgrub paḍire thabs 319slob dpon 'gro bzangs snying pos mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī tshwa na dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(322) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(322)0867 nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 323slob dpon la li ta badzras mdzad/basbur mchan/(325) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(325)0868 mdza byam /byethab nga /sde sgo thababag 326ā tsarya dzi mu da pā tā las mdzad/ā tsārya badzra pā ṇi dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(229) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(329)0869 gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo'i man ngag bzhugs/ 330slob dngo/na chen po nā ga bo rnyis mdzad/lo tsā ba dge slo nga chos rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(336) basbur 'bras re'u mig(337)0870 rdogacad byesabaka :go cos bka ngab(1bkabag/ 338slob dpon chen ngo/ la li ta badzras mdzad/2

bsdur mchan/(341) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(341)0871 'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 342bsdur mchan/(346) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(346)0872 gshin rje gshed kyi lag pa'i mchod pa/ 347dā na shī las bsgyur/bsnyur mchan/(348) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(348)0873 gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba 3go.ā tsārya tīrtis 'al snga nas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(355) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(355)0874 rdo rje 'dzin pas gshin rje gshed po la bstod pa'i rgyud/ 356bsdur mchan/(359) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(359)0875 gtor ma nye bar sbyang ba/ ༷ 360bsdur mchan/(362) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(363)0876 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi dka' 'grel/ 364yan lag dang po/ le'u'i grangs kyi go rims mngon par brjod pa/ 364yan lag gnyis pa/ bsdus pa'i don mngon par brjod pa/ 367yan lag gsum pa/ man ngag gi gnas mngon par brjodapa/ 369le'u dang po/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i bshad pa/ 36913

le'u gnyis pa/ las thams cad 'grub pa bstan pa'i bshad pa/ 373le'u gsum pa/ sngags btu ba'i bshad pa/ 378le'u bzhi pa/ bsgom pa'i bshad pa/ 380le'u lnga pa/ bris sgu'i cho ga'i bshad pa/ 382le'u drug pa/ sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga rgya che ba'i bshad pa/ 384le'u bdun pa/ bsam gtan gyi las bsgrub pa brtag pa'i bshad pa/ 386rdo rje slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi nā ya tsand+ra dang /lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(390) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(392)0877 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi mdor bshad pa zhes bya ba rtenasgyu sna dang po/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 393gnyis pa/ las thams cad 'grub pa bstan pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 396 gsum pa/ sngags btu ba'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 398bzhi pa/ bsgom pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 399lnga pa/ bris sgu'i cho ga'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 405drug pa/ sbyin sres bi las kyi cho sa rgya che ba'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 405bdun pa/ bsam gtan gyi las bsgrub pa brtag pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 407slob dpon so na shrīs mdzad/mkhas pa chen po ta thā ga ta'i zhal nas brgyud / bsdur mchan/(409) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(411)

0878 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyud kyi mdo mdor bshad pa zhes /bya /ba tsam1rtenadang po/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 412gnyis pa/ las thams cad 'grub pa bstan pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 415gsum pa/ sngags btu ba'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 417bzhi pa/ bsgom pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 418lnga pa/ bris sku'i cho ga'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 424drug pa/ sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga rgya che ba'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 424bdun pa/ bsam gtan kyi las bsgrub pa brtag pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 426slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brangs nga/'i sgo ba dngo/na dpa/la chen po rdo rje grub pa sa ma/dzad/bsdur mchan/(428) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(430)0879 rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi dka' 'grel/ 431dang po/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rtog pa'i dka' 'grel/ 431gnyis pa/ las thams cad 'grub pa bstan pa'i rtog pa'i dka' 'grel/ 434gsum pa/ sngags btu ba'i rtog pa'i dka' 'grel/ 435bzhi pa/ bsgom pa'i rtog pa'i dka' 'grel/ ༷༷ ༷ 437lnga pa/ dzres sku'i cho ga'i rtog pa'i dka' 'grel/ 438drug pa/ sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga rgya che ba'i rtog pa'i dka' 'grel/ 438bdun pa/ bsam gtan kyi las bsgrub pa brtag pa'i rtog pa'i dka' 'grel/ 439rlo ba dngo na ma khas pa/ chen ngo/ dpa la ba'on nu zla bas ma/dzad/pa ṇḍi ta chen ngo ta thā sa ta rakṣi ta dang /lo tsā ba dase slo nga ba ri rin chen grasas 5

pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(439) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(440)0880 rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa rin po che'i phreng ba /de/ma /bya /ba tsamatsam1dang po/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 441gnyis pa/ las thams cad 'grub pa bstan pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 4gogasum pa/ sngags btu ba'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 451bzhi pa/ bsgom pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷453lnga pa/ bris sku'i cho ga'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 458drug pa/ sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga rgya che ba'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 459bdun pa/ bsam gtan kyi las bsgrub pa brtag pa'i rtog pa'i bshad pa/ 461slob dpon chen po nag po pa nyid kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nyid las blangs nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo/ chen po paṇḍi ta dpa/la bee ro tsa na rakṣi ta dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(464) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(464)0881 ma he'i zhal kyi sgrub pa'i thabs 465rlo ba dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnam par snang mdzad srung ba'i zhabs dang / lo tsā ba khams pa/ dge slong ba ri dharmā tīrtis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(472) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(472)6

0882 rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 473'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya a narnya dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(479) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(na0)0883 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor basbus pa ༷ 481slob dpon chen po shrī bha dras mdzad/bsdur mchan/(na7) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(na8)0884 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang / sgrub pa'i cho ga dang / las spyor/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa las 'khor lo bskor ba'i las drag po phyogs gcig pa/ 489bsnyen pa'i cho ga ༷ 489sgrub pa'i cho ga go9las spyor/ 501rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa las 'khor lo bskor ba'i las drag po phyogs gcig pa/ 502slob dngo/na byu ba'i ye shes kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(504) bsdur 'bras re'u mig 505)0885 rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ 5067

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs jes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa ya mā ri sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma la gus de rjes gshin rje gshed nag rdo rje la/ /rang 'od yan lag 'dus pa bde ba rgyas pa gzhan gyi don 'jug pa/ /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo chu skyes gri gug thod pa'i phyag /zhal gsum 'jigs pa'i 'jigs byed la ni spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje gshed nag sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de nyid rig pa mngon 'dod pa'i/ /dbang la sogs pa thob pa nyid/ /de yi 'di ni sgrub thabs rim/ /byis rnams bde bar rtogs phyir dang / /mnyam pa dran par bya ched dang / /mchog rnams byis pa'i ngag la ni/ /mgu bya'i phyir ni rnam par bri/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs ldan/ /sems can don la ro gcig blo/ /byams sogs yon tan yang dag rdzogs/ /dad dang thos pas 24—3

rnam par brgyan/ /tho rangs snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dang por gdong sogs khrus byas nas/ /dben pa'i sa phyogs dur khrod sogs/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /brtsam bya rang snying padma ste/ /zla ba la blta shin tu gsal// ya yig sngon po'i 'od zer can/ /sems can don ni phun tshogs byas/ /bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /nam mkha' ma lus khyab par bsgom/ /de rnams dmigs la phyag byas nas/ /lus sprul pa yi cho ga yis/ /sems ma la sogs kyis mchod nas/ /sdog pa bshags pa'o/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa bgyis / /de bzhin bgyid du stsal pa dang / /mgon po rjes su yi rang gang / /de gsum byas pa bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de sras 'phags/ /bsod nams tshogs la rjes yi rang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam chos bcas/ /tshogs kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi/ /yon tan rgya chen khyed cag la/ /bdag gi )lus ni dbul bar bgyi/ /dam pa'i chos ni thams cad dang / /ston pa'i sgra mdzes gnas gyur cig /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /sbyin sogs las kyi ngo bo la/ /sku gsung ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu gus pas gnas par bgyi/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir—/ /gang zhig bsod nams tshogs bsags pas/ /byang chub tu ni bsngo bar bgyi/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed gyur nas/ /'gro la phan pa dag sde byed cing / /'di ltar smon lam btab nas ni/ /de nas blo yis gshegs su gsol—/ /snying rjes cho ga bzhin bltas nas/ /sna tshogs stong pa'i rnam par bsgom / /rang bzhin rnams dang bral ba'i phyir/ /rgyu yang mtshan ma med par bsgom/ /spyod dang bral ba nyid kyis ni/ /smon pa dag ni rnam par spangs//24—4

oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kopho1haṃ/ de la sems ni brtan byas nas/ /e 4yig las byung nyi ma las/ /der ni hūṃ snyeyig sngon po'i mdangs/ /'od zer 'phros pas kun la khyab/ /rdo rje rtse lnga thams cad du/ /bsrung ba'i don du bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sa gzhi lcags ri dang / /ra ba gur dang de bzhin no//sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam dag don/ /slar yang bsam gtan yang dag brtsam/ /de la sna tshogs chu skyes zla/ /saṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje las/ /yan lag bzang po yan lag 'byung / /chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ /steng du gnas pa mkha' mnyam bsam/ /dbus su padma zla ba la/ /slar yang de dbus dkyil 'khor te/ /hūṃ — yig 'khor lo las bskyed pa/ /rtag pa'i yan lag las byung ba—/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis brgyan/ pa dang / /dra ba dra phyed kyis brgyan pa/ /stegs bu lha mos legs mdzes pa/ /sna tshogs rtse mo rlung gis bskyod/ /ba dan dril bu dang ldan pa/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes rnam par brgyanalte / /zla ba nyi ma rgyal ba'i gdan/ /shar ni dkar po chen po ste/ /lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /byang ni btsod 1dang mtshungs pa'o/ /ind+ra nī la'i 'od byed pa/ /dbus kyi sa gzhi rnam par bsam / /phyogs kyi kha dog dbye ba 'dis/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin gur yang bsgom par bya/ /so so'i rtsig 7pa go rims ༷ bzhin/ /rnam pa lnga ni bsgom byas nas/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /dpal ldan rnam pa lnga dang bcas/ /rdo rje nag po sel byed pa/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni gzugs zhes grags/ /de ni dbye bas bsnyad par bya/ /lte bar sna tshogs padma'i gdan/ /zla bar dbyangs yig nyis rim dgod/ /de yi zla bar 24—5

ka yig sogs/ /ḍa shwe da dha ya la yang / /bcug nas de dag nyid las grub/ /'di dag 'di ltar grub pa ni/ /me long ye shes brjod par bya/ /mnyam nyid de dag gcig pa nyid/ /de skyes hūṃ ni so sor rtog /bya ba nan tan ye shes ni/ /de las skyes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /nor bu me shel 'od 'dra ba/ /sa bon bcas pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ /oṃ badzra ātpa kolha7haṃ/ zhes pas bdag nyid nga rgyal bya/ /de skyes dkar dmar mdangs ldan pa/ /'od zer mdzes pas 'khyud pa'i lus/ /khro bo sgeg gzugs bde ba yis/ /2—dkar dang sngo dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /gdan la g.yon brkyang gis gnas /pa/ /'bar ba'i ral gri rdo rje gri gug gsor ba'o/ /'khor lo 'dam skyes snod bee 'od zer 'phro ba yi/ /phyag ni g.yas dang g.yon rnams kyis/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin ni/ /ye shes rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag /rnam pa lnga yi rang bzhin gang / /rnal 'byor zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /zhes pa ni rnal 'byor ro/ /'dod chags chen pos 'dul ba ru/ /'gro ba gsum po yang dag bltas/ /rang snying ye shes 'od zer gyis/ /sna tshogs sangs rgyas gzugs byas nas/ /rang gi lus la yang dag gzhug /bde ba dam pa rnam pa'i gzugs/ /bdag gi longs spyod bsgom par bya/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /sngags mchog de nyid gsum zhes pa/ /hoḥ4dmar gnyis kyi nang du gzhug /ji ltar skar mda' 'phro ba ltar/ /byang chub sems ni de bzhin gzhug /snying rje chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag nyid zhu/ /byams sogs sems ma sogs rnams kyi/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo skul bar byed/ /bzhengs 24—6

shig gshin rje rje btsun snying rje'i khro/ /khams gsum thams cad pa yi gti mug sol / /de bzhin bdud las rgyal bar mdzod/ /bzhengs shig rje btsun thugs ni g.yengs gyur pas/ /'jig rten mgon po stong nyid ci ste bzhugs/ /bzhengs shig rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams kyis/ /byang chub 'dod pa'i 'jig rten mnyam mnan nas/ /ci phyir stong pa nyid la sems shing zhugs/ /bskul nas de ni thim gyur snanas/ /de yi ro yi rjes su song / /glu 'di yi ni dor byas nas/ /phun tshogs nyams 'dra las byung ba/ /zhu ba rjes pa las skyes pa/ /baṃ — snasngon po las nyi dkyil 'khor/ /mi bzad khro bcas mdog sngo ba/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /sma ra rnon po 'bar ba'i rwa/ /rmig pa rko rte ba 'jigs byed pa/ /ma hirṣa snyede'i rgyab gnas pa/ /rdo rje sngon po 'od zer bcas / /sa bon 'od zer bcas pa yis/ /gshed nag gzugs ni de yis bya / /sna tshogs dag 5la yang dag gzhug /'jigs byed chen po 'jigs su rung / /ma hirṣar 6ni rdo rjer bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug bsgom par bya / /'jig rten gsum po bdud kyi 'khor/ /'od zer rnon po 'phro bas bsreg /mi bzad drag shul mun pa'i lus/ /'od zer ljags ni 'dril 7ba po / /'bar ba'i mche ba gcigs pa'i byad/ /ral pa sma ra gyen du 'greng / /g.yon brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis mnan/ /nag po rnam par myos byed pa/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni bung nag 'dra/ /g.yas pa zla ba'i 'od byed pa/ /g.yon pa dmar po'i mdangs su bstan/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /sbom thung gsus pa 'phyang ba po/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang dang ldan/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /rang 'od shes 24—7

rab yan lag sbyor/ /bde ba 'bab pa gzhan gyi don/ /lhag ma g.yas pa'i phyag dag gis/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon na 'khor lo chu skyes 'dzin/ /sbrul gyi dbang pos brgyan byas te/ /sngon po mtha' yas sbrul dag gis/ /ral pa bcings pa shin tu 'jigs/ /dmar po 'jog po klu yis ni / /ma rungs pa yi 1rna ba brgyan/ /sna tshogs rigs ldan dpung rgyan 7te/ /dung skyong dag gi sbrul nyid ni/ /ser po gdu bu 'dzin pa'o/ /padma dkar po'i do shal can/ /ljang gu karko ṭa yis ni/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa shin tu mdzes / /bdud rtsi'i kha dog 'dra ba yi/ /nor 'dzin gyis ni ska rags byas/ /padma'i rtsa ba kha dog skya/ /padma chen pos zhabs gdub po/ /thams cad phuṭa kyi sgra byed pa/ /lce gnyis drag shul mche ba'i phreng / /'di ni 'khor ba myang 'das gzugs/ /gshin rje sel bar byed pa'o/ /rtog pa zad pa'i ched bsams nas/ /sngags kyis yang dag byin kyis brlab/ /oṃ dharma jo tu dzñā na swa bhā wa ātpa kolha4haṃ/ zhes pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /rang snying 'od zer beegs kyu yis/ /mkha' khyab rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams / /thams cad bkug nas zhal du gzhug5 /bde bar phab nas snying gar zhu/ /rdo rje lam byung zhu ba de/ /blo dang ldan pas spro bar bya/ /rang 'od padma'i khongs su gnas/ /rang gi sa bon gzugs su blta/ /sa bon las byung 'khor lo kun/ /sa bon kun gyis byen gyis brlab/ /'phro zhing sdud pa'i 'od zer ni/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bsgom/ /ya yig sngon bos dbus ma bskyed6/ /dkyil 'khor can gyi mtshan nyid gsungs/ /shar du kṣe las 24—8

'khor lo grub/ /rtag pa dkar po phyag drug pa/ /'khor lo ral gri g.yas pa'i phyag /g.yon na rin chen chu skyes 'dzin/ /lhor ni ma yi yi ge las/ /rin chen las skyes rin chen 'byung / /btso ma gser gyi mdangs byed pa/ /rin chen ral gri g.yas na 'dzin/ /g.yon na 'khor lo chu skyes so/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje can/ /sa bon me dang padma grub/ /padma rā ga'i 'od dang mnyam / /g.yas na padma ral gri'o/ /nor bu 'khor lo g.yon du dgod/ /da dang ral gri las byung ba/ /ljang gu phrag dog gshin rje gshed/ /g.yas na ral gri 'khor lo bsnams/ /mdzes pa'i nor bu padma g.yon/ /thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ /khro bo gzugs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /de rnams kyi ni rtsa ba'i phyag /gri gug thod pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis med gnyug ma'i shes rab dang / /lus bdag med pa'i ngo bo dang / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa//rtag pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rtsa bar gnas/ /sems can don byed bsgom par bya/ /shar sgor ya yig las skyes pa/ /tho ba sngon po yi ni gzugs/ /g.yas na tho ba ral gri 'dzin/ /nor bu bzang po padma g.yon//rdo rje thor grags gshin rje gshed/ /lhor ni dza dang dbyug pa las/ /dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar mdangs/ /dbyug pa ral gri g.yas pa na/ /chu skyes 'khor lo g.yon pa'o/ /nub tu padma gshin rje gshed/ /ni skyes 'dod chags mtha' 'joms gzugs/ /padma ral gri g.yas pa na/ /g.yon na 'khor lo nor bu'o/ /byang du ral gri gshin rje gshed/ /ra skyes phrag dog mtha' 'joms pa/ /ral gri 'khor lo g.yas pa na/ /g.yon na nor bu padma ste/ /cung zad sngo ba'i bye brag ste/ /zhes pa 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /sbrul ni 24—9

thams cad pa yi gzugs/ /rnam par gtsigs pa'i gad rgyangs can/ /skra ser gyen du 'greng ba ste/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang dag ldan/ /mche ba gatshigs pa gad rgyangs che/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rdo rje mtshams bzhi la/ /zla ba la gnas lha mo rnams/ /shar lho mtshams kyi lha mo ni//dza skyes rdo rje sems ma'o/ /dkar mo sgeg mo khro ba che/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs/ /de nas lho nub mtshams su ni/ /rdo rje phag mo sa las skyes / /khro bo phag mo'i gdong can ma/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dang mtshungs / /byang dang nub kyi mtshams su ni/ /rab tu zhi ba'i dbyangs can ma / /do skyes shin tu dmar ba'i mdog /'dod 1chags gshin rje mthar 'joms gzugs/ /byang shar gyi ni mtshams su ni/ /go rī — ljang gu 'jigs su rung / /ru skyes phrag dog gshin rje gshed/ /gzugs dang mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i mchog /sngon po'i g.yas ni dkar ba dang / /dkar po'i g.yas ni sngo ba dang / /de gnyis kyi g.yon dmar po ste/ /de las gzhan pa sngo dkar po/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mtshams bzhi ru/ /na yo ni ra thod pa'o/ /grub nas rab spro blo ldan gyis/ /ji skad brjod pa'i rang sngags kyis/ /sthāḥsgoḥ la sogs sngags kyi sgras/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo yang dag bskul/ /sprul pa mtha' yas spros pa yis/ /sems can don mchog byas nas ni/ /rang gi lus la thams cad kyis/ /khro bo dpa' bo thams cad dgod/ /dzi na dzika ces bya ba 'dis/ /shar du gti mug mthar byed pa/ /rtsibs kyi rtsa ba la gnas pa/ /sna tshogs chu skyes zla bar dgod/ /ratna dhrika 4ces bya ba 'dis/ /lho rtsibs chu skyes nyi ma la/ /phra ma zhes bya drangs nas ni/ /cho ga bzhin du dgod par bya'o/ /ā lharo '-ika 24—10

ces bya ba 'dis/ /'dod chags gshin rje sel byed pa/ /nub rtsibs 'dam skyes nyi ma la/ /cho ga bzhin du rnam par bsam/ /pradzñā dṛka ces bya ba 'dis//phrag dog gshin rje zad byed pa/ /byang rtsibs chu skyes nyi ma la/ /cho ga bzhin du dgod par bya/ /muṅgar dhrika ces shebya ba yis/ /shar sgor chu skyes nyi ma la/ / tho ba'i byematha' 'joms za byed pa/ /blo dang ldan pas bsam par bya/ /daṇḍa byeka pa'i sngags 'di yis/ /lho yi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /dbyug pa gshin rje 'dul thudaka' ba/ /sna tshogs chu skyes nyi mar dgod/ /padma dhrika ces bya ba 'dis/ /padma gshin rje gshed 'joms pa/ /nub sgor chu skyes nyi ma la/ /gtum po stobs chen bsgom par bya/ /kharge byeka ces bya ba 'dis/ /ral gri gshin rje zad par byed/ /sna tshogs padma nyi mar bsam/ /byang du bdud ni 'joms pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshams bzhi la/ /lha mo bsgom bya de bzhin mchog /shar lho lha mo sems ma ste/ /gtum mo mdzes ma'i 'od zer can//mo ha ra ti zhes sngags kyis/ /sna tshogs chu skyes zla bar gnas/ /de nas lho nub rdo rje mo/ /phag mo rigs kyi gtso mo ste/ /dzwa ṣa ra ti de nyid 'dis/ /padma zla bar mkhas pas dgod/ /de nas nub byang mtshams su ni/ /zla bar dbyangs can dgod par bya/ /rā ga ra ti'i sngags 'di yis/ /de nas byang shar go rī ste/ /badzra ra ti'i phyasngags 'di yis/ /zla bar oṃ gyis mtshan pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor grwa bzhi ru/ /de nyid gsum gyi thod pa'o/ /'di ltar spro bya dkyil 'khor bcas/ /brtan par byas nas bde ldan pa/ /sngon gyi 'khor lo der thim par/ /mnyam par gzhag 6pas blta bar bya/ /'di ni shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /24—11

mig dang sku sogs ngo bo la/ /lha rnams byin gyis brlab par bya/ /kṣiṃ las 'khor lo gti mug mdangs/ /cung zad khro bo snyemig la ni/ /rdo rje mig dgod blo ldan gyis/ /rna bar dzee yig rdo rje las/ /rdo rje rna ba nag po'i mdangs/ /sna ru khaṃ yig rin chen 'byung / /phra ma zhes bsgrags dang mtshungs pa/ /zla bar rdo rje sna tshogs so/ /lce la ram̐ zhes padma las/ /rdo rje lce byung padmar song / /'dod chags gshin rje mdangs ldan pa'o/ /kai byes ral gri las byung ba/ /rdo rje sku ste zla bar gnas/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs/ /dpral bar sku yi lus can no/ /lte ba'i steng du saṃ las skyes/ /thugs kyi rdo rje de bzhin mchog /khro bo sgeg pa'i gzugs can ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam par dgod//yan lag drug la dgod pa ni/ /mngon shes sgrub /snyepa'i don du bshad/ /snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje dbus/ /hūṃ gnas rdo rje sngon po'i mdangs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje gshin rje gshed/ /kha dog phyag mtshan yang dag ldan/ /mgrin par āḥyig padma las/ /slar yang padma las byung ba/ /'dod chags gshin rje gshed 'dra'i lus/ /dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje bsam/ /spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo ste//oṃ dang 'khor lo dkar po'i mdangs/ /sku yi rdo rje sku dbang phyug /phyag dang kha dog mtshan ma mchog /de nyid gsung gi rdo rje mchog /rdzogs nas nam mkhar gnas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas mchod nas sngags bye kyis ni/ /de rnams byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa lha kolhahaṃ/oṃ sarba 4ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa lha kopho5haṃ/ oṃ sarba 'uta thā ga ta kā ya 24—12

badzra swa bhā wa ātā kolhahaṃ byesna/ rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /sna tshogs gnas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas/ /mdun du bltas nas de rnams las/ /rnam par spros pa gang yin pa/ /sems ma la sogs slar yang ni/ /zla mdangs bum pa bzung nas ni/ /de rnams bkra shis tshigs bcad dang / /de bzhin snyan pa glu yi sgras/ /dbang bskur bar ni bsam par bya/ /bdag dang gzhan nyid thams cad la/ /spyi bor gshin rje nag por ro/ /rdo rje can rnams bdag spyi bor/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis / /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ /bdag mdun bltas nas khro bos ni/ /bgegs bskrad nas ni bsrung ba dang / /argha zhabs bsil la sogs 'bul ju bhe/ /oṃ muṅga ra 5dzaḥzhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis dgug go/ /oṃ daṇḍa hūṃ zhes pa 'dis gzhug go/ /oṃ padma baṃ zhes pa 'dis bcing ngo oṃ khaṅga hoḥzhes pa 'dis dbang du bya'o/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bkug nas gzhug /snying gar zhu bar bltas nas ni/ /rang snying padma'i lte ba la/ /zla ba las byung lha mo'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs me tog yo byad tshogs/ /lag pa'i 'dab mas bzung nas ni/ /mchod pa'i glu ni yid 'ong ba/ /sna tshogs gar gyi bye brag dang / /bde ba chen po ster ba yi/ /'gying dang bcas pas mchod par bya/ /e ma kye kye bla ma gshin rje gshed nag po/ /srin po'i gzugs kyi rang bzhin gang / /da ni khyod mthong bas 'jigs pas/ /bla ma khro ba'i 3rang bzhin dor/ /sa stengs 6sa bla sa 'og rnams/ /khyod kyis gar byas pas ni 'dar/ /mig sman bdar nag khro bo'i 7yid/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs gzugs/ /gnag cing 2sgom pa yi ni tshad/ /rnam pa mang 24—13

po'i gzugs sprul byed/ /rdo rje dbyangs can 'dud par byed/ /khyod ni gar mdzod bde ba che/ /khyod ni dīḥbyeḥsngags kyi sgras/ /khams gsum pa yi 'khrul pa sol/ /rje btsun snying rje yis ni khro/ /khyod ni 'go bltas gar byed pa/ /oṃ sarba 1 ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha haṃ/ brag ca dang mtshungs thams cad ni/ /sgra yi grong rnams rnam bltas nas/ /'khor lo can ni de rnams kyis/ /de bzhin gtso bos de rnams so/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin can / /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin / /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phra mo 4rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /rdo rje thugs bzhin rab gsal ba/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /thams cad dbyangs mchog dam pa mchog /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog dngos po'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po 5las kun byed/ /rdo rje sku bzhin rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu sdud/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug phyag 'tshal bstod/ /a yig las bskyed dag pa ni/ /mgo bo gsum gyi steng na gnas/ /padma'i snod ni rab rdzogs nas/ / de 'og 6me yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /ram̐ las byung ba gru gsum mo//de 'og rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo skyes sngon po gzhu yi dbyibs/ /g.yo ba'i 'phan gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de la ming yig dang po skyes/ /de ni rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ /da yig las skyes yang dag byung / /glang po la sogs lnga 27(—/ 1

po rnams/ /hūṃ skyes rdo rje'i kha chod kyis/ /da yi kha bcad bsgom par bya'o/ /rlung gis bskul ba'i me yis ni/ /de yang zhu bar rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje mnyam pa'i ror gyur pa/ /shin tu dri med dag par bltas/ /der ni oṃ yig 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun bkug ye shes gzugs/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis rab tu gzhug /bdud rtsi mchog lnga bltas nas ni/ /de nyid gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po tshim par bya/ /yi ge hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /lce ni rdo rje dkar por blta/ /de yi 'od zer sbu gu'i gzugs/ /de yis yang dag drangs nas ni/ /sna tshogs gnas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dkyil 'khor pa ni de bzhin mchod/ /snying gar ye shes 'od zer gyis/ /bkod nas rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /thog mtha' dbus kyi 1bye brag gis/ /'dir yang gcig tu mi rigs so/ /rdul phran cha shas med pas na/ /du mar yang ni rigs ma yin/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin gang / /gang bral de ni de bzhin min/ /'khrul gzugs de nyid ma yin pas/ /gang phyir 'khrul pa gnyis la gnas/ /ma 'khrul rtag tu bsam mi khyab/ /spro dang bsdu ba yi ni las — / /sems can don la ro gcig blo/ /'di las de nyid gzhan du med/ /ye shes zhabs sogs mchog rnams kyis/ /'di dag nyid ni gsal bar bshad/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa las/ /gsungs pa cung zad bshad par bya/ /dngos po med cing bsgom pa med/ /khams dag med byung rnam shes med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mthun pa'i gnas/ /nam mkha' bzhin du bdag med pa/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po yin/ /sa yang med cing chu yang med/ /me dang rlung yang yod ma yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i spyor ba yis/ /skye ba 'di ni rab tu 24—13

gnas / /thams cad dngos po dngos med bshad/ /dngos po med par de yis bsgrags/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor par 'byel pas/ /chad pa ma yin rtag pa min/ /phyag dang zhabs dang kha dog med/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /dngos po thams cad bden pa min/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' spangs pa/ /'di ltar dpyad na 'khor lo la/ /dam pa yang dag rtog pa spangs/ /phung po khams ni bdag med pa/ /bsgom bya bde ba dam pa'i gzugs / /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba gshin rje gshed byas nas / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /bkug nas de la song bar bsam/ /rdo rje dri ma rnged dang chos/ /ye shes lam skye dgod par bya/ /der ni rang gi sa bon rnams/ /ye shes dīḥbyeḥl sogs dgod/ /bde ba dam pa'i rnam pa mthong / /yang dag rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /spro dang bsdu ba yang dag rgyas//bdag nyid mkhas pas bzlas pa brtsam/ /sku la sogs pa spro dang bsdu/ /rim dang cig car dag kyang rung / /khro bo'i tshogs ni sprul las 1bya/ /'gro ba sthāḥbyeḥl sogs sgra/ /oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'di ltar cho ga 'di yis ni/ /bsgoms 2nas bzlas pa thams cad bya/ /zas sogs bya ba thams cad ni/ /byed 'dod blta bar brtson pa yin/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas nas/ /sems can don ni bya ba'i sems/ /de nyid gsum gyi cho ga yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /bdag la bdag gi 'khor lo ni / /cho ga ji ltar gzhug par bya/ /rang gi bsod nams yang dag bsags//mngon par byang chub yang dag bsngo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥzhes pa 'dis/ /gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /'di ni rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /24—16

langs nas rang gi bdag po yi/ /rnam pa'i nga rgyal byas nas 'gro/ /rnam pa thams cad dngos po kun/ /sngags kyi dngos po de bzhin du/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed po'i gzugs/ /bsgoms nas bcag pa dag tu bya/ /thun mtshams su ni rnal 'byor sogs/ /dang po rnal 'byor pas bsgom bya/ /cung zad ye shes rjes rnal 'byor/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /yang dag ye shes dbang rnam 1pas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i cho ga yis/ /thun gcig la ni bsam gtan 'dir/ /rnal 'byor pa yi spro bsdu lus/ /de nyid gsum bdag ye shes gzugs/ /rang nyid gshin rje gshed po yis/ /dbang bskur cho ga bsams pa dang / /bdud rtsi lnga yi cho ga yis/ /zas kyi bya ba bya ba dang / /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam rtog gis/ /bdag dang pha rol po yang rung / /cho ga bzhin du rtag tu mchod//dpal ldan gshin rje gshed gzugs su/ /mthong ba nyid ni byang chub che/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par byang chub ste/ /gang phyir rang gi bdag po sbyor/ /de ltar min ni 2ji ltar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pa yi grub pa mchog /ji ltar rnam pa sna tshogs nyid/ /dngos po gcig la brtags pa ste/ /grol dang bde dang sbug bsngal gnas/ /skye 'gyur las kyi bye brag las/ /rnam par mi rtog bdag nyid sems/ /bde ba dam pa mtha' yas gzugs/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo nyid / /gang phyir 'bras bu nag por 'gyur/ /sgrol 'dod 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skye dang 'chi bar bcas pa'i 'khor ba zab mo 'jigs/ /chags sdang la sogs chu srin 'khrugs pa shin tu g.yo ba lbu ba rmugs gnyid sogs/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed po bde ba'i rang bzhin nor chen sgrub thabs byas pa yis / /24—17

tshig gi snang ba grub bcas bdag gis bsod nams thob pas 'gro kun grub thob shog /tshig gi snang ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis 1mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta dā na tīrti dang / lo tsā 2ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur// //1bsdur mchan/3 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ rsha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngang /4 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉thadag5 1〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ 1〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ ('di'i 'og gi hūṃ rnams 〈〈snar 〉rol hūṃ zhes 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/) sngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shaṃ/ lta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7nan/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ad/7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byugs/ 8〈〈co 〉〉rem/6 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7lha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ngo bo/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7nan/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/7 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngagyur/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉mi/ 〈〈snar 〉zo ma/ — sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rko/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7) sha5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra dag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te'i shar/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉dri dril/ 〈〈snar 〉(yis/8 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yis/ 2〈〈snar 〉snga rgyan/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 yi ko ha/ ('di'i 'og gi wa dang wā rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal ba dang bā zhes 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/) 5〈〈pe 〉7zhug‘〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/1༷ 1〈〈snar 〉〉'dog 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ri/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ཿ/ ('di'i 'og gi hrīḥl ཿzhes pa'i :ཿrnams 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro sriḥ'es 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/) 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byuka 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas/11 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thob pa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zad/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadul/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉〉ri/ 6〈〈snar 〉ra zhag12 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgrub/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 sngags/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ko haṃ/ oṃ saza/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7྅/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mizla/13 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mosatma ko haṃ/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodabul/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ga 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/21dod18

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi grub thabs/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa ya mā ri maṇḍa la no pi ka /bod skad du / gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyi/ /dpal ldan gshin gshed dkyil 'khor gtsor/ /btud de cho ga mdor dran pa/ /de 2yi dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /dang po rnal 'byor pa 'gro ba gdon pa'i bsam pa can gyis/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la gnas la rang bzhin grub par bya ba'i phyir ram/ gzhan lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs pa de rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ gal te dkyil 'khor bri snyebar 'dod na/ rnal 'byor bzhi sngon du byas la/ bsnyen pa'i cho gas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed nag po'i sngags 'bum/ gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa gzhan gyi khri bzlas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 4rjes su gnang ba mtshan ma thob pa'am/24—20

rang gi sems dag pa'i sgo nas bri bar bya'o/ /de la cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang par dkyil 'khor gyis sbyang bar bya'o/ /gtor ma sbyin zhing mchod pa sna tshogs nye bar byas la/ rnal 'byor bzhi dang ldan pa'i grogs dang bcas pas/ oṃ bhu khaṃ hūṃzhes bya ba'i sngags kyis nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bya'o/ /hūṃ lo hūṃ zhes bya bas nor 'dzin tsosnardo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ me di mbi badzī bha wa — badzra banta hūṃ thuzhes bya bas de nyid du rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i gshin rje mthar byed nag po'i gzugs kyis snyerdo rje dang / dril bus byel ba'i hūṃphyag rgya dang ldan pa la gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis/ slob ma bzhi lag pa na rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pas / gsol ba gdab bo/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /phra ma rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod—/ /rdo rje thugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag 'tshal bstod / /'dod chags rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas brnyes/ /dbyings dzwamachog kun gyi gtso bo'i gtso/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun pa/ /rdo rje sku dang rab tu mtshungs/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsnyus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod//gshin rje 'jigs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor gyur pa / /sdig pa thams cad 'jig byed pa'i/ /mgon po dkyil 'khor bri bar 24—21

mdzod / /de rnams kyis dbyangs gcig tu gsol ba btab par rig nas/sems can gyi khams ma lus pa 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas gzir bar bltas te/ nyon mongs pa rnams bsal ba'i phyir/ hūṃ badzod 3tiṣṭha zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis rang gi rdo rje gsor la/ yi ge ma las mig g.yon pa zla ba ṭa las mig g.yas pa nyi mar byas pas dus dang phyogs kun gsal bar byas nas/ rnal 'byor pas khams gsum ma lus pa la blta zhing / rkang pa'i 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba bsgoms la/ rdo rje gsor ba nyid kyis/ rdo rje 'gros kyi gar dang / 'khor lo'i sa bskor bar bya'o/ /mgur na dīḥbyeḥl sogs pa sgrogs pa'i sgras/ dkyil 'khor gyi bgegs skrag par byas la/nyon cig lha tshogs bgegs kyi tshogs/ /lus ngag yid la gnas pa rnams/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag /srung ba'i 'khor lo spyor ba yis/ /rdo rje lus ni mdangs ldan pas/ /lus sogs gsum skyes 'jig 4par byed/ /gal te nga la 'gas brnyas na/ /'dir ni de gzhom gzhan du min/ /rdo rje'i gnas su 'khor lo dang / /rin po che dang / padma dang / ral gri rab tu bkod la brjod par 5bya'o/ /sa yongs su gzung 6ba byas pa'i rjes la/bgegs med par bya ba'i phyir phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /de la phur bu'i 7sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ gha gha 8ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭhan 9phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūṃ badzra shī la badzra dha ro ā 7dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bispyo rka kā ya bāka tsitta badzra khri la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'og dang steng dang phyogs mtshams kyi bgegs thams cad ral gri gshin rje gshed kyi phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar sa yongs su gzung ba byas te/ sa bgegs zhi bar byas pas 21—22

mthong nas/ phyogs mtshams 'bar ba'i 'od kyis mtshams bcad pa byas te/phyi rol du sa'i lha mo mdog ser ba/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lus kyi phyed byung ba/ phyag g.yas pa khas len pa'i lag pa lta bu g.yon na bum pa 'dzin pa—/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs kyis mchod la sta gon du gnas par bya'o/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur 1/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /theg pa spyod pa'i khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin snela'o/ /ji ltar shākya seng ge yis / /bdud kyi stobs rnams bcom pa ltar/ /bdag gis bdud kyi stobs bcom ste/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya/ /de nas de nyid du zhugs par bsam par bya ste/ sa sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /de nas yang de nyid la dris nye bar byugs la/ me tog sna tshogs kyis dgram par bya'o/ /lha'i gnas rnams su tsandan la sogs pa'i maṇḍal bya'o/ /de nyid du snying ga'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis 'khor lo bkug la mtshams bcad pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / bdud rtsi myang ba la sogs pa yang bya'o/ /de nas rkang pa g.yas pa'i pus mo sa la btsugs 5la/lag pa g.yas par spos snod thogs te/ 'khor lo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed 6rdo rje/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mgon po bdag nyid bri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma la ni brtse phyir dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni bcom ldan khyed la gus/ /dgyes par mdzad pa'i 'os lags so/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /'gro ba'i 'khor lo bya ba'i phyir/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /24—23

gzhan yang gsang sngags lha nyid dang / /'jig rten skyong dang 'byung po dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis rjes bstan pa/ /bstan la dga' ba'i sems can dang / /gang dag rdo rje'i mig can rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bdag ming 'di/ /gshin rje gshed nag dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba dag phyir bri bar bgyi/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod kyis/ /rjes su brtse ba nye bar stsol/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa dang / /dkyil 'khor pa yi grogs kun la/ /nye bar mdzad par 'os pa lags/ /de ltar lan gsum kyi bar du byas nas/ 'khor lo de yang dag par mchod de/ nam mkha' la dgod par bya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa nyi ma dang zla ba'i mig can yi ge dza las dbyung ba gti mug rdo rje gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i sa bon las byung ba/ de'i kha dog can nyi shu rtsa lngar dbye bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur tsam bya ste/ sgo'i nyi shu cha dri zhim pa lngas rnam par byugs pa'o/ /skud pa 'khal ba ral gri gshin rje gshed dang lhan cig skud pa bsgrim par bya'o/ /'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis lcags kyus bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bcug la/ oṃ dīpta dṛṣṭi saṃ ku sha dzaḥzhes bya ba'i sngags 'di dang / oṃ aḥpra yatstsha mo hā kā lā ri swā tsakra sru ri1tra na ya hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /zhe sdang dus kyi dgra la gsol ba gdab pa/ oṃ aX.a spyo tyā nu ga ta sarba dharmā2ཿpa ra spa ra a nu ga ta sarba dharmaḥ a tyant+ra nu pra biṣṭa 4sarba dharmā hūṃ zhes brjod de/ thig skud 'dzin pas yi ge dza dza dza zhes rang gis bskul zhing bton la/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis lte ba'i steng du thig skud bzung ste / nub tu 'dug la shar du mngon par phyogs pa dang / shar du 'dug ste nub tu mngon par phyogs pa dang / lhan sbug nam mkha'i thig gdab par bya'o/ /24—24

yang 'og gi thig gdab par bya ste/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sru hūṃtra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/sems can rnams kyi don du khyod/ /yang ni dus 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes bya ba dang / thig skud kyi sgras nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul la/ shar dang nub tu tshangs thig gdab par bya'o/ /byang du mngon par phyogs pa dang / lhor mngon par phyogs pas/ lho dang byang gi tshangs thig gdab par bya'o/ /mer 'dug la gnod spyin du bltas pa dang / dbang ldan du 'dug la yi dwags su bltas te/ shar gyi rtsa ba'i thig gdab bo/ /rlung gi phyogs su 'dug la/ yi dwags su bltas pa dang /bden bral du 'dug la gnod sbyin du bltas te/ nub phyogs kyi rtsa ba'i thig gdab bo/ /mer 'dug la klu phyogs su bltas pa dang / bden bral du 'dug ste / dbang por bltas pas/ lho phyogs kyi rtsa ba'i thig gdab bo/ /rlung gi phyogs su 'dug la dbang por phyogs pa dang / dbang ldan du 'dug la klu phyogs su bltas pas/ byang phyogs kyi rtsa ba'i thig gdab bo/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis tshangs thig gi phyogs gnyis kar thig bdun bdun gdab bo/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi phyi rol gyi 'gram du/ thig drug gi rgyab la ni rta babs ci rigs pa'i thig go/ /mtshams kyi thig gnyis kyang ngo / /thig de nyis 2bltab tu byas pas dbang ldan mtshams nas brtsams la/ skor phyogs su 'khor lo'i rnam par rdo rje'i phreng ba'i thig gnyis gdab bo/ /phyogs kun kyang mnyam par mos par bya'o//'dir da / mtshan ma ngan mthong mi 'grub bo/ /thig sgud chad na bla ma 'chi/ /phyogs rmongs 'khrul na slob ma'o/ /lhag chad las nad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ thig bzhi dang mnyam par ldan pa/24—25

do shal dang se mo do dang / dar dpyangs kyis brgyan pa/ mtshams dang sgo khyud dang / 'gram rnams la rdo rje rin chen gyis mdzes par byas pa'o/ /de lta bu ni phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /yang nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi cha gru bzhi pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la/ rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /de nyid dang rjes su mthun pa'i sgo'i bar du'o/ /blo dang ldan pas rtse mo lnga rnam par bsams la/ yi ge dhīḥlas khro bo blta'o1/ /sgo ni dkyil 'khor brgyad cha ru/ /bdag nyid chen pos shes par bya/ /kha khyer chen po ma gtogs par/ /shin tu mdzes pa yid 'ong ba'o/ /sgo khyud sgo dang 'drar shes bya/ /de bzhin lha yi snam bu ste/ /rdo rje'i lha mor yang dag ldan/ /glu dang rol mo la sogs gar/ /kha khyer sgo yi phyed yin te/ /sgo khyud la sogs dra ba dang / /dra phyed nyi ma zla ba dang / /me tog dag gi phreng ba yang / /tshon rtsi'i snam bu de yi phyed/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi phyi rol lo/ /rin chen ka ba sogs snam bu/ /mnyam pa'i sa la tshon rtsi sbyin/ /rta babs sgo yi sum 'gyur te/ /ba dan dril bur ldan pa rnams—/ /dril bur bcas pa rlung bskyod pa'o/ /ba dan phyi yi mtshams nyid du / /gzhan rnams 'khor lo'i rjes mthun par/ /ji ltar mdzes par rab tu brtag /khru gang nyid ni mnyam sbyin zhing / /ji srid khru ni stong gi bar/ /de bzhin du ni rim pa 'dis/ /snga ma bzhin du mnyam par thig btab nas/rim pa snga ma bzhin du rdul tshon kyi cha dag bteg cing bzung la 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis mngon par bsngags te/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes bya bas so/ /de nas rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i gshin rje mthar byed nag po'i rnal 'byor pa/kun du rtog pa ma lus pa spangs pa/ 'khor lo'i dbus su gnas shing /24—26

dbang ldan gyi mtshams su brten nas lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bri bar bya ste/dkar po dang / ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu ste/ nag po ni nang nyid du'o / /sgo'i nyi shu cha ni tshon rtsi ste/ kun kyang sgom po la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral bar bri bar bya'o/ /de la sbom po bris na nad 'byung ngo / /phras na ni nor nyams so/ / ma sos na 1'khon 'byung ngo / /chad na ni 'chi'o/ /tshon rtsi rnams kyi bar ni nas tsam gyis tshod par bri'o/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar po che/ /lho phyogs ser po dang ldan pa/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po'o/ /byang phyogs ljang dang ldan pa'o/ /ind+ra nī la'i 'od ldan pa/ /dbus kyi cha ni mnyam par bri/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas su/ /lha'i gnas thams cad du sna tshogs padma'o/ /dkyil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa 'byos pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi rtse mo'i rtsa ba la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi rtsibs kyi rtsa ba la/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i rin po che cha dgu pa'o/ /nub phyogs kyi rtsibs kyi rtsa ba la/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /byang gi phyogs kyi rtsibs kyi rtsa ba la ral gri ljang gu'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i me mtshams su 'khor lo'o/ /bden bral mtshams su rdo rje'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su padma'o/ /dbang ldan mtshams su ral gri'o/ /shar sgor ni rdo rje tho ba rtsibs nyi shu pa'o/ /lhor sgor ni dbyug pa dkar po'o/ /nub sgor ni padma dmar po'o/ /byang sgor ral gri'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams bzhir ni / padma'i snod bzhi bri bar bya ste/ rdul tshon dgye ba'o/ /de ltar yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la bltas la/ sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rang dang mtshungs pa'i yan 2‘1—27

lag dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi bdag po nyid du gnas te/ de'i sems kyis nam mkha'i khams khyab par dkyil 'khor sgrub cing spros pa gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bkod de/ mig la sogs pa dang / lus la sogs pa byin gyis brlab cing / bdag nyid dbang bskur ba'i cho gas dbang bskur bar bya'o//ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la argha la sogs pa dbul zhing khro bo rnams kyis 1dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang 3/ dbang du byas la mchod pa dang bstod pa dang / bdud rtsi myong ke ba yang bya'o/ /bzlas pa dang bsgom pa dang / mnyes pa yang bya'o/ /phyogs skyong ba rnams la yang gtor ma dang mchod pa dbul te/ /bdag nyid kyis dkyil 'khor bskor zhing phyag kyang bya ste/ 'di lta bu ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs so/ /de nas bum pa bco brgyad gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor du bzhag /padma'i snod bzhi yang gzhag 4go/ /las thams cad kyi mtshan ma gdab/ mgrin pa gos kyis dkri/ tsu ta la sogs pa'i kha rgyan dang ldan par bya/ rin po che lnga dang sman lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang ldan pa de dag kyang / sngags las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par bltas la/ de rnams su ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang zhing / argha la sogs pa phul te/ dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang dbang du byas la mchod pa la sogs pa dbul lo/ /me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa'i rdo rje steng rnams su bzhag la/ sngags pa de srid 'dod kyi bar du dus gsum du bzla zhing / 'khor lo de chu de nyid kyi rnam par mthong bar bya'o/ /de lta bu ni bum pa sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas ma tshang ba la sogs pa'i skyon zhi bar bya ba'i phyir dang / yon 24—28

bdag gi bsod nams mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de la zhi ba'i thab khung bzhin du las thams cad pa'i thab khung bya ste/ khru gang gi tshad tsam la/ zabs su khru phyed brko ba 1ma gtogs pa rgya dang / 'phang du sor bzhi pa'i kha khyer padma rgyas pa'i rnam pa lta bus bskor ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol du kha khyer sor gnyis pas gru bzhir bskor bar bya'o/ /de'i mtshams la zla ba phyed pa'i steng du rdo rje rtse gsum pa'o/ /thab khung gi dkyil du sor brgyad kyi tshad la rtse mo rnams la sor re re yod pa'i zhe sdang rdo rje rtse lnga pa bri'o/ /shar dang / lho dang / nub dang / byang du 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang /padma dang / ral gri sor drug gi tshad tsam bri'o/ /tshon rtsi dkar pos steng du bri'o—/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ bsreg pa'i rdzas ma lus pa g.yas ngos su bzhag 2la/ bsang gtor gyi chu'i snod la sogs pa g.yon phyogs su gzhag glugo/ /bram ze'i khyem mam/ dge 'dun kyi g.yos khang nas me blangs la/ 'o ma can gyi shing rab tu sbar bar bya ste/ srog chags la gnod pa spang bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yongs su gyur pa sngon du song ba'i sna tshogs padma'i steng du re zilas byung ba'i me lha sgu mdog dkar po zhal gsum pa gnyug mar gnas pa'i rig pa dang / gnyis su med pa'i sku phyag g.yas na spyi blugs bsnams lasnye/ gnyis pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ g.yon na dbyig gu rtse gsum pa bsnams pa gnyis pa na phreng 6ba bsnams pa/ gzhan dag na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa bsgoms la/ snying ga na gnas pa'i sa bon las ye shes kyi me dgug ste/ oṃ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥzhes bya ba'i sngags kyis ku sha'i chun pos 24—29

bsang gtor la sogs pa dbul zhing / dam tshig 'jug pa dang / mchod pa la sogs bya ste/ de'i zhal du yi ge ram̐ bkod la sreg snardzas byur bu dbul lo/ /drugs gzar dang dgang gzar gyi mchu dang / mchu la yang rim pa bzhin bsgoms te sreg rdzas thams cad dbul lo/ /phyis de'i snying gar gshin rje mthar byed kyi rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsams te/mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang ba la sogs pa byas la/ mchod pa la sogs pa dbul te/ de'i zhal du yi ge ram̐ bsgoms la/ oṃ agha ye swā hā/ zhes bya bas/ mar gyis bkang ba'i sreg drugs dbul lo/ /oṃ sarba pā pa da ha na badzā ya sarba pā pa ni da ha swā hā/zhes bya bas ni drur 2ba'o/ /oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ zhes bya bas ni 'bras ma god pa'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zhes bya bas ni zho'o/ /oṃ a phra ti ha ta badzā ya swā hā/ zhes bya bas ni ku sha'o/ /oṃ bo bye prikṣu 4ya swā hā/ zhes bya bas ni a shwaṅga'o/ /oṃ badzra ku bee rā ya swā hā/ zhes bya bas 5ni n+ya gro dha'o/ /oṃ badzra yadzñā ya swā hā/ zhes bya bas ni u dusthā 6ra'o/ /oṃ sa ha ka rā ya swā hā/zhes bya bas ni a mra'o/ /shing las byung ba ma yin pa'i sreg rdzas gzhan dag ni/rang gi 'dod pa'i lha sngags kyi man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du bsgul ba'i tshig dang ldan pas/ bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bsgrubs la bsreg par bya'o/ /de nas 'thor 'thung dang / zhabs bsil dang / me tog dri zhim po la sogs pa dang /na bza' dang / so rtsi dang bshos rnams phul nas/ 'dod pa'i dngos po blangs la/ yi ge muḥ'i mtha' can kyi yi ge gsum gyis gshegs su gsol lo/ /rdzas lhag ma rnams kyang sngar bzhin 7gyi cho gas me la bsregs 8la gshegs su 21—30

gsol lo/ /sbyin sreg gi dgang gzar khru gang gi tshad la rtsa ba rdo rje rin po che dang ldan pa sor bzhi pa sor gnyis brkos pa rdo rje dang ldan pa/ padma'i 'dab ma lta bu 'byung ba'i sbubs/ mje'u chung gi tshad tsam dang bcas pa'o/ /drugs gzar ni sor gnyis tsam la sor gcig brkos pa/ rdo rje dang ldan pa/padma'i 'dab ma lta bu ste/ dgang gzar dang / blugs gzar ro/ /de nas rab gnas kyi sa gzhi gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs dang / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba dang slob dpon yang ji ltar tshogs pa'i rgyan 1sna tshogs kyis brgyan la/ sku gzugs sam/ ri mo'am glegs bam mdun du bzhag ste/ bsang gtor dang / yon chab dang /'thor 'thung phul la/ khu tshur g.yon pa'am/ gzhan du yungs kar blangs te/sku gzugs la sogs pa mdun du g.yon pa'am/ gzhan gyis lan gsum gyi bar du bskor te/ me'i nang du blugs la/ oṃ sarba pā pa nad ha na badzā ya swā hā/zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis btab pa'i kham phor gsum gyis bskor zhing g.yabs la bskur ro/ /de nas snyim pas chu blangs la me de nyid du blugs/ de nas nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la nye bar spyod pa'i mchod pa rnam pa lngas yang dag par mchod de rnam par rtog pa thams cad spang zhing spos snod bzung la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sta gon du gnas pa'i phyir/dam tshig can khyod kyis bdag la dam tshig stsol cig ces lan gsum du brjod de/ji ltar yang dag rdzogs sangs kun/ /dga' ldan gnas su bzhugs nas ni/ /lha mo sgyu ma'i mngal 'jug pa/ /de bzhin 'dir yang bzhugs su gsol/ /mgon po 'dir ni rtag bzhugs nas/ /me tog la sogs 'di 4bzhes la/ /24—3/

mi 'di'i don ni gzung phyir dang / /byang chub sems ni brtan par mdzod/ /de nas gti mug rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bstod pa bya'o/ /lha sta gon du gnas nas tho rangs kyi dus 1sgu gzugs gos ser pos g.yogs la/ kha shar phyogs su bstan te khrus bya'o/ /de la rim pa ni 'di yin te/ ba'i rnam pa lnga la / oṃ hūṃ ṭwāṃ nadhīḥ.aḥzhes bya ba'i sa bon gyis mngon par bsngags pas bsgus la / de nas dri zhim po'i snum la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/zhes bya bas bsngags te/ drur ba'i chang bus byug par bya'o/ /de nas shun pa lnga 'khar 4ba'i snod du bzhag la snum phyi'o/ /de'i rjes la rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa nas brtsams te/ bum pa so so'i chus khrus gsol lo/ /ji ltar bltams ma thag tu yang / /de bzhin gshegs kun sku bkrus ltar/ /lha rdzas chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sgu khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rbha ṣe ka te 5sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /de'i rjes la nam mkha' la tsartsi 6ka la sogs pa rig pa'i tshogs rnams bkug nas/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i 7chus gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa de rnams kyis de mngon par dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas gos kyis rlan med par phyis la/ dang po'i gnas su gzhag go/ /ras ris 9sam glegs bam mam/ mchod rten chen po rnams ni me long la snga ma bzhin du sgu khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /de lta bu ni —khrus gsol ba'i rim pa'o/ /de nas mig la sogs pa dang / lus la sogs pa byin gyis brlab cing / bdag nyid dbang bsgur la/ rigs kyi gtso bo cod 11pan nyid du bzhag cing / nam mkha' la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par dmigs la/ yon chab la sogs pa 24—32

dbul zhing dam tshig la gzhug par bya'o/ /glegs bam la ni yi ge'i gzugs nyid 'gyur ba na tshobaza' dbul te/ oṃ badzra bant+ra ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa dbul te/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūṃ/chu dang thang las 2skyes pa yi/ /me tog gtso bo mchog 'di dag /gus pa mchog gis bdag 'bul na/ /ji ltar bde bas bzhes su gsol/ /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug pa'i dri yi mchog 'di dag /gus pa mchog gis bdag 'bul na/ /ji ltar bde bas bzhes su gsol/ /zhun mar 'bru mar snang ba 'di/ /lha rdzas 'od 'bar mun pa 'jig /bdag nyid dang bas 'bul lags na/ /mi shes pa kun bsal du gsol/ /bza' bca' kun dang bcas pa yi/ /kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa'i—/ /bshos gtsang dam pa bdag 'bul na/ /'di dag thams cad bzhes su gsol/ /de ltar mngon par bsngags pa'i me tog la sogs pa dbul lo/ /phyi nas sku gzugs kyi byin dbye ste/ dngul gyi snod na yod pa'i mar dang / sbrang rtsi gser kyi thur mas blangs la/ oṃ badzra tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon pas dril bu dpol la / gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i bstod pa bya ste/de lta bu ni rab gnas kyi cho ga'o/ /gang gi tshe snying rje mchog gi dbang du gyur cing dbang bskur la sogs pas slob ma bsnyu bar 'dod na/ de'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi gnas kyi phyi rol du/rigs dang gzugs dang lang tsho dang / dad pa dang / thos pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa/ don du gnyer ba'i slob ma lag tu me tog thogs te dkyil 'khor 24—33

la phyag byas pa dang / gzhan yon tan med pa yang sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gnas pa/chos bshad pas spro ba bskyed do/ /rjes su gnang ba bzhi po'am/ /rang gi bslab pa ldan pa'i 'khor/ /jeg pa chen po'i blo can la/ /sangs rgyas yang dag cho ga gsungs/ /sngags kyi dngos grub mtshan ma'am/ /'ga' zhig zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /de bzhin bsod nams 'dod la gzhan/ /'jig rten phyi ma theg mchog dang / /mang du 'jig rten pha rol don/ /byas nas dad ldan blo dag byed/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras spangs nas/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i 'bras 'dong la/ /gang phyir 'di la phan mang ba/ /'di med 'jig rten pha rol pa/ /de phyir 'jig rten gzhan grub phyir/ /khyed kyi bstan pa yid kyis bgyis/ /de ltar smras nas zhi bar 'jug pas rdo rje dang padma dag par byas pa la gsol ba gdab bo/ /bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub chen po'i lam bstan pa/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par tshogasol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod de/ gus pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma la 'di ltar gtsor byas la brjod do/ /sngags spyod tshul kyi cho ga yis/ /theg chen 'di ni bu khyod shog /khyod ni jeg pa chen po'i snod/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags mthu nyid kyis/ /ye shes mnyam pa med pa brnyes/ /shākya seng ge 24—37

sogs mchog gis/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pas/ /gang gis stobs chen bdud kyi sde/ /shin tu 'jigs pa che 1bcom nas/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug bkod pa yis/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de phyir bu khyod blo yis 'dir/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid thob par gyis/ /zhes gsol ba 'debs pa la smras nas/ byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir dang / skyes pa rnams yang dag par spyor bar bya ba'i phyir/ de dag shin tu 'dod par byas la/ de'i snying gar yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje/ mgrin par yi ge āḥlas padma/ spyi bor yi ge oṃ las 'khor lo/ de rnams su sa bon dgod pa ni ༄ hūṃ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod la/ dri zhim por bcas pa'i chu rdo rje'i khu tshur gyis gzung nas mgrin par bsgu'o/ /de nas de dag gi mgo la me tog sbyin no/ /dri dang byug pa ni mdun du'o/ /mar me mdun du'o/ /thams cad la las thams cad pa'i sngags bzla'o/ /de nas chags pa la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i so shing rtse mo me tog can sbyin no/ /des kha shar phyogs su bltas te/bca' shing ba lang gi pags pa tsam gyis phyogs ba lang gi lci bas byugs par dor ro / /de nas de lhang ba dang zhi ba la sogs pa grub pa'i mtshan ma de la bstan par bya'o/ /de nas chu khyor ba gsum gyis kha bshal te/ oṃ dhīḥbi shudheḥsarba dharmā pā pa nī tsā lya sho dha ya sarba bi kal paṃ 4a pa na ya 5hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /stan dang sngas 6su ku sha gding ngo / /de'i tshad sum 'gyur gyi sgud pas bcings te/ las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pas bsrung 7ngo / /de nas / thams cad mkhyen nyid 'jig rten du/ /brgya la 'byung ngam mi 'byung 'gyur / /u dum bā 8ra'i rnge tog kyang / /res 'ga' res 'ga' 'byung ba 24—35

srid / /gsang sngags tshul la gnas pa yang / /de bas kyang ni rnyed par dka' / /gang gis sems can dpag med don/ /nus par mdzad las 'das pa dang / /bskal pa du ma dpag med du/ /gang gis sdig pa sngon byas pa / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong bas ni/ /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur bas/ /sngags spyod tshul la gnas pa dang / /mnyam par gyur pas gzhan ci yod/ /tshe 'di nyid la sngags bzlas pas/ /bla med gnas su 'gro 'gyur te//sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas ni de dag spangs/ /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur bas/ /de dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu brtan gyur nas/ /khyod ni de ring rnyed pa mchog /bdag nyid chen po rnyed par 'gyur/ /gang gis rgyal ba thams cad ni/ /sras dang bcas pas bstan pa 'di/ /khyod kyi kun gyis yongs bzung ste/ /gnas nas bdag nyid chen po la/ /gang gis khyod ni jeg chen las/ /'dir ni 'go bar 'gyur ba yin/ /lam 'di mchog ste dpal dang ldan/ /theg pa chen po snang ba che/ /gang gis khyod ni 'gro 'gyur bas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur / /zhes bstan nas/ ku sha bting ba la bzhag la rmi lam cung zhig mthong na'ang nga la tho rangs khyod kyis zlos shig ces bya ste/ 'di ni slob ma sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /gal te mi dge ba'i mtshan ma zlos na de'i tshe/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis brdeg par bya'o/ /yang des bsrungs la sdom pa 'dzin du bcug ste/dkyil 'khor phyir mi ldog hūṃpa'i dbang / /gsal ba mgon pos bdag la stsol/ /dkyil 'khor lha dag bstod pa dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las dag dang / /24—36

sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /gsang ba'i sdom pa bla med rnams/ /slob dpon gyis ni bdag la stsol/ /rtag tu sems can don bgyid do/ /zhes brjod nas/ bdag dang slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga yin te/ dang po slob dpon dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang thams cad rdzogs par bya ste/ rjes su gnang ba thob nas/ yol ba'i phyi rol du yon phul ba'i slob ma dbang bskur ba'i snod du gyur pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi gzugs su dmigs la/ ā 1khaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzla zhing me tog gi phreng ba bzung ste/ mig gnyis bkab pa las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis btab pa'i chus bsangs te/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir/ khyod gang la dga' ba yin zhes dri'osne / /des kyang skal bzang bdag ni bde ba chen po la'o zhes brjod do/ /de ma thag tu oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta udmā da yā —/mi zhes bya bas rnal 'byor gyi sems bskyed par bya'o / /de nas me tog gi phreng ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/oṃ su ra te sa ma ya ṭwāṃ ho tiṣṭha badzra ya thā su khaṃ zhes bya'o/ /de nas sngar bstan pa'i yi ge lnga brjod cing / yol ba'i nang du bkug la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /de ring khyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis de bas na ye shes rdo rje de ngas bskyed par bya'o/ /ye shes gang gis de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyang 'thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyed 4kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas de'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /gal te khyod kyis 'di 'ga' la/ /smras na mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid ni/ /de ring khyod kyi snying 24—37

la gnas/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de yi mod la bkas nas gshegs/ /zhes bya ba 'dis mna' bsgag 1go/ /tsandan dang gur kum bsres pa'i chu la oṃ badzra u da ka ṭhaḥ2zhes lan bdun gyi bar du bzlas la/ 'di ni dmyal ba'i chu yin te/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs 4na 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung moshig /ces brjod la blud do/ /de nas 'di skad brjod de/ de ring phan chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ngas gang smras pa de khyod kyis mibya ba yin no/ /nga la brnyas par ma byed cig / nyam nga ba 7ma spangs par 'chi ba'i‘dus byas nas/ dmyal bar ltung bar ma byed cig ces brjod do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byen kyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /zhes brjod do//de'i spyi bor yi ge baṃ las byung ba'i bum pas mtshan ma dkar po chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkyil du ha'o/ /snying gar lo las byung ba'i dbang chen kyi dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshams su mtshan pa de la hūṃ ngo / /lte bar re las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dmar po shin tu rno zhing tsha ba de la ā'o/ /rkang pa'i 'og tu yi las byung ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i rnam pa lta bu g.yo ba'i ba dan phyed pas mtshan pa de la dzhaiḥdrag cing rno ba 'bar ba'i phung po de rlung gi bum par bsams la ji srid me'i dkyil 'khor gzhan gyi bar du'o/ /de dag g.yos par gyur nas 'bar zhing byung bas dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor yang 'bar bar gyur to/ /de nas chu'i dkyil 'khor las dag cing gtsang ba'i rgyun bab pas/ ngoms shing tshim par gyur nas rlung gis bteg pa dang / slob ma dang rang 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i khro bo chen po 277—38

gshin rje mthar byed sku shin tu drag po can/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gsor ba/g.yon pas dril bu 'khrol ba 'beebs pa'i sngags kyis phab ste/ spos dbul lo/ /de'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ sthāḥ byeḥwi kṛ snatā na na hūṃ 2snaphaṭa phaṭa ā be sha ya ste bhe bha ya ra ra ra ra tsā le hūṃ ha ā dzhaiḥphaṭa ces bya bas myur du phebs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du de ma thag tu dmigs la/de'i lce la yi ge āḥdamar po bsams te/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod docho/ /rdo rje chos ni mgon po che/ /'od dpag med ni bde ba che/ /smros shig 'dod chags chos chen po/ /dge dang mi dge ba de 'dri/ /babs na dge dang mi dge de/ /ngag gi brtan pa rjod par byed/ /sems ni brtan nas khams gsum dag /shes khushing lus ni brtan gyur namu/ /nam mkha' la yang 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gal te ring du 'gro 'gyur na/ /mgo bo'i gtsug tu lo las byung ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs rdo rjes kun nas mnan par bsgoms la de rengs par bya'o/ /de lta bu ni dbab pa'o/ /de nas thogs pa'i me tog de dkyil 'khor du dbul zhing pra tītstsha badzra ho zhes brjod do/ /de ltar lha gang gi gnas mtshan ma dang nye bar bab par gyur na de'i rigs yin par de la bstan par bya'o/ /gnas mchog tu bab na dngos grub mchog 'grub bo/ /gnas dkyil du ni dngos grub 'bring ngo / /gnas smad kyi las dngos grub tha ma'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu bab na dngos grub med do/ /gal te dkyil 'khor du ma bab na de yang 'phang ngo / /lan gsum 'phangs kyang de nyid du ma bab na de gzung chobar mi bya'o/ /de ni me tog dor ba'o/ /phangs shepa'i phreng ba de blangs te de'i mgo la bcings la/ sems can 24—39

stobs po che 'di longs shig rikyices brjod do/ /de nas/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid ni/ /de ring khyed kyi mig 'byed mdzad/ /de ltar mig ni thams cad 'byed/ /rdo rje mig ni bla med pa/ /zhes brjod nas gdong g.yogs dbye'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so'i ming bstan pa sngon du 'gro bas / byang phyogs kyi sgo nas brtsams te/ gtso bo'i bar du bstan par bya'o/ /de ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas chos chen po/ /rdo rje sems dpas dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag kyang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing / /nyid kyi mchog kyang stsal du gsol/ /zhes bya bas gsol ba 'debs pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma bzung la/ rdo rje tsartsi ka la sogs pas bum pas dbang bskur ro/ /rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum po yi 2phyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum pa yi gnas byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ /zhes brjod cing las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bum pa'i chu rdo rje khu tshur gyis kun nas gtor zhing / oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes brjod do / /slob ma 'khor los 4/sgyur ba bzhin du dbang bsgur ro/ /chu'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas gser ram gos las bsgrubs pa'i cod pan ji lta ba'i sngags kyis mgo'i steng du bzhag la nam mkha'i khongs su gtogs pa'i rang gi rigs kyi gzugs su cod pan la bzhugs su gsol te sbyin pa ni cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /de'i rjes la rdo rje byen la/ sangs rgyas rdo rje dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod ni dbang bskur bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje long shig 5rab 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing rdo rje snying ga la sogs par reg 'a lag pa g.yas par sbyin pa ni rdo rje'i dbang bsgur ba'o/ /24—40

de nas lag pa g.yon par dril bu byin la/ rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pa'i lag pa dag gis 'khyud pa ltar byas te/ oṃ badzra a bye pa ti ste tsho.a bhe ṣispyo 2mi tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya ste zhes brjod la sbyin te/ de ni dril bu'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nyid la bdag po'i dbang zhes kyang bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu spyi bor bzung la/ oṃ badzra satwa ste 4a bye ṣispya 5mi badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pas/ rigs dang rjes su mthun pa'i ming gdags so/ /dbang 'di dag gis sngags dang rgyud bshad pa dang /gsang sngags sgrub khupa la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni dbang lnga pa ste/ rtsa ba'i 3yin no/ /rtsa ba'i dbang thams cad la yang tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i bya ba thams cad yin pa nyid do/ /de nas rtsa ba'i dbang mnos pas slob dpon sdom pa can/ kye snying rje'i gter bdag dang gzhan gyi don nus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang de spyod kyi sku drin gyis stsal du gsol bhe zhes gsol ba gdab pa dang 9ldan pas dkyil 'khor dang nye bar rdul tshon dmar po las byas pa'i padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du gor stan la bzhag ste/ rdo rje tsartsi ka la sogs pas dbang bsgur zhing dam tshig gsum bzung — ngo / /de la dam tshig gsum ni 'di yin te/ hūṃ las rdo rje bsgoms la/ khams gsum pa yi ral gri che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa / /'di ni las kyi ral gri mchog /dgra rnams las rgyal bya phyir zung / /zhes bya bas de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje gzung ngo / /'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ /de nas āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu la shes rab dang / thabs kyi ngo bo nyid rdo rje dang dril bu 'dis 'grub par 'gyur gyis zung shig 1 /bu rdo rje khyod kyis slob ma 24—41

la yang zung shig hūṃces byas la/ de'i lag par byin te/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /sems can rang bzhin rtag tu dag /srid pa'i mchog ni byed pa yin/ /zhes bya bas de la gdams par bya ste/'di ni dril bu'i dam tshig go/ /de nas phyag rgya'i dam tshig bstan te/ yid kyi gzugs ni brtan pa nyid/ /phyag rgya yin par rab grags te/ /'di yis rang gi 'dod lha ni/ /bdag nyid phyag rgya chen por gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig go/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang lha'i de kho na nyid dang slob dpon gyi las dang dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / slob dpon 'jug pa'i bya ba bstan par bya'o/ /de la sangs rgyas dang / sangs rgyas ma yin pa bdag de kho na nyid du mnyam pas gru bzhi pa'o/ /lus dang / tshor ba dang sems dang /chos rnams gcig dang du ma dang bral bas gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa nyid la/dad pa rnam par dag pa ni shar phyogs kyi sgo'o/ /skyes pa dang ma skyes pa'i mi dge ba'i chos spang ba dang / mi bskyed —pa dang / skyes pa dang ma skyes pa'i dge ba'i chos 'phel zhing rgyas par bya ba dang / bskyed pa'i phyir rtsom pa'i las dang / rtog pa'i bdag nyid kyis brtson 'grus bzhi po rnam par dag pa ni lho'i sgo'o / /'dun pa dang brtson 'grus dang / sems dang / dpyod pa zhes bya ba rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / gang dran pa rnam par dag pa ni nub kyi sgo'o / /dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab ces bya ba dbang po lnga'i ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa ni byang gi sgo'o/ /rtog pa dang / dpyod pa dang / dga' ba dang / bde ba dang sems rtse 24—42

gcig pa zhes bya ba bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag dang / rtog pa dang dpyod pa spangs pa bsam gtan gnyis pa dang / dga' ba yang spangs shing btang snyoms dang / dran pa dang ldan pas bsam gtan gsum pa dang / btang snyoms dang dran pa dag pa dang / snyug bsngal yang ma yin/ bde ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba bsam gtan bzhi pa rnam par dag pa ni/ rta babs bzhi'o/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / dri ma med pa dang /seng ge rnam par rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi po rnam par dag pa ni kha khyer bzhi'o/ /don dang tshig 1dang / nges tshig dang / spobs pa bzhi dang / gzungs bzhi rnam par dag pa ni kha khyer la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs so/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs pas ni rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs so/ /mdo dang dbyangs kyis 2bsnyad pa dang / lung du bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang /shin tu rgyas pa dang / rmad du byung ba gsung rab yan lag dgu gdul bya'i skye bo la bstan pa rnam par dag pa ni/ dril bu dang g.yer kha'i sgra dang ba dan no/ /dran pa dang chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang / brtson 'grus dang dga' ba dang shin tu sbyangs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang btang snyoms zhes bya ba byang chub kyi yan lag bdun rnam par dag pa ni/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang /me long dang me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab 'bar ba'o/ /nang gzugs rnged pa'i 'du shes kyis phyi rol gyi gzugs stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam par mthong ba zhes bya ba rnam par thar pa dang po dang / phyi rol gyi gzugs med pa'i 'du shes kyis nang gi gzugs de bzhin du 24—43

mthong ba zhes bya ba ni gnyis pa dang / nang dang phyi rol gyi gzugs med pa'i 'du shes kyis gzugs rnams mngon sum du nye bar rdzogs par byas te/ gnas pa zhes bya ba gsum pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi pa dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa lnga pa dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa drug pa dang /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa bdun pa dang /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ni brgyad pa ste/ 'di dag rnams dag pa ni/sna tshogs rdo rje'i zur bzhi dang logs bzhi'o/ /rdo rje 1theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng gi rim pa dang / 'byel pa'i rdo rje'i thig dang yang dag par ldan pa'o/ /'bras bu dbye bas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo shin tu mtho ba'i bye brag gis sna tshogs rdo rje'i rtse mo nyi shu'o/ /rten dang brten pa'i dbye bas sa lnga ni ngos rnams dang steng ngo / /gos pa med pa'i chos gcig dang / du ma ji ltar rigs pa rab tu ston pa ni/ lha'i gnas kyi sna tshogs padma'o/ /byang chub kyi sems yongs su smin par byed pas nyi ma'i gdan dang ldan pa'o/ /byang chub kyi sems kyi myu gu 'phel bar byed pas zla ba'i gdan dang ldan pa'o/ /snying rje'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang bas na trebum pa brgyad do/ /chos kyi 'od kyi sgron ma'i grags pa ni dri zhim pa'o / /chos kyi zas ni bshos gtsang ste/ de lta bu ni dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid do/ /lha'i de kho na nyid brjod par bya'o/ /de la rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / zhe sdang chen po shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa bsdus pas 24—44
