gnag pa ni nag po'o/ /brtags pa'i yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa nyid gshin rje mthar 7byed pa'i phyir gshin rje gshed do/ /shin tu gdug pa can drag po zhi bas mi 'dul la khro bo chen po'o/ /rnam thar sgo gsum rnam par dag pa zhal gsum mo/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pas phyag drug go/ /ser sna la sogs pa 'jig par mdzad pas rdo rje la sogs pa drug phyag na bsnams pa'o / /zhe sdang gi cha'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'jig pas sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pas rang dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes la 'khyud pa'o/ /rtag tu sems can gyi don mdzad pas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba'i ngo bo'o/ /chos kyi sku nyid kyi phyir longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i sku mdzad pa'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po dang gti mug chen po rnam par dag pa dang / rnge long lta bu'i ye shes ni bcom ldan 'das gti mug gshin rje gshed do/ /gzhan ni snga ma bzhin no/ /gti mug gi cha'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i phra ma chen po dang /tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni bcom ldan 'das phra ma gshin rje gshed do/ /lhag ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /nga rgyal gyi cha'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / 'dod chags chen po dang / 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'dod chags gshin rje gshed do/ /'dod chags kyi cha'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / phrag dog chen po dang / 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang /bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes ni bcom ldan 'das phrag dog gshin rje gshed do/ /phrag dog gi cha'i nye ba'i 3nyon mongs pa dang / 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang /shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / phung po'i bdud la dad pa rnam par dag pa ni/24—45

bcom ldan 'das tho ba gshin rje gshed do/ /mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi rjes su mthun pa'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / mthar 'dzin par lta ba dang /'dod pa'i sgrib pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud la brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa ni bcom ldan 'das dbyug 1pa gshin rje gshed do/ /mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi rjes su mthun par nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang /lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud la dran pa rnam par dag pa ni bcom ldan 'das padma gshin rje gshed do/ /mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi rjes su mthun pa'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / skye ba'i sgrib pa dang / tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa dang / lha'i bu rnam par g.yeng byed bdud la ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa ni bcom ldan 'das ral gri gshin rje gshed do/ /sa'i khams dang thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /byams pa chen po'i ngo bo nyid rdo rje tsartsi ka'o/ /chu'i khams dang smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / snying rje chen po'i ngo bo ni rdo rje phag mo'o/ /me'i khams dang stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / dga' ba chen po'i ngo bo ni 2rdo rje dbyangs can ma'o/ /rlung gi khams dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /btang snyoms chen po'i ngo bo ni rdo rje go rī ma'o/ /phyi rol gyi gzugs la sogs pa dag pa ni thod pa bzhi'o/ /nang dri zhim pos kyang bkang ba ni/ chos kyi dbyings kun du 'gro'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa sa dang sbyar ba yang brtag par bya'o / /stobs dang ma 'dres pa la sogs pa ma bris pa ni gzhung mangs kyis 4dogs pas 'jigs pas so/ /de lta bu ni lha'i de kho na nyid do/ /de nas slob dpon gyi las te bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / bza' ba'i 21dod 6

dam tshig bsgrub 1pa rgyud de dang de dag bstan pa'o/ /bdag bsrung ba ni so so 2'brang ma'i dkyil 'khor dang sgrub 1thabs bstan pas so/ /slob dpon 'jug pa ni gtor ma byin te/ de la rnal 'byor bzhi dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis bca' ba dang / myang ba dang / btung ba bldag pa la sogs pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug yepa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu la sogs pa'i sgra chen po kun rdzob tu rdzogs pa dang bcas pa'i gtor ma shing rta bkang ba'am/ ma 'byor na nas kyi khur ba'am/ 'bras chan nyung shas tsam dang bcas pa'i chu khyor ba gsum tsam yang rung ngo / /de nas khro bo zhags pa dang lcags kyu la sogs pa thogs pa spros te/ phyogs skyong ba rnams snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung zhing / mgrin pa zhags pas bcings nas drangs par bsam mo de la oṃ juḥsgoḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba dubyen 6sa pa ri wā ra mā kārṣa thuya dzaḥzhes bya bas dbang po mig stong pa mdog dmar ser glang po che'i steng na 'dug pa/ lag pa g.yas dang g.yon rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub byas pa bkug la gzhag rego/ /sngags de nyid kyis nye dbang nam mkha' lding la zhon pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ g.yas na bsrub 9shing dang / 'khor lo/ g.yon na dung dang nor bu kau stu bha thogs pa/ de'i g.yon du ha cang mi ring bar gzhag go / /gshin rje sngon po ma te la zhon pa skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ lag pa na dbyug tsobye pa dang / sdigs mdzub can gshin rje'i phyogs su'o/ /chu bdag dkar po brang 'gro la zhon pa/ lag na klu zhags thogs pa nub phyogs su'o/ /ku bee ra nor kyi steng na 'dug 4pa ser po sa bon kyi grong khyer dang / nee'u le 24—/7

lag na thogs pa byang phyogs su'o/ /de nyid du sna can dkar po byi ba la zhon pa lag pa g.yas na phreng ba dang / sta re/ g.yon na la phug dang la du thogs pa'o / /dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa ral pa can/ mig gsum pa rtse gsum dang / thod pa thogs pa lag pa gnyis kyis go rī 1la 'khyud pa dang 1dbang ldan phyogs su'o/ /me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ lag na phreng ba dang spyi blugs thogs pa/ me'i phyogs su'o/ /srin po ro la zhon pa gri gug dang / thod pa lag na thogs pa khro zhing rngam pa sngon po bden bral du'o/ /rlung lha du ba'i mdog can ri dwags la zhon pa lag pa gnyis kyis gos thogs pa rlung gi phyogs su'o/ /zla ba dkar po ku mu da'i na steng na 'dug pa ku mu da ④lag na thogs pa steng du'o/ /nyi ma dmar po lag na padma thogs pa/ rta mchog bdun la zhon pa steng du'o/ /tshangs pa dmar po gzhan du ser po yod/1 gdong bzhi khupa lag na thal ba'i snod dang / mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / dbyug 7pa dang / phreng ba thogs pa can ngang pa la zhon pa yang steng du'o/ /sa'i lha mo ser mo padma la gnas pa g.yon na bum pa thogs pa/ g.yas pa khas len pa'i lag pa can 'og tu'o/ thags bzangs ris sngon po shing rta la zhon pa/lag pas ral gri dang sdigs mdzub can de nyid du dgod do/ /de dag thams cad dgug pa'i sngags la sogs pa ni snga ma de nyid do/ /de nas yang rang gi snying ga nas khro bo'i phur bu 8mgrin pa nas bzung nas/ thogs pa'i khro bo rnams rnam par spros la/ de dag gi snying ga dang / mgrin pa dang / mgo dang / rkang pa'i bar du gdab bo/ /sngags ni oṃ dīḥ:ཿwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sarba duṭwānd+ra ā 9di sa pa ri wā ra na shī la ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya'o/ /24—48

de'i rjes la grub pa'i bcud kyis len grub pa bzhin du kun kyang / gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par sgrub hūṃpa'am/ byang chub kyi sems khu ba'i ngo bor sgrub 37bo/ /gal te khu ba'i ngo bo nyid yin na de'i tshe sa bon dang phyag mtshan gyi rim pas bskyed par bya'o/ /de la oṃ dang rdo rje las byung ba'i dbang bo dmar ser rin po che'i cod pan can phyag dang po gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa/ lhag ma bzhi na rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / padma dang 'khor lo bsnams pa/ ri bong can la bzhugs pa'o/ /byāḥdang dbyug hūṃpa las gshin rje sngon po g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal dkar po dang dmar po g.yas rnams ni gri gug dang / dbyug 5pa dang ral gri dang 5 / phyag g.yon rnams na thod pa dang padma dang 'khor lo/skra ser po gyen du 'greng ba/ nyi ma la bzhugs pa khro bo'i gzugs can no/ /1ཿdang klu zhags las chu lha dkar po zhal g.yas dang g.yon sngon po dang /dmar po g.yas na gri gug dang klu zhags dang / ral gri/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang / padma dang / 'khor lo rin po che'i cod pan dzizla ba la bzhugs pa'o/ /wi dang sa bon gyi grong khyer bidzapur 7las ku bee ra ser po g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal sngon po dang / dkar po gri gug dang / sa bon gyi grong khyer dang /ral gri phyag g.yon na thod pa dang / padma dang / 'khor lo bsnams pa 3rin po che'i cod pan can ri bong can la bzhugs pa'o/ /kṛ 9dang rtse gsum pa las dbang ldan dkar po zhal g.yas dang g.yon sngon po dang / dmar po g.yas na gri gug dang / rtse gsum pa dang / ral gri dang / phyag g.yon na thod pa dang / nor bu dang / 'khor lo go rī ༄ la 'khyud pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba can ri bong can la bzhugs pa'o/ /ta dang thal snod las me lha dmar po zhal g.yas 24—49

dang / g.yon sngon po dang / dkar po/ g.yas na gri gug dang thal snod dang ral gri/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang padma dang nor bu/ nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /āḥ7dang rtse gsum las bden bral sngon po khro bo'i gzugs dang / zhal g.yas dang g.yon dkar po dang / dmar po dang / g.yas na gri gug dang dbyug 2pa dang / ral gri/ phyag g.yon thod pa dang padma dang 'khor lo/ nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /na dang gos las rlung lha du ba'i mdog can/ zhal g.yas dang g.yon dkar po dang dmar po/ phyag g.yas na gri gug dang ba dan dang ral gri/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang nor bu dang padma dang zla ba la bzhugs pa'o/ /na dang ku mu da las zla ba mdog dkar po zhal g.yas dang g.yon sngon po dang dmar po/ g.yas gri gug dang ku mu da tredang ral gri/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang nor bu dang 'khor lo'o/ /hūṃ dang padma las nyi ma dmar po zhal g.yas dang g.yon sngon po dang dkar po/ g.yas na gri gug dang padma dang ral gri/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang nor bu dang 'khor lo/hūṃ dang phreng ba las tshangs pa dmar po zhal g.yas dang g.yon dkar po dang dmar po/ phyag g.yas na gri gug dang phreng ba dang / ral gri/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang / nor bu dang / padma zla ba la bzhugs pa'o/ /phaṭa dang padma las/ sa'i lha mo ser ba/ zhal g.yas dang g.yon sngon po dang dkar ba/g.yas na gri gug dang bum pa dang ral gri/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang nor bu dang / padma zla ba la bzhugs pa'o/ /phaṭa dang ral gri las thags 6bzangs ris sngon po/ zhal g.yas dang g.yon dkar po dang dmar po/ g.yas na gri gug dang / ral gri dang rdo rje dang / phyag g.yon na thod pa dang / 'khor 24—50

lo dang padma nyi ma la bzhugs pa'o/ /swā dang dung las khyab 'jug sngon po/zhal g.yas dang / g.yon dkar po dang / dmar po/ g.yas gri gug dang dung dang ral gri/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang / 'khor lo dang padma zla ba la bzhugs pa'o/ /hā dang dgra sta las sna can dkar po/ zhal g.yas dang g.yon sngon po dang / dmar po/ g.yas na gri gug dang dgra sta dang / ral gri / phyag g.yon na thod pa dang 'khor lo dang padma/ ri bong can la bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag thams cad kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i shes rab ni/ sku dang gnyis su med par gyur pa/ phyag dang po gnyis na thod pa thogs pa 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/ sgrub pa po'i bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad pa/ de lta bur bsams la/ de dag gi mig la sogs pa la ji skad bshad pa'i rdo rje mig la sogs pa bskyed de/ lus la sogs pa la sku rdo rje la sogs pa dang / ji skad bshad pas dbang bskur la/cod pan la gshin rje mthar byed bsams te/ yon chab dang zhabs bsil dang /bsang gtor dbul lo/ /de nas gtor ma thams cad bstab par bya ste/bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i thabs kyis bsgrubs la/ de nyid gsum gyis bsngags te/de'i lce'i spyor ba rnam par bsams la/ bdud rtsi dbul lo/ /sngags ni 1 'di yin te/ oṃ ind+ra ya byāḥ/ ya ma ya bye/ ba ru shā 2ya wi/ ku bee rā ya kri/yī shā nā ya ta/ asna g.ye ā/ nee dṛ ta ye ma4/ bā ya bee na/ tsabye ya hūṃ/arka 5ya hūṃ/ bradma ṇi phaṭa/ ba su dha rā 6yi phaṭa/ be ma tsi tra bee swā/sarba khyu 3te bhyo hā/ hi nyi hūṃ hūṃ 8phe phe phaṭa phaṭa 9swā hā/ de nas ske tog dang /spos dang / mar me dang / dri dang bshos gtsang la sogs pa phul la/ de 24—51

dag gis kyang sgrub pa po mngon par dga' ba'i myang ba la sogs pa nye bar longs spyod par gyur to/ /de nas de dag la bstod pa ste/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol nas/ gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas bstod nas / mngon par 'dod pa blangs la gshegs su gsol te/ oṃ sdzahūṃ muḥlha/zhes bya bas so/ /sgrub pa po de ji ltar 'dod pa de dang / de sgrub cing mdun du rgyal bar gyur cig ces bya ba'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /'di ni gtor ma'i de kho na nyid do/ /de'i rjes la slob ma gshin rje 'dul ba'i gzugs su dmigs la rjes su gnang ba sbyin te/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar gdul bya sna tshogs la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /chos kyi gnas su rdo rje dang / /rin po che dang padma dang / /las kyi sgra bcug pa'i rim pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga ni rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na gnas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung / /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje sbyin pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sinta hūṃbadzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa two dha ra yā mi badzra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃhūṃ zhes slob ma la brtul zhugs sbyin pa'o/ /④ de nas bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su bsams la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chos gos snying gar bzung ba'i tshul dang / g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa byas la/oṃ e kho haṃ byā 5ka ro mi twohūṃ/ badzra satwa ta thā ga taḥhūṃ/ bha ba durga ti ti to udzre tya/ a tyanta bha ba shudhe ye/2 'dir ni ngas a lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de babeen gshegs/ /srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /srid mtha' shin tu dag pas na/ /spukye che ge 24—pya2

mo zhes bya ba ta thā ga ta sidhaḥs ma ya ste rmyebhusgo wa swa rnguḥzhes tshig 'di dang phyag rgya 'dis lung bstan pa byas pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du mgrin gcig gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston te/ mngon par mtho ba'i phyag rgya 'di'i mthu dang sngags 'di yi stobs la dad par gyis shig ces bya ba slob ma la brjod de/ 'di ni lung bstan pa'o—/ /de nas gsang ba brjod par bya ba ste/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /gzhan ni khams gsum na med de/ /des na rtag tu khyod kyis ni/ /'dod chags bral bar mi bya'o/ /dam tshig sbyin pa ni hūṃ phaṭa gsang ba brjod pa'o / /de nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong ba dang ni rig pa yis / /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /de ring khyod ni gnas par gyur/ /khyod ni yang yang mi 'chi bas/ /de phyir bde chen theg pa mthong / /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das pa'i/ /srid pa khyod kyis shin tu 'grub/ /rdo rje phyag rgya zhes bya gang / /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'thob ‘1the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ /gang phyir rdo rje'i phyag rgya'i phyir—/ /dam pa'i chos ni smad mi bgyi/ /nam yang spang bar mi bya'o/ /ma rig pa'am gti mug gis/ /rtag tu skur pa mi gdab bo/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang gtang ④bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon brnyas par mi bya ste/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid mi spang ste/ /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bas bde ba bzung 3/ /'di ni ma 'ongs sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyis/ /khyod kyi sngags dang rgyud kyang zung / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha 24—53

rnams kyis kyang 'dod pa yin/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ /cho ga bzhin du khyod kyis ni/ /'bad pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa pos ni rgyud la spyor1/ /zhes bya ba ni dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /'di dang rjes su gnas pa bzhi po ni/ dbang bskur ba'i rjes thogs sam dbang bzhi pa'i rjes thogs su yang sbyin par bya'o/ /slob dpon gyi dbang nyid la phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang zhes kyang bya ste/ 'di ni slob dpon kyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /da ni gos kyi yol ba la sogs pas dbeen par byas pa'i phyogs gcig snatu slob mar zin pa mdzes pa gzugs la sogs pa'i —yon tan dang ldan pa dam tshig gi sdom pa can sbyor ba bzhi la mkhas pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bla ma la gsang ba'i dbang gi don du dbul lo/ /de nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas rnams/ /ji ltar mchod chen stsol mdzad pa/ /bdag la'ang srung zi/ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes bya ba'am/ gzhan kyis kyang gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas bla mas sbyor ba bzhi mngon du byas la chos nyid kyi padma'i nang du 5rdo rje zhugs pa'i mtha' bskyod pas/ rang rig pa'i mthar phyin pa srin lag dang mje bos blangs te slob ma'i kha ru bcug nas/ btung ba rin chen 'di de ni/ /rdo rje lus su rab sgrub byed/ /bu khyod rtag tu shes gyis la/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'di 'thung / /zhes bya bas sbyin no/ /des kyang / e ma bde ba chen po zhes brjod cing mid par bya'o/ /des kyang rang gi padma'i lhag ma yang der gzhug par bya ste/ 'di ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /de'i rdo rje la de nyid dam gzhan yang rung / rang rig pa'i ye shes mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ sngar bstan pa'i tshigs su bcad pas gsol ba btab 24 —5ga1

pa'i slob ma'i lag par de'i lag pa gtad la/ mdzes pa 'di ni gzung ba dang //bstod bya sangs rgyas rnams kyis rmyebartags/ /'khor lo rjes chags sbyor ba yis/ /de phyir bde ba dam pa myang / /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di dag dag pa ste/ /de phyir 'khor ba spong ba ni/ /khyod ni nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /glen pa gang zhig 'das gyur na/ /dngos grub mchog ni de la med/ /ces brjod la sbyin no/ /de yang gur kum la sogs pas byugs la dri zhim po'i me tog gi phreng bas brgyan te/ gos dang bral bas chu skyes rab tu rgyas par gsal bar ston cing / slob ma la 'di skad brjod do/ /bu khyod dga' ba gang la yin/ /dri chen dri chu la sogs zas/ /de bzhin khrag dang shu kra dang / /sha dang bud med gus dang gzhan/ /de bzhin bha ga'i padma la/ /'o byed smros 3snashig bde ba can/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /des kyang / lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /dri chen dri chu khu sogs 'tshal/ /bud med la yang rtag dad bgyis1 / /bha ga la yang 'o bgyid do/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas des/e ma'o bdag gi padma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gang dag cho gas sten byed pa/ /bdag ni de yi mdun na gnas/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /ji lta ba bzhin padmar byas/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid kyang //'di nyid la ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /kye thar pa bstan 5cig ces brjod nas/des kyang bla ma'i man ngag gis/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar/ /dmigs pa bstan pa'i cho ga'i bye brag gis/ /rnal 'byor pas ni ji srid du/ /byang chub sems ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de srid rgyun mi 'chad thob thupa /24—55

dga' ba'i bde las gzhan ci yod/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur te/ /byang chub sems ni 'bab gyur pas/ /phung po'i rnam shes brgyal shāgyur pa/ /smad pas dngos grub ga la yod/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i khams spyor bas/ /der reg pa las ngo mtshar che'i/ /bde ba gang gang de las bskyed/ /mchog tu dga' ba byed pa'o/ /dga' bral gyi ni dbus dag tu/ /ltos la bstan pa mtshon par gyis/ /padma'i rdo rje la rdo rje'i bar ta kas mnan pa'i gnas su rdo rje skyil krung gis/ sems nor bu'i nang du song bas bltas la/ gang gi tshe ye shes skyes pa de'i tshe/ de'i gzugs su 'gyur te/ 'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbus kyang dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor gang tshe shes mig gis/ /zad med bde la gnas pa ni/ /thun nam yang na nyin mtshan nam/ /zla phyed zla gcig lo dang ni/ /bskal pa'am bskal pa stong dag tu—/ /ye shes mngon par sbyor bas gnas/ /de ltar brtags nas nus pa ji lta ba bzhin sems pa btang ste/ bcud kyis len gyis rtogs pa bzung la/ chu skyes kyi 2mtha' de nyid du mthong ba'i byang chub kyi sems blangs nas/ ro mnyam par gyur pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /gal te 'dir dbang lnga dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ma gsungs par / dang po rtsa ba'i dbang yin te/ /gnyis par ral gri sbyin par bya/ /gsum pa rdo rje dril bu ste/ /bzhi pa zla ba bza' ba'o/ /bzhi po de ni dbang chen te/ /nag po'i zhal nas byung ba yin/ /zhes rgyud las gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ dbang lnga po de nyid rtsa ba'i dbang zhes bya ste/ thams cad du rdo rje tsartsi kā la sogs pa rtsa ba'i dbang gi byed par ldan pa'i phyir dang /24—56

'dis thams cad du las rang dbang du gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig spyin pa ni ral gri'i dbang ste/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad gcod pa'i phyir ro/ /phyir mi sdog pa'i dbang bstan pa nyid kyis rdo rje dang /dril bu spyi bor bzhag pas rgyud las thun mong tshodu gsungs pa'i brtul zhugs dang lung bstan pa dang dbugs dbyung ba bstan pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gis rdo rje phag mo'i gzugs su bsgoms grenas/ btsun mo thams cad blang bar bya'o / /de nas btsun mos rdo rje blta/ /der ni 'o ma bsgrub par bya/ /rtse gcig sems kyis 'o ma bsgoms/ /phyag rgya chen por rab bsgrub pas/ /zhes bya bas bsgrubs pa nyid ni bla na med pa'i 'gro ba'i don ma lus pa'i/ sgrub byepa brtags pa'i ngo bo dang bral bas yang rang gi ④rig pa dang / tha mi dad pa thub pa'i 'khor lo'i bdag nyid/ yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i 'od 'phro ba bstan pa'i rang bzhin slob ma la sbyin no zhes bya ba 'di yang sbyin pa'o/ /slob ma de la phan yon gyis spro bar bya ste/ mtho sdodang reg pas mchog nyid kyi/ /snying po mchog gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol bar khu/ /de ring khyod ni legs par gnas/ /khyod la yang yang 'chi ba med/ /bde ba chen po'i theg pa 'di/ /kun du bzang po yin pas na/ /gar yang mi 4'jigs khyod rol cig /khyod ni srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgal/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i mchog gi mchog /'di ni rtag tu bsrung bar gyis/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pas yin/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par gsungs/ /bka' 'di rtag pa mchog yin no/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin khros 24—57

nas dpun 1zla yi/ /skyon rnams bsgrag snyepar mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang gtang — bar mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems kyang spang mi bya/ /rang gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /sems can yongs su ma smin la//gsang ba nyid ni bsgrag mi bya/ /bdag nyid smad par mi bya'o/ /rang gi chos la smad mi bya/ /gdug pa byams pas rtag tu spang / /chos la tshad bzung bar mi bgyi/ /sems can dad pa can mi slu4/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya /shes rab rang bzhin bud med rnams/ /skyon 'di zhes kyang smad mi bgyi/ /rnal 'byor slong mos mi 'khor zhing snye/ /rnal 'byor nyid ni spang mi bya/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzla/ /dam tshig la sogs rtag tu bsten/ /de bzhin bla ma'i dam tshig la/ /gnod na dkyil 'khor bri 6—byas la/ /bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags/ /de ring skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /de phyir 'di ni legs par mnos/ /mi mnyam pa yi lha rnams dang / /mnyam nas 7'gyur bar je tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rjer bcas kun kyis/ /tshe dang ldan khyod deng dbang bskur/ /khams gsum rgyal po chen po ste/ /de ring bdag por rab tu brtan/ /de ring bdud las rnam par rgyal/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /de ring sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /gyur pa 'di la the tshom rnged/ /ces bya bas rang gi rdo rje dam tshig mi zad pa'i bde ba byin la/bsten cig 'gro ba myur ba yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde bas ding / /rab tu mtshungs par rtag tu gyur/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /slob ma gus pa gsal ba yi/ /gsungs shig de bzhin bdag gis bgyi/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal bzhin/ /gal te yod par gyur na de'i lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo 24—58

thams cad kyis blangs la sbyin sreg gis zhi bar bya'o/ /sreg rdzas gcig gam gnyis sam/ bdun gyi bar gyis so/ /des kyang mgu ba'i yid kyis ji ltar 'byor pa'i sa gzhi dang / glang po dang / rta dang / gser dang / rgyan dang / bu dang / chung ma la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i dngos po'am/ bdag nyid kyang dngos grub la sogs pa bsgrub 1pa'i phyir dbul lo/ /yon bza' ba dang / rang dang gzhan gyi 'khor lo 2mchod par bya'o/ /spyor ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma bzung la/ mchog sna tshogs kyis de dag tshim par byas te/gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / bdud rtsi myang ba byas la gsol ba btab ste/ brtan pos lha'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /chos thams cad ni ma skyes pa ste/ chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o zhes brjod do / /rdo rje rtse mos 'khor lo gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas 'dod pa la rdul tshon cung zad byin la/ chu chen por gshegs su gsol lo/ /snying po grong du gang bcug dang / /sbyin sreg 'khor lo'i nor gang yin/ /de dag thams cad slob dpon ni/ /rdo rje 'chang mchog bskur bar bya/ /bzang po zhabs sogs kyis mdzad pa/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i cho gar gsal/ /'dir ni gsang ba'i rlabs 'khor lo/ /cho ga la 'bad nyid kyis ngal/ /de phyir dbang po mchog rnams ni/ /skye bo bzang la bzod par gsol/ /gang phyir rang nyid dran pa'i phyir/ /dpal ldan gshin gshed dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga sems can don bsgrubs 4byas/ /de las dge ba gang thob pa/ /rang gi shes las gzhan min pa'i/ /las 'joms shes rab dang ldan pa/ /spyod yul mi shes mun kun sel/ /srid pa mi 'jigs sad byed pa'i/ /legs pa'i tshogs gang 24—59

༄/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa/tsho ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra sa ra swa tī sto tra/ bod skad du/rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab mnga' bdag rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ /yang dag lam ston bla ma rje btsun la/ /dad cing mos la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros spel phyir bstod pa cung zad bri/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ /rang don grub nas gzhan don ni/ /mchog tu gzhol mdzad rje btsun ma/ /dbyangs can de la spyi bo yis/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhal gsum rnam thar gsum gyi dngos/ /phyag drug pha rol phyin drug rdzogs/ /zhabs gnyis bden gnyis don rtogs ma/ /rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba smin mdzad pas/ /rtag tu padma rā ga'i mdog /dbyangs can de la spyi bo yis/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod pa'i 'dam 24—64

gyis ma gos pas/ /rtag tu chu skyes steng na bzhugs/ /dbyangs can de la spyi bo yis/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni padma rā ga'i mdog /'dod chags rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yas kyi zhal ni ind+ra bhā la'i mdog /zhe sdang rnam dag thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yon pa'i 1zhal ni kun da zla ba'i mdog /gti myug rnam dag sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po padma bsnams/ /ma chags 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bar pa ma rig gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams/ /shes rab rnam gsum gsol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tha ma rnam rtog gcod mdzad gri gug bsnams/ /rtog meed ting 'dzin gsol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag drug g.yon gyi dang po bhanta bsnamasarnyi/ /bdag med don rtogs mnga' la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bar pa dbul ba gcod mdzad rin chen bsnams/ /'gro kun re 'dod skong la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tha ma 'khor ba gcod mdzad 'khor lo bsnams/ /'khor ba rtsad nas gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mtshan dang dpe byad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ka la piṅka'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shes bya kun mkhyen thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma rig mun sel khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta su ma ti khrirti dang / lo tsā ba mar do chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba'o// //24—65

0829༄/ /gshin rje dgra'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gshin rje gshed 'drung ba zhes bya ba/1rakṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya mā ri maṇḍa la no pi ka ya mānta ko da ya nā ma / bod skad du/ gshin rje dgra'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gshin rje gshed 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i sku 'bar thub dbang 'od tshogs can/ /rang 'od gnyis med 'khril zhing dpe bral bde bas gang / /rab chags mdzes pas lha dang khro bas 'khrugs lta la/ /blo mnyam 'jug mdzad gshin rje gshed der mngon phyogs te/ /rgyud rgyal yon tan mang ldan mkhas pa'i spyod yul ba/ /gshin rje dgra yi don la bdag blo blun gyur kyang / /zhal gyi padma las rnyed de yi rjes 'brangs nas/ /dbang bskur sgrub bcas lo 'dab rtse tsam bya bar 'dod/ /de la dang por sngags pa ni/ /rang lus 'jig na'ang gzhan don 'dod/ /rnyed dang bkur sti la ma chags/ /rgyud 'dir gsang sogs dbang bsgur bas/ /ri bo'i 24—67

phyogs sogs 'byor pa yod/ /ljon shing gis bklubs yid du 'ong / /skye bo 'dus nas rnam bral zhing / /dris byugs rnge tog legs bkram par/ /dang por gdong sogs dag byas la/ /spro bas bde ba'i stan 'dug nas/ /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /ya sngon 'od dang ldan pa bsam/ /de 'od las byung rigs tshogs kyis/ /bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas bkug nas/ /rnam thar kyi lkusgo dag byas te/ /dag par gyur pas mngon sum blta/ /gshin rje gshed por sgrub pa yang / /bsod nams med par mi 'grub la/ /sbyin sogs bsod nams bya ba yang / /dbul phyir bdag gis ni nus pas/ /tshe rabs sngon nas tshangs spyod bzhi/ /'bras bu yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'go ba kun gyi don byed pa'i/ /ya nyid rab tu dran par bya/ /de las bdag nyid māṃ 7sprul te/ /lan gsum bskor zhing phyag 'tshal bsam/ /de sprul rig ma'i tshogs rnams kyis//ma lus mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig bkyis dang / /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang gang / /sgyu ma sgyu ma la sogs bzhin/ /thugs rje can rnams mdun du 'chags— / /sngon byas ma lus bshags nas ni/ /phyin chad de la mi 'jug cing / /byang chub snying por gnas kyi bar/ /mi dge kun las ldog par bgyid/ /sangs rgyas de sras 'phags rnams dang / /srid pa mthar phyin dam pa'i chos/ /skyabs kyi dam pa de gsum la/ /deng nyid gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rnam rtog rgya mos rab bcings shing / /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa kun/ /bsgral phyir bde gshegs nyid thob bar/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sras bcas 'phags skyes po 4/ /kun gyi dge ba kun bsdus la/ /sel med rab tu yi rang zhing / /legs so zhes kyang 24—68

bsngags par bya/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas kun/ /gshegs shing gshegs dang gshegs 'gyur ba'i/ /sbyin sogs lam gyi rang bzhin gang / /ci yod stobs kyis yang dag bsten/ /yon tan rgya mtsho ldan rnams la/ /bdag nyid bdag gis dbul lags kyis/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis//so sor nang 'khor spyod du bzhes/ /gang zhig mya ngan 'da' bzhed pa/ /ji srid 'khor ba gnas bar du/ /de srid mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub shing la gzigs rnams la/ /jeg chen bdud rtsi rab bshad par/ /'gro ba'i yab tu gyur rnams la/ /'khor lo bskor bar 1gsol ba gang / / lus ngag yid kyi dge ba gang / /3bgyes pa ma lus kun bsdus nas/ /'gro ba kun gyi bde chen nyid/ /thob pa'i rjes su mthun gyur cig /de ltar bsod nams tshogs bsags la/ /gzhan don lhar mdzad thugs mnyes nas/ /rigs kyi bu khyod legs so zhes/ /gtang rag gnang nas mi snang gyur/ /rnam rtog rgya mtsho gting zab par/ /yang dag lta ba'i gru shor cing / /sna tshogs lta bas g.yengs rnams la/ /thugs rje chen pos dmigs nas su/ /rang bzhin med pas stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rnam rtog med pas rnam bral bar/ /byang chub sems mchog bsgom par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolhahaṃ4/ sngags 'di bzlas nas 'gro kun gyi/ /lus ngag yid rnams ngo bo gcig /stong phyir de rnams brtags pa tsam/ /brtags pa yin phyir lus ngag yid/ /oṃ sdzahūṃ yig gsum byas la/ /'od 'bar hoḥ5gnyis par gnas pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /nam mkha' la gnas bsam par bya/ /de las āskuḥchad 24—69

byung nyi ma/ /de dbus yi ge hūṃ mthing las/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'od 'bar ba /lte bar yi ge hūṃ bcas bsam/ /de 'od phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas/ /'od 'bar rdo rje'i gur du bsam/ /de dbus padma zla stengs su/ /saṃ dkar las byung rdo rje las/ /kun bzang yum bcas bsam par bya/ /'bru lngas de zhu las byung ba/ /chos dbyings dkar po gru gsum pa/ /gyen du gnas pa phyogs 'od bskor/ /padmo sna tshogs paṃ las skyes/ /'dab ma 'bum ldan de dbus bsam—/ /ge sar dbus su khaṃ 1yig las/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'od tshogs can/ /lte bar zlo ser 2las byung ba'i/ /rig bcas rtag pa las byung ba/ /gzhal yas khang mchog gru bzhi pa/ /sgo bzhi rta babs mu khyud bcas/ /rdo rje ra ba 'od phreng bskor/ /dbus su rdo rje rgya gram mdzes/ /padma nyi ma'i — gdan ldan bsgom / /gzhi'o4// //lte ba'i gdan stengs 57bsam bya ba/ /a dang āḥ6mthar thug phreng gnyis/ /de las zla ba de yis brgyan/ /ka sogs dpe byad 'od ldan pa/ /zung gcig las byung gnyis pa ste/ /dbus su 'dod chags yi ge re/ /des bzhu 'od kyi 7 gong bu las/ /dkar dmar hūṃ ni rab tu bsam/ /de mdog rdo rje de yis brgyan//badzod kolhahaṃ 8nga rgyal bskyed/ /rdo rje 'chang mchog 'od tshogs can/ /zhal gsum sngo dkar dmar ba la/ /rdo rje ral gri g.yas gnyis na/ /gzhan gnyis 'khor lo padma 'chang / /gri gug bandhas 9rang 'od 'khyud/ /bde bas gang ba bsam par bya/ /rnam pa lnga yi rang bzhin gang / /de ni sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan no/ /rnal 'byor ro/ /'dod chags chen pos 'dul ba yi⑩/ /snod du 'jig rten mthong nas su//24—70

rang snying las byung 'od zer gyis/ /khyab ste sna tshogs sangs rgyas byas/ /bkug nas bdag la zhugs pa yi/ /bde ba chen po nyid du gyur/ /mkha' la gnas pa'i yig 'bru lnga/ /ji ltar skar mda' 'pho ba ltar/ /khar thim khu bar rab 'phros pas/ /rig dang bcas pa'i kun bzang zhu/ /'od kyi gong bur gyur pa las/ /thig le phra mo bzhi chad de/ /byams sogs tsartsi kā nyusogs kyis / /snyan pa'i glu yis bskul bar bsam/ /rje btsun thugs rjes khro bzhengs la/ /gnas gsum kun gyi gti mug spongs/ /gtso bo bdud 5rnams kun las rgyal/ /rje btsun khros pa'i thugs kyis bzhengs/ /'jig rten mgron gnyer stong —gnas shing / /rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams bzhengs / /kye/ khyod ni stong dmigs ci ste bzhugs/ /'jig rten byang chub rang bzhin mgron/ /'dod chags la ni dga' ba yis/ /zhu ba la ni bskul nas su/ /de nyid la thim yang sngon gyur/ /rdo rje las byung mi bskyod pa//g.yas g.yon dkar dang dmar ba la/ /'od 'bar mthing ga sngon mtshungs phyag /rgyan kun bklubs jepa'i sbrul gyis bcings/ /yum ldan thub pa'i 'od kyis 'khrigs/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das dngos kyi/ /sku de byang chub sems mchog go/ /oṃ swa bhā wa ātma kolhasrehaṃ/ rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /gsang byin brlab dang rjes chags ni/ /rgyud 'dir bdag gis mthong med kyang / /rgyud rgyal don 'dir mi 'gal phyir/ /byin rlabs shirjes chags bya bar 'os/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /mkha' khyab bde gshegs kun bkug nas/ /rdo rje las byung pad lte la/ /bde ba'i rgyun du 'phros par bsam / /dga' ba'i thig le sa bon ni/ /'og nas 'chad pa nyid du gyur/ /24—71

de las thugs kyi phyag rgya ste/ /de las phyag rgya chen por blta/ /snod chen bzhi yang rdzogs pa dang / /blo ldan phyi rol spro bar bya/ / dhīḥsgoḥl thu/sogs gsang sngags kyis / /zhe sdang mthing ga rdo rje dang / /ral gri 'khor lo padma 'chang / /spros nas slar byon bdag la thim/ /dzi na dzika ces brjod pa yis/ /gti mug dkar po 'od 'bar ba/ /'khor lo ral gri rin chen pad/ /mkha' las bton nas shar phyogs su/ /lho phyogs rdo rje'i ra nyid las2/ /ratna j-ika gis ser sna ni/ /btso ma gser dang mtshungs pa'i mdog /rin chen ral gri 'khor lo pad/ /ā ro loka 1gis nub phyogs su/ /'dod chags byu ru bcag 'dra ba/ /padma dang ni ral gri dang / /'khor lo rin chen 'chang ba mchog /pradzñā byeka choces bya ba yis/ /byang du phrag dog chen po ste/ /sngo bsangs ral gri rdo rje dang / /'khor lo padma 'dzin pa'o / /muṅgar j-ika 5gis de bzhin te/ /sngon po tho ba ral gri dang / /rin chen padma 'dzin pa ni/ /shar gyi sgo ru bsam par bya/ /daṇḍa dhrika zheces bya ba yis/ /be con 'dzin pa dkar ba ste/ /be con ral gri 'khor lo pad/ /lho yi sgo ru bsam par bya/ /padma dhrika gis nub sgo ru/ /padma rā ga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /padma ral gri rdo rje dang / /rin chen 'dzin pa bsam par bya/ /khaspyo j-ika ñdzugis byang sgo ru/ /ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa ste/ /ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo can/ /rim bzhin 'chang ba 'khrugs pa'o/ /dzwa ṣa ra ti zhes de nyid/ /tsartsi kā mdog dkar mo la/ /gtso bo dang mtshungs phyag mtshan can/ /me yi phyogs su legs par gzhag9 /mo ha ra ti zhes pa yis/ /phag mo sku mdog sngon mo la/ /rang gi gtso bo'i phyag rgya can/ /spros nas bden bral grwa la'o/ /rā 7ga ra ti zhes sngags kyis/ /dbyangs can ma ni dmar mo la/ /padma la sogs 'dzin pa'i phyag /rlung mtshams na ni 'gro don 24—72

mdzad / /badzra ra ti zhes pa yis/ /mdzod ldan ljang gu utpal can/ /phyi ma gtso bo'i mtshan 'dzin ma/ /dbang ldan grwa ru bsam par bya/ /gti mug gshin rje lha mo bzhi/ /padma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lhag ma padma nyi ma la/ /lnga phrag gnyis dang drug phyed lha/ /gri gug bandha'i 1phyag zung cig /mthun par rang gi rig ma 'khyud / /bzhir gyur dbus su de 'od bsam/ /sngon po'i g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar / /dkar po'i g.yas sngo g.yon pa dmar/ /dmar po ser po ljang gu yi/ /g.yas sngo g.yon pa dkar po yin/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs 'od phreng can/ /ma lus 'khrugs bye pa sbrul gyis brgyan/ /me mtshams la sogs bhanta bzhi/ /zla bas gang ba oṃ gyis mtshan/ /padma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /de nyid gsum gyis rim bzhin gdon/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang lce/ /lus yid skra 4mtshams brang rtse ru/ /kṣiṃ dzi khaṃ gi shaṃ saṃ las/ /gti mug gshin dgra sogs rim bzhin/ /rdo rje can sogs kha dog rgya/ /mngon par shes pa'i don du ni/ /rdo rje skye mched rnam par bsgom/ /snying mgrin dpral ba'i zla stengs surngu/ /rdo rje padma 'khor lo la/ /hūṃ āḥ.oṃ yig bkod byas te/ /de las phyag rgya de byung sku/ /zhe sdang 'dod chags gti mug dang / /'dra bar thugs sogs bsgom byas te/ /de dag thams cad rang rang rgya/ /mtshan ma'i lte bar hūṃ yi oṃ/ /de las tsartsi kā 6sogs spro/ /mkhar bkug sangs rgyas mnyes byas nas/ /spyan drangs thugs gsung skur bcug la/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolhadzwahaṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolharehaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā tsuya 24—73

badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha1haṃ/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka yi/ /sa bon las 'od lha mor spro/ /phyogs bcu'i mgon po mchod byas nas/ /dbang bskur ba yang blang bar bya/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs dag las2/ /sprul pa'i tsartsi ka la sogs—/ /phyag na ye shes chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa zla 'od lags thogs te/ /yid 'ong ༄bkra shis glu len cing / /sil snyan spos kyi sprin dag dang / /dri med dbang bskur sprin phab pas/ /so so'i gtso bos dbu brgyan no/ /rang snying 'od kyi tsartsi kā'/ /bsgul nas de yi thugs ka nas/ /rang 'dra 'phros te khro mo bkug /rdo rje'i gur stengs bzhugs bsams 6la/ /khro bo rnams kyis mngon bskrad de/ /rdo rje'i ra ba bshig byas nas/ /zhugs te rang mdun padmar bsam/ /de nas snying 'phros khro bo yis/ /gur bshig phyir brtsigs ྅snying zhugs bsam/ /rang mdun dung chos sogs gsum bzhag /rnge tog dkar ldan dri chus bkang / /de mdun man 'ji gnyis stengs su/ /gser sogs gsol ba'i snod gnyis bzhag /g.yas phyogs dung ni gsum pa la/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i cho gas su/ /byin brlabs bdud rtsi bcu byed 8blugs/ /byāḥdzeeḥwi kṛ'i sngags bzlas la/ /ku sha'i bam pos dang po'i chu/ /bzed zhal dang por lan gsum gtor/ /gnyis pa chu dang me tog bcas/ /gzung 9ste de yi snod nyid la/ / phyogs su dung ni gsum pa la/ / ⑩lan gsum nye reg sbyin par bya/ /gsum pa bdud rtsi dang ldan pas/ /gnyis par mchod yon chu yang sbyin—/ /de nas me tog gzung byas la/ /zhabs bsil phyag rgya dang ldan pas//de yi snod la zhabs bsil sbyin/ /rang snying 'od kyis tho ba bskul/ /muṅgar dzaḥzhes brjod nas dgug /de bzhin be con bskul ba yis/ /daṇḍa hūṃ zhes 24—74

brjod nas gzhug /snying pos padma bskul nas su/ /padma baṃ zhes brjod nas bcing / /de bzhin ral gri 'dzin bsgul te/ /khaṅga hoḥ1zhes brjod mnyes bya/ /rang snying ye shes 'od zer gyis/ /mkha' khyab sangs rgyas kun bkug nas/ /khar thim lus kyi bcud gyur te/ /rdo rje lam byung shes rab kyi3/ /padma'i snying por rab 'phros las/ /lha mo'i tshogs ni mdzes gyur te/ /ba sru'i bu ga las 'phros nas/ /me tog sna tshogs mdzes rnams kyi / /sdong bu lag pas legs bzung nas/ /sgeg dang bcas pas mchod byas te/ /rab snyan yid 'phrog glu dang ni/ /sna tshogs mdzes pa'i gar gyis su/ /bde ba chen po rab tu ster/ /kye kye gshin rje dgra nag po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ /bdag gis khyod mthong rnam par 'jigs/ /khro bo'i rang bzhin nyid spongs te/ /bdag po yis ni gar byas pas/ /mtho ris mi yul sa 'og 'dir/ /nag po khro bo yid kyis 'jigs/ /gar byed khyod ni 'jigs pa che/ /nag po mi'u thung gshin dgra nag5 /gzugs ni rnam pa sna tshogs sprul/ /rdo rje dbyangs can mas zhus pa/ /gar byed khyod ni bde ba che/ /dhīḥbyeḥ'i sngags kyis gar byed khyod/ /gnas gsum kun gyi the tshom spongs/ /rje btsun gshin rje khro bo khyod / /'gro ba kun kyis gar byed mthong / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū gyedza badzra swa bhā wa ātpa kolha dzihaṃ/ sgra yul thams cad brag ca dang / /'dra bar rab tu blta byas te/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gnas la/ /yon tan kun ni sgrogs par bsam/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin dgra nag po rab tu 'jigs / /ston pa sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /mi 'jigs sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin dgra nag po shin tu 24—75

'jigs / /thugs kyi rdo rje rab snang ba/ /rin chen rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod//'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gtso bo 'dod chags chos 'byung ba/ /dbyangs kun gyi ni mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /thams cad las kun gshin rje'i dgra/ /las kyi rdo rje rab snang ba/ /ral gri'i phyag la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor bdag la phyag 'tshal bstod//yo 7 las byung ba sngon po la/ /gzhu 'dra'i ba dan mtshan pa ste/ / yo gis byin brlabs 4rlung dkyil 'khor/ /g.yo med steng na me nyid ni/ /dmar po gru gsum re las byung / /de steng a las ba dan ni/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'o/ /de nang bdud rtsi rnam lnga ni/ /gshin rje lnga yi yi ge las/ /lcags kyu lnga ni de nyid kyi/ /ming gi 5thog ma'i yi ge las/ /hūṃ dkar las byung rdo rje yis/ /de la kha ni bkab par bsam/ /mtho ④gang spags pa'i bar snang la/ /zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar bsam/ /kha bkab rdo rje'i lte ba yis/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros ba dan bskul/ /de yis rlung bskyod des me bskul/ /rdzas kun zhu zhing khol ba la/ /rdo rjes 'khrug cing zhu gyur pas/ /shin tu dri med bdag mthong nas/ /oṃ las 'od byung ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi bsdus nas der thim pas/ /gangs chu 'dra bar bsil gyur te/ /yi ge gsum brjod bsrungs la bzhag /gshin rje gshed kyi lha rnams kyi/ /ljags la rdo rje dkar po re/ /bsams 5te de las 'od zer ni/ /sbu gur gyur pa rab 'phros te/ /bdud rtsir zug la rang rang sngags/ /brjod pas sbu gus btung sbyinas tshim/ /snying 'od 24—76

'phros pas phyogs bcur khyab/ /dngos kun gshin rje dgrar byas nas/ /bsdus te bdag la thim gyur pas/ /bdag nyid yar thim thig ler gyur/ /thig ler 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed/ /de yi 'od kyi phreng ba yis/ /bdag sogs lha rnams bsal 1bhebyas te/ /snying gar dkyil 'khor phra gnas pas/ /brtan par gyur nas spro dang bsdu/ /las dang chos dang chen po dang / /gsang gsum dam tshig phyag rgya ste/ /thugs gsung sku yi rdo rje la/ /rang rang sa bon thugs kar bsam/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka ru/ /juḥz-iḥl sogs gsang sngags bsam/ /gsang sngags bzlas pas gnas bzhi nas/ /khro bo'i rgyun rnams spro bsdu ba/ /rim pa'am lhan cig bya bar 'dod/ /dbugs dbyung 'phro bar bsam bya ste/ /dbugs bsdu sngags kyang bsdu bar bya/ /bgrang phreng dung chen la sogs la/ /bdud rtsi lnga sogs mchod byas nas/ /gshin rje dgra yi skur bsams 3te/ /mthe bo lcags kyus drang zhing bzlas/ /rang snying de bzhin dmigs nyid pas/ /sems la nyams su chung 'gyur zhing / /bzlas pas skyo na lag g.yas kyis/ /bsgrims te rdo rje gsor nas kyang / /g.yon pas rdo rje dril gsil zhing / /rdo rje glu tshul sna tshogs dang / /mchod pa sna tshogs rnams kyis mchod/ /dkyil 'khor bzhengs la yang bzlas so/ /bdag nyid gtong bar 'dod gyur na/ /'gro ba'i don la 'gro bsams te/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas la/ /yig gsum mtha' 1ru muḥbazhag pa'i/ /sngags kyis ye shes gshegs par bskul/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi lha rnams ni/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥbadag la bsdu/ /bdag nyid ye shes sems dpa' la/ /ye shes sems dpa' phyag rgya ste/ /de yang yi ge de stong bsam/ /bzod pa gsol 24—77

dang gsol ba gdab/ /bsngo nyudang smon lam gdab par bya/ /'di ni rnal 'byor chen po'o// //rang gi lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /yang dag langs la spyod lam kun/ /gshin rje dgra yi ngo bor byas/ /zab cing rgya che'i rang bzhin no/ /kha zas ci za bdud rtsir brlab/ /kha yi hom khung sreg khang du/ /lha rnams tshim bya sreg rdzas rnams/ /lag pa'i gzar bus bstab par bya/ /phyi yi khrus rnams byed pa ni— / /'gro ba rang bzhin dag bsams — la/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga bzhin / /lha mo'i bum chus bkrus par bsam/ /phyi thun la yang de bzhin du//dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar du bya/ /bza' ba zos nas nyal ba'i tshe/ /shes rab snying rjer ldan pas nyal/ /ldang ba'i dus na dpal ldan pa'i/ /lha ma'i dbyangs kyis bskul bar bsam/ /'di ltar 'di las dang po pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 4bya ba yin/ /ye shes 'ga' sogs rnal 'byor pas/ /sbyor ba rnam gsum rim bzhin bya/ /spyod lam dag gi tshe na yang / /lus ngag yid kyi bya ba kun/ /phyag rgya sngags kyi bdag nyid du/ /bsams te bya ba kun bya'o//dpa' mi 5gcig cig mthong ba la/ /bde sbug rnam par grol 'gyur ba/ /sems nyid kho na yin pa'i phyir/ /rtog med sems gnag ga la 'gyur/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba'i cho ga'o// //bsnyen pas bgegs kyi tshogs bcom la/ /gzhan gyi don la brtson bya ba'ang / /mtshan ma brtan po yang dang yang / /mthong zhing gnang ba thob nas bya/ /yid dga' ba yi sa phyogs ni/ /shar dang byang gi cha nyid do/ /dbus mtho shar dang byang gzhol bar/ /bgegs bskrad phur btab gtor ma 24—78

sbyin / /gsol btab 1rnal 'byor gsum byas nas/ /sangs rgyas la yang gsol ba gdab/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil phul nas su/ /sbyin sreg gis kyang rab tshim bya/ /de nas mkha' la bkod nas su/ /bgegs rnged sa ni legs brkos nas/ /slar yang sa yis rab tu dgong 2/ /sngon du dus ring bsnyen byas pa'i/ /gshin rje gshed kyi sbyor ldan pas/ /dkyil 'khor sa ni rdzogs byas te/ /oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes sngags kyis ni/ /mkha' la ri ni bskyed par bya//hūṃ lo hūṃ zhes rdo rje'i bdag /nyid du sa byas de byin brlab/ /oṃ me di nī badzī bha snob badzra banta hūṃ/ sngon bzhin lha yi ting 'dzin ni/ /sa yi dbus su rnal 'byor bzhi/ /rim bzhin byas nas rdzogs pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun bdag gshin rje ni/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin gtso bo la/ /grogs po rdo rje dril 'dzin bzhi//gti mug sogs bdag lhan cig tu/ /sprul pas dkyil 'khor gsum la ni/ /mchod nas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun pyagyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs—/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun du bzang po sgu yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos mchog yang dag byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas gshin rje gshed langs te/ /ma dang ṭa yi yi ge las/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi mig gnyis su/ /nyi ma dang ni 21—79

zla ba bsam/ /blo can 'gro ba kun bltas nas/ /dkyil 'khor sa la stang stabs bskor/ /rkang mthil 1a las rdo rjer bsgom/ /g.yas pas rdo rje gsor byed cing / /g.yon pas dril gsel 2'gying bag tu/ /gnas te mche gadzigs hūṃ brjod do/ /lha dang lha min la sogs pa/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bskrad par bya/ /nyon cig bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun/ /sku gsung thugs la gnas pa yi —/ /bdag ni dpal ldan ral gri 'dzin/ /srung 4ba'i 'khor lo'i don byed pa/ /ral gri 'bar ba'i gzugs 'di yis/ /gal te gang gis bdag tshig 'das/ /lus ngag gsum las skyes pa bcad/ /'jig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /de nas sa la bskor byas te/ /bgegs rnged bya phyir phur bus gdab/ /phur pa stod ni khro bo la/ /smad ni rdo rje rtse gcig pa//phur pa'i gsang sngags bzlas pa lnga/ /mtshams dang dbus su gdab par bya /'od zer rnon po rab 'phro bas5/ /phyogs bcur yang dag gnas pa yi ni / /bgegs kyi phung po kun gzhom mo/ /shin tu bgegs med rab mthong nas/ /mtshams bcad phyogs bcing 7sngon bzhin du/ /blo yis byas nas sa rdzogs nas/ /sta gon gnas pa'i rim bzhin bya/ /baṃ ser las byung lha mo ni/ /'od dang bcas pa bkug nas su/ /mchod pa phul nas gsol ba 8gdab/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par kyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang btsugs te/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis//ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /dri zhim chu yis sa byugs nas/ /me tog mdzes pa sna tshogs dgram/ /bdud rtsi dang ldan dri chu yis/ /lha rnams maṇḍal 24—80

rab tu bya/ /de la dkyil 'khor rang sngags kyis/ /bkug la mtshams sogs bcing byas nas/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang bar bya/ /de nas bum pa'i sta gon ni/ /rin chen bum pa mi gnag pa/ /mgrin pa ras kyis bcings pa 3 las / /ldum bu mchog gis kha la brgyan/ /rin chen sman 'bru sna lnga dang / /dri chus bkang ba mngon par bsngags2/ /sna tshogs me tog brgyus pa yi /skud pa'i rtse mor rdo rje gdags/ /bum par bzhag la lag pas bzung 4/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso la sogs/ /sngags bzlas nas ni mchod yon 'bul//me tog dbul ltadang spos sogs mchod/ /dri sogs padma'i snod legs gzhag6sna/nyin dang mtshan mo thun gsum du/ /gtor ma spyin zhing de bzhin bzla/ /de dag dkyil 'khor phyi rol la/ /gnas nas rgyal ba gtso bo yis/ /de nas g.yon gyi snod la chu/ /drugs nas de yis gtor bas na/ /bdag dang slob ma thams cad kyi3/ /chu yis dbang bskur gyur pa yin/ /de nas rang gi lce brlabs la/ /g.yas pas spos phor bteg nas su/ /pus mo btsugs nas blo ldan pas/ /dkyil 'khor gtso dang sangs rgyas zhu/ /mgon po zhe sdang gshin rje yi/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gis gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po bri bar 'dod pa ste/ /slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang //khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /de bas bcom ldan gus ldan la/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad par gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /'gro ba 'khor ba'i don byed rnams/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gsang sngags kyi ni lha gzhan dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bstan par mngon dga' dang / /24—81

gang su lha yi mig can rnams/ /che ge zhes pa'i rdo rje yis/ /dkyil 'khor gshin rje las byung ba/ /ji ltar nye bar spyod nus pas/ /'gro dag don du bri bar bya/ /slob ma dang bcas bdag la ni/ /thugs rjes nye bar bzung lhanas su / /thams cad dkyil 'khor la bcug nas/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar snyan gsan lan gsum du/ /byas nas gtso la yon chab sogs / /phul nas bsrungs te phyir byung nas/ /slob ma brtags pa gzung bar bya / /byas pa gzo dang khengs pa med/ /rigs mdog na sor ldan pa dang / /jeg pa mchog la mngon dga' ba'o/ /de las bzlog pa'i slob ma ni/ /dman pas sta gon gnas mi bya/ /tshe 'dir 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/ /phyi ma'i tshe la mi 'byung ngo / /skyes bu tshe phyi mar 'dod pas/ /'dir yang 'bras bu rgyas par 'gyur/ /de ltar slob ma la smras nas/ /blo ldan rang gis kyenang du 'gro/ /yon tan de ldan slob ma yis/ /sgo nas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag la stsol/ /de nyid dam tshig bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par bgyid/ /de ltar lan gsum brjod nus pa'i/ /slob ma rab chags mdzes pa la/ /slob dpon rtse gcig tu byas la/ /tshig 'dis gnang ba sbyin par bya/ /'dir shog bu 'di theg chen gyi/ /cho ga sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya / /tshul chen la khyod bsnyen pa gyis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das 24—82

dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams//'gro la phan phyir zhugs phyapa kun/ /de dag gis ni gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga mchog bzang 'di brnyes 3nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mnyam med brnyes/ /gsang sngags cho ga mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge la sogs kyis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /'jig rten 'jug par rab shes nas/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas bshags dang yi rang sogs/ /byas nas byang chub sems bskyed la/ /srung byeb byas te de nas ni/ /thugs gsung sku yi byin brlabs la/ /yi ge gsum dang ldan pa der/ /mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /de nas lha yi sngags bzlas pa'i/ /so shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /me tog rtser ldan sbyin par bya/ /tho rangs langs nas shar bltas te/ /sa la ma lhung lci ba yis/ /sa la ba ko tsam byugs te/ /rtse mo bca' zhing de ru dor/ /zhi dang rgyas sogs gar grub blta/ /de nas kha bshal hub gsum chu/ /byin la sngags 'di bzlas par bya/ /oṃ dīḥ4bi shuddhā dharmaḥ5sarba pā paṃ ni tsa su sho dha ya sarba bi kal paṃ a pa na ya hūṃ/ gshin rje'i sngags bzlas ku sha ni/ /stan dang sngas khusu sbyin par bya/ /mdud pa gsum ldan srung 7skud ni/ /dpung pa g.yon par bcing bar bya/ /de nas sems kyi srungs bskyed phyir/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos bshad de/ /jeg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /de phyir khyod rnams dong bas na/ /rab byung skal ba chen po pa/ /yod dang med las 8rnam 'das shing / /zab mo rtog ge thams 24—83

cad kyis/ /rab tu mi rtogs gnas med pa/ /spros pa kun dang bral ba ste/ /spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /las dang bya ba sogs dang bral/ /bden pa gnyis la gnas pa yi/ /theg pa rab kyi mchog 'di yi/ /tshul la gnas na thob par 'gyur/ /ku sha'i mal ①du nyal bcug la/ /rmi lam mthong ba dge mi dge/ / tho rangs 'ubadag la ma 'dzem par/ /smros shig ces ni bsgos la btang / /de nas sdom pa bzung nas su/ /dkyil 'khor sbyor ba bsgom byas te/ /mchod cing gsol ba btab byas la/ /nam mkha' la ni dgod par bya/ /kha dog lnga yi skud pa la/ /yakṣe ma me da bkod de//gshin rje dgra lnga'i sku ru bsam/ /zhe sdang gshin rjer bdag bltas la/ /dza las byung ba'i nyi zla'i mig /'bar mig lcags kyus drangs nas su/ /rang mdog skud pa'i nang du thim/ /gti mug ral gri dang lhan cig /thig sna drangs la bsgril bar bya/ /a byo tyā nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥpa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣṭa sarba dharmā tyanta a nu pra biṣṭa sarba dharmā ཿ mtha' ma dkar ldan lag pa yis④ /gzung la sngags 'di bzlas par bya/ /sa ma ya sru snyetshotra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ ring thung dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur 4la/ /sbom phra sgo yi nyi shu cha/ /dri zhim bdud rtsi lnga yis ni/ /byugs nas bsrungs la snod gtsang bzhag mu /de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ /de nas skud pa bsngags 8byas la/ /dzdza yig gsum gyis gtang 9bar bya/ /des kyang dzdza yig gsum gyis drangs/ /lte bar khu tshur g.yon gyis bzung khu/ /nub tu gnas nas shar bltas te/ /mkhas pas nam mkhar thig gdab bo/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/sems can don byed dus dag tu/ /mkha' khyab pa yi de bzhin gshegs/ /24—84

'dir gshegs pa yi don gyi phyir/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul bar bsam/ lho nas byang du kha bltas te/ /shar gyi thig ni rab tu gdab/ /de bzhin byang nas lhor bltas te/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi sgud pa brtag /de nas shar du drangs pa yis/ /byang phyogs kyi ni ngos gdab bo/ /shar nas bden bral mtshams bltas te/ /lho yi thig ni gdab par bya/ /de nas ske yi mtshams gnas te/ /rlung gi mtshams su gdab par bya/ /bden bral mtshams nas dbang ldan du/ /drangs te grwa yi thig gdab bo/ /de nas thig rnams ci rigs par/ /lhag chad med pa nyid du gdab/ /de nas dbus su phur btab ste/ /de la brtod pa'i srad bu ni/ /dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur dag gis so/ /rdo rje ra ba la sogs bskor/ /'di yi phyi yi 'khor lo ni/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rab tu mdzes/ /kha khyer bzhi dang ldan pa la/ /rdo rje dril bu la sogs brgyan/ /sgo yi mtshams dang grwa bzhi ru/ /zla phyed rdo rje mdzes par bya—/ /de yi nang gi 'khor lo ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'jigs pa ste/ /rdo rje phreng bas rab mjes pas hūṃ/ /kun nas yongs su bskor bar bya/ /tī —las nyi ma zla ba dag /mig tu bsams te khro bo yi/ /blta bar bcas pas kun bltas nas/ /sgo rnams dag ni legs bya ba/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad char bya//sgo khyud chen po spangs pa yin/ /sgo yi tshad du khyams bya ste/ /de bzhin lha yi snam bu'o/ /kha khyer sgo yi phyed du ste/ /'gram dang gshog pa de yi tshad/ /dra ba dra phyed nyi zla dang / /rnga dang rdung dkrol la sogs rgyan/ /de phyed tshon sna lnga yi sa/ /rdo rje ra ba'ang de yi tshad/ /rta babs sgo yi sum 'gyur la/ /ba dan dril bu la sogs rgyan/ /rin chen kun dang lcags rnams dang / /24—85

'byung khyang dag dzo gi phye ma la/ /yi ge lnga bkod byen brlab 2bya/ /'bar bar gyur dang gsang sngags bzlas/ /oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ sems can khams rnams grol mdzad cing / /de ni chos dbyings ro yin no/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor 'dri — ba'i tshe/ /rlung la sogs pa byung gyur na/ /khro bo'i sbyor dang ldan pa yis/ /rlung sogs bcing ba tshul bzhin bya/ /gshin rje gshed po rgyal kun gtso / /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor gyur pa/ /skyon kun las ni rnam grol ba / /de yi dbus su legs gnas te/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas mnyam po ru / /bla mas g.yon gyi khu tshur gyis/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu sngon po de bzhin no/ /mnyam dang g.yas skor tshad ldan par/ /dkyil 'khor ri mo bri bar bya/ /mnyam po bri bar ri mo ni/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha yin te/ /de las sngusgoms na nad 'byung la/ /phras na nor rnams zad par 'gyur/ /kyag kyog byung na 'thab mo 'byung / /chad na slob ma bla ma 'chi/ /g.yas skor du ni ma bris na/ /rdul tshon gyi ni dngos grub nyams/ /rdo rje rtse mo dkar po'i ngos / /gzhan ser ba yi mdog yin te/ /gzhan ni padma rā ga'i ngos/ /de bzhin ma ra ka ta ste/ /nang du sngon por shes par bya/ /de ni rdul tshon rim par bshad/ /shar gyi phyogs su dkar po ste/ /lho yi phyogs su ser po yin/ /nub phyogs dmar po bya ba ste/ /byang phyogs ljang gu dag tu 'dod/ /dbus ma'i sa yi cha nyid ni/ /ind+ra dī la rab tu 'bar/ /rtag tu shes rab thabs ldan pas/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag yang dag bri/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gdan dag la/ /rdo rje'i 'od kyis kun 'khrigs pa'i/ /rdo rje dbus su yang dag bri/ /'khor lo 'od 'bar rab 'jigs pa'i/ /'khor lo shar gyi ra 5la bri/ /rin chen 'od 24—86

'bar rab 'khrigs pa'i/ /rin chen lho yi phyogs su bri/ /nub tu padma'i sprin 'khrigs pa'i/ /padma dmar po sdong bur bcas/ /ral gri'i 'od kyi tshosnarab 'khrigs pa'i/ /ral gri byang gi ra 5la bri/ /tho ba 'bar 'od gsal ba ni/ /shar gyi sgo ru dzi bar bya/ /be con 'bar 'od 'khrigs pa yi/ /be con lho yi sgo ru dgod/ /padma 'bar ba rab 'jigs pa'i/ /'od dang ldan pa nub sgor bri/ /ral gri 'bar ba'i sprin ldan pa/ /byang gi sgo ru bri bar bya/ /me mtshams la sogs grwa bzhi ru/ /go rims bzhin du 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje padma utpa la/ /'od dang ldan pa bri bar bya/ /phyi yi me mtshams la sogs par/ /zla bas gang ba'i snod bzhi bri/ /de ltar 'khor lo rdzogs pa dang / /mkha' la bkod pa phab byas la/ /de nas sngon bzhin shes rab dang / /spyor byas 'khor lo bskyed nas gdon/ /de la spyan sogs byen brlab bye dang / /thugs gsung sku yi rdo rje dang / /dbang bskur la sogs bya ba yin/ /de nas sngon bzhin ye shes kyi/ /'khor lo dgug dang bgegs bskrad sogs/ /byas la sgo bzhi'i khro bo yi/ /sngags la dzaḥsogs mthar ldan pas/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang bya dang //ra ba dra ba la sogs bya/ /de nas lha mos sngon bzhin mchod/ /bstod dang bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /rdul yab sbrang yab bsil yab dang / / khams dang skyed jemos tshal dag dang / /gzims mal dang ni gdan khri dang / /myur 'gro rta dang glang po dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /rta babs dang ni bla re sogs/ /bza' btung bro mchog sna tshogs dang / /glu gar la sogs mtha' yas mchod/ /de nas ci 'byor gzhan dag la/ /bzlas pa byas te mnyes par bya/ /bdud rtsi dang ldan dri chu yis/ /maṇḍal legs par byas 2 4—87

nas su/ /oṃ dīḥsgoḥblu kṛ tā lkun na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad e ku sha thudzaḥ.oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/'byung po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dgug dang phur bus gdab pa ste/ /de ltar byas pas 'od nyid du/ /gyur las rang rang yi ge ste / /de las mtshan ma de las sgu4/ /dhīḥsgoḥwi kṛ rnam bzhi ni/ /dbang po gshin rje chu lus ngan/ /'byung po me lha srin po rlung / /ta ā na na las byung ba'o / /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang yi ge gsum/ /nyi ma zla ba tshangs pa'o/ /phaṭa dang swā ste yi ge gnyis/ /sa bdag dang ni lha ma yin/ /hā ni khyab 'jug la sogs so/ /thams cad zhal gsum nyis 'gyur phyag /dang po rang rang phyag mtshan la/ /lhag ma bde bar gshegs dang mthun/ /zhal mdog rigs kyi gtso bo 'dra/ /mig sogs brlab dang lus ngag yid/ /dbang bskur ba yang 'dra byas nas/ /gtor ma bdud rtsi bzhin brlabs la/ /lce yang brlabs te sbubs kyis su/ /rang sngags brjod pas brngub par bya/ /oṃ ind+ra ya sthāḥya ma 1ཿwa 5ru ṇa ya wi/gu bee rā ya kṛ/ yī shā nā ya ta/ agha ye ā/ nee dṛ6tya ya na/ bā ya be na/tsand+ra ya hūm̐/ arka 7ya hūṃ/ brahma rja ya phaṭa/ ba su dha rā 8snaya phaṭa/ be ma tsi tā ya swā/ sarba tsubhu te bhyo hā/ ha ha ha ha hūṃ/ hi nyi hi hi hūṃ/ de yis phyogs skyong tshim byas nas/ /'thor 'thung byas pa nang du 'gro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor zhal bsro'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg gis ni tshim bya ste/ /sbyin sreg las las 'byung ba ltar/ /zhi dang rgyas pa bya bar 'dod/ /de nas slob ma rnams gzhug phyir/ /dang por bdag nyid 'jug par bya/ /bdag nyid sku sogs byin brlab cing / /snang ba thob par gyur pa yis/ /slob ma gzhug pa'i don 24—88

du ni/ /de nyid rab tu brjod par bya/ /oṃ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir—/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpar deng grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /de nas bden pa'i byin rlabs kyibarjod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa'i/ /mgon bo bden pa 'di yis ni/ /bdag la khyed kyis 'dod rdzogs shog /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /de nyid de nyid bskyed pa ni/ /de dag bden pas dkyil 'khor la/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /sdig med par ni thams cad mthong / /thun mong sdom bzung bye slob ma ni/ /sngon bzhin sku sogs 'od gsal ba/ /yol bas bar du bcad nas su/ /kun byed bum pa'i chu yis su/ /bkrus pa'i dar ras dmar po yis / /bu sdug de yi ngo bkab la/ /khyod su zhes ni dri bar bya/ /bdag 24—89

ni skal ldan yin zhes smra/ /khyod ci dga' zhes dris pa la/ /skal ba bzang la bdag dga' zhes/ /'jug pa pos kyang smra bar bya/ /de nas phreng ba spyin bya ste / /u dusmra 1ra manda ra/ /yongs 'du kyedag ni ma li ka /kar ni ka yi phreng ba ni/ /legs par mnos te bus zung shig ༄ sgyu /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bla ma slob dpon mgon rjes su/ /'bad pa chen pos dbang gi don/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas chos chen pos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rtsedabang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbang bskur te/ /bdag la don mchog stsal du gsol/ /gtso la yon sogs rab tu dbul/ /gtang sasems yang dag bskyed par bya/ /de yi snying gar rdo rje ni/ /me tog bcas pa'i snying por bzhagasnye /oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta/utyā da yā mi su ra ta sa ma ya ste ho sirnyi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ de ring khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam pa'i gsang chen 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya'o/ /dad pa med pa la yang mi rung ngo / /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /tho sogs sngags kyis drang bya zhing / /yi ge gsum gyis gzhug par bya/ /nang du sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug /de nas tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /de ring khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs la rab tu chud do / /de bas bdag gis khyod kyi rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'o/ /ye shes gang gis khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par bya meste / gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dngos grub 'di ni khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /khyod ni dam tshig la hūṃ'ada' bar mi rung ngo / /de ring rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /khyod kyi snying la 24—90

yang dag gnas/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na tshoni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs / /oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ/ pad gnas yig gsum 'bar ba yi/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni 'thung bcug ste/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg gyepar byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badzod ka ṭhaḥde nas 'di skad smra bar bya'o/ /de ring phan chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas ci smras pa'i bya ba 'di khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /nga la yang brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs par shi ba'i dus byas te/ dmyal bar ltung bar ma 'gro shig /de nas de ltar smra ba la/ slob mas 'di ltar smra bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byen gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig /ces smra bar bya'o/ /gsol 'debs de yi gnas bzhi ru/ /'byung chen bzhi yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /yi ge bzhi la dbyibs mdog ldan/ /ba dan la sogs mtshan byas pa/ /bsams te rlung la sogs bskyod pa/ /rdo ba dag kyang 'bab gyur na/ /sems ldan 'bab pa ci zhig smos/ /ye shes babs nas 'phar gyur na/ /tiṣṭha badzras brtan par bya/ /lce la yi ge a bsams te/ /dge dang mi dge dri bar bya/ /de nas mig gi snang ba dri/ /me tog 'khor lo la dor nas/ /pra tītstsha badzra ho zhes brjod/ /slar yang blangs la mgor bcings la/ /pra ti kṛtna la sogs brjod/ /mtshan ma gang la bab pa ste/ /de ni de yi lha ru sbyin/ /'od 'bar oṃ gnyis mig tu bsam/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis khyod/ /de ring nan tan mig phye'o/ /bla na med pa'i rdo rje'i mig /thams cad rab tu phye bar 'gyur/ /badzra pā sha /dkyil 'khor bzang 24—91

po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /sangs rgyas gdung gi rigs su 'khrungs/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'go ba phun tshogs dngos grub kyang / /khyod la mngon 3 du phyogs par 'gyur/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/ /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /ral gri gshin dgra nas brtsams nas/ /ji srid gtso bo'i mthar thug par/ /bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jug pa yin/ /spyi bor chu yis gtor bya zhing / /badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa brjod/ /dbu rgyan dbang yang de bzhin te/ /de nas rdo rje sbyin par bya / /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i 5dbang / /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje zungs shig sde rab grub phyir/ /rdo rje dril bu 'khyud byas nas/ /bdag po'i dbang yang bskur bar bya/ /oṃ badzra a bye pa ti two sngu.a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ spyi bor gdab tshul ming dbang bskur/ /tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya ste/ oṃ badzra satwa two a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/slob dpon gang dang gang dag gi/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang gang gi/ /de nas de yi mtshan dag ni/ /dpal dang kye yis mdzes par bya/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga byin nas su/ /rig spyor brtul zhugs lung bstan dang / /dbugs dbyung dang ni gsum du 'dod/ /hūṃ gis rdo rje de bskyed la/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis rtag tu gzung bar bya / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha baṃ5/ e ṣa ste 5dha ra yā mi badzra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ thog ma tha ma med pa yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /chos kyi dril bu gzung bar bya/ /'di 24—92

de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab rjes 'gro ba yi dbyangs/ /rtag par khyod kyis kyang gzung ste/ /rgyal ba byang chub mchog tu bzhed/ /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /srid pa rang bzhin gyis dag phyir/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'byung bar byed/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa'i mchog ni 'grub par byed/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bstan /hūṃ7bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi spyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /mkhas mchog bzhugs par gyur gyi tshe/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i thabs/ /bsod nams byin brlabs kyis bsgrubs la/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i brtul zhugs ni/ /de yis rab tu sbyin par bya/ /de nas sdom bzung yon phul te/ /phyag byas tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab / /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen 3snabagyis pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /'jug sgor padma 'dab brgyad pa/ /dar gyis bkab par 'dug byas la/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad glu sgra dang / /rdo rje dril bu gsil ba yis/ /skyob pa kun gyis mngon sum du/ /til kyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i/ /rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas su/ /de nyid la ni dbang bskur bas/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid rig par bsam / /chu dang dbu rgyan sngon bzhin te/ /rdo rje dril bu tshig 'dis sbyin/ /24—93

shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin du/ /grub pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'di/ /khyod kyis dad pas rab zung 1la/ /rdo rje khyod kyis slob ma bsdus/ /ming yang sngon dang 'dra bar spyin/ /de nas bla mas tshig 'di brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri gcig pu mchog/bdud rnams las ni rgyal ba zung / /dkyil 'khor de bzhin nyid bstan pa/ /mnyam pa nyid phyir gru bzhi ste/ /nye bar bzhag 2dang yang dag spong / /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang dbang po/ /go rims bzhin du sgo bzhi'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi ni rta babs te/ /ting nge 'dzin bzhi kha khyer yin/ /de rten gzungs kyi rang bzhin no/ /'gro kun gdul phyir phyogs sgo na/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril sgra sgrogs/ /byang chub yan lag rnam dag phyir/ /dra ba dra phyed la sogs spras / /rnam thar brgyad ldan ka ba ste/ /rgyan bkod bkra bas mdzes pa ni/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs bskong phyir/ /sna tshogs las kyi mthar thug phyir/ /pho brang sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar/ /theg chen 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /sems can sems ni dgrol bya'i phyir/ /tshon rnams ye shes lnga yin no/ /dam pa'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems gang ka pā la/ /bdug pa me tog mar me dang / /bshos dang byug pa la sogs ni/ /snyan grags byang chub yan lag dang / /dga' dang chos zas lus bde yin/ /ngo tsha khrel yod sdom pa yis/ /bde bskyed dbyangs dang gar sogs yin/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs phyir gzhal yas khang / /snying po len phyir dkyil 'khor ro/ /lha yi de nyid bstan bya ba/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran ting 'dzin/ /stobs rnams dag pa sgor gnas bzhi/ /byams 27—91

sogs tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi/ /tsartsi kā 1sogs lha mo bzhi/ /shin tu rnam dag la sogs lnga/ /zhe sdang gshin rje la sogs pa'o/ /'khor bas ma chags padma ste/ /nyi zla byang chub sems myu gu/ /gso dang smin par byed pa'o/ /de nas byad dang na sor ldan/ /ri dwags lte ba'i dri mnam dang / /gser gyi rna 2cha g.yo ba zhig /gcig cig legs btsal dbul bar bya/ /bla mas bzhes te byin brlabs la/ /sbyor ba'i cho gas mnyes par bya/ /bde ba mthe bong srin lag gis/ /slob ma'i kha ru dbab par bya/ /bde ba'i btung ba rin chen de/ /brtan pa'i blo yis btung bar bya/ /a ho su kha zhes kyang smra/ /de nas bu mo mig yangs mo/ /mdzes shing nu ma rgyas pa zhig /rang gi bu la sbyin par bya/ /mgo bor lag bzhag gsang ba gtad/ /de yi gzungs ma legs sbyin mo/ /de dang bde ba myang 4bar bya/ /de nas slob dpon shes rab dang / /bcas pas dkyil 'khor lha de nyid/ /slob dpon las rnams bstan 5par bya/ /ji ltar dbang bskur la sogs 'dis/ /sangs rgyas sogs kun thob pa bzhin/ /byang chub spyod sogs gzhan dag dang / /'dul sogs dge bas de bzhin min/ /de bas dam tshig bus srungs shig /rtag tu sdom pa yang bsrung ngo / /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' ste/ /de las gzhan pa'i dam tshig bsrung / /dkon mchog gnod pa gsad bya ste/ /bud med kun kyang spyad par bya/ /pha rol nor yang blangs nas su/ /rtag tu brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang gsungs 6pa/ /de ni cho ga bzhin du bsrung / /de nas de bzhin gshegs gyur nas / /lung bstan pa ni bya ba yin/ /g.yon gyis snying gar chos gos gzung 7//g.yas pa yis ni mchog 8sbyin bya/ /oṃ/ ngas khyod 'di ltar lung bstan yin/ /21—95

srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /srid pa'i mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /kye gshin rje mthar 'byin pa ni bhur bhu ba swaḥ de ltar lung bstan bsngags pa de/ /bla med nyid du lung bstan yin/ /de nas dbugs dbyung sbyin bya ste/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /mthong ba dang ni zhugs gyur pas/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol zhing / /khyed rnams de nyid legs par gnasatsho7/ /bde chen zeg pa 'di la ni/ /slar 'chi ba ni yod med de/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi song trepas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod bton/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /rtog pa mchog tu gyur pa yis /dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di/ /rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam kyis su/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /phyag na rdo rje gang yin pa'i/ /de la sogs pa'i bka' stsal ni/ /ci rigs par ni brjod par bya/ /de ltar bka' stsal thob pa dang / /slob ma gus dang ldan pa yis/ /bla ma'i rkang par phyag byas la/ /thams cad bsgrub par khas blang ngo / /de nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ /ci nus pa yang bya ba ste/ /slob ma g.yon phyogs bzhag nas su/ /de yi srin lag nas bzung thul/ /sbyin sreg bsang dang bsrung ba dang / /me tog bsnyus te bla ma la/ /phul la mer dor smon lam bya/ /de ltar bya ba kun zin nas/ /de nyid gsum mthar muḥldan pas / /ye shes sems dpa' gshegs par bskul/ /de dang mthun par bskyed par bsdu/ /thog mar a ldan gsang sngags kyis/ /rdul tshon bsgrims 24—96

te bsdu bar bya/ /rol mo bcas pas spyan drangs la/ /tī li shī lis chu bor dor / /rdo rje'i skam khas phur bu gdon/ /rig pa spyan bzlas 'o mas bkru/ /ba yi lci bas dkyil 'khor byug /de steng dga' ston la sogs bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni yo byad kun/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bar bshad/ /de ltar bya ba las dang po'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yi snabya ba yin/ /gzhan dag dbab dang sems nyid kyis/ /byas pa rmad du byung ba yin/ /de ltar dbang thob slob ma de / /deng nyid slob dpon go 'phang 'gyur/ /de yis bsgrub pa 'bras bcas phyir/ /des ni bsgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /las kyi mthar thug rgyud 'di ru/ /thun mong ma yin 'khor lo ni/ /dgos pa ma lus kun byed pa/ /de 'dir bdag gis bri bar bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pas/ /legs byugs dur khrod ras ma la/ /dug dang nim pa'i khu ba dang / /khrag dang dur khrod sol ba dang / /da du ra sogs snag tsha dang / /rus pa'i smyu gus bri bya ba/ /gcer bu skra bshig 1gdong bsnyer te/ /khros pas lho ru mngon phyogs la/ /sngags bzlas rtse gcig pa yis bri/ /zlum por bskor ba gsum bya ste / /dgu dang bcu gnyis bcu drug ste/ /le tshe rnams ni byas pa la/ /yi ge gsang sngags sa bon bri/ /dbus su zhe sdang rdo rje nyid/ /yang / shar du gti mug rdo rje ste/ /lhor ni ser sna rdo rje yin/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje la//byang du phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /kṣe ma me da gnyis pa yi4/ /gnyis pa'i phyogs bzhir lhor brtsams nas/ /shar gyi phyogs la thug gi bar/ /khro bo yum dang snod dag gi/ /re re'i thugong ma mas rim bzhin/ /do yo ya/ mtshams kyi le tshe brgyad po la/ /bden bral mtshams na lha mo gnyis/ /rlung gnas mdzod 24—97

ldan me mtshams sgod/ /dbang ldan na ni thod pa gnyis/ /me mtshams na ni sgo srung 1gnyis/ /dzā/ sa ru ṇa 2ni ratstsha ni/ /kun ming thog ma dbus su ste//a / lho ru ser sna ral gri 'dzin/ /nub tu chags dang dbyangs can ma/ /byang du phrag dog bden bral snod/ /shar du gti mug dang tho ba/ /ma ra me do yo kṣe ya/ / sngags ming bskul tshig bcas pa dang / /yi ge gnyis par ming bcug pa/ /spel zhing spel zhing bri bar bya/ /de ltar bris pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /lugs dang lugs min bar byas la/ /do da yo kṣe ya gnas la/ / gnas pa phyi nang so so yi/ /phyogs mtshams bye brag bklag pa dang / /phyi nang thun mong phyogs mtshams su/ /bklag pa dag ste gnyis su 'dod/ /gnas pa sde tshan so so ni/ /gtso bo khro bo lha mo dang / /bandha 4bzhi ru shes bya ste/ /sdom dang so sor bklag par bya/ /yakṣe ma me da pātstsha ni rā/ /dzā sa do ru ṇa yo nir/ /yi ge bcu bdun dbang byas nas5/ /rnam pa dgu ru bklag pa yin/ /rtsa ba'i sngags su gdon pa la/ /yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang / /rkang pa bzhi ru gdon pa dang / /so sor phye ste gdon pa'o/ /ya ma rā dza la sogs pa'o/ /dang po dang 'og 6mtha' ltag mtha'/ /gtso bo lnga ru bstan pa yin/ /dang po tha ma yi ge brgyad/ /gshin rje dgra nyid shes par bya /ya ya yaya yaya yaya/dang po mgo mtha' mtha' ma'i ltag /ser sna rdo rje yin par 'dod/ /ma ma / dang po'i mtha' ltag gnyis dang mgo/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i yi ge yin//me me/ gnyis pa'i mtha' ltag gsum dang 'og /phrag dog nyid du bstan pa yin / /da da/ gsum pa'i mtha' ltag bzhi dang 'og /gti mug rdo rje'i yi ge yin/ / kṣe kṣe8/ rkang pa dang po'i dbu ma bzhi/ /khro bo gcig dang lha 24—98

mo gsum/ /rā dza sa do/ rkang pa gnyis pa'i dbu ma bzhi/ /lha mo gnyis dang thod pa gnyis/ /do ru ṇa yo/ rkang pa gsum pa'i dbu ma bzhi/ /sgod chen gsum dang khro bo gcig /yo ni rā ya/ rkang pa bzhi pa'i dbu ma bzhi/ /khro bo bzhi ru shes par bya/ /yatstsha ni rā/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa dang / /'phel dang 'grib dang mu bzhi dang / /thun mong dang ni rnam pa drug /gcig gnyis gsum bzhi gong nas 'phel/ /gsum gnyis gcig dang zad mthar thug /rā do ru yo/ ni rā yatstsha ni rā/ dzā sa do na yo ya/ mtha' 1ma gcig dang gong ma gsum/ /'og ma gnyis dang gong ma gnyis/ /'og ma gsum dang dang po gcig /ma 'dres bzhi dang mu bzhi'o/ /'jug dang ldog dang thun mong ni/ /gong du bstan pas shes bya ste/ /'jug ldog phyogs kyi gtso bo la/ /thun mong phyi yi phyogs la'o/ /dgu dang brgyad kyi yi ge ni/ /bcu bdun dag ste lha ru 'dod/ /re re'ang mgo dang mthar ldan par2/ /gsang sngags gdon par bya ba yin/ /dbus kyi phyogs min stong pa ru/ /sa bon gnyis par ming spel bri/ /rim pa gsum pa'i le tse ni/ /bcu drug pa la bri bya ba/ /sngags ming bsgul tshig bcas pa dang / /yi ge gnyis par ming bcug pa/ /spel zhing spel zhing bri bar bya/ /de ltar dzres pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /lugs dang lugs min gnyis byas la/ /so sor mthun par mgo sprad la/ /til te phyi rol mar khus byug /thod pa gnyis ni kha sbyar bar/ /mar khus khrag blugs der bcug la/ /skud pa sngon pos khris bdun dkri/ /de la rnge tog nag bo dang / /dus 4sogs nag pos mchod par bya/ /rgyal po'i sgo khang sa dang ni/ /grog khyem la sogs sa dag las/ /gshin rje'i dgra yi sku bya ba/ /27—99

'khrugs pa zhal gabyug phyag gnyis pa/ /khru gang tsam gyi tshad byas la/ /de yi mdun du dkyil 'khor ni/ /gnag pa khrag gis 1chag chag can/ /byas la de steng spos chen dbul/ /de nas bdag gi gsang sngags ni/ /bskul ⑤tshig ldan par rab tu bzlas/ /khro bo'i rgyun ni rnam spros te/ /gzas pa'i lus las go cha dang / /srung ba phrogs nas bdag la thim/ /de nas de ni gos med cing / /sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas gzir bsam/ /de bkug mthar byed lto bar gzhug /khro bo gcan ri byegazan sna tshogs kyis/ /gshin rje gshed kyi lto ba nas / /rkang dang rgyu ma khrag tshil bubya/ /phyogs bcur khyer nas 'gro bar bsam / /de ltar brtan par gyur pa dang / /shing gcig dur khrod la sogs par / /gshin rje'i lto bar bcug la sba/ /'khor lo dgos pa kun byed 'di//so so'i bye brag shes byas la/ /zhi sogs las rnams thams cad ni/ /ji ltar mngon par dga' bar bya/ /la li badzra zhes bya nus pa kun dang rnam bral yang / /bla ma'i rjes 'brangs dad pas de yi phyogs tsam gzung bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di byas dge ba dri med gang yin pa/ /de yi cho'agro kun gshin rje ma lus mthar phyin byed gyur cig /gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /gshin rje gshed 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po la li ta badzra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badzra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ༄ snab cog gru shes rab bla mas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //24—100
