༄ / /mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi 2 tsitta lhange ti ka /bod skad du/mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga mdor bsnyus pa/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang thob gzhan don la dga' bas/ /dur khrod la sogs dben gnas su/ /byams dang snying rje sngon btang la/ /yon tan kun rdzogs mchod rten gdab/ /de la dang por bdag nyid kyis/ /las dang mthun pa'i sa blangs la/ /khrus dang rgyan rnams ci rigs bgo'o/ /de nas rdo rje rnam bzhi yis/ /yang na gar mos lha yang rung / /bdag nyid rdzogs nas 'jim pa brdzi/ /oṃ trīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ā thra 4te ku ru swā hā/zhes pas brdzis 'dzin rdo rje bzhi/ /gang 5bzhin ci rigs spyan drangs la/ /mchod bstod las dang bstun 6bhel bya/ /'od kyi gong bur gyur pa las/ /'bi 'bi 'od kyi thig bran can/ /gong bur 7dza sa do ru bkod/ /yang na oṃ 24dod104

bkod yum kyi mkha'/ /'bi 'bi'i rdul phran re re la/ /yi ge ya la sogs pa bkod / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med gdab/ /sgra yis 1dam chos la sogs sgogs/ /mkha' 'byung 2bde gshegs kun dpag med/ /rdul re sku re de ltar brtag /maṇḍal las mthun ras de bzhin/ /dang po snying po phyag rgya dang / /che ge las dang bstun par gzhug /de nas rgyan dbul srog 'khor ro //dar chen chu srin rgyal mtshan gsol/ /legs par rdzogs nas gzhan yang ni/ /de nas rang snying 'od zer gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas spyan drangs la/ /mchod bstod la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /gnyis med tshul du bsre bar bya/ /de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /tsartsi kā 4sogs legs pa'i glus/ /lha mo chu yis sku khrus gsol/ /de nas las dang mthun pa yi/ /gsol ba btab pas shes par bya/ /gdab pa'i sngags ni sthāḥdzdza'am/ /nang gi yi ge bcu bdun pa'am/ /'khor lo'i sngags sogs so so'am/ /sdom pa la yang 'gal ba med/ /rang rang las dang sbyar ba'i sngags/ /sdig pa zhi bar bya ba yis/ /sarba pā pa shādzhai ku ru yo ku ru swā hā/ nor dang bsod nams rgyas byed na/ /dbus su puṣṭi ku ru swā hā/ dgra la sogs pa dbang sdud na/ /pa bye ku ru swā hā/ gang dag gnod byed gsod 'dod na/ /mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bsgrub bya ngan byed par 'dod na/ /bi dzwa ṣa 5ya phaṭa / gnas nas spo bar 'dod pa na/ /utstsha ta 6ya phaṭa/ gang dag mnan par bya bar 'dod na/ ste 7bha ya hūṃ lam̐/ bsgrub bya dgug par 'dod pa yis / / ā kaste ya dzaḥ de la sogs pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /rgyud las 'byung ḍab bzhin du brtag /de skad du yang / nye ba'i las ni gang grub pa/ /phyag rgya snying po bris bcug na/ /gang bsgoms —the tshom med par 'grub/ /dngos grub 24—105

gang 'dod sbyin par snanges/ /gzhan yang nang gi sbyor ba ni/ /ting nge 'dzin la rag las pa/ /gzhan nas byung ba yang shes par bya'o/ /bdag gi dge ba cung zad 'di/ /'gro ba gshin rje gshed gnas thob par shog /rgya gar gyi mkhan po la li ta bajo(sa mjordod pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷4 nyamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ cas〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ chosate〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gro/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sri/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shegang / 'u〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bral can/ /gong bus/105 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pho/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de sha 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skab/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stam kā ra/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung / te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/106 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (757)24wa 106

༷831༄7/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs/sna༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ rakṣa sā dha no pi ka /bod skad du/srung 2ba'i 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po —la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal gshin rje dgra mgon la/ /yang dang yang du phyag byas la/ /bar chad zhi bar byed pa yi/ /srung 4ba dam pa bshad par bya/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga rdzogs pa yi5/ /de yis bsgrub pa 'bras bcas phyir/ /da ni srung ba'i las rnams bya/ /rab tu shis pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /khrus byas byug pa dri zhim byug /mchog gi gos bgo rgyan rnams gdags/ /bde stan skyil krung shar bltas la/ /phan pa'i sems dang byams par ldan/ /spro bas 5'dod pa'i lhar bskyed de/ /bsod nams tshogs bsags gnyis med bsre/ /mtshan bcas sngags bzlas gtor ma sbyin/ /gsar zhing dge ba'i ras dag la/ /tsandan ga pur byug bya ste/ /skyes bu zhi 7byed gur kum ste/ /bud med la ni gi 24—107

wang ngo / /ser ba la sogs zhi byed dang / /nad dang gnod pa thams cad la/ /gur gum dag gis yang dag bya/ /de dag bri ba'i smyu gu yang / /gser ram dngul lam shis par bri/ /de dag bri ba'i rim pa yang / /phyi dro maṇḍal legs byas te/ /mchod par ldan pas yang dag bri/ /bden pa bdar la bri bar bya/ /thig chen brgyad ni yang dag gdab/ /zlum por bskor ba gsum byas te/ /tha ma thod pas bskor bar bya/ /thig thung rnams kyang gdab bya ste/ /dgu dang bcu gnyis bcu drug mig /dbus kyi re'u 1mig dgu pa la/ /dbus su ya la shar du kṣe/ /lho ru ma bri 3nub tu me/ /byang du da ste mtshams bzhi ru/ /rakṣa rakṣa bar ming gzhug /rim pa gnyis pa shar brtsams nas/ /ya tsa ni ra dza sa do ru/ ṇa yo ni rā/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar brtsams nas/ /shar kyi re'u — mig dang po la/ /oṃ sthāḥskṛḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ che ge mo rakṣa rakṣa/ de 'og re'u ngamig gnyis pa la/ /che ge mo rakṣa rakṣa/ de ltar re'u 5mig bcu drug pa/ /spel zhing spel zhing dgod par bya/ /de ltar bris pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /lugs dang lugs min gnyis byas te/ /sa skor snelugs su byung ba la/ /gnam skor dang ྅ni lugs las bzlog /yig hūṃsngags mthun mthun mgo sprod 9de/ /so sor mnyam 7por bris la dril/ /kham phor yang dag gtsang nyu ma'i nang / /phyi rol spra tshil dril byas te/ /rtsi mar sbrang rtsir bcas pa gzhug /bas bskyed skud pa dkar po yis/ /khris bdun dag tu dkri bar bya/ /maṇḍal dkar po khru gang tshad/ /ba yi rnam lnga dri yis byug /de steng thukham phor kha sbyar bzhag /stong nyid ngang las thig le ste/ /de las yig 'bru phyag mtshan sku/ /kun kyang zhal gsum nyis 'gyur phyag /rang 24—108

gi rig bcas bde ba gang / /sgu mdog phyag mtshan rdzogs par bskyed/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs 1tshul bzhin bya/ /rang nyid hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo rdzogs pa dgug /phyag dang mchod sogs sdom pa gzung / /de nas gnyis med 'od zer gyis/ /dam tshig 'khor lo gnyis med bsre/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ /de nas thugs rje rjes dran nas/ /bsrung ba'i don du 'od du zhu/ /thig le dag las yi ger gyur/ /lha rnams sngags kyi gzugs kyi 2bzhugs/ /de la byen rlabs 'di dag bya/ /sbyan gyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i/ /hūṃ ya mān ta kṛta badzra dharmā tsakṣu pra be sha ya zhes brjod do / /zhal gyi phyag rgya shes pa yis/ /oṃ ya mānta ka de wa sho dha ya tram̐ pra bee sha ya phaṭa ces brjod/ gtsug tu phyag rgya rab byas la/ /oṃ ya mānta ka ba/ che ba'i phyag rgya ldan pa yis/ /oṃ gu khya gu lo/ de nas mchod dang bstod byas la// spro basbu 4ldan pas gsang sngags bzlas/ /bsrung ba'i don du rab tu sbyar/ /de nas kham phor dbyung byas la/ /spra tshil dag gis dril byas la/ /yang na rgya skyegs bskus byas pa'i/ /dri dang bsres te byug par bya/ /bsgrub bya khrus bya rgyan bgo 5ste/ /dris byugs maṇḍal 6steng bzhag ste/ /bden pa bdar te skyes pa g.yon/ /dpa' min dag ni g.yas su gdags/ /phas kyi rgol ba'i dmag rnams dang / /me dang chu dang nad la sogs/ /gang dag rlung dang ser ba rnams / /bsrung bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /shin tu gtsang zhing mthon por ni/ /maṇḍal 7legs byugs me tog dgram/ /de ni rgyal mtshan rtse la gdags/ /nyin re dus gsum yang dag mchod/ /bskul tshig ldan pas gsang sngags bzlas/ /gtor ma rgyun du sbyin par bya/ /sbyin sreg thal ba 24—109

phyogs bcur gtor/ /'khor lo 'dod pa'i bskul tshig ldan/ /de dag rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /srung 1ba kun gyi mchog yin pas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'bad par bya/ /srung ba kun gyi cho ga dam pa 'di/ /sgrub pa po dang sems can don du byas/ /de yis dge ba cung zad gang thob des/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi kun gyi gnod pa bsrung bar shog /dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷7 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipo/ —〈〈snar 〉thasrung / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yonas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ 7〈〈snar 〉thazhi/1༷8 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dri/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sde/ 45〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉re/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉bskor / 7〈〈pe 〉〉por dag 〈〈snar 〉ra skor dag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdog /yid/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sprad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamanyan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra tsang / 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs/1༷9 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉kya gzugs kyis/ 〈〈snar 〉〉kyis gzugs kyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs / 4〈〈snar 〉〉spros sdu/ 5〈〈snar 〉shes/ 6 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ḍal/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masal/11༷ 1〈〈snar 〉snga srung / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/24dod/ /0

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa ya mā ri nā 2ma sā dha dzha/ bod skad du / gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal khro bo 'jigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /drag shul che zhing 'jigs par byed/ /khro chen de la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub pa'i thabs bshad bya/ /de la sngags pa dbang dang dam tshig dang ldan pa/snying rje che ba/ rtul phod pa/ shes rab dang ldan pa des/ gnas dur khrod la sogs pa yid dga' ba'i gnas su gnas te/ brtul zhugs mchog spyad par bya'o/ /bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis lhar bskyed de/ /snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ bsam pa—/ /de la 'od zer gyis bsgul nas spyan drangs te/bzhugs pa la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa'i bye brag dbul/ de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang 5bya ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba 624—1 12

dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas—/ de nas stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya ste/ gang gi rnam par yang mi bsgom mo/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā 1dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolhahaṃ/ de 2rjes hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /sdang ba thams cad bsreg par bya/ /bsdus pas rdo rje gur du gyur/ /ra ba dra ba bsam par bya/ /de nas nam mkha'i dbyings bsam bya/ /de yi nang du gzhal yas khang / /rdo rje rgya gram yang dag ldan/ /rta babs bzhi dang ldan par bsgom/ /nyi gdan ma he yi dwags te/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa ni / /ā li 1bsgoms pas zla ba ste/ /kā li bsgoms pas rta bdun nyid/ /gnyis kyi bar du baṃ bsams te/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /de la snying pos yang dag brgyan/ /de las 'od byung don byas nas/ /slar 'dus de dag 'od du zhu/ /de las rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa la/ /g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar ba ste/ /rtsa ba'i lus mdog nag po'o/ /rdo rje ral gri gri gug g.yas/ /'khor lo padma thod pa g.yon/ /rdo rje rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yon pa brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas/ /rang rig ldan pa 4rab tu bsgom/ /rdo rje padma dag bya ste/ /bde 5gshegs thig le zla bar gyur0//de las yakṣe ma me da/ /ya tsa ni rā dzā sa do/ /ru ṇa yo ni ra dag ste/ /so so'i sa bon dag tu gyur/ /de las so so'i sku bskyed de/ /sngags chen gyis ni dbyung bar bya/ /oṃ juḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'khrugs pa zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /kha dog ind+ra nī 7la 'dra/ /lag na rdo rje chen po ste//zhe sdang chen po'i don mdzad nas/ /beer 'dus bdag nyid la thim bya/ /dzi na dzika gis gti mug gtso/ /zhal gsum phyag drug pa la zhi/ / dngas pa'i 824—113

chu zla dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lag tu 'khor lo thogs pa dbyung / /gti mug chen po'i 1don byas nas/ /mdun gyi zla dkyil dag la dgod/ /ratna j-ika gis ser sna'i bdag /btso ma gser mtshungs phyag drug ste/ /rin chen thogs pa dbyung bar bya/ /ser sna dag byas don chen byas/ /g.yas kyi nyi dkyil dag la bsam/ /ā ro loka cagis 'dod chags gtso/ /zhal gsum phyag drug padma 'dra/ /lag na padma thogs pa dbyung / /'dod chags chen po'i don byas te/ /gtso bo'i rgyab tu bsam par bya/ /pradzñā dhrika 5gis phrag dog bdag /zhal gsum phyag drug margad 6mtshungs/ /phyag na ral gri thogs pa dbyung / /phrag dog don byas rdo rjer gyur/ /g.yon gyi nyi dkyil dag la bsam//mud gar dhrika gis tho ba drag /mdog gnag phyag drug tho ba bsnams/ /drag po chen po'i 8don byas nas/ /shar gyi sgo la bsam par bya/ /daṇḍa j-ika gis be con can/ /gser mdog lag na bee con thogs/ /khro ba chen pos don byas nas/ /lho yi nyi dkyil dag la bzhugs/ /padma dhrika / gis padmo ste/ /mdog dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /padma thogs pas don byas te/ /nub kyi sgor ni bsam par bya/ /khaṅga dhrika 0gis ral gri dbyung / /zhal gsum phyag drug ljang gu'o/ /phyag na ral gri thogs pa ste/ /byang gi sgor ni bsam par bya//dzwa ṣa ra tis tsartsi dbyung / /'khor lo lag 'dzin dkar mo ste/ /byams pa chen pos don byas te/ /me yi zla dkyil bsam par bya/ /mo ha ra tis phag mo dbyung / /rdo rje lag 'dzin nag mo ste/ /snying rjes don byas slar bsdus la/ /lho nub zla dkyil bsam par bya/ /rā ga ra tis dbyangs can dbyung / /dmar mo lag na padma bsnams/ /dga' ba chen pos don byas nas/ /nub 27 —/ / /

byang zla dkyil bsam par bya/ /badzra ra tis mdzod ldan dbyung / /ljang gu lag na ral gri 'dzin/ /btang snyoms chen po'i 1don byas nas/ /byang shar zla dkyil bsam par bya/ /bdag po'i phyag mtshan 'dra ba la/ /rang rtags gang yin dang por sbyin/ /zhal mdog rigs kyis shes par bya/ /yang dag don gyi 'od du zhu/ /'od kyi gong bur de nyid gyur/ /tsartsi kā sogs legs pa'i glus/ /'od kyi gong bu sad par byed/ /kye/ rje btsun snying rjes khro bzhengs la/ /gnas gsum kun gyi gti mug sbyongs/ /bdud bzhi rnams las gtso bo rgyal/ /kye/ 'khrugs pa'i sems kyis gtso bo bzhengs/ /stod —gnas 'jig rten mgron gnyer ci/ /'jig rten sku mchog rje btsun bzhengs/ /kye / stong par bsams 5nas ci ste bzhugs/ /byang chub rang bzhin 'jig rten bzhengs/ /dngos rnams sgyu mar bsams nas ni/ /'od las yi ge hūṃ du bzhengs / /de las gtum po khro bo'i gzugs/ /'jigs byed gsus pa 6che ba yi/ /gshin rje nag po'i gzugs su gyur/ /zhal gsum phyag drug gong dang mthun / /gyen du skra 'bar 'jigs pa che/ /dum dang dum bur rnam par brgyan / /shin tu khros pa'i skur bsams te/ /ba spu'i bu ga rnams las ni/ /rang gi khro bo 'phro bar bsam/ /'jigs pa'i mche ba gabyugs pa'i zhal/ /ha ha 'byin pas za 7bar byed/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar lta bu ste/ /bdag nyid de ltar bsam par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsams nas ni/ /mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlab/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum bsgom/ /so so'i thugs las 'od byung ste/ /spyan drangs mchod pa yang dag spro/ /so so'i rig pa'i rim pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi sngags brjod bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 24dod/ /5

kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha1haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badzra swa bhā wa yas kolha2haṃ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ā kolhabye haṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' snying bsams te/ /de yi snying gar nyi ma bsams 5/ /de la sangs rgyas he ru ka /dbang bskur gshin gshed dbu la bsam/ /yang / de las 'od zer 'phros pas bskul/ /tho ba la sogs bzhi po yis/ /dgug dang gzhug dang bcing ba dang / /dbang du byas te mgu bar bya'o/ /zla ba nyi ma chu dang sman / /dri ni rlung me'i 'khor lor gnas/ /de la dpa' bo 'bru lngar bsam//de steng hūṃ las rdo rje bsam/ /oṃ gyis byin brlabs bdud rtsir hūṃbasgom/ /de nyid gsum ni mngon par bzlas/ /lce dag pas ni btung bar bya/ /de nas 'dod pa'i lha mo bsdu/ /cebadag gi dzeeb sru'i bu ga las/ /mchod pa spros te bdag nyid mchod/ /de nas 'khor rnams mchod par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātpa kolha haṃ/ chos rnams kun kyis de la bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed de 'jigs pa po/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun gyi 9bdag /mgon po 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i dgrar grags 'jigs pa po/ /thugs kyi rdo rjer rab snang ba/ /rin chen rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /mnga' bdag 'dod chags las byung ba/ /dbyangs kun gyi ni mchog gi mchog /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed de las kun mdzad/ /sku yi rdo rjer rab snang ba/ /ral gri'i phyag la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni kun bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni 24—/ 16

mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom/ /rnal 'byor 'di la rtag gnas bya/ /bsam gtan ma 1nus bzlas pa ste/ /bzlas pa bzhi la rab 'bad bya/ /zla ba drug gis mtshan ma 'byung / /de nas sgrub pa chen po brtsam/ /'khor lo la sogs gzhung bzhin bya/ /so so'i dus la gtad bya ste/ /zhag bzhir bsgrubs na 'dod pa 'grub—/ /oṃ dīḥskṛḥwi kṛ tā na 4na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ yakṣe ma me da ya tsa ni rā dza sa do ru ṇa 5yo ni rā/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra yakṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/ drag po'i gsang sngags man ngag bzhin/ /so so'i las dang spel bar bya/ /'byung po kun gyi gtor ma btang / /dang po gshin rje'i dgra la dbul/ /de nas so so'i 'khor la sbyin6/ /sngags chen 'di yis dbul bar bya/ /oṃ ind+ra ya trīḥ ya ma ye 1ཿ wa ru rja ya wi/ ku bee rā ya kṛ/ yī shwa nā ya ta/ agha ye ā/nai rje 7ta ye na/ bā ya bee na/ tsabye ya hūm̐/ srutyā ya 8hūṃ/ brahma shā ya phaṭa/ba su dha rā ya phaṭa/ bee ma tsi tra ye swā/ sarba khyu / te bhyo hā/ ha hā/ hi ṭī/hūṃ hūṃ phe phe swā hā/ sgrub pa chen po'i dus su ni/ /sku gzugs mdun du gzhag ⑩par bya/ /mchog gi sha la sogs pa dbul/ /mar me che yang rtag tu btang / /mchod pa'i mchog rnams dbul bar bya/ /ma yengs pa yi sems kyis dbul/ /'jigs pa'i sems ni ma yin no/ /sngags pas dpa' bo mchod par bya/ /spyod lam byed na 'di ltar bsgom/ /dngos po thams cad gshin rjer bsam/ /yang na rang rang dag par bya/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom/ /las kyi mthar thug 'jam dpal mchog /rtsod pa'i dus su byung ba 'di/ /bstan pa 27—117

bsrung ba'i dgos pa dang / /las kyi bye brag bsgrub pa dang / /blo dman rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi tshul du bris/ /blo dman dam tshig la gnas pas/ /rab tu 'bad de bsgrub par bya/ /rgyud kyi don mchog bsdus pa yi/ /gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub 1thabs byas/ /'di las ngal ba'i dge ba gang / /kun gyis 'jam dpal mchog thob shog /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon nyin mor byed pa'i grags pas mdzad pa spyodags so// //zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis/ rgya gar gyi dpe phyi mo dang gtugs te gtan la phab pa'o/ //bsdur mchan/112 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs nyin byed grags pas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartul/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dzeb/ 6〈〈snar 〉thar/113 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 bhā ātma ko haṃ/ der/ 〈〈snar 〉phro'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/5〈〈pe 〉thader/ 6〈〈snar 〉dkugyur/ 7〈〈pe 〉lke/ 8〈〈pe 〉rad pa'i/ 〈〈snar 〉rang ba'i/114 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnyika 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sden/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thag 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉beel 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamar gta/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrika 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stapos/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhrika115 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge sa/ 2〈〈snar 〉ra rtags/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stong / 5〈〈snar 〉〉bsam/ 6〈〈pe 〉sngagasus po/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 byed gsus po/ 7〈〈snar 〉ra za'/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/116 1 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasam/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gshin rje gshed de 'jigs pa po/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉271dod/ /8

〈〈snar 〉〉wa3/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉)sa/117 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ 2〈〈snar 〉togazhi/ sde〈〈snar 〉toradus/ zi〈〈snar 〉〉nā/ 57〈〈pe 〉ton/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉byinaske/ tshom〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ri/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skurya/ rsha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bhu/ te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhagaspe1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bos/118 〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ cha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (759)24wa 119

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i grub pa'i thabs/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa 2ya mā ri sā dha —/ bod skad du/gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed nag la/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni dpal 'dzin gyi/ /gdams pa la brten sgrub thabs ni/ /mdor basbus byis pas rtogs phyir bri/ /de la sngags pa nges par 'gro ba thams cad bsgral bar 'dod pa'i blo 4dang ldan pas dur khrod la sogs pa'i bsam gtan gyi gnas sam/gnas la lar tsandan la sogs pas byugs la/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang mi ldan pas 'khor ba las bsgral bar mi nus pas na/ dang por bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag par bya ba'i phyir bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ ya sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa bltas la/24—/20

de'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed du byas nas yang 'od zer des bla ma dang sangs rgyas la sogs pa mdun du spyan drangs te/ de dag la mngon par phyag byas la sa bon gyi 'od zer sngon po tsholas byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs sgeg mo la sogs pa dang / me tog la sogs pa'i zhen pa dang bral bas yang dag par mchod do/ /de nas sdig pa bshags shing bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / yongs su bsngo ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de ma thag pa'i zhing la tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo/ /de nas rten muḥyis gshegs so/ /de nas ye shes kyi tshogs la nan tan bya ste/ sna tshogs stong pa nyid du bsgom zhing / oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha2haṃ/ zhes brjod la/de nas stong pa'i bdag nyid las/ saṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po kha gyes pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de las byung ba'i rdo rje'i tshogs kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / ra ba dang gur bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su skad cig gis chos 'byung gru gsum pa dkar po'i nang du/ sna tshogs padma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la paṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs padma'i steng du re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi yig las rdo rje sngon po 'od zer bcas pa bsams te/ de'i 'od kyis thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i gshin rje gshed gsal bar byas nas/slar bkug ste/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje gshed du bsgom par bya'o//de yang sku mdog nag po g.yas dkar zhing / g.yon dmar ba/ rdo rje dang ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang padma dang / gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag drug pa/ ma he'i steng na g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa / mi mgo zlon pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs 21—121

can / rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra ser po gyen du langs pa / zhal mche ba rnam par gcigs pa bsams la/ de nas spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bya ba'i yi ge rnams bsam par bya'o/ /de nas mig la sogs pa skye mched byin kyis brlab par bya ste/ mig tu kṣiṃ ngo / /rna ba dag tu dzo 1ngo / /sna la khaṃ ngo / /dpral bar ni kai ngo / /lte bar ni saṃ ngo / /de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa rdo rje tsartsi kā la sogs pas bdud rtsi rnam pa lngas gang ba'i bum pa bzung nas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus ye shes kyi 4rdo rje mdun du bltas te/ de la mchod pa lngas yang dag par mchod la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba'o5—/ /de nas cho ga bzhin du mchod par bya'o/ /de nas bsgoms 6pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ trīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ldang ba'i dus su yang mchod pa byas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥzhes bya bas ye shes kyi rdo rje gshegs su gsol lo/ /thun so so la ji ltar rnyed pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor sbyangs la / sngags 'dis phyogs skyong rnams la dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ ind+ra ya dīḥ ya mā ya ṣṭiḥ wa ru zla ya wi/ ku be ru ya kṛ/ i shwa nā 7ya ta/ agha ye ā/nee rje ta ye na/ bā ya be na/ ārka 9ye hūṃ/ tsand+ra ye hūṃ/ brahma ṇi phaṭa/ ba su dha ra ye phaṭa/ bee ma tsi tra ye swā/ sarba bhū te bhyo hā/ ha hā hi tī/ hūṃ hūṃ phe phe swā hā/de nas zas za ba'i tshe na/ bdud rtsi rnam pa lngas sbyangs la/ de nyid gsum kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ lce rdo rje'i sbyor bas bza' bar bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs 'di/ /byas pas dge ba gang thob pa/ /'jig rten gsum ni ma lus 21dod/22

༄/ /dpal gshān rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs 'gor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa dang bcas pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī 2kṛdzha ya mā ri sā —dha dzee/ sa tsakra arba swe bista ra byā khyu/ bod skad du/ dpal gshin rje'i 5gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs / 'khor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa dang bcas pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' ltar spros med chos sku rnam dag dngos/ /'gro mgon 'jam dbyangs khro rgyal phyag 'tshal te/ /gshin rje gshed po dpal ldan de yi ni/ /sgrub pa'i thabs bzang 'khor lo bcas pa 6bshad/ /byang chub kyi sems gnyis shin tu brtan pa'i sngags pas tho rangs langs te/ lus kyi bya ba ma lus par byas la/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum dang / dpal gshin rje 'joms pa rnams 'od kyis bskul ba la/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa bdun dang /tshad rnged pa bzhi dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rnams byas la stong pa nyid 24—124

du bsam mo/ /de nas yud tsam gyis ma te'i steng du padma dang nyi mar 1bltas te/de'i dbus su hūṃ baṃ lo gyi sa bon gyur pa las rdo rje'o/ /de gyur pa las gshin rje 'joms par bdag nyid bsam pa ni/ zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa mi bzad pa'i khro bo sku mdog mthing ga zhal g.yas g.yon dkar ba dang dmar ba/ phyag g.yas g.yon na rdo rje dang / ral gri dang gri gug dang 'khor lo dang / padma dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /de nas de'i phung po lnga ni gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa lnga'o/ /khams bzhi ni tsazi kā la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i dpung pa dang g.yon pa'i dpung pa dang kha'i padma dang / gsang ba'i gnas rnams ni tho ba gshin rje gshed la sogs pa bzhi'o zhes mos par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' bsnyims 4la/yan lag drug bsams te/ de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la dbang bskur te/ spyi bo la rdo rje sems dpas brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i yo las spro ba dang bsdu ba skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du bya'o/ /skyo ba na oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra yakṣe ya yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/oṃ sthāḥz-iḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas so/ /yang na rim pas bzlas so/ /gal te 'khor lo bsgrub par mi 'dod na las kyi sngags 'ba' zhig bzlas so/ /gal te las la mi dmigs na snying po'i sngags 'ba' zhig kyang bzlas te/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ/ snying po'o/ /bzlas pa'i tshad ni re re la yang bye ba phrag gsum dang / 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas so/ /de nas bzlas pas skyo ba na/ ye shes sems dpa' la 5mchod pa dang / bstod pa byas te/gshegs pa'am slar bstems la/ yan lag drug gis srung 6ba byas la/ yi 24dod/25

ge brgya pa bzlas la ldang ngo / /langs nas kyang gsang sngags sku la dmigs shing grangs la phan mi 'dogs pa bzlas par bya'o/ /dang po rnal 'byor la 'jug pa na / oṃ ibye ya dhīḥzhes bya ba la sogs pas gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /dus rtag tu bdag dang gzhan chu zla ltar gcig dang du ma dang bral bar blta'o/ /bsnyen pa ma rdzogs kyi bar du gnas gcig tu spyad par bya'o/ /'di ni sngon du bsnyen pa'i rim pa mdor bstan pa'o/ /de ltar bsnyen par gyur pa'i sngags pa 'khrul 'khor bsgrub par 'dod pas/'di ltar blta 1ste/ dang po kho nar 'di la mngon spyod bya bar rigs sam/ci ste ma yin zhes gzhi gtan la dbab par bya'o / /2de nas bya bar rigs pa zhig yin na/ 'di ltar bdag ni dmyal bar song yang bla'i/ 'di dmyal bar mi 'gro bar bya zhing de'i rgyur 'di myur du gsad pas/ 'di'i sdig pa mang du mi 'phel bar bya'o snyam du yang dag par snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa bskyed pa yang dang yang bya bas byang chub kyi sems gtan la dbab par bya'o / / de nas sgrub capa'i gnas khyad par can dur khrod dang khang stong dang / ma mo 'du ba'i gnas dang / gnod sbyin 'du ba'i phug dang / shing gcig 5pa'i drung la sogs par 'gro bar bya ste/ 'di ni gnas gtan 6la dbab pa'o — 21—/26

der yang bdag gcig pus brtsams 1pa dang / yang na grogs po gsang thub pa/ dam tshig bsrung ba/ 'jigs shing bag tsha ba rnged pa/ lag bzo ba / sgrub pa po la snying nye ba/ stobs che ba/ blo dang ldan pa bzhi man chad dang brtsams te/ 'di ni zla grogs gtan la dbab pa'o / /2gnas der sha chen po dang tshil chen po la sogs pa/ gtor ma dang lha bshos su bya ba dang / me tog nag po'am sngon po dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang /khrag chen po dang / rnga dang gling bu dang / dung la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad dang / gshin rje'i gzugs kyi rgyu dang / ling ga'i rgyu dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / dur khrod kyi ras dang / thod pa dang sgud pa nag po la sogs pa yo byad thams cad dang ldan par byas te/ 'di ni rdzas gtan 4la dbab pa'o 5 de nas 'khor lo bri bar bya ste/ gtor ma byin la mchod pa 'jigs su rung ba'i tshogs kyang dbul te/ maṇḍal rab tu 'thas pa phyi bas byugs pa byas la / sngags pa kha lhor bltas te/ bdag khro bor gsal bas rtsa ba'i sngags zlos shing thod le kor gyis 'khor lo bri bar bya ste/ gnas skabs 'dir yang 'khor lo bri ba dang / ling ga bca' ba dang / ga'ur gzhug pa dang /ga'u bsro ba dang / gshin rje la gtad pa dang / nang gi rnal 'byor dang /'khor lo bca' ba dang / rjes kyi rnal 'byor dang / slar dbyung ba'i cho ga bya ste/ rnam pa dgus bsgrub par bya'o/ /de la 'khor lo bri ba ni/ ri mo lnga 2(—/27

bskor ba las snam bu bzhi dang / lte ba ste lngar bya'o/ /lte ba le'u tshe dgu pa'o/ /snam bu dang po le'u tshe bcu gnyis pa/ gnyis pa bcu drug pa/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa phyal ba'am/ sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /de la lnga dang bcu gnyis la rtsa ba'i sngags dgod/ bzhi mtshams la bskul snatshig /bcu drug la yang bskul thutshig /phyal ba nang ngos la ā li/ phyi ngos la kā li/ yang re'u mig dang 'dra bar yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis te/ ā li nyis 'gyur dang kā 4li la nga nya spang bar bya bas so/ /yi ge dag ri mo la ma reg par bya'o/ /'di gshin rje'i lto bar bri'o/ /de nas phyi'i 'khor lo la dpe byas te/ nang gi 'khor lo ro ras la dkar rtsis byugs la/ dug dang khrag bsres pa'i snag tsha bya rog gi sgro smyug gis blangs shing rtsa ba'i sngags zlos pas kha lhor bltas pas bris te/ gcig g.yas su bskor ro/ /gcig g.yon du bskor ro/ /zin pa dang phyi'i 'khor lo nang gi 'khor lo la thim par bsams la dbyi'o/ /'di ni 'khor lo bri ba'o/ /de nas rjes kyi sa dang / chu 'gram gyi sa dang / dug dang khrag dang dgra'i bshang gci byas pa'i sa dang / spra tshil rnams bsres la ling ga sor bzhi par bya/ de'i snying gar las kyi sngags kyi mjug la ming rus mā ra ya dang bcas par gzhug go/ /'di ni ling ga bca' ba'o/ /de nas rabs chad kyi thod pa'am/ chu 'gram gyi sa dang / dug dang khrag dang / dgra'i bshang gci byas pa'i sa dang / spra tshil rnams bsres la liṅga sor bzhi par bya/ ga'u 5gnyis la gong ma la me 'bar ba bri/ dbus su phaṭa 24—128

che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa ces pa bri'o/ /'og ma la rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sngags snga ma ltar bri/ ga'u steng ma'i rgyab tu ri rab la dbang chen gyi dbus su rdo rje rgya gram ser po bri/ de nas ga'u gong ma la bu ga smyug ma 'bring po shong ba cig gdod do/ /de nas 'khor lo g.yon du bskor ba 'og /g.yas su bskor ba steng / de'i dbus su ling ga bcug la/ legs par dril nas skud pa nag pos bcings 51te ga'u kha sbyor 2du bcug la ga'u skud pa nag pos dkris te/ga'u'i bu ga nas dug sna tshogs pa'i phye ma dang / khrag bsres pa drugs pas gang bar bya'o/ /'di ni ga'ur gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas rdo ba zur rngom pa zur gsum du 'dug pa'i sgyed sgo pu gsum gyi khar ga'u bzhag la/ dug gi me tog 'og nas sbor la dros pa tsam du bsros ④shig /'di ni ga'u bsro ba'o/ /de nas chu 'gram gyi sa'am/ spra tshil las gshin rje'i rgyal po gzugs khru gang pa/ rab tu sbom pa mi'u thung 'dra ba gsus pa che ba mche ba 'chang ba mdog gnag pa/ mche ba bzhi pa/ khro gnyer can/ skra kham pa 'dzings shing yegs la 'phyar ba/ lag pa g.yas na dbyug pa lcags las byas pa thogs pa/g.yon na sdigs 5pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng ba la zhags pa bkal ba 6zhig byas la/de'i lto bar ga'u de bcug la sba ste/ 'di ni gshin rje la gtad pa'o/ /da ni nang gi rnal 'byor bya ste/ gzugs de kha lhor bstan/ rnal 24—129

'byor pa kha lhor bltas te/ rus sbal gyi 'dug stangs su gnas pas/ ling ga de de nyid du bsam/ 'khor lo gshin rje'i grong khyer du'o/ /de la rnam shes bkug cing bstims la/ bcings te ye shes kyi lha dang dbral ba dang /kho'i nyes pa brtsi ba dang / rang gi dge ba'i stangs brtsi ba byas la/ de nas rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ khro bo 1srin po 'dra ba grangs med pa byung ba dang /de dag gis sprul cing bskul ba'i bya rgod dang khye dang spyang ki dang / ya ma pu ru ṣa rnams kyis de gsod cing pags pa bshu ba dang / rgyu ma 'dren pa dang /lus gtubs 2pa dang / mig 'bru ba dang / klad pa 'thog pa la sogs pa tant+ra nas 'byung ba ltar bsam zhing / gsang sngags mā ra ya dang bcas par bzlas pa bya ste/ de yang rang gi sems tshod dang rtags dang / bsnyen pa'i tshul las nyi ma gcig nas bdun kyi bar du bsgrims te bya/ khyad par du ni nyin gung mtshan gung la bya ste/ 'di ni nang gi rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas 'khor lo sba ste/ gnas der rang nyid kha lhor bltas la/ dong zur gsum pa zab rings rab la rgyar khru gang pa cig brus la/ der gshin rje'i gzugs de kha sbub la mgo lhor bstan te gzhag go/ /de nas 'byung po thams cad la de nyid du drag po'i ba bo byen la las bcol dpang gzugs so/ /de nas de ma thag tu bsgrub bya ya ma'i grong khyer na ya ma rnams kyis bzung ste gsod par bsams la/ ya ma rā dza la bskul ba bya ste/ bdag shin tu khros shing lhar gsal bas 'di skad bskul 4lo/ /'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ /dpag tshad brgyad khye'i pha rol na/ /thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ /yi 21—/30

dwags kun gyi sde dpon po/ /ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje bo/ /gson gshin kun gyi zam kha ba/ /gson po bskos la 'ded 1pa po/ /shi ba rnams kyi gshin bu rje / /dge ba can gyi ltangs 'dzin pa/ /sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan/ /nyes legs chos bzhin gcod pa po/ /chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu rlabs can/ /'khor bcas deng 'dir bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs kyi sras/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bsam pa byang chub sems kyis brlan/ /rgyur ni ye shes rdo rje 'chang / /gzi byin sku gsung thugs kyis bskyed/ /don ni 'gro ba yongs kyi don/ /las ni sangs rgyas kun kyi las/ /bka' ni dkon mchog gsum kyi bka'/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /drag po'i las 'di gtad par 'dod/ /che ge zhes bya'i gdug pa 'di/ /gson na 'gro ba yongs la gnod/ /dkon mchog gsum la rnam par 'tshe/ /dmigs kyi rnal 'byor yongs la sdang / /'di dag myur du bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ā 5karṣa ya dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu 'dra ba byung bas/ ya ma rā dza 'khor dang bcas pa gnas der 'ongs par bsam/ de'i tshe phyag rgya sbyar ba ni/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs te/mthe bong nang du bcug nas mdzub mo cung zad bskyed 6de/ gdengs thabs su 'phangs bstod pa ni be con gyi phyag rgya ste de sbyar ro/ /ya ma rā dza ni ji ltar gzugs su byas pa 7la ma he zhon pa de dus mtshan dang bcas pa/ 'khor ma mo 24—/3/

dang ya ma'i skyes bu mang pos bskor ba'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥcha kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya ste zhes brjod pas/de dag gis bdag la glags tshol mi nus par bsams te/ phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa las srin lag gnyis brkyang nas gshibs te bsgreng ba'o// /de nas gdong hūṃgi ya ma'i gzugs la me tog nag po gtor la/ ya ma rā dza 'khor bcas pa/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dir brtan bzhugs/ /mchod pa tshul bzhin bzhes nas kyang / /phrin byelas mdzad phyir ji srid du/ /las grub bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /ya ma rā dza sa ma ya ste zhes brjod do/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pas bee con gyi mu dra bcing / g.yon pas rakta dang chang bsres 1pas bkang ba'i bharnya jithogs la argha dbul te/ ya ma rā dza 'khor dang bcas pa la/argha gsol bas dmar gyi argha zhag gi me tog rgya mtsho ltar mi zad pa 'byung bar gyur cig /oṃ byāḥbyeḥcha kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ho zhes pas so/ /phyag rgya de nyid la gnas pas/ g.yon gyi me tog blangs te ya ma rā dza 'khor dang bcas pa la me tog phul bas me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa tog dang / kha bad du ldan pa ka ba brgyad zug pa/ me tog gi bla re dang /gdugs dang / phreng bas brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rang bzhin can 'byung bar gyur cig /oṃ byāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa badzra putpa pū chodza sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pas so/ /phyag rgya de nyid la gnas pas/ g.yon gyi khyebadug pa blangs la/ya ma dzwarā dza 'khor dang bcas pa la bdug pa sna tshogs phul bas/ gzhal yas khang gi mgul du bdug pa'i sprin bai ḍūrya'i mdog lta bu rin chen brtsegs pa 'dra ba 'byung bar gyur cig /oṃ sthāḥdzdzaḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa badzra dhū pa pū — dza sa ma 24—132

ye hūṃ zhes pas so/ /de bzhin du g.yon pas mar me blangs la/ ya ma rā dza 'khor dang bcas pa la mar me phul bas/ gzhal yas khang gi phyogs mtshams su mun pa 'joms pa nor bu'i 'od la sogs pa'i snang ba 'byung bar gyur cig /oṃ sthāḥskṛḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa badzra dī pa pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pas so/ de bzhin du g.yon pas byug pa blangs la/ ya ma rā dza 'khor dang bcas pa la 1 byug pa phul bas lus dang gnas kyi dri ma thams cad dag ste/ reg na bde ba'i reg bya dang dri bsnams 3bzod pa dang ldan pas tshim par gyur cig /oṃ trīḥbyeḥcha kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa badzra ganta pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pas so/ /de bzhin du g.yon pas bshos bteg bye la/ ya ma rā dza 'khor dang bcas pa la bshos phul bas kha zas dri dang ro dang kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / bdud rtsi dkar bo dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang sngon po dang bcas pa/kham gyi zas la gnas pa rnams tshim par byed pa'i mthu dang ldan pa rnams 'byung bar gyur cig /oṃ sthāḥ1ཿwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa badzra nai wi rya pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pas so/ /de bzhin du g.yon pas ba bo bteg la 'das ma thag pa'i tshig rjes la/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa ma hā 4ba lo pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pas ba lo dbul lo/ /de nas sil snyan sna tshogs bsgrags la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brjod do/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pa de bzhin du gnas pa las g.yon pa'i khu tshur thod pa'i tshul du byas la/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams kyis bskul bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po'i bka'/ /chos kyi rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ /de ring drag po'i phrin 5las 'di/ /khyed kyi las su 'os pa yin/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /legs nyes chos bzhin gcod 27— 33

pa khyod/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bka' 'khor na/ /bka' nyan dam tshig bsrung ba khyod/ /las dang rkyen gyis 'chi ba la/ /srog la dbang byed bdag po khyod/ /de phyir las 'di khyod la gtad/ /khyod kyi 'khor 'di mi srun 1te/ /tha mal sems can nyes med cing / /gzhan gyis bsgul bar ma byas par/ /glo bur phrad pa 'dzin byed na/ /nga yis gtad pa'i las 'di rnams/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i bka' bzhin du/ /dam tshig phyag rgya mig la bstan/ /dam tshig snying po rna bar 2bsgrags/ /rdo rje tha tshig snying la bzhag /dam rdzas mchod pa phul nas kyang / /dam tshig phrin las gnyer du gtad/ /las 'di mngon du bsgrub pa'i rigs/ /khyod kyis las 'di ma bsgrubs na/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' yang bcag /gshin rje gshed po'i dam yang dral/ /rang gi tha tshig rang gis bslus/ /dam tshig grogs po bdag cag gi/ /re ba'i bsam pa gting nas bcad/ /de bas las 'di grub par gyis/ /khyod kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /ya ma dru ti zhes bya ba/ /lag na lcags kyu nag po thogs/ /gang zhig gzung 4bar 'dod pa de/ /g.yugs 5pa tsam kyis 'dzin par byed/ /khyod la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /che ge zhes bya'i yul khams na/ /che ge mo zhes bya ba'i ming / /rus ni che ge mo zhes bya/ /'di dag 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /khyod kyis de ring gzung bar gyes/ /gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /kā la pā sha zhes bya ba/ /lag na dus kyi zhags pa thogs/ /gang zhig 'dzin par 'dod pa de/ /btab pa tsam gyis 'dzin par byed/ /lhag ma snga ma bzhin yin no/ /gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /ya ma rdadzee 6zhes bya ba / /lag na bee con nag po thogs/ /gang zhig bsad par 'dod pa kun/ /24—sde34

phyar ba tsam kyis 'chi bar byed/ /lhag ma snga ma bzhin yin no/ /gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /ya ma rdaṣṭi 1zhes bya ba/ /za byed mche ba 'bar ba can/ /gang zhig za bar 'dod pa de/ /gcigs pa tsam gyis za bar byed/ /lhag ma snga ma bzhin yin no/ /gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /kā la rā tri la sogs pa'i/ /gsod pa mo dang nag mo dang / /nam gru sha ka li la sogs / /bud med tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /la la las kyi me long can/ /la la nad kyi rkyal pa can/ /la la mtshon gyi dru gu 2can/ /la la bdud kyi khram bam can/ /la la shod rde'u dkar nag can/ /la la lcags kyi dre'u rta can—/ /la la bong bu gwa pa zhon/ /la la rlung nag 'tshub 4ma zhon/ /la la chu bya nag mo zhon/ /la la nam gyi gung la rgyu/ /la la chu bo'i gzhung la rgyu/ /la la nyi ma'i zer la rgyu/ /kun kyang gzhan srog 'phrog pa ste/ /khyed la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /lhag ma snga ma bzhin yin no/ /gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /ya ba ti dang phywa bsangs 5dang / /rmig pa ral pa dgu la sogs/ /la la rgyal po'i tshul du gnas/ /la la blon po'i tshul du gnas/ /kha cig dag ni sde dpon tshul/ /lag na bee con 'khor lo dang / /gsal shing la sogs mtshon cha thogs/ /so so'i sde dpon mngags 6pa dang / /pho nya phyag brnyan bcas pa la/ /'phrin las myur du gtad pa ni/ /che ge zhes bya'i yul khams na / /che ge mo zhes bya ba'i ming / /rus ni che ge mo zhes bya/ /'di dag 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /khyod kyis deng 'dir gzung bar gyis/ /zhes bskul zhing dmar gyi argha lan gsum gsum du 7sbreng zhing / gong gi argha'i sngags brjod do/ /de nas mna' chu blud par bya ste/ dri chab kyi nang du 24—135

bdud rtsi lnga drugs la nang du rdo rje bcug la/ oṃ badzra u da ka hūṃ ṭha zhes ci ran cig bzlas nas/ de nas ya ma'i gzugs kyi khar rdo rje bzhag ste/ steng nas dri chab blugs la/ ya ma rā dza 'khor bcas kyi snying gar ye shes kyi rdo rje 'od 'bar ba re rer gyur par bsams te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs snan dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'dis 'grub/ /gal te dam tshig 'das gyur na/ /'jam dpal rdo rje khros nas kyang / /snying ga nas ni gshegs par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzo da ka hūṃ ṭhaḥ sngon gyi tha tshig dran bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di bsnan pas/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i dam tshig ni/ /khyod kyi snying la gnas par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha zhes brjod de/ rdo rje ya ma'i snying gar gtug go/ /de nas gzugs de sas 2rab tu dam par sbas la/ sus kyang sbas par mi shes pa de ltar nan tan byas la/ de'i steng du khro bo'i tsham ngam kyi stang stabs byas la rang gi gnas su 'gro ste/ 'di ni 'khor lo sba ba'i tshul lo/ /gang zhig ting 'dzin thob pa'am/ bzlas pa'i mthu khyad par can yod pa des ni/ ga'u bsro ba dang / gshin rje la gtad pa dang / 'khor lo sba ba dag la 'bad pa de snyed mi bya ste/ 'khor lo bris pa la nang gi rnal 'byor dang bzlas pa byas la/ thod par bcug pa de nyid sbas pas chog gi las kyi gshin rje la ched cher gtad pa de dag bya mi dgos so/ /de nas rjes kyi rnal 'byor ni/ 'khor lo sbas pa'i rting la rang gi gnas su gsang sngags rjes su bskul zhing / ma mo dang ging dang / ya ma'i skyes bu 24—136

rnams la yang gtor ma bzang po byin la drag tu bskul/ rang gis bsten cing gnyen pa'i 'jig rten pa yod na de'i las kyi spyor ba yang bya zhing / de yang drag tu bskul te btang / bsrungs pa 'dra na bar der lha dang dbral ba yang bya ste / 'di ni rjes kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /beer dbyung ba'i cho ga ni/ las grub na 'khor lo slar phyung la/ ya mānta ka la mchod pa byas la/ ya ma rā dza la yang mchod pa snga ma ltar phul la/ 'khor lo 'o mas bkru zhing sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags bzlas te/ lha rnams la bzod par gsol nas/ rdzas rnams chu klung du bkrus la de nyid du dor bar bya'o/ /'di ni 'khor lo'i don rnam par bshad pa las/ drag po'i 'khor lo bstan pa ste/ zhi ba la sogs pa ni/ rtogs sla bas bdag gis ma bshad do/ /las kyi sngags la dmigs shing / rtsa ba'i sngags ma bsnyen pas ni 'khrul 'khor mi bya ste/ sbyin sreg dang / bzlas pa dang gtor ma dag gis las rnam pa bcu la sogs pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /ma mo'i gnas la sogs par mar ngo'i nyin phyed na song la/ thab khung gru gsum zabs su sor bcu pa rgyar sor nyi shu pa/dbus na padma 'dab brgyad la rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon pos mtshan pa/ mu ran nang ma sna la yang mtshon cha/ phyi ma la yang sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha can du drag po'i lha dang /me lha'i zhal du drag po'i sreg rdzas rnams dbul lo/ /sngags kyang drag po mā ra ya phaṭa ces pa dang ldan pas so/ /de yang dang por drag po'i thab 2khung byas la/drag po'i bud shing bcer/ ku sha dgram mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas bkram la rang 24—137

ya mānta kar bskyed do/ /de nas thab khung du drag po'i me sbar la/ me sbar ma thag tu hūṃ zhes brjod la tsha ba'i mar khu dgang gzar bdun nam gsum dbul bas me cher sbar ro/ /de ma thag tu thab kyi dbus su yi ge re 1nag po gyur pa las me lha mthing nag drang srong ral pa can phreng ba dang / spyi blugs dang / dbyu 2gu gsum dang / mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i lag pa can rlung gi me bsam mo/ /de nas oṃ e bye hi ma hā bhū ta/ de ba ṛ ṣi dī dza sata ma gri hi twa a snu ti a hā ri/ asmin 4san ni hi to bha bā 5zhes lan gsum brjod pas thab 'gram gyi mkha' la byon par bsam / de la argha dang mchod pa dbul/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta 6dzā la ya/sarba duṣṭhan 7bhasmin ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ dṛ shya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya ṭwāṃ a haṃ zhes brjod pas thab tu bskyed pa la bsnyim/ de nas me lha khros shing kha gdangs pa la dgang drugs la sogs pa sngags kyi mthar che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa dang ldan pas rdzas sum cha tsam phul la/ me lha'i snying gar lha mchog bskyed/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la bsnyims la mchod bstod byas nas khros pa'i zhal du rdzas phal cher bsreg go/ /de nas phrin las zhus la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la/ de oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥzhes pas 9slar gshegs nas/ dam tshig sems dpa' bdag la bsdu/ rdzas lhag ma me lha la dbul te/ las bcol te bzod par gsol la slar yi ge gsum muḥ'i mtha' can gyis gshegs su gsol la/ khrag gam chu nag pos me bsad 11do/ /sreg rdzas tha dad pa'i sngags dang hom gzar la sogs pa ni 'dir ma bshad de/gzhung gzhan las gsal bas der blta'o/ /zhi ba la sogs pa'i yang ci rigs su sbyar ro/ /'di ni las kyi sngags kyi bya ba mdor bstan pa'o/ /24—/38

da ni snying po'i sngags la gnas pa'i bya ba bshad de/ sngon bzhin du lha'i sku bskyed ma thag tu/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba 1ātma kolha haṃ zhes pas chu zla ltar bsams la/ ye shes sems dpa' bstem pa nas dbang bskur ba'i bar du byas la 'gro ba drug tu 'od zer drug spros pas rang rang la 4lhag par shas che ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / sdug bsngal bsal bar yang dang yang du byas la/ skyo na gsang sngags bzlas te/ ldang ba na dge ba byang chub chen por bsngos 5la yan lag drug gi srung 6ba byas la ldang ngo / /gtor ma dang yi ge brgya pa sngon bzhin no / /snang ba rnam par dag pa'i rdzogs rim 7dang rtag tu ldan par bya'o/ /nus pa lta na de kho na yid la byed pa'i rdzogs rim 8la yang gnas par bya'o/ /da ni rnam pa gsum char dang 'byel pa'i 'chi ba'i dus su yid la bya ba'i man ngag bstan par bya ste/ des dam tshig dang 'gal ba ci byas pa rnams legs par yid la byas la rab tu 'gyod cing phyis mi bya ba'i bsam pas/ 'gro ba yul du gyur pa rnams dang 'dod pa'i lha dang / chos skyong ba rnams la bshags par bya'o/ /des dge ba ci byas pa rnams 'gro ba'i don du byang chub tu bsngos la shi ma thag tu sangs rgyas dngos su bzhugs pa'i zhing du rdzus te 'byung zhing / rigs dang / gzugs dang / grogs dang / 'khor dang /longs spyod dang / dad pa dang / shes rab dang / gnyen po dang / dran pa la sogs pa phun sum tshogs par gyur te/ 'jug pa bde ba/ lam bde bas tshogs rnam pa gnyis bde blag tu bsags te/ myur du byang chub par gyur sbug ces bsngo bar bya'o/ /de nas 'di ltar gang rdo rje'i sku mnga' ba'i sangs 24—139

rgyas rnams kyang sku ched du 'jig cing / nyan thos dang ri1rang sangs rgyas las dang nyon mongs pa dang bral ba rnams kyang ched du lus la yid byung bas spong na/bdag gi — lus rnag can mthong ba'i chos la dngos grub kyi snod du ma gyur cing /bsrung ba byas pa sha thang ba 'di la ci zhig chags su yod ces lus dang srog la chags pa spang bar bya'o/ /de nas yang don dam pa byang chub kyi sems la dmigs nas skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'chi ba nam mkha' lta bu rga ba dang kun du skyo ba la grol ba/ blo'i blang dor dang 'jigs pa rnam par spangs shing /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten smig rgyu tsam du shes par bya'o/ /de nas bdag gi lus dang gnas dang / longs spyod sgyu ma lta bu rnams/ bsam pa thag pa nas sems can thams cad la byin cing / de'i 'og tu rang gi lus 'dod pa'i lha'i skur rnam par bsams te phyogs bcu thams cad rnam par dag pa'i zhing / lha'i rgyal po dang bsnyen bkur 4gyi gnas ltar yid du 'ong bar bsams la lhag pa'i lha la yang dang yang du yid gtad de/ tshor ba thams cad zil gyis mnan par bya'o / /de'i snang ba'i yul du 'ong ba dang / mi 'ong ba'i mtshan ma ci byung yang dga' ba dang 'jigs pa mi bskyed 5cing dri za'i grong khyer ltar bsam mo/ /'di ni 'chi ba'i dus su yid la bya ba'i man ngag go/ /gang zhig bla ma la gus snying rjes rgyud 'jam pas/ /chos kun stong par shes shing yul la 'dod pa spang / /gnyen po'i mthu ldan blo gros dri ma rnams dang bral/ /'gro ba skyob 6byed gdugs dkar lta bu de rnams dang / /bdag gi yang dag rtags 7pas smras pa'i gtam tshul 'di/ /myur du bar chad med par nyams len byed bcas phrad gyur cig /ji srid sa la 'gro ba'i longs spyod 24dod/ 0

rnam 'phel ma 'gags pa/ /de srid gtam 'di nyams pa med par 'gro don gnas par shog /gtam tshul 'di ni gsal smras pas/ /'gro ba 'jam dbyangs 'drar gyur cig /bdag dang chos kun sgyu 'dra bar/ /myur rig 'jam dpal nyid gyur cig /dpal gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'khor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa dang bcas pa slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya bi nā ya tsand+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā sheb dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te 2gtan la phab pa'o// //brtsar mchan/124 shāmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag mi〈〈snar 〉〉swā—/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsarja/ 5〈〈snar 〉rje/ 76〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khor bcas par/125 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga 'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra stem/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gil/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi bsrung /126 sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgrub/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉ceg(〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉thartan/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// //127 she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ceg pus brtsam/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyud/ 〈〈pe 〉ra tan/thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sha/ //128 hūṃsna3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mosal/ — 〈〈pe 〉ra sa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag bur/129 snasna〈〈snar 〉ra cing / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyar/ 〈〈snar 〉ra sgyed/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesas/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉bsdigs—/ (〈snar 〉snga sdog 6〈〈snar 〉〉gib/13bye 1〈〈snar 〉stab bo'i/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skarathub/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dgal/131 te 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra skol la 'debs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltangs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyar/ 〈〈pe 〉dkyis/24—141
