༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs jes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kṛṣṭa ya mā ri sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du / dpal gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gus pa yis ni bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi padmar 2phyag 'tshal te/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ /nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i/ /mdor basbus pa yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /dang por rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /dbeen pa'i gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /stong pa'i sems la mnyam gzhag ste/ /snying ga padma 'dab brgyad bsam/ /de steng nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yi steng du hūṃ bsams te/ /hūṃ las 'od byung mdun du ni/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro bzhugs par bsam/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod byas la/ /sdig bshags la sogs tshogs bcu bsag /de nas snying ga'i hūṃ las ni/ /'od byung lus ngag bag chags rnams/ /bsregs 4nas 27(—/8 /

stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /de ni ye shes tshogs yin no/ /sems ni hūṃ gi rnam par bsam/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lngar gyur/ /rdo rje las ni skur bskyed do/ /zhal gsum phyag drug sku mdog nag /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal / /spyan gsum mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen du badzees / /rdo rje ral gri gri gug gsum/ /g.yas pa yi ni phyag na bsnams/ /'khor lo padma thod pa gsum/ /g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams pa yi1/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gsus po che/ /lha mo phag mos mgul nas 'khyud/ /phag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /g.yas pa gri gug brnya g.yon/ /gtso bo'i sku la 'khyud pa'i tshul/ /gnyis su med pa'i gnas su bzhugs/ /mig dang lus sogs dbang po drug /sangs rgyas drug kyang yod par bsam/ /sgu gsung thugs kyang byen gyes brlab4/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od byung bas/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro spyan drangs la/ /tshig gi dbang yang blang bar bya/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan mnga' bdag chen po rnams/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol5/ /de skad bdag gis dbang blangs pas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bdag gi spyi bor dbang bskur bar/ /rigs lnga cod pan gyur par bsam/ /mchod dang bstod dang bdud rtsi bza'/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba ‘ste/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ /thams cad grub pa'i don du bzlas/ /gtor ma'i sngags ni 'di yin no7/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ārya nuta panda tāta 8oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i phyir/ /des ni gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /des ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /24—/85

de nas rnal 'byor ngal bso 47bya/ /snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /khams gsum ma lus kun la khyab/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas sgu ru gyur/ /gyur pa kun kyang bdag la bsdu/ /bdag kyang hūṃ la bsdu byas la/ /hūṃ yang thig ler gyur par bsgom/ /lhag ma'i rtog pa spangs pa ste/ /yang dag bde ba'i rnam pa'o/ /phyag med zhal med kha dog med/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i ñtshamatshan nyid do/ /'di byas bsod nams gang thob des/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas shog /nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub kyethabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/184 hūṃmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga / /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dma/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sres/185 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉than/ glu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bom/ sgo 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉thasus/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ sgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngasol/ sne〈〈snar 〉7ba/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jatpand+ra twad/186 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagaso/ 2〈〈snar 〉raga'i/ ༷ 〈〈snar 〉thasgrub/24—186
bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (766)24—187

0840༄rgya/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed nag po dus mthar phyin pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa ya mā ri kro dha rā dza ba tra sa ra sā dha dzee nā ma/ bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i nagashed nag po dus mthar phyin pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros bral thugs su chud bdag 'gro ba kun khyab pa/ /ma lus bdud 'joms thogs rnged khro bo kun gyi gtso/ /padma rdo rje snyoms 'jug zhi bde mdzes pas bsgyings/ /longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs pa'i snying po la btud de / /sangs rgyas thugs kyi 4rgyud rgyal 'bum pa thu bo che/ /na da ku be ra la yab kyis rjes gdams shing / /de yis de nyid bsdus pa'i byang chub sems chen po'i / /rnam par rgyal ba 5gshed rgyud las byung bshad par bya/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po ste/ /gtso bo mi yang dad ldan brtan ‘/ /ral gri padma skyon rnged gnas/ /cod pan brgyan pa mthong bar bya/ /mtha' yang 7mi gnas 27—/88

gtso bo la/ /dmigs dang padmos rjes bzung nas/ /rgyal por dran pa byas nas kyang / /lhag pa'i lha rnams spyan drang ngo / /rnam dag bdun gyis sbyangs pa la/ /tshangs pa bzhi yi sems gnas nas/ /'phrog pa med pa'i snying po nyid/ /thog mtha' med pa dmigs par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha1haṃ/ yi ge gsum gyi rang bzhin ni/ /bde gsal stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /thog mtha' med nas sems can la/ /gnas phyir rig pa nyams mi bya/ /hūṃ las re pha byung nas su / /nyi dkyil rdo rje 'khor lo bsgom/ /de rjes hūṃ las hūṃ byung ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' chos 'byung gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyar ldan/ /padma rdo rjes mtshan byas pa'o/ /gong mtshungs rgyu las gzhal yas khang / /oṃ las rtag 4pa sna tshogs mnyam/ /gdan ni rjes mthun gnas pa'o/ /a las mar ldan nyi ma zla/ /mnyam pa hūṃ las rdo rje ste/ /sgu yi gzi brjid bsdus nga rgyal/ /rgyud gshed rdo rje 'dzin pa bsgom—/ /phab pa'i sbyor ldan byang chub sems/ /yongs 'gyur thabs dang shes rab sku/ /yig 'bru lnga yis gang ba las/ /'phros pa'i lha mos bskul nas bzhengs/ /chos kun bdag pos bsgom par 5bya/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma kolhahaṃ/ ya las skyes pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /ind+ra byā 7la'i mdog 'dra ba/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar phag mos 'khril/ /ma te ser skya la bskum brkyang / /g.yas pa gri gug g.yon thod pa/ /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo pad—/ /thod pa lnga yis dbu brgyan cing / /dbu skyes gyen 'greng brgyad kyis brgyan / /rlon pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu 'phyang / /rnge dpung nang na gnas par bsgom—/ /rang mtshungs ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /cho ga gsum dang ldan 271—189

pas so/ /yi ge lnga rdzogs de bzhin gshegs/ /rigs kyi mdog dang mtshun 1mar ldan/ /sku ni mtho gang tshad yin te/ /phra mo lnga ni tshon gang ngo / /sgu gsum rab tu thob bya'i phyir/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin brlab 2bya/ /spyi gtsug rtag pa'i rgyal po ste/ /mgrin par rdo rje nyi ma bsgom/ /snying gar mi bskyod rdo rje 'chang / /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mig la sa yi snying po ste/ /rna ba la ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /sna la nam mkha'i snying po mchog /lce la 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon / /sgrib pa rnam sel lus la dgod/ /kun du bzang po yid kyi'o/ /kṣiṃ dzi khaṃ shaṃ kai saṃ/ /cho ga gsum dang ldan pa la/ /oṃ dang hūṃ gis spel bar bya /rdo rje lnga ni mchod 4byas la/ /gsol btab dbang gis mi bskyod 'gyur/ /mi bzad rdo rje 'khor lo nyid/ /mchod bstod byas la dgug gzhug bya/ /oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ tsakra maṇḍa la dhā tu dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya ste alha 5haṃ/ a la la la la ho/ a a a a/ rdo rje nam mkha' byen rlabs 6la/ /bskyod pas lnga 'gyur byang chub sems/ /mkha' yi padmar rdzus skyes nas/ /sa dgur bskyed la rab rgyas sgu/ /ba spu'i bu ga che nas spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin yang rjes bsams nas/ /rigs kyi don yang bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ badzra byeka ya hūṃ/ oṃ dzi na dzika kṣe hūṃ/ oṃ ratna dhrika 7ma hūṃ/ oṃ ā ro tpaka me hūṃ/ oṃ pradzñā j-ika da hūṃ/ shar du gti mug gshed po ste/ /lho ru nga rgyal gshed po'o/ /nub tu 'dod chags gshed po ste/ /byang du phrag dog gshed po'o/ /shar la 'od zer gzhan rnon po/ /dkar ser dmar ljang rang 'od rig /rigs kyi bdag po'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /gzhan ni go rims ‘spyor shes pa'o/ /ṇa yo nī ra 7'phros pa las/ /byang chub sems kyis rab rgyas pa'i/ /tsartsi kā 1sogs 24—190

lha mo yis/ /mchod pas rab tu mnyes par bya/ /de nas rdo rje dril 'chang bas / /bstod pa yang ni ched du brjod/ /dam tshig bzang po byin brlabs nas / /rdo rje hūṃ gis myang bar bya/ /spro ba chen po 'jig rten khams/ / thog ma 1med pas bsdus byas nas/ /du mar brtson 'grus ldan yid kyis/ /yang dang yang du goms par bya/ /rdo rje snying ga'i dkyil 'khor la/ /yid skyob bkod nas bzlas par bya/ /oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ rim dang cig car spyor ba yi/ /sems can don du bzlas par bya/ /zla ba'o cog gi bcu bzhi la/ /dri chus byugs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gru gsum ldan zhing me tog spras/ /mchod pa bzang ldan gtor mas bkang / /mi rus lnga bcu tham pa la/ /khrag gi spags pa'i mgo bor bsgom/ /ri lu re la gshed nag pos / /brgyan pa khri yi bar du bzlas/ /mchod pa rnams kyis mnyes byas la//gsol btab gtor ma dur khrod spyin/ /oṃ iddhā ya dhīḥ/ ya ma ya byeḥ/ ba ru shā ya wi/ ku be rā ya kṛ/ yī shā nā ya ta/ asna ye a/ nee rje 4ta ye na / bā ye bee ya na/ tsaddhā 5ya hūṃ/ srutyā ya hūṃ/ bradma ṇa ya phaṭa/ ba su dha rā 6ya phaṭa/ bee ma tsi tra ya swā7/ sarba bhu te bye hā/ hi hi hi nyi hūṃ/phe dze phe phe phaṭa swā hā/ gad mo chen mo brgyad brgad nas/ /gnang ba byin nas gshegs par bsam/ /'di ni bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /srid pa gsum gyi 'khor lo ni/ /dbang po skye mched stong pa yi/ /lcags kyi khang pa bcu bdun gyi/ /rdo rje snying po dgod par bya/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor shing rta dang / /ce spyang rgyug pa lta bu'o/ /spyor ldan man ngag dam pa ni / /dam pa'i zhal las shes par bya/ /las dang rjes mthun 'khor lo ni/ /24—/91

gzhan du rgya cher bshad pas na/ /'dir ni mang du ma smos so/ /ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya spe do ru ṇa 1yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra yakṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/ zhi ba'i mthar ni swā hā/ rgyas dang dbang la oṃ dang ho/ /drag po phaṭa kyis brtan par bya/ /phrin 2las bzhi ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyud dang bstan bcos mkhas pa bdag min te/ /dam pa bla ma'i zhabs la brten nas chos 'di byas/ /rgyud kyi mngon rtogs nges par byin pa'i yon tan dpal/ /dad dang shes rab snying rjer bcas rnams nges sgol shog /bsnyen dang sgrub pa'i cho ga'i rim/ /zab mo'i sgrub pa rnyed dka' ba/ /nor bu lta bu'i gzhung 'di yis / /'gro kun gshin rje gshed nag shog /khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed nag po'i dus mthar phyin pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan 4po shrī paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du bsgyur ba'o / / //24—/92

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṇḍa ya mā ri sā 2 dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du / gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun rdo rje sems bdag sngags/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo dgra nag la/ /btud de brgyud rim las rnyed pa/ /dngos grub 'byung phyir bshad par bya/ /rang gzugs rdzogs pa'i snying ga ru/ /ya yig las ni 'gro bar sbyang / /bdun po yis 4kyang sbyang byas nas/ /tshangs pa'i gnas la gzhag par bya/ /stong pa'i snying po gsal bar bsam/ /bsrung ba padmar ldan pa'i nang / /chu skyes ri bong can rnon po/ /byang chub rgyu yi gshin rje gshed/ /rtsa ba'i zhal gyi khyad par can/ /zhu ba'i thig le byang chub sems/ /ya las mtshan ma bsdu bar bya/ /de las 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /ind+ra bhā la lta bu ste/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa dkar dang dmar/ /phag mo de 24—194

mtshungs dam 'khyud pa/ /gri gug thod pa rtsa ba'i phyag /rdo rje bar dang tha ma gri / /gzhan na 'khor lo padma 'dzin/ /thod pa lnga yi dbu rgyan can/ /ser badzees spyan dgu bzlog byung 'gyur/ /lnga bcu'i do shal mnyam du dpyangs/ /gdug pa brgyad kyis sku brgyan cing / /rus pas brgyan cing dum bus sgeg1 /mtshon cha bcu gnyis 'khrug par bsam/ /ma he la bzhugs srid rtser 'bar /sgu gsung thugs dang skye mched dang / /dbang dang byin rlabs —mchod dang bstod / /bdud rtsi myang dang spro basbu dang / /bzlas pa'i rim pa'i man ngag las/ /shes pas dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ kā la byu pa hūṃ/oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra yakṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha/ ni rā ma ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ trīḥsgoḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ drug pas gtor ma bsnyen par sgyubya/ /sum cu brgyad pas nye bar bsnyen/ /bco lnga pas ni thams cad bsgrub/ /las kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya/ /gshed nag rgyud dang 'byung ba las/ /rnyed de sgrub thabs 'di bris pas/ /blo ni rab dag gyur nas kyang / /gshin rje gshed du 4'gyur bar shog /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad 5kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis 5rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //24—195

༄/ /gshin rje gshed rnam par snang mdzad kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bai ro tsa na ya mā ri no pi ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed rnam par snang mdzad kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba / rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rtag pa'i dpal / /me long ye shes byang chub sems/ /'od gsal rdo rje kun zhi ba/ /gti mug rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /sa rnams pha rol bgrod pa'i lam/ /rtag pa'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /dang por sngags pas snying rje dran pas rang lus rdzogs pa dang / /snying gar sa bon gsal ba las ni dam pa rnams bsams nas / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum gyi yon tan bsam byas nas//bsod nams rgya cher rab tu rgyas pa'i tshogs rab bsag par bya/ /byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms ldan pas stong pa bsgom/ /srung 4ba'i 'khor lo byas nas padma zla ba rgyas pa'i steng / /kṣe yig gyur pas chos kyi 'khor lo 24dod197

dmar zhing 'od 'phro ba/ /bsdu ba'i de nyid las ni rtag pa'i skur gyur pa de khro la sgeg /rtsa ba'i zhal dang gzhan gnyis dkar sngo dmar zhing phyag drug yum dang bcas/ /gri gug 'khor lo ral gri padma rin chen chu skyes rab tu 'khrugs/ /glang chen stag gi 1pags pas stod dang smad dkris mi mgo rlon 'dzag pa/ /thod pa drug ldan skra ni dmar ser gyen badzees sbrul brgyad yan lag spras/ /me dkyil na bzhugs ye shes sems dpa' gsal nas yan lag drug byas te/ /rlung dang me dang thod pa snod mchog sgron ma bcu yis 2kha bkab nas/ /bskyod dang 'bar bas glang po la sogs bcur gyur spyor ba'i sems bab nas/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ / byin rlabs rdo rje'i sbu 4gus rab drangs mnyes byas spro bsdus thim/ /rdo rje rtag pa rim gyis bskyod la rab thim nas ni lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' 5ba bsam / /yod dang med pa las 'das spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i byang chub sems dran nas/ /rmi lam sad pa'i rnal 'byor phung po khams rnams kun spangs der zhi nas ni ldang ba brtsam/ /khams sogs bde ba chen por mdog gyur gzugs brnyan lta bur rab rtogs 'di ni rgyal sras bdag /snying po nyi zer lta bur rdo rje'i 6bzlas pa 'gro ba kun la phan par bya phyir 'bum du bzlas/ /rnal 'byor sgyu ma'i gzugs kyis steng 'og la spyod 'jig rten don 'gyur thams cad gshin rje gshed thob shog /oṃ dzi na dzika mo ha ra ti/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod//ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje mi 'jigs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgrub thabs sangs rgyas la 'jug pa/ /bskyed pa dang ni rdzogs pa'i rim/ /gong ma'i go 'phang ston pa po/ /sngags rnams sgrib pa grol gyur cig /gshin 24—198

rje gshed rnam par hūṃsnang mdzad kyi mngon rtogs zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas par grags pa/ dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na khrirtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/197 2mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gan /gshin rje gshed rnam par snang mdzad kyi mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs so// thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra dpal/ bye〈〈snar 〉ra sams/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung /198 nyu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gistag gi/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yonag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlabs/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thu/rngu〈〈snar 〉raga'i/ phyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rdo rje'i/199 hūṃ/〈〈snar 〉〉nag por/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (769) 24dod199

༄/ /gshin rje gshed rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ratna saṃ bhā wa ya mā ri sā dha —rna nā ma/bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan don yid bzhin 'byung gnas rin po che/ /re 'dod skong mdzad rin chen 'byung gnas rgyal/ /kun rtog bral ba mnyam pa nyid ye shes/ /ser sna 'joms mdzad de la phyag 'tshal te//nga rgyal rab rgyas ser sna de don du/ /phra ma mthar mdzad rab tu bshad par bya/ /byang chub sems dang shes rab ni/ /snyems 'jug dran pa'i sngags pa yis/ /skad cig lha yi rnal 'byor pas/ /spro dang bsdu ba rab tu bya/ /bla ma rje dpal mgon po dang / /sdu gu lha sogs rab dmigs te/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs khyad par ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi lam gyur pa'i / /go rims tshangs pa'i gnas rnams bsgom/ /rang bzhin stong pa rkyen 24—200

gyis te/ /ye shes tshogs rab bsag 1par bya/ /ma yig hūṃ gis sna tshogs las//srung 2ba'i 'khor lo 'bar ba'o/ /chu skyes thabs dang shes rab ste/ /ma las rin chen zur brgyad pa/ /spro bsdu'i nga rgyal gsal bar bya/ /oṃ ratna saṃ bhā wa ātma kopho ho/ de las gyur pa'i rdo rje ni/ /btso ma gser gyi mdangs mnga' 4zhing / /rang 'od dang mtshungs rig mar ldan/ /zhal gsum g.yas g.yon sngo dang dkar/ /spyan dgu mche gcigs phyag drug pa/ /gri gug thogs 5pa rtsa ba'i phyag /rin chen ral gri 'khor lo pad/ /g.yas dang g.yon la rim gyis sbyar/ /dbu skra ser brdzes gdug pa'i rgyan/ /lnga bcu'i phreng dang dur khrod spras/ /'od zer rno dang 6me dpung 'bar/ /mi phyed rab tu 'khyud pa'o//sa bon rdzogs dang mig la sogs/ /kṣiṃ dzi khaṃ shaṃ shaṃ saṃ las/ /rdzogs pa drug ni byang chub sems/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ las sgu gsung thugs/ /'phros pas rin dbang gshin rje gshed/ /rab gnas rang dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ /rnam 'phrul mchod pa byang chub sems/ /bstod pa rgyud rgyal ji snyed bzhin/ /rlung me thod pa sgron me bcu//byin rlabs 7bdud rtsi myangs nas kyang / /spro bsdu byas nas bzlas pa brtsam/ /oṃ ratna beeka dzwa ṣa ra ti/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ stong gi nus pa khyad par rnyed / /mkha' 'gro ma yang de dbang 'gyur/ /khye yis 'byung po las kun byed / /bye bas rgyas dang brlag 'gyur te/ /bye ba lnga bzlas tshad dang bral/ /shin tu rab zhi bsdus pa ni/ /chu yi snying po de bzhin du/ /chur 'gyur rang gi gdos 7dang bral/ /dngos med mnyam par bsgom par bya/ /bdag gis rab phye la sogs ma bshad dang / /byang chub la mos sgrub po 'ga' tsam las /nga rgyal gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa brtsams/ /'dir mos rdo rje'i sa la thogs 24—201

༄/ /'od dpag tu shād pa'i sting po 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ a mi tā bhā z-i da ya 2rā ga ya mā ri sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i snying po 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgu gsung thugs dbyer med pa yi/ /'dod chags che la phyag 'tshal te/ /gang zhig jimangon zhen 'jigs byed pa/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /dad ldan shes rab snying rje yis/ /don bcas gzhan don gtsor 'dzin pas/ /sbyin pa la sogs legs sbyangs te/ /yid skyob sngags 'di brtsam par bya/ /dang por sngags pas khrus byas nas/ /nang tshangs can gyi stan bting la/ /rang gi snying nyid bskul bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs 'dus byas dang / /theg chen cho ga bzhi dag dang / /stong pa'i rang bzhin de nyid kyis/ /bdag rgyud yongs su dag par bya/ /bdud rnams zhi bar bya phyir dang / /sangs 24—203

rgyas zhing rnams dag pa'i phyir/ /bsrung dang chu skyes bsgom par bya/ /mtshon cha rgyas dang 'od zer sna/ /baṃ dang re las byung ba yi/ /nyi ma sa bon me yig las / /bcu drug mda' bcas lnga 'od zer/ /bsdus nas byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ a mi tā bhā z-i da ya 1rā ga ya mā 2—ri ātma kolha haṃ/ gyur pas rdo rje snang mtha' yas/ /padma rā ga'i mdangs dang mnyam/ /g.yas g.yon zhal ni sngo dang dkar/ /rang rig yum ni thabs dang mtshungs/ /stod smad stobs 'jigs pags pa gnyis/ /gri gug thod pa ral gri dang / /'khor lo rin chen shin tu 'khrug /sbrul dang rus pas rnam brgyan pa/ /dbu skra mdzes la spyan mig 'khrug /mche gcigs 'bar ba'i me dpung bsgom/ /rdo rje mig dang rna sna lce/ /lus yid la ni sa snying sogs/ /rdo rje lus dang ngag yid la/ /rdo rje sku gsung thugs ldan bsam/ /mi bskyod la ni dbang blang ste/ /dbu la gshin rje gshed po bsgom/ /sgo bzhi'i sngags kyis bcug nas kyang / /tsartsi kā jesogs rnam 'phrul mchod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas brnyes/ /dbyangs mchog gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlab/ /bdud rtsi myangs la spro bsdu bya/ /sngags pas ji srid mi skyo'i bar/ /bzlas zhing spro bsdu rgyas par bya/ /oṃ ā 5ro '-ika rā ga zhe ti hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/thams cad 'dod chags rjes dran nas/ /'dod chags chen por rab dmigs te / /tshad med yi ge spangs pa yis/ /a don bsam mi khyab pa bsgom/ /snying rje sad pas langs nas kyang / /phyag rgya bgrol la spyod lam bya/ /thams cad du ni nga rgyal bdag /spangs nas 7dam tshig nyams pa yin/ /bdag gi khye24—204

༄/ /gshin rje gshed rdo rje skon po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/hūṃ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra tīkyā ya mā 3ri sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed rdo rje rnon po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig sems can don byed cing / /nan tan ye shes phyir mi ldog / mar gad rjo ljang gu'i mdog 'dra la/ /rab tu dang bas btud byas te/ /brtul zhugs thogs pa med pa yis/ /las kyi don kun rab 'grub phyir/ /dgra nag rgyud la nyer bsten pyanas/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /dpal ldan g.yo sgyu med pa yis/ /bla ma mgon la btud sbyangs te/ /bum sogs dbang ni thob nas kyang / /dam bcas nas ni bsgrub par bya/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar dmigs te/ /snying gar ri bong can gyi dkyil/ /dhīḥyig 'od zer lnga ldan las/ /zhing gnyis ma lus sbyang bar bya/ /khyad par yul la brten nas kyang / /phra rab lus kyi phyag 'tshal bya/ /24dod206

tsartsi la sogs rnam 'phrul gyes/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bya/ /sdig sogs dag par byas nas kyang / /rje btsun pa ni mkha' la gshegs/ /don dam kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /tshangs pa'i gnas dang stong pa bsgom/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā 1wa ātma kophoX haṃ/ nyi dkyil 'od zer lnga ldan pa'i/ /hūṃ las srung byeba'i 'khor lo bsam/ /padma'i steng du nyi ma ste/ /dhīḥlas utpal ral grir gyuraji/ /spro bsdus sku gsung thugs bcug ste/ /gyur pas phrag dog gshin rje gshed/ /mar gad 3ljang gu lta bur mdzes/ /sngo dang dkar ba g.yas g.yon zhal/ /rang 'dra yum ni cung zad skem/ /'khyud cing yang dag mdzes par ldan/ /gri gug ral gri 'khor lo dang / /thod pa rin chen chu skyes 'bar—/ /stod smad glang chen stag lpags bsnams/ /rtog med go cha phreng bar dpyangs / /glu sgobargyad phuṭa sgra mche ba gadzigs/ /ske dkyil nang na bzhugs pa la/ /sku gsung thugs la rdo rje gsum/ /skye mched drug la byang chub sems/ /dbang bskur spyi bor gshin rje gshed/ /sgo bzhi'i sngags kyi hūṃbyin gyis brlabs/ /rnam 'phrul mchod pa bsam mi khyab/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab 'dra ba/ /ral gri phyag la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rlung dang mes ni padma sbyangs/ /ye shes zhu ba gsum byin brlabasnye / /rdo rje sbu gus mchod byas pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ /kun rdzob bden pa bla med yin/ /khab len rdo yi rnam pa ltar/ /bde ba'i ye shes 'dzin byed pa/ /chos kun ro gcig pa yin te/ /nan tan ye shes zhes bya'o/ /rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus sogs kyi/ /dgongs pa bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim/ /24—207

rgyud gzhung thams cad 'gal med 'dis/ /'gro rnams nye bar 'tsho gyur cig /gshin rje gshed rdo rje rnon po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/2༷6 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga /gshin rje gshed rdo rje rnon po'i sgrub thabs dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// 3〈〈bee 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma—/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zorgata/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharten/2༷7 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skad/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra hwa/ bye 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉bsrung / thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skaragyur/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagata/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra cangs/ /klu/ me〈〈bee 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ snye〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (772)24dod208

༄ga /rdo rje sems ma bde ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra tsartsi kā 2sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du / rdo rje sems ma bde ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs kyi rgyal po la 'dud shes rab go cha can/ /byams pa rnam par dag pas sems can brtse skyong ba/ /thabs chen sad pa'i mda' yis ma rig srog gcod cing / /gti mug rnam par dag pa ye shes yul can la/ /btud de zhe sdang thams cad rnam par mthar byed cing / /snying po 'khor lo bsgrub phyir rab tu bshad par bya/ /dang po sngags pas tho rangs cha /khrus kyi bum pa legs byugs nas/ /gur gum chus byugs rdo dag gis/ /sgo dgu la ni brdeg par bya/ /de nas gos sogs tshul bsdams nas/ /shu kra dkar po'i maṇḍal bya/ /bdag nyid lha ru gsal ba yis/ /rnam dag bdun dang tshad med bzhi/ /byas nas phyi nang ④chos la blta/ /sngags rkyen gyis ni 24—209

rnam thar bsgom/ /bdag bsrung ba ni ye shes la/ /gzhan bsrung 'khor lo chen po'o / /ma chags dang ni 'od zer bsil/ /dza las chos kyi 'khor lo bskor//spro bsnyus nga rgyal brtsam par bya/ /oṃ badzra tsartsi kā hūṃ/ātma kolhakyehaṃ/ gyur pas sku mdog dkar la zhi/ /cung zad skem zhing phra la 'jam/ /dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum ma/ /gri gug 'khor lo ral gri dang / / thod pa du rin chen chu skyes 'dzin4/ /stag gi pags pas smad dkris te/ /dbu skra ser badzees thod pa lnga / /dbu rgyan zhelnga bcu'i phreng ba can/ /zhi zhing sgeg pa me dbus dkyil/ /g.yon bskum g.yas pa brkyang bas gnas/ /rang snying sa bon rdzogs pa dang / /yig 'bru gsum la rdo rje gsum/ /skye mched la ni rdo rje drug /rig pa'i dbang bskur gshin rje gshed/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrab thim nas/ /ba spu bu ga chen po'am / /yang na snying ga'i rnam 'phrul dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bya / /lag pa rdo rje dril ldan pas/ /rdo rje zhi ba byang chub sems/ /gti mug rdo rje nyid dbyer med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag chen po/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /spro dang bsdu ba byed pa'am/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bya/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yis/ /phrin las mthun par gsang sngags bsgrub/ /oṃ mo ha ra ti badzra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ⑥phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje tshig ni mi gsal zhing / /sngags pa'i yid gsal bzlas par bya/ /gal te spros pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /ngal ba gso 4ba 'di lta ste/ /chos kun zhi ba rim bzhin du/ /padma chos 'byung la thim bya/ /chos kun yi ge gsum ldan pas/ /go rims bye.a yi sgras bskul te/ /skye med 'od gsal bsgom par bya/ /gti mug rab tu rmongs pa'i mun chen dang / /nga bdag 'ching 9trechen rab tu gcad pa'i phyir/ /24—210

rgyud chen las byung bcom ldan mngon sum du/ /thos nas bris pa'i gzhung 'dis kun grol shog /rdo rje sems ma bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na krirtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/2༷9 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉smon /rdo rje sems ma bde ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka du〈〈pe 〉〉byug ci〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉das/21 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉ka rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bo3/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wathodapa/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skopa'i phyagargya〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉sngas/ /dbu brgyan/ 'u〈〈snar 〉lhu hūṃ hūṃ/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rim / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cangs/bsdur 'bras re'u migasgro/da/ (11113)24wa 211

༄/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra ḍā ki yo gi ni sā dha rna sde—nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgu mdog rang bzhin rnam dag bde ba la spyod can/ /rnam par rtog pa bral bas phag mo'i zhal mnga' ba/ /btud de rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde rnyed bshad par bya/ /sngags pa shes rab snying rjer ldan/ /sa bon las ni rkyen gyis bskyed/ /myu gu rang gi lhar ldan pas/ /tshogs bsags 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor chang gis byugs nas kyang / /rang byung me tog thig le dgod/ /bskus pa'i me tog sngon po dgram/ /phyag sogs bdag gis ci nus bya/ /dang po byams pa bsgom bya ste/ /gnyis pa snying rje'i rnam pa bsgom/ /gsum pa dga' ba bsgom bya ste/ /gsum gyi tha ma btang stoms so/ /chos 24—212

kun stong pa nyid dag tu/ /shes pa'i rnal 'byor rig pa'i rgyun/ /yi ge ma ru gnas pa dag /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng nyid du/ /thugs kyi yi ge bsrung ba bsam / /padma'i 'od zer bsil ba'i steng / /sa la rdo rje sngon po ste/ /spro bsnyus nga rgyal dran par bya/ /oṃ dzwa ṣa ra ti badzra ātma kolha1haṃ/ gyur pas rdo rje phag mo ste/ /ind+ra nī la'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rtsa ba phag gdong rab sngo zhing / /de las gzhan pa dkar dang dmar/ /gri gug thod pa rtsa ba'i phyag /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo pad/ /rim bzhin bkod pa'i sku mchog ni/ /g.yon bskum g.yas pa brkyang bas gnas/ /dbu dang sgu ni dur khrod dang / /klu yis mdzes shing phreng ba —ldan/ /me dpung nang na gzi brjid che/ /bskyed pa 5gsum la rdo rje che/ /drug la byang chub sems dpa' drug /rig pa'i dbang bskur gshin rje gshed/ /ye shes phag mos byin gyis brlab/ /mchod pa'i rnam 'phrul snying las sprul/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhe sdang bdag po thugs dbyer med/ /mi phyed rnam rtog rab gcod pa/ /rdo rje phag mo khyod phyag 'tshal//'phros pas snying ga'i sa bon te/ /sbyangs pa rang yid dang ba'i lhar/ /byas nas bsdu ba dag kyang bya/ /gal te skyo na gsang sngags bzlas/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil nyi ste/ /rdo rje sngags ni 'bar bar bsam/ /oṃ dre ṣa ra ti badzra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ stong dang khri dang bye bar bzlas/ /sngags pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rab tu zhi ba'i byang chub sems/ /yi ge kha dog dbyibs kyang med/ /rnam par rtog pa kun spangs pa'i/ /skye 'jig med pa bsgom par bya/ /de la rten cing 'byel 'byung ste/ /phyag rgya bgrol la spyod lam bya/ /oṃ sdzahūm̐ muḥ/ bdag gis rje btsun pha la rgyu 4rnyed pa/ /24—213

rtog bral chos sku gzugs sku snang sgrub thabs/ /phag mo rnal 'byor ma yi sgrub thabs byas/ /'di yis dge thob thams cad grol gyur shog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mar me mdzad kyis ①mdzad pa rdzogs casaske/ / //bsdur mchan/212 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉mun /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ tshodu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wal/212 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bo3/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thād/214 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (774)24wa 214

༄/ /rdo rje bde rgyas dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra gī ti su kha ra da sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje bde rgyas dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa rgyal ba kun gyi 1yum / /dri ma med pa'i gsung chen rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ /btud de sangs rgyas bde chen rab tu 'phel bya'i phyir/ /gsung gi padma dri ma med pa'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /nags tshal mi sked zudaben pa'i gnas/ /nyams dga' bkra shis dang ba ru/ /'jam pa'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /chu bur lta bu'i tshul gyis bsgomasakru/ /sems can kun don legs byas nas/ /dam pa'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /phyag 'tshal bstod dang bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bsgul gsol gdab/ /bsngo dang smon lam btab byas nas/ /yid kyis gshegs gsol tshad med bzhi/ /sngon 'gro stong pa bsgom par bya/ /srung she24—215

ba'i 'khor lo 'jigs chen po/ /mtshon cha 'khrug pa shin tu bsgom/ /padma zla ba'i steng nyid du/ /byu ru bcag 'dra'i ngo tshodag las/ /chu skyes 'dab brgyad mtshan mar ldan/ /'phros nas bsdu ba bya ba ni/ /rigs kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa'o / /oṃ badzra rā ga ra ti ātma kolha2haṃ/ gyur pas padma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gsum g.yas g.yon sngo dang dkar/ /phyag drug gri gug padma dang / /ral gri thod pa 'khor lo dang / / nor bu yis ni shin tu mdzes/ /dbu la thod pa lngas bskor zhing / /rlon pa brgya phyed phreng bar ldan/ /rin chen klu dang rus pas spras/ /shin tu zhi zhing sgeg pa ste/ /stag lpags bsnams nas me dpung dkyil / / g.yon bskum g.yas pa brkyang bas gnas/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma kolha haṃ/ hūṃ las thugs kyi rdo rje ste/ /āḥlas gsung dang oṃ las sku/ /kṣiṃ las sa snying rdo rje mig /dzi 'ulas rdo rje can rna bar/ /khaṃ las nam mkha'i snying po snar/ /shaṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug lcer/ /shaṃ las sgrib pa rnam sel lus/ /saṃ las kun du bzang po yid/ /rig pa'i dbang bskur gshin rje gshed / /dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang du bya/ /mchod pa bha ga'i byang chub sems/ /rdo rje gsung gi 6ye shes che/ /padma shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'dod chags chen po nyid spyor ba/ /rdo rje mthar mdzad khyod 7la bstod/ /rdo rje sbu gus bdud rtsi myang / /sa bon 'phros pas 'gro ba sbyang / /rdo rje bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /yid gsal ba ni mchog tu gces/ /oṃ badzra rā 'ug ra ti hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ma ning rdo rje bzlas nas kyang / /snying po can dngos bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags chen po spyor ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /bde ba sems dran sgrub thabs 'di brtsams pas/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag 24—216

༄/ /las kyi rdo rje go rī'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ karma badzra ṇi go rī sā dha ṭwāṃ nā ma/ bod skad du / las kyi rdo rje go rī'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /btang snyoms rnam par dag pa phyag rgya che/ /ye shes pha rol phyin ma la phyag 'tshal/ /brtson 'grus thogs pa med pas sems can don/ /'grub phyir go rī'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /khrus dang rgyan dang gos dang byug pa rnams/ /phyi nang rnam par dag pa shes par bya/ /rang gi rnal 'byor dam pa mchod nas kyang / /bde ba'i 'khor lo bdag la gzhug par bya/ /tshad med bzhi la rnal 'byor sems gnas nas/ /chos kun snying po 'od nyid 4gsal bar bsgom/ /bdag rgyud sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge ni/ /ro gcig thig le'i ngo bo bye gyur pa las/ /chad pa nyi ma'i steng gi rdo rje nyid/ /'phros pas srung 4ba'i 'khor lo gsal bar bya/ /padma zla ba'i steng du ru dag las/ /gyur 24—218

pas atpal ral gri ljang mdog gi/ /dkyil nas 'phros shing 'dus nas nga rgyal bya / /oṃ badzra go ri 1—swa bhā wa ātma kolha2haṃ/ gyur pa'i sku ni margad shuljang mdog ste/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal ni dkar dang dmar/ /gri gug ral gri 'khor lo thod pa dang / /rin chen chu skyes rnams kyis mdzes pa'i phyag /dbu skra gyen 'greng thod pa lngas brgyan cing / /tshangs pa brgya byin mgo bo lnga bcus dpyangs / /klu dang margad trebherus pa'i rgyan 'jigs pas/ /stag lpags bsnams pa'i zhabs ni g.yas brkyang ste/ /gzi brjid me yi dkyil na cher 'bar ba'i/ /sku gsung thugs dang spyan sogs byin brlabs la/ /yi ge mtshan ma sku ni gang 'dod brtsam/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'phros pas 'khor lo bzang / /gsol btab rig pa'i skyes bu mi bskyod pa/ /rjes su mthun pa'i lha ni spyan drangs nas/ /mchod bstod mnyes par byas nas rang la thim /mchod pa'i rnam grangs nam mkha' rgyas gang ba/ /bha ga'i rnam 'phrul dag gis ci bder mchod/ /sngags pa rdo rje dril bur ldan pa yis/ /snyan pa'i glu dang ldan pas mchod par bya/ /rdo rje las ni kun grol ba/ /phrag dog rdo rje dbyer med sgu/ /thams cad rdo rje btang stoms 'di4/ /rdo rje las ma phyag 'tshal bstod / /yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzas/ /rgyal ba thams cad mchod phyir myang bar bya)/ /sems can thams cad rdo rje'i skur byas nas/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo ji ltar 'dod pas bzlas/ /oṃ badzra ra ti hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rgyal mtshan can kyi khams su 'o ma sgrub/ /thabs kyi gzugs las rtag tu dang 'gyur bas/ /rtag pa'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed nag las/ /mthong ba'i sgrub thabs bdag gis 'di byas pas/ /'gro kun spros bral zhi ba la 24—219

༄/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/1༄dze/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhaṭwā 2ka mañdzu shrī ya mā ri pū dza kra ma bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ rje btsun 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma rje btsun dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab snying rjer ldan zhing dad pa 4legs brtan dang / /sangs rgyas snying po 'dod phyir gang zag dbang thob pas/ /bsnyen dang sgrub pa'i rim pa khong du chud byas nas/ /rje btsun rnams la btud de rgyud 'dis sbyang bar bya/ /bdag nyid dran pa gcig pa'i 'go blor ldan/ /bdag med pa las bzlog cing 'byor pa gsum 5dag pas/ /bsnyen dang sgrub la rab tu mkhas byas te/ /nyin dang mtshan mo thams cad g.yeng med tshul gyis 'bad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo rdo rje can bcas dang / /dri med snying po mthar mdzad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin / /dgra las rgyal ba gshin rje gshed nag lha yi tshogs/ /thugs rjes 24—221

thugs chud spyan ras nyid 'tsho 1dgongs su gsol/ /chos sku longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku'i rang bzhin can/ /rgyal ba'i rang bzhin phung pos sems can re 'dod skong / /'byor ldan phun sum tshogs pas nad gsos sman pa'i mchog /bla ma mgon po de la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po lnga las rgyal zhing nyon mongs lnga rnams dag /rang gzhan don rdzogs gang zhig phag mo la sogs 'khril//ye shes rigs mtshungs lnga ldan rin chen lnga yi mdog /rnam thar pha rol phyin zhal phyag ldan 2 khyod la 'dud/ /bdud bzhi las rgyal lta ba'i nges sgrol bcom nas kyang / /dad sogs rnam dag khro bo'i rtags su nges 'byung ba/ /thabs kyis phyag rgyas sgrib pa thams cad mthar spangs pa'i/ /'jigs shing rab 4gtum phyag mtshan rtags ldan phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sa chu rnge rlung 'byung ba bzhi ni rnam dag sgu/ /byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang stoms nyid/ /thabs dang smon lam ye shes rdzogs mdzad pa/ /tsartsi phag mo go rī'i 5dbyangs ldan phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod yon gdan mchog zhabs bkru ldan pa dang / /spos dang me tog mar me zhal zas tshogs/ /rol mo'i 6sil snyan me tog phreng dang lda ldi dang / /mchod sdong bye bas brgyan pas rab tu mchod par bgyi/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /du mar spyad kyang tshim pa med cing ngo mtshar ba/ /yid ldan sems kyis ngal bso 7khyad par gyur pa rnams/ /mos blo dad pa'i mthu yis bde gshegs 'khor lo mchod/ /'khor lo rin chen rta dang glang po rab mtshan ldan/ /rgyal po btsun mo blon po mchog ni zhi zhing mdzes/ /'byor ldan phun sum tshogs pa 'khor los sgyur 9ba yi/ /khyad par rdzas kyis —bde gshegs 'khor lo dam pa mchod/ /gdugs dang nyer ldan dung dang padmas rab 24—222

tu mdzes/ /gudhe 1dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo mdzes pa'i mchog /'jig rten dag na grags shing snyan par gang brjod pa'i/ /bla med rnams kyis bde gshegs 'khor lo dam pa mchod/ /dri chen rdo rje chur ldan byang chub sems dkar dmar dang bcas/ /mi sha rta dang ba lang glang chen khye sha dang / /sgron ma che dang ldan pas dur khrod mdzes byas pas/ /rnam par rtog bral bde gshegs 'khor lo dam pa mchod/ /bde gshegs khyed la ji snyed gnas pa'i yon tan ni/ /bdag gis bskal pa'i mtha' bar brjod pas mi lang bas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' tsam mos 'dis/ /rgyal ba gcig bzhin sangs rgyas 'khor lo thams cad bstod/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug mang gis bskyed cing / /lus ngag yid gsum sgo ru smin pa'i mi dge bcu/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems dang rig pa 'dzin/ /tshul khrims sdom dang dam tshigs nyams pa ji snyed bshags/ /bdag gis bgyis dang de bzhin bgyid du stsal/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i tshogs/ /slob dang mi slob sems kyis grogs su gang gyur pa/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas zhing la bzhugs pa'i ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gdul bya'i snang ba rab tu tshim mdzad khro dang zhi/ /'gro ba mig ldongs shes rab sman kyis gsol 4 ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bskor bar bskul/ /rgyal ba bcom ldan mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams/ /khyod mi bzhugs na 'jig rten 'di dag mgon med pas/ /nam mkhas gar khyab sems can ji srid mchis pa ru/ /de srid rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi 5lus ngag yid kyi dge ba'i tshogs ji snyed/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bsgoms 24—223

pa nyid du ngas bsnyus te/ /bdag gir bzung ba med cing sems can kun don du/ /dmigs pa med pa'i sems kyis yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag gis rje btsun rnams la shin tu dad sems kyis/ /sems can kun la phan phyir bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gsum du bsdus byas te/ /dpal ldan bla ma rje btsun mchog gi zhabs drung shog /nyon mongs tshogs rnams dag cing sems rtogs nas/ /rgyal ba mgon po bcom ldan 'das kyi skur gyur shog /me tog shu kra len cing spros pa nyid spangs te/ /nyon mongs mngal du mi 'jug bde ba len par shog /yid ches sems kyis lhan cig skyes pa rnyed gyur te/ /'byor pa'i nus pas rdo rje lta bu'i lus thob shog /chos rnams ro gcig bsam mi khyab kyi ro thob nas/ /rig 1dang tshogs kyi spyod pas sems can 'dul gyur cig /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i phrin las nyer thob ste/ /gdug pa can rnams gshin rje gshed la mngon gzhol shog /thun mong dngos grub thogs pa med par thob nas kyang / /blo stobs dman pa'i rnal 'byor de nyid kyis 'tsho shog /nam mkha' dang mtshungs bde ba chen po'i sa thob nanas/ /bdag dang sems can gshin rje gshed po nyid grub shog /sgrub po dad ldan lus ngag yid gsum rab sbyang phyir/ /rje btsun pa rnams mchod pa'i cho ga 'di byas pas/ /nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib pa byang gyur te/ /rgyun chad med dang phun sum tshogs sku thob par shog /'gro ba thibs po nyon mongs lam la rab tu gzhol/ /sdig pa'i dba' 1nga 'khrug pa'i nang du rtag tu zhugs/ /rnam smin chu srin gdug pa can gyi khar zhugs nas/ /g.yeng bas ngal ba don med ma byed dge ba sbyongs/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/24—224

slob dpon chen po kṛṇḍa paṇḍi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/221 lhamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa bzhugs so// bye 〈〈bee 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bhaṇḍa/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉—dam pa/ kru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rgadad pa/ bhu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa/222 bye 〈〈snar 〉thamatsho/ — sgo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giphyag ldan/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 phyag rgya/ je 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra tu/ 37〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉dri/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉so/ tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉lo sgyur/〈〈snar 〉〉lo bsgyur/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/223 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gun de/ tshobye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshig 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ṣe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagaso/rdo1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/224 1 〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/ hūṃ 〈〈snar 〉〉thogabasdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (777)24 —225

༄/ /sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa ya mā ri budhe sā dha dzwa nā ma/ bod skad du/ sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur 2pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rje btsun bla med dang / /sgu gsum mgon po gshegs nyid las/ /btud de de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs / /blo dman bdag gis bshad par bya/ /sngags pa blo dang ldan pa yis / /snying rje chen po rab bskyed de/ /skad cig dran pas gsal bar bya/ /gnyis pas rdzogs pa thig le che/ /bzang po nyid dang dpal gyi mgon/ /so so las kyang bzhi 'byung bya/ /rdzogs dang rab tu gnas pa dang / /mngon par btud la mchod byas te/ /ya yig sprul pa'i las bya'o/ /bshags dang rjes su yi rang dang / /bskul dang gsol ba gdab pa dang / /skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed che/ /lus dbul yongs su bsngo ba bya'o/ /smon lam gdab 24—226

dang gshegs su gsol/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi sngon song bas/ /rnam thar gsum gyi bdag nyid bsgom/ /oṃ swa 1bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shurnyolha haṃ/gnas dang dag pa'i ngo bo dang / /bde ba bzang po 'di bsgom bya/ /shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atpa kolha haṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid ni/ /yi ge gsum gyi ngo bor bltarnyi/ /dag pa'i thig le nam mkha' yi5/ /rgyun gyis gnas pa'i nyi ma hūṃ/ /gyur pa rdo rje gzhal med khang / /zla ba rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis / /chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam par gnas/ /sna tshogs padma'i dkyil nyid du / /zla ba yi ge bcu drug bcas/ /re pha las byung gnyis pa las/ /gsal byed yi ge khor yug blta/ /ro mnyam pa la 6sa bon nyid/ /nor bu rdo rje spro dang bsdu/ /nga rgyal gyur pas rdo rje sems/ /dkar dang gnag dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /shes rab gnyis med sgeg dang stangs/ /gdug dang dur khrod rgyan gyis spras/ /gri gug thod pa rtsa ba'i phyag /rdo rje ral gri g.yas na bsnams / /g.yon na 'khor lo chu skyes so/ /sa bon 'od kyi bdag nyid dpal / /rjes su gyur pas khu bar blta/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gnas/ /nyi ma dmar po ya gcig bcas/ /gyur pas rdo rje sngon po ste/ /sa bon 'od las gshin rje gshed/ /char sprin gzhon nu lta bu'i mdog /g.yas pa zla ba lta bu ste/ /g.yon pa padma rā ga'i mdog /rang gi yum dang ldan pa'i sku/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gis 'khyud pa'i stangs/ /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo dang / /padma 'od zer chen po 'bar/ /gri gug rdo rje mtshan pa dang / /thod pa byang chub sems bkang ba/ /yum dang mtshungs par 'dzin pa ste/ /gcer bu rgyan bral skra grol ba'o—/ /snyoms par 'jug pa'i stangs dang ldan/ /brgya phyed mgo bo'i phreng 24—227

ba can/ /padma zla ba'i gdan stengs su/ /ma he nyi ma gnas pa'i stengs/ /rdo rje gshed po bsgom par bya/ /sku gsung thugs dang ldan pa yis/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje bde bar bsgom/ /skye mched zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /sems dpa'i yi ge gsal bar bya/ /kṣiṃ dzee khaṃ gi ki saṃ/ /spyi gtsug mgrin pa snying ga'i steng / /zla ba padma nyi ma'i dkyil/ /dkar dmar gnag pa'i yi ge dgod//oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sa bon las 'phros gshin rje gshed/ /yab yum gnyis med spyor ba yis / /bde chen byang chub sems/ kyi rgyun/ /phab ste spyi gtsug bab gyur pas//dri med dag pas rdo rje sems/ /spros dang bsdus pas de nyid don/ /mnyes par byas la rgyud la bstem/ /nges dang gsal dang brtan pa dang / /phab la thig le thig le che/ /byed pa spyor dang phra ma dang / /go rims 1nam mkha'i rdo rje'o / /'di ni 'grub med 'grub pa med/ /rang bzhin nyid nas rdo rje sems / /rdo rje nam mkha'i khams sbyor bas/ /gnyis med ye shes chos kyi sku//'di ni rnam par dag pa'o/ /ldang ba sā lu'i 'bras ltar du/ /gnas pa rgyal po'i dbang bsgyur zhing 2/ /dbyings kyi rdo rje tha mi dad/ /sbyor ba'i byang chub sems phab pas/ /sa stengs sa 'og sa bla yi/ /gnas su sku gsung thugs bsams te/ /ma yengs don grub bzlas par bya/ /oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ/'dis ni brgya byin la sogs pa brgyal bar byed pa'o/ /oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra yakṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'dis ni dngos grub chen po yang thob par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'dis ni las thams cad 'grub bo/ /ha cang drag min dal ba min/ /cung zad ring ba ma 24—228

yin te/ /thung dang mi gsal rnams 1spangs te/ /tshig gi bar du ma chod pa'i/ /chen pos bzlas pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni bsgrub pa'i don du byas/ /las kun bla ma brgyud shes bya/ /mi shes pa dag dgrol ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis rtogs par gyur pa brtsams/ /'di las 2'byung ba'i bsod nams kyis//dpal ldan gshin rje gshed 'gyur shog /sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ nā da ku be ra las byung ba'i don/ kun da nakṣe ri na bzhugs pa'i mkhas pa chen po rnal 'byor pa nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur tu mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/226 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉7/ /sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// 2〈〈snar 〉〉gigyur/227 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yonas/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rolas/228 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdem/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉(〈snar 〉〉sgyur bzhin/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 4〈〈snar〉〉du/229 —1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ram/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/24dod229
— sdur 'azas re'u mig da/ ( 778 )—/24 — 2 3 0

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṇḍa 2ya mā ri sā 1dha dzee nā ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ mgon po gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma la gus de rjes la/ /gshin rje gshed nag rdo rje ni/ /rang 'od yan lag 'dus pa yi4/ /bde ba rgyas la phyag 'tshal te / /gshin rje gshed nag sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de nyid blo yis bshad par bya//bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /snying rjes skad cig lhar bskyed la/ /snying gar padma ya yig dgod/ /'od 'phros sbyangs te bla ma dgug /bkod pa bsams la phyag dang ni/ /mchod pa la sogs tshogs bsags te/ /blo yis mkha' la gshegs su gsol/ /de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ /rang bzhin rnams dang bral bas rgyu/ /'di ltar yang na mtshan ma ni/ /rnam par dpyad pa zhemed pas na/ /'di ltar smon lam rnam par spangs/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shudheḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā 24—231

wa shurnyolha1haṃ/ de ltar brtan par bsams nas ni/ /ma yig las byung nyi ma las / /sna tshogs hūṃ las rgya gram bsam/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros ra ba'o/ /de dkyil paṃ las padma ni/ /dmar po'i steng du zla ba ste/ /de las dbyangs yig rnam par bsam/ /de steng 4ro las nyi ma ste/ /gsal byed bkod la gsal bar byas/ /de las gong bu hūṃ du gyur/ /de las rdo rje hūṃ ldan bsam/ /de las rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /zhal gzhan gshin rje gshed dang 'dra/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni dkar bar bsgom/ /thugs kar sa bon gsal ba las/ /'od 'phros bkug la zhal zhugs pas/ /snying gar zhu nas thim byas la/ /mkha' gsang sbyangs la gtor ma 5bsam zhu bas skar mda' lam zhugs bzhin/ /mkha' gsang nang du babs gyur pas/ /bdag nyid yum dang bcas pa zhu6/ /de las thig le bzhi 'phros pas/ /lha mo bzhi yis bskul bar bsam/ /rje btsun stong nyid la bzhengs la/ /khams gsum kun gyi gti mug sel/ /rje btsun chos nyid la bzhengs la/ /snying rjes sems can don mdzod cig /de rjes de yang thim gyur pas/ /thig le'i ngo bor blta byas la//zhu bas yongs su gyur pa skyes/ /ya yig sngon po nyi dkyil 'khor/ /de las rdo rje sa bon bcas/ /'od 'phros bstems te gyur pa las/ /bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni sngon po la/ /g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar ba ste//rang gi yum dang ldan pa'i lus/ /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo dang / /chu skyes gri gug thod pa'i phyag /ma te 7gdan bcas gsus po che/ /glang po stag gi pags pa mnabs/ /mche gcigs sbrul gyi chas reldan bskyed/ /sems ldan 'od 'phros ye shes dgug /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ de nas mig dang rna ba sna/ /lce dang lus yid rnams la yang / /mngon shes bsgrub phyir lha bsgom bya/ /kṣiṃ dzee khaṃ gi kai si/ /de 24—232

nas sku gsung thugs gsum la/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum/ bkod pa lha ru dmigs par bya/ /de nas me lha 1spyan drangs te/ /mchod bcas pa yis yam shing gis//sngags pa'i dngos grub 'jig par byed/ /yam shing dbang du byas pa yi/ /sreg rdzas mchod rdzas rnam pa ni/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum thug pa dang / /'bras chan nas chan can gyi tshogs/ /sman gyi tshogs ni la du dang / /de sogs rdzas dang til dag ni/ /g.yas kyi phyogs su gzhag par bya/ /spos dang me tog mar me dang / /dri dang zhal zas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /g.yon gyi phyogs su gzhag par bya/ /ku sha yon chab g.yas yin te/ /mar dang rdo rje dril bu dang / /dgang gzar blugs gzar mdun du'o/ /sreg rdzas mchod rdzas rim pa'o/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i bya ba ni/ /dag pa'i khrus byas lus dris byug /gos dang rgyan ni bgo bya ste/ /ku sha bde ba'i stan nyid la/ /shar du kha bltas 'dug byas te/ /snying brtse ba yi bsam pa yis/ /las kyi bum pa byin brlabs nas/ /rdzas rnams dag par bsang bar bya/ /oṃ kharge dhrika /de nas mchod pa so so yi/ /phyag rgya bcing zhing sngags bzlas te/ /tshul bzhin byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ dīḥdzdzaḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod yon la'o/ /oṃ badzra dhū pe sdzahūṃ/ bdug pa'i'o//oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ me tog la'o/ /oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūṃ/ mar me la'o /oṃ badzra garje tpahūṃ/ dri la'o/ /oṃ badzra nai wi bye āḥhūṃ/ zhal zas la'o/ /oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ rol mo la'o/ /de nas dngos med ngang nyid las/ /skye ba med la padma yi/ /gzhal yas khang pa chu gdan can/ /bsam pa bram ze'i khyem dang ni/ /dge 'dun rgyun bzhag me dag las/ /blang la me ni sbar byas te / /bsangs la gzi bskyed me pra brtag /de nang byang chub lnga dag las//24—233

gyur pa'i padma'i gdan steng du/ /gru gsum me las byung ba yi/ /me lha dkar po zhal gsum pa/ /rang gi rigs dang ldan pa'i lus/ /g.yas na spyi drugs mi 'jigs sbyin/ /g.yon na dbyug pa phreng ba 'dzin/ /gri gug thod pa rtsa ba'i phyag /g.yas brkyang ba yi phyag gis mnan/ /khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o / /de nas thugs kyi sa bon las/ /ye shes me ni dgug par bya/ /oṃ ṭākki hūṃ dzaḥ/ bsangs la dam tshig gzhug par bya/ /oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥ/ oṃ daṇḍa hūṃ / oṃ padma baṃ/ oṃ kharge hoḥ/ de nas skye mched sgu gsung thugs/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur mchod pa 'bul/ /bstod pa zhal du re pha bkod/ /sreg rdzas byur bur dbul bar bya/ /yakṣe ma me da/ yatstsha ni rā dza sa ru/ ṇa yo ni ra/ rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad/ /ral gri tho ba dbyug pa dang / /padma dang ni ral gri che/ /'khor lo rdo rje pad ral gri/ /so sor sngags kyis lhar bskyed bya/ /de nas skye mched byin brlabs te/ /mig ni sa yi snying po la//rna ba phyag na rdo rje'i tshul/ /sna ni nam mkha'i snying po dgod/ /lce la 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhag /sgrib pa rnam sel lus la bshad/ /yid la kun du bzang po'o/ /kṣiṃ dzee khaṃ gi kai saṃ/ /thugs la zhe sdang rdo rje ste/ /gsung la 'dod chags rdo rje dgod/ /gti mug rdo rje sku la'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de nas dbang bskur dgug gzhug bya/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod byas la/ /rdo rje dril bu ldan pa yis/ /gshin rje'i dgra la bstod pa bya/ /de nas sreg rdzas bsangs nas ni/ /bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bsgrubs nas kyang / /bdud rtsi me lha'i zhal nyid du/ /sreg rdzas rnams ni phul bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po mnyes par bya/ /gtso bo la 'bum 'khor la khri/ /de bzhin stong dang brgya rtsa 24—234

brgyad—/ /lnga bcu nyi shu rtsa gabyug bdun/ /gtso dang 'khor gyi bye brag gis/ /go rims bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /so so rtsa ba'i sngags dag 1la/ /gsol ba gdab la dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa spyi bor blta/ /de las sa bon yi ge las/ /'phros pas yi ge nyi mar bsdu/ /de nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag tshul du/ /gtor ma ldan pas bzlas pa bya/ /de nas ldang bar brtsam pa ni/ /sems can don la sems pa yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ uhūṃ muḥ/ yid bzhin 'khor dang rdo rje bzlas/ /gtso mo khro tshul lo ma gcigs/ /phra ba'i tshul gyis bzlas par bya/ /oṃ trīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'dis ni las kun byed pa ste/ /'dod pa thams cad yid bzhin 'gyur/ /yo las rlung ste ram̐ las me/ /kai las thod pa a las snod/ /'dab brgyad sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /hūṃ las kha dgab oṃ āḥhūṃ / /bsams te rnge sbar zhu bas bsdu/ /sbyangs te oṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes bkug la bstem byin brlab/ /sbu gus drangs nas gsol sbyin bya/ /lha la sogs pa'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /lha rdzas rdo rje yongs su dag pa'i gtor ma 'di / /kṛṇḍa khā hi kṛṇḍi 5khā hi ma ma shārnying ku ru swā hā/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs la/ /dpa' bo 6nga rgyal btang mi bya/ /dngos po dngos bral skye dang bral/ /g.yo ba g.yo med bde ba can/ /thabs dang shes rab las 'byed cing / /don gsum gnyis su med la bzhag /bdag gi sgrub thabs sbyar ba 'dis/ /'gro kun gshin rje gshed thob shog /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po ka ma la rakṣi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—235

༄ / /khro bo bo ba gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ muṅga ra kro dha ya mā ri sā dha rna nā ma/bod skad du/ khro bo tho ba gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ind+ra bee la'i 'od mnga' zhing / /'jig tshogs bdud las rnam rgyal ni/ /mthar byed che la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /skad cig lha yi rnal 'byor gnas/ /skyes pa'i 'od kyis 'gro ba sbyangs/ /'khor lo chen po spyan drangs nas/ /rnam dag dgu 2yi tshogs bsag bya/ /byams dang snying rje dga' btang snyoms/ /tshangs pa'i rgyun dang ldan pa yi/ /stong pa chen po bsgom par bya/ /bdud kyi phyogs rnams 'jig byed phyir/ /srung 4ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /chu skyes nyi ma'i steng nyid du/ /ya las rdo rje tho ba ni/ /rtse mo nyi shur ldan pa yi/ /lte bar sa bon rab bzhag nas/ /spro bsdu byas nas nga rgyal bsam/ /oṃ sarba budhe 24—237

badzra swa bhā wa ātma kophosnye1haṃ/ gyur pas tho ba gshin rje gshed du bsgom/ /sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po/ /rang gi rig mas 'khyud cing mdzes /g.yas g.yon zhal ni dkar dang dmar/ /gri gug tho ba ral gri dang / /thod pa 'khor lo rin chen mdzes/ /stag gi pags pa sham thabs su/ /mnabs shing g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ /klu dang dur khrod 'khrugs pas brgyan/ /mche gcigs spyan dgur 'jigs pa'i mdangs/ /me dpung dkyil du gnas pa bsgom / /sgu gsung thugs dang skye mched drug /rdo rje gsal bar bskyed par bya / /dbang brtags gshin rje gshed kyis brgyan/ /yig 'bru bzhi yis dgug gzhug bya/ /bu ga chen po spros pas mchod/ /rdo rje dril bu ldan pas bstod / /hūṃ hūṃ rdo rje stobs po che/ /rab 'jigs mi mthun zad mdzad pa/ /rdo rje sku dbyer med pa'i lha/ /tho ba rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgron ma 'o mar ldan pa yis// /kha yi bu ga dag par bsam/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs bskul bas/ /'gro ba ma lus sbyang bar bya/ /sngags kyi rgyal po rjes dran pas/ /khri dang 'bum du bzlas par bya/ /oṃ muṅga ra j-ika 3hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/phyag rgya bgrol nas ngal bso ba/ /gcig dang du ma las grol ba/ /rang bzhin med pa'i snying po can/ /chos kun gyi ni bdag po can/ /sems kyis 4 bskal par bsgom par bya/ /bdag gis rgyud dang bla ma las/ /rnyed pa'i drin 'di thob pa des/ /bskul 5nas sgrub thabs 'di byas pas/ /thams cad 'bras bu mngon rnyed shog /khro bo tho ba thugashin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba / rgya gar gyi mkhan po mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—238

bsdur mchan/237 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 3 〈〈pe 〉stanagug sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torajigs/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsrung /238 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉to/྅/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnyika 'i 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉geb/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nya)/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉skul—/ khya〈〈snar 〉〉wab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (7na ༷)24wa 239

༄/ /dbyug pa gshin rje gshed rnam par 'joms pa jes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ daṇḍa dhrika 2bi dā ra ya mā ri sā dha āoṃ nā ma/bod skad du/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs kyi de nyid gtso dang mtshungs pa yi/ /lha ni bdud dgra dbyug pa gshin rje gshed/ /las rnams thams cad mthar mdzad la btud de/ /mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub phyir bshad par bya/ /rang lus phyag rgya chen por dran/ /theg pa chen po'i blor byas nas/ /bla ma rje btsun rnams la ni/ /bsod nams tshogs rab bsag par bya/ /gnyis rnged sangs rgyas gnyis su med/ /rkyen skyes chos kun chu zla 'dra / /de nyid skye med shes bya'i phyir/ /dag pa'i sngags kyis bskul la bsgom / /tshad med rgyun chad med pa'i sems/ /nam mkha'i thigs 4pa de nyid las/ /srung 5ba'i 'khor lo gdan bsams te/ /dza las dbyug pa 24—240

dkar dang sku/ /rtsa zhal dkar la sngo dmar zhal/ /rang gi rig mar mtshungs pa'i lus/ /gri gug dbyug pa ral gri dang / /thod pa 'khor lo chu skyes 'dzin//g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs/ /chu skyes 'od zer rnon po mnan/ /mi mgo'i phreng dpyangs 1stag lpags mnabs/ /klu dang rus rgyan 2dbus mdzes pa/ /bskyed la lus ngag yid gsum dang / /skye mched rnams la 'dis byin brlab/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ kṣiṃ dzee khaṃ gi kai saṃ/ /dbang bskur cod pan mi bskyod bsam/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs byin gyis brlab/ /byang chub sems kyi sprul pas mchod/ /de nas rdo rje dril ldan pas/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po brjod par bya//sangs rgyas rdo rje kun du bzang / /mnyam pa'i rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ /rdo rje gsang ba dbyings chen po/ /ye shes rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yig 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi rdo rje lce yis myang / /spro dang bsdu ba byas nas kyang / /gsang sngags khri ru bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ badzra daṇḍa dhrika gruhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i rim/ /ye shes thig ler byas nas kyang / /gzugs ni sgra nyid rang bzhin dag /bdag med snying po bsgom par bya/ /ma rig mun pa 'joms byed sgron ma'i mchog /bdud dgra khro bo'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs 'dis/ /'gro ba'i 'jigs chen nges dgra bcom nas kyang / /thams cad gshin rje gshed po nyid mtshungs shog /dbyug pa gshin rje gshed rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na shīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //24—241

dzo /ral — gshin rje gshed gtum po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsaṇḍa khaṅga ya mā ri sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/ ral gri gshin rje gshed gtum po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong pa zhi ba 2las ni rdo rje'i sku/ /bdud mthar mdzad pa rab tu gtum pa'i zhal/ /sems can rjes 'dzin thugs rje chen por ldan/ /ral gri che la btud de bshad par bya/ /skad cig dran pa'i lhar bskyed nas/ /dam pa dmigs la tshogs bsag bya/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi sngon 'gro bas/ /stong pa dang ni 'khor lo bsgom/ /padma 'od zer rnon po ste/ /ram̐ las shugs can gyur pa'i sku/ / margad ljang gu'i mdog 'dra ba4/ /sngo dang dkar po g.yas g.yon zhal/ /gri gug ral gri 'khor lo dang / /thod pa rin chen chu skyes 'dzin/ /dpa' bo'i rgyan dang klu yis spras/ /dbu skra gyen 'greng me dpung dkyil/ /stag lpags mnabs shing g.yon brkyang ba//24—243

bskyed pa'i sku la 'di lta ste/ /snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje thugs/ /mgrin par āḥlas rdo rje gsung / /spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje/ /mthing dmar dkar zhing mtshon char ldan/ /sa snying dkar po mig la kṣiṃ/ /rdo rje 'dzin sngon rna bar dzee / /nam snying ser po sna la khaṃ/ /'jig dbang dmar po lce la gi/ /sgrib sel ljang gu dpral bar kai/ /kun bzang dkar po sten 1snar si/ /spyan drangs mchod bstod byin rlabs bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha haṃ/ rdo rje sems ma la sogs kyis/ /dbang bskur spyi bo 4gshin rje gshed / /sgo bzhi'i sngags kyis 'dod lha bsgul/ /rang gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /muṅga rā dzaḥ/ daṇḍa hūṃ/ padma baṃ/ khazhe hoḥ/ snying gar ye shes zhu ba'i rgyun/ /ba sru'i 5khung nas sprul pas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko36haṃ/ hūṃ rdo rje las ni brtson 'grus che/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /las mthar mdzad pa'i thub pa po/ /rdo rje brtson 'grus khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bdud rtsi myang ba byas nas kyang / /spro bsdu ldan pas bzlas par bya/ /oṃ badzra khaspyo byeka 7hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung ba rim gyis thim 8pa la/ /yi ge gsum du sbyangs nas kyang / /bde dang sdug bsngal mi dmigs pa'i/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /bdag gis rnyed dang bkur ste la/ /ma bltas sems can la brtse'i phyir/ /ral gri rdo rje'i sgrub thabs byas/ /'di yis nges 'byung rnyed gyur cig /ral gri gshin rje gshed gtum po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //2tsho‘—244

bsdur mchan/243 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rab /ral gri gshin rje gshed gtum po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈snar 〉〉bzhi pa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rjes/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mar kuṭa ljang khu'i mdog 'dra la/244 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉steng / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bor/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gas/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wahwa/ 97〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrika du/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉5) thigabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (782)24wa 245

༄ga /padma gshin rje gshed shes rab bde ba can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā su kha ya 2padma ya mā ri sā dha rgo nā ma/bod skad du/ padma gshin rje gshed shes rab bde ba can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rjes su dran ldan zhing / /de 'dren thugs rje'i rtags mnga' ba/ /mtsho skyes zhal la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /dang por sngags pas khrus byas nas / /ku sha'i stan la legs 'dug ste/ /lus ngag yid gsum bag ldan pas / /cung zad 'gro 'ong ldan pas bya/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar ldan pas/ /cod pan rje btsun gzung bar bya/ /de nas rje btsun spyan drangs te/ /skyabs 'gro byang chub sems bskyed de/ /de nas maṇḍal bstar 4ba ste/ /me tog dgram zhing mchod tshogs bsham/ /de nas sems can kun gyi phyir/ /bsod nams tshogs bsag/sa gshegs su gsol/ /bu gcig ltar dran byams pa dang / /24—246

sdug bsngal bral 'dod snying rje dang / /bde ba thob pa'i dga' ba dang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i btang snyoms so/ /snying rje thabs kyi rang bzhin dang / /ldan pa'i stong pa bsgom par bya/ /srung 1'khor podma nyi ma'i steng / /ni las chu skyes gyur pa'i sgu/ /padma rā ga'i mdog 'dra la/ /g.yas dang g.yon ni sngo dang dkar/ /gri gug chu skyes ral gri dang / /thod pa 'khor lo rin chen 'dzin / /thod pa lnga yis dbu bskor cing / /phreng ba klu dang dur khrod brgyan/ /rnge dpung skyil krung stag lpags mnabs2/ /bskyed pa cung zad 'jam pa'i mdangs / /sku gsung thugs dang skye mched drug /rang lus ngo bo byin gyis brlab / /dbang bskur rtags dang ldan pa la/ /mchod la bstod pa 'dis mnyes bya/ /hūṃ rdo rje dam tshig rdo rje gsung / /rdo rje dbyangs ni zab mo che /'dod chags rdo rje nyid mtshungs pa/ /skyon bral rje la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud rtsi myang zhing spro bsdu bzlas/ /byas nas phyag rgya bkrel bar bya/ /oṃ badzra padma j-ika byehūṃ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rig pa'i shes rab mda' dag 5gis/ /ltong ldan 'been la thug pa na/ /gcig kyang mi gnas bde ba che/ /bsgom bya sgom byed med pa yi/ /rje btsun gsung gi drin dag dang / /rgyud las mthong ba bris pa 'dis/ /'gro kun dri ma med pa yi6/ /sangs rgyas sa la gnas par shog /padma gshin rje gshed shes rab bde ba can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra zhes bya bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //24—247

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi maṇḍal gyi cho ga jes bya ba/1༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ kriṣṭa ya mā ri sru dha ṭwāṃ maṇḍa la bi dhi nā ma/bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi maṇḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rdo rje ye shes dang / /rje btsun mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub slob dpon mnyes bya'i phyir/ /rje btsun dkyil 'khor dam pa yi/ /cho ga bdag gis bshad par bya/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /sa gzhi bzang po yid 'ong la/ /rin chen spos chus legs bkrus ri byete/ /mnyam pa'i sa la dri sogs sbyin/ /mdzes pa'i gzhi la zig le bzhag pya /tā ma la yi 'o 4ma 'am/ /ras bal gtsang mas dgod par bya/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ /phyi nang khrus la gnas nas kyang / /skad cig bskyed la tshogs bsag 5bya/ /srung 6dang chos 'byung gzhal yas khang / /bskyed la de yi nang du ni/ /me tog bzang po dgram 24dod249

par bya/ /zhe sdang rdo rje las 1brtsams te/ /ral gri rdo rje rab tu bskyed/ /tshom bu re la lan bdun te/ /bzlas pa 2padma nyi zla'i steng / /bde gshegs sras bcas bsam par bya/ /oṃ trīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na kshi hūṃ 4phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/oṃ dzi na j-ika5 /oṃ ratna dhrika6 /oṃ ā ro '-ika /oṃ pradzñā dhrika8 /oṃ muṅga ra dhrika /oṃ daṇḍa j-ika /oṃ padma rjaka /oṃ khaṅga dhrika /oṃ mo ha ra ti/ oṃ dwo ṣa ra ti/ oṃ rā 9ga ra ti/ oṃ badzra ra ti/ so so'i sgu mdog phyag mtshan dang / /rgyan dang bzhugs pa'i phyag rgya rnams/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i cho ga las / /'byung ba bzhin du gsal bar bskyed/ /tshogs bsags dkyil 'khor bstem pa dang / /skye mched sku gsung thugs byin brlab/ /dbang blang ba dang dgug gzhug bya/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /spro bsnyu dang ni bzlas pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor pa yis legs byas te/ /'dod pa'i don rnams gsol ba gdab/ /gshegs sbyidang bzod pa gsol byas te/ /de nyid gsum gyi cho ga yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig bskyed pa'i lha rnams ni/ /snying ga nyid du rnam par bstem/ /gnyis don dam pa bden pa yi/ /chos kyi tshul la gnas par bya/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir / /byang chub tu ni bsngo ba dang / /smon lam chen po gdab par bya/ /de ltar nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /snying brtse brtson pas dbul bar bya/ /g.yeng ba rnam par zhi don du/ /tshogs bsags maṇḍal ting 'dzin ni/ /sbyor ba'i cho ga sngon song bas/ /gser dang pad zla rnam bsams te/ /gong bzhin rim par dgod par bya/ /oṃ badzra re khe hūṃ/ maṇḍa la hūṃ/ oṃ badzra re khe hūṃ1 /padma maṇḍa la hūṃ/ oṃ badzra re khe hūṃ/ a tsand+ra maṇḍa la hūṃ/ bsnyen par bya ba'i 24—250

gong bzhin du/ /gshegs su gsol dang bsnyu ba min/ /khyad par bsdus pa'i maṇḍal ni/ /las kyi sngags kyis byin brlabs te/ /mdzes pa'i sngags kyis dgram par bya/ /ras sam bzang po'i gzhi dag la/ /thig le 'bru sogs bkod nas kyang / /bde gshegs sras bcas spyan drangs te/ /gdan gyi tshul du dbul bar bya/ /shin tu bsdus pa 'di lta ste/ /tshom bu gcig la mngon brten te/ /gzhal yas khang du dmigs nas kyang / /de nas kṣespyan drangs bzhugs su gsol/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /gsol btab bsngos la gshegs su gsol/ /ma chags brten pa'i snying gar bsdu/ /sgyu ma'i blo yis zin par bya/ /bla na med pa'i maṇḍal ni/ /snying ga'i padma rnam dag nang / /ye shes chen po'i thig le ni/ /lnga phrag gnyis dang drug phyed kyi/ /yig 'bru mchog tu rnam bsams te/ /mtshan dang rdzogs pa'i skur gyur nas/ /dus gsum tshogs kyi mchod pa bya/ /rtag tu bsdu ba ma yin te/ /dus med rtag tu brtson pas 'grub/ /bsam gyis mi khyab maṇḍal ni/ /chos nyid zung du 'jug pa las/ /rang gi de nyid rnam bsams pa'i/ /skye med mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas/ /rtog dang bral ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje lta bu'i pho brang yin/ /dus gsum rtag tu sangs rgyas nas/ /skye med de bzhin nyid kyis bdag /chags sdang bral bas dbul bar bya/ /maṇḍal kun gyi mchog yin no/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi maṇḍal las/ /ye shes maṇḍal rnam par skye/ /de phyir thabs kyi maṇḍal ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis dbul bar bya/ /thun mong 4dngos grub bsgrub pa dang / /mchog gi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi 5bsam pa bzang po yis/ /maṇḍal byas pa'i dge ba gang / /des ni sems 24—251

can thams cad kyis/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams dag thob shog /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi shemaṇḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //zangs gling rnal 'byor nā ga pū bye ra yis/ /rnal 'byor ka ma rakṣi hūṃta nyid la/ / gu tsha rgyal bu'i zibu nyid btad nas kyang / /ta ru pa ri dur khrod tshal nyid du/ /rnal 'byor 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi tre'akhor lo nang / /gsol btab rnal 'byor rnams kyi zhal ngo ru/ /maṇḍal cho ga bsod snyoms pa yis byas//deng sang rnal 'byor lta spyod ldan pa yis/ /dus rnams rtag tu maṇḍal 'bad par rigs// //bsdur mchan/249 shāmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi maṇḍal gyi cho ga padma srung bas mdzad pa bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sprus/ — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagazhag je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skala'i lo/ pe/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sags/ hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrung /25༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tī/ ri〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 hūṃ/ zhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dzika she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrika 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabag snye〈〈pe 〉〉lhaka swā hā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉drig swā hā/tsu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabashags/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gimaṇḍa la hūṃ/ oṃ badzra re khe hūṃ/251 1〈pa pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodabul/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabangs/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉me sa/252 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sgrub thabs kyi/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ bye sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 ka ra tri/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rab tsha rgyal ba'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa/24—252
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (784)24wa 253

0858༄khya/ /chos kyi ma'i snang ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharma kā 2ya dī paṃ bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du / chos kyi sgu'i snang ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po snying rje'i bdag nyid pas/ /srid pa'i bde la ma chags shing / /bdag 'dzin dag la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /bdag 'dzin yongs su dor byas te / /bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa dang / /rang dang gzhan gyis 4blang ba'i phyir/ /phyi nang bar chad sel ba'i mchog /chos sgu rten mchog gdab pa'i phyir/ /gshin rje gshed la gus btud de/ /mchod rten cho ga bshad par bya/ /zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /yid dga' ba yi sa phyogs su/ /dur khrod dgon pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /bkra shis sa ni bzang po la / /bdud rtsi rnam lngas legs byugs te/ /spos dang dri yi tshogs rnams dang / /gser dang mu tig byi ru sogs/ /rin chen rnam mang bcug nas 24—254

kyang / /khrus byas dag pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'jim pa'i gong bu dril nas kyang / /bdag nyid lha ru rnam bskyed nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags bya/ /srung 1ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs byas la/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi khang pa dang / /gzhal yas khang mchog bskyed nas ni/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus nyid du/ /skye med snang ba las byung ba'i/ /thabs dang shes rab gsal ldan bsam / /gyur pas ro mnyam thig le'o/ /de la thugs kyi yi ge ste/ /de nas thugs mchog nyid du 'gyur/ /nga rgyal sku gsung thugs bcug ste/ /zhu bas chos kyi sgu ru gyur/ /de yi sa bon yi ge las/ /'phros pas gshin rje gshed bkug ste/ /zhal du zhugs nas zhu bar bsam/ /bdag nyid thig le chen por blta/ /phyogs bcur thig le bzhi spros pas/ /tsartsi phag mo'i dbyangs ldan ma/ /go rī lha mo bzhir gyur te/ /rje btsun thig le bskul bar bya / /rje btsun bzhengs shig 2snying rje khro/ /srid gsum pa yi ma rig sol/ /rje btsun bzhengs shig rgyal rigs bdud bzhi las ni rgyal ba'i sems ni g.yengs / /rje btsun bzhengs shig 4'jig rten snyan mnan stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /byu phyir 'jig rten snyan mnan stong pa nyid la sems te bzhugs / /bcom ldan rgyal pos bskul nas kyang / /lha mo nyid kyang thim par gyur/ /de la nyi ma sa bon bcas/ /gyur pas rdo rje mtshan ma can/ /de la gshin rje gshed mchog sgu/ /rtog pa bzhin du gsal bar bsam/ /de las mkha' gsang byin brlabs te/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bkug nas kyang / /zhu bas khams mchog dag pa'i nang / /thig le bcu bdun nyid du gyur/ /de las sa bon gzugs su gyur/ /yakṣe ma me da/ ya tsa ni ra/ dza sa do ru/24—255

ṇa yo ni rā/ rdo rje sngo dang 'khor lo dkar/ /rin chen ser 1dang padma dmar/ /ral gri ljang gu tho ba sngo/ /dbyug pa gar gyi phyag rgyar gyur/ /de las yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ /dgra lnga yum bzhi bsgom par gyur/ /mngal nas skye ba'i tshul nyid du/ /so so gnas su dgod par bya/ /de nas bdag gi snying ga nas/ /sa bon dag las 'od 'phros pas/ /dkyil 'khor dag la phog gyur te/ /'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshul nyid kyis/ /gsal ba'i bzlas pa dbul bar bya/ /oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na/ pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaka saṃ buddhā ya/ oṃ te ru ka 4susmye/sa me sa ma te/ sa ma ye/ sa ma ro bye/ a na lasbe ta ram̐ bee ya sho ba ti/ ma hā te dza/ ni ra ku le nirba ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga tā/ z-i da ya a byejo na a 5byespyu te swā hā/ gtso bo dag la ji lta 6bzhin/ /gti mug sogs la rim bzhin no / /oṃ dzi na dzika /oṃ ratna j-ika /oṃ ā ro tpaka /oṃ pradzñā j-ika /oṃ muṅga ra dhrika /oṃ daṇḍa dhrika /oṃ padma j-ika /oṃ khaṅga j-ika /oṃ mo ha ra ti/oṃ dre ṣa ra ti/ oṃ rā ga ra ti/ oṃ badzra ra ti/ nyi shu rtsa gcig lnga bcu dang / /brgya dang brgya rtsa brgyad dang ni/ /gtso dang 'khor gyi rim pa yis/ /bzlas pa bsdu ba'i tshul gyis bzhu/ /'od kyi phung por bsams nas ni/ /de nas skol 8phor g.yas thogs te/ /gu gul a kar nag la sogs/ /dri yi bdug pas bdug par bya/ /de nas 'od kyi gong bu las/ /bcad cing sku gdung gdab par bya/ /snying por 'byel pa'i rten 'byel dag /bzlas shing dkyil 'khor dbyung bar bya/ /bkod pa'i tshul gyis mkha' la bzhag9 /rdzogs nas lha yi dkyil 'khor lo7/ /skye mched byin gyis brlab pa dang / /sku gsung 24—256

thugs dang de bzhin te/ /dbang bskur dgug gzhug mchod bstod dang / /bdud rtsi myang gis smin par 1bya/ /de nas gsol ba gdab pa dang / /bshags dang baspo ba byas nas ni/ /sgyu ma'i blo yis zin par bya/ /de nas smon lam btab nas ni/ /gnas khang bzang por bzhugs 2par bya/ /dus rnams kun du mchod pa dang / /bskor ba sogs kyis mnyes par bya/ /na mo ratna tra yā yabye / ye dharmā te tu pra bha wā/ he tun te ṣān ta thā ga to khya ba data / te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha/ e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra 4ma ṇaḥ/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang po la/ /mos pa'i blo yis bskor bar bya/ /na mo bha ga wa te / ratna ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyaka saṃ buddhā 5ya/ta rya thā/ oṃ rasne rasne/ ma hā 6rasne/ rasne bī dza ye swā hā/ rnal 'byor sems la gnod gyur na/ /nam mkha' dag la gdab par bya/ /cho ga'i rnam pa gong bzhin te/ /mtshan med phyir na mchog yin no/ /rkyen rnams tshogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /chu dang me dang rlung dag la/ /baṃ ram̐ yo ni rnam bsams te/ /'phros pas rgyal ba sras bcas dag /bsdus te yig 'bru la bstims pas/ /chu la dkar dang rnge la dmar/ /rlung la khro bo sngon po bsam9/ /zhu bas 'od kyi phung por gyur/ /skol 7phor thogs la gdab par bya/ /rab gnas bya ba gong bzhin te/ /de la khyad par yod ma yin/ /rnal 'byor bsod nams bsags pa dang / /bar chod myur du zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis sgu gdung cho ga'i mchog /mngon par brtsams pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis / /rnal 'byor lam la gnas pa rnams/ /sgo gsum sdig pa dag gyur te/ /chos sku gnyis med thob par shog / rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka lā pa ma hā zhes bya 24—257

bas mdzad pa mchod rten gyi cho ga sdogs so// //rnal 'byor bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā nas 3rang 'gyur du byas pa'o/ /so ma pu ri'i 2gtsug lag khang chen du/ /nag po zhabs zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor pas / /rnal 'byor tshe 'phos de ba pā la yis/ /yab mchog dharma zipā la 'das gyur pa'i/ /ched du gsol btab rgyal po'i zhal ngo thuru/ /mchod rten cho ga me tog tshal du mdzad/ /spros bcas spros sted tshul gyi lam mchog 'di/ /deng sang rnal 'byor rnams kyis gdab par rigs// //bsdur mchan/254 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /chos kyi sgu'i snang ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā ka bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ste/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/255 tsho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasag bya/ /bsrung / —— sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉deng / cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhugs shing /256 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagaser/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamal/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dza/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gika5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri da yā dhiṣṭha nā/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rdzar/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'aka —〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉spor/9〈〈pe 〉sngagazhag nyu 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rol/257 1〈〈snar 〉〉 mi/ 2〈〈pe 〉ra zhug 〈〈snar 〉sngagazhug 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa yā / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shā/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rtse/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dku/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)rya/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉bsams—/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉por/ 11〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 12〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 1snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// //258 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 pradzñā dzñā na yis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ri/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉jarmā / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdza/24—258
