༄/ /gshin rje gshed kyi ro sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ho ma bi byeṣṭi sha kṛṇḍa ya mā ri nā ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed kyi ro sreg 2gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /zab mo bcas pa'i rdo rje ni/ /bla meed snying po la btud de/ /ro sreg cho ga bshad par bya/ /sems can sangs rgyas snying po can/ /sangs rgyas nyid du rab spyor ba'i/ /thabs kyi khyad par ro sreg par—/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /bsgrubs la bsreg par bya ba dang / /dur khrod bsreg par bya ba'o/ /bsgrubs 5la bsreg pa rnam bzhi ste/ /dang por longs spyod 'khor lo dang / /gnyis pa rab tu phye ba la/ /gsum pa nye ba'i sgrub pa nyid/ /bzhi pa mchod rten cho ga yi / /dang po ro la khrus byas nas/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /phyi yi gtor ma gtang 7bar bya/ /de nas tshogs bsags nas bzung ste/ /24—260

mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs pa dang / /bzang po'i khri la bzhag nas kyang / /rgyan gyis legs par spras pa la/ /ga pur la sogs khar blud nas/ /bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab bya ste/ /snying gar gzungs thag btags nas kyang / /rtsa ba'i sngags la de nyid gsum/ /spel ba'i bzlas pa khri tsam bya/ /de nas bye brag las byas nas/ /thod pa klad pa dbang po lnga/ /snying sogs bzhi dang nywa 1bzhi dang / /snum dang bdud rtsi lnga dang gnas/ /rkang brgyad sde pa'i bu ga dgu / /rgyas pa'i srad bus bcings nas kyang / /shun pa'i nang du dril la bzhag /de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ /rtog pa dang bcas rtog med dang / /shin tu rtog med la sogs ni/ /gang zag sems kyi khyad par yin/ /de yang rab tu sbyar ba dang / /'dod pa gzhan la spel ba dang / /rtog med rlon pa'i rol pa'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo las/ /byung ba'i bkra shis smon btab nas/ /tshe las 'das pa'i don gyi phyir/ /bsngo ba rab tu zin par bya/ /de ni longs spyod 'khor lo'o/ /smon lam dkyil 'khor de nyid dang / /lha yi de nyid las sbyar ba'i/ /tshe las 'das pa'i don gyi phyir/ /rgya chen rab tu gdab par bya/ /sbyang ba gsum du shes bya ste/ /dang po thal ba btags la btsag/de nas dri dang sbyar bya ste/ /trīḥbyeḥl ni ngan 'gro kun/ /spyong nabar byed pa'i sngags btags la/ /khri'am stong du bzlas pa bya/ /de nas maṇḍal ngos mnyam gal / /ba yi rnam lngas byugs nas kyang / /dri zhim pa yi —bsgos pa'i sa/ /dri yis 5thig le gdab par bya/ /de nas srog chags med 'gyur zhing / /mnyen zhing 'jam la dkar ba'i sa/ /blangs la dri zhim chu yis bran/ /de nas thal ba dang bsres la/ /'jim pa legs pa'i gong bu bya/ /de nas snying 24—261

ga'i sa bon las/ /'phros pa'i 'od kyis tshe 'das ni/ /'og gi gnas nas bkug byas la/ /lus ngag yid gsum sbyang ba 1snabya/ /de nas hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod pas / /khu ba'i thig ler zhu gyur te/ /a dkar thung ngu gsal bar bya/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /dbyangs dang gsal yig bsdu bar bya/ /de las —rdo rjer gyur nas kyang / /hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar bya/ /de nas rang gi lha dang ni/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' ru/ /bskyed la sku rnams bsdu bar bya/ /de yang byin kyis brlab pa ni/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma kophongahaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma kophohaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolhahaṃsnye/de nas byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas byas la/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bstems khunas kyang / /'od kyi phung por blta bar bya/ /de nas rten 'brel ldan pa'i sngags/ /brjod cing btab la 'khor lo bsgom/ /sngon 7gyi maṇḍal drang ba'i dkyil/ /dri yi thig les brgyan pa la/ /me tog tshom bu bkod pa'i steng / /spyan drangs nas ni bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas 'khor lo rgyal mtshan dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phen 8gyis brgyan/ /de nas na bza' dkar po gsol/ /bkod pa shin tu mdzes byas la/ /skye mched sku gsung thugs dang dbang / /dgug gzhug mchod dang bstod byas la/ /bdud rtsi myang dang spro bsdu bzlas/ /rdzogs nas bsngo dang smon lam btab/ /de nas gzhal yas bzang po'i nang / /bzhugs su gsol la rtag tu mchod/ /ro bsregs pa'i rus pa'i sā tstsha'i 9cho ga yin/ gshin rje gshed kyi ro sreg sbyigi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—262

bsdur mchan/26 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉smon /gshin rje gshed kyi ro bsreg gi cho ga bzhugs so// ②⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg ④〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg par/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg par bya/⑤⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabasgrub/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang /261 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nya/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsnyams/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stonas/⑤〈〈snar 〉sten/262 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ rju〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ ④/〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa3/ du〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉glasbadzra 'gre/ citta badzra 'gre/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstem/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lor bsgom/ /sngar/(du/〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toraphan/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg gi rus pa'i tsha tsha'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsregabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (786)24wa 263

༄7/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga jes bya ba/sna ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa tsakra bi dhī nā ma/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ rje btsun mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams khyad par bsags pa dang / /dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba dang / /bgegs rnams nye bar zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi —tshogs 'khor bshad par bya/ /yid dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs su/ /tshogs kyi khang pa yid 'ong ba/ /'khor khang rim gsum ran par brtsig4 /de nas tsandan gur gum dang / /dri yi tshogs ni bsgos nas kyang / /sa gzhi bzang po legs byas te/ /rnam lngas skyong 5nul byas nas kyang / /gzhung dang mthun pa'i maṇḍal la/ /mdzes pa'i me tog legs bkram ste/ /mchod pa'i tshogs rnams tshang bar bsag /'byor pa'i yo byad ldan pa dang / /bsdu bar 'os pa'i rnal 'byor tshogs/ /ma lus par ni basbus nas kyang / /slob dpon la ni zhu ba dbul/ /las kyi bum pa 24dod264

byin brlabs nas/ /mchod pa'i bum pa bsags nas kyang / /mdzes pa'i me tog legs btang ste/ /tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya/ /khro bo sngon po mdzes pa che/ /khrod ni dam tshig yid du 'ong / /nor bu rin chen ches bcing ba'i51/ /dbyug pa phyag na bsnams pa ste/ /bdag ni 'khor ba las bsgral phyir/ /dpa' bos gnang gis gtong du gsol/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs dbus su/ /bzang po'i sgo ni rnam par dbye/ /gsol ba btab na — 7nang bkug ste/ /las kyi twobum pas chu gtor te/ /mna' chu blud la gral la dgod—/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon la/ /me tog phul te gsol ba gdab/ /de nas rnal 'byor pho mo la/ /me tog gtor la 5bskul bar bya/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /lhar bsgom lce lag byin gyis brlab/ /phyag rgya byin brlab mngon rtogs brjod/ /hūṃ/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag po'i gtso/ /oṃ ma hā badzra hūṃ/ a/ srid pa rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gdod nas dag /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /srid pa dam pa mchog tu byed/ /oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā badzra gandha/ de nas mchod pa'i khyad par tshogs/ /de nyid gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'phros pa yis/ /bla ma rje btsun mdun bsams te/ /mchod yon zhal bsil zhabs bkru dbul/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis rab mchod nas/ /de kho na nyid bstod pa bya/ /oṃ sthāḥskṛḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā badzra pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ / de bzhin du puṣpe/ dī pe/ gadhe/ nai wi bye shasde7/ oṃ sdzahūṃ/24—265

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū 1dza badzra swā bhā wa ātma kolha— haṃ/ rdo rje dril bu ldan pa yis//gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje mi 'jigs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /nga rgyal rdo rje ngo bo khyod/ /rdo rje thugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rin chen rdo rje ngo bo nyid/ /'dod chags rdo rje gtso bo khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi rnam pa bsnyems/ /thams cad dbyangs ni mchog gi mchog /rdo rje gsung mchog phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sgu yi rdo rje rab 'dra ba/ /ral gri phyag la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi dngos po khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsnyus/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gi — nyon mongs tshogs rnams las/ /byung ba'i sdig pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs spyan snga ru/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid dang ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' dge 'dun mchog /slob sogs dge ba thams cad la/ /rgya cher bdag ni rjes yi rang / /khams gsum rnam rtog dra ba yis/ /mngon par gtibs pa mun nag la/ /jeg pa chen po'i ye shes che/ /chos kyi sgron mes 4'od snang mdzod/ /rdzogs sangs 'khor ba'i chos rnams las/ /chos skur mya ngan 'da' bzhed pa/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas bar du/ /sems can don mdzad bzhugs su gsol/ /bsod nams tshogs las mngon byung ba'i/ /dge ba'i bsod nams ma lus kun/ /sems can 'khor ba las sgrol phyir/ /thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /mchod pa nyi shu'i tshogs rnams kyang / /24—266

de sogs rol mo'i tshogs rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis lku'abad pa yi/ /rdo rje chen po mchod byas la/ /de nas blo yis gshegs su gsol/ /de nas stong pa nyid bsgoms te/ /snying rjes byin 2pa'i gsal bar bya/ /de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dang / /'bar ba'i khang pa drag po la/ /mtshon cha tshogs kyis spras par bsam/ /nang du chos 'byung dkar po ni/ /gru gsum mtshon pa bye dang bcas pa/ /rdo rje gzhal yas khang bskyed la/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi tshul dag gis/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor smin par bya/ /de nas bdud rtsi byin brlabs te/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin mchod/ /de nas mthe bong srin lag gis/ /blangs pa'i bdud rtsi byugs pa yis/ /chos 'byung gru gsum dkar dmar bri/ /de nas bdud rtsi'i thig le yis/ /mjes pa'i me tog legs bkram ste/ /skad cig bskyed dang dgug gzhug bya/ /de nas bdud rtsi phul nas kyang / /bdag nyid la ni mchod par bya/ /thabs dang gsang bas blangs nas kyang / /lce rtse smin mtshams spyi bor gtor/ /de nas de dag mi dmigs bsgom/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid la ni/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod nas kyang / /bstod cing bdud rtsi myangs nas kyang / /gsal bar dmigs nas bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas zhing skyong 'khor bcas la//gtor ma rgya chen btang ba ni/ /yi ge gsum gyi ngo bo yis/ /bsregs dang sbyangs dang gtor byas la/ /maṇḍal bzang po yid 'ong ste/ /thig le le tse ④dgu byas te/ /dbus la ye shes 'khor lo bsam/ /phyogs dang mtshams la zhing skyong brgyad/ /ma mo sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /bcas pa spyan drangs mchod pa bya/ /oṃ/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni ri sul phug/24—267

grong dang bzhi mdo dag dang ni/ /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /gdol pa'i snod dang thang dang ni/ /khyad par du ni chu la gnas/ /nag pa 3drag po drag po che/ / lha sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po gcigs dang mi sdug drag /rga las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byad mo dang drag mo dang / /mi sdug ma dang u ma dang / /rgyal ba rnam par rgyal ma dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen po/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo / /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jib byed gong gnas rnal 'byor ma//drag po'i gzugs dang drag chen mo/ /mche ba gatshigs pa'i thod chen mo/ /thod phreng phreng can kha ṭwāṃ ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /de bzhin chen mo mkha' 'go ma/ /las kun rjes su grub byed ma/ /spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen mo/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku che ste/ /rdul byed rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo / /rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /oṃ kakka ṭwā 4na/ bathran na/ kha khā khā 5da na/ sarba dutthan6/ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a mo ka su hūṃ/ zhes pas bkug la/padma'i gdan la gnas par bsams la/ mchod pa lngar byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid dbul te/ sngags de nyid kyi mjug la/ a mu ka su shārnying ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas dbul te/ so so'i lce la hūṃ las rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs 7par bsams pa'i spu gu'i 'od kyis drangs te mchod par bsams la/de nas chos bshad de/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing 24—268

gsal tūzhes bya ba brjod nas/ smon lam btab ste/ sems can thams cad sdig med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi1/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad par shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma gol ba rnams bdag ges dgrol/ /da lta nyid du rjes brtse bas/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas la dgod/ /ces bya bas bsngo bar byas gshegs su mi gsol/ de nas rnal 'byor pho mo kun lha'i dkyil 'khor du bltas la/ dang po dri yis mchod/ de nas me tog dang bdug pa dang mar me dang / lha bshos kyi cetshul bzhin du mchod la/ de'i 'og tu bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'i chang gis mchod de/ lag pa g.yon pas chang bzung nas—/ /g.yas pas rtse gsum pa byas la/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'dis sbyin te/ /ltos shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di la the tshom yod ma yin/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum/ /rang bzhin gasbug tu rtogs par bza'/ /zhes bya bas drang ngo / /len pa pos brjod pa/ 'dod chags dri ma bral ba yi /rin thang med las legs 'ongs chos/ /gzung zhedang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /de kho na nyid bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas padma'i bskor treb dang bcas pas blang ngo / /'og ma rnams la drang ba la 'di skad brjod/ spyor ba'i dus na dngos grub ni/ /spyod kun de nyid de bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor pas ni kun du spyad//ji ltar bde bar spyad par bya/ /zhes bya ba brjod la brim mo/ /de'i 'og tu sha khu dang gur mar gyis mchod/ de nas lha bshos so sor drangs la/ de nas kun gyis phud basbus la/ slob dpon la phul nas/ slob dpon gyis cha gnyis su bgos te/cha gcig g.yon gyi phyogs su bgos la byin gyis brlabs la/ dkyil 'khor kyi lha 24—269

dodal dbul/ cha gcig g.yas su bzhag la/ byin gyis brlabs la phyogs skyong la dbul te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis mchod/ de nas ci bder rol cing longs spyod/ skabs der bkra shis bya'o/ /de nyid yang dag spyod pa yi1/ /rnal 'byor pa ni kun nas bdag /ji ltar bde bar brjod par bya/ /sgyu ma lta bur mdzes pa yis/ /gnyis sprod kun 'khyud sogs spyor ba/ /lus can don du yang dag spyad/ /dngos po bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas lha dang phyogs skyong la gnang ba nod pa dang / 2badzra satwas bzod par gsol ba byas te/ badzra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig gi lha snying gar bsnyus la/ oṃ padma ko shi hūṃ/ zhes basbu'o/ /oṃ badzra dhu pe kṛṇḍi gatstsha hūṃ/ zhes bya bas phyi rol gyi lha gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas lhag ma bsdus te/ de la yang gnyis te/rnal 'byor pho mo'i lhag ma ni phyi rol gyi sha za la sogs pa mi ma yin pa rnams la btang ste/ phyi sgor bton la btang ngo / /khyim pa'i lhag ma ni khyem pa de nyid kyi mi ma yin pa la bsngo'o/ /lhag ma de lta bu'i skal ba med pa la/ slob dpon gyi kha nas bdud rtsir byas la sbyin no/ /de nas yon bdag dang 'khor la bkra shis dang smon lam gdab bo/ /de nas gtor skyel de log pa dang / tshogs kyi khang sgor me long dang dung bud pa dgrol chu can gyi zan ni mchod/ de nas nang du log nas rnal 'byor pho mo la yang de bzhin mchod pa bya'o/ /ma 'ongs skye bo'i tshogs rnams bsags par 'dod pa dang / /bslab pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /don du dri med lung dang 4bla ma'i man ngag ltar/ /ma nor bzung ste bdag dang gzhan la phan phyir bris pa yin/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rim pa slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //21—270

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/hūṃ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa ya mā ri shādhi ho ma bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ mgon po 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can/ /char sprin gzhon nu'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rtog bral lhun gyis skyes pa'i bdag /gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal te/ /sdig pa zhi dang bsod nams 'phel/ /dbang du bya dang tshar bcad dang / /dngos grub myur du thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis sbyin sreg bshad par bya/ /bde gshegs chos kyi sku dag gi/ /bsnyen pa sngon du song ba yis/ /yid dga' ba yi sa phyogs su/ /bkra shis bzang po'i gzhi dag la/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i sa sbyangs nas/ /tshad dang ldan pa'i thab khung ni/ /rgyar ni khru gang zabs su phyed/ /kha khyer sor bzhi dor nas kyang / /dpangs dang rgya ru sor bzhi brtsig /phyogs kyi thad kar sor 24—272

gnyis las/ /dra ba zla tshes rdo rje'i gzugs/ /kha dog dkar po nyid byas te/ /tsandan dkar po'i 'o mas byugs/ /me tog dkar po dus gsum gtor/ /nang du 'dab brgyad dkar po bri/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang / /padma ral gri phyag rgya dgod/ /nang du rdo rje'i phreng ba ste/ /kha khyer me ris rnam par bskor / /thab kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /bud shing tshad ni khru gang la/ /skam pa dang ni rnying pa dag /rul dang srog chags rnam spangs te/ /n+ya gro dha dang pā la sha /sha mi ta dang dri bzangs dang / /byang chub shing dang tsandan dang / /dri zhim bzang po'i shing de dag /thab kyi kho ra khor yug tu/ /ku sha sngon po bkram pa'i steng / /thab khung dma' bar legs brtsigs la/ /sbrang rtsi 'o ma dri chus byug /bud shing dbang du byas pa'o/ /yam shing 'bras bu tsandan kyi/ /shing ngam dri zhim shing dag la/ /rtse mo'i cha las byung ba yi/ /rlon dang 'dab mar bcas pa ste/ /sor bcu'i tshad du mngon par gsungs/ /dri chu 'o mas sbags la bzhag /rtse gnyis gas dang chag pa dang / /'bus zos pa dang srog chags bcas/ /shun pa med dang brla bskams dang / /yo dang rul dang sbom pa dang / /ring thung phra ba rnam par spangs/ /gdags yig btags la bsreg par bya/ /bye brag dang ni sde tshan no/ /na maḥshārnying ku ru swā hā/ a mu ka gye sarba tre ha ṇi/ sarba bispyo na/ sarba dzwa ra khaṃ/ sarba byā bye rna/ sarba ro ga rna/ sarba bi ṣa rna7/ sarba a mo ga le rna/ sarba dur ni mi ta rna/ sarba pā paṃ karmā pa ra khaṃ/ shādhing ku ru swā hā/ til dang yungs kar rgyal po ni/ /sdig pa sbyang phyir bsreg par bya/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā 2ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/de nas mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ /dgang blugs phul la bsreg par bya/ /24—273

ye shes gshegs la dam tshig bsdu/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ 1muḥ/ de nas mee sbyangs sreg rdzas kyi/ /lhag ma ji snyed pa rnams ni/ /rnge yi lha la sngags kyis dbul/ /mchod bstod dgang blugs bzod gsol bya/ /ye shes me lha gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig 'bar ba'i rnam par bsnyim/ /de nas bdag gi phyag rgya che/ /dgrol dang thugs kar basbu tshul gyis/ /dam tshig rgyal por gnas nas kyang / /thab la bskor zhing me tog dbul/ /de nas glegs bam klog la sogs/ /ji ltar mthun pa'i spyod lam bya/ /sgrub thabs mngon rtogs 'di dag ni/ /dngos grub thob phyir bdag gis brtsams/ /'di yis bsod nams gang thob des/ /kun gyi thun mong mchog thob shog /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs so// //bla ma nag po'i zhabs nyid chen po la/ /gser gling rnal 'byor gu ṇa dzñā na yis/ /bram ze karma tsand+ra btang nas kyang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi zhal ngor sbyin sreg 'di/ /dpal mchog rdo rje gdan du rnam par brtsams/ /jeg pa che la nyi ma'i 'od bzhin mdzes/ /rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du byas pa'o// //2(—274

༄ / /yi dwags thams cad rdo rjes bcings pa rmye༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba pre ta badzra pā sha kasnye / bod skad du/ —/yi dwags thams cad rdo rjes bcings pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo / /gshin rje'i slob dpon mi mchog gis/ /bsnyen pa las sngags bstan pa ni/ /sbyor ba sgogs pa 'bum tsho shegacig /mar ngo'i tshes bdun nas brtsams te/ /dgu yi bar du bzlas pa bya/ /gshin rje nyid kyang 'ching 'gyur na / /de las gzhan pa smos ci dgos/ /mtheb sor nyi shu'i tshad can nang / /rgyar bcas gru gsum sor bcu zabs/ /sor gsum kha khyer phyir bskyed pa'i/ /sor gsum rgya dang dpangs su mnyam/ /dur khrod sol bas nang byugs te/ /khrug gis sor gsum gnyis kyang byug /lcags phye thal chen sor re'i tshad/ /rabs chad nag po'i thod pa la/ /nang khrag dug gis byugs nas kyang / /tshangs pa'i bu gar skar 5khung gdong / /gsang khung chen po gcig btod nas/ /24—276

chos 'byung kha sbyor ljang gu la/ /mu khyud rdo rje ra bas bskor/ /sku yi yig 'bru drug bkod la/ /lte bar bsgrub bya ming dang bcas/ /'og tu mnan pa'i rgyab stegs su/ /dur khrod ro yi ras dag la/ /gser gyi sa gzhi dang ldan pa'i/ /ri rab spyog brgyad bkod pa bri/ /de stengs sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan/ /hūṃ ṭwādang lam̐ dang hūṃ 1yig bri/ /re'u mig thag pa bzhis brtod zhel/ /tsha ba rnams dang lcags phye sogasabhya/ /'bru gsum bzlas pa byas la gdab/ /oṃ las chos 'byung dkyil nyid du/ /sprul pa'i khro bos bkug la gzugs/ /sa dang ri rab rdo rje dang / /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed kyis mnan/ /skrag cing gzir cing 'bar bar blta/ /oṃ kā la ru pa ⑤ hūṃ/ oṃ sthāḥskṛḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ thuphaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dri ma ra dri mā ra/ snying ḍi shri ḍi shri/ ya ma khrag tshul ba baṃ/si ri si ri/ ril rda rdu pu/ nag po ti pa ra na shag 8/ snying la thod pa pra shag rna/ badzra tī li tī li ⑦ya/ de nas dur khrod g.yam pa la/ /dri sogs dug gis byugs nas kyang / /rgya gram rdo rje bris pa la/ /dbus su — dang rtse mor dzaḥ bye/ /bkod pas kha dgab mnan par bya/ /thal chen dug gi rgya yang bya/ /hūṃ ⑨lus ngag sems las ⑫skyes pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /da ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mnan pa'i 'khor lo rab sbyor ba/ /rdo rje'i lus ni 'bar ba yis/ /gnas gsum las skyes gnon par byed / /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'jig par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min / /'khor lo rin chen padma dang / /gzhan du yang ni de bzhin brjod/ /rdo rje gom pa'i stabs ldan pas/ /shin tu mnan pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ /sems can las ngan sdig can khyod/ /gtad do gshin rje'i lag tu gtad/ /24—277

bcing ngo rgya mtsho'i gting du bcing / /mnan no ri rab ljid kyis mnan/ /sbyang ngo 'byung ba bzhi la sbyangs/ /sba'o 1 klu rgyal snying la sba/ /'di las 'da' bar ma byed cig /gal te byang chub sems bskyed pade/ /shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /dad pas mgon po mchod srid na/ /nga yis khyed la bden pa bstan/ /mnan pa'i rdo rje spyor chen po/ /rnal 'byor bar chad sel byed pa/ /stobs chen gzhan gyis mi thub nyid/ /mgon po de la phyag 'tshal bstod / /gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa nas phyung ba/slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na tīrti'i —rang 'gyur ro// //5bsdur mchan/276 rtamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smi ra 〉〉༄7/ /yi dwags thamar cad rdo rjes bcings nga/ nag po pas mdzad pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na la'i rang 'gyur dang las gshin 'khor bcas kyi mchod pa'i cho ga brlan a tsaryas mdzad pa je sdang rdo rjes 'gyur bzhugs so// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha sha ha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7bod skad du/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatsho/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rasar/277 rta 2 〈〈co 〉〉hūṃ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastod/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke sa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉rū ba/ 6〈〈co 〉〉hūṃ hūṃ/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 9 〈〈co 〉〉〉/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal/278 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbya nga / /sba yo / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga nga / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṅkarti'i / 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sma ra 〉7ni ru ba ri yu na pa / gsum bcad pa// bla ma bya/ snod yul ba rin bzang / bla ma nam mkha' dpal / ārya de ba/ bla ma rin chen dpal lo//24—278
bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (78 9)24dod279

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i mngon par rtogs pa'-i rim pa/hūṃ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa ya mā zuri a rnyi sa ma ya kra ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gus pas bla ma dang ni gshin rje gshed nag rdo rje ni/ /nyid mtshungs dang 'dus bde bas yongs gang gzhan gyi don 'jug pa/ /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo chu skyes gri gug thod pa phyag na bsnams/ /zhal gsum pa la 'jigs pa sel mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dgra nag po sgrub pa nyid/ /gang zhig 'dod nas de nyid rig /dbang bskur la sogs thob pa dag /de yi bsgom sdepa'i rim pa 'di/ /byis pas bde bar rtogs phyir dang / /mtshungs pa rnams kyis dran phyir dang / /gong ma byis pa'i tshig dag la/ /mgu ba bskyed phyir bri bar bya/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs ldan / /sems can don dga' blo dang ldan/ /byams pa la sogs yon tan 24—280

rdzogs—/ /dad dang thos pas rnam brgyan pas/ /dang por gdong la sogs bkru ba/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid sngon du bya/ /dbeen pa'i gnas su brtsam bya ste//dur khrod la sogs bde gnas la/ /'dug nas snying gar padma dang / /shin tu 'od gsal zla ba blta/ /ya yig sngon po 'od mdzes pa/ /sems can 'byor pa'i don byed blta/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun gang ba'i/ /bla ma dang ni rdzogs sangs bsgom/ /lus kyi bkod pa byas nas ni/ /de rnams dmigs nas phyag kyang bya/ / tsā kā 1sogs kyis mchod pa/ /byas la sdig pa bshags pa'ang bya/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sdig /bkyis dang bgyid du pa ba dang / /gang yang rjes su yi rang ba/ /de ni mgon la dus gsum bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /'phags pa rnams kyis bsags pa yi/ /bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang / /dam pa'i chos dang tshogs mchog bcas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bdag gis lus ni dbul bar bgyi1/ /dam pa'i chos kun ston mdzad pa'i/ /sgra yis mdzes pas khyed bzhugs gsol/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs sras bcas pa'i / /sbyin pa la sogs ngo bo la/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dga' bas gnas par bgyi/ /sems can don phyir yang dag rdzogs/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /dge ba yang dag gang bsags pa/ /byang chub tu ni bsngo bar bgyi/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed gyur nas/ /bdag gis 'gro la phan bgyi'o zhes/ /smon lam de ltar btab nas ni/ /de nas blo yis gshegs su gsol/ /snying rjes cho ga bzhin bltas nas/ /sna tshogs stong par rnam par bsam/ /ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir/ /rgyu nyid 24—281

kyi ni mtshan ma med/ /rnam par rtog pa spangs pa'i phyir/ /smon pa nyid kyang rnam par spangs/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha1haṃ/ sems de brtan par byas nas ni/ /ram̐ las byung ba'i nyi ma la/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i mdog sngon po/ /'od zer 'phro bas kun bskor ba'i/ /rdo rje kun nas rtse lnga pa/ /bsrung ba'i don du bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sa yi dkyil 'khor dang / /ra ba gur yang de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam sbyang phyir/ /yang dag bsgom pa yang brtsam bya/ /de la sna tshogs pad zla bar / /rdo rje bzang po'i lus byung ba'i/ /chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa'i/ /nang du sna tshogs pad rdo rje/ /gyen 'greng mkha' mnyam bsgom par bya/ /de nang du ni dkyil 'khor yang / /rgyu yig 'khor lo las byung ba'i/ /rtag pa'i yan lag las byung ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes par brgyan/ /do shal se mo do yis mdzes/ /ba dan rtse mo sna tshogs la/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bur ldan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 4rnam par mnan/ /zla ba nyi ma rgyal ba'i gdan/ /shar kyi phyogs ni dkar po che/ /lho phyogs ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha rgo dmar po ste/ /byang phyogs margad lta bu'o/ /dbang ldan sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /dbus kyi cha ni bsgom par bya/ /'di bzhin sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /rtsig ngos steng g.yogs kyang bsgom bya/ /rnam pa lnga ni rnam bsgom la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nyid de/ /rnam pa lnga yin gshin rje rnams/ /'jigs byed sangs rgyas gzugs zhes 6grags/ /de yi dbye ba bshad par bya/ /sna tshogs gdan gyi lte ba la/ /padma zla ba dbyangs yig zung / /de nas zla ba ka sogs pa/ /ḍa shwe da dha ya la yang / /bsnan 2(—282

pa gnyis 'gyur las byung ba/ /zla ba dmar po bsgom par bya/ /'di dag yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes brjod/ /de dag gcig gyur mnyam pa nyid/ /der skyes hūṃ ni so sor rtog/bya ba nan tan ldan ye shes/ /de las skyes pa'i rdo rje'o/ /nyi ma'i mdangs ldan nor bu 'dra/ /sa bon dang bcas 'od zer 'khrug /oṃ badzra ātma kolha1haṃ/ zhes bya bas nga rgyal bya'o/ /de las skya rengs dang po'i mdog can thub pa'i tshogs kyis mdzes pa nyid mtshungs kyis 'khyud sku/ /sgeg dang khro bo'i gzugs can bde ba mchog gi rang bzhin dkar dang sngo dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /g.yon brkyang ba yis gnas pa 'bar ba'i ral gri rdo rje gri gug gsor mdzad cing / /'khor lo chu skyes sgod ni 'od zer 'phro ba g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams/ /chos dbyengs ye shes ngo bo rgo/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bdag nyid gang / /rnam pa lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ro/ /'dod chags chen pos 'dul ba yi/ /'gro ba gsum la gzigs nas kyang / /rang snying ye shes 'od 'phro bas2/ /sna tshogs sangs rgyas gzugs su bya / /dga' bde dam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /rang gi lus la mnyam par gzhug /kun rtog thams cad spangs pa yi/ /longs spyod rdzogs par bdag nyid bsgom/ /de ltar sngags mchog yi ge gsum/ /dmar po hoḥ gnyis kyis brten pa/ /ji ltar skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin/ /byang chub sems ni de nas gzhug /snying rje chags pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /rdo rje 'chang nyid rang yang zhu// tsārtsi kā 4sogs byams sogs pas/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo skul bar byed/ /21—283

snying rjes khros pa'i dad sgrol bzhengs/ /khams gsum kun gyi gti mug sol3 / /dad sgrol rtsol med ma bzhugs bzhengs/ /bdud 'di dag las rgyal bar mdzod/ /'jig rten mgon pos stong nyid ci ste bzhugs/ /dad sgrol 'jig rten bsod nams kyis bzhengs shig /byang chub 'dod pa'i 'jig rten mgron bos nas/ /ji ltar stong pa nyid ni sems par byed/ /bskyal bye nas khu ba der thim par/ /de la rjes su chags par gyur/ /de lta'i 1glu yi ngo nyid du/ /de la rgud pa ltar bsams nas/ /khu ba'i gzugs ni yongs gyur te/ /yi sngon nyi ma las byung ba//khro bo sngon po 'phro bar bcas/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rwa rnon 'bar zhing spu ser skya/ /rmig pas brko zhing 'jigs sbyin pa'i/ /ma he yi ni rgyab gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje sngon po 'od dang bcas/ /sa bon bcas pa de'i 'od kyis/ /ma 'ongs las dgra 'jigs byas nas/ /bdag nyid la ni yang dag zhugs/ /'jigs pa chen po'ang 'jigs byed pa/ /ma te'i rdo rje rnam bsgoms nas/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo bsgom par bya/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdud dkyil 'khor/ /'od zer drag po spros pas sgod/ /drag po mun 'dra gzugs drag po/ /lce 'dril ba la 'od 'byin pa/ /sma ra smin ma mgo skyes ser/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pa yis/ /gshin rje dran pa med par byed/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /g.yas pa zla ba'i 'od 'dra ba/ /g.yon pa khrag dang 'dra bar bshad/ /rdo rje ④rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang la sbom/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas nyarnam par 'phyang / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi rngo 7 phyag dag la/ /thod pa dang ni gri gug bsnams/ /nyid mtshungs shes rab kyis 'khyud cing / /bde bar snyoms klu'ajug gzhan don 24—284

'dod / /g.yas pa'i phyag ni lhag ma la/ /rdo rje ral gri 'bar ba bsnams/'khor lo chu skyes g.yon dag la/ /sbrul gyi dbang pos rgyan 1du byas/ /sbrul rgyan sngon po dga' bo yis/ /skra bcings shin tu 'jigs par byed/ /takṣa ka klu dmar po yis/ /rna cha gdub kor byas pas 'jigs/ /rigs ldan khra bo dpung rgyan te/ /dung skyong zhes bya'i klu de ni/ /ser po lag pa'i gdu bu byas / /padma dkar pos do shal byas/ /karko ṭa ni ljang gu ste/ /se ral kha ru byas pas mdzes/ /bdud rtsi'i mdog dang 'dra ba yi/ /nor rgyas bus ni ska rags byas/ /padma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar mdog /padma chen po rkang gdub yin/ /kun kyang phuṭa sgra drag po sgrogs/ /lce gnyis mche ba'i phreng ba can/ /de ltar 'khor ba mya ngan 'das/ /gshin rje 'dul ba'i gzugs su shes/ /rnam par rtog pa spang ba'i phyir/ /sngags kyis yang dag byin gyis brlabs/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba a kolha4haṃ/ zhes bya ba ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /rang snying sa bon 'od kyis bkug /yang dag rdzogs sangs mkha' khyab pa//kun du kha nas gzhug par bya/ /bde ba myong bas snying gar bzhu5/ /byas nas blo ldan khu ba de/ /rdo rje'i 6lam nas spro bar bya/ /nyid mtshungs padma'i nang du gnas/ /sa bon ngo bo ldan byas te/ /sa bon las byung 'khor lo mchog /sa bon kun gyi byin rlabs la/ /me stag tshogs kyis gsal gyur pa/ /blo ldan cho ga bzhin du bsgom/ /dkyil du yi sngon las byung ba/ /bstan pa'i mtshan ldan 'khor lo can/ /shar du kṣe dang 'khor los byung / /rtag pa phyag drug dkar po'o / /g.yas na 'khor lo ral gri phyag /g.yon na rin chen chu skyes 'dzin/ /24—285

lho ru ma dang rin chen las/ /byung ba rin chen 'byung ldan te/ /btso hūṃm gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /g.yas na 2rin chen ral gri bsnams/ /phyag g.yon 'khor lo chu skyes so/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje can/ /me dang padma las byung ba/ /padma rā ga 'dra ba'i mdog /padma ral gri rin chen dang / /'khor lo g.yas g.yon phyag na dgod/ /da dang ral gri las byung ba/ /ljang gu phrag dog gshin rje gshed/ /g.yas na ral gri 'khor lo bsnams/ /mdzes pa nor bu padma g.yon/ /khro bo'i gzugs can thams cad kyang / /zhe sdang gshin rje mtshan nyid 'dra/ /de dag rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis pabye sna/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa bsam/ /rang gi shes rab lus dag dang / /bde ba'i ngo bor gnyis med gyur/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam par gnon/ /rtag pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje rtsibs kyi rtsar thuganas pa/ /sems can don mdzad bsgom par bya/ /shar sgor ya dang tho ba las/ /byung ba sngon po'i gzugs can te/ /g.yas na tho ba ral gri 'dzin/ /nor bu mchog dang padma g.yon/ /tho ba zhe sdang gshin gshed 'dra/ /rtsi sgodang dbyug pa las byung lhor/ /dbyug pa gshin gshed mdog dkar po'o/ /dbyug pa ral gri pad 'khor lo/ /nub tu padma gshin rje gshed/ /ṇi las 'dod chags mthar byed 'dra/ /byang du ral gri gshin rje gshed/ /ra las phrag dog mthar byed mtshungs/ /chu skyes sngon po'i khyad par kyis/ /bsgyur ba lta chung la 'jigs byen/ /kun kyang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rnam 'jigs khudagod pas 'jigs byed pa/ /skra ni 'bar zhing gyen du 'greng / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /mche ba gcigs shing 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin par mdzad/ /sna tshogs rdo 24—286

rje'i mtshams bzhi ru/ /de bzhin lha mo zla bar gnas/ /shar lhor dza dang 'khor lo las/ /lha mo rdo rje tsārtsi kā nyusna/ /skem mo dkar mo cher khro ba/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed dang mtshungs/ /lho nub mtshams su sa dang ni/ /rdo rje las byung rdo rje phag /khro zhing phag gi gdong pa can/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dang mtshungs/ /nub dang byang gi mtshams su ni/ /rab tu zhi ba'i dbyangs can ma/ /do las byung ba rab tu dmar/ /'dod chags gshin rje gshed dang mtshungs/ /byang shar mtshams su ru las ni/ /go rī ljang gu 'jigs byed ma/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed dang mtshungs/ /sngon po'i g.yas pa dkar po ste/ /dkar po'i g.yas pa sngon po yin/ /de dag zhal g.yon dmar po'o/ /gzhan gye sngo dang dkar ba'o/ /mtshams bzhin sgo /ṇa yo ni rā las/ /dkyil 'khor mtshams su thod pa'o/ /ji ltar rang rang sngags bstan pa/ /bskyed la blo ldan gyis spro bya/ /byāḥbyeḥl sogs sngags sgra yis/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po bskul bar bya/ /sprul pa dpag med spros byas la/ /sems can don ni mchog byas nas/ /rnam pa kun gyis rang lus la/ /khro bo dpa' bo gzhug par bya/ /shar du dzi na dzika ces pas/ /rmongs pas rmongs pa mthar byed pa/ /rtsibs rtsa'i sna tshogs padma dang / /zla ba la ni de bzhin bzhag /ratna j-ika ces bya ba yis/ /lho rtsibs rtsa bar pad nyi la/ /phra ma zhes bya bkug nas ni/ /cho ga bzhin du gzhag par bya/ /ā ro '-ika 5ces pa sngags kyis/ /'dod chags gshin rje 'jigs byed la/ /nub tu padma nyi ma la/ /cho ga yis ni rnam par bsam/ /de nyid pradzñā dhrika ces pas/ /phrag dog nag po 'jigs byed pa/ /byang du padma 'od rno la/ /cho ga bzhin du gzhag 7par bya/ /24—287

muṅga ra j-ika de nyid kyis/ /shar sgo padma nyi ma la/ /tho ba mthar byed 'jigs byed pa/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bsam/ /daṇḍa j-ika 1gi sngags kyis ni/ /lho yi phyogs sgor gnas pa yi/ /dbyug pa gdul dka' gshin rje'i dgra/ /sna tshogs padma nyi mar dgod/ /padma byeka ces bya ba 'dis/ /padma gshin rje gcod byed pa/ /nub sgor padma nyi ma la/ /stobs chen khro bo bsgom par bya/ /khaṅga dhrika /gi de nyid kyis/ /ral gri gshin rje zad byed pa/ /byang du padma nyi ma la/ /bdud tshar gcod pa bsam par bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshams bzhi ru / /'di ltar lha mo mchog bzhi bsgom/ /shar lho mtshams kyi ༄ lha mo ni/ /skem mo khro la 'od bzang ma/ /mo ha ra ti'i sngags kyis ni/ /sna tshogs padma zla bar gnas/ /de yi nub tu rigs mchog ma/ /rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba/ /dwo ṣa ra ti'i sngags kyis ni/ /padma zla bar mkhas pas dgod/ /de yi byang gi mtshams su ni/ /rā ga ra ti'i gsang sngags kyis/ /padma zla bar dbyangs can dgod / /de yi shar du go rī ma/ /pad zlar badzra ra ti yis/ /phyag 'tshal bas ni 'di dag brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor phyi yi mtshams bzhi ru/ /de nyid gsum kyi thod pa ste/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor dam pa spro/ /bde ba dang bcas bstan par bya/ /'khor lo snga ma der thim par/ /mnyam par bzhag 4pas blta bar bya/ /'di ni shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /nag po gshin rje 'jigs byed kyi/ /dkyil 'khor pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /lus dang mig sogs lha rnams kyis/ /mngon par byin gyis brlab par bya/ /'khor lo kṣiṃ 5las gti mug mtshungs/ /cung zhig khro ba mig la ste/ /rdo rje 24—288

mig ni 3mkhas pas bsgom/ /rna bar dzre las 2rdo rje las/ /nag po rdo rje dang mtshungs pa/ /sna la khaṃ dang rin chen las/ /phra ma dang mtshungs zla ba la//lce la gi dang padma las/ /padma ri bong can la bsam/ /'dod chags dang mtshungs rka ral gri/ /padma ri bong can bzhugs sku/ /rdo rje phrag dog gshin gshed mtshungs / /lus zhes 4bya ba dpral ba la'o/ /saṃ dang rdo rjes lte ba'i steng / /rdo rje 'chang 'dra rdo rje'i thugs/ /sgeg dang khro ba'i gzugs can no/ /yan lag drug la dgod pa 'di/ /mngon shes don ni sgrub phyir bshad/ /snying gar hūṃ dang rdo rje las/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i thugs rdo rje/ /mdog dang mtshon char yang dag ldan/ /mgrin par sdza5dang padma las/ /'dod chags gshin rje gshed 'dra ba/ /ngag gi rdo rje bsam par bya/ /mgo bor oṃ dang 'khor lo las/ /sku yi 'khor lo 'dra ba lus/ /phyag dang sku mdog mtshon chas ldan/ /rdo rje sku mchog de nyid gsum/ /bskyed la nam mkha'i dkyil gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mchog la sngags kyis ni/ /byin gyis brlab pa dag kyang bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha6haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha7haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha haṃ / rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bzhugs sangs rgyas sras dang bcas/ /bkug nas mdun du blta 9bar bya/ /de dag las ni spros pa yi/ /zla 'dra tsārtsi kā 7sogs kyis/ /bzung ba'i bum pa dag gis ni/ /de dag bkra shis glu la sogs/ /dar dir dbyangs kyang yang byas la/ /bdag nyid dam ni gzhan dag kyang / /dbang bskur ba ni bsam par bya/ /gshin rje gshed nag mgo la'o/ /bdag nyid mgo la rdo rje 'chang / /rang snying sa 24—289

bon 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ /rang gi mdun du blta bar bya/ /khro bos bgegs rnams tshar bcad bsrung / /yon chab zhabs bsil sogs phul la/ /oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥ'i sngags kyis dgug /oṃ daṇḍa hūṃ zhes bya bas gzhug /oṃ padma baṃ zhes bya bas bcing / /oṃ khaṅga hoḥzhes bya bas mnyes par bya'o/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun bkug lku zhal du gzhug /snying gar zhu bar byas par blta/ /rdo rje'i rmyelam nas rjes byung nas—/ /rang gi rig pa'i dbang dkyil du/ /zla ba las byung lha mo'i tshogs/ /me tog phreng ba sna tshogs sogs/ /lag pa'i snod du gzung 5byas pa/ /de dag sgeg dang bcas pas mchod/ /mchod pa'i glu ni yid 'phrog pa/ /bsgyur ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bde ba chen po gsal bar byed/ /a kye kye gshin rje gshed nag po/ /srin po'i gzugs can rang bzhin khyod/ /bdag gis mthong na shin tu 'jigs/ /khros pa'i rang bzhin 'di thong mdzod/ /mi dang sa 'og rgya mtshor bcas/ /khyod kyi gar gyis g.yos par mdzod/ /añdza nag po bcag 'dra ba'i/ /khro bos ro langs bzhin gar mdzod/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul cing / /mdangs gnag tshad ni thung ba la/ /bde chen ngo bos gar mdzod ces/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma gsol 'debs/ /sthāḥbyeḥsngags dang gar gyis khyod/ /srid pa gsum gyi 'khrul pa gcod/ /snying rje khros nas gar mdzad pa/ /'gro bas mthong na ngo mtshar gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha7haṃ/ sgra yi tshogs rnams thams cad ni/ /brag ca 'dra bar blta byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor pas ni gtso bo bstod/ /des kyang de dag de bzhin no/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod//24—290

ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sgu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyung bar bsams la/ oṃ badzra tī la ya badzra muṅga ra ā snye1ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod do/ /oṃ badzra uta tī grul ya zhes bya ba'i sngags dang phur bu phyung bar bsams pas/ phyogs skyong ba thams cad gshin rje gshed du gyur par bsams te/ de rnams la oṃ ibye 4ya byāḥ ya mā yaṣṭi 5ཿba ru rja ya wi/ ku bee rā ya kṛ/ yī 6sha nā ya ta/ agha ye ā/ nai rje tā 7ya na/ bā ya be ya na/tsand+ra ya hūṃ aryā ya hūṃ/ bradma shā ya phaṭa/ ba su dha ra ye phaṭa/ be ma tsi tā ya swā / sarba khyu te bhyo hā9/ hā hā hā tī tī tī hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phe phe phe swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis gtor ma phul nas/ khyed kyis bdag gi smon lam thams cad grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig ces brjod la/ sarba de bā di muḥ zhes brjod pas / 'byung po thams cad slar btang bar bsam mo/ /de nas bdag bi dge ba 'dis bdag myur du 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed khro bo chen por gyur cig ces smon lam btab la/ sngar bskyed pa'i gnas la sogs pa je chung 'dus nas bdag nyid kyi bar du mi snang bar bsam 1 pa gshegs pa chen po zhes bya ste/ oṃ mañdzu shrī sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ mañdzu shrī two no pa tiṣṭha dṛ 11rnyo me bha ba/ su tostso pome bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ su postso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyimbi pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsiṭwāṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān2/sarba ta thā ga ta/ badzra mā me muñtsa/ badzre bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥzhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gyi yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom pa dang / bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa byas te/ ji lta ba bzhin pa'i las kyi cho ga byas pas ni/ zhi ba la sogs pa dngos grub bcu po gang yang rung ba 24—291

'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phal cher 1zla gsang nag rgyud la brten nas/ /khro chen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po yi/ /sgrub thabs ji bzhin byas pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /'gro kun myur du gshin rje gshed gyur cig /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed khro bo chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal rdo rje'i blos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bldur mchan/28༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉g.yo/ /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa slob dpon dpal rdo rje'i blos mdzad pa bzhugs so / / 2〈〈snar 〉rnam/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 sdom/281 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar tsi ka 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thagyis/282 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbye/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mches 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamar kata/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shes/283 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 2〈〈snar 〉toraphros pas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar tsi ka284 1〈〈snar 〉sngagasol/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabaskul/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 6〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'joms/285 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thargyan/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyal/ 〈〈snar 〉thargyan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipho/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉gzhu—/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 7〈〈pe 〉ra rlabs/ 〈〈snar 〉ra rlab/286 1〈〈snar 〉sngagatso/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gin/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtso/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jig287 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar tsi ka 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga 'ir/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sgrika 4〈〈snar 〉snga zhag 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ka 〈〈snar 〉〉dhrika 7〈〈snar 〉snga zhag288 1 〈〈snar 〉〉drika 〈〈snar 〉lo / 〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag 5〈〈snar 〉〉kṣi/289 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag dang / 〈〈snar 〉mtshangs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shes/ 5〈〈bee 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 678〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipho/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar tsi ka24dod292
