༄/ /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga bzhugs/1༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam chos sku zhi ba nyid/ /gang 'dir khams gsum rnam rgyal te/ /gshin rje'i sgra zhes grags pa yi/ /'khor lo bskor ba'i cho ga bshad/ /yon tan ldan pa'i sngags pa ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bsnyen pa yis/ /dur khrod dben pa la sogs par/ /maṇḍal khru do'i tshad du bya/ /dri dang ba yi rnam lnga dang / /nyi zla sogs par byi dor bya/ /ba lang sha sogs dam rdzas lnga/ /gzhan yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /phyi nang mchod pa'i bye brag gis/ /legs par mchod pa byas nas ni/ /'khor lo bri dang btu ba dang / /drang dang bsre dang spo ba bsam / /sngags pa rnal 'byor ldan pa yis4/ /lho yi phyogs su kha bltas te/ /dam tshig rjes su dran pa yis/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūṃ/ gsang sngags 'di ni dran byed cing / /'khor lo bri ba brtsam par bya/ /dbus nas sor tshad bcu 24dod294

drug par/ /kun du zlum por bskor ba ni/ /'di yi nang gi 'khor lo ste/ /rim pa gsum du bskor ba la nya/ /sgo med lcags mkhar bcu drug bya/ /'di ni gshin rje'i grong khyer te/ /srid pa gsum gyi 'jug sa yin/ /de yi phyi rim mu khyud gsum/ /kun du lcags ris bskor ba ste/ /mu khyud de dag re re yang / /khang pa bcu drug dag dang ldan/ /'go ba'i chos bzhin gcod 2 pa yi/ /'khor lo 'di dag sdebris nas ni/ /phyi rol mu khyud tha ma la/ /yi ge ka sogs da yig mtha'/ /nga nya bsal nas dgod par bya/ /yi ge dha sogs kṣa yig mtha' / /de yi rjes su bri bar bya/ /mu khyud dbus 7ma de la ni/ /dbyangs yig bcu drug nyis 'gyur dgod/ /btu dang dgod sogs brtsam glupa na/ /mtshan ma 'di dag shes par bya/ /zla ba mig dang yon tan dang / /rig byed mda' 5dang dbang po dang / /rgya mtsho bkra shis gza' dang phyogs/ /grags pa nyi ma yan lag sa/ /tshes zhes bya bar rab tu grags/ /phyi rol mu khyud tha ma la/ /shar gyi tshangs thig nas brtsams te/ /rim min gza' can khang pa nas / /yi ge bkra shis can blangs te/ /nang gi ngos kyi mu khyud kyi/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi ngos dag la/ /phyogs bzhir mig gi tshad du sbyin/ /rim min phyogs can khang pa nas/ /yi ge mig gi tshad blangs te/ /shar du de yi g.yas g.yon gzhag3 /rim min bkra shis khang pa nas/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa can blangs nas/ /mig gi tshad du byas nas ni/ /de yi ngos la re re gzhag /shar gyi tshangs thig nas bgrangs pa'i/ /rgya mtsho can gyi khang pa nas//dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa dang ldan/ /mig gi tshad du blangs nas ni/ /lho yi ngos la de bzhin sbyin/ /shar nas rim pa bzhin pa yi/ /zla ba can gyi khyem 24—295

nas ni/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa dang ldan/ /lho ru de yi rjes sbyin bya/ /dha nyid dbyangs yig gsal ba ni/ /mig gi 1tshad du blangs byas la/ /sngon bzhin nub kyi phyogs su sbyin/ /shar nas bkra shis khang pa nas/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa dang ldan/ /mig gi tshad du blangs nas ni/ /nub kyi ngos su de bzhin sbyin/ /shar brtsams tshes can khang pa nas/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig dang ldan pa/ /mig gi tshad du blangs nas ni/ /byang gi ngos su de bzhin sbyin/ /rlung gi sa bon zhes bya ba/ /mig gi tshad blangs de rjes sbyin/ /mda' can khang pa na gnas pa/ /'od kyi gong bur byas pa dang / /de nyid nas ni bgrangs pa yi/ /gza' can khang pa la gnas pa/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa ldan pa dag /zla ba'i tshad du blangs nas ni/ /byang shar mtshams su re re sbyin/ /rgya mtsho'i khang pa na gnas pa/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan pa/ /rim min yon tan khang pa nas/ /zla ba'i tshad du bzung nas ni/ /shar lho mtshams su de bzhin sbyin/ /rim min bkra shis khang pa nas/ /dbyangs yig lnga pa ldan pa dang / /yan lag can kyi khang pa nas/ /zla ba'i tshad du blangs nas ni/ /lho nub mtshams su de bzhin sbyin/ /rim min tshes can khang pa nas/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa ldan pa dang / /rim min bkra shis khang pa nas/ /zla ba'i tshad du blangs nas ni/ /nub byang mtshams su de bzhin sbyin/ /de ltar dgod pa byas nas ni/ /de nas drang ba brtsam par bya/ /dam tshig rjes su dran byed cing / /rdo rje shugs dang ldan pa yis/ /shar gyi tshangs thig ngos gnyis nas/ /yi ge zung ldan drangs nas ni/ /dbus kyi khang par gzhag par bya/ /phyogs gzhan tshangs thig ngos dag nas/ /de bzhin 24—296

zung ldan drangs nas ni/ /de bzhin dbus kyi khang par gzhag1 /de nas shar gyi yi ge yang / /zung ldan gnyis pa drangs nas ni/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i khang par gzhag2 /phyogs gzhan du yang de bzhin no/ /shar gyi zung ldan gsum pa yang / /rim pa gsum pa'i khang par drangs/ /phyogs gzhan du yang de bzhin no/ /mtshams kyi yi ge ya bral ni/ /rang rang nang ni mtshams su drang / /de dag byung ba khang stong du/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge drang bar bya/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge'i gzhi la ni/ /ming gi yi ge drang bar bya/ / ming gi yi ge'i / gzhi la ni/ /so so'i las dang mthun pa yi/ /bskul ba'i yi ge dgod par bya / /bsad jidang bskrad dang dbye ba la/ /yi ge phaṭa ni gzhag par bya/ /mnan pa la ni yi ge lo/ /zhi ba la ni yi ge oṃ/ /rgyas pa la ni yi ge swā5/ /dbang la hoḥyis brgyan pa ste/ /dgug pa la ni yi ge dzaḥ/ /de la las kyi 'od zer ni/ /zhi la chu ste rgyas la sa/ /dbang gi me ste drag po'i rlung / /dbye dgug bskrad pa drag dang mthun/ /mnan pa dag gi rgyas pa bzhin/ /drang ba'i spyor ba byas nas ni/ /bsre ba'i spyor ba brtsam par bya/ /gnyis med sngags dang ldan pa yis/ /dbus kyi yi ge bkra shis la'ang / /zla ltar 'od kyi gong bur bya/ /'od kyi gong bu de'i nang du/ /'dod pa'i bsgrub bya gzhag par bya/ /de dkyil rang min dang por gzhag6 /phyogs kyi khyem na gnas pa yi / /yi ge zur ma thams cad kyang / /de tshe 'od kyi gong bur bya/ /sngags kyi rgyal po bcu pa yang / /bcu drug khyem du spel te bri/ /byin rlob hūṃ zhes bya ba yang / /khang pa bzhi la zur rer mdzes/ /yongs su dag par 7bkod byas te / /mchod dang gtor ma byas nas ni/ /spro ba dag ni brtsam par bya/ /24—297

las kyi dbye ba ji lta bar/ /'khor lo'i ras ni blang bya ste/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa la/ /shin tu dge ba'i ras las rmyebya/ /dbang dgug thusmad 'tshong smad dkris sogs/ /bsad dang dbye dang bskrad pa dang / /mnan pa la ni dur khrod ras/ /gi waṃ gur kum zhi rgyas la/ /dbang dang dgug la tsandan dmar / /mnan pa la ni ldong ros sogs/ /bskrad la bya rog khrag gis te/ /dbye la rta dang ma te sogs/ /bsad la dug la sogs pa bri/ /dge ba'i las la shing bzang po/ /dge ba min la rus pa dang / /lcags la sogs pas bri bar bya—/ /zhi la shar blta dbang la nub/ /rgyas pa byang ste drag po lho/ /gzhan yang ci rigs par sbyar bya/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa la/ /sa skor rim bzhin bkod byas te/ /gnam skor dag ni rim las bzlog /bsad bskrad dbye dang mnan pa la/ /sa skor rim la zibazlog pa ste/ /gnam skor dag ni rim bzhin bri/ /'di ltar legs par ma bris na/ /'khor lo rang la bzlog par 'gyur/ /de bas 'bad de nan tan bya/ /ras kyi 'khor lo legs zin nas—/ /maṇḍal la gnas 'khor lo de/ /ras kyi 'khor lor spyan drangs te/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /maṇḍal 'khor lo bsdu bar bya/ /ras kyi 'khor lo mchod nas ni/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs phyedamigs par bya/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /'khor lo sba ba byas nas ni/ /gsang sngags bzlog pa brtsam par bya/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya ste/ dam tshig gi sngags so/ /oṃ badzra be ga rdo rje shugs kyi sngags so/ /oṃ a sa me tri 6ma hā sa ma ye swā hā/yi ge bsre ba'i sngags so/ /o badzra sa ma na dzaḥ—dzā/ 'khor lo spo ba'i sngags so//oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra yakṣe ya/24—298

yakṣe hūṃyatstsha ni rā ma ya phaṭa phaṭa/ 'di ni rtsa ba'i gsang 2sngags te/ las thams cad pa'o/ /oṃ byāḥ 1ཿwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'di ni las kyi sngags te las thams cad pa'o/ /shādhi 4ku ru swā hā/ zhi bar bskul 5 ba'o / /puṣṭi ku ru swā hā/ rgyas par ro/ /ba shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ dbang gi'o/ /mā ra ya phaṭa gsad pa'i'o/ /bi dre ṣa ya phaṭa dbye ba'i'o/ /utstsha ta 7ya phaṭa/bskrad pa'i'o/ /ste bha ya hūṃ lo mnan pa'i'o/ /ā kasgo ya hūṃ dzaḥdagug pa'i'o/ /oṃ muḥslar dgrol ba'i'o/ /ā li kā li'i grong khyer ni/ /gsang sngags 'byung ba brtsam pa ste/ /las kyi btson 8/ra dag kyang yin/ /yi ge btu ba med na ni//gsang sngags sgra ni log par 'gyur/ /yi ge tshang bar ma bkod na/ /gsang sngags sgra ni nyams par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags brda yis ma bstan na/ /sngags pa'i dngos grub med par 'gyur/ /drang ba dag ni ma byas na/ /shin tu 'khor bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yi ge bsre ba ma byas na/ /khang pa bcu drug don med 'gyur/ /bskor phyogs log na don mi 'grub/ /rig sngags nyams dang log pa ni/ /lha min g.yul las pham pa dang / /dbang po'i dgra bo bsad pa bzhin / /'khor lo spo ba ma byas na/ /cho ga dag ni nyams par 'gyur/ /rgyu yin pa dang sbyor ba dang / /dad pa bstan 9pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan bskyed de bya/ /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //24—299

bsdur mchan/294 (13mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagra/ du〈〈pe 〉to/nas/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/295 77〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ 〈〈〈snar 〉〉spyod/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ltar/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanabu/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsom/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanama'/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag296 spyi〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 37〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/297 ①sti〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag du〈〈pe 〉〉mig gi yi ge'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉mig gi ye'i/ tshobya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasad/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ming dang por bzhag ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/298 )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ khya〈〈snar 〉stanagu/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasad/ rgya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sa me/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pardzo/299 7 〈〈snar 〉〉pa tī/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi gsang / snyu〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉(ཿli kri/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khrin ti/rgya〈〈snar 〉〉skul/ khya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsad/ tsho2〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skab/ khya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉brtson/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (791)24wa 300

༄/ /gshin rje dgra nag po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs shesna༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṇḍa snyeya mā ri nā gum sā dha nahūṃ/ bod skad du/ gshin rje dgra nag bo zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal zhe sdang gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma la gus phyag 'tshal nas/ /de rjes gshin dgra nag rdor la/ /rang 'od yan lag bzhugs pa yi/ /bde bas gang bas gzhan don mdzad/ /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo dang / /'dam skyes gri gug phyag pad 7lta'adzin/ /zhal gsum 'jigs pa yang 'jigs mdzad/ /de la phyag 'tshal sgrub thabs bri/ /gshin dgra nag po'i 6sgrub thabs 'di/ /de nyid blo ldan 'dod pa yis skye/ /dbang sogs la ni thob pa gang / /de yi 'di ni bsgom rim mo/ /byis pa rnams kyis go bde dang / /rang dran don du byas pa yin / /mchog rnams la ni 'grub par gsungs/ /rab 8dga' bas ni bri bar bya/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs ldan/ /blo legs 'gro don ro 124—301

gcig pa/ /byams sogs yon tan yang dag ldan/ /dad ldan thos pas brgyan pa yi/ /thog mar gdong sogs dag byas nas/ /snga dro gshin rje bdag nyid pas/ /dngen yul la ni rab tu brtsam/ /dur khrod la sogs bde stan 1bzhugs / /rang snying padma'i zla ba la/ /ya yig rnam pa 'od ldan dmigs/ /kha dog sngon po 'gro don byed/ /bla ma dang ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ma lus nam mkha'i 'od gang bar/ /bsgom zhing de ni legs dmigs te/ /sku tshogs de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /tsārtsi 2la sogs mchod byas te/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig byas gang / /byas shing de bzhin yi rang ba/ /mgon la lan gsum smras shing bshags / /'phags pa rdzogs sangs rgyas sras dang / /'dul ba'i bsod nams rjes yi rang / /yang dag sangs rgyas bdag skyabs mchi/ /dag pa'i chos dang mchog dge 'dun/ /khyod la bdag gi 4lus sbyin te/ /yon tan rgya mtsho la yang 'bul/ /chos ni thams cad gnas pa yin/ /legs pa'i sgras ni bstan pa'o/ /rdzogs pa yi ni sangs rgyas sku/ /de lam sbyin pa la sogs bzhugs/ /sku gsum 5ye shes thob don du/ /gnang bas bdag gis gnas pa ste/ /sems can don ni byed pa'i phyir/ /yang dag byang chub sems bskyed bya'o/ /bdag gis bsod nams byas pa gang / /yang dag sangs rgyas la bsngos te/ /dpal ldan gshin rje dgrar gyur nas/ /bdag gis 'gro ba'i don byed shog /smon lam mchog 'di byas nas ni/ /blo ldan de rnams gshegs su gsol/ /snying rje'i rim pa mthong nas ni/ /sna tshogs stong par rnam dmigs na/ /rgyu ni mi rtog pa yin te/ /rang bzhin rnam par bral ba'o/ /rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir/ /smon lam de ni rnam gshegs bya'o/ /oṃ shu 24—302

n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha1haṃ/ sems de nyid ni dag byas nas/ /a las byung ba'i nyi dkyil te/ /de la hūṃ skyes kha dog sngo/ /'od zer 'phros pas kun du khyab/ /bsrung ba'i don du rdo rje bsgom/ /kun du rtse ni lnga yin te/ /rdo rje sa gzhi de las byung / /de bzhin gur dang ra ba'o/ /sangs rgyas zhing dag don du ni/ /yang dag bsam gtan kun brtsams te4/ /de la sna tshogs pad zla la/ /rtag rdor yan lag las byung ngo / /dkar po gru gsum chos dbyings te/ /dbus su sna pad rdo rje'i gdan/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam 'greng ba bsam/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gnas pa'o/ /rja 5rnams 'khor lo ste 6dbus skyes/ /dag pa'i yan lag las byung ste/ /zur bzhi dang ni sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni brgyan pa'o/ /dra ba dra phyed kyis ni spras/ /mchod rnams lha mo yang dag brgyan/ /sna tshogs rtse mo rlung gis 'phyar/ /ba dan dang ni dril bu ldan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje kun du mnan/ /zla ba nyi ma rgyal ba'i stan/ /shar du dkar po chen po ste/ /lho ru ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar bo yin/ /byang du ljang gu'i kha dog go/ /ind+ra nī la'i 'od dang ldan/ /dbus kyi sa ni rnam bsgoms te/ /'di ltar phyogs kyi dbye ba yis//sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom bya'o/ /bris sku la yang de bzhin bsgom/ /rab tu gzugs kyi rim ji bzhin/ /rnam lnga bsam par byas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rnam bsgom mo/ /rnam lnga de ni dpal dang ldan/ /de rjes gang bar bdud sel byed/ /de ni sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan grags/ /de phyir de la de gsungs so/ /lte bar sna tshogs pad zla la/ /dbyangs yig nyis skor dgod par bya/ /de yis zla ba rdzogs pa ste/ /ka yi thog mar nyis skor bya/ /21—303

ḍa shwe da dha ya la drug1 /bsnan pas de rnams rdzogs pa yis/ /zla ba dmar po rnam bsgom bya/ /de gnyis rdzogs la ji skad gsungs/ /me long mnyam pa nyid du brjod/ /de dbus hūṃ skyes so sor rtog /de las gyur pa rdo rje ste/ /de ni bya ba nan tan brjod/ /nyi ma'i nor bu 'od zer mtshungs/ /'od dang sa bon lan rdo rje/ /oṃ badzra ātma kolhaṭwāhaṃ/ zhes bya bas nga rgyal bya'o/ /de la skyes pa kha dog dkar/ /thub pa'i mchog gis rab brgyan pa/ /rang 'od kyis lus 'khyud pa ste/ /sgeg pa khro bo'i gzugs can no1/ /mchog gi bde ba dang ldan pa/ /dkar po sngon po dmar po'i zhal/ /g.yas bskum chegayon brkyang bar gnas pa/ /'bar ba dang ldan ral gri dang / /rdo rje gri gug gsor bar byed/ /'khor lo'i padma skal ldan pa/ /g.yas pa'i g.yon du shin tu yang / /'od zer 'phro zhing phyag gis 'dzin/ /oṃ dharma dhwa tu dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ā kolha ltahaṃ/ zhes bya bas rnam pa lnga'i rang bzhin las/ rnal 'byor 'di ni yod pa ste/ /'di rnal 'byor ro/ /chags pa che bas 'dul ba yis⑪/ /'gro ba gsum ni kun du dmigs/ /rang gi rnam shes 'od zer gyis/ /sna tshogs spros pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rtag bde dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /de rnams rang gi lus la zhugs0 / /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs bya 5/ /bdag nyid longs spyod rdzogs par bsgom/ /'di ni de nyid sngags rtse dmar/ /hoḥspuganyis kyis ni spel ba ste/ /ji ltar skar ma 'pho ba bzhin/ /byang chub sems ni de bzhin gzhug /snying rje pya chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rdor 'dzin nyid du 'od du zhu/ /byams pa la 24—304

sogs tsartsi kāsazi1// /'khor lo'i bdag po skul byed do/ /snying rje'i khro bo rje btsun bzhengs/ /gnas gsum kun gyi gti mug spongs/ /bdud rnams bzhi las gtso bo rgyal/ /kye 'khrugs pa'i sems kyis rje btsun bzhengs/ /'jig rten mgron gnyer stong par bzhugs/ /'jig rten bsod nams rje btsun bzhengs / /kye stong par bsams 1nas ci ste bzhugs/ /byang chub rang bzhin 'jig rten mgron/ /'dis ni zhu ba bsgul ba ste/ /chags pa'i rjes chags thim pa'o/ /'di yi glu yi mngon pa yis/ /'od du zhu ba'i bde sems ni / /rab tu zhu zhing zhu la skyes/ /nyi dkyil la ni ya sngon te/ /khro bo dang ni khros pa can/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis yang dag brgyan/ /smin ma rnon po 'bar ba can/ /yan lag spu gri bzhin 'jigs sbyin/ /rdo rje sngon po 'od dang ldan/ /ma he'i 4rgyab tu gnas pa'o/ /de yi sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /nag po dgra yi gzugs byas nas/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par byed / /sna tshogs bdag nyid mnyam par bzhugs/ /ma te'i 5rdo rje bsams nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po rnam par bsgoms/ /dug bzhin tsha ba 'phros pa ni/ /'jig rten gsum zad dkyil 'khor ni/ /mun nag lus ni drag shul can/ /ljags 'dril rab tu 'od zer 'phro/ /mche ba 'od zer 'phro zhing zhal/ /smin ma sma ra skra gyen te/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis gnas / /dus ni mi dran byed pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni bung ba che/ /g.yas pa shin tu zla ba 'od/ /g.yon pa dmar po rab tu gsungs/ /rdo rje rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /mi thung gsus chen nag po yin/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byed / /g.yas g.yon dang po'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /bharnya 6dang ni gri gug 24—305

'dzin / /rang 'od shes rab yang dag spyor/ /bde ba 'bab byung gzhan don byed/ /lhag ma g.yas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /'bar bzhin rdo rje ral gri 'dzin / /g.yon pa gnyis kyi phyag gis ni/ /padma dang ni 'khor lo 'dzin/ /sbrul gyi rgyal pos rgyan 1byed pa/ /sngon po grangs med sbrul rgyan —gyis/ /shin tu 'jigs byed dbu skra bcings/ /dmar po 'jog po glu yis ni/ /stobs chen rna cha'i rna rgyan byed/ /rigs ldan ser pos dpung rgyan jite/ /ser po yang ni phyag gdub 'dzin/ /klu rgyal dung skyong klu yis ni/ /shin tu dkar po'i padma 'dzin/ /'jog po ljang gu klu rgyal gyis/ /legs par tshangs skud byed pa ste/ /nor rgyas klu yi rgyal pos ni/ /de yi ska ragasto byas pa ste/ /padma chen po klu rgyal gyis/ /pad skud kha dog dkar po bzhin/ /des ni zhabs gdub byas pa ste/ /thams cad phuṭa 5sgra drag shul can/ /mche gnyis so phreng 6lce ga/nyis pa'o/ /'di ni 'khor byang rang bzhin can/ /'di legs gshin rje gshed po yin/ /shes nas rnam rtog med par bya/ /brlabs shing sngags kyis mnyam bya'o/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma kolha7haṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /rang snying 'od zer beegs kyus dgug /mkha' khyab rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /thams cad de ni zhal du gzhug /bde zhugs 'bab cing snying gar zhu/ /byas pas blo ldan rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdor lam khu ba de nyid 'phro/ /rang 'od padma'i nang gnas pa/ /sa bon gzugs kyis dmigs par bya /sa bon 'khor lo yang dag 'byung / /sa bon rnams kyi byin rlabs 8te/ /tsha tsha 24—306

'phro zhing 'bar ba can/ /mkhas pas rim par bsgom pa ste/ /gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid ji bzhin pa/ /ya rnams dbus su sngon po byung / /dkyil 'khor bdag po bzhengs pa'o/ /shar du kṣe yis 'khor lo rdzogs/ /rtag pa phyag drug dkar bo ste/ /g.yas par 'khor lo ral gri gnas/ /g.yon par rin chen mtsho skyes 'dzin/ /ma yis 1rnam pas sgo phyogs su/ /rin chen 'byung gnas rin chen rgyal/ /gser bsregs —dang ni mtshungs pa'i mdog /g.yas pas rin chen ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon pas 'khor lo padma gnas/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ste/ /mi yi sa bon padma rdzogs/ /padma rā ga mnyam mtshungs pa/ /padma ral gri g.yas par gnas/ /nor bu 'khor lo g.yon par bkod/ /sa bon da las ral gri skyes/ /ljang gu phrag dog gshin dgra ste/ /ral gri 'khor lo g.yas pas 'dzin/ /padma nor bu g.yon par bsnams/ /thams cad zhe sdang gshin dgra yi/ /mtshan nyid kyis ni khro bo'i gzugs/ /rtsa ba'i phyag ni gnyis gnyis kun/ /gri gug bhanta 4bsgom bya ste/ /rang gi shes rab gnyis med lus/ /bde ba'i gzugs kyis rang bzhin can/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kun gnas pa/ / dge ba 5zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rtsibs rtse la/ /sems can don mdzad bsgom par bya/ /ya rnams shar phyogs sgo ru byung / /tho ba sngon po rang bzhin te/ /g.yas par ral gri tho ba 'dzin/ /g.yon na nor bu pad dkar gnas/ /de tho zhes ni gshin rje gshed/ /tsa 6las byung ba be con sgo sgor gnas/ /bee con gshin dgra kha dog dkar/ /g.yas pas bee con ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon pas 'dam skyes 'khor lo bsnams/ /nub tu padma gshin dgra ni/ /dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /ni las 24—307

skyes pa 'dod chags rgyal/ /byang du ral gri gshin dgra ni/ /ra las skyes pa'i cha byad ni/ /rgyal po phrag dog dbyebs kyis /—1gnas/ /cung zhig sngon po'i dbye ba yis/ /rab tu 'jigs bzhin byas pa ste/ /thams cad khros pa dang ldan pa/ /yan lag la 'grogs pa yis brgyan/ /gcigs pa'i zhal gyis bzhad pa ste/ /skra ni ser skya 'bar zhing 'greng / /nyi dkyil la ni yang dag gnas / /mche ba gadzigs shing stobs kyi zhal/ /gri gug bhandha bye /'dzin pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje grwa bzhi ru/ /de bzhin lha mo zla dkyil gnas/ /dza 'khor rdo rje tsārtsi kā1/ /lha mo de ni shar lhor gnas/ /skems ma dkar mo khro chen ma/ /gti mug gshin dgra rang bzhin bzhugs/ /de nas lho nub phag mo ste/ /sa las rdo rje skyes ma yin/ /phag pa'i gdong can khro chen ma/ /zhe sdang gshin dgra 'dra ba'i 'od/ /rab tu zhi ba'i dbyangs can ma/ /nub byang gi ni grwa ru gnas / /do las skyes ma mchog dmar mdog /'dod chags gshin dgra'i dbyibs can ma/ /byang shar grwa ru yang dag gnas/ /dkar mo ljang gu 'jigs byed ma/ /phrag dog gshin dgra'i phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /ru las skyes pa'i phrag dog dbyebs/ /sngon po'i g.yas pa dkar po ste/ /dkar po'i g.yas pa sngon po yin/ /de gnyis g.yon zhal dmar po ste/ /gzhan ma'i zhal ni dkar po'o/ /ṇa yo ni ra grwa bzhi ru/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni bhandha (jeste/ /rang sngags rig pa ji bzhin gyis/ /blo ldan rdzogs shing 'phro bar bya/ /hūṃ sthāḥbyeḥl sogs sngags sgra yis/ /dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag yang dag bskul/ /grangs med sprul pa rnam 'phros te/ /brtson 'grus sems can don mdzad pa/ /dngos po thams cad rang lus la/ /khro bo'i dpa' bos gzhug bya'o/ /dzi na 24—308

dzika ces bya bas ni/ /shar du gti mug gshin dgra ste/ /sna tshogs pad zla dbyibs rtse ru/ /de la de ni gnas par bya/ /ratna rjaka ces bya bas ni/ /lho yi padma'i nyi dkyil la/ /bgegs med don du dgug pa ste/ /rim pas de la gzhug par bya/ /ā ro tpaka sheces bya sngags kyis/ /'dod chags gshin dgra skyon med pa/ /nub kyi sna tshogs pad nyi la/ /rim pas de ni rnam bsgom bya/ /pradzñā j-ika ni de nyid kyis/ /phrag dog dgra ni rnam zil byed/ /byang gi padmo rnon po la/ /de ni rim pas gnas par bsam/ /muṅgar byeka ni de nyid kyis/ /shar phyogs sgo ru padma la/ /nyi dkyil la ni 'bar zhing gnas/ /tho ba mthar byed min zhes bya/ /rim pas mkhas pas yang dag bsam/ /daṇḍa dhrika ༄ byeces bya sngags kyis/ /lho yi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /be con gshin dgra mi bgrungs zupa/ /sna tshogs pad nyi 5zla 'od bsam/ /padma j-ika ces bya bas ni/ /padma dus med gshin dgra ste/ /nub sgor phye'adam skyes nyi dkyil la/ /'khrugs pa stobs chen bsam par bya/ / khaṅga j-ika 5ni de nyid kyis/ /ral gri de ni dus med pa/ /sna tshogs pad dang nyi dkyil la/ /bdud med byed pa byang sgor sgomabye/ /sna tshogs rdo rje grwa bzhi ru/ /gzhan yang de bzhin lha mo bsam / /dwo ṣa ra ti zhes sngags kyis/ /shar lho mtshams kyi lha mo ste/ /zla ba dang 2ni sna tshogs pad/ /khros ma tsārtsi byeyang dag gnas/ /de nas lho nub rdo rje phag /rigs kyi bdag mo phag mo ste/ /mo ha ra ti de nyid kyis/ /padma zla bar mkhas pas bsgom bhe/ /de nas nub byang grwa nyid la/ /rā ga ra ti zhes sngags kyis/ /pad zla la ni dbyangs can dgod/ /de nas byang shar dkar mo ste—/ /badzra ra ti zhes sngags kyis/ /zla pad la ni lha mo bsgom/ /dkyil 24—309

'khor gyi ni grwa bzhi ru/ /de nyid gsum gyi bhandha rnams/ /'di ni rnam 'phros dag pa'i 'khor/ /dam par byas na bde dang ldan/ /gong ma'i 'khor lo de thim ste/ /mnyam nyid pas ni dmigs pa ste/ /'di ni spyor ba dang po'o/ /gshin dgra nag po dus 'jigs pas/ /de yi rang bzhin dkyil lha rnams//mig dang lus sogs rang bzhin te/ /lha rnams kyis ni byin rlabs 1bya /gti mug kṣiṃ 2la 'khor lo skyes/ /cung zhig khros pa mig la gnas/ /rdo rje mig yin blo ldan dmigs/ /rna gnyis dzre las rdo rje byung / /rdo rje rna ba kha dog gnag /dri las khaṃ skyes rin chen 'byung / /ser sna de ni zla ba la/ /rdo rje dri ni de bzhin mchog /ljags la shaṃ las padma byung / /'dod chags dra ba rdor ljags yin/ /rka las skyes pa ral gri ste/ /ri dwags mtshan pa'i rdor lus yin / /phrag dog gshin dgra rang bzhin gzugs/ /dpral bar lus yin zhes bya ste/ /lte stengs saṃ las rdo rje yin/ /rdo rje sems ni de bzhin mchog /sgeg po khro bo rang bzhin gzugs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dgod bya ste/ /'di ni yan lag drug dgod pa'o/ /mngon sum don grub las su gsungs/ /snying gar hūṃ rdor dbus su gnas/ /hūṃ rdor sngon po legs 'od can/ /gshin dgra dang 'dra phyag mtshan mtshungs/ /sems la gnas pa'i thugs rdor bsgom/ /ol gong 4a las padma skyes/ /de dbus sum̐ las chags pa byung / /'dod chags gshin dgra lta bu'i lus/ /dpal ldan gsung rdor rnam bsgom bya/ /spyi bor oṃ rnams 'khor lo dbus/ /dkar po gshin 'bar de dbur 5'khor/ /sku yi rdo rje sku dang 'dra/ /phyag dang phyag mtshan kha dog mtshungs/ /de ni de 2 4—3/0

nyid rdor mchog ste/ /rdzogs pas mkha' gnas sangs rgyas mchod/ /sngags kyis de rnams byen rlabs spubya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha2haṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha4haṃ/ rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /sras dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /sna tshogs la gnas dgug byas pas/ /mdun du de ni bzhugs dmigs te/ /des ni yang dag spros pa yi/ /ji srid tsārtsi 5la sogs pa/ /zla 'od mtshungs pa'i bum pa yis/ /bkra shis la sogs glu 6rnams kyis/ /yang ni dbang bskur dmigs par bya/ /bdag nyid dang ni thams cad la/ /dbang bskur bas ni ci byung ste/ /spyi bor gshin dgra nag po yi/ /rdor 'dzin bdag nyid de bzhin no/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis//bdag mdun ye shes 'khor lo 7dgug /'khor lo de ni dmigs nas ni/ /khro rnams bgegs bskrad srung bar byed/ /argha bsel yab phul byas nas/ /oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥ/ 'di sngags kyis ni dgug pa ste/ /oṃ daṇḍa hūṃ/ 'di sngags kyis ni rab tu gzhug /oṃ padma baṃ/ sngags 'di yis ni 'ching ba ste/ /oṃ khaspyo hoḥ sngags 'di yis ni dbang byed do/ /rang snying sa bon 'od rnams kyis//sangs rgyas dgug cing gzhug pa ste/ /snying gar 'od zhu dmigs nas ni/ /ma lus rdo rje lam nas dbyung / /rang 'od rig ma'i padma la/ /zla ba las byung lha mo rnams/ /sna tshogs me tog la sogs rdzas/ /phyag gi yal gas de rnams 'dzin / /sgeg ldan de yi mchod pa ste/ /yid 'phrog mchod pa'i glu dang bee/ /sna tshogs gar gyi bye brag gis/ /des kau bde chen rab yin no/ /kye kye gshin rje dgra nag po/ /bla ma srin po'i rang bzhin can/ /khyod mthong bdag ni 24—311

rnam 'jigs te/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ /bdag pos gar byed pa yis ni/ /steng kye—ris mi yul sa 'og 'dar/ /mig sman bcag bzhin khros pa'i yid/ /mig bgrungs /rgukhyod ni gar byed do/ /mi thung nag po gshin dgra ste / /gzugs ni rnam pa sna tshogs sprul/ /rdo rje dbyangs can bdag gis zhus / /bde chen khyod ni gar mdzod cig /sthāḥskṛḥsngags kyis khyod gar byed / /khams gsum the tshom med par mdzod/ /gshin rje khro bo rje btsun khyod / /gar byed 'gro bas mthong ba'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma kopho —haṃ/ thams cad sgra brnyan lta bu'i dpe/ /sgra yul bzhin du rnam dmigs bya'o/ /'khor lo la gnas lha rnams kyis/ /'khor lo'i bdag po bstod pa ste/ /gti mug rdo rje rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin dgra bde ba 'jigs pa'o / /sangs rgyas kun ldan mgon po ste/ /'jigs med rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod / /ser sna rdo rje rang bzhin khyod/ /yang dag gshin dgra 'jigs pa po3 / /thugs kyi rdo rje rab snang ba/ /rin chen rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje rang bzhin khyod/ /'dod chags rgya mtsho chos kyi bdag /thams cad dbyangs kyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje rang bzhin khrod/ /gshin dgra las kun thams cad byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab snang ba/ /ral gri phyag la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas kun gasbug yang dag 'dus/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor mnga' ju byebadag phyag 'tshal bstod/ /a las skyes pa'i dag pad de/ /mgo gsum steng du yang dag gnas/ /rnam sdogs de 'og me dkyil 'khor/ /gru gsum ram̐ spyob las byung ba'o/ /de 'og 21—312

rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ /g.yo ba sngon po gzhu dang 'dra/ /yo las skyes pa ba dan dang / /de la kha dog ming dang gzugs/ /snang mdzad la sogs gnas pa ste/ /de la sogs pa yang dag dbyung / /rigs 1ngan la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rim pa yis/ /de ni dgag pa bsgom par bya/ /rlung gis me ni rab sbar bas/ /zhu bzhin rnam par dmigs pa yin/ /rdo rje ro mnyam bsgyur ba ste/ / gshin dgra —dri med dmigs pa'o/ /de la oṃ rnams 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin dgug /sngags kyi gzugs kyis 4rab tu gzhug /dmigs nas bdud rtsi lnga mchog ste/ /de nyid gsum gyis byin brlabs nas/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po tshim par bya/ /zhi ba rdo rje lce la gnas//hūṃ las skyes pa dmigs nas ni/ /de la sbu gu'i rnam pa yis/ /des ni mnyam par dgug par bya/ /sna tshogs gnas pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams de bzhin no/ /snying ga'i 'od zer rnams kyis ni/ /rnam rtog spangs pas dmigs bya'o/ /thog ma dbus mtha' dbye ba yis/ /'di la gcig tu spyor rnged de/ /rdul phran cha med rgyu yin pas/ /grangs med de ni spyor mi bya/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rnam par bral ba gang yin de/ /de ni de bzhin de ma yin/ /the tshom de nyid las bya'o/ /gang phyir the tshom gnyis la gnas / /bsam mi khyab la the tshom med/ /spro 5dang bsdu ba'i sgu yin te/ /sems can ro gcig don las byung / /gzhan ni rgyas par de nyid med/ /'di ni gsal bar rab tu gsungs/ /ye shes zhabs kyi zhal nas byung / /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus par gsungs/ /'di la bdag gis rgyas ma smras/ /dngos po'i bdag nyid dngos po med/ /khams med rnam par shes pa'ang med/ /24—313

nam mkha' kun mnyam gnas bzhin te/ /nam mkha' ji bzhin bdag med pa/ /'di ni chos mchog bde chen po/ /sa min chu min gnyi ga min/ /me min rlung min mkha' min te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab spyor bas/ /skye ba 'di ni rab gnas pa'i/ /dngos po thams cad dngos min te/ /de'i 1phyir dngos med grags pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor gyis ni 'byel/ /rtag dang chad pa gnyis min te/ /zhal med phyag med kha dog med/ /mchog gi dga' ba'i 2mtshan nyid la/ /dngos po thams cad nges rtag min/ /thog ma dbus mtha' rnam par spangs/ /de ltar pho brang shes gnas pas/ /rnam rtog thams cad spangs pa ste/ /phung po khams dang bdag med par/ /dag pa'i bde gzugs bsgom pa'o / /'gro ba gshin rje gshed byas nas/ /rang snying sa bon 'od rnams kyis//de bkug 'ong bar dmigs nas ni/ /sku gsung thugs rdor rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin chos yin te/ /ye shes las skyes dgod par bya/ /de la de yi sa bon rnams/ /dīḥbyeḥl sogs ye shes 'bar/ /lhag rtog spangs pas mthong ba ste/ /dag pa'i bde ba'i rnam pa can/ /'phro ba 'dus pas yang dag dgang / /bdag nyid mkhas pas bsgom pa yin/ /sku la sogs par 'phro bya ste/ /dus gcig dang ni rim pa yis/ /khro gzugs sna tshogs sprul pa byed/ /sthāḥz-iḥl sogs sngags kyis ni/ /'gro ba thams cad bde byed do/ /oṃ sthāḥskṛḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bsam gtan byed pa'i rim pa 'dis/ /'bad la sngags ni de bzhin bya/ /gzhan yang bza' ba la sogs las/ /bsam gtan ldan zhing thams cad bya'o/ /mchod dang bstod dang bdud rtsi za/ /sems can don byed yid kyis bya/ /de nyid gsum gyi rim pa yis/ /ye shes 24—311

'khor lo rnam par dbyung / /bdag gi 'khor lo bdag nyid la/ /ji ltar rim pas gnas pa ste/ /bdag gis bsod nams byas pa gang / /mngon par byang chub la smon bya/ /de nas smon lam byas nas ni/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ'i sngags kyis ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /'di ni rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /rang bdag rnam pa'i rang bzhin bzhengs/ /de yi nga rgyal yang dag byed/ /'bad la dngos po thams cad ni/ /de bzhin de yi gzugs nges bya/ /gti mug gshin dgra'i gzugs kyis ni/ /gnas dang 'gro ba bsgom pa'o/ /gsungs pa'i dus ni de rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bzhi bsgoms te/ /dang po'i 1rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /cung zhig ye shes de rjes spyor/ /spyor bdag yang dag rnal 'byor che/ /yang dag ye shes dbang gnas so/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i rim pa gcig /dus gcig la ni sngags bsgom bya/ /rnal 'byor che ldan rnal 'byor pa/ /'phro dang 'du ba'i lus nyid do/ /de nyid ye shes gzugs can dag /de phyir bdag nyid gshin rje gshed/ /dbang bskur rim pa bsam gtan gyis/ /khrus dang bza' ba thams cad bya/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi'i 4rim pa yis/ /gzhan mchod pa la rtogs par bya/ /bdag nyid dang ni gzhan ma rnams/ /rim pa ltar ni rtag tu mchod/ /dpal ldan gshin dgra'i bdag nyid can/ /byang chub bsgom pas rtag tu dmigs/ /bdag gzhan mnyam pa byang chub yin/ /de phyir rang bdag spyor ba ste/ /de med bdag nyid bsgyur 5'dod pa/ /rnal 'byor chos sgrub rnyed min no/ /ji ltar sna tshogs rnam pa la/ /dngos po gcig la rtog pa ste/ /sdug bsngal bral nas bde ba skye/ /las kyi dbye bas de dag skye'o/ /bdag nyid sems la rnam rtog 24—3/5

med / /dag pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin la/ /nag ces pa ni dga' ba'o/ /des ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la/ /de 1skyes 'khril bas shi dus su/ /zab pa stobs chen gshin dgra nag /des ni phan byed gzhan min no/ /gshin sgrub snyezhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin/ /stobs chen 'byung tshogs 'jigs med de/ /de rnams dgug byung phur pas gdab—/ /de ni 'jigs can khro gzugs so/ /oṃ dīḥsgoḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ 'byung po thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa dgug pa ste dzaḥ.oṃ juḥz-iḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ 'byung po thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa phur bus gdab pa 1ste hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dis ni 'ong bar shes byas nas/ /rang gi kha dog brgyan pa brtag /g.yas pa'i phyag la rang mtshon 'dzin/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na sna tshogs pa'o/ /brgya byen gshin rje dbang ldan dang / /sthāḥsgoḥwi kṛ sa bon gyis/ /de dag thams cad rdzogs pa ste/ /me dang bden bral rlung lha dang / /hūṃ byung lus ni shes bya ste/ /nyi zla sa yi ④'jig rten lha/ /hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā las skyes/ /lha rnams thams cad khyab 'jug ldan/ /'di ni gtor ma'i de nyid kyis/ /mnyam pa thams cad yang dag skyes/ /rim pas dmigs nas byin gyis brlab/ /de la rim pas dbang bskur sbyin/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi rim pa yis/ / re gyi 3sa bon gser dang mtshungs/ /mchod dang gtor ma de rnams dbul/ /'di ni gshin rje dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon kun du bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //slob dpon don yod rdo rje yis/ /legs par gsal nyabyed sgrub thabs 'di—/ /bsgyur ba'i bsod nams grangs med dang / /gzhan yang smon lam 24—316

'di btab pas/ /rgyu 1dang sgrub thabs mi 'bral zhing / /de yi man ngag rjes 'brangs pas2/ /bdag dang gzhan dag sems can kun/ /gshin rje gshed kyi zhal mthong shog/ //bsdur mchan/3༷1 kyimatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rag/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon kun tu bzang pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// 2〈〈snar 〉〉kri —/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 na maḥshrī ya mā rī dzwa ṣa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / dzwa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sharang / 9 〈〈snar 〉〉re/3༷2 1〈〈snar 〉ra stan/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar shi — 〈〈snar 〉〉bshegs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ zhi〈〈snar 〉〉gsung /3༷3 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodam/ 〈〈snar 〉thazhi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsam ste/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbye/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skaradud/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag3༷4 1〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gidrug 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ya/ 4〈〈snar 〉rnamam/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipho/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byugs/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rjes/3༷5 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar tsi kas/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganyen stong pas/ 〈〈snar 〉snga sam 4 5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉zad/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉than da/3༷6 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rgyan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyal/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉klu/ 4〈〈snar 〉rabargyan/ sku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga da/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phreng / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripho/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/3༷7 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉sregs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga na da/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodag pa/ spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tstsha/3༷8 rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharnya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar tsi ka 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rnya/3༷9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ga 〈〈snar 〉〉rnyika 〈〈pe 〉ra sgor sgom/ 〈〈snar 〉〉'grungs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabaḍa drika 7〈〈pe 〉ra sgor sgom/ 〈〈snar 〉snga sgor bsgom/ 〈〈snar 〉〉24—317

༄/ /gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/sna ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya mā ri sā dha na/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur thupa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mthar mdzad thugs rje'i rang bzhin can/ /'go ba'i don du phyi rol gtum chen sku/ /mgon po gshin rje gshed la mgos btud de/ /de yi sgrub thabs 'dod pa'i don du ni/ /sngags pa dang po sems yongs mgu ba dang / /bde ba'i stan gnas 'og tu dam bca' byas/ /snying gar hūṃ bkod pa las mchod pa'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs pa yi mgon la mngon par mchod/ /de yi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags la sogs/ /byas nas stong nyid yongs su bsgoms nas ni/ /dang por rlung gi dkyil 'khor yo las byung / /du ba'i mdog 'dra gzhu yi dbyibs can la/ / ram̐ gyi 4sa bon las byung me yi ni//dkyil 'khor gru gsum mdog kyang dmar ba yin/ /baṃ las byung ba'i chu yi 24—319

dkyil 'khor ni/ /bum pa 'dra zhing dkar la thur ltas pa/ /lo 1las byung ba'i dbang chen dkyil 'khor ni/ /zur bzhi pa la kun nas rab tu ser/ /hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ las byung ba'i ri rab ni/ /ri rgyal rtse mo brgyad pa go rims bzhin/ /sngar bshad rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /gong nas gong ma'i rim pa bsams nas ni/ /de 'og hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa/ /ra ba dra ba dam pa dbus kyi char/ /a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dbus na dhīḥlas byung ba'i 'jam rdo rje/ /dpa' bo phyag g.yas ral gri mdzes pa dang 2/ /gzhon nu'i g.yon na thugs kar glegs bam bsnams/ /sku ni dmar ser zur phud lnga gnag cing / /rdo rje skyil krung mchog bcas shin tu zhi/ /bsams la slar yang de yi thugs zla bar / /hi las byung ba'i nyi ma 'char ka'i gzugs/ /kun nas 'od zer nag po 'phros pa yis/ /khams gsum khyab nas rgyal ba byang chub sems/ /khro bo rig pa gnas na legs bzhugs rnams/ /yang dag bsgul te bkug 4nas nyi gzugs la/ /bcug la der ni gcig tu gyur pa na/ /slar yang nyi ma nyid du gyur pa las/ /'od zer dmar po rab tu rgya che ba/ /shin tu 'bar ba spyos nas de ru ni/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje kha gyes gnag /lte bar hūṃ bcas sna tshogs 'od 'dra ba/ /de las rgyal dang byang chub sems dpa' spros/ /slar yang de yis 'gro ba drug la gnas/ /sems can btul te byang chub mchog bkod nas/ /bkug ste thams cad rdo rje la rab gzhug5 /de 'og rdo rje nī 6la yongs su gyur nas/ /gshin rje gshed po zhal gcig phyag gnyis bsam/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyig pa 'phyar ba dang / /phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub rdo rje zhags pa can/ /gshin rje ma he'i steng na gan rkyal gnas/ /24—320

g.yas brkyang gnas pa yis ni gnon 1par mdzad/ /mi thung zhal ni rnam 'gyur mche ba gcigs/ /gsus khyim che la ljags ni rnam par rkyong 2/ /dbu skra smin ma sma ra dmar ser ni/ /gyen du brdzes shing spyan gnyis rnam par dmar//gnag cing khro bcas gnyer ma dpral bar bsdus/ /phus 'debs klu brgyad kyis ni yan lag brgyan/ /stag lpags bsnams zhing thod pa'i rtse bran can/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang mdzad cing / /dus mtha'i me ltar 'jigs 'od rnam par 'bar/ /'jigs par byed pa'ang 'jigs pa skyed —par mdzad//gtum zhing gshin rje gshed tshogs sangs rgyas 'phro/ /'jig rten lha mchog tshogs kyis phyag byas shing / /ha har bzhad pas lha dang lha min tshogs/ /kun nas yongs su skrag par mdzad pa'o/ /sa gsum dag na yod pa'i bdud kyi tshogs / /ma lus pa yang rnam pa 'byer bar 5mdzad/ /de ltar bsam gtan la brtson gnas pa ste/ /dogs pa med par nyin mtshan sngags zlos shing / /de nyid spyor bas dur khrod sogs par gnas/ /dam tshig rnam dag nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /de yi sgrub thabs 'di ni legs bris las/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob des 'jig rten/ /gshin rje gshed mnyam 'gro kun sdug bsngal ni/ /mi bzad tshogs mthar 6bdud tshogs myur zad shog /gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon 'gro bzangs snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā 7ba dge slong rin chen bzang 8pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //2tsho1—321

༄ / /nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i grub thabs bzhugs/ 1༄7/ /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gus pa yis ni bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi padmar phyag 'tshal te/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ /nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i/ /mdor bsdus pa yi sgrub thuthabs bshad/ /dang por rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /dbeen pa'i gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /stong pa'i sems la mnyam gzhag ste/ /snying gar padma 'dab brgyad pa/ /de'i steng nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yi steng du hūṃ bsams te/ /hūṃ las 'od byung mdun du ni/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro bzhugs par bsam/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod byas la/ /sdig bshags la sogs tshogs su 'gyur/ /de nas snying gar hūṃ las ni/ /'od byung lus ngag bag chags rnams/ /bsregs nas stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /de ni ye shes tshogs yin no/ /sems ni hūṃ gi rnam par bsam/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lngar gyur/ /rdo 24—323

rje las ni sgu bskyed do/ /zhal gsum phyag drug sku mdog gnag /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /spyan gsum mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal//dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes/ /gri gug rdo rje ral gri gsum/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams pa yin/ /bhandha padma 'khor lo gsum/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams pa yin/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gsus po che/ /lha mo phag mo'i mgul nas 'khyud/ /phag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /gri gug dang ni bhandha 2g.yon/ /gtso bo'i mgul nas 'khyud pa'i tshad/ /gnyis su med pa'i gnas na bzhugs/ /mig dang lus sogs dbang po drug /sangs rgyas drug kyang yod par bsam/ /sgu gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od byung bsam/ /ye shes mkha' 'go spyan drangs te/ /tshig gi dbang yang blang bar bya/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan mnga' bdag chen po rnams/ /khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur gsol/ /de skad bdag gis dbang blangs pas/ /ye shes rdo rje chu rgyun gyis/ /bdag gi spyi bor dbang bsgur bas/ /rigs lnga'i cod pan gyur par bsam/ /mchod dang bstod dang bdud rtsi bza'/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ dhīḥpy-iḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ thams cad grub pa'i don du bzlas/ /gtor ma'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmya rde/ ārya nutpanda 4tāta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i phyir / /des ni gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /de ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o /de nas rnal 'byor ngal bso 5bya/ /snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /khams gsum ma lus kun la khyab/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas sgu ru 'gyur/ /gyur 24—32 4

sngag /'o ma sgrub pa'i thabs/3 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṣi ra sā dha na/ bod skad du/ 'o ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal mtshan ngos ldan de nas blta/ /de la 'o ma rab tu sgrub3/ /'o ma goms pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /phyag rgya chen po rab tu bsgrub/ /rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa rigs su byung ba'i bud med phyi dang nang gi yon tan gyis brgyan pa/ rnal 'byor pa ye shes cung zad dbang bas bzung ste/ legs par bkrus shing dri zhim pos byugs la rgyan ma lus pas brgyan te/ de nas bdag med pa sngon du song bas/ sa bon kyi yi ge sa dang rdo rje las byung ba'i rdo rje phag mor bsams te—/ bdag nyid kyang rdo rje sems dpar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi phyag rgya'i lus la dkyil 'khor lnga bsgoms te/ de'i gsang ba'i bha ga byāḥ4las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /lte ba bye las mu tig lta bu'o/ /bdag nyid kyi 5gsang 24—326

ba yang hūṃ las rtse lnga pa'o/ /nor bu'i yi ge oṃ las so/ /yi ge phaṭa ser po bu gar ro/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha1haṃ/zhes pas stoms par 'jug ste/ sen mos 2gdab pa byas la/ myos byed kyi lag pas yang dang yang du brud cing lce rtse'i thur mas yang yang / de nas sa gsum gyi dbang phyug ma rgyas pa nas sngar bshad pa'i sngags kyis snyoms par zhugs te/ dal bus dal bus bskyod pa na 'o ma 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /babs pa na yi ge phaṭa kyis bsdams te/ snang ba med pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /de ltar yang dang yang 'o ma 'bab pa goms pas ni/ skad cig la bab — snapa na snang ba med pa la skad cig la 'jug pa4/ de'i tshe phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ ji ltar dpal mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje dra ba'i rtog pa las gsungs pa/ chu rgyus 5dra ba dang bcas shing / /yan lag kun ldan bu ga can//lus de med par snang gyur pa/ /de yi skad cig de la ni/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sku 'dzin 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'di dgyes pa'i rdo rje ni mtshan pa ste/ /phyag rgya chen po grub pa'i tshul thams cad 'di ltar man ngag las shes so/ /don 'di nyid dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pas kyang gsungs te/ rdo rje nyi ma nub pa na/ /sgrub pa kun du brtsam par bya/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i dus dag tu/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces pa dang / sor mo dang ni lce'i thur mas / /yang nas yang du cung zad bskul/ /rtsa ni rnam par rgyas 'gyur te/ /mchog gcig pu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sngags pas bar chad med par ni/ /sra ba cung zad cung zad bskul/ /nor bur gnas pa yid las byung / /yi ge phaṭa kyis bsdam par bya/ /byang chub sems ni ma shor na/ /bde ba dam pa skye 24—327

ba ste/ /de yi rang bzhin spros pa yis1/ /ma lus chad pa rnged par snang / /khyab cing zhi la bde ba yis/ /go 'phang dam pa nges par thob/ /byang chub sems ni shi ba ni/ /brgyal 2bas 'dir ni thob ma yin / /zhes so/ /'di lta bu'i bya ba ni rnal 'byor pa lam rnam pa gnyis las/ pho nya'i lam la dga' ba / de nyid kyi gsung dang thugs la dbang thob pa/ las dang po pa'i sa las 'das pa/ ye shes la dbang thob pa dang / ye shes la yang dag par dbang thob pa ma yin pa/ ye shes la cung zad dbang bas spyad par bya'o/ /de las gzhan pa ni ma yin te/ las dang po pa ni des nyams la/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa ni de mi 'bad pa'i phyir ro/ /dpal kṛṣṭa ya mā 4ri'i rgyud las/'o ma sgrub pa'i man ngag tu byas la/ ā tsarya dzi mu da zhipā tā las mdzad pa/ 'o ma sgrub pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// //ā tsārya badzra pā ṇi dang / lo tsā khub dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //24—328

bsdur mchan/326 )tshomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /'o ma sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉togazung / /ri〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/327 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa3/ sri〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉mo/ sa〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'bab/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa'ajugapa/rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyun/328 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 27〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyal/ dngha 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sten/ ji〈〈pe 〉stan:ya ma a/ 〈〈snar 〉〉kṛ: ya ma a/ snyem〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉blorya dzi ma ḍa/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yotstsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (795)24wa 329

༄/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'gor lo'i man ngag bzhugs/ri1༄7/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las gang byed kyang dang po bsnyen pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang gnas dbeen par/rang nyid rim pa bzhin du hūṃ la 2gshin rje'i rgyal po gzugs khro bo 'jigs byed chen po zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ sgu mdog sngon po/ zhal dbus ma sku dang mthun/ g.yas zla ba lta bu dkar po/ g.yon padma dmar po lta bu'o/ /phyag g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa ral gri/ gsum pa ni gri gug 'dzin pa'o / /phyag g.yon gyi dang po na 'khor lo/ bar ma na padma/ tha ma na bhandha'o / /thod pa rlon pa'i do shal dang / thod dang thod dum gyi gdu bu dang /dbu rgyan dang / mgul do dang / rna cha dang / ska rags dang / rkang gdub byas shing / ma he'i steng na nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas bsgum/ g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ gsus pa thur du bshal ba/ zhal gdangs shing 24—330

ljags 'dril ba ste/ 'jigs pa'i tshogs kun 'jigs par byed pa/ skra kham tsho ser me dpung 'bar ba lta bu gyen du 'khyil pa sma ra dang smin ma ser po dang ldan zhing mche ba gadzigs pa/ spyan dmar po shin tu 'jigs par bzlog pa ba spu'i sde bu ga thams cad nas mi bskyod pa'i gzugs dpag tu med pa rgyun du 'phro ba/'od dang 'od zer dus mtha'i bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba dang ldan pa bsgoms la / /de nas oṃ byāḥdzdzaḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa 'phro 'du dang bcas pa'am/ lha la ma yengs pa tsam gyis zlos kyang rung ste/ grangs 'bum mam/mtshan ma bzang po yang yang mthong ba'i bar du bzlas so/ /de ni bsnyen pa ste/las kun la de ltar bye brag med par dang bor mthun par bya'o/ /de ltar las su byed pa'i dus su bye brag tu bya ste/ 'di ltar zhi bar byed na rang lha'i gzugs su bsgyur te/ mdog dkar por bsgyur ba dang / byams pa'i sems dang ldan par byas la/ bdud rtsi'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar snga dro'i dus su/ shing lo'am go ga'i shun pa gsal/ /skyes pa zhi bar byed pa gur kum gyis bri/ bud med zhi bar byed pa'i gi wang gis bri ba ni/ 'khor lo rim pa bzhi bris la/dbus la re mig dgu dgur bya ste/ de yi phyi rim bcu gnyis mig /de yi phyi rim bcu drug mig /tha ma thod pas bskor ba bri/ /dbus kyi re'u mig dgur dgod 1pa/ /dbus char ya gidang shar char kshibye/ /lho yi mig la ma bri'o/ /nub mig mi 6bri shar du'o/ /de dag g.yas skor dag tu 'dod / /de mtshams re'u mig bzhi po la/ /sa bon gnyis par mig thubacug la—/ /g.yon skor du ni bri bar bya/ /zhi ba'i sa bon oṃ swā hā/ /rgyas pa'i sa bon bo ṣa byeṭa/ /rmongs pa'i sa bon lo yin no/ /dbang gi ho ste 24—331

mngon spyod hūṃ/ /pho dgug dzaḥl mo dgug trīḥ/ /de ltar bye brag shes byas la /ma nor bar ni legs par bri/ /de yi phyi mar 'khor lo ni/ /re'u mig bcu gnyis pa de la/ /yi ge g.yon skor 1du bkod pa/ /shar gyi re'u mig nas bzung ba'o/ /ya tsa na ri/ dza sa do ru/ ṇa yo ni ra rnams so/ /de yi phyi rim 'khor lo ni/ /re'u mig bcu drug pa de la/ /shar gyi re'u mig nas brtsams nas / /g.yas skor du ni bri bar bya/ /sngags dang ming dang bskul tshig dang / /ldan par shar gyi re'u mig la'o/ /de yi 'og ma'i re'u mig la5/ /sa bon gnyis dang ming bcug bri/ /de bzhin re'u mig bcu drug la/ /spel zhing spel zhing bri bar bya'o/ /de ltar bris pa'i 'khor lo de/ /lugs dang lugs min gnyis su bya/ /chu zhing mnyam po ga nyis su bya'o/ /khyad par du ni 'og ma la/ /sngags kyi mtha' ru phaṭa gzhag go/ /de bzhin kha sbyar bya lugs ni/ /steng 1 'og so so'i yig sngags dag /mthun mthun so sor mgo sprad sbyar/ /de ni zlum por dril bya 3la/ /drag min dag la spra tshil gyis/ /phyi rol g.yogs snyepa rab byas la/ /de nas kham phor mnyam po gnyis/ /byas pas gcig tu rtsi mar dang / /sbrang rtsi bsres pas bkang ba yi/ /nang du kha sbyar 'khor lo gzhug /de nas kham phor gcig gis ni/ /steng nas kha ni dgab par bya'o/ /de la las kyi mdog mthun pa'i/ /skud pa'i khris ni mdun du dkri/ /de nas rang lha'i las mthun pa'i/ /gzugs su rang nyid rab byas te/ /'khor lo kha sbyar steng du yang / /de 'dra'i gshin rje ru bsams la/ /de la me tog dri chab mdog dang mthun pa yi/ /bdug spos la sogs mchod byas la/ /bsgrub bya zla ba la bzhag 5ste/ /rang nyid 3zla ba'i rdo rje yis/ /lte ba'i hūṃ las rang 'dra 24—332

ba'i—/ /khro bo du ma ye shes kyi/ /chus gang bum pa las mthun mdog 2 /'dzin pa spros pa slar bsdus te/ /bsgrub bya'i spyi bor dbang bskur bas/ /gang 'dod 'bras bu thob bsams la/ /thun mtshams bzhi la gsang sngags ni/ /ming dang bskul ༄ tshig bcas pa bzlog /dbang la bye brag tu bya ba/ /tsandan dmar dang srin lag khrag /rgya skyegs khu ba btsag kyang rung / /dmar po'i thurdzas kyis bri bar bya/ /bud med dgug la khyad par ni/ /dur khrod kyi ni ras ma la/ /padma'i raktas bri bya ste/ /bud med bhandha kha sbyar gzhug /rmongs la khyad par dung ras la/ /ldong ros kyis bris kham phor gzhug /de stengs sum̐ las ri rab dang / /lam̐ ser sna tshogs rdo rje yi/ /steng du lha bskyed kun la sbyar—/ /rmongs rgyas ser po dbang dgug dmar/ /drag dang tshar gcad gnag zhi ltadakar/ /de ltar kha dog bye brag sbyar/ /drag po khyad tre/par dbye ba ni / /dur khrod ras la 'khor lo ni/ /gong dang mthun par bri bar bya/ /snag tsha ske tshe tshwa dzwadang dug /nim pa sga dang pi pi ling / /na le sham yungs kar nag dmar/ /shing nag chen po'i sa bon dang / /tsi tra ka yi khu ba dang / /srin lag khrag 8dang dur khrod sol/ /de rnams rnyed tshad bsres pas bya/ /snyu kye gu bya rog sgro rtses bya/ /des ni 'khor lo legs bris la/ /kha sbyar dril te rgyu rnams la/ /byas pa'i gzugs brnyan snying gar gzhugatshi /de nas gzhan yang ri rtse yi/ /sa ni shin tu skam po la/ /rigs ngan kha nas chu blangs sbru13/ /sbrus pa'i 'dag pa de las 6ni/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i gzugs byas te/ /g.yas bsgum g.yon brkyang bgrad pa la/ /g.yas pa tho ba zhags pa g.yon/ /gsus pa che la thur bshal ba/ /byas la mdun du gzhag 7par bya'o/ /mar ngo'i tshes 24—333

brgyad bcu bzhi la/ /las dag nyin phyed nam 1phyed na'o/ /rang nyid khro gzugs khro sems kyis/ /lho ru kha bltas stan bder —'dug /de nas rang snying hūṃ yig las/ /khro rgyal mdog nag zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis 'khor lo lcags kyu thogs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin spros la/ /bsgrub bya'i go cha mtshon cha kun/ /phrogs te drangs nas rang snying gi/ /sa bon hūṃ la thim par bsam / /tshul des de yi khyim stong bsam/ /de nas yang ni rang snying las/ /gong ltar khro bo rab spros pas/ /bsgrub bya drangs nas sngags pa yis/ /mdun du kha dog nag po ru/ /gzugs brnyan la bstem snyegasal po ru/ /de la sna tshogs nad rnams kyis/ / mnar bar 4bsam zhing gcer bu dang / /rab tu 'dar zhing sems gdung dang / /lus ni shin tu snyug bsngal zhing / /lus la shu ba ral gri mda'/ /sta re la sogs mtshon rnams kyis/ /tshabs cher gzer bar bsam 5par bya'o/ /de yang rlung nag ches g.yengs pas/ /shin tu grang bas 'khyags par bsam/ /me chen rab 'bar bas bskor te/ /rab tsha bas kyang gdung bar bsam/ /de la'ang khyi dang seng ge wa/ /stag dang bya rog bya rgod dang / /mchu rings sogs pa rngam tshul du/ /bsgrub bya'i lus de bza' bar blta/ /de nas gzugs brnyan de la ni/ /tsher ma rdon po rab blangs la/ /bar mtshams med par rab phug la/ /tsha ba'i lde gus rab bskus la/ /de nas gshin rje'i lto bar gzhug /de gsus bsgrub bya rab bsams la/ /rang snying khro bo mtshon thogs spro/ /de yis gshin rje'i gzugs gnas pa'i/ /bsgrub bya de bsad 6de'i sha khrag /zos 'thungs rus chog rkang gzhibs bsam / /sprul pa bya rgod gzugs can kyis/ /nang khrol phyung khyer khar song 24—334

bsam—/ /las ngan byed de dmyal bar 'gro/ /mi gdung bya phyir de yi sems//rgyal ba'i gzugs su rang snying gi/ /'od kyis bsdus te rgyal ba yi/ /zhing sar khyer nas bkod par bsam/ /de ltar las kyi tshul de nyid1/ /sdeg pa can la dgongs pas gsungs/ /yang na gshin rje'i sgom 2lugs gzhan/ /zhal gcig bye phyag gnyis g.yas zhags pa/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub ldan pa la/ /dbu rgyan rang rang rigs 0bdag go/ /so so'i sngags kyi dbye ba ni/ /gsal bar bris pa 'di yin no/ /oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ che ge mo shārnying ku ru swā hā/ 'di ni las kyi bzlas pa dang / 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa spel la/ dgod pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa bo ṣaṭa che ge mo puṣṭi ku ru bo ṣaṭa dang / oṃ byeḥ byeḥblu kṛ 5snatā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ho che ge mo dza ཿdza sthā cewa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ7/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bo ṣaṭa che ge mo ba sha na ya ba sha na ya/ oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sthāḥbud med che ge mo ā karṣa ya sthāḥ/ oṃ sthāḥdzdzaḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥ/ skyes pa che ge mo la ā karṣa ya dzaḥ/ oṃ trīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lo che ge mo rang gi gnas dang bcas pa/ sto bha ya lo/drag po'i 'khor lo 'og ma'i/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ steng ma'i/ oṃ sthāḥbye8ཿwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ/ oṃ che ge mo swā hā/ bo ṣaṭa che ge mo bo ṣaṭa/ lo che ge mo lo/ho che ge mo ho/ dzaḥche ge mo dzaḥdīḥche ge mo sthāḥ/ dbus kyi re'u mig grwa bzhi dang / /gsum pa bcu drug pa la ni/ /spel ba'i sngags su shes par bya/ /ring po dag ni spel ba ste/ /las dus bzlas pa de ltar ro/ /gru bzhi dang 24—335

gsum pa'i phyogs bcu drug spel lo/ /gshed nag 'khor lo'i man ngag /slob dpon chen po nā ga bo dhis mdzad pa rdzogs so// // lo tsā hūṃ7ba dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur// //bsdur mchan/33༷ 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉rdzar bkod/ — bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rolas/ 1/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 na/331 1〈〈snar 〉skabams/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gib spu'i/ — bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoragod/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo /༄lha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snye/ skyo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉(6 bya'o/ /nub mig me/ hūṃ/〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉sumang / kye〈〈snar 〉〉sha332 hūṃ〈〈snar 〉thaskor/ tre〈〈pe 〉donas/ nee〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snodang / thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayos/ gye〈〈pe 〉sngagazhag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)nga /333 hpha〈〈snar 〉shedag 3sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mugal/ bye〈〈snar 〉skadag 5〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉tha'i/ e〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bcad gnas bzhi/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadab/ rtse〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skye tshe tsha/ bye〈〈snar 〉〉gig bye7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyu/ khe〈〈pe 〉sngagazhugs/ 〈〈snar 〉snga zhugs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgru/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodaga' ba de la/ mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zhag334 /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bad/ kyi〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thastems/ ④〈〈pe 〉thaman bar/〈〈snar 〉rnaman rab/ zhe〈〈snar 〉snga sams hūṃ〈〈pe 〉ra sa/335 ṭwā〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / rngo 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgom/ 1〈〈snar 〉ra ga pya〈〈snar 〉〉reg /⑤〈〈pe 〉stab kṛ/〈〈snar 〉〉driḥwi kre/ zhwa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsho dza ha/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 3sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dri/336 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lotstsha/24—336
bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (796)

༄ / /sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs/tsho ༄go/ /dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin sreg 2gi rim pa ni/ sa'i cho ga dang sta gon dang / thig rnams tshul bzhin byas la/thab khung yang lugs mthun par brus te/ sa nag pos byug go/ /rnga mo dang bong bu'i sbangs dang / phub ma dang / rnge tog nag po dri mi zhim pas byugs la/ shin tu rtsub pa dang tsha ba dang dur khrod kyi thal bas kyang byugs la/yam shing yang de nyid las byung ba/ rtse mo khrag dang dug dang yungs mar la sogs pa dang / drag po'i sreg rdzas ji ltar 'os pa bsag /bdag nyid kyi chas gos kyang dur ras 4dang g.yang gzhi dang gos nag 5la sogs pa bsham6 /de nas rdzas rnams g.yon du gzhag7 /mchod yon la sogs pa g.yas su gzhag/de nas bdag nyid stan med cing sra ba la rus sbal gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/kha lhor bltas te/ rgyan cha gyon te/ khros pa'i sems kyis so bca' zhing rnal 24—338

'byor gnyis byas la/ rjes su rnal 'byor la rang 'dra gzhug /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bya ba de la/ rnal 'byor chen po rdzogs byas la/ de nas thab yig a las byung ba nag po 'od nag po 'phro ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis kyang gsod par nus par bsam/ yo byad kun kyang ya yis byin gyis brlabs 3la/ rdzas re re'ang 'od nag po 'phro ba/ gang gis mthong ba'am/ reg na'ang gsod sbung 'jigs pa/ lha rnams la phul bas kyang khro ba dang gtum par 'gyur bar bsam/yi ge bcu bzhi pas thab dang rdzas kun bsangs la/ thab tu shing brtsig4 /de nas me gnyer te/ rigs ngan gyi khyem nas byung ba'am/ rdo drud zhipa las byung ba/ yam shing la me sbar te/ yi ge bcu bzhi pas bsangs la thab tu 'usbar de la yungs mar gang phul la rlung g.yab 7kyis g.yab cing / bzlas te/dzā la ram̐ dzā la re/ de nas mtshan ma brtag par bya/ ltas bzang ba dang me lha bskyed de dang por shemangon par byang chub pas rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed de 'od du zhu ba'i gong bu las lha mo bzhi chad de/ des bskul bas/ ram̐ nag po de las byung ba'i rdo rje las/ me lha 'khros pas zhes bya ba zhal la sogs pa gtso bo gnyis 1'dra ba cig bsam/ de nas ye shes kyi me lha tsārtsi kās dgug ste / dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che / /lha yi drang srong bram ze'i mchog /sreg drugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs su gsol/ /sngags ni/ kro dha asne —che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de la zhabs bsil phul la/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i gzhug la/arghaṃ pra tītstsha sache ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces so/ /zhabs bsil yang sngags kyi mjug la/ ni ri khaṃ che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'thor sa 'thung yang sngags kyi 24—339

mjug la/ pra wa ra saṭwā ra pra tītstsha 1che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod do/ /de nas sgo ba bzhis dgug gzhug bya/ de nas mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / lus ngag sems kyang byin gyis brlab/ de nas dbang byin/ de nas zhabs bsil la sogs pa dang / rnam pa lnga dang / rang gi sngags kyi mjug la bskul tshig dang bcas pas so/ /de nas mar dang / yam shing de nas til / de nas 'bras/ de nas dug dang / rdzas kun yi ge bcu 3bzhi pa'i mjug la bskul tshig dang bcas pas so/ /de nas mchod dang bstod/bdud rtsi myang ba bya/ de nas kha lag bshal/ de nas me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par 'gyur bar bsams la/ yang thab dang rdzas bsangs la 'bar ba'i nang du dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du ston te/ de'i mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / lus la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs te/dbang bskur 4la ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas la dang po zhe sdang rdo rje la thun 5mong gi mchod pa byas la/ de nas sreg 6rdzas kun yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i sngags bskul tshig dang bcas pas 'bul dzwate/ de nas mchod bstod/ bdud rtsi myang ba 8bya/ de nas yang thab 9bsangs la/ yang gti mug rdo rje dang /de de bzhin du rim pas dbul/ tha mar liṅga la bkug 'dren byas la/ de nas gtub cing sreg7 /de nas ye shes pa 1gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig bdag la bsdu/ yang me lha bskyed/ sreg 12rdzas lhag ma kun dbul te/ de nas kha lag bshal/ ye shes kyi me lha gshegs/ bskyed pa bdag la bsdu/ de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon chen po la li ta badzras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—340

༄/ /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/1 ༄go/ /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po ni/ /'chi bdag bdud ces bya ba ste / /'gro ba kun gyi lus kyi bdud/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du/ /'gro ba kun la snang ba ste/ /phung po nying mtshams spyor ba po/ /'jigs pa de yi gzugs mthong na/ /ya ma de yi dri ngan 'byung / /de nas rang gi srog gi bdud / /lhag pa'i phyogs na gnas pa ste/ /gadzigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo / /de la 'chi bdag skyes bu'i gzugs/ /khru gang yi dwags gos la dzre/ /nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /'jigs pa ral pa mche bzhi gcigs/ /rgyan meed rus pa'i phreng ba can/ /g.yas pa ya ma'i dbyug pa 'dzin/ /sdigs mdzub zhags pa g.yon na bsnams/ /ma he dag la gnas pa bri/ /de la rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /mdun du gnas la zhi gnas bya/ /yang na saṃ bye rnam 4gsum las/ /hūṃ las nag po chen po ste/ /yi ge bcu gcig brjod byas la/ /21—342

ras la bris pa bzhin du bsgom/ /oṃ kā la rū pa 1ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas bsnyen pa bya ba gsungs/ /dur khrod nags tshal song byas la/ /bzlas brjod byas pa'i tshul dag gis/ /ha ha bzhad cing 'ong bar rigs/ /mngon du gyur nas ba lo kyesbyin/ /de la bsnyen pa'i snying po 'di'o/ /oṃ kā la rū pa dī ma yakṣa hūṃ/ ma hā —ro ṣa khaṃ/ na ra sidhe ye/ sarba byu ta a dhi pa ta yephya7/ya ma rā dzā ya hūṃ hūṃ spephaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ thog ma dbus mtha' yang dag ldan/ /bcu bzhi phye ba bsnyen pa yin/ /rim pa bzhin du ma bye 3ba/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa yin par shes/ /grub ste mngon du gyur pa na/ /sha chen gtor ma chen po spyin / /oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ i rda ba lo greṇḍi —kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ tshogs la sogs pa mngon du sbyin/ /de ltar grub na las bya ste/ /bhandha mtshan ngan bzang po btsal/ /dum bu gcig gam gnyis pa la/ /dpral ba'i ngos nas ltag par drang / /mi thod dag pa ro ras 9la/ /gnod sbyin bai ba swa tā'i sbyigazugs—/ /snag tsha bya rog khrag dang ni/ /dur khrod sol ba bong nyu1bu'i chus/ /mi rkang snyu 8gus legs par bri/ /spyi bo'i ngos kyi phyogs dag la/ /ras la 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /rim pa skor khegasum ldan pa la/ /rim pa gnyis pa dag la ni/ /rtsibs gnyis gnyis kyi tshad la bri/ /de la gsang sngags dgod pa ni/ /ma ma sha bye 7a mu kai/ /'khor lo lte ba'i dbus su bri/ /shar nas brtsams nas 'di lta ste/ /tā sa ya tā sa ya/ ā kaṣṭha ā kasbyo/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bandha bandha/ tsūrṇa tsūrṇa/rim pa tha ma dag la ni/ /shar nas brtsams nas 'di ltar bri/ /tsakṣa badzra na sgo ra ba tra ma kṣe tra pā la ya/ tstshandha tstshandha mumi/ dnghanda bhinda/ thā shaṃ badzra bā slobye/21—3/3

ru bye ra argha sa/ oṃ mā ra ya badzra ye s+ho bha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bar du dgra yi ming rus bri/ /rgyab srubs dag la gsang sngags bri/ /skud pa sngon po nag po yis/ /thod pa de ni bsdam par bya/ /ro shing 3me la bhandha kyebasro/ /de la zhag cho gsum byas nas kyang / /las kyi 'chi bdag khru gang la/ /zhal gcig ④mche gcigs phyag gnyis pa/ /bdun por sa dang rnam snang dang / /dur khrod sol ba'i rgyu dag la/ /bong thubu'i chu yis gzugs byas te/ /de yi snying gar thod pa gzhug/'khor lo la bris sngags bzlas te/ /mar tshes bcu bzhi dang brgyad la/ /dur khrod ro khang dag tu mnan/ /de ltar las ni rdzogs gyur nas/ /gang la bya ba'i dngos po de/ /rang gi bdud kyi dbang du gyur/ /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po de/ /ma dros mtsho yi 'bri dkyil la/ /ri nag po yi pha mtha' ste/ /spos dang ri bo'i bar dag na/ /chu dang zheng du cha mnyam mtsho/ /de 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po'i gnas/ /'gro ba'i ltag 37 pa'i phyogs na gnas/ /de yi yum de tsa muṇḍi④/ /rabs chad pho mo'i thod pa la/ /ya gnyis dag gi bar du yang / /ro ras dag la gzugs bri ba/ /zhal dang phyag zhabs sngon 3bzhin bri/ /de la 'chi bdag tsa muṇḍi/bye/ /nag mo mig gsum khro gnyer can/ /kha gdangs skra brdzes nu ma 'phyang rngu/ /gsus chen dus /1/'gro'i gos gyon ma/ /g.yas na tri shul g.yon thod pa/ /mi yi thod pa dang sbyar ba/ /mi yi rgyus pas bsdams pa yi/ /bar du 'khor lo gzhug par bya/ /de la 'chi bdag 'khor lo ni/ /snga ma bzhin du bri bar bya/ /de la ma mo'i 'khor lo ni/ /ras la 'chi bdag tshul bzhin du/ /rtsibs brgyad gnyis dang ldan pa la/ /dbus nas brtsams te de bzhin bri/ /ma ma sarba 24—344

sha hūṃtsho/ lte ba'i dbus su bri bar bya/ /shar nas rim pa 'di bzhin du/ /a mu ka su/ dhu na dhu na/ bandha bandha/ ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pra ma tha/hūṃ dzwa ra dza/ dza re na bya/ bye ri ge rna༄ 7/ rim pa tha ma dag la ni/ /shar nas brtsams nas 'di lta ste/ /ni ga na shi baṃ haṃ yi ri tshu sa ya/ a bi sha ya/dzee baṃ z-i da yi/ tshinda ma de pa shi shaṃ mā ra ya nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du yang / /gang la bya ba'i ming gzugs dnghagazhug /bla mas 'chi bdag bsams byas te/ /srog gi snying po bzlas par bya/ /gos sngon gyon pa de bzhin du/ /yum mam las mkhan dpa' bo bzhin/ /yum gyi srog snying bcu po dgod/ /oṃ sthāḥtsa muṇḍi 7ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yab yum 'khor lo gang yin pa//gong gi thod par gzhug par bya/ /shi ba'i skra yi skud pa la/ /mi rgyus dag gi skud pas bsdams/ /mi yi rgyu mas gzungs thag byas/ /gtso dang gzungs kyis gzung byas nas/ /maṇḍal steng bzhag bzlas pa bya/ /'khor lo steng 'og las sngags la/ /gtso dang gzugs snakyi 'bum phrag bzlas/ /de nas bzlas pa rdzogs nas kyang / /dur khrod lha khang ro khang ngam/ /lha klu drag po'i gnas su mnan/ /lha la sogs pa shi bar bstan/ /de yi sgrub dzwapa'i gnas rnams kyang / /dbeen pa'i gnas su byas nas ni/ /bla ma pha ma mchod pa yin/ /gang byung yang ni bsgral ba yin/ /de tshe bsgral ba ma byas na/ /de tshe rang nyid 'chi bar 'gyur / /gsang ba gzhan la bstan mi bya/ /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //24—345
