0889da༅/ /dpal de go na nyid grub pa/① ༄༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tatwa 37 sedhi/ bod skad du/ dpal de kho na nyid grub pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas byang chub rdo rje ni/ /tshe 'dis 'grub kyi gzhan du min/ /lus dang ngag yid legs gnas pa 5 / /med par 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod rgyun mi 'chad/ /med na de yang 'grub mi 'gyur④/ /de yang ji ltar 'dod pa bsten/ /gnyis med ye shes dag pa las/ /de ltar min na log par rtsang / /de nas sdug bsngal brgyud mar 7'byung / /de phyir sngags kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /mkhas pa dag pas sngon 'gro spyad/ /ji ltar chu yi thigs pa ni/ /rgya mtshor babs na lan tshwar 'gyur/ /lan tshwa 'o ma'i mtshor zhugs nas/ /de nyid slar yang bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /ji ltar dug sbrul de nyid shes—/ /nus pa 'phrog par byed nus med/ /de nyid rgyud gzhan dag la ni/ /24—555

lnga po'i gnas skabs las mi 'da'/ /gzhan yang 'dod pas zil non na/ /'dod pa nyid ni sman yin no/ /ji ltar dug gis gdungs pa la/ /dug nyid sman du che ba yin/ /ji ltar rnge yis tshig la me/ /tsher mas zug la tsher ma nyid//de bzhin nyon mongs kyis nyen na/ /nyon mongs nyid ni bdud rtsir che/ /dper na dug gi de nyid shes/ /dug zos kyang ni gnod mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin yul gyi de nyid shes/ /'dod pa spyad pas gnod pa med/ /ji ltar 'dam gyi padma ni/ /'dam la gnas kyang des mi gos/ /de nyid rig 1pas rtag tu ni/ /'dod pa rol pas spyad par bya/ /de phyir kun nas dogs meed par/ /khyad par du ni longs spyod 'gyur/ /'dod pa lnga la brten byas na / /dngos grub myur du nges thob 'gyur/ /dka' thub brtul zhugs smyung ba yis —/ /khams rnams skams par 'gyur ba yin/ /skams pas sdug bsngal 'gyur ba ste/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yengs 'gyur/ /g.yengs pas byang chub gzhan du 'gyur/ /de phyir dngos grub mchog gnyer ༄ —na/ /dka' thub brtul zhugs spyad mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bas de bzhin gnos ce/ /bde ba spangs na dngos grub med/ /de bas yid 'ong gnas su ni/ /nyams dga'i bu mo bcu gnyis ma/ /yid 'ongs mig gi dkyus ring ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par mdzes/ /brtan zhing mi g.yo dam tshig can/ /'dam las skyes pa'i dri 'bab ma/ /chags pa chen po'i ros phya/rol pa/ /mchog tu mkhas shing sgeg pa dang / /nyams dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rang nyid 'khor lo'i dbus su gnas/ /dam tshig can ni rgyud dag pa'i/ /nang du nyin mtshan 'du bar bya/ /spu ldang 'dar zhing cher 'dar la/ /'dzum dang dgod dang 24—556

rab tu dgod/ /myos pa dang ni bcas pa yi/ /'bebs pa rnam pa bdun du bshad / /rengs dang myos dang 'gyur ba ste1/ /rol dang yur dang shin tu 'phel / /rkang pa 'dor dang lag pa bsgyur/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma lta stangs dang / /sngags dang rgod dang drag po sogs/ /ki li ki li phreng sgogs byed/ /rol pa dpa' bo rnam par nyed/ /sa bskyod ca co'i bye brag ldan/ /brgyal 5ba rab zhi ngu bas rtogs/ /byams shing dga' ba rgya mtsho ni/ /bde ba'i rtags las skyes pa'i 'od/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gsal ba'i yid/ /gnyis med rnam par gsal ba yi/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes dag dang ldan/ /de ltar bden don rab zhi ba'i/ /bye brag bcu gnyis dag gis mdzes/ /e yi cha byad bzang po gang / /dbus su waṃ gyis rnam par brgyan/ /bde ba kun gyi gnas yin te/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /der ni dga' ba skye 'gyur te/ /skad cig dbye bas phye ba ni/ / dga' ba'i 4grangs kyi rim pa yis / /de dag so sor gsal bar byas/ /stong nyid gsum gyis 5nyams sbyar bas / /thams cad stong nyid rab tu gsal/ /de nyid gsal bas dag pa ni/ /mchog gi go 'phang de gsal 'gyur/ /de phyir mi g.yo phra ba'i yid/ /ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas mtshon bya/ /ji srid gsal bar ma gyur pa/ /de srid sgom 6pa la 'jug bya/ /rab tu gsal ba thob nas ni/ /rang dga'i gzugs su skye bar 'gyur/ /der ni skad cig ma bzhi dang / /de bzhin du ni dga' ba bzhi / /de la sna tshogs skad cig dang / /rnam par smin pa 7rnam par nyid/ /mtshan nyid med par brjod pa yi / /bye brag mkhas pas shes par bya/ /sna tshogs du ma'i rnam pa can/ /'khyud dang 'o byed la sogs pa'o/ /rnam smin 24—557

de las gyur pa ste/ /bdag gi bde ba la dpyod shāmadzes/ /rnam nyed dpyod 2pa'i bdag nyid de/ /bdag gi bde ba la dpyod mdzes/ /de dag las gzhan mtshan nyid bral/ /dga' ba dang po mchog dga' dang / /dga' bral la sogs lhan cig skyes/ /dga' ba'i bde ba cung zad bde/ /mchog tu dga' ba de bas lhag /dga' bral chags pa bral ba ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa de dag spangs/ /brgyal dang phyi mo phyed tsam dang / /phyi mo zhes bya skad cig gsum / /dam pa'i bde ba rnam par rol/ /dbye bas lhan cig skyes pa shes//brgyal ba kun nas ye shes med/ /cung zad shes pa phyi mo'i phyed/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /ye shes phyi mo nyid du 'gyur/ /de phyir de nyid ye shes ni/ /gnyis med ye shes rab tu gsal/ /de la chags dang chags bral med/ /gnyi ga ma yin stong nyid min/ /kun min thams cad min pa min//yang na thams cad rnam par thim/ /ji ltar char gyi rgyu sna tshogs/ /ro gzugs du ma gzhan yin kyang / /snod gcig tu ni zhugs pa na/ /zhu nas ro gcig nyid du 'gyur/ /de bzhin ye shes bde chen po/ /rnam par ngo bo nyid kyis gsal/ /gnyis med rnam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos kun rnam par 4bcom pas na/ /ye shes rgyun 'bab gtong ba'i blo/ /mkhas pas de lta bu nyid mtshon/ /mi g.yo sgrib bral phra ba yi/ /thig le'i gzugs can rtog pa med//thog mtha' med pa'i de nyid ni/ /ma byung ma byas mchog yin no/ /skye bo chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /gzhi ni de nyid nyid 5yin no/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rnal 'byor pa yi de nyid la/ /mthong ba de nyid ma mthong ba/ /de la phyi rol ci zhig bsam/ /de phyir 'khrul pa'i mchod pa sogs//27(—558

phyi rol pa yis ci byar yod/ /thams cad spangs nas de nyid bsgom/ /thams cad 'di las 'grub par 'gyur/ /ā li kā li mnyam spyor las/ /gang tshe nor bur chud pa na/ /man ngag gis ni rlung bzung ste/ /de tshe ye shes mthong bas 'grub/ /bskal pa mtha' yas bar du ni/ /der ni 'dod pa yang dag gnas / /'od gsal ba yi gnas thob nas/ /sems can kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /tha mal snang ba'i rnal 'byor kyis/ /bzhi pa'i de nyid la brten bya / / sngon du goms 1byed rnal 'byor pas/ /des ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur / /rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas gdab cing / /'bras bu la yang rgyus rgyas gdab / /rgyu 'bras gcig tu rgyas btab pas/ /phyag rgya chen po skye bar 'gyur / /mtshan mo snang ba'i cha ste gsal ba'i nyi ma'i 'od zer 'gyed pa snang ba mched pa yin/ /mtshams ni snang ba thob pa rang gi rang bzhin rnams kyis lan cig min par 'go/ /mtshan nyid 2nyin par min pa mtshams min gang zhig rang bzhin rnams dang rnam bral ba/ /de ni byang chub yin par bla ma mchog bshad rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /ji ltar nang bzhin phyi rol te/ /gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor 'dis/ /sgrub pa ru ni rigs pa yin/ /slob dpon chen po ke ra li pas mdzad pa de kho na nyid grub pa sgogs so// // 24—559

bsdur mchan/555 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ra /de kho na nyid grub pa slob dpon ke ra li pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// da / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta / 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ride yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ 'u/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thar/556 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/ — — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ bye bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉panyen/ gye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thamanos/snye〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉shesal/557 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang / / rngu‘〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyal/ ‘gu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snga gis/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag pa'i/snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ gye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis/558 hūṃ — — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyod/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / khya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ginyid/559 lha 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pangon du gom/ pya 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉staban/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉 maṅgā lo/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (8 16)24 —560

༄ga /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dam tshig la 'jug pa'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bye ra wa sa ma ya maṇḍa la bi byeḥ /bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dam tshig la 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar nges par snyerim par brgyud pa dang / de kho na nyid bcu la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i bla ma la/ theg pa chen por rigs nges shing dad pa dang ldan pa'i slob mas/ go 'phang 4mchog thob par 'dod pa'i don du/ yang dang sgoyang du gsol ba btab pa dang / bkra shis pa'i gnas dang / dus der rjes su gzung bar 6byas nas/ bla ma la mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas pas / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed mnyes par bya ba'i don du/ gnang ba rab 'bring tha ma )gang yang rung ba thob pa des/ slob ma rnams kyang ji lta ba bzhin sbyang ba byas la/ sbyin sreg 9la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams tshul bzhin du 24—56/

tshogs par gyur pa ni/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas ji skad du gsungs pa'i gnas su sems dpa' dang bcas pas/las thams cad pa'i chus bsang gtor 1byas la/ der dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgoms shing mchod nas gtor ma btang ba'i bar du bya ste/ de nas sa'i lha mo la sa blang ba la sogs pa byas la/ de nas bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas/ gang la dmigs pa'i sa de la tshon 2thag dang / phur bus bskor te ji lta bar brko zhing sbyangs nas/ maṇḍal ba'i ko ba tsam pa byas la / ci rigs pa'i sa gter gzhug cing ba'i rnam lnga spos dang bcas pas 'thas par bcags te —/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad kun bkram la/ rgyan cha dang bcas pa'i slob dpon des/ maṇḍal gyi steng du rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ sa gzhi thams cad stong pa'i ngang las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram 'bar bar gyur par mthong ba dang slob ma lha mo bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas/ phyogs bzhi nas dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa'i don du bzhengs par gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la/ rdo rje slob dpon de mnyam par bzhag pa las langs te/ mig gnyis su ma dang a las nyi ma dang zla ba 4gsal bar byas te/ de dag gi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi 5khams thams cad zil gyis gnon par bsgoms te/ rkang pa gnyis haṃ las rdo rje rgya gram 'bar bar bsam ste6/ dbang ldan mtshams nas g.yas phyogs su bskor ba lan gsum gsum tsam du bskor zhing / hūṃ bzhi pa dang bcas pas 'byung po kun la 'jigs pa sbyin par bya ste/ de nas dkyil 'khor kyi steng du 271—562

'jigs pa chen pos gnas te/ phyogs kun du rnam par blta ba'i gar 1rnams byas la/ de nyid du 'dug nas nan tan du bgegs byed par 'dod pa rnams gzhom par 'dod pa'i don du/ bdag nyid kyi snying ga nas nges par 'phros pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyel pa lnga bton pa'i phur pa la stod khro bor gyur pa dag /dkyil 'khor de'i dbus dang grwa bzhir gdab ste/ de'ang g.yas pas tho ba g.yon pas phur pa bzung — ste/ phyogs skyong bcu la btab cing / thal phyin par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭan phaṭa phaṭa/tī la snguya tī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ badzra tī la ya sarba bispyon 5/badzra dha ra ādzñā snapa ya ti kā ya wāka tsitta 7badzra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas gdab par bya'o/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags la sogs pas kyang tshar gcad /pa'o / /sa yongs su gzung 9ba'i cho ga'o// //de'i rjes la stan la legs par 'dug nas/ g.yas pa'i rtse gsum phyag rgyas ni/ /sa la bsgrun pa tsam gyi tshe/ /padma dang bcas lha mo ni/ /lte ba yan chad 'thon pa la/ /thal sbyar bka' nyan tshul bsgoms nas/ /mchod cing gsol gdab bka' bsgo nas/ /gnang ba byin te sa der thim/ /de nas maṇḍal de dbus su/ /dri yis byugs pa'i maṇḍal gru bzhi pa cig byas te/ me tog gi tshom bu bya'o/ /de bzhin dri'i thig le re re dang / me tog gi tshom bu lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa dgod par bya'o/ /shrī badzra bye ra wa a byeṣṭha na/zhes pas bsnyen par gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid 'dir brtan par gyur par blta'o / /de nas rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ de nyid du 24—563

dbyer med par bzhugs pa la mchod pa dang bstod pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab ste / bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo /bdag gis gshin rje gshed dkyil 'khor/ /mgon po bdag ni 'dri bar 'tshal /slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /byen kyis rlobs par 3mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs/ /'khor los 'gro ba'i don mdzad dang / /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gsang sngags kyi ni lha gzhan dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bstan la mngon dga' ba'i/ /gang su lha yi mig can kun/ /che ge zhes pa'i rdo rje yis/ /gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor las byung ba'i / /ji ltar nye bar spyod nus pa/ /'gro rnams don du bri bar bya/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa kun/ /thugs rjes nye bar bzung nas ni/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor la bzhugs phyir/ /byin gyis rlob par 7mdzad du gsol / /bdug spos rol mo bcas pa yis/ /kun gyis pus btsugs gsol ba gdab/ /de dag gis kyang rjes gnang ba/ /'go mgon skyobs 4gnas yin par bsgo/ /dris 5/lan tshul du mchod bstod bya'o/ /lha lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang dbyibs kyis mdzes pa drug gam/bcu gnyis la sogs pa la zhwadakar por bsgyur zhing / sna tshogs padma'i steng du rigs so so'i phyag rgya bris te/ las thams cad pa la rdo rje rgya gram bri'o/ /24—564

snying po'i 'bru lnga dang / rin po che dang / sman dang / dri dang / snying po rnams kyis dgang bar bya zhing / spos rnams dang bcas pas bkang la mgul chings dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / kha rgyan dang / gzungs thag rdo rje la btags pa dang bcas pa3/ yol ba byas la/ de dag mi dmigs pa las/rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du/ padma'i sdong po'i steng du nyi zla'o/ /de'i steng du cho ga gsum las gtso bo'i sku bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' bsgrubs te/ mchod cing bstod nas/ bzlas pa bya ste/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci rigs par bzlas pa'i rjes la/ mchod yon la yi ge brgya pa ci rigs pa bzlas pa'i chus reg 3pa'i tshe na zhu ba'i thig le'i rang bzhin du blta'o/ /bum pa kun la'ang de bzhin du sbyar zhing / las thams cad pa ni padma'i steng du bskyed par bya'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas shar phyogs su maṇḍal bya ste/ slob mas slob dpon la nye bar longs spyod pa rnams kyis mchod par bya ste/ yang slob ma la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa 1byin pa des slob dpon la gsol ba gdab ste/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /mgon po chen po bdag la gsol/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol zi/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon des slob ma rnams spro ba 24dod565

bskyed par bya ba ni/ 'jig rten 'dir ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dusmra ra'i me tog ltar/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ste/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga rnams/ /de bas ches cher dkon pa ste / /de ltar yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog /ded dpon bzang dang bcas pas blang / /gal te bag med gang gyur na/ /duḥhūṃkha rgya mtsho skyed par byed/ /ces brjod cing / de nas gsang sngags kyi che ba'i yon tan nye bar brjod pa ni/bu tshur jeg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga rnams/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod kyis tshul chen brten 2par byos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag gis kyang gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di rnyed 4nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags cho ga mnyam med des/ /shākya seng ge la sogs kyis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /'khor lo bskor 5 nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis 6blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces lan gsum du brjod byung / cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du rgyun bshags dang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par byas la/ de'i cho ga ni slob ma'i lus la/ 'byung ba bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyis 'od kyi gong bu de las yi ge 'bru gsum du gsal ba dang / sna g.yas g.yon gang nas rgyu ba'i rlung gis bsdus te/ thugs ka nas gsang ba'i gnas nas bton 7te/ mdun du rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa de la/ sgu gsung thugs rdo rjer gyur par byin gyis 24—pyi66

brlabs la/ mchod pa rnams phul te/ rang gi rigs kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad zlos su gzhug go/ /de nas bya ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'i sdom pa dang /dam tshig la sogs pa 1/ci rigs pa dbog cing / dgag pa dang gnang ba la sogs pa'i bye brag dang / nyes dmigs kun kyang bsgrag par bya'o/ /de nas so shing sbyin zhing dag pa brjod par bya ste/ oṃ byāḥbi shudhe dharmā 2sarba pā paṃ ni tsā gya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa na 4pā paṃ a pa nā ya hūṃ/ zhes kun la mngon par byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /srung 5skud la rigs kyi snying po bzlas par rig par bya'o/ /ku sha'i chun po la sngas 5dang stan la yang dag par bsngags la yang sbyin te/ bya ba gzhan gyis blo ma yengs par/ snying po'i don dpal gshin rje gshed po 'ba' zhig la sems par gyis shig ces pa dang / de nas bsgo ba byas la ci bde bar gnas so/ /mdun gye dkyil 'khor thabs shes rab kyi rang bzhin du gnas par bsam mo/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas snga dro'i dus kyi tshe na/ rnal 'byor dang bcas pa'i sngags pas/sngar gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gsal ba de la yang dag par mchod nas/bar snang la gnas par bltas la/ maṇḍal la bye dor byas te/ de nas thig skud ni/ dog pa lnga dbus dang / phyogs bzhir bkod/ dang por mi dmigs par bya'o/ /de nas yig 'bru lnga dang phyag mtshan lnga yongs su gyur pa las rigs lngar grub pa la/ ye shes sems dpas byin gyis brlab cing /mchod pas mchod cing / slar skud par gnas pa de la bsgril 7bar bya ste/dza'i sgra las byung ba'i sgrub pa'i grogs la skud pa'i sna gtad de/ rang gi sor mo 24—pya 67

lnga'i bar nas skud pa lnga bkod la/ a byon+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā 37pa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣṭa sarba dharmā 5a tyanta a nu pra biṣṭa sarba dharmā nubadzra sirnyi hūṃ aḥ/ zhes pas sor mo bcu'i bar du bsgril bar bya ste/ de ltar legs par grub pa'i this sgud de la/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sru ④tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes bzla zhing dri dang spos kyis bsgos pa de la ji lta ba bzhin du mchod par bya ste/ de nas slob dpon gyis sngags dang bcas pas thig skud bsdogs te/ dza' sgra dang bcas pas thig sna gtad de/ rang bzhin kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal bar dmigs te/ de nas slob dpon lho nas byang du bltas te thig gcig gdab bo/ /de nas lho nas byang du bltas te shar gyi kha khyer gyi thig gdab bo/ /de bzhin du byang dang lhor bltas te nub kyi kha khyer gyi thig go/ /de bzhin du nub dang shar du bltas pas byang gi kha khyer kyi thig go/ /de nas nub dang shar du bltas pas lho'i kha khyer gye thig gdab bo/ /de nas me dang rlung gi mtshams su gnas pa dang / srin po dang dbang ldan du gnas pas mtshams kyi thig gdab bo/ /de nas cha chen bcu drug tu phye ba las/ cha phran rnams ji ltar rig sgopar gdab bo/ /de nas bskor thig gi grangs nges par bya'o/ /bcu drug gi phyi rol du lhag par yang yongs su shes par bya'o/ /de nas tshon rtsi'i cho ga ni/ dkar po/ ser po/dmar po/ ljang gu mthing ga rnams thod pa'i nang du so sor bkod la/ ye shes lngar gsal ba la mchod cing / beer tshon rtsi yongs 6su gyur pa la byen gyis brlab pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bltas la/ byang shar mtshams su re khā lnga bri'o/ /de nas thod pa bkab la rkang pa'i 'og tu mnan te/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems 24—568

can khams rnams rab sgrol byed/ /rgyal ba 'jam mgon rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /zhes brjod cing tshom bu btab la/ de nas phur pa'i shul dgang ngo / /de nas yang rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa ltar du dbus nas brtsams nas kyang / go rims ma nor bar bri bar bya ba ni/mtshan mo phyed ni dus dag ste/ /ma he gdong gi sbyor ldan pas/ /gcer bu skra grol bdud rtsis byug /dur khrod sol ba rus phye sogs/ /sna tshogs ldan pa'i tshon rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes par bri bar bya'o/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa1sna—/ /rta babs bzhi dang dra bas brgyan/ /dril bu dril bu g.yer ka'i phyed2sna//nyi ma zla ba rin chen phreng / /rin chen gdung dang mdzes pa'i thog /tog gis brgyan zhing 'od zer sprin/ /ngos rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas/ /mdzes par bltams shing 'khrigs sgopar spras/ /me tog phreng ba sna tshogs dang / /rin chen rgyal mtshan la sogs brgyad/ /gru chornams kun du bsgrengs pas brgyan/ /sa gzhi rdo rje rgya gram 'bar/ /de yi lte ba'i dkyil du ni/ /'khor lo'i mchog gi rnam pa la/ /zlum po re mig dgu pa ste/ /thod pa skam rlon phreng gis brgyan/ /bar khyams gru chad sgo bzhi mdzes/ /sgo gcig tu ni 'dug nas ni/ /sgo gzhan yongs su gcad hūṃpar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ de bzhin du yang dbus ni zlum po la re mig dgu pa'o— sna/ /de'i phyi rol sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram la rtse mos sgo'i nang du slebs 3pa la/ ra'i mtha' me zlum bskor 'od zer 4bcas pa ni ci rigs su bya'o/ /mtshan ma dngos su dgod par bya ba ni/ dbus su ro mgo lhor bstan pa'o/ /bar khyams la shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag 9pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa'o/ /shar gyi grwar 5 thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/24—569

lho'i grwar thod tshal gyi phreng ba/ nub kyi grwar dur )khrod kyi ras te zhing lpags brgyangs pa/ byang gi grwar 2gsal shing la btsugs pa'i mi ste/ 'di dag ni nang gi mtshan ma dag yin la/ de nas phyi rol gyi phyag rgya dgod de shar kyi snam bu la ni gri gug dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / gtun shing dang / chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / lcags kyu la sogs pa bri'o/ /lho phyogs kyi snam bu la sta re dang / mda' dang / kha ṭwāṃ 4ga dang / dbyug to dang /'khor lo dang / rdo rje'i zhags pa la sogs pa bri'o/ /nub phyogs kyi snam bu la rdo rje dang / rnge'u chung dang / phub dang / gzhu dang / dril bu dang /rlung gis 'phyar ba'i ras la sogs pa bri'o/ /byang phyogs kyi snam bu la/ sdigs mdzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / glang po che'i pags pa dang / rdo rje'i tho ba dang / mdung dang / rdo rje'i me thab la sogs pa bri'o/ /khyad par 5du sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir ro langs ma rungs pa'i cha byad can re re dgod do//dbus kyi ro langs kyi steng du sna tshogs kyi padma la gri gug gam6/ ral gri 'bar bas mtshan pa bkod do/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i rim pa'o /de nas bum pa dgod de/ gtso bo'i bum pa dbus su dgod do/ /gzhan dgu dang las bum dang bcas pa byang shar du bzhag la bispyon ta kṛta 7la bsrung ba'i las bcol lo/ /de nas mchod pa'i yo byad dgod pa ni/ spyir sha dang khrag thams cad gtso bor gsungs so/ /mchod pa rnams ni bsham pa dang /grangs dang / go rims ni ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin no/ /mar me chen po brgyad ni/phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgod pa la sogs pa dang / sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir ni sha 24—570

khrag sna tshogs pas bkang ba'i thod pa chen po'i gtor ma brgyad dang / gzhan ci rigs par bshams pa'i 7tshogs kyi yo byad rnams dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i yo byad de/ gos zung du sbyar ba la sogs pa dang / rgyan gyi yo byad ni/ bla re dang / 'phan dang / gdugs dang / yol ba la sogs pa dang / bsrung ba'i yo byad ni gri phur dang / mda' bo che dang / sgo mtshams ma la sogs pa dang /sgrub pa'i yo byad ni rnal 'byor du 'dus pa rnams ni/ ting nge 'dzin gcig tu gyur pa'am/ ma gyur pa'ang rung ste/ mnyam par 'jog nus pa rnams te/ de dag gis ni dkyil 'khor brgyan par byas pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing / 'bar ba'i lta ba dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya zhing / nor ba rnams bcos 2 par bya'o/ /srung — —ba'i 'khor los byin gyis brlab par rig 4par bya'o/ /de nas lho'i sgor stan la 'dug nas/ sems mnyam par bzhag pas/ cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du dam tshig sems dpa'i 'khor lor sprul la/ bar snang la gnas pa de yang 'bar ba'i lta ba dang / yi ge dza' sbyor bas/ shrī badzra bye 5ra ba ma hā maṇḍa la ā 6be sha ya a a a zhes pas gnyis su med par gyur par mthong nas/ skye mched drug dang / sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du sgrub ste/ de nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drang zhing / dbyer med par gyur pa'i tshe na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar rig par bya'o/ /de nas blo ldan slob ma gang / /dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur 'dod pas/ /mchod pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa'i/ /bla ma mchod la brtson bya ste/ /dad pas 24—571

rang dang longs spyod bcas/ /ji ltar 'byor zhing yid 'thad kun/ /rje btsun zhubs la btud de 'bul/ /de nas snying po byang chub bar/ /zhabs kyi padma la btud cing / /theg mchog bsrung bar bskul skya'adebs shing / /'gro ba'i mun sel sgon me spro/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon des/ /rang rig pa'i rgyal por nges par mthong nas/ skye mched drug dang lus ngag yid rdo rjer byin gyis zlob 2cing / ye shes kyi 'khor lor byin kyis brlabs te / dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ bsang gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod yon dang sku khrus gsol te/ bdug spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag du ma dang /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang / sbyang ba dang / sbar zhing rtogs par bya ba'i bdud rtsi'i ros ni sangs rgyas thams cad la yang dag par mchod nas/ de bzhin du 'jig rten pa dag la yang rgya che bar mchod par byas nas/ de dag sgyu ma'i rnam par shes par 'gyur ba dang / rang gi rtog pa las ji skad du gsungs pa ltar du zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gis kyang don thams cad sgrub par gsungs so/ /de nas slob ma dbang bskur phyir/ /'khor los chosgyur rgyal spyor bas 'jug /bdag nyid gnang ba thob gyur nas/ /gzhan don mchog 'gyur thuthe tshom med/ /de nas yang slob mas dbang bskur ba'i don du/slob dpon la gsol ba gdab ste/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam spyong ba'i/ /ji ltar bshad pa'i rin chen ltar/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin sprul/ /khyod zhabs padma spangs nas ni/ /mgon po gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i mgon po thub chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /de nas yang phyogs bzhi nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de 24—572

bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /1mtshan min 2thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa zhi ba chos mchog yang dag 'byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor sems can kun kyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha los sgyur / /dkyil 'khor de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa dang / dam tshig rnams dbog cing / de dag gi sngon du rgyun bshags la sogs pas legs par sbyangs na/ slob dpon yol ba'i nang du gnas la/ las kyi rdo rjes phyi rol du las thams cad pa'i bum pa des ci rigs su bkru zhing / gos dmar pos thugadong pa g.yogs 5te/rnam par snang hūṃmadzad du bskyed de/ a khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ zhes me tog gi phreng ba snyim par gtad la/ rdo rje nas 'dzin du bcug ste/ bslab bya dang bcas pa yol ba'i rtsar phyin pa dang / zhal bzhi pa dang / ta kṛta dzabazhi'i sngags dang bcas pas/ bgegs kyi tshogs kun bskrad de/ khyod ni gang zhig ci la dga'//zhes bsgo ba dang dad pas legs par bsgrubs 8pa ste/ skal ba bzang la bdag dga' 'o/ /zhes smra bar gyur pa dang / de la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bya ste/ yol ba'i nang du 'ong ba na/ /bo dhi tsitta utyā da yā tsu7mi/zhes brjod do/ /de'i snying gar rdo rje dang bdud rtsir bcas pas rgyas btab ste/de ring khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byen gyis brlab par 'gyur te—/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa de kho na nyid kyi 24—573

gnas chen po 'di ni/ phyin ci ma log par bstan par bya ste/ gang dag khyod kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ dad pa chung ba dag dang / yongs su ma smin pa rnams la smra bar mi rigs so/ /gal te bag med par smras na mgo 1'gas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum du byin gyis brlab cing / rdo rje dang bcas pa'i bdud rtsi'i thig le bya zhing / nyi zla kha sbyar re re bkod par bsgoms nas/ de nas yang 'di skad du bsgo ste/ deng nas khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su chud pa yin par shes par byos shig /de lta bas na/ ngas khyod la ye shes chen po'i rdo rje nges par bskyed par bya'o/ /ye shes gang gis khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang 'grub par 'gyur te dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/'di dag ni dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba dag gi drung du brjod par mi bya ste/dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang deng khyod kyis/ /snying la yang dag gnas par byas/ /gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ/ de nas padma'i snod du bsgrubs pa'i 'chi med de las rdo rje blangs te/ de'i lce la bzhag ste/ 'di ni rdo rje'i bdud rtsi'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub kun/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub sna/ /oṃ badzra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥde ring phan chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin pas ngas ji ltar bsgo ba'i dge ba'i las rnams khyod kyis bya dgos pas/ nga la brnyas par 'gyur ba'i 4las dag ma byed cig /ji ltar du mi bde ba dag ma spangs par che'i dus byas nas / sems can dmyal bar gyur ta re'o/ /de nas yang slob mas 'di 271—574

skad du gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ bdag ni de nas bzung nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig /ces brjod la/ byin rlabs rgyud ldan bla mas ni/ /rdo rje'i slob ma byin brlab 1phyir/ /slob ma'i lus dang rten 'byel rdzas/ /thugs kyi byin rlabs 2dkyil 'khor gyis/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor des/ /sems ni byen gyis brlabs tsam gyis/ /g.yo zhing rtogs thob gang yin pa / /stobs su gyur phyir kun gyis kyang / /rol mo'i sgrar bcas rtogs pa bskyed/ /brtan pa'i cho ga ci rigs spyad/ /de las shes pa brtan gyur nas/ /kha dog la sogs snang ba dri'o/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje dang bcas pas bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / dkyil 'khor chen po la bskor ba byas nas/ nub kyi sgo nas shar du blta bas/ rnge tog gi phreng ba de dkyil 'khor chen por dor bar bya ste/ma hā pū 4bye pra tītstsha badzra ho zhes brjod de/ slar yang blangs te/ gtsug chophud du bcings la/ pra ti kṛṇḍa 6badzra hoḥgang la bab pa'i lha de nyid yi dam lha ru bskyed cing dpog go/ /de nas mig gnyis 7oṃ du bsam/ /'od 'phros khams gsum 3dag par mthong / /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed pa la brtson par byed/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /ye shes mchog tu gsal bar byed/ /te badzra pā sha /gdong g.yogs bkrol ḍate/ oṃ badzra tsakṣu ma hā maṇḍa la pra bee sha ya phaṭa/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu'i dngos/ /dag cing gsal la ma rnyogs par/ /gang rtog zhing khams rnam dag mchog /bla na med pa'i gnas mchog yin/ /rdo rje thugs rje'i rgyun gnas pas/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyun mi 'chad / /bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis mthong / /24—pya 75

phun sum tshogs kun 'dis 'grub 'gyur/ /dngos grub sgrub phyir dam tshig skyongs / /gsang sngags don la brtson par kyis/ /shar sogs sgo bzhi nas brtsams te/ /ji srid gtso tshogs rim par bstan/ /der rjes rnal 'byor thams cad kyis/ /mgrin gcig tu ni bsngags pa yis/ /bkra shis glu dbyangs du mar bcas/ /bum pa blangs te dbang bskur bya'o/ /ji ltar bltams pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /lha rnams kun gyis dbang bskur ltar/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs kun gyis/ /rigs kyi bu khyod dbang bskur bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dngha ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ye hūṃ/ a khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ zhes pa cho ga gsum las rigs lnga'i skur gsal bas/ snga ma bzhin du dbang bskur bya ste/sangs rgyas kun dngos cod pan dbang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab bsgrub —1 phyir / /cod pan mchog gi dbang bskur bas/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal mgon dbang bskur/ /oṃ dzee māṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ hūṃ/ ratna mu ku lduṭa a sgyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab bsgrub 4phyir/ /rdo rje mchog gis dbang bskur bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra a dzha ṣi.āoṃ rma/ chos kyi dril bu bla med don/ /stong nyid ye shes sgra sgogs 5pa'i/ /thams cad stong nyid don ston pa'i/ /dril bu'i dbang bskur bla na med/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shapta pa ta le dharma dhwa tu a bhi 6ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas rtag pa chen po'i don/ /mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i sdar/ /rngo rje'i rgyal po byin gyis brlabs/ /nges par ma yengs rgyun du bsgoms / /oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti rtse/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa saṃ/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ badzra satwa ste/ badzra a dzha ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ya lngahūṃ/ lhag pa'i lha ni 24—576

gang gang gi/ /de dang de yi mtshon byed brda/ /shrī yi 1sgra yis mdzes byas ming / /ma 'ongs zhing du lung ston 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs dbugs phyung 5lung bstan pas/ /cho ga'i rjes 'gror gsungs pa ste/ /brtul zhugs sku gsung thugs yin te/ /phyag rgya gsum gyi thugs rgyas gdab/ /phyag rgya chen por gang gyur pa/ /rdo rje dril bu byin rlabs gtad— / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badzra tiṣṭha e ṣa s+ho dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi ho hūṃ oṃ/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bdag snyems bdag mdzod cig /hoḥ—chos kyi dril bu gzung chobar bya'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /rtag tu khyod kyis gzung 6bya ste/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos kyi dril bu darngol bar bya'o/ /srid pa rang bzhin gyis dag phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ④srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog tu sgrub par byed/ /'khor ba'i bde ba shin tu chung / /duḥdukha chen po dag bya'i 9phyir/ /mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs /dam tshig 'di dag rtag tu skyongs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ji ltar bde ba brten rmye/bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya'o/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /thabs mkhas mchog chen bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mchog thabs/ /bsod nams byin rlabs kyis bsgrubs pa'i/ /dam tshig 'di dag rtag tu bsrungs—/ /dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i 24—577

brtul zhugs mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnang ba sbyin/ /de nas bdud dpung 'joms byed mchog /'bar ba chen po'i sku rtedabang bsgur/ /gri gug la sogs phyag mtshan bsnams—/ /yi ge bcu pa'i gsang sngags mchog /mngon par bzlas shing rim gyis gtad/ /stod g.yogs smad g.yogs 4dag la yang / /nye ba'i snying pos byin brlabs la/ /theg chen don ldan dbang bskur te/ /sbrul sogs thod pa'i phreng ba la/ /phreng ba'i sngags kyis byin brlabs la/ /longs spyod rdzogs skur dbang bskur ro/ /gsung gi brtul zhugs brtan depa ni/ /gsang sngags sgrub dang nyan pa dang / /dam tshig rjes gnang mchod pa gnang / /las bzhi grub chen brgyad sgrub gnang / /cho ga ji bzhin rgyas par gtadatre/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon mchog /'khor los 7sgyur bar dbang bskur te/ /padma'am seng ge'i khri steng du/ /rgyal por dbang bsgur don phyir gzhag8 /steng nas rin chen gdugs dkar dbub/ /des kyang ji bzhin gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen / gsol btab ltar/ /bdag kyang nges par grol ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /de yi rjes la rnal 'byor pa'i/ /tshogs kyi sngags bcas bkra shis dang / /bum pa la sogs kyis dbang bskur/ /khyad par du yang rdo rje'i ming / /kun gyi 7bkra shis brjod nas ni/ /dbang rnams ji lta bar yang bskur/ /kun gyis tshig tu rjod byed pa/ /oṃ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' che rang bzhin/ /sems dpa'i mchog tu deng grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 24—578

kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu grub par mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid grub par mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang bo kun bdag nyid//byang chub mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /rgyal ba bdag nyid che rang bzhin/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag mdzod cig /de nas gzhal yas khang pa dang / /lha yi mtshan nyid rnam dag lam/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba'i dngos/ /ma bcos don dam rang bzhin mchog /skal bzang de la gsal bar bstan/ /dam tshig mchog tu grub par byed/ /de nas dben zhing bder gnas pas/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa la sogs kun/ /nye bar sta gon gnas byas te/ /rang bzhin dag cing sbyangs pas mdzes/ /chos kun mtshan nyid bshad pa des/ /nam gyi gung la mnyam sbyar nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyes byin brlabs pa'i/ /dri sked bdud rtsir kyebyin brlabs pa'i/ /lce yi pang steng rdo rje'i rtser/ /bde ba chen po'i snying por sbyin/ /ngag gi sgrar bcas dam tshig bsgragasarte/ /de nas rigs dang rgyud sbyangs la/ /brda dang gar la sogs pa yis/ /nam phyed dus su bum dbang bskur/ /phyi rol spyor ba dag pa dang / /rtsa gnas rlung gi sbyor ba mkhas/ /bde ba che la lhag par dang / /de la sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor du / /ye shes rtogs —phyir dbang bskur mchog /bag yangs nyam 4nga blos thongs tshe/ /skad cig skad cig dbyer med par/ /bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid sad5/ /ma ning mkhan po sgra mkhan dang / /tshad ma rtog ge'i spyod yul 24—579

min / /dgag cing sgrub las 'das pas lku na/ /brjod bral lhan cig skyes dgar gsungs/ /'di dag bde bar skyong byed rnams/ /bslab bzhi 'dul sgom dam tshig kun/ /nges par bsrung phyir sems bdag nyid/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dgra bsad cing / /'dod la nges par chags phyir spyad/ /gzhan gyi longs spyod bag med blangs/ /dngos kun brdzun sogs sgyu mar smra/ /tshogs drug bde chen longs spyod spyad/ /grub pa lnga dang lcags kyu lnga/ /longs spyod lnga sogs rgyun ༷/ du spyad/ /rtag tu sems las dngos grub bsgrubs7/ /dus gsum rtag pa'i sku ru gnas/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas sras su lung bstan te/ /bu la ston pa'i phyag mtshan bskon/ /g.yas pa skyabs sbyin khyegayon mnyam gzhag /sems can don sgrub tshul du langs/ /de la mgrin cig 'utshig 'di brjod/ /oṃ ngas khyod 'di ltar lung bstan te/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton tshu/ /srid pa mchog tu bsgrub bye7pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /oṃ ya mānta kṛta —/hūṃ saṃ bhur bhu wa swaḥ0/ de nas dbugs dbyung sbyin bya ste/ /de ring khyod bdag legs par rnyed/ / /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes/ /sems nyid rang byung ba yi gter/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i nye ba gnas/ /gsang sngags mnyam med rmyesems las grub/ /zag pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor che/ /mthong ba'am ni zhugs gyur pas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /byang chub sems mchog rmad byung rnyedathu/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms shing duḥmukha yi/ /skye rga na 'chi 'jig par byed/ /srid pa'i ngo bo nyid dag pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje deng 24—580

gyur to/ /de nas de'i sems kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya ste/ byang chub chen po'i rgyur gnas pa'i/ /mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar 1ni rab tu grags/ /skye mched khams rnams mang po kun/ /lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ye nas rang byung ye shes che'o/ /bdag nyid chen po rtag pa'i lha/ /ma bsgrubs rdo rje sems dpar 2gnas/ /de nas blo ldan slob ma yis/ /bdag nyid mchog tu gyur shes nas/ /bla ma la ni 'byor pa'i mchog/ci nus dad pas dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyis mchod pa dang / /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya'am stong / /'byung po kun la gtor mas mchod/ /skye bo gzhan yang mgu bya yi4/ /longs spyod ci rigs mkhas pas sbyin/ /de nas bzod gsol bshags pa 5dang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol/ /rdul tshon mtshan ma kun bsdus te/ /bsngo ba dag byas chu bor dor/ /bla ma mnyes byas ci rigs gshegs/ /mthar ni dam tshig mchog gis bstan/ /bdag gzhan don rnams rab bsgrub 6phyir/ /rtag tu bde ba'i mchog gnas pas/ /rang gi dam tshig bsrung bar gyis/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dam tshig sgrub par byed pa'i cho ga /dngos grub mnyes 7pa'i slob dpon chen po dpal la li ta badzra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po a mo gha badzra dang / lo tsā ba mar pa dge bsnyen chos 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //24—581

༄ga /rdo rje'i tshig rnam par dbye ba zhes bya ba/1 ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra pa da bi bhe da nā ma/ bod skad du/rdo rje'i tshig rnam par dbye ba zhes bya ba/ gang zhig khro ba las rgyal legs pa du ma 'byung ba'i gnas/ /duḥ/kha che 'joms bde ba rab rgyas bde chen ma te'i zhal / /chags las rnam rgyal chags bral rab 'joms mtshan ma legs bsgrengs pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'jigs mdzad he ru ka la kun nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig khams kyi snying po bde ba 'dzin byed dge slong chen po yin phyir dam tshig sdom pas brgyan/ /rgas pa'i 'jigs bral rnam par mdzes ldan gzugs bzang dri med gzi 'od rab rgyas yun ring bde bar 'tsho/ /rdo rje'i sku thob mtshan dpes rab brgyan lha dang lha min gnod sbyin gdengs ka mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu/ /rgyal ba'i thugs mthong dmyal ba'i 'jigs 'joms de yi mdun na rdo rje 'chang gnas gshin rje'i grong las ring / /byang chub sems nyams mkha' 'gro'i gong 24—585

khyer bye ba 'jigs 'gyur lha dang bla ma sgrub la spyan mi blta/ /bde ba spangs phyir tshul khrims 'chal gyur dam tshig las 'das thub dbang bslus pas dmyal ba'i duḥ1kha myong / /gzi 'od rab zad rgyud las nyer gzir phrin las nyams shing dngos grub ring gyur rgas dang 'chi bas 'joms/ /lcung ba'i bde bas ye shes mi mthong 'dod chags dbang gyur rnal 'byor lam min tshe 'dir 'bras bu 'gag /so so'i skye bo nyams phyir 'bras chang zag dang don med tshangs spyod skams gyur don chung gla rtsi ngan/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang ldan pa'i thig le don ldan 'gyur te mdzangs 2pa'i nor yin yon tan rab tu 'phel/ /spyor lam la ni yun rings 'bad kyang skad cig gis nyams lo zla'i 'bras bu ser bas 'joms pa ltar/ /rdzas dang lam kha kha zas 'khrul 'khor rlung dang dmigs pas rang lus sna tshogs 'di 'phel bya/ /tshad med snying rje rab rgyas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 4rgya chen sems dpa' gsum ldan sngon du stong par sgom/ /rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung lag gnyis mnyam gzhag 5lus bsrang mgrin pa dgug cing dpung mgo legs par 6brkyang / /sna rtser mig gtad phyir la rlung bud nang du bsdu dang bskyar te dgang zhing mjug tu gyen la 'phang ro rkyang / /mi phyed phra gzugs brtan 'dzin rtog med gang ba'i dbus der 'bar ba'i a thung la sel bya/ /ske dang nyi ma lan tshwa spangs la mthun pa'i zas brten 8 thog mar rang lus bsgom bya dge ba bsngo/ /tsha zhing gzer zug 'thems 'chus lhags pas lus dang rtsa yin stong dang bug pa rlung gre chu sa sgom/ /nam mkhar sdigs mdzub rdo rje rol ba seng ge rnam grol brkyang bsgum rol stabs ri bong gyad 'dzin dang / /ka ra na te 'khrul 'khor 'di drug mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rdo rje gar bya drag po'i rlung gi bu//24—586

steng dang 'og tu blta zhing 'dug ste brtson pas 'bad na rtsa yi stobs rgyas lus kyi nad rnams 'joms/ / dbug rngam rgod 'gag 1bzlog 'tshub gtor ba rlung dang ngag ste g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab steng 'og bug pa sgom/ / stag mo'i skyug 2stangs sbrul gyi bya ba bsnyengs dang rgod kyi lding thabs ri bong mchog 'gros rma bya'i mjing skor 4dang / /seng ge'i sprug stangs 'khrul 'khor 'di drug ha rings hi thung hūṃ zhes drag pa'i 5rlung dang bcas te bu/ /des ni bzlog 'tshub gtor ba'i skyon spong rlung gi stobs rgyas ngag gi nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /'byongs 'dus ltengs 6pa yid kyi skyon ni nyams shing skam gyur chag 7dang zug rngu skyes pa thig le'i gags/ /sems ni bsrus phyir hūṃ gyur slar zhugs dbu mar thim ste gsang zhing 'phang bya gang 'dod yid la bsam/ /gu gul yungs kar thal chen gri khrag dug dang rus pa sbrang mar gcan gzan pags pa tsha ba gsum/ /'khrul 'khor drug dang rdzas sngags dmigs pa gzung rwabazlog dgram ste thig le'i stobs rgyas yid kyi nad rnams 'joms/ /mee phreng sdong po gtsub shing 'khor lo sum 'gyur kun khyab rnge yi dkyil 'khor drod kyi bogs su 'gyur/ /rlung gi gzhu yis me yi mda' 'phangs haṃ gi 'ben bcom lte ba'i snyoms 'jug yid 'phrog padma dang / /steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo kha spyor 'og ma 'byed 'dzum yid kyi rig ma bde stong bogs su 'gyur/ /padma'i phreng ba til gyi mar rnge mthing gi rgya mtsho rlung gi ba dan gsal ba'i bogs su 'gyur/ /lag pa'i phyag rgyas rigs lnga'i 'khor lo gsang ba'i rdo rje zhi bas gsor te dkar bsil ri bong dbab/ /'og rlung 'then zhing sgo gcig bsdams te gling bzhi bsnyus nas rig byed sor mos lam gnyis mtshams su mnan/ /yid kyi phyag rgya yid 'ong la sems snyoms 27(—587

'jug ting 'dzin g.yos pas bde stong dga' ba dang po'o/ /mchog gi gnyen po rtsol ba dor la dbang po bzlog cing lam gcig gling bzhi shesnartsol med mgrin pa dgug /steng dang 'og la rlung la 'dor len bya zhing chags pas mi 'phrogs 2ting 'dzin ro myang haṃ la gtad/ /rdo rje khu tshur gling bzhi bsnyu zhing ngan 'gro'i lam dag 1rgya mtsho ri zirab la sbyar lhun po dgug /ro 'dzin nyi zla steng phyogs thur sel gyen la 'dren cing sems dang thig le nam mkha'i phyadabus su gtad/ /lha dbang lhun po glang po snar 'dzin rnam 'gying rol pa rdo rje gtsug tor brgyad 6kyi 'dzin stangs dang / /rtse gsum gdengs ka 'di drug hika dang hūṃ gis steng 'og rlung gzung drag tu 'then pas bdun gyis 'drongs/ /sprugs thupa gar dang seng ge rnam rol rnam 'gying gzhon nu kun spyod lha mo'i rol stabs kyis/ /ldang dang 'dug cing thams cad bskyod pas sna tshogs lus sprug rab tu gsig cing skyil krung gdan la 'phags/ /rlung dang bcas pas ro stod ro smad mgo dang dbang bo yan lag bzhi ste gang 'dod rnams su dgram/ /thig le kun khyab ye shes bde chen ros gang bsgoms pas bzhi pa'i dga' ba rdo rje 'chang du 'gyur/ /sgrub 'dod slob ma theg chen rigs gyur gsang sngags la mos bla ma bzang 'dzin thar pa 'dod rnams kyis/ /dang po'i don du rnam bdun dbang sbyin mchog dbang bskur la slob ma smin byas skal 9ldan nyid du sgrubs/ /bla ma la gus blo bzang lang tsho brtson bcas gyur na gdams pa mchog sbyin dam tshig don du bstan/ /rnal 'byor rtog bral dkar po mi nyams ting 'dzin rgyas byed kun mkhyen thob phyir thabs dang ldan pas bya/ /gang zhig dkar po mi 'dor rnal 'byor pas ni rgyal ba'i bde ba sgrub cing pho nya'i lam/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa ma lus rgyud 24—588

du thub dbang rnams kyis yang dag lam du thabs 'di legs par gsungs/ /sgrub po lang tshos lus dar rtsa bzangs brtson bcas blo gros bzang ldan dbang gis rnam par smin/ /gsum pa'i dbang thob sngags dang rgyud kyi pha rol son cing bla ma'i lung gis sgrub dang skyon sel mkhas/ /dbang gi ye shes mngon 1 du byas te rtsa dang rlung 'byongs thig le la dbang gnyen ngo/ 'dzin nus shing / /dbang dang dkyil 'khor lha sngags rdzogs rim thabs lam mthar phyin sems nyid nges rtogs sa bcu mngon 2du 'gyur/ /dpal ldan rgyud mchog rgya chen bla ma'i man ngag rab zab rnams las dri med bdud rtsi'i bcud babs pas thabs lam man ngag rdo rje'i tshig 'byed me tog phreng 'dzin sbas pa'i gnad 'di don yod rdo rjes phye/ /de yi dge ba mtha' yas rgya chen mi nyung des ni bde chen dbus su lhan cig skyes pas rab tu 'khyud gyur cig /'gro ba kun gyi 4bskal pa'i lam chen tshe 'dir bgrod de rdo rje 'chang dbang sngon du byed par shog /rgyud dang man ngag thams cad kyi don phyogs gcig tu bsdebs mtshan ma gyen 'greng thig le'i 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag /rdo rje'i tshig rnam par dbye ba zhes bya ba/rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta a mo gha badzras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //2tsho(—589
