rgyun du btang ngo / /de nas bdag nyid gshin rje'i gshed dmar po 1rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ mdun gyi zur der/ dpal lha mo tsaṇḍi ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dmar nag /g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/ bdag gi bka' lung nyan par bsgoms pa/dam tshig gi rdzas phul bas mnyes par bya'o/ /oṃ shrī ya mānta badzra/ tsaṇḍi ka/rakta dza ṭi/ a mu shaṃ/ ka pa tri yan tri pa na tri/ ka bid ṭī/ ma hā ni tri/ka la na tri/ pi tso ka ya/ ma tsu kho/ u la tsa tsu tri/ kha na u ma tso/ kho la na tso/ /badzra tsa muṇḍi 4hūṃ/ pū tsa u a kha muṇḍi5/ i tsi mi tsi/ phu 6la u ma tsi/ kho khu li/ mi li tsu pa tsa ro/ tsa muṇḍi7/ ka ra i ka ra/sarba dubyen8/ a mu rka/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ i oṃ ba lo9/ rakta tsitta/ kha kha / khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣṭhan / a mu shaṃ/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa dang / skabs su drag po'i rdzas kyi sbyin sreg gis lha sbyin 11la brdeg par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor du srog chags mun ṭo ka la ngar sgra sgogs pa dang / rakta sa mu tra byung ba dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pas lha sbyin mi la brdung ba dang gdab par bya'o/ /lha sbyin yi dwags dang / ming la sogs pa thab khung du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /gtor ma yang lha sbyin gyi phyogs su dor ro/ /des ma grub na lan gnyis gsum du bsgrub par bya'o/ /des kyang las mi byed na/ dpal rdo rje tsaṇḍi ka sngon gyi thugs dam dran du gzhug pa'i man ngag bya ste/ gnad la dbab pas/mna' 5bskyal ba'i dam tshig dran pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar byas na sgrub pa po'i bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje tsaṇḍi ka'i salas sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon chen po bram ze dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—bye92

༄/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra bye ra wa sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo / /rab tu khros shing gdug pa 'dul/ /ma lus log pa'i bdud 'dul ba/ /zhal dang phyag drug mtshon cha 'dzin/ /ma he 4zhal la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa zhig /bdag gis dran nas brtsam par bya/ /dang por yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bdag nyid khrus byas te stan bde ba la 'dug nas/oṃ badzra bhe 5ra ba dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ/ zhes pas lus bsrungs nas/ bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /oṃ a bha bā swa bha wa bi shudhe badzra tsakra a a i a/ zhes bya bas stong pa nyid bsgom mo/ /de nas bdag nyid yi ge ar gnas pa las de'i 'od zer gyis tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi steng du a zhu ba las utpal 6'khor los 24—pya9 /

mtshan pa de zhu ba las bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba sgu mdog mthing nag g.yas na rdo rje g.yon na utpal 'dzin pa/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs la rgyan gyis brgyan pa bsam mo/ /de'i thugs ka nas nyi ma la hūṃ gnas pa can du bsams te/ hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra rgyun mi 'chad par byung bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ tshur hūṃ la thim pas/ zhe sdang gi sgur gyur pa ni / zhal drug phyag rnam pa drug dang ldan pa/ stobs che ba/ ma he'i zhal can / sku mdog mthing nag /mi mgo brgya'i do shal can/ zhabs brkyang bsgum 2du bzhugs pa/ phyag drug g.yas g.yon gyi dang po keng rus kyi dbyug pa dang rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi bar pa na mda' gzhu dang ral gri/ tha ma na sna tshogs rdo rje dang mdung bsnams pa'o/ /de las tshad sped pa bzhi'i khro bo 'phro ba can no/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bsgum du bzhugs pa bsgom / de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ bsams 4la/ spyan drang ba la sogs pa rdzogs pa dang gsang sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ/zhes pa'am/ oṃ duḥkha tshe da 5hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas mtshan gyi sgo nas bstod do/ /gtor ma btang nas gshegs su gsol te ldang bar bya'o/ /bdag gis dge ba 'di byas pas/ /bla rnged byang chub thob par shog /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon a sho ka shrīs mdzad pa sdogs so// //paṇḍi ta dharmā shrī mi tra dang / lo tsā 6ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //24—59ka

bldur mchan/594 tshotshotshomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ri bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bher ba swā/ bu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpa'/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tre/ thu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snye/ she7〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉 la/595 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngosam/ thu〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉rabasam/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du kha tshe ta—/ gye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lotstsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (8 2༷ )24dod596

༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bā rā tī sā dha rgo2/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sgrub pa pos gdug pa can rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gzhug pa'i phyir/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos dben pa'i gnas su song ste/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma sngon du song bas / rdo rje phag mo bsgom par bya'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de'i steng du g.yas gri gug 'jog pa/ padma dang zla ba'i steng du g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ g.yas bskum pas de'i byin pa'i steng du reg pa'i brkyang bsgum gyes bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra grol ba cung zad khro ba'i rnam pa can / rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gar gyi ro dang ldan pa bsgom mo/ /21—597

— ——dod —de'i snying ga'i chu skyes las zla ba'i steng du dhīḥdamar po blta'o/ /chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa kha phye 1ba la/ ā li bcu drug 'dab ma re re la gnyis gnyis mdun nas brtsams te/ g.yas skor du mgo gyen du bstan pa mdog dmar po bsams la / ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ a ā/ i yī/ u spru/ ṛ dṛ/ '-i shā/e i/ o au/ saṃ aḥdīḥswā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig 4pa'i sems kyis bzlas so/ /de'i man ngag ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros te song bas bsgrub bya'i snying la phog /bdag la ma dad pa'i dri ma phyir bsal 5te/ gus pa'i sems gsal bar skyes par bsam/ de nas bsgrub bya de'i snying gar sngags kyi dbyangs kyi yi ge bsams 6la/ bdag gi snying ga nas sna bug g.yas nas dīḥthon te/ sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te/snying ga'i dbyangs yig dang rang gi snying ga'i yig 'bru la bsil la bde ba bsam kho'i snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams dang / ming yig dang po skom dungs dungs par bsam mo/ /dhīḥl thim pas skom pa'i gdung ba sel ba dang / bde ba skyes nga/ de gzhibs nas/ yang snying gar bsdus pa la 'og gi tshigs bcad kyi don dran par bya'o/ /de ltar zhag bdun gyi mthar mtshan thog thag bya'o/ /des 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /yang rang kha nub tu bstan pa'i mdun du gre long la dris byugs te/ sintu ra bkram la/ de la padma 'dab ma bzhi pa lte ba dang bcas pa bris te/ lte bar dīḥ7shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du yo re baṃ lo rim pa bzhin bkod pa dang / ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang / nam mkha' la yi ge lnga bris pa lta bu ste/ nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang /21—598

ser po'i rnam par bsams la/ me long gi yi ge rnams la bsnyim1/ yi ge'i rnam pa can gyi mkha' 'a1 ma rnam pa lnga la sngags de nyid brjod cing / me tog dmar po dang / chang gi 2mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas phreng ba dmar po bzung ste / yi re baṃ lo dhīḥzhes bzlas so/ /lte ba'i yi ge las 'od kyi phreng ba spros te/mdun gyi sngags la thim pa la sogs pa spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rnam pa bya'o/ /de ltar sa ya phrag gnyis bzlas so/ /de nas nya'i nub mo mtshan thog thag bya'o/ /de ni bsnyen pa bya ba'o/ /de nas rang byung gi me tog sint+ra ra dang bcas pa'i maṇḍal sngar bzhin bkram ste/ shar la sogs pa'i yig —'bru yo la sogs pa bkod la/ snga ma ltar yi ge la bsnyim/ mchod pa rgya chen po bya zhing /sngags bzlas pas/ chu skyes kyi dīḥlas 'od 'phros te bsgrub 5bya mdun du bkug ste / 'gyel ba dang / yang spyoḥ'i 'od zer dmar po'i 6snying gar thim pas/dmar khrig ste khengs nas myos te/ bdag la chags pas brgyal bar bsams la/dhīḥl thim pa dang / yi ge sngags rnams rnam par yangs/ /sgra dang thig le sems kyang med/ /'di ni bde ba chen po'i mchog /bdag dang gzhan du yod ma yin/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar zhag bdun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis 8mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po rgyal ba'i sras bi byu ti tsand+ra'i zhal snga nas/dpal chos kyi dbyings kyi gtsug lag khang rang byung du mdzad pa las glo bo lo tsā 9ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //24—599

—sgrub thabs zhas bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra sā ra swa ti 2sā dha nai nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba ltar gsal blo ngan bsreg /dug 'joms gzhan dbang byed mar grags/ /bde ba phun sum tshogs ster ma/ /dpal ldan ma la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dur khrod la sogs pa yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dam tshig la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i sngags pas snga bar langs te/maṇḍal byug pa la sogs pa byas te/ stan bde ba la 'dug par bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i chu skyes la a las skyes pa'i zla ba'i 4dkyil 'khor blta'o/ /de'i steng du dhī5ཿdkar po'i 'od zer gyis nam mkhar bla ma dang rdo rje dbyangs can ma la sogs pa yang dag par bltas la/ snying ga'i sa bon las a 6'thon pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod yon la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas/ sdig pa la 24—601

sogs pa bshags par bya'o/ /yang byams pa la sogs pa yang bsgom par bya ba nyid do/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudheḥsarba dharmāḥ1swa bhā ba shusgolha pahaṃ/ zhes bya bas chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur rang gi rig pas shes par bya'o/ /yang snying ga'i sa bon gyis bsdus te dmigs pa med par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha4haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran pas rang gi sems baṃ gyi rnam pa / de yongs su gyur pa las padma dmar po/ de'i steng du a las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge dhīḥdakar po blta'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros shing basbus te yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje dbyangs can ma ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba padma dkar 5po dang zla ba'i steng na g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug bsnams pas rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod par mdzad ma/ g.yon pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ lo bcu drug gi cha byad can/ cung zad mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal/ dbu skra phyed grol zhing / phyed 'khyel ba/me tog gi thod can/ cod pan rdo rje thod can gyis brgyus 6pas mdzes pa/'khor lo dang rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang / 'og pag gis brgyan pa/ sum khugs su 'khyog cing spyod pa'i ba dan gyis dgyes pa/rus 7rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa'i phreng ba 'chang ba/gcer bu bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams can/ rnge long gi gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa/ sprul pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa/ thugs kar padma dmar po la zla ba'i steng du 24—602

—— ke——dod dhīḥdakar po bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis yang dag par bskul ba'i lha mo mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'dug ste/ mchod nas bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o/ /yang sa bon des bsgul ba'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa mdun du spyan drangs nas dbang bskur bar bya'o / /spyi bor sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'od dpag rnged kyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams kyis bdag nyid la yang mchod par bya ste/ bdud rtsi myang bar bya'o/ /de bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyangs can ma nyid do zhes nga rgyal brtan par bya'o/ /yang rang gi snying gar padma dmar po dang /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la trīḥbasgoms te/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba dkar po zhal nas 'thon pa de'i 'od zer gyis/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab dang ye shes dang yon tan gye tshogs dang / sngags dang sman dang nor bu dang bstan bcos dang sgyu rtsal la sogs pa'i nus pa dang stobs rnams blangs te snying ga nas 'jug cing / bdag dang gzhan gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa dang /rmongs pa'i mun pa thams cad bsreg pa'i bdag nyid du bsgom par bya ste/ de ltar ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bsgoms te/ spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor gyis myur ba la sogs pa'i skyon rnams dang bral bas sngags bzlas par byas te/sngags ni 'di'o/ /ldang bar 'dod na sngags kyi phreng ba dhīḥyig la bstems la mchod pa dang / gsol ba gdab ste yi ge brgya pa brjod cing / bsod nams yongs su bsngos te/ lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /thun gzhan la yang thams cad de bzhin du bya'o/ /mtshan phyed kyi thun la yang thams cad de bzhin du byas nas/ seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis lha dang bla ma yid 277—603

la byed cing nyal bar bya'o/ /blo brtan pos 'bum phrag bcu bzlas na 'grub par 1je tshom med do/ /bstan bcos thams cad shes par 'gyur ro/ /sgyu rtsal thams cad la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /smra mkhas par 'gyur ba dang /'khor gyis kyang zil gyis mi non pa dang / 'jigs pa med pa dang / yid gzhungs par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros phra ba dang / blo gros zhib par 'gyur ro/ /sngags grub pa las thod le skor la sngags btab ste/ gang la byen pa de blo dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /thabs shes rab zung 'jug gi ye shes phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur ro/ /dug gi gnod pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zas bdud rtsir 'gyur ro/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /dug sbrul la sogs pas nye bar mi nus so/ /'dis nye bar gtses pa gzhan rnams la yang phan par 'gyur ro/ /dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gye paṇḍi ta chen po rgyal ba'i sras dpal bi bhū ti tsand+ra dang / glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen kyis chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang sku mkhar nyi gzungs su bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o// // 24—604

bsdur mchan/6༷1 lkumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra / /dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ phu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shrī badzra swa ra swa ste/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma / gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gizla ba'i/ ‘she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra a/6༷2 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wa shurtse sarba dharma/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7lha/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sta/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha—/ dzu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dmar/ khye 〈〈pe 〉thargyud/ tshome 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rus/6༷4 1/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa/ (kye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skalas/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉 bkra shis// maṅgā lo//bsdur 'azas re'u migabyud/ (8 22)24 dod605

0896༄/ /rdo rje dkar mo'i rjes su 'dzeen pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ hūṃ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra go rī ldu.a nu gra ha sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje dkar mo'i rjes su 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dkar mo sgrub par 'dod pa'i sngags pas / yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad la brtse ba chen pos phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa nas/ btang stoms kyi bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid sngon du byas pa'i rjes la/sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i steng du/ ru'i yi ge ser po dang ral gri las sku mdog gser dang mtshungs so/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ma rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon kyi zhal/ ser po dang dmar po dang dkar po'o/ /g.yas pa na ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / gri gug go/ /g.yon pa na 'khor lo dang / padma dang /thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /spyan gsum ma/ mgo bo'i phreng ba'i cod pan dang /24—606

mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i ro dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang dang / zla ba la ru yig ser po'o/ /rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ gi rnyi ra badzra karti ta 1gha gha hūṃ/ rakta sho ṇi ta dṛ —ye/go ri 2ye bigha na dza dhīḥzhes 'bum phrag gcig rtse gcig zupas bzlas so/ /de nas las nye bar bsgrub pa'i phyir sngon du bsnyen pa mtshan ma thob kyi bar du bya'o/ /des 5grub la sngags kyis skyebasgrub par bya'o/ /de nas bla gab med pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya ste/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang bcas pa'i gzhal med khang pa'o/ /'dab ma brgyad pa la klu chen po brgyad kyi 1 mjug mas mnan pa'i rtsang ke tu'i gzugs ra yig las skyes pa dzre bar bya'o/ /de'i phyag g.yas na klu'i zhags pa/ g.yon na shasti bsnams pa'o/ /de'i steng du dpal rdo rje go rī ma snga ma lta bus mnan pa'o/ /der mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pa bshams te/ slob dpon bdag nyid grogs dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa la brten pas/ma rungs pa'i sems kyis sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ nyi shi mu ta tse du ma ma sha lā ka la dza la ti a dzi te swā hā/ tarya thā/ tsa ta tsa ta/ tsi tsaṇḍa/ tsi tsaṇḍa/badzra ṣe la ṣa la te swā hā/ oṃ li du la dza ma ka swā hā/ sngags gsum po de stong phrag bzhi bzlas pas so/ /oṃ pa sha mi gi ṭu ma sha dza ti a dzi te swā hā/ brgyad kyis lhag pa'i brgya phrag gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /yang sngags de gnyis kyi rim pa yin pas bzlas par bya'o/ /de ltar gnyis kyis mtshan ma thob kyi bar du byed pa ste sngon du bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo la mngon du phyogs pas/rkang pa chu'i nang du bcug ste/ rtsa ba'i sngags dang snying po dang / las kyi 24—607

sngags rnams gcig bar bzlas par bya'o/ /yungs kar gyis bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /yul brta rmyebar bya ba'i phyir zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma rgya cher bya'o / /gal te zhag gsum gyi bar du char mi phebs na de'i tshe kham phor du klu'i gzugs brnyan sngags snying gar bzhag pa gzhug ste/ de la mchod nas kha sbyar la byang nub kyi phyogs su drag po'i thab khung du bcug ste/ 'og gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor du btang bas rlung cher g.yos nas me 'bar nas chu bsros kyete/ klu chen po rnams kyi dug rlangs pa dang / rgya mtsho'i rlangs pa byung bas bar snang du sprin char du lte bar babs par bsam mo/ /gal te de ltar byas kyang zhag lnga'i bar du char mi phebs na/ de'i tshe ke tu la drag por bsdigs par bya'o/ /rdo rje dang don grub kyis bsnun pa spyodang bcas pas/ oṃ ha na ha na badzra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes dam tshig brjod nas/ oṃ pa sha mi ke tu ru mi shi ka dza la ti oṃ badzra la te swā hā/ oṃ bhin dhar ra hūṃ ma hā gro dha pā da ṣā la ṣā la te swā hā/ oṃ ke tu yakṣa dza la re shī li tī la ya sarba swā hā/ khri bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas dam bcas pa rjes su dran nas char nges par 'beebs par 'gyur ro/ /dpal rdo rje dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur choba'i slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi paṇḍi ta rgyal sras dpal bi bhū ti tsand+ra phyedang / glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis chos kyi rgyal po'i khab sku mkhar nyi gzungs su bsgyur cing zhus te gtan phab pa'o// //24—608

bsdur mchan/6༷6 tsho1tsho mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga /rdo rje dkar mo sgrub thabs// ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ri/ 6༷7 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉71 karte ka khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pri/ 1 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉dri/ 4/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rtse gcig sge 〈〈bee 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de'i/ 'u 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/6༷8 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lha/ kṣe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesas/ khya7〈〈co 〉7ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉lo sgyur/ 〈〈snar 〉〉lo bsgyur/(snye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bhu tsaṇḍa/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (8 23)24 dod609

༄/ /las kyi gshin rje'i mchod pa'i cho ga bzhugs so//༄1 ༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gzhan bar chad zhi ba dang / /dngos grub mthar phyin bya ba'i phyir/ /las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas kyi/ /mchod pa'i cho ga 'di ltar bya/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas mdun bskyed snemachod/ /ri rab bang rim bzhi pa yi/ /rtse la chos kyi rgyal po ni/ /nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /padma nyin byed ma he'i steng / /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pas bzhugs/ /rdo rje thod dbyug sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /dar dang stag lpags na bza' gsol/ /sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /zhal gdangs mche gcigs khro gnyer bsdus/ /spyan gsum drag po'i me stag 'phro/ /skra ser sma ra gyen du 'dzings/ /rngam gtsigs gtum po mi sdug pa/ /mchan khung g.yon na tsa muṇḍa / /rnam dag rtse gsum 'dzin pa bskyed/ /de yi phyi rim steg bu la/ /ya ma rā dza skyod 4byed 'bar/ /24—610

ma ru tse dang ral dgu ldan/ /ded dpon mngags pa pho nya'i tshul/ /'khor dbyug padma ral gri rnams lku/ /thams cad rdo rjes mtshan pa 'dzin/ /g.yas su ya ma dhu ti dang / /kā la pa sha daṇḍi nag /ya ma rdabhe lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa bee con mche ba rnams —/ /'khor los mtshan pa phyag na bsnams/ /g.yon du kā la ra tri dang / /gsod ma nag mo chen mo dang / /nam gru sha ka li la sogs/ /me long nad rkyal dru bu dang / /khram shing padmas mtshan pa 'dzin/ /g.yon na sho rde dkar nag go/ /sngo dkar dmar ba'i kha dog can/ /cha lugs gtso bo bzhin du bskyed/ /de yi phyi rol stegs bu la/ /phyogs bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi/ /g.yas g.yon gza' brgyad klu chen brgyad/ /de yi phyi rim stegs bu la/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang sde brgyad dang / /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams/ /rang rang gzugs sam gtso bo bzhin/ /'byung po kun gyis bskor ba bskyed/ /gnas gsum byen brlabs dbyings nas dgug /dbang bskur rdo rje sems dpa'i rgya/ /tshogs dang gtor ma'i mchod pa dang / /gur phod dang ngar glud dang / /nam mkha' ba dan mda' dang 'phang / /srog chags sna tshogs dur ba dang / /rin chen lnga dang 'bras bu dang / /gling dang gling phran la sogs pas/ /mchod dang bstod pa las bcol bya/ /'jig rten rang gi 'dod pa dang / /mthun 5pa'i las kun bka' bzhin bsgrub/ /gangs ri'i khrod na rgyal po'i bu/ /sbyin bdag chen po'i bzhed pa bzhin/ /bod kyi lugs dang mthun pa 'di/ /'gro la phan pa'i ched du bsgrubs/ /bla ma'i lung dang mi 'gal zhing / /gdul bya'i blo dang mthun pa yi/ /man ngag lha yi rjes gnang nas/ /bhaṅga la las brjod pa yin/ /rgya gar shar phyogs kyi 2(—611

paṇḍi ta dpon ā tsaryas phyamadzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta de nyid dang ⑤/ lo tsā (1 ba zhe sdang rdo rjes dag par bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/61༷ humatshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉non /bcom ldan 'das zhe snang gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// 3)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ tshoge〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thun tri/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dzā myos/611 3)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsnams/ 5/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsnams/ stso)〈〈pe 〉stanadhe/ 〈〈snar 〉〉shod dhe/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skomadun/612 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhar pañtsa tsa rgyas/ treX〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/dang / ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (824)24wa 612

༄/ /dpal rdo rje 'dzeegs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs jes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī 2badzra bye ra ba sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan sku mchog 'jig dus me ltar 'bar/ /rdo rje 'jigs par byed la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yis las rnams rab tu sgrub pa'i phyir/ /ma te'i gdong gi snying po'i sgrub zithabs bri/ /yid dang mthun zhing dbeen pa'i gnas dag tu/ /dang por bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /ma te'i gdong can skad cig rnal 'byor pas/ /lha dang bla ma mnyes byas de rjes la/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong ma yin pa/ /sems nyid spros dang bral ba rnam par bsgom/ /yo las rlung ste re las bskal me 'bar5/ /de nas hūṃ spros rdo rje'i rang bzhin nam/ /a las zla ba rgyas pa'i steng nyid du/ /dhīḥlas 6'jam dpal gzhon nu bskyed par bya/ /24—613

thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams snabasams la/ /de stengs hūṃ yig nag po 'bar ba blta/ /de nyid yongs su gyur pa rdo rje gdengs/ /thams cad yongs gyur bcom ldan ma te'i 2zhal/ /sku mdog sngo nag char sprin lta bur 'jigs / /sku las me 'bar khams gsum sreg par byed/ /khro bo dur khrod thod pa'i do shal byas/ /zhal gcig ma he nag po rgod pa'i zhal/ /rwa gnyis bar du 4gzhon nu'i zhal gyis brgyan/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje gdengs pa'i gri gug 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis/ gyad kyi dor stabs ro yi gdan/ /ma te'i 5nag po'i steng du rnam par bsam/ /mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur pa dang / /snying gar nyi la 6hūṃ yig 'bar bar bsam/ /de la )dgug dang bcing ba la sogs bya/ /de nas de nyid skar ma'i tshogs 'dras bskor/ /g.yeng ba med par rtag tu bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag gsum du bzlas pa bya/ /de yis tsho las rnams thams cad 'grub/ /gal te ldang bar 'dod pa na/ /ye shes ma he'i zhal la ni/ /mchod cing bstod la 77ldang bar bya/ /ma he'i sbyor ba rnam par rgyu/ /shin tu rtogs dka'i rgyud las ni/ /las rnams thams cad spyor ba'i lha/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gdams pa 'di/ /blo dman rnams la phan phyir bkod/ /dge ba cung zad thob pa des/ /bdag dang 'di la mos pa rnams/ /nad dang 'jigs sogs rab bcom nas/ /myur du 'jigs byed chen por shog /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ma te'i gdong can dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/slob dpon mañdzu badzras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—614

0899༄ / /rdo rje 'jogs byed kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/sna ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra bye ra ba ga ṇa tsakra nā ma/ bod skad du / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid gtso/ /dang por rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal nas/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bdag gis bshad/ /sngags pa mchog tu rtog med pas/ /dus kun du ni mnyam par gzhag2 /rgyud kun gyi ni rjes 'brang shes/ /de nyid bcu ni mchog tu rig /zab cing rgya che chos rnams la/ /yid ni dal bar gyur pa dang / /nga rgyal med pa'i slob ma rnams/ /legs par thos 'dod dang rnams la/ /tshogs kyi lha ni yongs rdzogs pas/ /'dod yon lnga yi 'bras bu ster/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i khang pa ru/ /der ni rang gis mchod pa brtsam/ /rnal 'byor rgan pa'i rim pa yis/ /phyag dang mchod pa bya 24—616

bar grags/ /yang na yon tan che ba'am/ /mgron po yin phyir gus pa dang //khrus dang dri zhim gos dang ni/ /me tog phreng bas brgyan pa dang / /mchod yon bdug pa ci nus pas/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo brtsam par bya/ /las kyi rdo rje mnyam bzhag 1pas/ /'di dag la ni bsang gtor bya/ /mdzod spu spyi bor thal sbyar nas/ /yan lag brgyad kyis phyag bya'o/ /rin chen snod sogs gtor ma gzhag /rgyal ba 'jig rten 'das la dbul/ /'jig rten pa dang sngags lha la/ /de nyid rig pas mchod pa brtsam/ /rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i spyor ba yis/ /padma'i snod du bdud rtsi che/ /lcags kyu bcu ni yang dag bzlas/ /de dag thams cad tshim par bya/ /thun mong kun gyi mchod pa dang / /kun la gsang ba mchog gi mchod/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang gnas/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo 'jug par bya/ /bu mo dal ba snyetshang zhing zhal gyi padma'i mgo bo smad/ /yon tan chen po shin tu rgyas shing de nyid yang dag rig par rung ba nyid/ /sems kyi rnam rtog bral zhing rgyan rnams kun dang ldan/ /nu ma gnyis ni mchog tu rgyas pas bdud rtsi'i snod ni de yis 'bul/ /rang byung ye shes me 'bar bas//'od 'phro gdan gyi lus 'bud cing / /khar ni de nyid sbyin sreg phyir/ /ro la sogs pa dbab par bya/ /de nas snying ga'i zla dkyil sar/ /thig le'i 4lha ni mnga' bdag che/ /yang na rang gi 'dod sogs lha/ /'khor lo rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /ming med thig les zhithig le ste/ /de nyid bsrung 6bsrubs 'od zer can/ /lce yi rtse la nyung zad dgod/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis tshim bya'o/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo nā de las/ /byung dzwabs de yi ro bkug nas/ /lan gsum du ni 'thungs nas su/ /rnal 'byor pa de bde bar gnas/ /bi mu ma ra shu da 24—617

ha na go ku pañtsa kai/ /rgyud dang rgyud gzhan brjod pa yinya/ /gzhan yang bdud rtsi chen po rnams/ /bar snang du ni gnas pa la/ /kun la mdzub gtor byin par bya/ /dpa' bos dpa' bo'i lha dang ni/ /lha mo kun gyi tshogs la gsal / /lcags kyu bcu yi de nyid ni/ /thogs 2nas sbyin bdag sems dag phyir/ /ji ltar rigs par rtogs nas ni/ /phyi rol lha la dbul bar bya/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas nyid/ /kun gyi snying rje'i stobs kyis bsgrub/ /rdo rje dril bu ldan pas bstod/ /'khor los sgyur la bstod par bya/ /sgeg pa'i tshul kyis ster ba dang / /mchod rdzas kyi ni snod dag rnams/ /so so'am kun la gcig tu'o/ /dag dang ma dag spyad mi bya/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i bza' dang btung ba rnams/ /mchod pa sna tshogs mang po yis/ /rdo rje can gyis mchod pa yin/ /ci bde ji ltar 'dod par gsol/ /de ltar seng ge bzhin du dogs sked rtogs bral bas/ /srid zhi'i go 'phang de nyid gnas pas bde bar ldan/ /rang gi yid ce'ong ke shi ka la sogs pa'i glu/ /rgyal ba ma lus tshogs la gar gyis kyang ni mchod par bya/ /snod ni gang gis lag par gzhag /gar gyi lag pas snye gzung bar bya/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /smod par gyur na chad pa thob/ /lus ngag yid kyi las kyis ni/ /la la dul bar ma gyur na/ /chad pas de ni zhi ba'i phyir/ /de yis ji ltar rigs 7snyepar brtag /lag pa gnyis kyi phyag rgya yis/ /de nyid gtso bo'i cho ga bzhin/ /phan tshun du ni tshim par bya/ /sgeg dang rtse ba'i ro yis bde/ /zab dang rgya che'i 3gtam brjod cing / /de nyid brtson pas mchod par bya/ /glu dang rnga sogs gar gyis ni/ /thabs dang shes rab bde ba'i mchog /phan tshun du ni 24—618

mnyam par gus/ /dam tshig nyan par shin tu 'dod/ /pha rol phyin bcu sbyor ba yis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis mchod sbyin bya/ /'gro bar 'dod pas thal sbyar nas/ /sngon du bzod gsol 'gro bar bya/ /bya ba byas nas blo ldan gyis/ /de nas phyag byas 'jug par bya/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor bdag nyid dang / /rtag tu de nyid lam la zhugs/ /rtag tu 'dul bar ldan pa yin/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bya/ /spyin pa'i zas sbyin pa rnams la/ /phyag rgya thun mong du ni brjod/ /de phyir grol bar 'dod pa yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /ji srid rang gi bde 'dod pas/ /'di nyid rol dang sgeg pa yis/ /de srid phyag rgya lhan cig tu/ /gnyug ma 'di yis mchod par bya/ /mig la sogs pa'i thabs chen gyis/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje ma yi tshogs/ /rnam shes rnams kyi bde chen bo/ /phyi rol kyi ni rtag tu 'jug /rdo rje padma'i 'od zer kyis / /zla ba'i 'od zer dkar po 'dra/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs kyi 1'od zer 'byung bas rang bzhin med par rang bzhin can/ /shin tu bde ba mchog tu 'phags pas yid du 'ong ba'i shes rab bka' nyan las/ /dag pa'i lce yis len byed sems can de ni rdo rje sems/ /de nas gshegs gsol thob pa na/ /bkra shis klu dang lha kun la/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo mngon byas nas/ /yon bdag mgo la rnge tog gzhag4 /bkra shis brjod la sdom pa sbyar/ /'byung po thams cad sangs rgyas su/ /bla na med par smon lam gdab/ /lhag ma'i gtor mas tshim par bya/ /gtor ma chen po yang dag bsnyus/ /chos bdag ye shes gyur nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pas dge la sbyar/ /mtho gang tsam gyi 4mtho ba ru/ /rgyal ba chos kyi gzhi bsam bya/ /de las bdud rtsi rgyun 'dzag pa/ /24—619

rang nyid la ni bsam par bya/ /yungs kar tsam gyi phra ba ni/ /rdo rje can gyi mtshan ma ste/ /rdo rje rtse'am sna rtser bsam/ /brtan par gyur nas 17spro bar bya//snyeng ga'i dkyil ni nam mkha' la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ste/ /der ni chos kyi 'byung gnas gnas/ /phra mo'i rdo rje rtag — 7tu dran/ /rdo rje la sogs ro dang ldan/ /yid kyi rang bzhin rnam thar gsum/ /rnam pa kun gye don dag la/ /'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba che/ /thabs dang shes rab rnal 'byor dag /las kun la ni thams cad du/ /yang dag byang chub legs sems gzugs/ /de nyid brtson pas bsam par bya/ /sngags ni srog gi yi ge bzlas / /thig le'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /chos dang chos min las grol ba/ /rtag tu yongs su bsgom par bya/ /de yis dus sam thams cad du/ /grol ba'i lam la brtson pa yis/ /rtag pa'i dus su bsgom byas na/ /de yis grol thob phun sum tshogs/ /'gro ba rnams kyi bsam pa sbyin pa la sogs kun gyis jemyur du yongs rdzogs nas/ /bdag med rdo rje la sogs kyis ni rnam rtog rmongs pa'i gong khyer thams cad brtag byas nas/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor lo gang zhig bskor bas bla ma'i ye shes 'char zhing thar pa ster byed pa/ /'phags pa de yi pethugs rje chen pos nad rnams rtag par shin tu grol bar byed/ /zab pa'i tshogs kyis yon tan gter ldan pas/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rtog pa las rgyal nyon mongs spangs pa yi/ /bag chags bcas pa'i gnas las gol zhing rnam grol ba'i/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam grol spyornal 'byor pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yan lag rgyan rnams kyis ni rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /nam mkha' zla ba'i 'od zer cha ni rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa gang / /shes rab 24—020

tshogs kyi bdag nyid la ni phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das bcas bla ma'i 'khor lo can/ /bsgom bya rnam par bsgoms pas 'gro ba grol ba'i phyir/ /gang zhig phan pa'i bsam pas 'dir ni dkyil 'khor byed pa yi/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed pa de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sems can thams cad la gnas dri med dngos po yi/ /bsgoms pas gsal bar gyur pa'i bde chen bsdus pa la/ /phyag rgya dang bcas byed pa de la 1phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ slob dpon ratna ā ka ra 2shārnyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/616 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /'jigs byed kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/617 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhag 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag 〈〈snar 〉〉 kun/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zod/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉yas / hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rasum/ dzee〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄nga / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha ra/618 sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yis/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thob/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yi/ 5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi/ sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉che/619 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha tsam gyis/62༷ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgroXs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rnam grol/621 tsho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rag rī〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rir/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7tstsha/24—621
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (826)24wa 622

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sbre sbrenda ra kalpa/ bod skad du/ dzra dzranda ra'i rtog pa/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje 2gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sgo sgonda ra'i cho ga zhib mo bshad par bya ste/ oṃ ru dro ya ma he shwa ra yo ga pra shā la ya/ yo ga sirnyi ma4/ da dā hi me swā hā/ hūṃ hūṃ haḥd ha da ha/pa tsa pa tsa/ urde 5ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rig sngags 'di'i bya ba'i cho ga ni/ nyin mtshan du ni mi nyal bar 6dri dang me tog dang bdug spos phul nas gtor ma btang ste/ stong phrag brgyad bzlas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas las rnams 7su gyur pa ni dzdza sgonda ra shi ba blangs la/ pags pa dang rus pa dang sha dang sru rnams phye mar btags te/ stong phrag gnyis bzlas nas phye ma des dpral ba la bskus na bdag nyid dgra yis mi mthong ngo / /oṃ ma ma hu ya ti/ phye ma des lag pa la bskus nas gang la reg pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de nyid 24—623

rkang pa la bsgus na dpag tshad brgya stong du phyin nas ldog go/ /phye ma de nyid kyis dgra'i sgo logs la bskus nas khyem kyi sgor stong phrag brgyad bzlas na sgod par byed do/ /phye ma de dang dur khrod kyi sa 1dgra bo'i sgo rtsar bcad cing sbas na dgra bo'i rigs rnams 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /yang na dgra bo'i rigs sgod par 'dod na/ sbre rjenda ra'i pags pa blangs la stong phrag brgyad yongs su bzlas nas gcin shul gyi sas bkang nas skud pa sngon pos bcings te nam mkhar btags na gcin 'gags par 'gyur ro/ /bgrol na thar ro/ /sbre tstshanda ra'i pags pa phye mar btags nas lha chen po'i mdun du stong phrag brgyad bzlas la/ yang dri dang me tog dang bdug spos dang / gtor ma btang ste/slar yang stong phrag brgyad bzlas na de nas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de sna'i rtse mor bskus na skye 'gro thams cad sdud 2par 'gyur ro/ /mgo bor bzhag na dgra thams cad dang 'gyed pa'i len 4jebs par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de nyid rang gi snying gar bsgus nas gal te dgra la bstan na snying ngan par 'gyur ro5/ /sā lu'i phye ma las 6gzugs byas nas phye ma des bskus na dgra bo de rengs par 'gyur ro/ / sā lu'i phye ma las dzwagazugs byas te phye ma des bskus na mdzes thebs par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi thal ba dang bcas pas dgra'i tshogs la gtor na gang gis mnan pa dang mthong ba de dag nad kyis thebs par 'gyur ro//phye ma de la lan stong bzlas na 9gang gang gi mgo bor blugs pa de dbang du 'gyur ro / /phye ma de thod pa dang lhan cig tu sgo glegs su bzhag na dgra bo dbye bar 'gyur ro/ /phye ma des ⑩bud rnged kyi lag pa la bskus na bud med de 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de gang gi sgor sbas na spod par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de dang 24—62 1

sha chen po bsres nas gang gi 1btung bar byin na/ nyi ma bdun na 'chi'o/ /phye ma de dag bshang ba dang bsres nas dgra la byin na/ dgra bo bkres pa dang /gzhang 'brum dang tshad pas thebs nas phyi nas ni rang nyid dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /spru sgonda ra'i rus pa blangs nas gang gi khyim du sbas na 'chi'o/ /sbre sgonda ra'i sha dang nya'i zhag dang bcas pas lha la mchod pa byas nas/ dur khrod du thod pa'i steng du 'dug la thod pa bzung la bzlas pa bya ste/ yang dur khrod kyi thal ba la lan stong du blugs shing sbyin sreg byas na 'grub par 'gyur te/ phye ma de tsha ba gsum dang bsres pas las su 'gyur ba ni/ gang gi khyem du bzhag na de la ske'i tsha ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de ske tshe dang bsres pas kyang las de nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de 4dur khrod kyi sa las 5gzugs byas te sgo rtsar sbas na 'phral nas 'phral du na tsha dang gsod par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de dang lan tshwar bsres nas gang la brdegs pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de yungs kar dang bsres nas rgyal po'i sgo la gtor na/ rgyal po de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gang gis mnan pa de dag thams cad kyang dbang du 'gyur ro/ /kham phor so ma btang ba la pha wang brun gyis byugs la/ dgra'i dri chen dri chu drod ma yal ba la bkab na/ dri chen dri chu 'gag go/ /phyung na 6slar 'tsho'o/ /sgo nd+randa ra'i rtog pa rdzogs so// //bha ro phyag rdum gyi phyag dpe las/ rwa — rdo rje grags kyis phyis bsgyur ba'o / / //271—625

gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā badzra bye ra ba ho ma bee bye nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i / /dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal te//de yi sbyin sreg cho ga bshad/ /gang yang rgyud rnams thams cad du/ /sbyin sreg cho ga med pa la/ /dngos grub 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /de bas sbyin sreg la 'jug bya/ /de la sbyin sreg gi rim pa ni slob dpon dbang bskur ba dang ldan pa/snying rje che ba/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ bla ma la gus pa des dur khrod la sogs pa rgyud las gsungs pa'i gnas yid du 'ong bar lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas la sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ sngon du bsten pa bya'o/ /24—627

thab 1kyi tshul ni gnyis te/ ro bsregs pa'i sa'am/ yang na khyem gyi phyogs gcig tu thab 2bya'o/ /khyem du thab bya ba ni gru gsum pa rgyar khru gang dpangs su de'i phyed la kha khyer sor gsum pas kun nas bskor ba/ ro bsregs pa'i thal ba dang / sol bas kha dog nag por byas la/ khro bo'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dri chen dang bong bu dang / rnga mo'i rtug pas byugs pas bsad pa la sogs pa'i las bsgrub par bya'o/ /thab 4kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /ro bsregs pa'i sa'am/ thab khang 5du rdzas gzhag pa ni mchod pa'i rdzas me tog nag po 7dri mi zhim pa dang / sha'am/ khrag gi dri spos dang /me mar chen po'i mar me dang / dri chu'i dri chab dang / mi la sogs pa'i sha'i lha bshos dang / khrag dang / zhag dang / tshil dang bcas pa'i mchod yon la sogs pa'i chu snod rnams ni rang gi g.yon du gzhag snyepar bya'o/ /mi'i rus pa dang / dri chen dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo'i rtug pa dang shing tsher ma can dang / dur khrod kyi yam shing dang / tsha ba'i mar nag dang / skra dang sen mo la sogs pa'i sreg rdzas rnams ni g.yas phyogs su gzhag 9 par bya'o/ /rdzas dgram pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas sgrub thabs las gsungs pa'i rim pas rang lha'i rnal 'byor byas la mchod rdzas dang / sreg rdzas thams cad byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ dhīḥbyeḥ.a zhes pas mchod yon lan gsum mam bdun gyi bar du mngon par bzlas la gzhug par bya'o/ /de bzhin du oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces bya bas bsang gtor bya 24—628

ba dang / oṃ ku mā ra rū pi ṇi dza dza zhes bya bas me tog dang / oṃ sthāḥha ha he phaṭa phaṭa ces bya bas bdug spos dang / oṃ dīpta lo tsa ni wi kṛ tā na na ma hā aṣṭa ha sa ni dīpta dībhā sheya swā hā/ zhes bya bas mar me dang / oṃ cha kṛ tā na na duṣṭa satwa dā ma ka bye gaḥgaḥdri'o/ /oṃ kā la rū pa sarba satwa da ma ka ma hā byu ta ba ti i rda ba lo griṇḍi kṛsnra gapa ya swā hā/ zhes bya bas lha bshos kyi ste/ de kho na nyid kyis gtor ma la yang mngon par bsngags 4la/ gong du gsungs pa'i bsang byegator gyis rdzas thams cad dang / thab khung la sogs pa la bsang gtor bya'o/ /rdzas byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas bud shing dang me blang bar bya ste/ bud shing ni ro bsregs pa'i mgal dum mam/ shing tsher ma can gyi rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba'o/ /shing tsher ma can ni/ nim pa dang / seng sdeng dang / ko bi da ra dang / ba la da ka la sogs pa'o/ /de la me yang ro bsregs pa'i sa'am/ gdol pa'am/sme sha can nam/ rdo las byung ba yang rung ste/ rab tu sbar bar bya'o/ /bud shing dang me gnyer ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de nas ji lta ba bzhin du bsang gtor byas nas me sbar bar bya ste/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces pas mngon par bsngags la/ 'og tu yang yi ge yi yongs su gyur pa las gzhu lta bus spor bar byed par bsam mo/ /me sbar ba'o/ /de nas hūṃ gis thab khung bskyed la/ dam tshig gi me lha 'di ltar bskyed par 'ubya ste/ dza las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du re yongs su gyur pa 24—629

las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ oṃ āskyeḥhūṃ gis 'khor lo dang / padma dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo'i me lha shin tu drag cing khro bar byed pa/ 'jigs pa dag kyang shin tu 'jigs par byed pa'o—/ /skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba 'od zer brgya stong du mas brgyan pa zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po zhe / g.yas pa dkar ba / g.yon pa dmar ba / phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang / spyi drugs dang /skyabs sbyin no/ /phyag g.yon pa rnams la dril bu dang / dbyug pa dang /bgrang phreng rnams 'dzin par bsgom par bya'o/ /sngags 'dis gnyug mar gnas pa'i rnge lha spyan drang bar bya ste/ oṃ e bye nyi ma hā byu ta de wa ṛ ngaṣi satwa ma a hu 5ti rasmin sa— hi to bha wa kro dha asne 6ma ma sha hūṃ mā 1ra ya phaṭa phaṭa ces pas thab kyi g.yas phyogs su bzhag la dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bcing ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang / khrus kyi cho gas khrus byas te/ thab kyi dbus su bsam par bya'o/ /me lha'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de nas mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams dbul bar bya ste/gong nas gsungs pa'i rim pas mchod pa thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod nas—/ dgang drugs gsum mam bdun yungs mar dang bcas pas zhal shin tu gdangs par dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmi 8ku ru sarba duṣṭa ma na che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas sreg 9drugs dbul bar bya ste/ shing tsher ma can kyi yam shing sor drug pa kha dog nag po dang yungs mar la sogs pa'i 21—630

rjas rnams la sngags 'di bzlas te gsad 1pa'i las bya'o/ /oṃ dīḥbyeḥli kṛ tā na na ma ma sha hūṃ 2mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces gsad par bya'o/ /dzha 4de sha ya zhes pa ni dgar ba'o/ /utstsha ṭa ya zhes pa ni bskrad pa'o/ /mo ha na zhes pa ni rmongs pa'o / /ste bha ya zhes pa ni rengs pa'o/ /udman da zhes pa ni thru ba'o/ /ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes pa ni 5dgug pa'o/ /raṣṭa ba da 6sha ya zhes pa ni grong khyer dkrug pa'o/ /wa shi 7ku ru zhes pa ni dbang du bya ba'o/ /de dag rtsa ba'i sngags sam/ snying po'am/ nye ba'i snying po'am/ gang yang rung bar bsngags 3la ming spel la/ las thams cad bsgrub par bya zhing tha ma yang dgang blugs gsum mam/ yang na bdun phul la mchod pa ni rnge lha mchod pa'i cho ga ste/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas me lha de'i snying gar yang rung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed ji skad du bshad pa'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan du ldan pa bsgom pa ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las zhal dgu pa/zhabs bcu drug pa/ phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ma te'i gdong can no/ /rwa g.yas pa'i phyogs kyi zhal gsum ni sngon po dang /dmar po dang ser po shin tu khros par bya'o/ /rwa g.yon pa'i phyogs kyi zhal gsum ni dkar po dang / nag po dang / dud ka'o/ /rwa gnyis kyi bar gyi zhal ni dmar po1/ de'i steng gi zhal ni ser ba cung zad tsam khro ba dang bcas par bsam par bya'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams la gri gug dang / thag mdung dang / gtun shing dang / gtub mtshon dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang /24—631

sta re dang / mda' dang / lcags kyu dang / dbyug to dang / kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / ral gri dang / cang te'u bsnams pa'o/ /phyag g.yon pa rnams la ni thod pa dang / a ko tse dang /phub dang / rkang pa dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / rgyu ma dang /dril bu dang / lag pa dang / dur khrod kyi ras dang / gsal shing dang /me thab dang / thod tshal dang / sdigs mdzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum dang / rlung gi ras rnams so/ /phyag dang po gnyis kyis ni glang po che'i pags pa 'dzin pa bsam par bya'o/ /zhabs g.yas pa rnams kyis ni mi dang /ma he dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo dang / glang dang / khyi dang / lug dang / wa rnams mnan pa'o/ /zhabs g.yon pa rnams kyis ni bya rgod dang /'ug pa dang / bya rog dang / seng ge dang / khra dang / bya chen dang /srin bya dang / khrung khrung rnams mnan par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sngags/ 'dis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bar bya ste/ oṃ trīḥsgo bho ma hā kro dha ā gatstsha ya ā 2gatstsha yā sma da pū dza pra ti kṛṇḍa pra sā dha me dhi man riku ru sha hūṃ 5mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas bsang gtor byas la dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bcing ba dang / gnyis su med par bya ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas gong ma bzhin du mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa bya ste/ dgang blugs dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas yam shing la sogs pa 'bar ba'i rdzas rnams/ ni bsgrub bya'i rus pa yin par bsams 6te/ 'od 'bar ba la bsreg par 24—632

bsam par bya'o/ /mar la sogs pa zhu ba'i rdzas ni bsgrub bya'i khrag yin par bsams te zhal du dbul bar bya'o/ /dri chen la sogs pa'i rdzas ni sha chen yin par bsams te phyag tu dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/thog mar dug dang / khrag dang / ske tshe dang / lan tshwa dang / nim pa dang / da du ra dang bcas pa'i yungs mar gyi dgang blugs so/ /de nas sreg blugs kyi rim pa 7ni yam shing dang / mar nag dang / khrag dang / dri chen dang / dri chu 2 dang / mi rus kyi phye ma dang / dug dang / ske tshe dang /lan tshwa dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo'i sbangs la sogs pa rnams las 1ṅga byas la/ de la bsgrub bya bstems ༄ —la gri gug gis gtub 4te dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la dbul bar bya'o5/ /de nas dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul la mchod pa lngas yang dag par mchod de/ dgang blugs kyi dus su ni gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub blang zhing me tog nag po las bsgrub par bya'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /de nas de kho na nyid las bsgrub par bya ste/ bsad 6pa la ni dug dang /khrag dang / ske tshe dang / lan tshwa dang / nim pa dang / da du ra rnams bsres la sngags dang 7spel nas bsreg pa'o/ /dbral ba ni bya rog dang /'ug pa dang / yang sbrul dang / sre mong gi sha'am/ pags pas so/ /bskrad pa la ni bya rog gi sha'am/ rnga mo'i sbangs dang / chang rnams lhan cig bsres pa'o/ /rmongs pa ni ldongs ros dang / yung ba dang / ldong ros dmar po dang / go ro tsa na rnams sbyar bar bya'o/ /rengs pa la ba bla dang /24—633

yung ba dang / ldong ros dang / gi wang dang bcas pas bya'o/ /spyo bar bya ba la ni srin bya'i tshang dang / sha chen dang gnyis kyis bya'o/ /grong khyer dkrug pa la ni khyi dang / sbal pa dang / rus sbal gyi sha dang / rnga mo mo gsham 1gyi sbangs dang / byi la'i khrag rnams cha bsnyams te sbyar ba'i ri lu byas la yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzlas pas so/ /rgyal po dbang du bya ba la ni rta'i sha dri chen dang gnyis mnyam por sbyar bas so/ /tha mal pa dbang du bya ba la zheni glang po che'i sha byang chub kyi sems dang bcas pas so/ /bud med dbang du bya ba la ni nya'i sha dang chang rnams 5bsres pas so/ /dgug pa la ni bdud rtsi rnam pa lngas so/ /las rnams so sor bsgrub pa'o/ /de ltar las rnams bsgrubs thuzin nas ni dgang blugs phul la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de sngags 'dis gshegs su gsol bar bya ste/ oṃ dza ya dza ya su dza ya bi shwa rū 5pa dha ri gatstsha gatstsha swa sthā/ rgo kṛ ta te ta thā ga ta na maḥ/ sarba bhū ta bi sardza ya ma ma katram̐ ku ru swā hā/ gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /ye shes kyi lha gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /de nas rdzas lhag ma rnams me lha la phul la gnyug mar gnas pa'i me lha 'dir gshegs su gsol bar bya ste/ oṃ khyod kyis 'gro ba'i don kun mdzad/ /dngos grub ji bzhin stsal lags kyis/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa'i me lha gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /24—634

dam tshig bsdus te de nas nya dang sha rnam pa sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i gtor ma dpal gshin rje gshed 'khor dang bcas pa la byin nas g.yon phyogs nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar de rnams byas las 1byung ba yi/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba thams cad kun/ /sdig dang bral zhing dge ba rab 'phel nas/ /dpal ldan 'jigs byed de dang 'dra bar shog /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga a mo gha badzras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/627 snamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rang /628 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra snyen pa bya'o// //thabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉byeg tu thab/ 〈〈snar 〉〉cig tu thabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasad/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skathung / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge rna'i/ 8 9 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhag629 ste〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dripta/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra da man/ 〈〈snar 〉stanaṇḍa kṛṇḍa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lngags/mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasang / 6〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/63༷ sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mos/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpo'o// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'o// 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉re/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snga tū/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes dhāsne/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rim/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smi/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stegs/631 rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasad/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas hūṃ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pas/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dzra dhe/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shang / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadags/ khe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ya'o//24—635

༄/ /dpal rjo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bye ra ba sā dha dzee no pi kā/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs mchog rab tu drag po che/ /dpa' bo mchog gi spyod yul can/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni yang dag par/ /bdag gis nges par brjod par bya/ /rtogs dga'i 2rgyud rtog la btud nas/ /rim pa 'di la 'jug par bya/ /phun sum tshogs sogs mtshan nyid can/ /bla ma dang po mnyes par bya/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed mchog gi don/ /thams cad slob mar de bzhin te/ /dus kun du ni snying rje ba/ /lus can kun la bsgom par bya/ /sngags pas thog mar langs nas ni/ /ci bde bar ni bsgom par bya/ /dang po dur khrod chu 'gram mam/ /shing gcig gam ni mtshan gcig gnas/ /24—637

bzhi mdo'am ni ri bo yi/ /rtse mo dang ni khang stong gnas/ /ma mo'i khyim mam yang thog mdzes/ /lha yi khang pa dag tu dang / /'thab mo'i sa dang grong khyer stong / /yid du 'ong ba'i gong dag tu/ /'bol ba'i steng 3sogs la 'dug nas/ /thang ka la sogs gzugs gzhan bsgom2/ /mchod dang bdud rtsi la sogs kyis/ /zhi ba la sogs khyad par rnams/ /sha rnams kun gyi gtor ma ni/ /'byung po la sogs 'jigs la sbyin/ /dang por lha la bzod par gsol/ /zhing skyong la sogs thams cad gshegs/ /snying gar zla ba nyi dkyil gnas/ /yi ge hūṃ ni 'bar ba'i mchog /de la 'od kyi phreng 'phro bas/ /'jigs byed la sogs bkug nas ni/ /lha rnams lag na thogs pa yi/ /mchod pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /de yis bcom ldan 'das rnams dgyes / /'khor rnams la yang lhan cig dbul/ /sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ /skyes shing byung ba rnams ni bsal/ /mi byed par ni 4spyan sngar brjod / /de bzhin bsod nams rjes yi rang / /bdag gis bde 'gro yongs su bsngo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis bsgral/ /byang chub gnas la dgod par bkyi/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /tshad med bzhi yi khang bzang 5lam/ /mchod pa bdun ni rab tu bya / /gtso bo mkha' la bzhugs su gsol/ /lha dang chos rnams thams cad kun/ /bdag med par ni bsam par bya/ /dang por sngags 'di brjod pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag med dran par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba 7dharmāḥswa bhā wa shusgolha snahaṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā bhe/dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha7haṃ / 'di yis chos rnams thams cad dang / /bdag nyid stong par rnam 24—638

par bsam/ /sems can bla med bya ba'i phyir/ /sngon kyi smon lam dran par bya / /stong las yi ge yo du gyur/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par bsam/ /du ba'i mdog can rdo rje'i gdan/ /de dbus yi ge a las zla/ /de yi steng du yi ge dhīḥ/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu yi ni gzugs/ /de yi snying gar rnam bsam pa/ /yi ge aḥ shesnalas nyi dkyil 'khor/ /bdag dang nyi ma gcig 2tu gyur—/ /de las 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /de rtser 'od zer rnam 'phro ba/ /'jam dpal gzugs ni bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje ral gri g.yas na 'dzin/ /g.yon pa na ni sdigs mdzub kyang / /bgegs dang bar chod yang dag gsod/ /slar 'dus de yi dkyil du thim/ /slar yang 'od zer spros pa yis/ /phyogs bcu por ni yongs su gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs dang byang chub sems/ /rig pa 'dzin dang lha yi tshogs/ /khro bo la sogs de dag kun/ /slar 'dus nyi mar rnam par thim/ /de bzhin gshegs dang 'jam pa'i dpal/ /rig pa 'dzin dang lha yi tshogs/ /nyi mar gcig tu gyur par bsam/ /gdug pa chen po'i 'od 'bar bas/ /dpag tshad dag ni stong phrag brgyar/ /thams cad khyab par rab tu gnas/ /de yi dbus su gzhal yas bsam/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes pa dang / /ba dan dril bu la sogs dang / /phreng ba la sogs rnams kyis spras/ /sgo khyud kyi ni phug 4dag tu/ /rdo rje rin chen sogs kyis spras/ /'khor lo nyis brtsegs yang dag bsam/ /lnga bcur gcig gis ma tshang dag /padma zla ba yang dag gnas/ /de dag steng na nyi dkyil 'khor/ /thams cad mchog tu bsreg pa yi/ /me lce 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /de la rim pa bzhin du yang / /lnga bcur gcig gis ma tshang 24—639

ba'i / /lha rnams de dkyil ro steng bsam/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang ni/ /byang dang dbus su go rims bzhin/ /mgo dang lag pa rgyu ma rkang / /me sogs grwa bzhi dag tu yang / /de bzhin thod pa thod tshal pa/ /dur khrod kyi ni ras kyang gzhag /skyes bu gsal shing btsugs pa gzhagatsho /de bzhin du yang phyag rgya'i ming / /shar la sogs pa'i snam bu bzhir/ /gri dang mtshon ni rtse gcig dang / /gtun shing dang ni chu gri dang / /rtse gcig lcags kyu ma te dang / /ba lang lhan cig shar du brgyad/ /sta re mda' dang dbyug to dang / /kha ṭwāṃ 'khor lo de bzhin zhags/ /phag dang bong bu lho phyogs kyi/ /snam bu la ni rim pa bzhin/ /rdo rje rnge chung dang ni phub/ /gzhu dang dril bu rlung gi ras/ /rnga mo khyi ni nub phyogs kyi/ /snam bu la ni de bzhin bri/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni 'phan rtse gsum/ /glang chen lpags dang tho ba dang / /mdung dang me yi thab dang ni/ /lug dang spyang ki lhan cig brgyad/ /byang du rtag tu bsam par bya/ /sgo yi phyogs su gzhag pa ni/ /shar gyi sgo ru bya rgod gzhag /lho yi sgo ru 'ug pa gzhag /nub tu bya rog seng ge yang / /byang du rnam par bsam par bya/ /me grwa khyung ni legs par gzhag /bden bral du ni khra gzhag go/ /rlung gi gnas su ri skegs te/ /dbang ldan du ni de bzhin bzhad/ /thams cad de bzhin rnam par dgod/ /zla ba'i gzugs su bsam par bya/ /dbus kyi zla bar yi ge dhīḥ/ /sngon gyi 'jam pa'i gzugs 'dra bar/ /gti mug brdzun dang chags phrag dog /shar sogs le'u tshe bzhi la'o/ /me yi grwa sogs rnam bsam pa/ /sems ma rdo rje de bzhin du/ /rin chen rdor ma bsgom par bya/ /chos kyi rdor ma de bzhin te/ /las kyi rdor ma rnam bsam bya/ /rdo rje rnon po 24—610

rdo ral gri/ /byams pa dang ni 'jam dpal gzhag /ye shes sku dang ngag dbang phyug /zla ba'i 'od dang ye shes mtsho/ /shar du brgyad po de dag gzhagalho phyogs su ni gzhag bya ba/ /rdo rje sna tshogs rdor gnon 1sbyin/ /rdo rje khu tshur rdo rje chos/ /rdo rje srung ba rnon rdo rje/ /rdo rje rgyu dang dra ba'i 'od/ /nub phyogs de bzhin brgyad gzhag pa/ /rdo rje smra ba rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje rgyal po rdo rje chags/ /rdo rje legs dang rdor rin chen/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang rdor nyi ma/ /byang du yang ni brjod bya ba/ /rdo rje dpal dang rdo rje bzhad2/ /spos kyi glang po ye shes rtogazhe /thams cad thabs kyis 'gro ming dang / /rgya mtsho'i blo gros legs par gzhag /blo gros mi zad bsgom par bya/ /bdud rtsi 'od 4dang brgyad gzhag go cho/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhi ru/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rdo rje zhags—/ /rdo rje lcags sgog rdo rje dril/ /rim pa bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /me la sogs pa'i grwa ru yang / /rdo rje gnod mdzes gtsug tor dang / /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad de bzhin du/ /rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub pa'o/ /shar gyi phyogs pa thams cad gnag /de bzhin lho pa thams cad ser/ /mun 6pa thams cad dmar po yin/ /byang ni thams cad ljang gu yin/ /'di dag sa bon yi ge ni//oṃ dzee j-i 7khaṃ/ saṃ re rghaṃ shaṃ/ baṃ khaṃ mo mo/ dzñā baṃ rtsa radhī/ bo yo dzee sgo/ram̐ tai haṃ rdzu/ lha baṃ dzā ram̐/ rsā ram̐ hūṃ baṃ/ shaṃ haṃ shaṃ dzñā/ saṃ sī e saṃ saṃ shaṃ 9phroṃ ghi—/ sum̐ sum̐ hūṃ a zhes pa'o/ /de nas yi ge a sogs ni/ /yi ge ha yi mthar thug pa/ /'di dag thams cad yongs gyur las/ /gong gi lha ru rnam bsam bya//yang ni —de bzhin kun la yang / /yi ge a las nyi dkyil 'khor/ /de bzhin nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las/ /'od zer dag ni rnam 'phros pas/ /phyogs 24dod641

bcu kun du bzhugs pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs dag yang dag bskul/ /thams cad dgyes byas slar yang ni/ /bsdus nas nyi ma dag la thim/ /de la zhugs pa brtan par bsgom/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsal/ /de yis rang bzhin dag pa'i ming / /'od gsal ba yi ting nge 'dzin/ /de la yang ni 'jam dpal sogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs kun/ /gtso la bskor nas lhan cig tu/ /de bzhin du ni thim nas kyang 1sna/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsam bya/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i gzugs can no/ /de yi dkyil du gtso sogs kyi/ /sa bon yi ge rnam bsam bya/ /yi ge hūṃ ni gtso bo sbyin/ /snying po thams cad nyi ma la/ /oṃ dīḥsgoḥwi kṛ tā na na/ gti mug sogs kyi dkyil 'khor lo/ /yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/ shar du yang dag bsam par bya/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ de bzhin lho yi phyogs su gnas/ /ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/nub phyogs snam bu la ni sbyin/ /ya da yo ni ra yakṣe ya/ byang du lha de gzhag par bya/ /ya mānta ka sgo bzhi ru/ /shar la sogs pa rnam bsam bya/ /oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ me la sogs pa'i grwa bzhi ru/ /thams cad 'od zer lnga rang bzhin/ /dbus sogs shar phyogs dkar po yin/ /ser po dmar po ljang gu'i mdog/lho dang nub dang byang yin no/ /de bzhin thams cad 'od zer ni/ /rnam par 'phro bar bsam par bya/ /sngon brjod de bzhin gshegs la sogs/ /slar yang bsdus nas gzhug par bya/ /dbus kyi yi ge las khro bo'i/ /rdo rje chen po kha dog gnag /'od zer 'gyed par rnam bsam bya/ /de bzhin rdo rje phra mo'i gzugs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems khro bo/ /rig pa'i lha mo nam mkha'i steng / /til gyi gang bu bzhin gang bar/ /gnas par bsam par bya 24—642

ba yin/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas la sogs pas/ /sems can yongs su smin par yang / /btul nas byang chub la gzhag ste/ /yang bsdus 'ongs te rdo rje la / /thim par rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /'khor ba gnas pa byas pa ni//sngon du brjod pa'i mgo sogs brgya/ /'od ltar kha dog khyad par sbyar/ /'od zer rang bzhin rnam bsam bya/ /so so rigs kyi lha bzhin du/ /nam mkha'i steng du gnas pa ni/ /til gyi gang bu bzhin nyi ma'i/ /gdan la mngon par gnas par bsgom/ /de yis 'gro don byas na yang / /'ongs nas rang la gzhug par bya/ /slar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thams cad 'og tu rang gnas su/ /rang mtshan lhan cig yongs su gyur/ /gtso bo la ni bskor nas gnas—/ /myur ba nyid du sku ru rdzogs/ /dhīḥbyeḥbarjod pa'i rang bzhin can//gtso bo bstan pa de bzhin 'dir/ /sgrub pa pos ni de bzhin bsgom/ /de ni rdo rje yi ni gzugs/ /zhal dgu pa ni rtag tu drag /ma te yi ni gzugs can te/ /'jig pa'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /thams cad drag po'i bdag nyid gzugs/ /dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /khams gsum po 1ni za bar nus/ /rnam par gcigs pa'i zhal bgrad pa/ /ljags 'dril ba ni gzi brjid che/ /rdo rje me dang mnyam par 'phro/ /rnam par gabyugs pa drag por gcigs / /khro gnyer zhal bgrad smin bgreng spyan/ /'jig 2pa chen bo'i dus dang mnyam/ /'brug gi sgra dang rtag tu mtshungs/ /mi yi khrag dang rkang dang zhag /tshil bu klad pa za rang bzhin/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das sogs pa'i/ /lha la bsdigs par byed pa'i gtso/ /brgya byin tshangs dbang bisngu dang / /gzhon nu bi nā ya ka sogs/ /thams cad yang ni gsol bar 24—643

byed / /thod pa yis ni thod du byas/ /lha la 'jigs pa chen por byed/ / phe gyi 1sgra ni sgrogs pa yin/ /shin tu khros pa yi ni gzugs/ /thod pa'i 'phyang 'phrul dag gis brgyan/ /kham 1pa shin tu yang dag badzees/ /gcer bu zhabs ni bcu drug ste/ /g.yon pa'i zhabs kun brkyang pa yin/ /'dar zhing g.yo bar yang dag sbyor/ /'jigs pa chen po yi ni sku/ /thams cad 'bar ba gyen du badzees/ /phyag ni sum cu rtsa bzhi ste/ /gnyis kyis glang po'i pags rlon 'dzin/ /g.yas kyi dang po gri gug 'chang / /gnyis pa rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /gsum pa gtun shing de bzhin no/ /bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa nicho/ /chu gri rtse gcig sta re'o/ /bdun pa mdung rtse brgyad pa na/ /mda' ste dgu pa lcags kyu'o/ /de bzhin bcu pa dbyug to'ozhwa/ /bcu gcig pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /de bzhin bcu gnyis 'khor lo'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni 7rdo rje ste/ /bcu bzhi pa na tho ba'o/ /bco lnga pa na ral gri ste/ /bcu drug pa na rnge'u 7chung ngo / /g.yon pa'i dang po thod pa ste/ /gnyis pa na ni mgo bo'o/ /gsum pa phub ste bzhi pa rkang / /lnga 9pa de bzhin zhags pa'o/ /drug pa gzhu ste bdun rgyu ma/ /brgyad pa dril bu dgu ni lag /bcu pa na ni dur khrod ras/ /bcu gcig skyes bu gsal shing btsugs / /bcu gnyis pa na me thab bo/ /bcu gsum pa na thod tshal te/ /bcu bzhi pa na sdigs mdzub bo/ /bco lnga pa na 'phan rtse gsum / /bcu drug pa na rlung gi ras/ /rim bzhin bsgom ste gzhan yang ni//g.yas kyi rkang pa dang pos mi/ /gnyis pa yi 1 ni ma te'o/ /gsum pa yis ni ba lang ste/ /bzhi pas de bzhin bong bu'o/ /lnga pas rnga mo drug pas khyi/ /bdun pas lug ste brgyad spyang ki/ /g.yas kyi rkang pas sade dag zhon/ /g.yon 24—6 4tsho1

gyi rkang pa dang po yis/ /bya rgod gnyis pas 'ug pa'o/ /gsum pas bya rog bzhi pas seng / /lnga pas khyung ste drug pas khra/ /de bzhin bdun pas ri skegs te/ /brgyad pa yis ni bzhad yin no/ /rim pa bzhin du zhon pa'o/ /dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal/ /dang po ma he'i gdong pa ste/ /nag po 1 khro ba g.yas pa yi/ /rwa rtsa na ni zhal gsum ste/ /g.yas kyi dang po'i zhal ni sngo//de yi g.yas dmar ser po dang / /g.yon pa'i rwa rtsa'i zhal gsum ni/ /dkar dang dud ka nag po'o3/ /thams cad shin tu khros pa ste/ /zhal gtsigs par ni rnam par bsam/ /rwa gnyis kyi ni dbus ma'i zhal/ /brgyad pa yin te dmar po'o/ /zhal nas khrag rnams 'dzag pa ni/ /shin tu de bzhin bsgom par bya/ /de yi steng du kun bzang gi/ /zhal ni cung zad ser ba'o / /cung zad tsam ni khro ba'i gzugs/ /gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o//gtsug phud lnga yi rtse mo can/ /dgu pa yin te dus kun du'o/ /zhal rnams thams cad spyan gsum par/ /bdag nyid de bzhin bsgom par bya/ /'khor kyi tshul rnams thams cad kyi/ /ming dang gzugs la sogs pa brjod/ /shar gyi ming ni rdo rje mgo/ /lho yi rdo rje lag pa'o/ /nub kyi rdo rje rgyu ma ste/ /byang ni rdo rje rkang pa'o/ /me grwa'i rdo rje thod pa mo/ /bden bral rdo rje thod tshal ma / /rlung du dur khrod ras ma'o/ /dbang ldan mdung rtser bskyon pa'o/ /phyi rim shar phyogs snam bu la/ /de bzhin rim par bsgom bya ba/ /rdo rje gri dang rdo rtse gcig /de bzhin rdo rje gtun shing dang / /rdo rje chu gri mtshon rtse gcig /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gzhan/ /rdo rje ma he rdo rje ba/ /shar na gnas pa brgyad kyi'o/ /snam bu dang por shes par bya/ /lho yi rdo rje sta re dang / /24—643

rdo rje mda' dang rdo rje dbyug /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ de bzhin te/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rdo rje zhags/ /de bzhin rdo rje phag pa yang / /rdo rje bong bu brgyad pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje rdo rnge'u/ /rdo rje phub dang rdo rje gzhu/ /rdo rje dril bu de nas yang / /rdo rje rlung gi ras yin no/ /de bzhin rdo rje rnga mor shes/ /rdo rje khyi ni brgyad pa'o / /byang gi rdo rje sdigs mdzub dang / /rdo rje 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / /rdo rje glang pags hūṃrdo tho ba/ /rdo rje mdung dang rdor me thab/ /rdo rje lug ni de bzhin te/ /rdo rje spyang ki brgyad pa'o/ /gnas bzhi ru ni bsgom par bya/ /shar sgo skyong ba bya rgod do/ /lho yi skyong ba 'ug pa ste/ /nub kyi skyong ba bya rog go/ /byang gi skyong ba seng yin no/ /me grwar khyung ni legs par gzhag /bden bra'/ gyi ni khra yin no/ /de bzhin rlung gi ri skegs bsrung / /dbang ldan bsrung ba bzhad yin no/ /ming gi thog ma kun rdo rje/ /dang po gzugs mdog nag por brjod/ /de rnams kha dog gcig yin te/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa'o / /rang gi ming bzhin phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yas bskum zhabs kyis brtan par bzhugs/ /thams cad ro yi gdan la bzhugs/ /spyan gsum pa ni cher drag pa/ /dbu skra kham pa 'bar ba'o/ /thams cad thod pas brgyan pa ste/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du blta/ /cher 'khrugs pa ni bzhad pa'i zhal/ /zhal nas phe gyi 37sgra sgrogs 'phro// /bcom ldan de bzhin thams cad kyang / /de bzhin gcer bu mtshan gyen 'greng / /lha rnams thams cad la mtshungs par/ /rang gi sa bon snying gar dgod/ /de las sprul pa'i 'od 'phro bas/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drang ngo / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i yi ges dgug/gzhug dang bcing /rīdang mnyes par bya/ /sngags pa yang ni gcig pu ni/ /24—646

dbang bskur ba yang bsgom par bya/ /mchod pa sna tshogs mchod par bya/ /bdag gis thams cad bstod par bya/ /mi yi sha la sogs pa dang / /khrag gis kyang ni mchod par bya/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni/ /snying rjes 'khrugs pa'i ting 'dzin kyis/ /drag po'i las kyi don du ni/ /sngags bzlas de bzhin dran par bya/ /brnyas pa'i sems can gdul bar bya/ /thams cad jes su mthun par bya/ /oṃ dīḥbyeḥli kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nye ba'i snying po'i sngags/ /oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa yang ni snying po'i sngags/ /oṃ ya ma rā dza —4sa do me ya/ ya me do saru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya kṣe ya/yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa dag ni rtsa sngags so/ /'di rnams de ni gang 'don 4par/ /sngags bzlas par ni de bzhin bya/ /yi ge 'bar bar bsgoms pa yis/ /dngos grub dag ni myur ba yin/ /thams cad la ni dbang bsgyur bar/ /snying gar nyi ma rnam bsam bya/ /thams cad kyis 5ni 'khor bar yang / /ma te'i gdong gi snying gar dgod/ /snying po'i sngags sogs dang por ni/ /sngags gsum bzlas pa yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin sngags ni so sor bzlas/ /sgrub pa pos ni gang 'dod bya/ /snying po la sogs brtan gnas pa/ /lha rnams la yang de bzhin dgod/ /sha rnams thams cad za ba na/ /dang por ma he'i gdong la dbul/ /gtor ma 'byung po thams cad la/ /sngags bzlas pas ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ byu 9tsa ra ṇḍaṃ/ ya pā tā la tsa rā 7ya/ rma khe tsa rā ya/ ta pūrba —ni gā rgo9/ ka dakṣi ṇa 7dī gā yā/ hūṃ pabye rmā rmā 7/ phaṭa utta ra dī gā ya/ oṃ rtasthāḥyast+riḥbā likṣi kṛ ko/ tā na snan de / hūṃ bhyo phaṭa sarba bhū sate bhyaḥrtsa ba'i sngags kyis byin brlab 7bya/ brtan 24—647

pa ru ni bsgom pa yis/ /'di yis thams cad rdzogs par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin ni bsgrub pa'i ming / /sgrib pa thams cad sel ba'o/ /dus gsum du ni de ltar bsgrub / /rgyun du brtan par bsgrub par bya/ /thams cad las ni gang byed pa/ /bdag nyid ma he'i zhal gyis so/ /ting 'dzin gsum ni sems kyis bya/ /'khrugs pa'i 'bar ba'i sems kyis sbyor/ /sems can mthun dang mi mthun dag /yid kyis bya ba rab tu bya/ /bdag gis byang chub tu rab gdul1/ /sems can mnyam par yang dag byung / /dam pa'i don du rnam dag pa/ /dus ni dpa' bo chen po'i gzugs/ /zhal brgyad thun tshod brgyad yin no/ /zhal dgu thun tshod spyi yin no/ /phyag dang zhabs gnyis zla ba dang / /zla ba phyed dang yang dag spyor/ /bzhon 2pa bcu drug dus dang ni/ /zla ba yi ni zhag tu shes/ /zhal ni gza' dgu dag tu shes/ /phyag ni rgyu skar dag dang sbyar/ /zhabs ni 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang / /dus bzhi yang ni de bzhin no/ /mtshon cha rnams ni stong pa dang / /snying rje dag ni bcu drug gnyis/ /glang chen pags pa bgegs chen te/ /drag po'i gzugs ni sdug bsngal che/ /sel bar byed pa'i gtso bo'o/ /kha dog nag po byams pa che/ /thod pa'i rgyan ni mi 'gyur ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor lha ni thams cad dag /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dus dag go/ /sngags gsum dag pa sku gsum mo/ /lha rnams nyid ni 4rang ming ni/ /dang por oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa mtha'/ /thod par btung ba'i dus dag go/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub phyogs yin no/ /zhon pa sa ri santi ka /mdog sogs de bzhin gshegs pa ste/ /dag pa thams cad shes pa'o/ /'di ni dag pa cung zad tsam/ /'jam dpal rgyud na rgyas pa yin/ /bdag gis sgrub thabs 'di 24—648

byas pas/ /bsod nams de ni gang rnyed pa/ /de yis 'jig rten bsod nams shog /bdag gi sdug bsngal bral gyur cig /dpal gyi sgrub thabs 'di bsdus pa / /rdo rje 'jigs byed rtog pa ni/ /sum brgya pa ste 'jam dpal gyi/ /rgyud las cung zad tsam zhig phyung / /ma tshang lhag pa gang yin pa1/ /bdag la legs par bzod par mdzod/ /sngon du bdag gis gang las mthong 2 / /de ni mnyes par bya ba tsam/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon la li ta baja' zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā shrī de ba dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba cog gru bande shes rab bla mas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o /bsdur mchan/637 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan7'a/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra tus/638 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltan/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhag bsgoms/ 〈〈snar 〉thashag 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo nga /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazangs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 sa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gisasba/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 9〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ rka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pho/639 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉riḥ/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ceg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsho da/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pags/64༷ dzo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄zhag 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pags/641 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzanod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khizhad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tog 4〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ra ni/lha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7go/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jab/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro dzi/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha shi 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dku/642 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pang / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhug643 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgreng can/ /'jigs/24—649

༄na / /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bye ra wa 2sā dha na/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo / /rnam rtog dra ba rab bsal zhing rjo / /ye shes rgya mtsho blo mnga' ba'i /'jam pa'i dbyangs la rab btud de/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sgrub thabs bshad/ /dang por re zhig sngags pa yis/ /dur khrod dang ni chu yi 'gram/ /shing gcig dang ni mtshan ma gcig /lam gyi bzhi mdo ri bo'i rtse④/ /khang stong dang ni ma mo'i gnas/ /lha rnams yang dag rtsod pa'i sa/ /gong khyer grong gi mtha' rnams dang / /rang nyid rjes dga'i gnas 'dug nas/ /'jam dbyangs khro bo bsgrub par bya/ /rang gi snying gar padma la/ /nyi ma la gnas yi ge mchog /thugs kyi bdag nyid rnam bsgoms te/ /bla ma dang bcas lha dmigs bya/ /ye shes las gzhan tshogs kyi phyir/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing 24—651

bsngo mthar thug /rnam bdun bsags nas de rjes su/ /tshangs pa'i gnas ni bsgom par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shudheḥsarba —1dharmāḥswa bhā 2wa shusgolha haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolha3snahaṃ/ stong pa nyid du rnam bsgoms nas/ /yi ram̐ waṃ lo yi ge las/ /rlung dang me dang chu dang ni/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /der ni khuhūṃ gi rnam pa las/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dang / /de bzhin rdo rje'i gur dang ni/ /bla re yang ni bsam par bya/ /de dbus gnod mdzes rgyal po ni/ /bka' yi 'khor lo bsgom par bya /rtsibs bcu rab 'bar cung zad ser/ /khro bo bcu dang bcas pa bsam/ /gnod mdzes la sogs khro bo'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs padma nyi zla la/ /g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis yang dag gnas/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dang po yi/ /phyas gnyis rang gi shes rab 'khyud/ /'di lta bu yi 'khor lo 'di7/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin lta bus/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rab tu 'joms/ /gnod mdzes dang ni gshin rje gshed/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rta mgrin dang / /bdud rtsi 'khyel rnams dbus dang ni/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su bsam/ /'dod pa dbyug pa stobs mi g.yo/ /byin za la sogs mtshams su'o/ /gtsub tor rdo rje sa 'og ni/ /de bzhin steng dang 'og tu bsam/ /dbus dang shar dang lho dang nub/ /de bzhin steng gi khro bo rnams/ /mthing dang dkar po dmar po dang / /de ltar sngon po dkar dang dmar/ /dkar po mthing ga dmar po dang / /de bzhin dmar dang mthing ga dkar/ /ser ljang mthing ga dkar po ni/ /gnod sbyin bden bral rlung gi phyogs/ /mdog rnams dbang po'i phyogs ltar te/ /de bzhin byin za dbang ldan dang / /'og 24—652

rnams dbus ma ji lta bu'i/ /rdo rje tho ba bee con dang / /de bzhin padma rdo rje dang / /lcags kyu dbyug pa dpal rtse dang / /ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje rnams/ /g.yas kyi dang po'i rim 1bzhin du'o/ /de bzhin g.yon pa ral gri ste/ /mi g.yo ba la rdo rje'o/ /g.yas g.yon bar ma thams cad la/ /rin po che dang padmas stelabye/ /bdag po'i g.yas g.yon tha mar ni/ /lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa'o / /de bzhin du ni rta mgrin la/ /padma'i gnas su 'khor lo'o/ /gnod mdzes la sogs thams cad la/ /thugs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab ste/ /gshin rje gshed dang rta mgrin la/ /de bzhin sku dang gsung gis so/ /de nas bdag po yongs gyur nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsam byas te/ /dkar dang mthing ga dmar po'i zhal/ /phyag drug dang pos rig ma 'khyud/ /lhag ma rdo rje ral gri dang / /rin chen padma 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas chos kyi 'byung gnas ni/ /mdog dkar gyen bsgreng gzugs can la/ /chu skyes sna tshogs rdo rje yis/ /rnam par rgyal ba mkhas pas bsgom/ /der ni rgyu dang 'khor lo'o//rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba yi/ /rtag pa'i rgyal po bsam pa ni/ /rdo rje la gnas 'khor lo'o/ /de las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par mdzes/ /dril bu 'phan bcing 4la sogs dang / /gre tog phreng bas rab tu brgyan/ /grwa rnams dang ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud dag gi phyeganas su yang / /rdo rje rin po che yis brgyan/ /de bzhin zla ba phyed pas so/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo ni/ /re'u mig dgu pa zlum po ste/ /sgo gcig dag ni bzhag nas ni/ /lhag ma'i sgo ni gcad par bya/ /sgo bzhi dang ni mtshams rnams su/ /yi dwags chen po dgod par bya/ /de dbus 24—653

dbyangs yig dang po las/ /byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /der ni dhīḥlas gyur pa yi/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu bsam pa ni/ /gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis te/ /cung zad ser po phyag g.yas na/ /ral gri g.yon na glegs bam bsnams/ /de yi thugs kar 1dbyangs yig ni/ /bcu drug pa las byung ba yi/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam bsams nas/ /de yi 'od kyis phyogs bcu na3—/ /bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs sras bcas dang / /rig pa'i lha mo khro bo'i tshogs/ /spyan drangs 'jam dpal dang bcas pa/ /sangs rgyas tshogs kun rab bzhugs pas/ /'od zer drug pos khyab pa yi/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya /de steng kha dog dkar po hūṃ/ /'od zer lnga dang ldan pa bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis sangs rgyas tshogs/ /sngon bzhin spyan drangs rab bcug nas④/ /rdo rje chen po rnam par bsgom/ /de yi 'od zer las byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas khro bo dang / /rig pa'i lha mo la sogs pas/ /nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par bsam / /'gro kun byang chub la bkod de/ /de rnams dang bcas rdo rje la/ /bcug pas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /'jigs byed sku mdog nag por bsam / /zhal dgu phyag ni sum cu bzhi/ /bcu drug zhabs la g.yon brkyang ba / /gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du 'greng / /ljags brkyang gad mo rnam par sgrog /spyan gsum dpral ba'i khro gnyer can/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'od 'bar zhing / /thod pas brgyan zhing phe gyi thusgra/ /sgrogs shing 'jigs pa bsdigs par mdzad/ /gsus pa che zhing skra badzees pahūṃ/ /dang po'i zhal ni ma te'i 7ste/ /kha dog nag po cung zad khro/ /g.yas kyi rwa hūṃyi zhal gsum ni/ /24—654

dang po mthing ga g.yas dmar po/ /g.yon ser shin tu khro ba'o/ /de bzhin g.yon gyi rtsa ba'i zhal/ /dkar po dud ka de bzhin du/ /nag po shin tu khros pa yis/ /rwa gnyis dbus su zhal dmar po/ /'jigs byed zhal nas khrag 'dzag bsam/ /de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal/ /ser ba cung zad khro ba ste/ /zur phud lnga pa gzhon nu yi/ /rgyan gyis legs par rnam par brgyan/ /zhal rnams kun kyang spyan gsum po/ /g.yas g.yon dang po'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen pags pa zlon pa bsnams/ /gri gug bhindi pā 1la dang / /gtun shing chu gri de bzhin du/ /karṇa 3ya dang sta re dang / /mdung dang mda' dang lcags kyu dang / /dbyug pa kha ṭwāṃ 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rdo rje tho ba dang / /ral gri rnge'u chung g.yas pa yi/ /phyag mtshan rnams ni rim bzhin bsam/ /de bzhin g.yon gyi phyag rnams ni/ /thod pa dang ni mgo bo dang / /de bzhin du ni rkang pa dang / /phub dang de bzhin zhags pa gzhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu mi'i lag pa / /de bzhin dur khrod ras dang ni/ /rtse gsum mtshon btsugs skyes bu dang / /me snod thod pa'i dum bu dang / /sdigs mdzub rtse gsum ba dan dang / /rlung gi ras rnams rim bzhin bsnams/ /mi dang ma he glang dang ni/ /bong bu rnga mo de bzhin khye/ /thug re cece spyang g.yas pa yi5/ /zhabs rnams kyis ni rim pas mnan/ /de bzhin g.yon pa'i zhabs rnams kyis/ /bya rgod 'ug pa bya rog dang / /nee tso khra dang nam mkha' lding / /khyem bya bzhad rnams rim bzhin mnan/ /de nas dbang bskur skye mched dag /byin kyis brlab cing lus la sogs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bsgom/ /de bzhin ye shes sems dpar bsam/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa yis5/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ni/ /24—655

spyan drangs yon chab la sogs pas/ /rim bzhin mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /oṃ sthāḥha sgo ma hā kro zo ā 1gatstsha/ asma ta pū dza pra ti kṛṇḍa tu pra sā dha/ me bye rma ku ru swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i 3sngags so/ /oṃ trīḥbyeḥ.a/ mchod yon gyi sngags so/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhabs bsil ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ wi kṛ tā na na dukhye satwa da ma ka gaḥgaḥdri'i sngags so/ /oṃ ku mā ra rū 4pi ṇi dza dza hūṃ ha/me tog gi sngags so/ /oṃ byāḥha ho 5phaṭa/ bdug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ dīpta lo tsa nee 6bi kṛ tā na na ma hā aṣṭa 7ha sa na di ni dīpta ya swā hā/ mar me'i sngags so/ /oṃ badzra nee blu bye āḥhūṃ swā hā/ lha bshos kyi sngags so/ /oṃ kā la rū pa sarba satwa da ma ka ma hā khyu ta pa ti i rda ba bo kṛṇḍa kṛṭwā pa ya swā hā/gtor ma'i sngags so/ /de nas yang dag sngags bzlas bya/ /bzlas dus rang gi snying gar ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam bsams te/ /rang gi gsang sngags rnam bkod bya/ /de rjes ma yengs sems kyis ni/ /'bar ba'i gsang sngags bzlas par bya/ /oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya kṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha/ ni rā ma ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ 'di ni 'jam dpal zhes bya ba'i/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i mchog /'khor lo ma he'i zhal na ni/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis 1 las kun byed/ /gsang sngags 'bum du bzlas pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur//oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di ni gsang sngags rgyal po ste/ /ma te'i zhal gyi spyor ba yis/ /las rnams kun ni byed pa'o/ /'bum phrag gsum ni bzlas nas su/ /las rnams thams cad rab tu bya/ /oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa/'di ni ma he'i gdong can gyi/ /snying po'i sngags su rab tu grags/ /yi ge re 24—656

la 'bum bzlas na/ /las rnams thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /khams gsum la ni gang dang gang / /shin tu mnyam gzhag rab tu grub/ /de nas bzlas pa btang 'dod na/ /spyan drangs khro bo gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ dza ya dza ya su dza ya bi shwa rū 1pa dha ri/ gatstsha gatstsha swa sthā āoṃ/ kṛ two te na ta thā 2gatstsha sarba budhe bya bi sardza ya ma ma kadro ku ru swā hā/ gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /gang gzhan lhag pa'i sems med kyang / /brtse ba'i stobs kyis 'di bris pa'o/ /bsod nams de yis 'gro ba rnams/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang mtshungs par shog /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //grub pa'i slob dpon la li tas mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/651 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos nga/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉༄ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga wa ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasal cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes yi/652 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7za/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7lha/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibadzra/5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7lha/ 6〈〈snar 〉7rgyu dang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉dzee/653 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rems/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grel/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra cings/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/654 1〈〈snar 〉zodakar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐ phyobs bcu nas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṭhang dze gi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thasgreng ba/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dku/655 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bhā ti pa/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka na/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a mo/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/5〈〈snar 〉(yin/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(na/656 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drangs nga/'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉〉du/ 5〈〈snar 〉te/271—657
