0913༄7/ /dpal rdo rje 'jogs byed kyi bstod pa/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bye ra ba snyu ti/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ 'jam dpal mkha' las byung ba'i gser mdog can/ /'jam dpal thugs la chos kun rang bzhin gsal/ /'jam dpal gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal —dbyangs/ /'jam dpal bdag ni re ba'i sems kyis 'dud/ /thugs mchog 'jam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir gshin rje'i gshed/ /'jigs byed chen po 'jigs pa'i char snabastan nas/ /mi bzad dus mtha'i bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /zhal gdangs khro gnyer smin ma glog ltar 'gyu/ /spyan bgrad mche ba gcigs shing rab tu 'bar/ /rdo rje'i rta gad drag po ha har bzhad/ /mkha' 'gro sbud pa'i phe skad gnam du 'don/ /khros pa'i zhabs chen brdabs 4pas khams 24—717

gsum gnon/ /sdigs mdzub gnam du bsgrengs shing lha chen 'dul/ /ljags 'dril tshems chen gcigs shing khrag gis myos/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zhal du gsol/ /glang chen ko zlon thod pa'i phreng ba zhags/ /gcer bu 'jigs byed dbang phyug chen po'i tshul/ /'jigs byed ma he khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing / /zhal dgu 'bar bas srid pa zad par rngub/ /'gro ba sna tshogs 'dul ba'i phyag rgya 'bar/ /bdud bzhi gnon pa'i zhabs ni brkyang bskum gnas / /'jigs byed chen po'i sku la rtag tu 'dud/ /dbu dgu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /g.yas kyi zhal gsum bgrad pa ni/ /mthing ga dmar dang ser ba'i zhal/ /g.yon gyi zhal gsum gdangs pa ni/ /dkar dang dud ka gnag pa'i zhal/ /dbus kyi zhal gsum 'bar ba ni/ /khro dang chags dang zhi ba'i tshul/ /phyag rgya 'od zer 'bar ba las/ /g.yas kyi phyag mtshan bcu drug ni/ /rdeg 1cing 'joms pas 2mtshon cha gdengs/ /g.yon gyi phyag mtshan bcu drug ni/ /rol cing stob pa'i mtshan mas mdzes/ /brjid rngam zhabs kyi tsham ngam las/ /g.yas kyi zhabs brgyad bskum pa ni/ /dregs pa'i lha brgyad thabs kyis 'dul/ /g.yon gyi zhabs brgyad brkyang ba ni/ /dregs pa'i lha mo brgyad la rol/ /'dod chags chen po gdul ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu liṅga rgyas pa'i tshul/ /drag po'i tshul gyis zhe sdang 'dul/ /'dul sku khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bdud dang gshin rje thabs kyis 'dul/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ /dbang sbud 4rjod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dbang med dad pas 'dus pa dang / /ye shes sprul pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /24—718

'khor bcas tātan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /ji lta bur ni sprul gyur kyang / /rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i/ /mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'a65la 61/ /rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/717 )mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smon /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skur/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stabs che'id bstabs/718 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉degs/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradul/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsdud/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (840)24wa 719

༄/ /de nyid lnga pa'i bstod pa/kyi༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa tata2sto tra/ bod skad du/ de nyid lnga pa'i bstod pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ chos dbyings ma bcos mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /'jam dpal rgyu yi byang sems sku/ /utpal ral gri rab bsnams shing / /zur phud lnga ldan gur kum mdog /zla gdan la bzhugs ye shes kyi/ /sgu mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdud 'joms la/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas 'dren pa yi// /'jam dbyangs thugs khros hūṃ nag po/ /dngos grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje khros pas srid gsum spyor4/ /spro zhing bsdus pas ma he'i zhal/ /ljags 'dril phe gyi 5'brug sgra sgrogs/ /hūṃḥbyeḥ'i gsung 'jigs la phyag 'tshal/ /dbu dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi phyag /bcu drug zhabs can dpa' bo che/ /mig sman bdar 'dra'i sgu mchog ni / /'jigs dus me 'dra'i gshin rje gshed/ /2 4—720

gnag dang dmar dang ser zhal dbus/ /dkar dang dud mdog gnag zhal g.yon / /sngo dang dmar dang ser zhal g.yas/ /zhal dgus srid gsum gsol ba po/ /gri gug rtse gcig gtun shing dang / /chu gri rdo rje dgra sta mdung / /mda' dang lcags kyu dbyug to 1dang / /kha ṭwāṃ 'khor lo rdo rje dang //thod pa ral gri ḍa ma ru/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /thod pa mgo bo phub dang rkang / /zhags pa gzhu dang rgyu ma dang / /dril bu lag pa dur ras dang / /gsal shing phub dang me thab dang / /ro sgod sdigs 2mdzub ba dan dang / /rlung ras phyag g.yon bsnams pa'o/ /gnyis ni glang chen ko rlon gon/ /mi dang ma he glang dang ni/ /bong bu rnga mo khyi dang lug /ce spyang g.yas kyis zhabs brgyad gnon/ /bya rgod 'ug pa bya rog dang / /seng ge khra dang go bo dang / /sngags can bzhad bya brgyad po la/ /g.yon zhabs 'jigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo dur khrod rje/ /ltung ba'i lha gnyis sdig pa'i sku// sdigs mdzub drag 4pos gdul dka' 'dul/ /go bzlog mnan nas rab tu gsol / /liṅga langs shing rtog pa spangs/ /dpa' bo gnas na gnyis drad rol / /lha min kun sogs dbang pos btud/ /mun sel thugs kyi mngon gyur pa/ /rnam rtog gshin rje 'dra ba rnams/ /nyid rol pa yi rnam rtog gis/ /gar mkhan ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /gnyug ma'i gnas la 'god pa'o/ /'jam dbyangs ye shes snying rje khro/ /e ma srid gsum gdug pa sel/ /bu la ma byams gshe ba ltar/ /bcos ma'i khro byang khyod 5phyag 'tshal/ /de nyid lnga pa'i bstod pa rdzogs so// //24—721

༄sa/ /na mo badzra bye ra bā ya/ stong nyid las byung nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs/ /'jam dpal thugs rje khros 2pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed ni/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor zhing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan/ /khro rgyal dus mtha'i rnge ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhal dgu phyag ni sum cu rtsa bzhi zhabs bcu drug /mthing nag mi'u thung gzugs can gcer bu ma te'i zhal/ /phe dang ha ha hi hi drag po'i sgra dang ldan/ /mi 'gyur 'jam dpal bde chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /drag po'i stobs kyis bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad gshin rje'i 4gshed/ /grub chen brgyad kyi dbugs 'byin skye mched 5mchog sbyin mdzes / /sems can re skong las mdzad byams pa thugs rje can/ /zag sked bde rgyas mnyam mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo6// //24—723

bsdur mchan/723 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde bstan dkar chag 〉〉ltar bkod/ 3bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khros/ bye 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stab/④ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rje/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ad/ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉thastod/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (842)24 —724

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bye ra ba stu ti/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi thung sgeg po sprin 'dra'i mdog /'od zer bye ba 'phros pas bzhengs / /mtshan ma 'greng ba ma te'i zhal/ /gnyis med spyor bas khyod rgyal mdzad/ /byol song ma lus thams cad kun/ /bcu drug zhabs kyis thams cad mnan/ /brkyang bsgum zhabs ni brjid par gnas/ /stobs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang po'i pags pa phyag gnyis 'dzin/ /g.yas kyi dang po gri gug ste/ /gnyis pas jematshon rtse gcig pa 'dzin/ /gsum pa'i phyag gis gtun shing bsnams/ /bzhi pa chu gri bzang po 'dzin/ /lnga pa rdo rje rtse gcig bsnams/ /drug pa'i phyag gis sta re 'dzin/ /bdun pa'i phyag gis mdung 'dzin to/ /brgyad pa'i phyag gis mda' 'dzin to/ /dgu pa 'gugs 2sgyu1——723

don lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcu pa khyab 'jug dbyug to 1bsnams/ /bcu gcig rtog 'joms kha ṭwāṃ ga /chos 'khor bskor ba bcu gnyis pa/ /bcu gsum ye shes rdo rje 'dzin/ /bcu bzhi brdungs 2don tho ba bsnams/ /bco lnga dgra gsod ral gri 'dzin/ /bcu drug cang te'u gnyis med brdung / /de ltar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pas 4tshangs mgo bsnams/ /gsum pa shes rab phub 'dzin te/ /bzhi pa bsgrub bya'i rkang pa 'dzin/ /lnga pa bcing don zhags pa 'dzin/ /drug pa gzhu 'dzin thabs kyi don/ /bdun pa nyon mongs rgyu ma 'dzin/ /brgyad pa shes rab dril bu 'khrol/ /dgu pa rdeg don lag pa 'dzin/ /bcu pa bri don dur khrod ras/ /bcu gcig gsal shing nyon mongs 'bugs/ /bcu gnyis sreg 5don me thab 'dzin/ /bcu gsum pa na thod tshal 'dzin/ /bcu bzhi sdigs mdzub bsdigs par mdzad/ /bco lnga 'phan bsnams dug gsum 'joms/ /bsgrub bya rlung bsgur 6bcu drug ras/ /g.yon pas 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor na7/ /sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i gdan/ /gzhal yas rnge dpung 8dkyil na bzhugs/ /'jigs mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod / /brgya phyed mgo bo'i do shal can/ /dbu rgyan thod pa lnga lngas brgyan/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal dgu pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /spyan bzlog nyi shu rtsa bdun dmar/ /ljags 'dril zhal nas ha har bshad9/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag ldan/ /ma he'i zhal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'di ni bstod pa'i dam pa yin/ /rnal 'byor kun gyis rnyed dka' ba/ /'od 'byung dad cing gus pas zhus/ /don yod rdo rje mkhas pas byas/ /'di byas pa yi dge ba 21—726

yis / /kun gyis 'jigs byed zhal mthong shog /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa 1rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / zhang lo tsā 3ba shes rab bla mas bsgyur ba'o// / /bsdur mchan/725 she7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rag /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa bzhugs so// ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toraphro bas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/726 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tho/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brdung / sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srog 57〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skur/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanapungs/ tesna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhad /727 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wapa/ lde 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/sde /843)24wa 727

༄/ /'jam dpal 'dzeegs byed mtshan gyi bstod pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra 2 shrī bye ra ba nā ma stu ti/ bod skad du/'jam dpal 'jigs byed mtshan gyi bstod pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a la la ho 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rngam byed rgyal po 'jigs pa'i rol thabs — can/ /dur khrod gnas na 4rol sku'i cha lugs ldan/ /tshangs chen khyab mjug 5gzhon nu lha tshogs dang / /dbang phyug thags bzangs 6ris rnams ma lus zhal du gsol/ /khros mdzad rngam khro ru lu ru lu ste/ /thod pa dbu mar khrag bcas zhal du gsol/ /che phran mang po'i zar bus mgrin 7zhugs brgyan/ /glang po che yi pags pa'i na bza' can/ /zhal dgu khros gcigs 'jam dpal chos kyi sgu/ /ma he'i zhal 'dzin byol song skrag mdzad cing / /rwa mdog ind+ra nī la'i 'od 'phro zhing / /hūṃ dang chem dang sgra chen 'jigs par sgrogs/ /zhal nas ljags 'dril te he he he dzārka/ /24—728

ston ka'i char sprin gzhon nu 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /nam mkha'i āñtsa'i 1mdog 'dra sngon por snang / /pad dang padma rā 5ga'i mdog 'dra gnyis/ /gser bsregs dang mtshungs che ba'i yon tan ldan/ /shel dang dud 'dra zla ba zhi ba'i tshul / /sre ya ka ltar dud kha rab tu drag /dgu pa bzhin khros byes pa'i rgyan gyes brgyan/ /thod pa lnga bcu se ral khar bsnams pa/ /rkang tshil khrag dang zhag bcas glo snying gsol/ /sri ka duṣṭhan hūṃ 4na ma ra na/ shāsto puṣṭa 5ma hā ma ra dza/ las rnams ma lus rdzogs pa 6mthar phyin pas/ /sems can khams rnams ma lus kun don mdzod/ /gri gug 7la sogs rdzogs pa'i mtshan mar ldan/ /dbu mgo chen po'i tshogs ni gyen du sgreng / /yan lag rags pa'i lto ni thur du bshal/ /dzā dzā nee kai hūṃ hūṃ ha la ha/ ha ha ya ya ma ma ra ra zhes / tsa tsha las rnams ma lus kun mdzad pa/ /slob dpon skur dang de yi dkor khyer dang / /kun la gnod byed dam pa skur pa dang / /dam tshig dag la mi gnas sgrol bar byed/ /rdo rje thod dbyig 'jigs pa'i sgra dang ldan/ /mi dang ma he la sogs de bzhin bya rog 'ug /bya rgod 8zhabs kyis gnon pa'i sgu 9tsar bzhugs/ /ha la mgrin 7bzang mar khu chen po gsol/ /a shwad la sogs shing dbus dgyes par gsol/ /spyang ki kaṅga 'bar ba ce spyang dang / /bya rog khra dang ma hā ru lu ni/ /gdug 1pa can rnams ma lus sha za ba'i/ /tshogs kyi phyogs ni de bzhin sprin ltar gtibs/ /de 'dra'i dbus kyi gzhal yas khang pa na/ /tshul du bzhugs pas sems can 'gro don mdzad/ /rol mdzad thugs rjes sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug 5pa zhal du gsol la phyag 'tshal lo//las rnams mthar phyin mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro tshogs 'jigs pa'i sku la 24—729

—phyag 'tshal lo/ /utpal sngo 'dra'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma brgya yi gzi ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ /'ga' zhig mtshan ni 'dzin zhing bstod pa dang / /de yi yon tan phyogs tsam bzung tshonas kyang / /yid la gnas kyi gzhan du mi smra na//dngos grub ster zhing las rnams ma lus 'gugs/ /'jam dpal 'jigs byed mtshan gye bstod pa/ slob dpon las kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/728 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho /'jam dpa' 'jigs byed mtshan kyi bstod pa bzhugs so// 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ñdzu/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltabs/ 〈〈pe〉)〈〈snar 〉ras/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorajug 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thag zangs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skaragrin/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cam/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dza/729 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mosalnga'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rwa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgub/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dku/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / shān ti puṣṭi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ska ga 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rog / 〈〈pe 〉〉skye/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thur/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaragrin/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadug73༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanazung /24dod730
bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ 844)24dod731

༄ / /dpal rdo rje 'dzeegs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs rdo rje'i 'od ces bya ba/hūṃ ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bye ra wa badzra pra ka ra sā dha nā rtem/bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs rdo rje'i — 'od ces bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab cing rgya che 'jigs pa 'jigs mdzad pa'i/ /snying rjes khros pa'i 'khor lo la btud de/ /de nyid thob phyir snying rjes 'gro rnams la/ /mi phyed gsal ba'i sgrub thabs cho ga bri / /'di nyid dbang thob blo gros gsal/ /gnang ba thob cing brtul zhugs nus/ /'gro ba'i don la rab brtson pas/ /dur khrod la sogs gnas su bsgrub/ /bris sku rab gnas legs ldan la/ /sha chen mar chochen mchod gtor dbul/ /rig ma lan 5cig dpa' ba 'am/ /yang na gcig pus bsnyen bsgrub bya/ /mchod sbyin rgya chen sems bskyed cing / /dbang dang tshogs ston smon lam gdab/ /bdud rtsis khrus gsol khro bo bcu'i/ /sngags kyis gnas 24—732

bdag rnal 'byor srung 1/ /snying gar paṃ dang re pha 2dang / /thugs mchog sa bon rim pa las/ /padma nyi ma rdo rje che/ /sa bon mchog las 'od lnga spro/ /rigs rigs bskul dang sbyang byas nas/ /rgyal ba 'jigs byed bla ma blta/ /bkod pas phyag byas spros pas mchod/ /sdigs pa 'gyod bshags been chad bsdams④—/ /yi rang skyabs dang sems bskyed cing / /bskul dang gsol rnams rgyas gdab sngotsa/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms bzhi la nan tan bsgo me/ /rang rang gnas dang bris sgu la/ /spyan drangs 3/lha sogs gshegs su gsol/ /de nas phyi dang nang gi chos/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid yin cing / /swa bhā phya)wa yis rjes su brjod/ /stong pa nyid la shin 9tu gzhag /de nas sngon gyi smon lam dran/ /chos nyid de las yi ge yo/ /re dang hūṃ ni sngo dmar nag /de dag so sor gyur pa las/ /rlung dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba gur/ /blo dang ldan pas bsrung ba ni/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa rab tu bsgom/ /de yi dbus su paṃ bsam zhing / /dang po'i dbyangs yig dhīḥdag las/ /sna tshogs padma zla ba dang / /dhī las 'jam dpal ye shes sku/ /btso ma gser mdog mchog gi phyag /rdo rje skyil krung rin chen spras/ /mthon mthing zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /sgu yi rigs kyi bdag po bsgom/ /thugs kar rim par gnas pa yi/ /'od zer spro dang bsdus pa las/ /rnam par snang mdzad nyid du gyur/ /mtshan dang dpe byad nyid kyis brgyan/ /de yi khyad par gyur pa las/ /gzhal yas phyi nang bcas par hu1bsgom/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dril bu ral gri 'phan la sogs/ /me tog phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /sgo dang 24—733

sgo khyud 'gram rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa'i/ /zla ba phyed pa de bzhin no/ /'dod yon mchod pa'i lha mo rnams/ /dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa ste/ /shar ni gtum drag dag tu grags/ /de bzhin lho nub byang gi rim/ /ha ha dgod dang dpal kyi nags/ /ki li ki lir lkushes par bya/ /me la sogs pa'i rim pa yis/ /tshang tshing can dang 'bar ba'i 'od/ /'jigs sde dang ni mun pa can/ /de yi rim pas brgya byin dang / /gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang / /me lha srin po rlung lha dang / /'byung po'i bdag po dang brgyad do/ /shar gyi lha dbang dkar po ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa glang po zhon/ /lho yi gshin rje kha dog nag /dbyug pa 'dzin la ma te zhon/ /nub kyi chu lha dmar skya'i mdog /sbrul gyi zhags 'dzin chu srin zhon/ /byang gi gnod sbyin rta yi khri/ /kha dog ser po bum pa 'dzin/ /me lha dmar po dbyu khyagu ste/ /drang srong cha byad ra la zhon / /srin po nag po gri gug lag /mi ro mi yi khri la gnas/ /rlung lha ljang gu ba dan 'phyar/ /sha ba zhon pa dag dang ldan/ /'byung po'i bdag po thal ba'i mdog /rtse gsum khyu mchog zhon par bcas/ /'di dag thams cad phyed skyil krung / /ral pa'i thor tshugs mig gsum pa/ /khro bo'i brjid ldan sbrul dur khrod/ /brgyan zhing chung ma bu 'khor bcas/ /chu lha gcig pu sbrul mgo dang / /bcas pa rnal 'byor rnams kyis bsgom/ /klu shing a mra'i shing /dang tā la'i shing / /ardzu na dang pa la sha /u dusmra kru ra byang chub shing / /shing gi zhing skyong brgyad po yang / /phyogs skyong kha dog rgyan 5de bzhin/ /glang po ma te gdan gyi mdogamu /g.yas pa gri gug thod pa g.yon/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsgrub pa'o/ /dri za gshin rje phyogs kyi gdon/ /sha za yi 24—734

dwags ro langs gzhan/ /bya dang gcan gzan shesbrul dag dang / /ro langs dum bu tshig byedang rus/ /mchod rten ce spyang za ru brgyug /phyogs kyi rim pas steng dag na/ /tshangs pa dbang po khyab 'jug drag /tshogs bdag stobs bzangs smin drug bu/ /legs ldan nyi zla lha yi tshogs/ /ser po dkar po smug po nag /ser skya sngo skya dmar skya nag /bum pa rdo rje 'khor lo dang / /rtse gsum mda' gzhu ③ral gri phub/ /mdung dang gri gug 'dzin pa yis4 / /chung ma bu dang bcas pa bsgom/ /chu brgyad sprin brgyad bar dag na/ /'og gi sa bdag lha mo phag /klu brgyad shar la sogs rim par/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /mtha' yas nor rgyas 'jog po dang / /rigs ldan padma padma che/ /ljang dang ser dang sngo dang dmarathu/ /dkar po ser po dmar dang dkar—/ /sbrul gyi gdengs ka zhags pa dang / /rang rang kyechung ma bu 'khor bcas / /thams cad rdo rje'i mig can te/ /rgyal ba'i bka' nyan bstan pa bsrung / /sgrub pa po srung kluphyi bzhin 'brang tsu/ /sha khrag drag po'i las la dga'—/ /gzhal yas de yi nang dag tutsusna/ /1 sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra ba bsgom/ /shar ni dkar po lho ser po/ /nub ni dmar po byang ljang gu/ /chen po dbus ni sngon po ste/ /ā li kā li kyezla ba nyi/ /dhīḥdang ral gri spros bsdus nas—/ /gcig tu gyur nas 'jam pa'i dpal/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dus gsum sku/ /mdog dkar phyag gnyis spyan gsum zhi/ /rigs lnga'i zur phud mthon mthing lnga/ /phyag rgya lnga ni rin chen brgyan/ /rdo rje g.yas la dril bu g.yon—/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung rkye bcas la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje padmar bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang phan tshun gzigs/ /snying gar pad zla dhīḥbaltas la/ /24—735

rigs rigs bskul sbyang 'od lngar byas/ /rnal 'byor dang bo nyid der gsal//zhi bas sbyangs dang sman 3byas nas/ /thams cad dhīḥyig chos nyid zhugs/ /drag po'i rigs can la brtse bas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sngags kyis bskul/ /tshad med bzhi yi lha mo bzhis/ /tsālha gu sogs kyi glu yis bskul/ /thugs rjes khros pa'i dad sgrol khyod bzhengs shig /khams gsum kun gyi gti mug rab tu sol4 / /dad sgrol brtson bskyed stong pa nyid las bzhengs/ /bdud bzhi dag las shin tu rgyal mdzad pa/ /'jig rten mgon bo stong nyid ci ste bzhugs//dad sgrol 'jig rten mgon mdzad da bzhengs shig /byang chub dgod par sems can mgon bos nas/ /ci ltar stong pa nyid la zhugs snyepa ci/ /glu yi sgra yis de nyid gsum/ /ho gnyis 9bcas pa der thim ste/ /'gro ba'i dkyil 'khor sgyu mar mthong / /'gro la chags pas khu bar gyur/ /hūṃ sngon nyi ma la gnas pa/ /rdo rje sngon po khro bo bskyed/ /khro bo sngon po rus pa'i rgyan/ /spom thung gsus pa 'phyang 7ba yi/ /mun pa lta bur 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /dkar dang dmar ba g.yas dang g.yon/ /gyen skyes sma ra ser po 'bar/ /ljags 'dril mche ba rab tu gatshigs/ /g.yon brkyang ba yis gshin rje brdzis/ /shes rab dang bcas gzhan don byed/ /gri gug rdo rje ral gri g.yas/ /thod pa 'khor lo chu skyes g.yon/ /yum ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'khyud/ /mtha' yas sngon po takṣa snye snadakar/ /skra bcings rna cha mgul du 'phyang 1—/ /rigs ldan khra bo dpung pa'i rgyan/ /dung rkaskyong ser po lag pa'i gdugasanyu1/ /padma dkar po sado shal byas/ /karko ṭa ljang se ral kha/ /nor rgyas dkar po ska rags dang / /padma chen po rkang gdub rkang mu/ /lce dang mche ba gnyis ldan pa/ /24—736

phud phud sgra sgrogs 'jigs byed pa/ /mgo bo brgya phyed phreng ba 'phyang /rwa rno rmig pa rno ba dang / /spu ser 'bar ba 'jigs pa yis 3/ /ma he gshin rje pho mo yis37/ /steng du 'jigs byed legs bsgoms la/ /chos dbyengs dag tu chos kun bsgomasakyi/ /oṃ dharma dhwa ༄tu swa bhā wa ātma kopho5haṃ/ de ltar rjes kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /snying ga'i hūṃ de ya gyur te/ /de yi 'od kyis phyogs bcu yi/ /rgyal ba yum bcas dga' bar gyurashi/ /bde bar zhu nas rang la zhu7/ /hūṃ las rdo rje paṃ padma/ /oṃ las rdo rje rtse mo dang / /padma'i ze 'bru byin gyis brlabs — //rjes su chags pas mkha' gsang du/ /thig le yi ge dang bcas la/ /gzhal yas lha rnams legs par bskyed/ /gzhal yas dbus su ya nyid las/ /gtso bo rang nyid lta bu bsgom/ /shar du kṣe dang 'khor lo las/ /gti mug rdo rje dkar po ste/ /gri gug 'khor lo ral gri g.yas/ /thod pa rin chen chu skyes g.yon—/ /lho ru ma dang rin chen las/ /phra 9ma rdo rje gser gyi mdog /gri gug rin chen ral gri g.yas/ /thod pa 'khor lo chu skyes g.yon/ /nub tu me dang padma las/ /'dod chags rdo rje rā nyu ga'i mdog /gri gug padma ral gri g.yas / /thod pa 'khor lo rin chen g.yon/ /byang du da dang ral gri las/ /phrag dog rdo rje mar kata mtshungs skya/ /gri gug ral gri 'khor lo g.yas/ /thod pa rin chen 7padma g.yon/ /khro bo'i gzugs ni thams cad 'jigs/ /rdo rje sna tshogs rtsa ba bzhir/ /nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang bzhugs/ /gti mug rdo rje zla ba la/ /gti mug sel ba nyid kyi phyir/ /shes rab cha yis de bzhin du//rdo rje rā 7yi mtshams bzhi ru/ /zla ba'i gdan la lha mo bzhi/ /shar lhor dzā dang 'khor lo las/ /rdo rje tsā ⑫gti mug mtshungs/ /lho ru sa dang rdo rje 24—737

las / /rdo rje phag mo gtso bo 'dra/ /nub byang do dang padma las/ /'dod chags rdo rje lta bur bsgom/ /byang shar ru dang ral gri las/ /phrag dog gshed dang 'dra bar bsgom/ /sgo bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /khro bo bzhi ni rim pas bskyedalha// /shar sgor ya dang tho ba las/ /tho ba gshed ni bdag po mtshungs/ /g.yas na tho ba ral gri 'dzin/ /rin po che dang padma g.yon/ /lho sgor tstsha dang dbyug pa las/ /dbyug pa gshed mdog gti mug 'dra/ /dbyug pa ral gri g.yas na 'dzin/ /padma 'khor lo phyag g.yon na/ /nub sgor ni dang padma las/ /padma gshed ni 'dod chags mtshungs/ /padma ral gri g.yas na 'dzin/ /rin chen 'khor lo phyag g.yon na/ /byang sgor rlung ①dang ral gri las/ /ral gri gshed ni ljang gu zu ste/ /zhal dang rgyan ni phrag dog mtshungs / /ral gri dang ni 'khor lo g.yas/ /rin chen dang ni padma g.yon/ /gri gug thod pa rang rig 'khyud/ /skra ser ④sma ra smin ma 'bar/ /zhal bzhad mche ba rnam par gabyugs/ /gtso bo lta bu sbrul gyis brgyan/ /sngon po'i g.yas dkar dmar po g.yon/ /dkar po'i g.yas sngo g.yon dmar la/ /dmar po g.yas sngo g.yon pa dkar/ /ser ljang g.yas nag g.yon dkar zhal/ /zur bzhi na yo ni rā las/ /bdud rtsi dang ldan thod pa bzhi/ /legs par bsgrubs nas dbyung ba ni/ /gtso bo rang rang sngags kyis phyedabyung / / hūṃ z-iḥ'i 6sngags kyis gtso bo dbyung / /rigs kyis zhe sdang las bya ste/ /khro bor 'dus nas zhal dgur )gyur/ /gtso bo bdag la gzhug mepar bya/ /dzi na dzika brjod gti mug gshed/ /gti mug las byas shar phyogs kyi/ /rdo rje rtsibs kyi rtsa bar gzhag3sna /zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /ratna byeka gis phra 24—738

ma ni/ /nga rgyal sbyangs nas lho ru dgod/ / ā ro '-ika shebarjod 'dod chags gshed bu—/ /nub tu pad nyi dag la dgod/ /pradzñā jeka na gis phrag dog gshed//phrag dog las byas byang nyid ④bzhugs/ /mo ha ra ni ༄5 brjod pa yis/ /tsārtsi 'usgeg mo 'od bzangs ma/ /shar lhor rdo rje'i mtshams su bsgoms)/ /rang gi rigs kyi ⑧las byed ma/ /dre ṣa ra ti lho nub kyi/ /mtshams su rdo rje phag mo bsgomakye/ / /nub byang mtshams su dbyangs can ma/ /rā tsog ra ti'i sngags kyis dbyung / /badzra ra tis go rī 32ma/ /byang shar rdo rje'i mtshams su bsgomasahūṃ//thams cad phyag 'tshal ba dang ldan/ /lha mo padma zla ba'i gdan/ /rigs kyi phyag mtshan dag gis bskyed/ /rang rigs bskul sbyang byas la gzhug /de nyid gsum gyis thod pa dbyung / /zur bzhi bde ba bdud rtsir ldan/ /muṅgar dhrika gis tho ba gshed⑩/ /las byas shar sgor pad nyi bsgom/ /daṇḍa dhrika gis dbyug pa gshed/ /lho yi sgo ru de bzhin gzhagathu /padma byeka gis nub sgo ru / /padma gshed ni bsgom par bya/ / khaṅga j-ika skyagis ral gri gshed/ /byang gi sgo ru bsgom par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag la mnyam par blta/ /'di ni shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /gshin rje gshed nag 'jigs byed kyisa.ayo/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams mig la sogs/ /kṣiṃ / dzee7 / khaṃ / shaṃ / shaṃ / saṃ gis/ /lha rnams dag tu byin gyis brlab/ /padma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad/ /ral gri rdo rje sa snying dang / /phyag na rdo rje mkha' snying po/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon sgrib pa sel/ /kun du bzang po bsgom par bya/ /phyag na rdo rje kun du bzang / /thugs kyi rdo rje 'dra bar bsgom / /mig ni gti mug sna phra ma/ /lce la 'dod chags lus phrag dog /24—739

gshed po 'dra bar go cha )bya/ /khro bo sgeg pa'i gzugs can no/ /snying gar hūṃ nag āḥtredamar kha/ /mgo bor oṃ ni dkar po bsgom/ /rdo rje padma 'khor lo las/ /sgu gsung rdo rje spro bsdu bsgom/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga byeta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolhahaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolhahaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā ༄wa ātma kolhadzwahaṃ/ rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun bkug nas/ /mdun 7du dmigs la mchod pas mchod / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dzha snyeṣiñtsa māṃ brjod pas/ tsālha sogs kyis 9bkra shis glu/ /bdud rtsi bum pas bkrus pa dang / /gtso bos dbang bskur gtso bo la/ /rdo rje 'chang nyid cod pan te7 sna/ /'khor lo pa la gshin rje gshed/ /cod pan dag dang ldan par bsgom/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ /khro bos bgegs bskrad mchod byas la/ /sgo ba bzhi yis gnyis med bsre/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sa bon gyis/ /zhal zhugs te zhu bas rdo rje'i lam/ /padmar dbyung dang phyung ba las/ /lha mo sna tshogs me tog sogs/ /phyi yi mchod pas mdzes par mchod/ /tsārtsi dku sogs kyis bdud rtsi dang / /sha lngas tshim par bya ba dang / /rang rig 8gnyis pas gnyis rnged mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū ⑫dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma kolhahaṃ/brag ca lta bu phul ba de/ /sgra brnyan nyid du rang la thim/ /de bzhin bstod pas legs par bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po mirab 'jigs pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i sango bo khyod/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /phra ma rdo rje'i ⑫ngo bo khyod/ /rdo rje thugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rin chen rdo rje phyag 'tshal 24—740

bstod—/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /'dod chags padma'i 'byung gnas mnyam/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi gtso bo'i gtso/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed—/ /rdo rje sku dang rab tu mtshungs/ /phyag na rdo rje lhaphyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod//de ltar bstod nas lha rnams spro/ /'gro ba sbyangs nas 'khor lor gzhug /'khor lo legs bsdus phung po khams/ /skye mched yan lag rang bzhin shes/ /rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ye shes brtan par bsgom/ /der bsdu ba'am shar sgo lho/ /nub byang lha mo rim pas bsdu/ /zhal dgu rdo rje rtse mo ru / /'khor lo bsgom dang rtsa ba dang / /lte ba snying ga de bzhin bsgom/ /de nas gnas kyi 'khor lo ni/ /bskyed pa rnal 'byor chen po bya/ /de brtan ya mānta ka nyid/ /zhal gsum rjes kyi rnal 'byor sgur2/ /sgom pa rdo rje rtse dang rtsa/ /lte ba snying ga rnal 'byor che/ /de rjes 'jam dpal ye shes nyid/ /dang po sangs rgyas gyur pa ni/ /rdo rje rtse mo rtsa bar bsgom/ /lte ba snying ga de bzhin bsgom/ /de nas gnas kyi rim pa las/ /re baṃ lo yo rim par dgodabya//lus glod ngag bsdams yid ④bcings la/ /'bar la bsros pas dbab par bya/ /babs pas zhi dang snying gar gnas/ /dbang bzhi'i rim pas thig le drangs phya7/ /bde ba mi rtog stong nyid la/ /rnal 'byor mchog 'dod pa yis 5bsgom/ /de yang dmigs nas spro dang bsdu/ /gsal dang brtan dzwapa spro bya zhing / /'dus pa de la rgyun du gzhag /sems med sems kyi 'od gsal mthong / /mthong 24—741

ba'i rtog pa yongs min te/ /kun rdzob nyams ①la rigs pas smras/ /rjes la phyi dang nang gi chos/ /yang dag dpyad tsepas grub pa med/ /phyi rol rdul las grub pa ste/ /drug cu ༄ drug tu go gcig phyir/ /dpyad pas phra rab grub pa med/ /phyi rol sgyu ma dgag mi bya/ /nang la bdag dang gzhan gnyis kyang / /grub dang ma grub dpyad pa yis/ /bdag med gzhan yang rtags 4༄pa dang / /mi rtag pa yis bden pa dang 77/ /gnyis dang gnyis med de las gzhan/ /rigs pas rab tu mi gnas so/ /de bas chos rnams rnam par dag /chos sku gzugs sgu tha dad med/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis/ /'jug dang ldang ba'i 5rigs shes bya/ /de ltar rtog pas 3rnal 'byor pas/ /du ba mar me zla nyi yi/ /rtags rnams rim pas nges par 'byung / /de yis thurdo rje'i sku 'grub bo/ /skyon pad zla ba rtenyi ma la/ /dhīḥdang hūṃ dang nyi ma dang / /'khor lo brgyad kyi rtsibs dang steng / /nyi steng snying po las sngags dang / /rtsa ba'i snying pos bskor ba la/ /rang zhegi rgyu ba shes pa yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag gang 'dod pa/ /bsam gtan sogs kyis rim pas bzla/ /de nas sngags kyi bsnyen pa ni/ /zhe sdang can dag 'dul ba la/ /ya mānta ka'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /snying gar nyi ma hūṃ bkod de/ /spro bsdu sngags kyi yi ges bskor/ /bdun 'bum snying po oṃ dang po/ /yā '-imānta ka hūṃ phaṭa bzlas/ /ting 'dzin mchod gtor bcas pa'o/ /des kyang 'dul bar ma gyur nas/ /de nas zhal dgu 'jigs byed de/ /dhīḥskṛḥspro bsdu shes byas la/ /las sngags rgyal po sum 'bum bzlas/ /des kyang khyab par ma gyur pas/ /lha ni bcu bdun gsal ba yis / /rtsa sngags bcu bdun spro dang bsdu/ /'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas 24—742

par bya/ /de nas bsgrub pa bya ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dang po ni/ /mar tshes gnyis la dur khrod ras/ /khru do kha sbyor ldan pa blang / /thal chen sa dkar bdud rtsi lnga/ /khrag lnga dug lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /kha ba lnga dang tsha ba lnga/ /ras brgyad legs par sbyar byas nas/ /bya rog sgro dang mi rus la/ /snyu kye gu byas la bri ba ni/ /gshin rje pho mo 'jigs ldan pa'i/ /rten 'brel 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bri/ /gsum du bskor la phyi rim la/ /re 5mig 'khor lo bcu drug bya/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad la lus pya kyi sngags/ /sthāḥbyeḥming dang spel ba dgod / /bar ma me ri mig bcu gnyis ④/ /hūṃ phaṭa bsgrub byar bcas pa zi//bar ma re mig bcu gnyis la/ /rā dzā sa do ru ṇa yo/ /ni ra yatstsha ni rnams bri//nang ma brgyad la phyogs bzhi ru/ /ma me dakṣe dbus su ya/ /mtshams kyi kha stong bzhi la yang / /bsgrub bya dag la sngags rnams dgod/ /mgo bo phyi ru phyogs par bya/ /spyi bo dpung mgo g.yas g.yon dang / /brla snyegayas dag dang g.yon pa lnga/ /mdoms spyodang rkang mthil snying po dgod/ /mtshog tshu mar oṃ sthāḥlag g.yas la/ /skṛḥcha rkang mthil g.yas pa la/ /kṛ tā na na rkang mthil g.yon/ /hūṃ phaṭa lag mthil g.yon du'o/ /me dang hūṃ phaṭa ming dang spel / /bsgrub bya mtshams bzhir bri ba ni3/ /phyogs kyi hūṃ dang phaṭa brgyad dgod—/ /dza dang yas kyang bskor bar bya/ /rtsa ba'i snying po so gnyis kyang / /bcu bdun lus la bskor bas 'grub/ /ya ni snying gar spyi bor kṣe/ /lte bar ma dang kha la me/ /da ni lce dang kha la dgod/ /dpung pa g.yas dang g.yon gnyis la/ /yatstsha de bzhin rkang gnyis la/ /ni ra rim pas dgod par bya/ /dzā ni sa steng 'udapral bar dgod/ /sa ni chu ste lte bar bri/ /do ni me ste mgrin ⑩24—743

pa nyid/ /ru ni rlung ste brla mdoms tshosu/ /lha mo yum ni g.yon par dgod/ /na yo ni ra mig rna sna/ /lce dang bzhi la mkhas pas dgod/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bye brag yin/ /de ltar re mig dgu pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor rgyud las lhag med bri/ /chag chag khrag chen dur khrod tshon/ /lha ni bcu gsum dkyil 'khor yang / / de 'dra gzhug cing bka' bsgo'o thu/ /mchod gtor bzang ba sgron ma lnga/ /sa bdun rgyu las gshin rje'i gzugs/ /khru gang shin tu 'jigs par bya / /'khor lo dang bcas lho sgor gzhag /rgyud ltar byas la rab gnas ni/ /rlung che'i 5nang du rlung me dang tre/ /ya dang ral gri las skyes pa/ /de 'dra gzhug cing bka' bsgo'o/ /sna tshogs mtshon cha 'khor na gnas/ /lto ba srid gsum phyogs skyong dang / /gshin rje pho mo las byed rnams/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bu shes par bsgom/ /sa bdun 'khor lo'i rdzas rnams la/ /de yi bdud rtsi rjes dang bsre/dza /gzugs brnyan sor brgyad bya ba dang / /'khor lo yi ge sngar ltar dgod/ /lho sgor gshin rje'i mdun du yang / /jod pa gsum la kha spyor gzhag8 /de ltar bri ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /skra grol gcer bu bdud rtsis byugs / /lho phyogs ma te zhal ltar sbyor/ /mchod gtor gsol ba gdab pa shis / /de nas rnal 'byor bzhi rdzogs nas/ /ya mānta kar bsgyur byas la/ /snying ga'i nyi ma hūṃ 'od kyis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas khro bo rnams/ /bskul te bsgrub bya'i ye shes dang / /bsrung ba rang gi snying gar gzhug /rang bzhin 9dbang dang gzi byen bskyed/ /de yi 'jig rten lha dag kun/ /chos skyong rnams dang bral bar bya/ /zla ba phyed du bdun 'bum bya/ /'khor lo'i gzugs la gzhug pa ste/ /khugs 7nas 'khor lo'i las shis so/ /zla ba phyed 2 1—7/4

du rnal 'byor pa/ /re mig dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lho nas zhugs shing lho ru blta/ /snying ga'i snying po spros pa yis/ /las kyi gshin rje'i lto bar dkrugs/—/ /gshin rje bka' bsgo phyogs skyong dang / /gshin rje'i tshogs rnams mngag pa yis/ /oṃ dang byāḥbyeḥwi kṛ sogs/ /steng dang shar lho nub byang gi sna/ /phyogs skyong bskul bas khyab 'jug sogs/ /bsgrub bya'i rnam shes reg bya 'dren/ /bsgrub bya'i sems dang reg bya skyong / /de nas 'pho la rings pa yis/ /gshin rje'i lto bar de nas 'ong / /brgya byin sprul pa 'khor tshogs kyis/ /gzugs phung mig gi khams bcas dkrugs/ /gshin rjes tshor ba sna tshogs dkrugs/ /klu yis 'du shes sna khams dkrugs/ /gnod sbyin 'du byed lce tshogs rnams/ /dkrugs pas skyo nas lto bar yod/ /steng 'og mtshams bzhi de bzhin du/ /srog gcod sha za khrag 'thung 4zhing / /mdangs 'phrog dbugs len par yang byed/ /lus lci la sogs 'byung ba rgud/ /rnam shes 'pho ba'i las byed cing / /gshin rje'i lto bar 'gugs par byed/ /'bum phrag chogasum gyis dbugs gzhug pa/ /dhīḥbyeḥbacu pa'i las yin no/ /de nas 'khor lo kha sbyar du/ /bsgrub bya 'khor lo'i khang stong gzhagadzwa /thod pa kha sbyar nang bcug la/ /bcu gsum dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhag /rnal 'byor bzhi rdzogs rtsa ba'i sngags/ /gtso bo thugs ka 'khor de bzhin/ /bkod pa bltas 9pas sngags dang lhas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di dang gzhan bskul lo / /sprul pas gzhan bskul rigs rigs kyi/ /bsgrub bya'i yi ge rtsa dang ni//bdud rtsi bcu dang sems blangs la/ /dkyil 'khor lha la dbang bskur zhing / /lhar bsgrub dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bya/ /zla gcig nyi ma bzhi ru bcad/ /24—745

bzhi tshan bdun dang zhag gnyis te/ /dang por gsol gdab tha mar bshags/ /pra ma ya hūṃ phaṭa dang ni/ /rakta tsa ra pa ya dang / /mur tsa pa tsa pa ya dang / /dum spa nyu sarba mā ra ya/ /rim pas sngags dang ming spel bzlas/ /'bum gyis nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshan mo byāḥbyeḥ'i sbyor ba ni/ /gong du bstan pa de nyid do/ /las la chos skyong gshin rje dang / /khro bo rnams ni de bzhin bskul—/ /sgrub kyepa po yang skra grol zhing / /gcer bu bdud rtsi lngas byugs la//lho sgor lho ru phyogs pa yis/ /g.yon brkyang ḍa zhum ru dkrol lo/ /ha ha zhes pa'i sgrub pa po/ /gsum mam dpa' brtson rang nyid bsgrub/ /ya ma me da kṣe lnga yis/ /zhe sdang la sogs las skyes pa'i/ /sbrul mgo glang mgo bya yi mgo/ /'brug mgo phag gi mgo bo can/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po lnga bskul ba/ /skye rga na 'chi'i 'khor lo bskor/ /yatstsha ni ra shan pa bzhi/ /gsod bshu gcod dang za bar byed/ /dzā sa do ru drag mo bzhi/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i chung ma rnams/ /'ju skems bsreg cing gtor ④ba yi/ /shan 5pa bzhi yi chung ma ste/ /legs nyes blta zhing dur khrod nyul/ /de yi 'khor na zhe sdang can/ /gsod dang sha la shin tu dga'/ /mi sdug gzugs can mtshon cha thogs/ /bka' bskul rim pas bsgrub bya la/ /brtse ba'i tshul gyis rlung shugs kyis/ /gshin rje'i lto bar bcug par bsam/ /so sor dril bar bstod par bya/ /snying rjes khro la bsgral bsam zhing / /rang nyid 'jigs byed nyid yin zhing / /sems stobs bskyed la bstod par bya/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom/ /gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos nyid la bzhengs ye shes sku/ /dang po'i 24—746

sangs rgyas 'jam pa'i dpal/ /mngon byang ye shes longs spyod rdzogs/ /ya mānta ka phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rigs bsnyus pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rigs kyi gtso/ /zhe sdang 'joms mdzad gshin rje gshed/ /khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing khros lku/ /phyag drug mtshon chas bdud rnams 'joms/ /lha mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor bzhengs/ /byams pa'i stobs kyis sku mdog nag /khros pas dbu skra kham ser 'bar/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhal dgu khams gsum sa dgu mnan/ /mthar gyis snyoms par 'jug pa dgu/ /bstan phyir zhal mdog so sor bstan/ /mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs rje spyan dmar rtsa bdun 'bar/ /bzhad dang khro dang phaṭa kyi sgra/ /ha ha hūṃ hūṃ zhal rnams 'gyur/ /'jigs byed khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag gnyis ni/ /'gro ba skyod 2phyir glang pags rgu'adzin/ /phyag gzhan sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /byang chub phyogs las rnam par sprul/ /g.yas kyi rdo rje la sogs pas/ /thams cad gsod par mdzad pa po/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa la sogs pas/ /thams cad zil kyis gnon par mdzad/ /phyag dang phyag mtshan nam mkha' gang / /gar mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sbrul nag tshangs skud dur khrod rgyan/ /3sha khrag tshil zhag rkang la dgyes/ /dur 5khrod bdag po 4phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes me chen 'bar zhing 'phro/ /bde chen mtshan ma gyen du 'greng / /ma te'i gdong can yum dang bcas/ /bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /stong pa bcu drug zhabs rnams kyi/ /lha 24—747

rnams 1mi dang byol song gi/ /gtso bo kun mnan g.yon brkyang zhabs/ /rtag chad sel la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor ba'i sems can bsgral ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i thugs ni rab tu khros/ /gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo thusprul/ /'jigs byed tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba zhe sdang gzir gzigs nas//'gro ba'i zhe sdang zhi bya'i phyir/ /bcom ldan zhe sdang gshed du byon/ /zhe sdang gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'go ba gti mug bsgribs /rngugazigs nas/ /'gro ba'i gti mug bsal bya'i phyir/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed du bzhengs/ /gti mug rdo rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba nga rgyal mnan la gzigs / /'gro ba'i nga rgyal zhi bya'i phyir/ /phra ma gshin rje gshed du sbrul/ /phra ma 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro kun 'dod chags gsungs gzigs nas/ /'gro ba'i 'dod chags sbyang ba'i phyir/ /'dod chags gshin rje gshed du byon/ /'dod chags 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba phrag dog bcings mthong nas/ /'gro ba'i phrag dog sgol bya'i phyir/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed du byon/ /phrag dog 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyed kyi thugs rje dus da yin/ /bstan pa nyams byed sdig can rnams/ /tshe srog las ngan dus de sgrol/ /rnam shes mi bskyod gnas su 'phongs 37 zhe sdang chen po'i dus la bab/ /sdig can zhe sdang rnam shes sgrol/ /gti mug chen po'i dus la bab/ /sdig can gti mug gzugs phung sgrol/ /nga rgyal chen po'i dus la bab/ /sdig can nga rgyal tshor ba chom/ /'dod chags chen po'i dus da yin/ /sdig can 'dod chags 'du shes shig /phrag dog chen po'i dus da yin/ /spyig can phrag dog 'du byed phrol/ /bka' las 'das so dam 24—748

las 'gal/ /bstan pa 'jig go sdig las byed/ /kun la gnod do sems can 'tshe/ /slon dpon smad do slob dpon 'khu/ /sdig can 'di la thugs jes gzigs/ /'di la thugs rjes ma bsgral na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sems can bslus/ /khro bo rnams kyang rang la khro/ /de bas sdig can thugs rjes sgol/ /lus dang rnam shes so sor phye/ /lus dang sdig las 'di 1sgrol lo//rnam shes dge ba mi bskyod 2mdzod/ /bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed bka'/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir dkyil 'khor lha/ /'khor gyi chos skyong gshin rje rnams/ /khyed la drag po'i las bcol lo/ /oṃ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor steng du bdag 'bod pas/ /steng du phyogs skyong lha rnams ni/ /gza' dang rgyu skar rgyal chen bzhi/ /gtso 'khor chung ma bu dang g.yog /bcas pa rnams la bdag 'bod pas/ /bdag la don chen gzhan med na/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan la dga'/ /khyed ni sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa zhig la khad/ /khyed kyis rgyal ba mi brjed dam/ /dam bcas bka' 'di ma slu 4bar/ /bdag gis phyogs skyong khyed bskul gyis/ /sdig can nyams pa myur du sod/ /oṃ gyis bod 5kyis lha chen brgyad/ /tshogs dang bcas pa myur du sod/ /oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma he shwa ra de ba ind+ra bradma ru dri hūṃ/ ga 6na dha ri ti karti ma hā kā 7la che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/do rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor gyi/ /shar kyi dur khrod gtum drag na/ /shar phyogs skyong bar dam bcas pa'i/ /dri za bskor ba'i brgya byin ni/ /lus mdog dkar po glang po zhon/ /g.yas na rdo rje dril bu g.yon/ /dur khrod rin chen rgyan dang ldan/ /chung ma bu dang bran g.yog 'khor/ /rnal 'byor 24—749

bdag ni khyed 'bod pas/ /khyed la don chen gzhan don hūṃmin/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan la dad/ /khyed ni sangs rgyas bstan pa srung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa zhig la khad/ /bstan pa 'jig snye pa che ge mo/ /sthāḥyis 'bod kyis brgya byin lha/ /sangs rgyas bka' las khyed ma 'da'/ /mchod gtor sbyin pa chud ma gsan/ /'khor gyi pho nya las la bskul/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i las la 'di/ /zhags pa can kyis mgul nas chings/ /lcags kyu can kyis snying nas drongs/ /lcags sgrog can gyis 'di bsdoms la/ /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul/ /las kyi gshin rjes mdun nas bsu/ /stobs chen rnams kyis 'di khug cig /dmigs pa'i rten la thim par gyis/ /gshin rje lto ba'i 'khor lor chug /mtshon cha du ma'i char phob 4la/ /sdig can 'di yi tshe srog chod/ /srog la dbang bas 'di srog chod/ /dbugs la dbang bas 'di dbugs phrogs/ /sha za rnams kyis 'di sha zo/ /sdig can 'di yi srepags pa dang / /khrag dang zhag dang tshil dang rkang / /rang rang dbang pos sneso sor khyer / /gtad dang khas blangs bstan pa srung 3/ /oṃ sthāḥbyeḥ blu kṛ tā nā na na —ind+ra ye dhīḥ9 che ge mo mā 3ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lho yi dur khrod ha ha dgod/ /lho phyogs skyong bar dam bcas pa/ /gshin rjes bskor ba'i gshin rje tso ni/ /lus mdog nag po ma te zhon/ /g.yas na dbyug pa zhags pa g.yon/ /dur khrod rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /chung ma bu dang bran g.yog 'khor/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni khyed 'bod pas/ /khyed la don chen gzhan yod min/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan la dad/ /khyed ni sangs rgyas bstan pa srung na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa zhig la khad/ /bstan pa 24—750

'jig 1pa'i che ge mo/ /oṃ byāḥbyeḥwi kṛ 2tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ bye yis 'bod pa gshin rje sogs/ /rim par bskul bar shes par bya/ /oṃ byāḥbyeḥcha kṛ tā na na ya ma ye sbyi che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas sngags kyis — gnad la dbab/ /bcu pa phyogs skyong spel bas bzla/ /gzugs la dug tshon phur pa lngas/ /gnas par gdab pa man ngag yin/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'og phyogs skyong bar dam bcas pa'i/ /sa yi lha mo klu chen brgyad/ /rdo rje 4 mig can dkar po'i phyogs/ /gtso bo'i chung ma bu dang 'khor/ /lus mdog phyag mtshan rang rang rtags/ /a dang phuḥyis 'bod pa dang / /las kun 'khor la bcol bar bya/ /oṃ dhīḥ sgoḥwi kṛ tā 5na na hūṃ nā ga phu pha sum̐ phe phi phi pho che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo mtshon cha dpag rnged kyis/ /sdeg can 'di la rnam par gzir/ /rdo rje zhags pas mgul nas bzung / /rdo rje lcags kyus snying nas drongs/ /rdo rje lcags sgog dam du chings/ /rdo rje mtshon gyis rnam par chom/ /'khor lo 'bar bas rab tu khros/ /tho ba dbyug pas rdul du brdungs/ /mda' dang mdung gis thal phyung phug /gri gug dgra stas lcu zug phrol/ /ral gri chu gris dum bur gtub7/ /me rlung las kyis rnam par gtor / /rgyal ba'i bka' yin khro bo 8las/ /'khor kyi pho nya'i dus la bab/ /sdig can 'di la snying rje med/ /khro bo rnams kyi thugs rje yis/ /'khor gyis bsad pa'i sdig can 'di/ /mi bskyod bzhin 9du 'di bskyol la/ /rgyal ba'i sras su 'di sgrubs tsoshig /rgyal ba'i thugs dam des mthar phyin/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed las byed pa/ /ya yi las byed ya ma ya/ /ya yis 'bod do khyod bskul lo/ /las kyi gshin rje khyod bskul lo/ /khro bo sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ /24—751

khams gsum khyod kyi lha ma 1lto na 'khor/ /skye rga na 'chi'i 1'khor lo bskor/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i sdig can 'di/ /g.yas kyi gri yis srog snying chod/ /myur du 'chi ba'i las la sbyor/ /g.yon gyi thod pa snying gar sbyor — / /kha ru brdungs 4shig khā hi pi/ /tsitta rakta ma ra khā 5hi/ /sdig can tsitta rakta khā hi/ /las kyi gshin rje des sprul pa'i/ /dur khrod bdag po gshin rje gshedadzi/ /nag po gel bag ral gri zhags/ /khyod kyi lto bar skye 'gro 'gro/ /sdig can 'di yi tshe srog chug /zhags pas zung la ral gris gtubs/ /sdig can srog rtsa ma ra rbad / /phra ma rdo rje'i las byed pa/ /ma yi las byed ma ru rtse/ /ma yis 'bod do khyod bskul lo/ /srog gi bdag po ma ru rtse/ /glang mgo gshin rje ya ba ti/ /skye 'gro khyod kyis 7lte rtsa gcod/ /g.yas kyi gri yis lte rtsa chod/ /myur du 'chi ba'i las la sbyor/ /g.yon gyi thod par lte khrag spyos/ /kha ru brdubs shig khā hi pi/ /chorpā ta rakta ma ra khā hi/ /sdig can na ga rakta khā hi/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i las byed pa/ /me yis 9las byed smon byed de/ /me yis 'bod do khyod bskul lo/ /mdangs kyi bdag po bya mgo can/ /myos byed gshin rje pi pa tra/ /skye 'gro khyod kyis mgrin rtsa chod/ /g.yas kyi mda' yis mgrin rtsa chod/ /myur du 'chi ba'i las la sbyor/ /g.yon pa thod par 1 mgrin khrag spyos/ /kha ru brdubs shig khā hi pi/ /mgrin pa rakta ma ra khā hi/ /sdig can mgrin par 1 rakta khā hi/ /khrag 11dog rdo rje'i las byed pa/ /nga yis las byed bum bu rji/ /nga yis 'bod do khyod bskul lo/ /dbugs kyi bdag po bum bu rdzi/ /'brug mgo gshin rje ku be ra/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bla dbugs gcodaḥ / /g.yas kyi dgra stas bla dbugs chod/ /'chi ba'i las la myur du 24—752

sbyor—/ /g.yon gyi thod pas bla khrag spyos/ /kha ru brdubs shig khā hi pi/ /rpā ta rakta mā ra khā hi/ /sdig can rpā ta rakta khā hi/ /gti mug rdo rje las byed pa / /kṣe yi las byed bee swa tā/ /kṣe yis 'bod do khyod bsgul lo/ /tshe yi bdag po bai swa tā/ /phag mgo gshin rje kṣe pa la/ /skye 'gro'i tshe rnams khyod kyis phyung /1/ / /g.yas pa'i dbyug pas tshe brdungs shig /'chi ba'i las la myur du sbyor/ /g.yon gyi thod pas bla khrag sbyos/ /kha ru brdungs 2shig kha ru pi/ /mun dha rakta ma ra khā snyehi/ /sdig can mun dha rakta khā hi/ /rdo rje tho ba'i las byed pa/ /ya yi las byed ya ma ra/ /ya 4yis 'bod do khyod bskul lo/ /gsod byed bdag po phywa sangs ni/ /sha ba'i mgo can gshin rje drag /skye 'gro khyod kyis lhagasod par byed/ /g.yas kyi gri yis tshe srog gcod/ /g.yon gyi zhags pas dam du bsdoms/ /rdo rje dbyug pa'i las byed pa/ /tsa'i 6las byed tsa ra na/ /stso kyeyis 'bod do khyod bskul lo/ /bshu byed bdag po tel pa ste / /ce spyang mgo can gshin rje rno/ /skye 'gro khyod kyis bsha' bar byed/ /g.yas kyi gri yis lpags bshus la/ /g.yon kyi zhags pas dam du bsdoms/ /rdo rje padma'i las byed pa/ /ni yi las byed ya ma ni/ /ni yis 'bod do khyod bskul lo/ /gcod byed bdag po rmig pa ni/ /rmig pa'i mgo can gtum po mgyogs / /skye 'gro khyod kyis gtubs 9par byed/ /g.yas kyi dgra stas rab tu chod/ /g.yon gyi 'khor los rab tu phye/ /rdo rje ral gri'i las byed pa/ /rā yi las byed ral tshar dgu/ /rā yis 'bod do khyod bskul lo/ /za byed bdag po rā hu 7la/ /chu srin mgo can gshin rje 'jigs/ /skye 'gro khyod kyis za bar byed/ /g.yas kyi 'khor los dum bur gtubs/ /g.yon gyi lcags 24—753

kyus rab tu gzung 1/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor gyi/ /las byed rnams kyi chung ma brgyad/ /dmar mo khrag gi ral pa can/ /gri gug thod pas lag gnyis 'byel/ /las kyi gshin rje'i chung ma yin/ /khams gsum skye 'gro sto bar chug /gcod cing sha khrag za la dga'/ /'khor lo bskor cig gshin rje'i yum/ /dzā sa do ru yi las byed ma/ /tsārtsi 5phag mo dbyangs can ma / / go rī bzhi yi ༄ bka' nyan ma/ /dus bzhi 'byung ba'i lha mo bzhi/ /sha khrag drod dang dbugs la gtod/ /dzā sa do rus khyed 'bod kyis/ /sdig can 'di yi sha khrag drongs/ /dbugs 'di khyod kyis myur du phrol/ /sgo ba'i pho nya bka' nyan cing / /na yo na chora'i las byed ma/ /zung shig 3chings shig rab tu bsdoms/ /'khor lor gnon pa'i las gyis shig /dus la bab po tsan tra dza/ /bka' las ma 'da' sa ma ya/ /rnal 'byor ma bslu dkar ma dkar / /bstan pa srungs 6shig dar ma dpal/ /ya ma me da kṣe che ge mo mā ra ya rbad rbad/ ya dzā 3ni ra che ge mo mā ra ya khā hi khā hi/ dzā sa do ru che ge mo mā ra ya dzwa la dzwa la/ ṇa yo ni rā che ge mo mā ra ya dzdza/ gshin rje'i lto bar 'khor lo bskor/ /gshin rje 5'khor gyi pho nya'i tshogs/ /bya dang sbrul dang gcan gzan khye/ /sha zan thams cad myur du rgyug /sdig can 'di la rnam par rol/ /rang rang pags pa sha dang khrag /zhag dang tshil dang rkang mar rus / /dbang po don snying skal khā hi/ /1de nas las la sbyar ba ni/ /rgyal po gtum po tsaṇḍa līnyu / /'khor lo thod pa kha sbyar gzhug /lho sgor thod pa sgyed steng gzhags /srid pa gsum gyi sems can rnams/ /dbang med skye 'chi'i las la bskul/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa yi/ /las kyi gshin rje 24—754

pho mo bskyed①/ /ya yis dgug gzhug bcing ba dang / /gnyis med gshin rje'i lto ba dkrug /khru gang gshin rje'i bskyed sogs yang / /de ltar las mkhan dgu sogs bya/ /bsgrub bya dzra ṭalas 'khor lo dang / /gzugs la bskyed dang dgug nga sogs bstem/ /khro bo chos skyong bka' bsgo zhing / /snying po bdun 'bum bzla ba dang / /sha chen khrag chen gtor ma bzang / /bsgrub bya skyabs med khro bos bsgral/ /de nas nyi ma lngar phye la/ /nyin mo so so ④ mtshan mo dril/ /las sngags rtsa sngags so so la/ /sum 'bum 'bum phrag dag tu bzlas/ /sngags kyi lha rnams so sor bskul/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sngags brjod pas/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs rnams/ /dzi na dzika sgrogs phyogs skyong bskul/ /khro bos gshin rje ded cing bsgul/ /bsgrub snyebya'i ske nas 'khor los lus/ /so sor blang 6dang so sor khyer/ /sha dang khrag sogs sbyin pa'i rgyu/ /phung po khams sogs lhar bya zhing / /sems ni mi bskyod zhing du 'phang / /khro bo phyogs skyong gshin rje yi/ /g.yon gyi mtshon chas 'gugs byed cing / /g.yas kyi mtshon chas gsod par bsam/ /snying rjes khros pa'i las la bskul/ /de nas sbyin sreg mnan pa ste/ /pha rnges bskyal ba'i dur khrod du/ /'khor lo gshin rjes mnan pa sba/ /thab khung nang du 7gru gsum bya//khru phyed brko zhing rdzas ngan byug /dur gyi shing la dur khrod mes// /sbar la me lha gshin rje dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed sogs bya/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed spyor ba yis/ /gzugs brnyan mi byerus phye ma dang / /de yi rjes dang skra sen dang / /rnam snang chu dang bcas pa rnams/ /nam phyed dag nas nam phyed bsregakye /tshu tshun dha ra'i pags pa ru/ /rnam snang chu yi spyor ba ni/ /24—755

bla ma'i ngag la legs blangs la/ /gnas su sbas na nges par 'grub/ /de nas rtags sam nges 'phos nas/ /bsgrub bya de la dbang bskur zhing / /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i cho ga yis/ /mi bskyod zhing du nges par skye/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes gnang ba la/ /rnal 'byor pa de 'go don 'grub/ /rgyal bas bden par gsungs pa dang / /bdag gis brgyud pa'i man ngag mthong / /ting nge 1sna'adzin ma gsang —snasngags mchod/ /yang na rdzas ma tshogs pa yin/ /'on kyang zhe sdang kho na dang / /dam tshig — snanyams pa dag kyang srid/ /tsaṇḍa lī yis 4mtshon bsnun la/ /las kyi gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskyed/ /gnas su yi ge dgod pa dang / /lto bar 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /mtshan mo sngags kun gcig tu bzla/ /nyin mo so sor phye 5la bzlas/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bris sku la/ /sgron ma chen po'i mchod pa 'bul/ /spro bsdus snabaskul don snga ma bzhin/ /zla ba phyed kyis de des 'grub/ /de nas de yi pags 7pa bshu/ /lha yi gnas kyi sha rnams kun/ /bzung nas rjes la las kun la/ /'khor lo lha yi sbyor ba yis / /zhi dang rgyas pa dbang la sogs/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor los bsgrub / /mchod dang gtor ma rgya chen dang / /snying rje kho nas bsgrub par bya/ /rjes thob mnyam par bzhag pas 'grub/ /bskyed dang rdzogs dang gnyis med pa'i / /bsam gtan bzlas pa spro bsdu yis/ /rtag tu bsnyen pa bya ba yin/ /des kyang grub par ma gyur zhing / /mtshan ma rmi lam rtags rnams med/ /'khrugs dang nor ba byung ba dag /dam tshig 9nyams pa yin pas sbyang / /dbang bsgur tshogs kyi mchod pa dag /sngon gyi slob dpon de nyid dam/ /grub thob sgrub pa rtag tu byed/ /de mnyes byas la zhu ba bya/ /rdo rje 'jigs 24—756

dod ——————————— ———————— ———byed rgyud nyid kyi/ /cho ga shes pas dbang bsgur ro/ /de nas cho ga'i rim pa yis / /'jam dpal rnal 'byor gsal ba la/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa dang / /skye mched byin rlabs dbang bsgur la/ /mi bskyod cod pan ldan pa yi/ /snying gar zla dkyil yi ge dhī/ /zhe swā hā phyogs bzhir bzla/ /sngags dbyings chos la spro bsdu bsam/ /rjes la mchod gtor bzlas pa 'bad/ /gnyid 4dang le lo'i bar chad spang / /zhag drug zla drug lo drug tu/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga dpa' bas bya/ /thun gcig zhag gabyug zla ba lo/ /tshe gcig bskal par dka' 5min bsgrub/ /lam mchog 'di ni yun ring tshomin/ /dam tshig snying rje thabs dang ldan / /zla drug nang du rtags mthong bas/ /rgyal ba mnyes byed mngon spyod spyad/ /de rjes rjes thob 'gro ba la/ /phan phyir 'khor lo'i las la 'jug /phyi rol pa dag bstan la gnod/ /rang rig dam tshig nyams pa dag /mchod dang gtor ma bzlas la brtson/ /bsrungs pa dag gis 'gyangs pa la/ /ngag mnan bzlog pa'i 'khor lo bya/ /'khor los sngags sbyor rim pa dang / /rdzas dang ting 'dzin rim pa dang / /bsnyen sgrub las spyor zla drug gis/ /rgyud ltar 'khor 'o/ sbas pas 'grub/ /de las khyad par rnal 'byor pas/ /mnan dang bzlog pa'i cho ga ni/ /sngon du bsnyen dang rtag tu bsgom/ /gzhan du rgyal ba'i bka' las 'das/ /mar tshes brgyad la bri ba ni/ /ras dag sngon ltar rdzas kyis brgyang / /yung ba ba blas kha bsgyur ba'i / /sngon gyi rdzas kyis 'khor lo dzre/ /'khor lo'i yi ge dbri dang bsnan/ /las kyi bye brag shes pa yis/ /ma ra stambha bcu pa'i mthar/ /bra ma ra ya stambha ya lo/ /mkhas pas ya ma bzhi yi mthar/ /khang stong bathi la liṅga bskor/ /27——7bye7

de bzhin spel ma zhag lnga bzla/ /dang po zhag la bsnyen pa dang / /tha ma lkugs pa'i chu la mnan/ /zhag bdun dag gis nges par gnon/ /yang na mi 'jigs bsrung ba ni/ /rtag par bsgom pa de nyid mchog /'khor lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjer bskyed/ /de nyid gsum gyi spro bsdus bsrung / /bya min nyal ba'i sa min spang / /shar du phyogs shing gsum la skyabs/ /rten 'byel mthu yang thabs yin pas/ /bram ze srid bsrung las byung ras/ /tshes brgyad dag la 'bas chus brgyang / /tsandan dkar po til dkar dang / /gu gul dkar pos legs byas la/ /gur kum gi wang legs sbyar bas/ /bcu bzhi'i snga dro bri ba ni/ /bcu gnyis sor ni zlum por bskor/ /phyi rol rdo rje ra ba la/ /rnge ri hūṃ dang rab tu ldan/ /de nas cha mnyam bzhi ru bskor/ /phyi rol 'khor la sum cu gnyis/ /rtsa sngags 'khor lo'i rtse mor dgod/ /rtsa bar oṃ ni drug cu bzhi/ /bsrung ba'i ming ni mtha' rten 4bri/ /rtsibs mtshan hūṃ phaṭa mtha' brten pa'i/ /bar chod dag gis 5ming dag bri/ /re mig kā li dag gis dgang / /de nas 'khor lo bcu drug la/ /dīḥ6sogs brgyad ni brgyad por bri//brgyad la ming dang bsrung bar bcas/ /sngar bzhin rtsa bar oṃ gyis brten/ /mtshan la phaṭa brten gzhan dag bri/ /re mig dag la ā li yin/ /de bar brgyad la snying po ni/ /a thung bsnan pas brgyad bri'o/ /rtsa bar a brten bsrung ba gzhag7 /mtshan mar hūṃ phaṭa gzhan bsnan no/ /de nas dhīḥdabus gzhag 8pa yi/ /phyogs bzhir o dhīḥswā 9hā dgod/ /stong pa bzhi la ming bcas bsrung / /oṃ gnyis dhīḥ kṣe shar yin la/ / da me 1ma ni byang nub lho/ /srong la maṇḍal 1 legs byugs la/ /me tog nag po bcu bdun dgod/ /de 24—758

steng bzhag la rnal 'byor bzhi/ /rdzogs nas gtor ma btang dang bcol/ /bzlas pa spro bsdu yi ge dang / /bcas pa'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs dang / /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba gur/ /rtag tu de nang gnas pa gdags/ /yang na rtag tu mchod par bya/ /mgul lam gtsug dang dpung g.yon gdags/ /khro bo khros kyang 'jigs mi nus/ /phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'dod na yang / /sngon bzhin rnal 'byor bzhis bskyed dam/ /rgyud las myur dang skad cig las/ /rnal 'byor gsal bas 'grub pa po2/ /stong dang snying rje me ri dang / /dra gur ldan pas bdud bzhi bzlog /de nas 'khor lo so bzhi ni/ /steng du oṃ las lha chen dgu/ /rtsa sngags rnams la gshin rje brgyad/ /las mkhan brgyad dang pho nya brgyad/ /shan pa brgyad ni bskyed pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor rang lha'i mngag pas bzlog /hūṃ las rdo rje'i mig can rigs/ /phaṭa las 'og tu klu chen brgyad/ /rtsa sngags bdun bzlas bzlog par bsam/ /de nas 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la/ /steng 'og phyogs skyong bskyed pa dang / /de nang drug las snying po las/ /gshin rje drug ni bskyed pa dang / /de bzhin rang bzhin re re gzhug /gnyis rnged gyur pa las bcol 5ba/ /so so lus bong ljang gu'i mdog/g.yas kun 'khor lo 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon kun sdigs mdzub byed pa yis/ /phas kyi 'byung po bzlog bsam 7la/ /snying gar ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /'jam dpal ting 'dzin spro bsdu bzlas/ /bdun brjod sgu yi rigs rnams gzhug /ye shes gshin rje gshed bsams nas/ /ya mānta ka bdun brjod la/ /gsung rigs thams cad bskul zhing gzhug /dam tshig 'jigs byed gsal ba yis / /dhīḥbyeḥbadun brjod thugs rigs gzhug /bcu gsum yon tan rtsa 24—759

sngags brjod/ /bdun gyis rgyal ba thams cad gzhug /de bzhin bdun bdun nang rim du/ /phyi nas brjod pas bzlog pa'o/ /sems ni ting 'dzin dhīḥl sba/ /bdag 1ni ye shes āḥl sba/ /lus ni dam tshig oṃ la sba/ /rdo rje bzlas pa ldan pas zhal/ /yang na pho mo ma nor ba'i/ /thod par 'khor lo bri ba ni/ /rdzas dus sngon bzhin legs bris la/ /mā 2ra'i gnas su stambha gzhag /steng gi thod pa spyi rdol la/ /liṅga tshon lngas btags pa drang / /sngags gsum tha mar stambha btags/ /dhīḥswā 4hā yis bsrung bar bya/ /zhag gam thun nam zla ba ru/ /thun gcig dus gsum dag tu brab/ /non pa'i rtags dag nges pa dang / /ba bla yung bas g.yam nag la/ /nang du sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /phyi ru ri rab bris pa yis/ /mi 'bab mtsho ru mnan pa bya/ /ba bla yung ba ldong ros dang / /gi wang dag gis thab khung ni/ /khru gang gru bzhi par byugs la/ /skyer pa dur khrod shing dang ni/ /seng ldeng glang po che yi sbangs/ /rgyal po'i me sbar me lha ser/ /'jigs byed bskyed sogs gsal ba la/ /ba bla yungs ‘kar yung ba dang / /glang po che yi sha bsregs 7pa/ /byang du phyogs/ pa'i ming dang bsreg /zhag bdun bsregs na rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnod cing rengs pa'i spyor ba'o/ /yang na pra ba nag dang dmar/ /cho ga sngon mas de bzhin mnan/ /dam tshig bskang ba'i cho ga yis/ /bsrung ba shin tu bsdus rte bzang / /stong dang snying rje kho na yis/ /bsrung ba mchog gis sangs rgyas/ 'grub / /sngags rnams rgyun du bzla ba dang / /dge gzhan gtor ma dag 'a/ brtson / /dam tshig bla mas legs bskyangs na/ /bar chod thams cad bzlos par 'gyur/ /las kun sngon du bsnyen pa ni/ /zla gnyis bsgrub pa zhag bdum 2(——760

dang / /las spyor zhag re spyir dgos pa/ /sgrub 1pa po yis shes par bya/ /bskrad pa rgyal mtshan ras blangs la/ /sngon gyi rdzas kyis 'khor lo bya/ /sngags spel liṅga shes pas dgod/ /dgug gzhug rim pa zhag bdun bsgrub/ /sa bdun dag la rta dang ni/ /bsgrub bya zhon pa'i gzugs byas te/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng lho phyogs/ /nyi ma'i nyin mo tsaṇḍa lī / /lus la ske che'i mar byugs nas/ /nim pa'i shing la des 'dzeg pa'i/ /thod par nyi phyed sbum de bzhar/ /bya rog tshang bsreg 4thal ba dang / /dur khrod thal ba bsres pa ni/ /de yi mgo la blugs shing 5byug /rgyal mtshan ras bsregs thal ba dang / /bsres pa de yis rkang la bsku/ /dur khrod sol ba bya rog khrag /bya rog rus pas shing shun la/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bris byas la/ /de yi dkyil du bsgrub bya yi/ /liṅga ming sngags spel ba bri/ /bya rog dag gam sa bdun las7/ /byas pa'i mgul du de btags te/ /lho ru phyogs pas de sngon gzhagar /sa bdun sbrus las gshin rje ni/ /dbyug thogs de yi rgyab nas 'ded/ /dgug gzhug gsal bas sgrub pa yi/ /rtags byung zhag bdun lon pa dang / /'khor lo gshin rje'i lto bar gzhag /liṅga bsgrub bya'i snying gar sba/ /nim pa'i shing gcig rtsa ba ru/ /lho ru phyogs pas bskyal bar sgod/ /de nas sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ /rlung gi thab khung dbus su ni/ /nim pa 'bras phub bya rog tshang //da du ra shing dur khrod shing / /dur khrod shing gis rnge beer la/ /me lha ljang gu bskyed pa dang / /'jigs byed bskyed sogs gsal ba na / /gcer bu skra gol lhor phyogs pas/ /bya rog khyem bya 5sbal pa khyi/ /sha dang rnga mo'i rtug pa tshang / /byi la'i khrag gis sbrus la bsreg /yi ge bcu pa gtsor byas la/ /2(——76/

—— —ming dang bcas pas grub pa yin/ /zhag bdun byas na grong khyer sgod1/ /smyo bar bya ba smrod dang mtshungs/ /sha chen da du ro 'bras bsreg /dbye ba'i spyor ba bstan pa ni/ /bram ze ma 2bi ma te rta/ /bya rog 'ug pa nee le sbrul/ /khrag gis 'khor lo brgyad dag bri/ /mkhas pas sngags dgod spel bas bzlas/ /bram ze rigs ngan thod par gzhag— /sa bdun dag la ma te rta/ /gzugs la shing shun liṅga sba/ /sgro gnyis rus pa gnyis la ni/ /bcu pa'i sngags spel 5bri ba dang / /sgro gnyis bcings la pags 6par gzhug /nim pa'i shing gi steng du gzhag7 /sa bdun rgyu las bsgrub bya ba/ /ma he rta la bskyon byas nas / /da du ra yi thal ba dang / /tsher mas bcu pa'i sngags bzla'o/ /las spyor liṅga bsgrub bya 9sba/ /chu 'gram 'thab sar —sba zhing bskyal/ /de nas chu dang me yi thab / /tsher ma 'o ma can gyi shing / /dur khrod shing dang 'bras phub la/ /dur khrod gtum po'i me sbar te/ /lha ni dmar nag bskyed pa dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed pa la/ /ma te rta dang bya rog 'ug /rma bya sbrul gye sha bsreg bya/ /yi ge bcu pa ming spel bas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'byed/ /de nas dbang dang dgug pa bstan/ /gur kum gi wang srin lag khrag /'khor lo brgyad dag bri bar bya/ /thod pa gnyis la 'khor lo dzre/ /'khor lo dgug gzhug dril la gzhug /gur kum gi wang srin lag khrag /sa bdun sbrus la bsgrub bya yi/ /sor mo bcu drug gzugs brnyan la/ /sha khrag gi wang gur kum gyis/ /gro ga'i 'khor lo 5snying gar gzhug /me tog spos phor dus gsum mchod/ /nub tu phyogs pas rtsa sngags bzla/ /seng ldeng me la thod pa bsro/ /bcu pa'i snying po las spyor bya/ /'gyang na dur khrod rdzas rdzo7——762

'khor lo/ /gsad pa'i 'khor lo sngags bye ba/ /ro bsreg 1sol ba spra tshil dang / /tsha ba gsum dang rdzas gzhan la/ /bsgrub bya mtho gang kha so gcigs/ /'khor lo snying gar bcug byas la/ /g.yon brkyang ma te 2zhal sbyar bas/ /mnan la yi ge bcu pas dgug /sbyin sreg thab khung zla gam du/ /tsandan dmar po gur kum dang / /gi wang srin lag khrag gis 4byug /seng sdeng me la lha gnyis dmar/ /ske che'i gzugs rten nya dang chang / /til dang 'bras kyi tsher ma dug /bdud rtsi lnga dang khrag sbrus la/ /nub tu phyogs pas dus gsum du/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni zhag bdun bya/ /sha lnga rnam snang rdo rje'i chu/ /chang dang bsres 5na rgyal po sogs/ /thams cad dbang du 'gyur ba yin/ /yi ge bcu pa'i spyor bas bya/ /rgyas par 'dod la rgyas pa'i las/ /sgrub 6pa po yis 'di ltar bya/ /rgyal po khyem bdag ras blangs la/ /gur kum gi wang tsandan gyis/ /'khor lo brgyangs la bri bar bya/ /sra ba gru bzhi ser por sba/ /srad bu ser pos rgya gram dkri/ /maṇḍal ser po'i steng du gzhag7 /byang du phyogs pas bsam gtan sngags/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed spyor bas bya/ /me tog ser pos dus gsum mchod/ /phra ma gshin rje gshed mnyam pa'i/ /rgyas pa'i las ni gang 'dod pa/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub par 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg rgyas pa'i thab khung du/ /u dusmra ra'i shing la me/ /spar la lha gnyis ser por 9 bskyed / /til nas mar dang 'bras zho dag /byang du bltas pas stong du bsreg /gang 'dod pa de rgyas par 'gyur/ /sngags dang ming du bcas bsregs na/ /gang 'dod rgyas par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhi ba'i las dag 'di ltar bya / /stong dang snying rje 'jigs byed ldan/ /tsandan til dkar gur kum 2(—763

dod dodadang / /gi wang go ro tsa na yis/ /'khor lo brgyad dang yi ge dgod/ /sra ba zlum po dkar po sba/ /srad bu dkar pos dkri byas la/ /maṇḍal dkar po'i steng bzhag ste/ /shar du phyogs pas zhi bas bsgrub/ /me tog dkar pos dus gsum mchod/ /sbyin sreg thab khung zlum po ru/ /pa la sha la mee sbar la/ /dre lha rdo rje 'jigs byed dkar/ /bskyed dang dgug sogs legs par mchod/ /shar du kha bltas til dang mar/ /sbrang rtsi 'o ma drur 1ba dag /dus gsum dag tu zhag bdun bsreg /bdag dang gzhan gyi bar chad zhi/ /las gzhan kun dang spogs pa ni/ /'khor lo'i rdzas dang spyor bas dbye/ /man ngag brgyud pa bla ma bsten/ /rdzas dang dam tshig ting 'dzin gsal/ /sngags la gus na 'grub pa las/ /ma gsang 4gzhan du mi 'grub po/ /thams cad rdzas dang 'khor lo dang / /bsam gtan sngags la brtson pa dang / /bsnyen pa brtul zhugs dpa' ba dang / /bla ma la gus gsang na 'grub/ /de las gzhan pas mi 'grub pas/ /rgyud ltar sgod btags 'bad pa gsang / /ma gsang snod ngan la bshad pas/ /slob dpon 'di dang phyi mar brlag /rgyud don bla ma la brten nas/ /mos pas 'di byas mkhas pas bkod/ /sgra nor don log nyes pa rnams/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed chos skyong bshags/ /rgyud dang gdams ngag la brten te/ /'gro la bsams nas sgrub thabs bris/ /'di las dge ba ci thob pas/ /bdag gzhan rdo rje'i sgu thob shog /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs rdo rje 'od ces bya ba/ slob dpon chen po bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rdzo7 76 /
