0919༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje 'dzeegs byed kyi dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga gsal ba zhes bya ba/1 ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bye ra wa badzra maṇḍa la pra ka bi bye nā ma / bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gye cho ga gsal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' lta bur dngos bdag med/ /dus mtha'i 'od ltar lha rnams 'bar/ /shes rab thabs 'dres gnyis su med/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nyid thob 'dod rigs can la/ /de yi dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /brgyud pa'i rim 'ongs man ngag thob/ /rgyud sde shes shing cho ga mkhas/ /dam tshig la gnas byin rlabs yod/ /spyin sogs snying rje slob ma 'dzin/ /gnod spyin rigs 'dus bstan la gus/ /de ni bka' 2yang slob dpon rigs/ /gzung bar bya ba'i slob ma ni/ /dad gus snying rje shes rab yod/ /dge sdig rnam smin 'bras bu shes/ /sdom gnas dul shing khro ba spangs/ /brtul zhugs 24—770

dpa' phod sems stobs brtson/ /sems gcig don med bsgrub pa 'dod/ /zab dang rgya che 'dzin 3la gnas/ /de las gzhan pa 'dir mi gzung / /dur khrod la sogs dbeen bsdad de/ /maṇḍal mchod gtor rdzas bsags la/ /sdom dang sngags kyis gaslob ma bsrung / /rnal 'byor bzhi gnas 'bum khri stong //snying po las dang rtsa sngags bzlas/ /chos skyong bsnyen pa rtags mtshan grangs/ /bsnyen pa grub nas sta gon te/ /dbyibs sngags chos dang ldan pa yis/ /phyogs dang dbyibs dang kha dog la/ /btsal dang brtag pa dag tu bya/ /dkar dang zlum dang shar la sogs/ /'bol snum gyong dang yang ba yis /rnyed legs slang dang dbrog par bya/ /yang na rin gyis nyo yang rung / /lha mo dpang gsol rnal 'byor bzhis/ /stong nyid dra gur rdo rje'i gdan/ /oṃ bhū khaṃ gis chos nyid mkha'/ /hūṃ lam̐ hūṃ sogs 'byung ba'i rim/ /badzra me de'i sngags brjod cing / /rakṣa rakṣas rdo rjes bsrung / /sa ro dbyung zhing sbyang bar bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par ni/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /brjod la lha mo mkha' la bteg /bdud rtsi khrag chen pa yi dri/ /sor bzhi mtho gang gru bzhir brtsigs4/ /slob dpon khrus byas 5dri zhim dang / /bdud rtsi lngas byug dur khrod kyi/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan cod pan dang / /stod smad gos ldan gdan la bsdad/ /rdo rje dril bu snying rjes bzung / /'gro ba bsgral phyir dkyil 'khor 'jug /rnal 'byor chen pos gnas pa la/ /dris brgyan rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /slob ma bzhi yis gsol ba gdab/ /'gro kun gti mug mnan mthong nas/ /'gro ba'i gti mug bsal 6ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan gti 24—771

mug gshed du byon/ /gti mug 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal bzhengs/ /'gro kun nga rgyal gyis mnan gyis/ /'gro kun nga rgyal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bcom ldan phra ma gshed du byon/ /phra ma 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal bzhengasarmye/ /'gro kun 'dod chags gzir gzigs nas/ /bcom ldan 'dod chags gshed du byon/ /'gro ba'i 'dod chags sbyang ba'i phyir/ /'dod chags 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal lo / /'go kun phrag dog bcings mthong nas/ /'gro ba'i phrag dog bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan phrag dog gshed du mdzad/ /phrag dog 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal bzhengs/ /'gro kun zhe sdang gis gzir gzigs/ /'gro ba'i zhe sdang sbyang ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan zhe sdang gshed du sprul/ /zhe sdang 'jigs mdzad phyag 'tshal bzhengs/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor ni/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi mngon gyur pa/ /sdig pa thams cad nyams byed cing / /'dod pa kun 'byung mgon por bri/ /gsol ba'i sgra de brag ca ltar/ /gsal nas chos nyid dag la bzhengs/ /snying rje chen pos 'gro ba kun/ /dug lnga'i gnas nas bsgral bsams la/ /hūṃ hūṃ badzra untidzre/ /brjod la rdo rje gsor bas bzhengs/ /ṭa dang ma las rdo rje'i spyan4/ /g.yas dang g.yon kyis khams gsum blta/ /sangs rgyas kun bskul bgegs bskrad bsam/ /rkang las hūṃ 'od rdo rje'i sa/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad/ /ral gri ra ba g.yas brkyang sogs/ /gar dang bcas pas lan gsum du/ /dkyil 'khor bskor la bsrung ba bya/ /hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /srung 5ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor byed/ /nyon cig bgegs rnams kun nyon cig /lus ngag yid la gnod pa kun/ /lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs khyed/ /de ring gzhan du 'gro 24—772

bar gyis/ /gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje 'di yis bgegs byed kun/ /lus ngag yid gsum dgas par bya'o/ /de nas gnod mdzes sngags kyis bsrung / /gha 1snaghā ta yis phur pas gdab/ /mchod dang gtor mas khro bo mchod/ /bdag dang slob ma bsrung bar gsol/ /lha mo dmigs nas mchod pas mchod/ /skyob 5pa shākya seng ge yis/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang de ltar bcom/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /lha mo khyod kyis dpang mdzod cig /lha mo slar thim sa sta gon/ /de nas lha gnas bdud rtsi'i dris—/ /thig le me tog tshom bu bya/ /lha bskyed dgug gzhug bcing dgyes byel/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / /bstod dang snying po ci nus pas/ /mnyes par byas la gsol ba gdab/ /pus mo'i lha nga padma la/ /g.yas btsugs 3g.yas pas spos thogs te/ /bcom ldan gshin rje 'jigs rdo rje/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse 5phyir dang / /bcom ldan spyod la mchod pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mgon po bdag ni 'dri 9bgyid cing / /bdag nyid khyed la gus pas mchod/ /bcom ldan bka' drin gnang bar 'os/ /'khor lo 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gzhan yang sngags la gnas pa'i lha/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i 'byung po rnams/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dga' ba yi/ /rdo rje mig dang ldan pa rnams/ /de ring rdo rje 'dzin min bdag /rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor 'di/ /'gro la phan phyir bri bar byed/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod kyis//24—773

rjes su brtse phyir nye bar gsol/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa dang / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni grogs kun la/ /bsrung dang nye bar skyob pa ni/ /khyed kyis bya bar 'os lags so/ /de ltar lan gsum brjod pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor sta gon mkha' la bteg /de nas nag po nog rtsab spangasahūṃ/ /gser sogs rin chen sa yang rung / /lto yangs mgrin ring mchu 'phyang ba/ /bco brgyad rang rang mtshan mas gdab/ /rin chen lnga dang sman lnga dang / /tsu —ta'i kha rgyas gos kyis dkri/ /lha bskyed dgug gzhug mchod bstod bzla/ /zhu ba bdud rtsi'i chu yis dgang / /rnge tog phreng ba argha'i snod/ /rdo rje dang bcas ku sha'i gdan/ /lha gnas dag gam rim pas gzhagasgo /skabs der rung ba'i slob 4ma dag /khrus dang maṇḍal mchod pa dag /me tog las bzung 5gus pas ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi sgor bsdad par bya/ /dngos grub 'dod pas dad pa yis/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs te/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgrub par bya/ /'jig rten 'di dmigs mchog mi 'grub/ /de ltar spro ba bskyed nas ni/ /dad pa bskyed pa'i slob ma la/ /cho ga ji bzhin sems bskyed cing //tshig 'di dag gis lan gsum brlab/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdog pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro sogs dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung 6 / /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can ma lus bdag gis mgon 7du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong sbyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /'gro ba thams cad bdag gis bsgral/ /de nas gus pas slob dpon la/ /tshig 'dis lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /24—77/

dpa' 7bhechen khyod bdag ston pa bo/ /slob dpon spyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la gsol/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum po yang bdag la gsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po — 7bdag nyid 'jug par byabhe / /bu tshur shog cig theg chen la/ /sngags spyod pa yi mchog 'di ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /khyod ni theg chen snod yin no/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag mnyes/ /shākya seng ge sogs mchog gis/ /gsang sngags mnyam mred mthu yis ni/ /'jigs pa chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang des bcom nas/ /'jig rten rjes su gshegs nas kyang / /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gos 'di gyis shig /de don bshad nas mkha' gsang nas/ /byin rlabs dbyung ba rnam snang dmigs/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs 4mchod pa bya/ /gsang sngags mchog tu der sems bskyed/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum po la skyabs su 'chi/ /5rdo rje dril bu 6phyag rgya yang / /gsum bdag nyid du gzung thubar bgye/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung 8bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin re bzhin nam dus drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen 24—775

po'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /padma'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gnas par bgyi / /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdu ba dang / /sems can don bya'i tshul khrims gsum/ /de nas bdag gis gzung lkubar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma grol ba rnams dgrol 3snabar bgyi/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bkyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /skyon spangs rtse mo cha las byung / /bcu gnyis sor bcas me tog bcas/ /ba yi pags pa tsam gyis byug /shar bltas dor la zhi sogs brtag /ngag gi nyes pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dri chus skyor chu sbyin par bya/ /oṃ dīḥbi shudhe sarba dharmāḥpā pā ni tsa su bi sho dha ya sarba bi kaspra na cho.a pa na ya hūṃ/ las dang rtsa ba'i sngags brjod pa'i/ /ku sha sngas dang stan du sbyin/ /lus tshad gsum sgril las sngags kyis/ /mdud pa lha dang bsrung ba gdags/ /bar chad sdig pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /zhi ba'am man ngag sbyin sreg thubya/ /de nas spro ba'i chos bshad bya/ /gtor ma btang zhing mchod bstod bzla/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'jig rten du/ /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid/ /u dusthā 3ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na'am res 'ga' 'byung / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i mchog 'di ni/ /de bas kyang ni rnyed par dka' / /gang phyir sems can mnyam med don/ /bla na meed pa byed par nus / /bskal pa dpag tu med pa ru/ /gang gis mtshams med sdig byas pa//24—776

dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa thams cad zad par byed/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang 1bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis sngags spyod mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu dri rnged na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro thams cad 'dis spong ngo / /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams bsrung / /jeg ༄ mchog 'dir ni khyed rnams kun/ /legs pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba/ /las —mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams 'di ru 'gro bzhin par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas slob ma sems spro bas/ /maṇḍal me tog legs su dbul/ /'dod pas seng ge bzhin du nyal/ /las sngags bzlas shing bla mas bsrung / /nam langs khrus dang maṇḍal bya/ /rmi lam bzla zhing ngan na bzlog /de nas kha dog lnga ldan pa'i/ /thig sgud sngugasar pa nyi shu'i cha/ /nyis 'gyur zhe sdang rdo rje dang / /gti mug gshed du dmigs pas bsgril/ /'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu dang / /yid kyis rigs lnga gzhug par bya/ /oṃ dīpta dṛṣṭi e 5ku shi dzaḥmachod la gsol ba gdab par bya/ /oṃ āḥpra yatstsha mo ha shī la re swā 6tsakra sru tra shā ya 4hūṃ/slob dpon slob mas thig bzung ste/ /nub dang shar bsdad thig gdab po/ /ye shes gzhal yas gsal bar gdab/ /sngags 'dis sangs rgyas thams cad bskul/ /oṃ a byo tyā nu ga taḥsarba dharmāḥ9pa ra spa ra khaṃ⑩/ a nu ga taḥsarba dhaṭwāṃ/ a tyaddhā 11nu pra biṣṭa sarba dharmi hūṃ/ de skad brjod la dza tra brjod/ /24—777

shar du drangs la rdzogs par gdab/ /de nas dam tshig thig gdab pa/ /slob dpon rjes su slob ma 'brang / /cha gar bor la shar lhor nub/ /byang phyogs 'drim 1zhing thig bzhi gdab/ /tshangs thig gnyis gdab dkyil 'khor gdab/ /dkyil 'khor snyethig gi phyi nang du/ /bdun bdun btab pa bor la gnyis/ /nyi 'od rdo rje padma phreng / /pho brang dbang ldan mtshams nas bkod/ /de nas dur khrod rin chen sa/ /nag dkar ser dmar ljang gu lnga/ /padmar bzhag la lha sgred cing / /dgug gzhug mchod la tshon du gyur/ /phyag rgya ting 'dzin gsang sngags brjod/ /oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ khu tshur g.yon pa dbang ldan du/ /dkar ser dmar ljang nag por bri/ /sbom phra sgo yi nyi shu cha/ /sgom phra g.yas g.yon chad pa la/ /chad dang nor nyams 'thab dang 'chi/ /thod pas bkab la bsrung ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor nang gi thig gnyis la/ /pho brang nag po 'jigs byed dngos/ /bzhi snal sna tshogs rdo rje bya/ /phyed la rdo rje'i 'phreng 4ba nag /phyed dang gnyis la snam bu rigs/ /lha yi phyag mtshan bri bar bya/ /phyi rol cha gnyis sgo bzhi rigs/ /gcig ni ya phubs phyed brtsigs pa/ /de yi phyed ni nam mkha' stong / /bzhi la rta babs chos 'khor gdugs/ /cha gnyis brtsigs pa 'dod yon byed/ /dra ba cha gnyis mda' yab phyed/ /mtshams dang sgo khyud 'gram rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen zla phyed mdzes/ /bum pa do shal dril bu ras/ /'phan dang bum pa sna tshogs mdzes / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi/ /thig bzhi dag kyang yang dag ldan//shar ni dkar po chen po ste/ /lho nub nub byang 5ser dmar ljang / /dbus su rdo rje 'khor lo shar/ /lho ru rin chen padma nub/ /byang du ral gri 'khor lo 24—778

me / /bden bral rdo rje padma rlung / /dbang ldan utpal tho ba shar/ /lho sgor padma dbyug pa lhanub/ /byang sgor ral gri nyi zla la/ /lha yi mdog gi mtshan ma dgod/ /me 'od dmar po phreng ba nag /padma sna tshogs phreng bas bskor / /gdugs dang bla re ba dan 'phan/ /'dod pa lnga yi mchod pa dgram / /bum pa phyogs sam la 2yis dgod/ /gtor ma rgya chen dag kyang bsham / /de nas slob dpon rgyan spras pas/ /dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor bzhi ru bsgrub/ /bsgrubs nas phyir dbyung shar sgo nas/ /slob dpon 'jug cing dbang blangs la/ /gnang ba thob nas slob ma rnams/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug dang dbang gnang sbyin/ /khrus byas maṇḍal sems dad pas/ /khang pa'i phyi rol dag tu gzhag /mkha' gsang nas dbyung rnam snang gzugs/ /bsrung dang gsang sngags zlos su gzhugasnye /lha la phyi nang mchod dang bstod/ /slob dpon de nyid der rol bya/ /de nas lha la gsol ba ni/ /slob ma 'jug dang dbang bskur phyir/ /'dod chags chen po 'byung ba yi/ /'khor lo gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /bdag gis 4mthong nas slob ma rnams/ /gzhug phyir khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod / /nyes pa'i skyon bral yon tan ldan/ /'dod chags kun gyis rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis bsgrub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin 24—779

gshegs / /kun du bzang po kun gyi bdag /byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /kun gyi mchog gyur dngos grub che/ /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i lha/ /rdo rje dngos grub chen po mchog /phyag na rdo rjer bdag grub mdzod / /sems can kun gyi yid la khyab/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas—/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de/ /'dod chags bde ba'i dam tshig mchog /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gsol1/ /slob ma gdong g.yogs bum chus bsang / /a khaṃ bī ra hūṃ zlos gzhug /gdong g.yogs bcing zhing me tog dang / /rdo rje gtad pas sems bskyed bya/ /sarba yo ga tsitta utyā da yā tremi/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya ste ho sidhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyod gang la dga'/ /skal bzangs bdag ni bde chen la'o/ /thog ma med zhag 'khor ba nas/ /deng 'dir yan chad sdig bkyis dang / /bgyid du stsal pyadang yi rang bshags/ /gtso bo slan chad mi bgyid sdom/ /gang yang rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /'gro ba'i legs byas dge ba la/ /de dag kun la yi rang nas/ /thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /bsam pa thag pas byang chub bar/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir/ /de nas skyabs su mchi bar bkyi/ /byang chub sems gnyis bskyed nas ni/ /'gro ba deng nas mgron bos nas/ /bdag sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba kun/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar bgyi/ /deng nas khang pa'i nang du gzhug /de ring sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rigs su bu khyod zhugs pas na/ /ye shes rdo rje ngas bskyed bya/ /ye shes rdo rje mchog thob na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /khyod 2 (—780

kyis hūṃdakyil 'khor ma mthong ba/ /rnams la smras na dam tshig nyams/ /rdo rje me tog mgor bzhag ste/ /'di ni sku yi rdo rje ste/ /dam tshig sku yi dngos grub thob/ /dam tshig dngos grub 'di smras na/ /khyod kyi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs pa ste/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg 8par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs neen dngos grub thob/ /'thung zhig rdo rje'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badzra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ/ brjod pas rdo rje dri chu blud/ /yang na rdo rje spyir bzhag la/ /deng nas bzung ste khyod nyid kyis7/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed nga yin pas/ /brnyas par ma byed bsgo ba nyon/ /brnyas dang ma mnyes 5byas na ni/ /nyam nga ma spangs dus byas nas/ /rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rgyud sde mkhas dang byas pa med/ /dkyil 'khor man ngag thob par bya// //de nas maṇḍal me tog yon/ /phul la dbab pa'i gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis khu/ /rdo rje dbab par mdzad du gsol/ /brjod la rtse gcig pa yi sems/ /skyil krung tsog tsog 7por bsdad la/ /spyi bo snying ga lte ba rkang / / sgo lo 8sgyure yo kṣiṃ dag las/ /chu dang sa dang me dang rlung / /dkyil 'khor bzhi bskyed kṣiṃ gis bskul/ /bskyod par bskul dang rlangs pa zhu/ /bdud rtsi 'bab cing ye shes skye9/ /babs par bsams nas bskul bar bya/ /rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol/ /oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ 1 tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ā be sha ya sto ba 1ya ra ra ra tsa sal ya hūṃ hā kṣiṃ phaṭa/ lus ngag yid ni gang phebs la/ /gti mug gshed sogs gtso cher dbar / /ngag la a 24—781

dmar smra ru gzhug /lus la tiṣṭha badzra dang / /lam dang dbang gis brtan par bya/ /ye shes lha rnams de la dbab/ /de ltar phebs pa dam pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor bar bya/ / lho yi —1 sgo nas 'jug par bya/ /sangs rgyas gnas 'dir slob ma rnams/ /de lta yang dag nyid du gzhug /lha rnams gang gi rigs yin dang / /dngos grub gang yin 'bab par shog /pra tītstsha ho brjod pas dbul/ /me tog gar babs rigs kyi lha/ /zhi sogs las kyang de yis shes/ /gtsug tor ༄ spyan thugs mchog 'grub cing / /sgu gzhan 'khor rnams thun mong ngo / /dkyil 'khor re khā gang nye'i rigs/ /phyi rol byung ba lan gsum bskyar4/ /des kyang ma bab dbang mi bskur/ /de nas snang ba dril 5bar bya/ /lha yi rigs dang mthun pa 'grub/ /mig la oṃ bsgom ye shes spyan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbye bar bsam/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed deng khyod kyi/ /mig ni yang dag 'byed par byed/ /rdo rje mig ni bla rnged pa / /phye bas thams cad mthong bar shog /gdong g.yogs bgrol la dkyil 'khor bstan/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /mthong nas dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni 'jigs byed rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byen gyis brlabs/ /tho ba rdo rje 'jigs byed nas/ /zhe sdang 'jigs byed bar du bstan/ /slob dpon lha la phyag gsum bya/ /dkyil 'khor gzhug pa'i cho ga ste/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa byang bar bstan / /6de nas slob ma dbang thob phyir/ /rin chen bang mdzod bu smad bcas/ /rang gi lus ngag yid gsum yang / /dad gus dga' bas dbul bar bya/ /gdugs dang bla re ba dan sogs/ /mchod pa dag dang rgyan bzang ngam/ /dur khrod 271—782

rgyan gyis legs brgyan la/ /sgo sgor bsrung bar shes par bya/ /byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen stsal pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu skyob pa'i phyir/ /nam mkhar rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum de brjod gsol ba gdab/ /de ltar dbang bskur yon rnams dbul/ /de nas slob ma rnal 'byor bzhis/ /bskyed la dbang bskur lha mo dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed slob dpon nyid/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga bsgur 1bar bya/ /bkra shis sgra brjod bkra shis par/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed mkha' 'gros byed/ /gsang ba gsum nas byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje chu yis bum dbang bskur/ /oṃ badzra ka la sha a bye ṣiñtsa māṃ/ las bum khrus bya rnam rgyal dbang / /rigs kyi spro bsdu shes bya la//chu dang 'byel bas de bzhin kun/ /gser sogs thor tshugs cod pan dbang / /sangs rgyas kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /rigs lnga'i dbang bskur dag pa 'di/ /spyi gtsug rgyal bar dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna pa tra la a bhe ṣiñtsa rmā / rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rdo rje'i dbang / /sangs rgyas rdo rje 2dbang chen 'di/ /yang dag khyod la bskur bar bya/ /oṃ badzra a bye pa ti hūṃ rnyi.a bhi ṣidzi mi tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya shaṃ/ chos rnams rnam dag rnam par thar/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /dril bus 4dbang bskur chen po long / /oṃ badzra sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ghaspyo a dzhai ṣiñtsa rmā/ de nas rdo rje ldan pa'i lag /spyi bor bzhag pas ming dbang sbyin/ /dngos po gang dang gang snang ba/ /de de rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid/ /chos rnams rang bzhin nyid kyis dag /sangs rgyas ye 24—783

shes rang snang ba'i/ /oṃ badzra satwa ta nā ma a bhe ṣiñtsa māṃ/ rdo rje che ge mo brjod do/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga lha mos bskur/ /ye shes lha lnga chos nyan rig /nyan dang bsgrub pa kun la dbang / /des na rig pa'i dbang thob po / /1de nas slob dpon dbang don du / /3yon dbul gsol ba gdab par bya /dkyil 'khor phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang 1/ /slob dpon dbang bsgur bdag la stsol / /dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las dag dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dam tshig dang / /gsang ba mchog gi sdom pa rnams/ /sems can kun don bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag la gsol / /de nas lho sgor gdan dang khri/ /cho ga shes bya slob ma gzhag /bgegs bsal 5rgyan bzang dur khrod brgyan/ /slob dpon mi ldog dbang sbyin no/ /lag g.yas rdo rje bskyed nas ni/ /de nas rdo rje sbyin par bya/ /thog mtha' med pa'i rdo rje ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' che rang bzhin/ /kun du bzang po kun gye bdag /rdo rje 'jigs byed dag pa'i bdag /oṃ badzra ma hā hūṃ/ de bzhin g.yon par dril bu sbyin/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos rnged byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /dag pa'i srid pa grub par byed/ /oṃ a badzra ghaṇḍa a/ rang 'dra'i dam tshig phyag rgya ni/ /dam tshig phyag rgya de bstan pa/ /rang nyid kru gzugs ni brtan par bya7 / /'di ni rang gi 'dod pa'i lha/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar grags shing gnas/ /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pa'i/ /lag pa gnyis kyis yang dag 'khyud8/ /slob dpon dbang du bskur bar bya/ /brjod la de don de la bstan/ /de ltar mi ldog dbang bstan nas/ /de ni dkyil 'khor 24—784

de nyid bstan/ /dran pa bzhi dang spong ba bzhi/ /rkang pa dbang po shar sgo sogs / /bsam gtan bzhi ni rta babs yin/ /ting 'dzin rnams ni kha khyer bzhi/ /gzungs sgo dag ni lha mo'i tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir rgyan sna tshogs/ /gsung rab yan lag 'phan 1dril sogs/ /byang chub yan lag bdun rnams ni/ /dra ba dra phyed me long sogs/ /ye shes lnga ldan dkar sogs phyogs/ /ma 'dres ye shes lha snam bzhi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rdo rje phreng //sna tshogs rdo rje rigs lngar 'dul/ /nyes pas ma gos sna tshogs pad2/ /bdud rnams bsregs pas ye shes nyi/ /nyon mongs sel phyir zla ba'i gdan/ /snying rjes brlan phyir bum pa brgyad/ /bde chen spyod pas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dur khrod gdan gyis gshin rje 'joms/ /phyag 'tshal gdug pa 'dul ba po/ /rnam shes zhe sdang chos kyi dbyings/ /ye shes rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid/ /zhal dgu rnam thar gyis 'jug pa/ /dbus zhal gsum ni sgu gsum pa/ /g.yas gsum thabs kyi sgu gsung thugs/ /g.yon pa shes rab rnam thar gsum/ /rwa gnyis thabs cedang shes rab la/ /ma he dregs 5pa'i bdud rnams 'dul/ /spyan gsum dmar ba snying rje gsum/ /byams pa nag po dag pa rags6/ /khro bo bdud 'dul sbrul gyis klubs/ /klus brgyan gshin rje gar dgus ldan/ /byang chub phyogs chos so gnyis phyag /phyag mtshan lha min 'dul byed pa'i/ /nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis gtso/ /gcer bu chos sgu mtshan 'greng ba/ /bde ba chen po sku yi rtags/ /phyag gnyis glang po'i pags pa ni/ /thugs rje thabs kyis 'gro ba skyob/ /stong pa bcu drug zhabs bcu drug /zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags rims/ /'dul phyir lha dang mi sogs bya/ /dbu skra nang gi 24—785

ye shes 'bar/ /gzugs sogs phung po gti mug sogs/ /ye shes bzhi yis gzhan gshed bzhi/ /zhal gsum rnam thar ngo bo ste/ /mdog gis zhi sogs phyag mtshan yang / /rigs rigs las dang mthun pa dag /nye ba'i nyon mongs 'byung ba bzhi/ /byams sogs tsārtsi 1la sogs so/ /mdog 3zhal phyag mtshan sngon dang 'dra/ /bde chen longs spyod thod pa bzhi/ /tho ba la sogs sgo ba bzhi/ /skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal bzhi/ /sgrib bzhi lta bzhi 'joms tshipar byed / /bdud bzhi bsdigs 4par byed pa dang / /mdog zhal phyag drug sbyin sogs drug /de ltar lha yi de nyid do/ /de nas mtshan ldan dbang thob cing / /rigs dang mos 5pa ldan pa la/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub cing dbang bsgur ba/ /bla ma dag las 'dir blang bya/ /shes rab ye shes bzhi pa yang / /slob ma bzang la sbyin par bya/ /de nas slob dpon las kun bsten 6/ /lho sgo la sogs phyogs bzhi ru/ /rin chen padma rdo rje dang / /'khor lo'i gdan la de bzhag la/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sems can kun la thams cad du/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /rin chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /rin chen gnas su padma sogs/ /smras la rjes su gnang ba sbyin/ /de nas rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dbang / /sngon bzhin rdo rje dril bu sbyin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra satwa sa ma ye tiṣṭha e ṣa ste7/ dha ra yā mi hi hi hi ti te hūṃ/ de ring sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na gnas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bzung bar gyis8/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes su 'gro/ /rgyal bas byang chub mchog tu bzhed/ /khyod kyis kyang ni bzung 9bar kyis/ /rnal 24—786

'byor snod dang kha ṭwāṃ ga /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor sbyin/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas la/ /g.yon pas chos gos snying gar bzung snasna/ /g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya yis/ /sangs rgyas dang bcas 'di skad bsgrags//oṃ sho tai bya ka ro mi ta badzra satwa ta thā ga ta bha wa dur kha 2ti to u ta ti tya a ta ta na dha bha wa siddhā ye kye che ge mo zhes bya ba ta thā ga ta satwa sa ma ya ste bhu ra bhu wa swaḥ4 phyag rgya sngags 'di'i mthu yis ni/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi5/ /khyod ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/ /mgrin gcig tu ni lung ston 'gyur/ /de nas dbugs dbyung dam tshig sbyin/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med pas/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis 6 nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ de ni gsang ba 7brjod pa'o/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mthong dang zhugs pas dbang bskur bas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /khyod ni dge ba nyid du gnas//gang phyir bde chen theg chen 'dir/ /yang yang 'chi ba yod pa min/ /gzung dang bcing bar mi nus pas/ /'jigs med dag par 'gro don gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /khyod ni srid pa sdug bsngal bzlog /rdo rje phyag rgya bya ba 'di/ /gang zhig skyes pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'thob the tshom med//byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos kyang mi spang zhing / /smad par bya ba ma yin no/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa la/ /'di ni smra bar mi bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /nam yang gtang bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon dag kyang mi spang ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi de nyid mi spang zhing / /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bas bde 24—787

bzung nas/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de nas dbugs ni phyung nas kyang / /gtor ma dur khrod dag tu bskyal/ /de las gtor ma sbyang ba ni//mi dang bong bu rnga mo sogs/ /sha khrag nas 'bras chan khur ba/ /chang dang dri ro rnam ldan rnams/ /bcu'am bcu gcig dbul ba yang / /rdo rje dril bzung slob dpon gyis/ /de nyid gsum brjod stong par bsam yo re a a oṃ ā 1ཿhūṃ / mas yar rim pas de dag kun/ /sngo dmar dkar 'od dmar dang ldan / /dkar nag rim pas bsgom par bya/ /de nyid gsum brjod rang sa bon / /hūṃ gi 'od dang bcas pa bsgom / /yam̐ las ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i//rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu dbyibs sngo/ /ram̐ 'a/sa re ldan gru gsum dmar/ /a gcig sgyed po mgo rlon gsum/ /gcig ni bdud rtsi'i snod gyur pa/ /hūṃ dang bi mu shu ra dang / /da ha go ku na rnams kyang / /phyogs mtshams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /sa bon bltas la gsal ba dang / /oṃ dang āpya ཿhūṃ gsum brjod la/ /sa bon rnams las bdud rtsir gyur/ /phyogs phyapo la thug pas a zla ba/ /der ltung hūṃ de gyur rdo rje/ /gyur pas bdud rtsi 'bar sbyang 4bya/ /rdo rje'i lte bar zla ba hūṃ/ /oṃ gyi 'od dang bcas pa yis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi der dbab bya / /rang nyid 'khor lo'i lha rnams dang / /dkyil 'khor lha rnams bdud rtsi myang / /de nas phyogs skyong phyogs phyogs su/ /yod pa de dag gsal bar bsam—/ /shar du brgya byen dkar po ni/ /g.yas na rdo rje dril bu g.yon/ /yum bcas dur khrod rin chen brgyan77/ /glang po dkar po zhon pa cig sna /g.yas su tshangs pa ser po ste/ /'khor lo mtshan ma g.yas dang g.yon/ /g.yon na stobs rgyu ljang gu dang / /zhing skyong glang po'i mgo bo can/ /lho ru 24—788

gshin rje nag po ste/ /dbyug pa zhags pa ma he zhon/ /g.yas su nye dbang ser po ni/ /ral gri ba dan g.yas dang g.yon/ /g.yon du dung skyong ser po dang / /zhing skyong nag po ma te'i gdong / /nub tu chu lha dmar po ste/ /chu srin sbrul zhags chu srin zhon/ /g.yas su khyab 'jug smug po ste/ /'khor lo sbrul zhags g.yas dang g.yon/ /g.yon du mtha' yas sngon po dang / /zhing skyong chu srin gdong can dmar/ /byang du gnod sbyin nor sbyin ser/ /shing thog hunee le rta dkar zhon/ /g.yas na dbang phyug chen po sngo/ /rtse gsum padma g.yas dang g.yon/ /g.yon na nor rgyas dmar po dang / /zhing skyong rta yi gdong can ljang / /dbang ldan 'byung po'i bdag po dkar/ /rtse gsum zhags pa khyu mchog zhon/ /g.yas na smin drug bu ni sngo/ /mda' gzhu gnyis ni g.yas dang g.yon/ /g.yon na 'jog po dkar po dang / /zhing skyong khyu mchog dkar po can/ /me ru me lha dmar po ste/ /phreng ba spyi blugs ra yi khri//g.yas na tshogs bdag dkar po ste/ /dbyu gu padma g.yas dang g.yon/ /g.yon na rigs ldan ser po dang / /zhing skyong ra yi mgo can dmar/ /bden bral srin po dmar po ste/ /gri dang thod pa mi'i khri/ /g.yas na stobs bzangs ༄ —dmar po ste/ /g.yas na ral gri g.yon na phub/ /g.yon na padma dmar po dang / /zhing skyong srin po'i mgo can dmar/ /rlung du rlung lha sngon po ni/ /ba dan zhags pa sha ba zhon/ /g.yas na legs ldan nag po ste/ /g.yas na gri gug g.yon pa dung / /g.yon na padma chen po dkar/ /zhing skyong sha ba'i mgo bo can/ /'di dag thams cad rus pa dang / /rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /chung ma bu dang 'khor g.yog bcas/ /sna tshogs gzugs 24—789

dang mtshan ldan bsgom/ /lha la lha yi 'khor dang ldan/ /lha min mi ni phyogs skyong 'khor/ /klu la ngan 'gro gsum po'i 'khor/ /bsam zhing phyag rgya bzhis 'jug go/ /snying rjes bsgral dang mchod pas byams/ /byams pa'i sbyin par 'di bshad do/ /de kun rang rang yid dga' bas/ /snyoms 'jug tshul du bsrubs pas na/ /thams cad bdud rtsi'i gzugs su gyur/ /oṃ dhīḥ'akhor lo phyag mtshan las/ /shar du rnam par snang mdzad rigs/ /thams cad gti mug rdo rje yi/ /gshin rje gshed ltar bsgom pa ni/ /dkar po g.yas g.yon nag dang dmar/ /gri gug thod pa rtsa ba'i phyag /kun gyi phyag mtshan yin par shes/ /'khor lo ral gri g.yas na 'dzin/ /nor bu padma g.yon na'o/ /lho ru byeḥdang rin chen las/ /phra ma rdo rje 'jigs par byed/ /ser po nag 1dkar g.yas g.yon zhal/ /rin chen ral gri g.yas na 'dzin/ /padma 'khor lo g.yon pa na/ /nub tu wi dang padma las/ /'dod chags rdo rje 'jigs byed dmar/ /nag dang dkar ba g.yas dang g.yon/ /padma ral gri g.yas par 'dzin/ /rin chen 'khor lo g.yon pa na/ /byang du kṛ dang ral gri las/ /phrag dog 'jigs byed ljang gu ste/ /ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas/ /padma 'khor lo g.yon na 'dzin/ /nag dang dkar ba g.yas dang g.yon/ /tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ phaṭa dang swā hā sa bon rnams/ /ral gri 'khor lo gong bzhin rim2/ /'byung po me lha 'khor bcas rnams/ /gti mug gshed sogs mdog can no/ /hūṃ gnyis phaṭa gcig nyi zla sogs/ /gti mug gshed po lta bu'o/ /phaṭa dang swā hā lha mo dang / /sa bdag khyab byed 'og phyogs skyong / /rdo rje zhe sdang 'jigs dang mtshungs/ /dkar dang dmar po 24—790

g.yas dang g.yon/ /rdo rje ral gri g.yas gnyis na/ /padma 'khor lo g.yon par 'dzin/ /thams cad yum bcas nyi zla dang / /rdo rje 'khor lo padma'i gdan / /dur khrod sbrul gyi rgyan kyis 9brgyan/ /ye shes dgug gzhug bcing dang dgyes/ /sku gsum byin gyis brlabs dbang bskur/ /kun gyi lce ni rdo rjer bsgom/ /mi 'jigs pa yi sbyin pa'o/ /bdud rtsi myang bya chos nyid dang / /bde ba chen po rtogs par bsgom/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri/ /zhal zas sgra dang rol mo dbul/ /oṃ ind+ra ye swā hā/ dhīḥya ye swā hā/ byeḥwa ru ṇa ye swā hā / li ku bee ra ye swā hā/ kṛ yī sha na ye swā hā/ tā asna ye swā hā/ na needzo 2ti ye swā hā/ na bā ya ba — —ye swā hā/ hūṃ tsand+ra ye swā hā/ hūṃ arka ye swā hā/4 phaṭa bai ma tsi tre nee swā hā/ sarba bhu te bhyo swā swā hā/ ha ha/ hi hi/ hu hu/ te te / ho ho/ tse phe dze phaṭa swā hā/ 'di ni zang zing sbyin pa'o / /5de nas rdo rje dril bzung la/ /gti mug rdo rje ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /phra ma rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod / /rdo rje thugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rin chen rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod / /'dod chags chos las yang dag 'byung / /'dod chags rdo rje ngo bo khrod/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi gtso bo'i gtso/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod / /phrag dog rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed//rdo rje sku dang rab mtshungs pa/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig sdud 6pa/ /sangs rgyas kun thugs mchog gi gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod//24—791

a yi sgo can sngags brjod la/ /'dod pa'i las ni gsol ba dang / /smon lam rgya chen gdab byas la/ /gtor ma dur khrod sogs su bskyal/ /chos kyi sbyin par gyur pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi ru/ /khru gang khru do yar khru gang / /sor mo nyi shu bzhi sogs rgya/ /phyed phyed zabs su dbyibs rim brko/ /sor bzhi brgyad gsum phyed gnyis dag /bskor dang brtsigs pa'i rim pas shes/ /rdo rje rin chen padma gri/ /phreng ba zur bzhi dag tu dgod / /tsandan gur kum pa la sha /dri mi 37zhim pas kha dog byug /zhi sogs phyag mtshan lha yis dgod/ /me tog dkar ser dmar nag dgod/ /dgon pa'i ba lci pa la sha /u dusthā 7ra a shwazagru/ /tsandan dur khrod nim pa'i shing / /zhi sogs bud shing rim pa bzhin/ /las kun thab khung zhi dang mthun / /padma'i dbyibs can rdo rje'i phreng je/ /zla phyed rdo rje zur bzhir dgod / /lha yi mtshan ma de bzhin no/ /zhi la til sogs rgyas la zho/ /dbang la me tog dmar po bya/ /gsad pa lan tshwa ske tshe dug /mar la sogs pas rdzas rnams dbul/ /thab bsang me zhi rab tu sbar/ /bram ze rgyal po rje'u rigs dang / /gdol pa zhi sogs rim pas blang / /me lha las dang mthun par ni/ /re dang dbyu gu rtse gsum las/ /zhal gsum g.yas g.yon rigs dang mtshungs/ /dbyu gu phreng ba mchog sbyin g.yas/ /gudhe padma thod pa can / /gsus pa che ba bskyed byas la/ /shar lho'i spyan drangs 5gnyis med bya/ /mchod pa lnga dang legs par bstod/ /sreg rdzas bdun nam rtsa gcig brgya/ /phul la me lha gnas su gshegs/ /me lha gzhal yas lha bskyed la/ /ye shes dgug la sogs pa yi/ /rnal 'byor chen po rab tu bya/ /phyi nang gsang 24—792

ba'i mchod pa dbul/ /bstod pa sngags kyis rdzas kun bsreg1 /oṃ agha ye swā hā/ mar gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ 1ha na da ha na badzra ya che ge mo sarba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ til gyi sngags so/ /oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras kyi'o/ /oṃ badzra bi dza ye swā hā/ so ba'i 'o/ /oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ nas dang sran ma'i 'o/ /oṃ badzra ā yuḥṣe swā hā/ drur 1ba'i 'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā ya swā hā/ ku sha'i 'o/ /oṃ badzra asna ye swā hā/ u dusmra — ra'i 'o/ /oṃ badzra bo dhe bṛkṣa ye swā hā/ byang chub shing gi'o/ /oṃ badzra la ta ye swā hā/ /beekṣa'i 'o5/ /oṃ badzra ku be ra ya swā hā/ n+ya gro dha'i 'o/ /oṃ badzra sgo da ye swā hā/ 'o ma'i 'o/ /oṃ badzra dha hi ye swā hā/ zho'i 'o/ /brgya sogs phul la bstod la gshegs/ /gal te drag po'i las 'dod na/ /sa bdun bzung la dug lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga dang khrag lnga dang / /kha ba lnga dang tsha ba lnga/ /sbrus skul gzugs dang ming spel la/ /dur khrod nang du sur mes bsreg /dur khrod shing la me sbar la/ /drag po'i me la 7rang la basbu/ /man ngag yod pas bsregs na 'grub/ /nam 8phyed 'jigs byed spyor bas bya/ /thal ba gzugs brnyan de nyid du/ /mnan pa byas pas gdon mi za/ /khru gang gser dngul zangs lcags la/ /yu ba khru gang pa yi snod/ /sor 9drug rdo rje rin chen bcas/ /sor gnyis zabs su rdo rje ldan/ /rdo rje 1 sbu gur ro rnams dbyung / /mje chung shong ba'i bu ga'o/ /blugs gzar ring thung de yi tshad—/ /rtse sor bzhi ni pad 'dab 'dra/ /sor gnyis zab can rdo rjer ldan//de yis thams cad dgang gzar dag /phyi nas me lha lhag par mchod/ /smon lam shis pa la sogs pa'i/ /cho ga cho ga shes pas bya/ /yi ge brgya pas lha 24—793

gshegs la/ /thab dang thal ba legs par gshegs/ /slob dpon 'byor pa 'dod pa yis/ /rab tu gnas pa 'dod na yang / /dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg spyor shes pa/ /gdugs dang bla re mchod sogs dgram/ /slob dpon khrus byas dri zhim lus/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan rdor dril bzung / /sum cha'i gdan la legs bzhugs la/ /sgu gsum mchod rten glegs bam dag /ri mor gzugs ma 1nub bzhugs la/ /shar du zhal ni gzigs par shis/ /bsang nagator yon chab 'thor 'thung dbul/ /sra ba sar par gu gul bsreg /de la til dang bsang gtor gyis/ /lan gsum bskor la dor la bskyur/ / oṃ hūṃ tri tri a zhes bsku/ /de nas dri zhim drur 4bas bsku/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod pa bskul lo/ /de nas shun pa lngas bkru 5ste//oṃ swa bhā wa ba shuzlolhahaṃ/ zhes pas bkru'o/ /de nas las kyi bum pas bkru/ /ji ltar bltams 6pa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bde gshegs nyid khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ ri mo me long nang du bkru/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs mchod dang bstod/ /bkra shis tshig bdun dge bar brjod/ /snyan gsan phab la sta gon bzhugs/ /na bza' ser po rten la gsol/ /bzlas pa gtor ma ci nus bya/ / tho rang 7skya rengs byung ba dang / /sngon bzhin slob dpon rnal 'byor ldan/ /sngon gyi rim pas sku khrus gsol/ /mchod rten gzugs dang glegs bam rnams/ /sgu gsum dag gam rigs lnga'am//thugs dang sgu dang gsung gi lha/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yis 8legs bskyed la/ /rim par dbang bskur rab tu gnas/ /glegs bam 'od dpag med gyur nas/ /24—794

de yang gang yin de nyid gyur/ /sngags 'dis na bza' gsol bar bya/ /oṃ badzra bā sa se swā hā/ mchod bstod smon lam bkra shis bya/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg shin tu shis/ /da nas rdul snod dag tu ni/ /'o ma mar dang sbrang rtsi yis/ /gser gyi thur mas spyan dbye ste/ /oṃ tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ni badzra swā hā/de nas gong gi gsol bstod bya/ /'gro kun gti mug gzir mthong nas/ /zhes pas gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /de la sogs pas bstod pa bya/ /bcom ldan gshin rje 'jigs rdo rje/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /slob ma yon bdag brtse phyir dang / /bcom ldan khyed la mchod pa'i phyir/ /lha khyod snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mgon po bdag nyid rab gnas bgyirte/ /bdag nyid khyed la gus mchod pas/ /bcom ldan bka' drin gnang bar 'os/ /'khor lo 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /gsang sngags lha rnams bdag la dgongs/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs/ /gzhan yang sngags la gnas pa'i lha//'jig rten skyong ba'i 'byung po rnams/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dga' ba yi/ /rdo rje'i mig dang ldan pa rnams/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon bdag /rdo rje 'jigs byed rab gnas 'di/ /slob ma 'di yi tshogs bsags byed/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod kyis/ /rjes su brtse bas nye bar gsol/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa dang / /rab gnas byas pa'i rten 'di la/ /bsrung dang nye bar bskyab pa ni/ /khyed kyis bya bar 'os pa lags2/ /lan gsum du ni brjod par bya/ /sta gon dus su mi bsgyur bar/ /de srid srod la lan gsum brjod / /yi ge brgya pa rang snying gis/ /rab tu gnas la brtan par bya'o/ /271—795

sngon bzhin gtor ma sbyangs la dbul/ /de nas slob dpon slob ma yis /maṇḍal legs gshegs pa yis byug /bum pa la sogs lha kun gshegs/ /yang na slob dpon rten der bsre/ /de la maṇḍal mchod pa bya/ /yi dam lha dang chos skyong la/ /bsam gtan nor 'khrul rdzas ma tshogs/ /nyes pa thams cad bzod par gsol/ /dge ba ci tsam yod pa kun/ /'gro ba bsgral phyir rab tu bsngo/ /dge ba'i las 'di rnams byas pas/ /sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed bdag bsrungs te/ /'gro ba'i bdud bzhi zhi byed shog /de nas slob dpon slob ma yis/ /maṇḍal legs gshegs pa yis byug /bum pa la sogs lha kun gshegs/ /yang na slob dpon rten der bsre/ /la li badzra grags pa yi/ /nag po chen po brgyud pa'i rim / /'jigs byed dkyil 'khor cho ga yiX/ /lhag chad 'khrul pa mkhas bzod mdzod/ /yi dam lha dang rdo rje mkha' 'gros bsrungs/ /bdag gis lus ngag ngal bas 'di bris pa'i/ /dge ba dri med rgya chen thob pa des/ /'gro ba rdo rje 'jigs byed thob par shog/ //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta bee ro tsa na rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta bai ro tsa na de nyid dang / lo tsā rib glan dar ma blo gros kyis 5bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //6 24—796

༄/ /dpal gshin rje gshed po'i rtsa ba'i sngags don rdo rje rab tu 'byed pa jes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ya mānta ka badzra pra ste da nā ma mū la mdzeerba / bod skad du/ dpal gshin rje gshed po'i rtsa ba'i sngags don rdo rje rab tu 'byed pa zhes bya ba/ dpal 'jam 2mgon la phyag 'tshal lo /'jam rgyal khro bo'i gsang sngags gang / /rgyud gzhan kun du sbas byas shing / /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba/ /rgya mtsho rgya dang rdo rje ltar/ /brtag dang 'da' dka' mi phyed pa/ /ded dpon nyi ma bcud len bzhin/ /'dren sel rnam par spyong ba'o/ /dri za'i grong dang sangs rgyas bzhin/ /sgo dang byin rlabs mtha' yas pa/ /ji ltar nam mkha' lding gi rigs/ /gcig kyang skye ba'i bye brag gis/ /rigs kyi bye brag rnam pa bzhi/ /de dag nang gi dbye ba yis / /stong phrag nyi shu gcig la sogs/ /mtha' yas bshad pa ji lta bar/ /rtsa ba'i snying po la sogs pa'i/ /gsang sngags gang yin rigs gcig kyang / /24—803

yi ge bsdu dang gtor ba dang / /de bzhin rab tu gtor ba dang / /yan lag so sor phye ba yis/ /sngags don sgo bzhir shes par bya/ /sngags don de dag re re yang / /rnam grangs sgo zhes bya ba yis/ /sgo mtha' yas par gyur pa ni/ /ye shes chags pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mkhyen pa las/ /nyan thos rnams kyis mi shes na/ /'jig rten nga yis smos ci dgos/ /'di ltar sngags don mtha' yas shing / /byim/ grebs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /thub pa bdag nyid chen po yis/ /gang gi don du gang sbyar ba'i/ /gleng gzhi'i 1dbang du mdzad pa bzhin/ /gang gis de ltar sbyar byas pa/ /de la de yi dngos grub dag /ngo bo nyid kyis myur bar gsungs/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /bdud rnams 'dul bar byed pa yi/ /khro bo'i mchog ni gshin rje gshed/ /las rnams grub par byed pa la/ /'khor lo spyor ba rnams kyi mchog /sngags kyi nang na rtsa ba ste/ /khro bo nyid yin mnyes byed cing / /de yi bka' bzhin grub byed pa'o / / gsang sngags yi ge sum cu gnyis/ /bcu bdun yin te lngar yang shes/ /'di dag rab tu gtor 4tshul bshad/ /ya/ khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje thugs/ /ye shes rab tu mi g.yo ba/ /gzung 'dzin rnam shes dag pa'o/ /kṣe/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa na/ /tshogs mchog gnyis las grub pa'i sku/ /mchog tu snang bas snang mdzad de/ /lus dang gnas gzugs dag pa'o/ / ma/ sa 5chen gter gyi 'byung khungs bzhin/ /yon tan zad med gter gyur pas/ /rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ste/ /longs spyod tshor ba rnams 6dag pa'o/ /me/ lhun po bzhin du bstan 7pa yi/ /24—801

chos 1mchog mi g.yo brnyes pa yang / /chos 'od dpag med ston mdzad de/ /tha snyad 'du shes dag pa'o/ /da/ sbyin dang snyan smra la sogs pa/ /'gre don spyod pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bde gshegs mdzad don grub pa ste/ /'du byed dag pa'i bdag nyid do/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i rgyal ba kun/ /thugs sogs chos kyi bdag nyid de/ /de phyir mi bskyod rdo rje sogs/ /rgyal ba rnam pa lngar 'dod do/ /ya/ gzung dang 'dzin pa spong byed pa'i/ /ye shes zung mthar phyin pa ste/ /lta dman spong ba'i dran pa ni/ /bde gshegs kun kyang 'gugs 2par byed/ /tstsha༄ / dpyod pa rnam par bral ba yi/ /ye shes shes rab mthar byed yin/ /yang dag spong ba'i brtson 'grus ni/ /rgyal ba'ang sems can don du 'jug /ni/ nges tshig 5brjod pa mtha' yas pa/ /brjod pa bral ba pad mthar 'byin/ /rdzu 'phrul ting 'dzin mi g.yo ba/ /rgyal ba'ang sems can don du 'ching / /rā6/ rdul bral rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /ye shes bgegs mthar 'byin pa ste/ /dad sogs dbang du gyur pa ni/ /rgyal ba'ang sems can dbang du byed/ /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin ni/ /thar pa'i grong khyer sgo yin te/ /sgrib pa spong ba'i ye shes ni/ /khro bo sgo skyong zhes bshad do/ /dzā7/ 'gro 'dzin shes bya stong nyid sa/ /byams pa chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /gzigs pa rnam dag spyod yul phyir/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes brjod pa yin/ /sa/ sems can kun du sbud byed pa/ /snying rjes brlan pa chu yi khams/ /'gro ba bdag gir byed pa 8na/ /rgyal ba'i yum mchog mā ma tī/ /do / nyes pa sel byed shes rab me/ /dga' ba chen po'i bdag nyid de/ /dri ma kun nas dag pa'i phyir/ /gos dkar mo zhes 'dod pa yin/ /ru/24—805

khro dang chags pa gnyis med pa'i/ /btang snyoms ye shes chags bral 1rlung / /'gro ba gnas nas 'don pa'i thabs/ /sgrol ma zhes su rnam par bshad/ /stong nyid dang ni 2snying rje dang / /shes rab dang ni thabs rnams las/ /rgyal ba 'byung phyir spyod yul phyir/ /'gro ba skyob phyir yum du 'dod/ /rgo/sna tshogs rnam par spras pa'i gzugs/ /phyag rgya'i mchod pa bla med pa/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba mnyes byed dam pa'o/ /yo/ gang zhig rab tu gdangs snyan glu/ /sgra yi mchod pa bla med de/ /bstan pa dam pa'i dngos nyid chos/ /mchod pa rgyal ba mnyes par byed/ /ni/ dri med rnam par dag pa'i dri/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i bdag nyid de/ /bla med dri yi mchod pa 'dis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par byed/ /ra/ khu ba bcud len ro yi mchog /ting 'dzin rab tu mi g.yo ba/ /bde gshegs mdzad pa'i bdag nyid de4/ /rgyal ba mnyes byed dam pa'o/ /gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i bdag nyid ni/ /byang chub sems sogs 'dod pa'i mchog /longs spyod mchod pa'i rang bzhin 'di/ /bud med gzugs su rnam par brtags / /lus dang gnas dang longs spyod las/ /sgrib pa kun du 'byung bas na/ /'di dag tsam gyis 5zag bcas kyi/ /chos kun yongs su bsdus par 'dod/ /de dag nyid las bzlog pa'i chos/ /'bras bu dang ni don dam dang / /lam dang bstan pa dam pa yis/ /zag pa med chos bsdus pa yin/ /gtso bo yum dang mchod pa dang / /de bzhin sgo skyong bcas pa yi6 zag bcas zag rnged dbyer med pa'i/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thams cad bsdus/ /gang zhig yi ge phreng 7ba'i don/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bdag nyid du/ /27—806

bsgom dang bzlas la brtson 1byed pa/ /myur du rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i rgyud de/ ya ni rdo rje gshin rje dgra'o/ /kṣe ni rdo rje zhing ngo / /ma ni rdo rje sa'o/ /me ni rdo rje lhan po'o/ /da ni rdo rje sbyin pa'o/ /ya ni rdo rje zung ngo / / tstsha ni 2rdo rje dpyod pa'o/ /ni ni rdo rje nges tshig go/ /rā ni rdo rje rdul bral lo/ /dzā ni rdo rje 'gro 'dzin no/ /sa ni rdo rje kun sdud do/ /do ni rdo rje nyes sel lo/ /ru ni rdo rje gnas med do/ /na ni rdo rje sna tshogs gzugs so/ /yo ni rdo rje gdangs so/ /ni ni rdo rje dri rnged do/ /ra ni rdo rje ro'o/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rgyud de/ rdo rje gshin rje'i sgra ni zhing dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rdo rje'i zhing kau zhing dag pa'i gzugs so/ /rdo rje sa ni zhing dag pa'i yon tan gyi bdag nyid do/ /rdo rje lhun po ni zhing dag pa'i chos so/ /rdo rje sbyin pa ni zhing dag pa'i dpyod pa'o/ /rdo rje zung ni sgo dag pa'i dang po ste 'jug pa dang 'byung ba'i sgo'o/ /rdo rje dpyod pa ni sgo dag pa gnyis pa ste btang ba dang len pa'i sgo'o / /rdo rje nges tshig ni sgo dag pa gsum pa ste dpyod pa dang brtson pa'i sgo'o//rdo rje rdul bral ni sgo dag pa 4bzhi pa ste spyong ba dang spyor ba'i sgo'o/ /rdo rje 'gro 'dzin ni gnas dag pa 5bzhi'o/ /rdo rje kun sbud ni gnas dag pa'i bla gab bo/ /rdo rje nges tshig ni sgo dag pa'i gdan no/ /rdo rje gnas med ni gnas dag pa'i snang ba'o/ /rdo rje sna tshogs gzugs ni longs spyod dag pa 6dang po ste/ rab tu spro ba'i kha dog dang dbyibs so/ /rdo rje gdangs ni longs spyod dag pa gnyis pa ste rab tu spro ba'i dbyangs dang tshig dag go/ /rdo rje dri med ni longs spyod dag pa gsum pa ste rab tu spro ba'i dri sna tshogs so/ /rdo rje ro ni longs spyod dag 2(—807

pa bzhi pa ste/ rab tu spro ba'i ro sna tshogs so/ /de la 'di 1ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi yan lag gi rgyud de/ rdo rje gshin rje'i dgra ni lus dang snying ga'i gnas byin gyis rlob pa ste/ nag po dang rdo rje ni kha dog 2dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje'i zhing ni mtshog ma byin gyis rlob pa ste/ dkar po dang 'khor lo ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje'i sa ni lte ba'i gnas byin gyis rlob pa ste/ ser po dang rin po che ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje lhun po ni mgrin pa'i gnas byen gyis rlob pa ste/ dmar po dang padma 4ni kha dog dang mtshan pa'o5/ /rdo rje byin tshopa ni rkang pa'i gnas byin gyis rlob pa ste/ ljang gu dang ral gri ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje zung ni lag pa g.yas byin gyes rlob pa ste/dkar po dang tho ba ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje dpyod pa ni lag pa g.yon byin gyis rlob pa ste/ sngon po dang dbyug pa ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje nges tshig ni kha byin gyis zlob pa ste dmar po dang padma ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o / /rdo rje rdul ni gsal 7ba'i gnas byin gyis rlob pa ste/ ljang gu dang ral gri ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje 'gro 'dzin ni mtshog ma'i gnas su g.yas phyogs byin gyis rlob pa ste/ dkar mo dang 'khor lo ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje kun sdud ni lte ba'i gnas su g.yon phyogs byin gyis rlob pa ste / mthing ga dang rdo rje ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje nyes sel ni mgrin pa'i gnas su g.yon phyogs byin gyis zlob pa ste/ dmar mo dang padma ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje gnas med ni rkang pa'i gnas su g.yon phyogs byin gyis rlob pa ste/ ljang gu dang utpal ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje sna tshogs gzugs ni mig byin gyis zlob pa ste/ dkar mo dang me long ni kha dog 274—808

—dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje gdangs 1ni rna ba byin gyis zlob pa ste/ dmar mo dang gling bu ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje dri med ni sna byin gyis zlob pa ste/mthing ga dang spos phor ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /rdo rje ro ni lce byen gyis rlob pa ste/ ljang gu dang ro snod ni kha dog dang mtshan ma'o/ /de la 'di ni rdo je dkyil 'khor gyi 2gsang sngags kyi rgyud de/ ya rdo rje gshin rje dgra'i sa bon no / /oṃ badzra ya mā ri rdo rje gshin rje dgra'i gsang sngags so/ /kṣe rdo rje zhing gi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra kṣe tra rdo rje zhing gi gsang sngags so/ /ma rdo rje sa'i sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra ma tīdzre/ rdo rje sa'i gsang sngags so/ /me rdo rje lhun po'i sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra me ru rdo rje lhun po'i gsang sngags so/ /dā rdo rje spyin pa'i sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra dā na rdo rje sbyin pa'i gsang sngags so/ /ya rdo je zung gi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra ya ma rdo rje zung gi gsang sngags so/ /tstsha 4rdo rje dpyod pa'i sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra tsartsa na rdo rje dpyod pa'i gsang sngags so/ /ni rdo rje nges tshig gi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra me rutta 5rdo rje nges tshig gi gsang sngags so/ /rā rdo rje rdul bral gyi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra rā dza 6rdo rje rdul bral gye gsang sngags so/ /dza rdo rje 'gro 'dzin gyi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra dza ghi dha ra rde rje 'gro 'dzin gyi gsang sngags so/ /sa rdo rje kun sdud kyi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra saṃ ha ra ni/ rdo rje kun sbud kyi gsang sngags so/ /do 7rdo rje nyes 8 sel gye sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra do ra hi da rdo rje nyes sel gyi gsang sngags so/ /ru rdo rje gnas med kyi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra ru ni la rdo rje gnas med kyi gsang sngags so / /ṇa rdo rje sna tshogs gzugs kyi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra ṇa na rū 9pa/ rdo rje sna tshogs gzugs kyi gsang sngags so/ /yo rdo rje gdangs kyi sa bon no/ /24—809

—oṃ badzra yo ya ge yi rdo rje gdangs kyi gsang sngags so/ /ni rdo rje dri med kyi sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra nir ma la rdo rje dri med kyi gsang sngags so/ /ra rdo rje ro'i sa bon no/ /oṃ badzra rā sa rdo rje ro'i gsang sngags so/ /gsang sngags kyi yi ge tshig 'di dag la brten nas/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo dang / rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi yan lag rnams legs par byen gyes rlob par 'gyur ro/ /de ni yi ge rab gtor ba/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad pa yin/ /de nas yi ge gtor ba yi/ /spyor ba tshul bzhin bshad par bya/ /gsang sngags yi ge sum cu gnyis/ /basbu ba bcu bdun dag tu shes/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i las rnams la/ /gtor ba 'di ni bshad par bya/ /dang por ya zhes gang gsungs pa/ /gdug pa thams cad 'jigs par byed/ /kṣe zhes bya bas dgra rnams kun/ /zad par byed par gdon mi za/ /ma zhes bya bas de bzhin du/ /de dag myur du gsod par byed/ /me zhes bya ba'i ngo 1bo yis/ /kun nas gnon par byed par bshad/ /da zhes bya ba 'joms pa ste/ /lus dang yan lag ma rung ༄byed/ /de nas phyi rol bshad bya ste/ /ya zhes bya bas de bzhin du/ /'jig cing rnam par g.yeng bar byed/ /tstsha 4zhes bya bas pags pa nas/ /snying gi mthar yang za bar byed/ /ni zhes bya bas lhag ma nas5 / /cung zad lus par mi byed do/ /rā 6zhes bya bas gzugs rnams kun / /rdul bzhin du ni bsnyil bar byed/ /dzā 7zhes bya bas dbang po rnams/ /rmugs par byed par gdon mi za/ /sa zhes bya bas yi dwags bzhin/ /'khor nas 'khyams par byed pa yin/ /do zhes bya bas bzang po yang / /dman pa rdzo (— 8/0

dag tu byed par 'gyur/ /ru zhes bya bas khrag rnams kun/ /sbu gu'i gnas nas rmongs par 'gyur/ /na zhes bya bas thams cad du/ /rnam par 'dren par byed par bshad/ /yo zhes bya bas las dag la/ /kun nas spyor bar byed pa'o/ /ni zhes bya bas de bzhin du/ /dbang po nyams par byed pa ste/ /ra zhes bya ba dran pa'i gnas/ /bral bar byed par bshad pa'o/ /sgrub par byed pas tshul bzhin du/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor mchog bsgoms te/ /gsang sngags yi ge bcu bdun 'di/ /tshul bzhin sbyor ba gang shes pa/ /de ni ring po mi thogs par/ /gdug pa 'dul ba gdon mi za/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags yi ge ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang nor bu bzhin/ /dgos pa thams cad sgrub byed de/ /sgra dang yid la byed pa yis1/ /rjes su mthun par 'go ba yin/ /ya zhes bya bas 'gugs pa dang / /bskrad dang dbye ba sogs kyang byed / /kṣe zhes bya bas bsrung ba dang / /gtong dang 'khrug pa'i las kyang byed / /ma zhes bya bas rmongs pa dang / /bskyed dang shes pa'i las kyang byed/ /ske zhes bya bas bdag nyid la/ /gang dag 2dgos pa de sbyor byed/ /da zhes bya bas 'dzin pa dang / /sbyin dang 'dul ba'i las kyang byed/ /ya zhes bya bas de bzhin du/ /gang dag bstan pa de sbyor byed/ /tstsha zhes bya bas g.yo ba dang / /'gro 'ong spyod pa'i las kyang byed/ /ni zhes bya bas 'gog pa dang / /ma lus gdon mi za bar byed/ /rā 4zhes bya bas dga' ba dang / /chags dang grags 5la sogs pa'ang byed/ /dzā 6zhes bya bas mig 'phrul dang / /bskyed dang bsgyur ba la sogs byed/ /sa zhes bya bas bde ba dang / /rdzogs dang sbud pa'i las kyang byed/ /do zhes bya bas ring 'gro zhing / /sman la spyor 2(—8/ /

dang sel bar byed/ /ru zhes bya ba khro ba dang / /chags dang kun nas sgra sgrogs byed/ /na zhes bya ba thob byed cing / /mthong dang 'dod pa 'dren par byed/ /yo zhes bya ba gang dang gang / /rigs pa kun la spyor bar byed/ /ni zhes bya ba snga ma bzhin/ /'gog pa la sogs spyor bar byed/ /ra zhes bya ba de bzhin du/ /dga' 1dang chags la sogs pa byed/ /sgra yi rjes su zhugs pa yis / /las rnams gang dang gang byed pa/ /yi ge gtor ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /de dag mdor bsnyus bshad pa yin/ /de nas bshad par bya ba ni/ /kun nas bsdu ba zhes bya ba'i/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba'i tshul gang yin/ /mdor bsdus 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /thog mar brjod pa'i yi ge ni/ /ya ma rā zhes gang gsungs pa/ /yi dwags bdag po bod pa ste/ /las la skul bar byed pa'o/ /dzā 2sa zhes bya ba'i yi ge gnyis/ /rmugs shing 'khrul 4dang 'khor ba ste/ /rgyas btab nas ni rmongs 'gyur ba'o/ /de nyid myur du bskul ba ni/ /do me ya zhes brjod pa ste//gshin rje dgra yi gsang sngags 'dis/ /'bad nas bsgul ba byas pa ste/ /rgyas 'debs rnams kyis rgyas btab na5/ /yi dwags bzhin du 'khyams par 'gyur / /gsang sngags tshig rkang dang po 'di/ /'gro ba rgyas 'debs dam pa'o / /gnyis pa dag tu brjod pa'i sngags/ /ya ske do zhes gang gsungs pa / /ma gdon bdag po bod pa ste/ /las la skul 7bar byed par bshad/ /ru ṇa zhes bya ba'i yi ge gnyis/ /lus kyi gnas rnams thams cad kyi/ /sbu gu'i gnas rnams thams cad nas/ /khrag kun yongs su 'dren par bshad/ /24—8/2

de nyid myur du skul byed pa/ /yo da ya zhes brjod pa ste/ /gang zhig gshin rje gshed kyi sngags/ /'bad nas zlos par byed pa des/ /ma gdon bzhin du 'gro kun gyi/ /khrag rnams 'dren par gdon mi za/ /gsang sngags tshig rkang gnyis pa 'dis/ /khrag 'dren rnams kyis khrag drangs nas/ /rmongs par bya ba la sbyor ba/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bka' yis so/ /gsum pa dag du gsungs pa yi/ /ya da yo zhes gang brjod pa/ /'joms byed bdag po bod pa ste/ /las la skul bar byed pa'o/ /ni ra zhes bya'i yi ge gnyis/ /dbang po gnas rnams thams cad du/ /nus pa nyams shing 'gog pa yis/ /dran pa bral bar byed pa ste/ /de nyid myur du 1snabaskul ba ni/ /yakṣe ya zhes brjod pa ste / /gang zhig gshin rje gshed po'i sngags/ /'bad nas zlos par byed pa des—/ /'joms byed rnams kyis bcom nas ni/ /brgyal bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /gsang sngags tshig rkang gsum pa 'dis/ /shin tu rmongs par byas par 'gyur/ /bzhi pa dag tu gsungs pa'i sngags/ /yakṣe ya zhes gang gsungs pa/ /za byed bdag po bod pa ste/ /las la skul bar byed par bshad//tstsha 2ni zhes bya'i yi ge gnyis/ /pags pa mig dang snying gi mthar/ /gzhib dang myang dang bza' ba yis4/ /lhag ma cung zad ma lus byed/ /de nyid myur du bsgul 5ba ni/ /rā ma ya zhes brjod pa ste/ /gang zhig gshin rje gshed po'i sngags/ /'bad nas zlos par byed pa des/ /gdug pa za bar bya ba la/ /za byed rnams kyis 6za bar 'gyur/ /gsang sngags tshig rkang bzhi pa 'dis/ /gdug pa za ba'i mchog tu bshad/ /bstan pa dag la gnod byed pa'i/ /gdug pa tshar gcod bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas ni/ /24—813

gsang sngags tshul bzhin gang zlos pa/ /de yis gdug pa 'jig pa la/ /gsang sngags bsnyu ba bshad pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /kun nas dang ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /de la 1phan gdags bskyab pa'i phyir/ /yi ge bsdu ba tshul bzhin bshad/ /gsang sngags yi ge sum cu gnyis/ /tshul bzhin phreng 2ba bkod pa la/ /gang dang gang du ya dang ni/ /ni zhes bya ba'i yi ge dag /bsal nas lhag ma brjod byas nas/ /'gro la phan 'dogs byed par bshad / /ma rā dzā 4zhes gang smos pa/ / 'chi bdag las la thugaso bar bshad / /sa do me zhes smos pa ni/ /de la de nyid sbyin byed pa'o/ /dang por brjod pa'i gsang sngags 'dis/ /'gro la srog sbyin byed pa'o/ /gnyis par brjod pa'i gsang sngags gang / /me do ru zhes smos pa dag /bdag la nyes par brjod pa las6/ /gang dang gang ni med byed pa/ /na yo da zhes brjod pa ste/ /gsang sngags gnyis pa 'di yis ni/ /grags pa nyams pa gso bar byed/ /gsum pa dag tu gsungs pa'i sngags/ /da yo rakṣe zhes brjod pas / /gang dag ji snyed yod pa yi/ /nor rnams kun du srung byed pa'o/ /gsum par gyur pa'i gsang sngags 'dis/ /longs spyod nyams pa gso bar byed//bzhi par gyur pa'i gsang sngags gang / /kṣe tstsha 7ra ma zhes brjod pa/ /dga' ba'i spyod yul phun sum tshogs/ /yongs su srung bar byed pa ste/ /gsang sngags bzhi par gyur pa 'dis/ /dga' ba'i spyod yul thams cad la/ /spyod par rang dbang thob pa ste/ /rgyal po chom rkun me la sogs/ /'jigs pa dag las thar bar 'gyur9/ /dad ldan sems can bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gsang sngags bsdu ba bshad pa'o/ /de dag tsam gyis rtsa ba yi/ /sngags don kun 21—8/ 4

nas bsnyu ba bshad/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /yan lag so sor phye ba yi/ /sngags don cung zad bshad par bya/ /gsang sngags kun gyi thog ma ru/ /phyag 'tshal yi ge gang bzhag pa/ /a ni gdod nas skye ba med/ /u ni byang chub sems bskyed pa/ /de dag zung du 'byor pa yisna/ /o 2ni cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i sgo/ /i ni mngon par rdzogs byang chub/ /de bas yi ge oṃ zhes bya/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir/ /phyag 'tshal yi ge zhes bya ste/ /gsang sngags gang dag brjod pa yi/ /thog mar yi ge 'di bzhag na/ /rab tu bsngags zhes bshad pa yin/ /tha mar phyag 'tshal brjod pa las/ /ha ni mi phyed rdo rje ste/ /u ni byang chub sems bskyed pa/ /e ni mngon par rdzogs byang chub/ /de phyir yi ge hūṃ zhes pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rten byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang bkra shis yi ge ni/ /sa ni yang dag mnyam pa nyid/ /ba ni sgra snyan yid 'ong ba/ /a ni skye ba med pa'o/ /ha ni sdig pa sel ba 5la/ /a ni de 6bzhin skye ba med/ /de phyir swā hā zhes bya ba/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /swā zhes bya ba swa ste 7ka /hā zhes bya ba ro ru 8ha/ /bkra shis gzhi tshugs zhes 9brjod pa'o/ /de phyir sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /mjug tu tshig 'di bsngags pa yin/ /de la sogs pa'i sngags tshig la/ /yi ge yan lag gang ldan pa/ /de dag bye brag rnam 7phye ste/ /chos don lha dang las rnams dag /bye brag so sor sbyar byas pa 1/ /yan lag so sor phye ba yi/ /sngags don bshad pa zhes bya'o/ /24—8/5

de la 'di ni rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa'i cho ga'i rgyud de/thog ma nyid du rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i sa bon du gyur pa/ yi mo ram̐ dzee zhes bya ba'i yi ge bzhi/ byang dang shar dang lho dang nub rnams su rim pa bzhin du sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang dkar po'i kha dog dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge mo de las oṃ badzra baṃ spa ra ṇa zhes bya bas bskul bas/ yi ge oṃ de las ye shes kyi rdo rje byung nas 'jigs 1rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab ste/'gro ba thams cad kyi ma rig pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i nga rgyal dang bcas pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / phyi rol dang / nang gi sa thams cad la phog pas / de dag gi dri ma thams cad yongs su dag par byas te — dbyer med par gyur nas/ ye shes kyi sa rdo rje de nyid dang dbyer med par gyur te rdo rje de nyid kyang de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas yi ge dzee de las oṃ badzra dzee bee ra ṇa zhes bsgul bas/ yi ge dzee de las ye shes kyi chu byung nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab ste/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi ma rig pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / phyi rol dang nang gi chu thams cad la phog pas dri ma thams cad dag par byas te/ ye shes kyi chu dang dbyer rnged par gyur te/ ye shes kyi chu de yang de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas yi ge ram̐ de las oṃ badzra re spa ra ṇa zhes bya bas bskul bas/ram̐ de las ye shes kyi me byung nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab ste/'gro ba thams cad kyi ma rig pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i zhe sdang dang bcas pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang phyi rol dang nang gi me thams cad la phog pas dri ma 24—816

thams cad dag par byas te/ ye shes kyi me dang dbyer med par gyur nas/ye shes kyi —1me de yang de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas yi ge yi de las oṃ badzra yi spa ra ṇa zhes bskul bas/ de las ye shes kyi rlung byung nas/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab ste/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi ma rig pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i phrag dog dang bcas pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang phyi rol dang nang gi rlung thams cad la phog pas dri ma thams cad dag par byas te/ye shes kyi rlung dang dbyer med par gyur nas/ ye shes kyi rlung de yang de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas dri ma thams cad yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid bdag dang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi 2dbyer med pa'i ngo bo nyid ye shes rang rig pa tsam sgyu ma lta bu chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid du ro gcig par gyur pa ji ltar nus pa de tsam du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas snying rje chen po'i sems skyes pas/de ma thag tu byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin de nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu gyur to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhin du dbus sa'i cha dgu dang ldan pa/ gru bzhi sgo dang ldan pa'i phyi rol 'khor 4yug kun nas zlum pa/ 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba dang ldan pa dang / dbus kyi cha la yi ge ya kha dog mthing ga 'od zer gyi phreng 5bas kun nas bskor ba bsam par bya'o / /shar phyogs kyi cha la yi ge kṣe kha dog dkar po 'od zer gyi phreng bas kun nas bskor ba bsam par bya'o/ /lho phyogs kyi cha la yi ge ma kha dog ser po 'od zer gyi phreng bas kun nas bskor ba bsam par bya'o/ /nub phyogs kyi 6cha la yi ge me kha dog dmar po 'od zer gyi phreng bas kun nas bskor ba bsam par bya'o / /byang phyogs kyi cha la yi ge da kha dog ljang gu 'od zer gyi phreng bas kun 24—817

nas bskor ba bsam par bya'o/ /'od zer gyi phreng ba de dag kyang dang bo rang rang gi kha dog dang 'dra ba'i 'od las/ phyi rol nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu rab tu gsal bar 'phro ba'o/ /de nas shar lho'i cha la yi ge dzā 51snakha dog dkar po 'od zer gyi phreng ba can no/ /lho nub kyi cha la yi ge sa kha dog sngon po 'od zer gyi phreng ba can no/ /nub byang gi cha la yi ge dza kha dog dmar po 'od zer gyi phreng ba can no/ /byang shar gyi cha la yi ge ru kha dog ljang gu 'od zer gyi phreng ba can no / /de'i phyi rol kyi grwa rnams la/ shar lhor yi ge ṇa kha dog dkar po 'od zer gyi phreng ba can no/ /lho nub tu yi ge yo kha dog mthing ga 'od zer gyi phreng ba can no/ /nub byang du yi ge ni kha dog dmar po 'od zer gyi phreng ba can no/ /byang shar du yi ge rā kha dog ljang gu 'od zer gyi phreng ba can no/ /'od zer gyi phreng ba brgyad po de dag kyang / dang po rang rang 'dra ba'i 'od zer las phyi rol zla ba'i 'od zer lta bur gyur pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor yi ge ya kha dog dkar po/lho phyogs kyi sgor yi ge tsa kha dog mthing ga /nub phyogs kyi sgor yi ge ni kha dog dmar po/ byang phyogs kyi sgor yi ge rā kha dog ljang gu de dag kyang 'od zer 4phreng ba can sha stag ste/ 'od zer gyi phreng ba de dag kyang dang po rang rang gi 'od zer las phyi rol rnge'i 'od lta bur gyur pa'o/ /de ltar ji ltar nus pa zhig bsam par 5byas nas/ de nas yi ge ya la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra ya mā ri zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ ya las ya'i 'od zer byung nas/nam mkha'i khams thams cad du gang bar gyur to/ /yi ge de dag bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po'i sgu sha stag tu gyur te nam mkha'i khams yongs su gang bar bsam mo/ /de nas sku de dag thams cad 'od du gyur pa las de bzhin 21—818

gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnas kyi rang bzhin chos 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya shel lta bur dkar zhing dngas pa gru gsum pa gyen du gnas pa/ nang padma dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa zhig tu gyur par bya'o//sna tshogs rdo rje las kyang ye shes kyi rlung gi phung po chen por gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brtan 1par nus so/ /de nas yi ge kṣe la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra khye tra zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ kṣe las kṣe'i 'od zer byung nas chos 'byung ba'i phyag rgya thams cad gang bar byas te/ yi ge de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku sha stag tu gyur nas/ chos 'byung ba'i phyag rgya yongs su gang bar byas so/ /de nas sgu de dag kyang 'od du zhu bar gyur pa las bdud rtsi'i 4rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas rin po che padma 'dab ma dang ge sar dang snying por bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa gzugs kyi mtshan nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge ma la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra ma tīdhri zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bsgul bas/ ma las ma'i 'od zer byung bas padma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng thams cad yongs su gang bar byas so/ /de nas yi ge de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ba'i sku sha stag tu gyur nas padma'i snying po la 'dus par gyur pas 'og 5tu zhu bar gyur nas/ rin po che gser gyi rang bzhin du kun nas 'khrigs 6par gyur par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge me la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra me ru zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis bskul bas/ me las me'i 'od zer byung nas padma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yongs su gang bar byas so/ /de nas yi ge de dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi sgu sha stag tu gyur te padma'i snying po gser kyi rang bzhin gyi gzhi la 'dus par gyur pas 'od 27(—8/9

du gyur nas rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po lhun po rab tu brtan par gyur par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge da la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra da na zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bsgul bas/ da las da'i snasna'od zer byung nas phyogs kun du gang bar byas so/ /de nas yi ge de dag bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa'i sku sha stag tu gyur te de dag ri rab kyi rtse mor 'dus pa las/'od du gyur nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi longs spyod sna tshogs kyi gzhir /gyur pa ni 'di lta ste dpag bsam gyi shing dang / ljon pa'i shing dang / me tog gi shing dang / 'bras bu'i shing dang / spos kyi shing dag kyang kha dog dang dbyibs dang gnas pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /gser dang / dngul dang / shel dang / bee ḍūrya la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyang kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / reg bya dang gnas pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /bdud rtsi'i chu dang / btung ba'i chu dang / khrus kyi chu dag kyang kha dog dang dbyebs dang dri dang ro dang yan lag dang gnas pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /gos dang rgyan dang / bza' ba'i bye brag dag kyang de bzhin du yon tan gyis khyad par du byas pa ste/ de lta bu la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam kyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge dza la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra dzā gadzha ra zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bsgul bas/ dza las dza' 'od zer byung ste/phyogs kun du gang bar byas nas de dag kyang sangs rgyas spyan kyi sku sha stag tu gyur te slar 'dus nas 'od du gyur pa las gzhal med khang gi gzhir gyur pa ni/'di lta ste/ gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje las grub cing / phyogs kun du yang sna tshogs rdo rje ra ba dang / dra ba'ang 'khrigs par gyur pa de'i nang du/ rin 24—820

—po che sna bzhi'i rgyu las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzhi grub par bsam mo/ /de nas yi ge sa la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra saṃ ha ra ṇi zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ sa las sa'i 'od zer byung nas phyogs kun gang bar byas te/de dag kyang mā ma tī'i 3sku sha stag tu gyur nas slar 'dus te 'od du gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gi bla gab tu gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi gdung dang / phyam chen dang / phyam dgu po dang / phyam phran dang / lan kan gyi dra ba dang / rten ma dang / gzer mig la sogs pas 5spras pa'i dbus na gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa gnas pa/ phyi rol rdo rje gur gyis yongs su 'khrigs par gtams pa'o/ /de nas yi ge do la dmigs te / oṃ badzra do ra hi 4ta zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ do las do'i 'od zer byung nas/ phyogs kun du gang bar byas te/ de dag kyang na bza' dkar mo sha stag tu gyur nas/ slar 'dus te 'od du gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gi gdan du gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ padma dang / nyi ma dang /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas yi ge ru la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra ru ni la zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ ru las ru'i 'od zer byung nas phyogs kun du gang bar byas te/ de dag kyang sgrol ma'i sgu sha stag tu gyur nas slar 'dus te 'od du gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gyur pa ni 'di lta ste / phyogs mtshams rnams su rin po che snang bar gyur te shin tu 'od gsal bar gyur pa'o/ /rin po che snang ba de dag kyang gzhi rten pa med cing 'od sgrib pa dang chod pa med de/ 'dod dgur 'phrul ba snang ba sha stag go/ /de nas yi ge ya la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra 5ya ma zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul 277—82/

bas / ya las ya'i 'od zer byung nas shar phyogs su 'phros te de dag kyang gshin rje mthar byed kyi sku sha stag tu gyur nas shar phyogs kyi sgor 'dus te 'od du gyur nas shar phyogs kyi sgo phun sum tshogs par gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ sgo de yang sgo khang dang bcas pa/ sgo glegs dang / zem 1skas dang rta babs dang bcas pa/ 'gro ba 'jug pa dang thugs rje 'byung ba'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i sgor gyur pa'o/ /de nas yi ge tsa la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra tsa ra tsa na zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis bskul bas/ tsa de las tsa'i 'od zer byung nas/lho phyogs su 'phros te de dag kyang khro bo shes rab mthar byed kyi sku sha stag tu gyur nas lho phyogs kyi sgor 'dus pa las/ 'od du gyur nas lho phyogs kyi sgo de yang phun sum tshogs par gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ gtong ba dang len pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i nasgo'o/ /de nas yi ge ni la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra ni ru ka ti zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ ni las ni'i 'od zer byung nas nub phyogs su 'phros te de dag kyang padma mthar byed kyi sku sha stag tu gyur nas nub phyogs kyi sgor 'dus pa las 'od du gyur nas nub phyogs kyi sgo de yang phun sum tshogs pa'i sgor gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ dam pa'i chos sna tshogs bstan pa la spyod cing rtsen pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo'o/ /de nas yi ge ra la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra rā dza zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ rā las rā'i 'od zer byung nas byang phyogs su 'phros te/ de yang bgegs mthar byed kyi sgu sha stag tu gyur nas byang phyogs kyi sgor 'dus pa las 'od du gyur nas byang phyogs kyi sgo de yang phun sum tshogs pa'i sgor gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang / sems can yongs su sgrol ba la sbyor ba'i 27—822

mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i sgo'o/ /de nas yi ge ṇa la dmigs te/oṃ badzra ṇa na rū 1pa zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ ṇa las ṇa'i 'od zer byung nas phyogs thams cad du 'phros te de dag kyang gzugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i — lha mo'i sku sha stag tu gyur te beer gzhal yas khang gi 'khor yug tu 'dus nas gzugs kyi mchod pa thams cad byen gyis rlob par mdzad par gyur to/ /de nas yi ge yo la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra yo ya ge yo zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ yo las yo'i 'od zer byung nas phyogs thams cad du 'phros te de dag kyang sgra'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i lha mo'i sgu sha stag tu gyur nas/ slar gzhal yas khang gi 'khor 4yug tu 'dus te/ sgra'i mchod pa thams cad byin gyes rlob par mdzad par gyur to/ /de nas yi ge ni la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra rgo ra ma la zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ ni las ni'i 'od zer byung nas phyogs thams cad du 'phros te de dag kyang dri'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i lha mo'i sku sha stag tu gyur nas/ slar gzhal yas khang gi 'khor yug tu 'dus te dri sna tshogs kyi mchod pa byin gyis rlob par mdzad par gyur to/ /de nas yi ge rā 5la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra rā 6sa zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ ra las ra'i 'od zer byung nas phyogs thams cad du 'phros te de dag kyang ro'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i lha mo'i sku sha stag tu gyur te/ slar gzhal yas khang gi 'khor yug tu 'dus nas ro sna tshogs kyi mchod pa byin gyis rlob par 7gyur to/ /de nas neerdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 9'khor lo'i bsgom pa bshad pa yin/7de nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /yan lag bsgom pa bshad par bya/ /24—823

dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus gnas par/ /sa bon bcu bdun gyis gang ba'i/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gnas pa las/ /cung zad tsam zhig bltas nas ni/ /de las 'od zer spro 1bya ste/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun du/ /rgyal ba kun dang de yi sras/ /rigs 2sngags rgyal po rgyal mor bcas/ /yi ge'i 'od kyis spyan drangs nas/ /snga ma'i gnas su thim par gyur/ /de yi 4nyi ma sa bon bcas/ /nyi ma'i nor bu 'bar 'dra ba'i/ /ye shes 'od kyi gong bur gyur5 / /chos sku dag pa'i rang bzhin du/ /gnyis med ye shes brtan pa las/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskul ba dang / /snying rje chen po'i mthus bslangs kyenas//gshin rje gshed ni bzhengs par 7bya/ /sgu ni ri sngon 'dra ba 'am/ /yang na char sprin 'dra ba'i mdog /sngo rang dag gam stag zil bzhin3/ /yang na las kyi bye brag gis/ /dkar dang dmar dang ser yang rung / /zhal drug phyag drug zhabs kyang drug /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis bzhugs pa la/ /stag lpags rlon pa na bzar gsol/ /smin ma srun dang skra yang ser/ /sen mo sru dang pags pa dang / /lus kyang rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ /'bar zhing mtshan ma'ang rab 'bar ba/ /be con ral gri dgra sta rnams/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams pa ste/ /bhaddhā 9sdigs mdzub zhags pa ni/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na 7bsnams pa la/ /dpa' bo g.yas brkyang stabs kyis ni/ /ma te ro dang bcas pa brdzis/ /mi bzad 'bar ba'i skur gyur pa'o/ /yang na zhal gcig phyag gnyis te/ /g.yas pas mtshon cha be con gdengs/ /g.yon pas 1 sdigs mdzub thugs kar 'dzin/ /gang dag phyag bzhi 'dod pa na/ /g.yas na be con ral gri ste/ /g.yon na bhandha sazhags pa bsnams / /'di la sogs pa'i 24—824

phyag mtshan ni/ /bcu gnyis dag gam bco brgyad dam/ /yang na brgya dang stong dag dang / /'bum dang bye ba rdul snyed du/ /ji ltar 'dod par bsgom par bya/ /ji ltar 'dod pa de nyid kyis/ /dngos grub thob par gdon mi za/ /de nas snying ga'i gnas dag la/ /sa bon bcu bdun gyis gang ba'i/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin/ /'dir yang gnas par blta 7bar bya/ /de nas sa bon yi yig la/ /sngon bzhin gsang sngags kyis bskul bas/ /gshin rje'i dgra ru gyur nas ni/ /beer 'dus thugs kyi rdo rjer gyur/ /sngon po rdo rje mtshon cha can/ /snying ga'i gnas phyogs nyid du ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gdan la bzhugs/ /de nas sa bon gyis gang ba'i/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyang / /thugs kyi rdo rje zhethugs kar gnas/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o / /oṃ badzra ya mā ri/ de nas kṣe — yi sa bon de/ /snga ma bzhin du sngags kyis bskul/ /rdo rje'i zhing du gyur nas ni/ /dkar po 'khor lo'i mtshon cha can/ /mtshog 4mar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sku yi rdo rje bzhugs par gyur/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra kṣe tra/ de nas sa bon ma las ni/ /rang gi gsang sngags kyis bsgul bas/ /rdo rje sa zhes bya bar gyur—/ /gser 'dra rin chen mtshan ma can/ /lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la / /mnyam pa'i rdo rje nyid du gyur/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra ma tīdhri/ de nas me zhes bya ba la/ /gsang ba'i sngags kyis bsgul ba yis /rdo rje lhun po zhes byar bshad/ /padma rā ga 'dra ba la/ /me tog padma'i mtshan ma can/ /mgul par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gsung gi rdo rje nyid du gyur/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra me ru/ de nas sa bon da zhes pa/ /24—825

de bzhin gsang ba'i sngags kyis bskul/ /rdo rje sbyin pa zhes byar gyur/ /rin chen margata 1'dra ba la/ /ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon cha can/ /rkang pa g.yas su nyi ma la/ /las kyi rdo rje nyid du gyur/ /de la rīsngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra da na/ de nas dza la bltas nas ni/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskul ba yis / /rdo rje 'gro 'dzin zhes byar gyur/ /dkar mo 'khor lo'i mtshon cha can / /rdo rje zhing gi g.yon phyogs su/ /zla ba'i gdan la gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje zhing la gzigs par mdzad/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra dzā gadhe ra/ de nas sa la bltas byas te/ /de bzhin sngags kyis bskul ba yis//rdo rje kun sdud ces byar gyur/ /bai ḍūr rdo rje mtshan ma can/ /rdo rje sa yi g.yon phyogs su/ /zla ba'i gdan la gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje sa la gzigs par mdzad/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra saṃ ha ra ṇi/ yi ge do la dmigs byas te/ /de nyid gsang sngags kyis bsgul bas/ /rdo rje nyes sel zhes byar gyur/ /dmar mo lag na padma can/ /rdo rje ldun po'i g.yon phyogs su/ /zla ba'i gdan la gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje lhun po la gzigs mdzad//de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra do ra hi ta/ yi ge ru la dmigs byas te / /de bzhin sngags kyis bsgul ba yis/ /rdo rje gnas med ces bya ba/ /margad utpal shes rab mtshan/ /rdo rje sbyin pa'i g.yon phyogs su/ /zla ba'i gdan la gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje sbyin pa la gzigs mdzad/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra ru ni la/ de nas na la dmigs byas te/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskul ba yis/ /rdo rje sna tshogs gzugs su gyur/ /dkar mo lag na me long can/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gdan la ni/ /mig gi gnas su 24—826

bsam par bya/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /badzra ṇa na byu pa/ yi ge yo la dmigs byas te/ /sngon bzhin gsang ba'i sngags kyis bskul/ /lha mo rdo rje gdangs su gyur/ /dmar mo lag na pi wang 'dzin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sanas par/ /mkhas pas rna ba'i gnas la bsam/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o / /oṃ badzra yo ya ge yo3/ yi ge ni la dmigs nas ni/ /de bzhin sngags kyis bskul ba yis/ /rdo rje dri med ces byar gyur/ /sngon mo lag na phreng ba 'dzin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par/ /sna yi gnas la bsam par bya/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra ni ra ma la tsa/ de nas ra la dmigs nas ni/ /rang gi sngags kyis bsgul ba yis/ /rdo rje ro zhes bya bar gyur/ /ljang gu ro ldan zas snod can/ /mkhas pas lce yi gnas la bsam/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra rā sa/ de nas yi ge ya la dmigs/ /sngags kyis bskul bas de bzhin du/ /rdo rje zung du gyur nas ni//dkar po rdo rje tho ba can/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /dpung pa g.yas pa'i gnas la dgod/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra ya ma/de bzhin tsa la dmigs nas ni/ /rang gi sngags kyis bskul ba yis/ /rdo rje dpyod pa zhes bya ba/ /sngon po lag na dbyug pa can/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /dpung pa g.yon pa'i gnas la dgod/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o / /oṃ badzra tsa ra tsa na/ 5yi ge ni la dmigs byas te/ /de bzhin sngags kyis bskul ba yis/ /rdo rje nges tshig ces bya ba/ /dmar mo lag na padma can/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /mkhas pas rkan la bsam par bya / /de la gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra ni ru ka ti/ yi ge ra la 24—827
