0923༄ / gshin rje'i dgra grub pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya mā ri sidhe 2tsakra sā dha na / bod skad du / gshin rje'i dgra grub 4pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan gshin rje'i dgra mgon la/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ /gshin rje'i dgra ni bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni bshad 5par bya/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa der gsungs pa'i dam tshig yongs su bsrung 6zhing sems dag pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dri la sogs pas byugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la me tog gi sil ma dgram par bya'o/ /der bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i 7dgra'i bris sgu bzhag la / de nas rang gi sngags kyis argha'i sgod la mngon par bsngags te gzhag par bya'o/ /rang gi snying gar a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du sa'i pha rol gyi sna tshogs mdzes pa'i gdan us byas la/ zla ba dang thig les brgyan pa 21—99 /

las 'od zer sngon po 'bar ba las bdud kyi gnas bsregs te bgegs med par dmigs la/ rang gi sa bon gyi 1'od zer sna tshogs spros te/ de rnams sdogs pa las rje btsun bla ma dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis til gyi gong bu bzhin du nam mkha' khyab par mthong nas/ yang dag par mchod par bya ste/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūṃ/ oṃ badzra dhū 2pe hūṃ/ oṃ badzra dī pe hūṃ/ oṃ badzra gadhe hūṃ/ oṃ badzra nee bi bye hūṃ/ de nas/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung //sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun mchog /byang chub bar du 4skyabs su mchi/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi5/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can ma lus bdag gis mgron 6du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod pa bdag gis spyad par bya/ /'go la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /de ltar sngon du smon lam lan gsum brjod de/ de'i rjes la sngags 'dis chos thams cad bdag rnged par bsgom ste/oṃ shu n+ya tā 7dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba na.ātma kozhu9haṃ/ zhes bya ba 'di lan gsum brjod de/ khams gsum ma lus pa sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du bsgoms te/ 'gro ba thams cad mi dmigs par bya'o/ /de nas thog ma med pa'i dus kyi kun du rtog pa'i sa bon ma rig pas byas pa'i ngo bo nyid dag cing / lhag par mos par byed pa ni lan gsum bzlas te/ oṃ swa bhā ba shuddhāḥsattha dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyolhahaṃ / de nas sngar gsungs pa'i sa bon las byung ba'i rdo rje tho ba de'i lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūṃ bsams te/ de las gshin rje 27—995

gshed kyi rang bzhin du 'od spro bar bya ste/ de'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer gyis gshin rje gshed kyi rang bzhin du gsal bar bltas la/ de nas de thams cad 'dus pa las/ de nyid kyi mtshan ma la gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas thams cad rdzogs pa'i mthar gshin rje'i dgra mdog sngon po khros pas sna'ajigs par byed pa/zhe sdang dang bcas pa gad rgyangs rnam par sgrogs 2pa/ mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal / gsus pa 'phyang ba/ mi mgo skam pos rnam par brgyan pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can mgo bo'i 1 phreng bas dbu skra'i ral pa bcings pa/ 'jam dpal gyis kun du brgyan pa/ klu'i dbang po sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ seng ge'i pags pas se ral du brgyan pa/ zhal drug po'i ljags bsgyur ba/ sna tshogs pa'i zhal dang ldan pa/ steng gi zhal 'jigs par byed pa/ tshangs pa dang dbang po dang drag pos phyag byas pa/ phyag drug pa g.yas gsum na rdo rje tho ba dang / ral gri dang / rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gyi gsum na sdigs mdzub byed cing / zhags pa dang / gtun shing dang 4/ rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /sna tshogs kyi mdog can 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 'od kyis khro bo rnams kyi phyag na mtshan ma lnga bsnams pa rnam par bsgoms te/ ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ zhabs drug pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis g.yon brkyang ba/ rdo rje'i rkang pa gnyis kyis gar byed pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rkang pa gnyis kyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung legs par brten pa/ de'i 'og tu gshin rje'i rgyal po chung ma dang bcas pa kha sbub tu 'gyel ba dang / lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i bgegs rnams 'joms par byed par bsam mo/ /bdud rnams 'jigs shing 24—996

sngangs pa dang / /kha sbub tu 'gyel te gnas pa'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bar bya ste/ mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du byas la bskul zhing sngags 'dis dgug ste/ oṃ badzra e ku sha dzaḥ de nas mdzub mo gnyis zhags pa'i tshul kyis gzhug par bya zhing / oṃ badzra pā sha hūṃ/ lcags sgrog gi gzugs kyis rked pa'am dpyi mgo gnyis bcing bar bya zhing / oṃ badzra sgo ṭa baṃ/de nyid rdo rje tho lkubs bcings te/ dbang du bsdu bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra ā be sha hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug par bsam par bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog de mthong ste/ hūṃ las bgegs rnams gzhom par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya 'dis argha'i snod sbyin par bya ste/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar la argha'i snod ltar bya ste/ oṃ dīḥbye2ཿwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo dang mthe bos me tog blangs la khu tshur bcangs te/ rim gyis gung mo la sogs pa brkyang ste/ oṃ pra ba ra saṭwā ra pra tītstsha swā hā/ de nas phyag rgya 'dis basbus te/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ mdzub mo dang mthe bong se gol brdab cing / oṃ badzra sa mā dza —dzaḥ / zhes lan gsum brjod do5/ /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal ji skad gsungs par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum gnas gsum du dgod par bya'o//de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang rang gi sngags dang lhan cig tu snying ga dang /mdzod sru dang mgrin pa dang / mgo rnams su gzhag par bya ste/ de la phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar te/ mthe bong gnyis brkyang gung mo'i rgyab tshigs kyi gsum par sbyar ro/ /de nas rang gi lce la hūṃ gis rdo rje gnod mdzes bsgom par bya'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don du de nas 24—997

dbang bskur ba blang bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa las gung mo gnyis bsgreng ste myu gu ltar byas pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya ste/ spyi bor bzhag la oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ a bhe ṣiñtsa māṃ/ 'dis thams cad du/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa mdog gnag pa sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas gnas par bsam mo/ /de nas/ mje bong gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du mdzub mo dang gung mo so sor sbyar te / mdzub mo'i tshigs 1gnyis pa bcag /gung mo yang yud tsam bcag ste/lhag ma sor mo mnyam par sbyar ba ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi ste/ dpral bar bzhag nas rnam par snang mdzad mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa las gung mo rin po che'i gzugs ltar byas pa ni rdo rje rin chen mas te/ rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag pas rin chen mchog ser po mchog sbyin can no/ /de nyid las sor mo rnams padma'i myu gu ltar byas la gung mo rtse sprad de yud tsam thur du bcag ste 'dab ma ltar byas pa ni chos kyi rdo rje ma ste/ ltag par bzhag pas snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mje bong gnyis mnyam par sbyar la gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gzhag pa ni las kyi rdo rje ma'o/ /rna ba g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag pas don yod grub pa mdog ljang gu mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas go cha'i dar dpyangs bcings te/ mtha' ma la sogs pas bsrungs te kun nas mchod par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni bcom ldan 'das la sngags kyis mchod pa ste/ thams cad kyang padma dang zla ba'i gdan can ma'o/ /oṃ lha gye hūṃ me'i mtshams su rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo/ sems dpa'i skyil krung ma thams cad padma dang zla ba'i gdan can ma/2(—998

———rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dkur brten te gar byed pa'i 'akying bag dang bcas pa/g.yon du zhal yid tsam 'dud pa'o/ /de bzhin du oṃ badzra mā le hūṃ/ bden bral du rdo rje phreng ba ma sku mdog ser mo bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ badzra gī ti hūṃ/'dis rlung gi phyogs su mdog dmar mo g.yon rdo rje khu tshur sdigs mdzub bsgreng 1ba / g.yas rdo rje khu tshur sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba'o/ /g.yas g.yon glu len nga/'i gar byed cing sgeg 3pa'o/ /lus yid tsam gar byed pa glu len cing pi wang rdung bar byed pa'o/ /oṃ badzra 1 ti hūṃ/ 'dis dbang ldan gyi phyogs su sku mdog ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis phyogs kun du bsgyur ba sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa de nyid mgo bor gnas pa/ gar spyor ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa ni gar mkhan ma'o / /oṃ badzra puṣpe hūṃ/ mdun du sku mdog yid tsam dkar ba de bzhin du sngon du gar byed pa/ rdo rje thal mo mgo bor rnam par 'dzin pa las snying gar me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin par byed pa ni me tog ma'o/ /oṃ badzra dhūbye 4hūṃ/g.yas phyogs su yid tsam 'dud pa5/ sku mdog ser ba lag pa gnyis kyi mje bong gnyis brkyang ba ste thur du bskor zhing spos dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra dī pe hūṃ / rgyab tu yid tsam 'dud pa sku mdog dmar ba/ de bzhin du rdo rje khu tshur bcings la lag pa gnyis gyen du bsgreng ste bskor zhing mar me 'bul bar bya'o / /oṃ badzra gadhe hūṃ/ g.yon du yid tsam 'dud pa kha dog ljang ba de bzhin du sngon du gar byed cing yongs su bskor ba gnyis kyis byug par byed pa dri chab ma'o/ /'di dag rang rang gi phyag rgya bcings nga/ las byung ba/ sgeg mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rol pa dang bcas par lag pa bskyod pa rnams so/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pa'i chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i ngo bor 6rtogs pa/2(dod999

so sor brjod kyis 1mi lang ba'i rang bzhin sprul te/ mchod pa sna tshogs pa'i sprin gyi tshogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed par bsam mo/ /ji ltar bstod pa la sogs pa thams cad man ngag la bya'o/ /dus bzhi'i rim pas rtsa ba'i sngags ji srid bzlas pa de srid mtshan ma bzang po rnams nges par mthong zhing nyi ma bdun na rmi lam bzang po mthong ba ni de'i dus la sangs rgyas rmi lam du mthong ba dang / mchod rten dang / sku gzugs dang /gang yang dge 'dun mthong ba dang / dge slong ma dang / de bzhin du yang lha'am 2lha khang ngam/ dge slong gcig gam/ de bzhin du chu klung ngam/mtsho la rkyal /ba dang / ri la 'dzeg pa dang / bde bar gshegs pa rnams dang / brtul zhugs can dang / sngags pa bye brag can la dbang bskur bar byed pa rmi lam na mthong ba dang / dge slong ma dang / de bzhin du ljon shing gis spras pa'i gnas rnams mthong ba dang / dam pa rnyed pa dang / reg pa dang / de bzhin du gzhan yang dge ba'i dngos po rnams kyi mtshan ma mthong na / de nas las rnams brtsam par bya ste/ de la las thams cad byed pa ni/'khor lo'i mtshan nyid re'u mig bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa shin tu 'bar ba gsal bar bya ste/ de la ā li kā li'i sbyor ba la u med pa rnams cho ga bzhin du bris pa las dbang ldan la sogs pa'i phyi rol gyi mtshams la ṛ ltal sogs pa'i yi ge bzhi dgod par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i sngags goms pa'i dbang gis spel lo/ /u'i re'u mig gi steng du ji lta bar mgo bos pha rol mdzes pa'i sna la brgyan 6pa dang 'og gis spras pa/ dbyangs yig bzhi po sum skor byas la dbus kyi re'u mig la yi ge ji skad 7gsungs pa'i rim pas bsgrub bya'i ming dang spel te bri'o/ /las 24—1000

thams cad byed pa'i 'khor lo des bsrung ba'i don la skyes pa rnams la gur gum dang / bud med rnams la gi wang gis shegro ga'am/ um bha'i 2shun pa'am/gla gor zho sha'i shun pa'am/ ras la bsrung ba'i bskul tshig dang ldan par bri ba ni kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ zhi ba'i las nang bar gyi mtshams la bya/rje btsun sku mdog dkar por bsgoms te 5bri/ mchod pa chen po byas te ji lta ba bzhin du dbang bskur ba la sogs pa sngar sbyin pa byas na/ srung dzib chen po byas pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bud med dam skyes pa la sogs pa zhi bar bya bar 'dod pas/ 'khor lo 'di shing shir sha'i shun pa la bri bar bya'o7/ /tsandan dang / gur gum gyis bris shing yang dag par de nyid kyis bya'o/ /sngar gsungs pa'i zhal la sogs pa las thams cad byed pa'i thab tu dgod par bya'o/ / bum pa 8de'i steng du bla re dgram par bya'o/ /bum pa bzhi po rnams la rin po che sna lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang sman lnga khenang du gzhug /dri zhim po'i chus dgong 7 /ras kyis bum pa'i mgrin pa dkri bar bya/ me tog dang 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i shing gis kha rgyan bya/ phur bu sna tshogs kyis thab 1kyi phyi rol gyi mtshams bzhir bgegs bskrad par bya/ bum pa bzhi gzhag par bya/ thams cad du thang ka la sogs pa gzhag cing dgram par bya/ dri dang chu dang me tog dkar po bsres la / skyor chu stong mugi sngags kyi ༷ chu'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /chu des thams cad du yang dang yang du gtor/ nyi ma bdun du thams cad du yang gtor ma sbyin/de nas 'khor lo de dbyung bar byas nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te gnas mthon por bzhag ste nyi ma re re zhing mchod pa byas na de nas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dmag gi dpung la sogs pa 1 rengs par bya ba la sngar gsungs pa'i shing shun la 24—1001

———————dodasdong ros dang / yung ba'i khu bas bakhrus te bri1/ de yang bsgu/ bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / chu bo'i ngogs gnyis kyi sa dang / ri'i sa dang lam rgya gram gyi sa dang / sngar gsungs pa'i ldong ros dang / yung ba'i khu ba bdod la gzugs brnyan byas nas de'i snying gar bcug ste/ kham phor kha sbyar gyi nang du bcug la bsgrub par bya ba 'ong ba'i lam gyi sa 'og tu bcug ste/ seng ldeng gi phur pa sor brgyad pas lus la sogs pa man ngag ji lta bas phur bu gdab par byas nas gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i mdog la sogs pa 'di dag rdzogs pa dang / lnga stong bzlas pa byas na gdug pa can thams cad rengs par 'gyur ro/ /gang du rims 4dang dug la sogs pa med par byed pa der sran nee la lan bdun bsngags te 'dis 'khor lo bri bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du bsgrub bya gzhag cing ji ltar gsungs pa'i cho ga byas na de nas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra bo bcing ba la kham phor ma bsregs pa kha sbyar la/ 'khor lo 'di 5myos byed kyi khu ba dang dur khrod kyi sol ba dang btsag rnams bsres la bri/ ro bsregs pa'i thal ba dang sas g.yogs par bya/ de'i ming dang spel te stong bzlas na 'dis kha bcing ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsad pa'i spyor ba la 'khor lo 'di dur khrod kyi ras la dug dang / tshwa 7dang ske tshe dang / mdzub mo'i khrag bsres la bri/ ro bsregs pa'i sa dang / thal ba dang / dgra bo'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang / mi rus kyi phye ma rnams stibasres la gzugs brnyan byas te de'i snying gar gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod kyi me la bsro zhing khros pa'i sems kyis stong phrag bcu bzlas pa byas nas/ de'i khyem mam dur khrod du sbas na/ de nas de rdzo4——/002

dodasdeskad cig gis 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra nang dbye na ma he dang rta'i pags pa'am / yang na dur khrod kyi ras sam/ ro'i ras la ma he'am rta'i khrag gam/bye la dang khye'am khyim bya'i khrag gam/ nim pa'i 'dab ma'i khu ba dang / ske tshe dang bsres pas 'khor lo 'di bri/ rnam par 'gras par byed pa'i tshig dang ldan par bskul ba bris nas/ rta'i sbal gyi khar bcug la ma te'i rmig pa'i nang du gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa khri byas shing nim pa'i shing brkos te de'i nang du sba bar byas na/ de gnyis 'gras nas dpag tshad brgyas chod 1kyang 'thab par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rims kyis jebs par 'dod na dur khrod kyi ras la 'khor lo 'di tsi tra ka dang / dug dang / arka'i lo ma dang / ske tshe dang khrag rnams kyis rdzogs par bris nas seng sdeng gi me la bsro zhing khros pa'i sems kyis brgya phrag lnga bzlas pa byas na/ rims kyis 'dzin par 'gyur ba ni bsgrub bya'i khyem mam/ lam gyi bzhi mdo'am/ dur khrod du sbas na'o/ /thams cad las grol bar 'dod na 'o mas bkrus na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyas pa la gro ga la bzhi mnyam gyis 'khor lo 'di bri/ tha ma gnyis su oṃ bri/dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming / sgul bar byed pa'i tshig dang ldan par gzung 4bar bya zhing / thang ka'i mdun du nyin re bzhin du kha nub tu bltas la zla ba drug tu gnod sbyin dang / gnod sbyin mos rin po che'i char 'bebs par byed par bsam zhing bdag po'i gzugs kyi 5rnam par bsams te/ bzlas pa khri dang sbyin sreg khri byas na 'grub cing 6de nas nor gyi bdag po chen por 'gyur ro//dbang du bya ba la ni 'khor lo gro ga la sogs pa'i shog shog la rang byung gi me tog dang gi wang gis bri/ yang na srin lag gi khrag dang / bil ba'i lo ma'i 24—/003

khu ba dang / ras dmar po'i khu ba dang / de'i rtsi rnams bsres la bris1 /spra tshil gyis yang dag par dkri zhing byugs nas mar dang sbrang rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa'i nang du bzhag la/ 'dzab khri bya ba ni ho mthar sbyar zhing nyi ma re re zhing ji ltar gsungs pa'i rim pas mchod pa byas na mod la dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gro ga la gur gum gyis skar ma rgyal gyi zla ba la sogs pa gzas zin pa'i dus su bris nas skud pa dmar pos dkris shing 2mchod pa chen po byas te/ gtor ma yang sbyin zhing 'dzab stong phrag bcus sgrub pa byas la ji ltar gsungs pa'i gzugs kyis mi'i thod pa'i nang du gzhug par byas na/ de nas gang dang gang 'dod pa de rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /ral gri la sogs pa rengs par 1bya ba la/'di nyid kyis ci yang rung ba'i mtshon rengs par byas nas/ tshig bskul ba dang ldan par bris na des rengs par byed do/ /drag po la sogs pa yo byad tshogs pa dang ldan pas gang 'dod pa de med par byed do/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i rim pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ma mo'i khyim dang / dur khrod dang shing gabyug gi drung ngam/ gnas stong pa'am/ chu 'gram mthon po dang ri'am/gnas dben pa'am/ mchod rten dang / sngon du grub pa'i gnas dag gam/yid dang mthun pa'i gnas sam/ lha khang dang rang gi khyem du sngags pas 'dzab bye ba bzlas pa byas na/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i rim pas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba bla ma la dad pa de kho na nyid rigs thupa bla na med pa des ci yang 'grub po/ /ri lu 'dod pa'i dngos grub dang / rā sa'i dngos grub dang /rengs pa'i dngos grub dang / rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub dang / ral gri dang /zhe sa 'og gi 6dang / 7bum pa bzang po dang / de bzhin du rig pa 24 —1004

'dzin pa'i dngos grub dang / klu mo dang / gnod sbyin mo dang /1 lha ma yin gyi bu mo dang / mi'am ci'i bu mo dang / de bzhin du mi'i bu mo dang /mkha' la spyod pa dang gang 'dod pa de grub par byed do/ /rang gi sde yongs su srung 2bar byed do/ /gzhan gyi sde 'joms par byed do/ /srin mo la sogs pa gred par byed do/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'joms par byed do/ /rims nyi ma bzhi pa la sogs pa drad par byed do/ /dug dang pra dbab pa la sogs pa la yang bzlas pa byas pas 'grub po/ /stag la sogs pa 'jigs par byed do/ /chu'i 4'jigs pa sked par byed do/ /sngags 'dzin pas 'dod pa'i snying po de rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyis snang ba las/ rang gi snying gar 'khor lo dgod par bya'o/ /ngo mtshar du ma rnams byed do/ /rje btsun gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas kun du gnas par bya'o/ /sngags pas rtag tu bzlas pa byas na des thams cad 'grub po/ /gtor ma thams cad sngags 'dis sbyin par bya'o/ /oṃ sthāḥbye5ཿwi kṛ tā 7na na hūṃ ma ma a mu shaṃ kadre ku ru sarba sha tru na bi ma ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ man ngag ji lta bas bdud rtsi la sogs pa zin pa dang / gtor ma sbyin par byas pas 'grub bo/ /'khor los dgos pa kun byed do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byen rlabs 7kyis/ /ye shes bla ma'i 8gnang ba yi / /byas pa dran pa yis ni byas/ /gshin/ rje'i dgra mgon man ngag gi/ /sgrub 9pa'i thabs kyi mgon byas la/ /de yi bsod nams khyad par gyis/ /sems can gnas chen thob par shog /dpal u rgyan gyi yul nas byung ba grub pa'i 'khor lo ji ltar rnyed pa klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—1005

༄/ /gshin rje mthar byed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ rakta ya mānta ka sā dha dzee/ bod skad du/gshin rje mthar byed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun nas bla ma la btud de/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo nyid/ /gshin rje gshed sku dmar po yi/ /sgrub thabs gsal por bri bar bya / / dang por re zhig sems can gdon pa'i bsam pa can gyi sngags pas snga dro 4langs te kha gtsang ba la sogs pa byas la/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste rang gi snying gar yi ge saṃ 5dmar po yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /der yi ge hūṃ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgos mtshan pa bsgom mo/ /de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po'i steng du yi ge hūṃ kha dog dmar po'i 6'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar po dang bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub 24—/008

sems dpa' rnams nam mkha'i phyogs su bsam mo/ /de nas yi ge hūṃ las 'thon pa'i me tog dang spos la sogs pas 1yang dag par mchod la sdeg pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas te/ byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o / /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma kolhahaṃ / zhes pa yid kyis bklag go/ /sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang las yi ge baṃ yongs su gyur pa'i padma'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las dbyug pa dkar po ste der yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yi ge hūṃ gis mtshan pa'o/ /de las hūṃ yig gi 'od zer rnams kyis 'jig rten gsum bkang ste sems can mtha' dag gshin rje mthar byed kyi gzugs su byas nas hūṃ yig de la gzhug go/ /de 4thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid gshin rje mthar byed sgu mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gsus pa 'phyang ba g.yon brkyang gi gom stabs kyis 5ma he la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas na dbyug pa dkar po g.yon na khrag gis yongs su gang ba'i thod pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bsgreng ba/mi mgo lnga'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ klu la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mgul par mi mgo 'dzag pa'i phreng ba can/'bar ba'i phreng ba dmar po'i 6phyogs mtha' dag khyab pa/ gshin rje 'jigs par byed pa/ mche ba rnam par gatshigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ljags 'gyur ba/ zhal 7khrag 'dzag pa/ rang snang gi shes rab kyis mgul nas 'khyud par bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i shes rab ste/ 'on kyang bye brag tu shes rab ni mgo bo skam po'i phreng ba can 24—1009

༄/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa/ 1༄go/ /'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig shin tu goms pa yis/ /spros pa yid 2kyis yid g.yengs na/ /bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas/ /spros pa de nyid spros med bya/ /ri bo'i rtse sogs rab dben par/ /maṇḍal la sogs tshogs byas la/ /bdag bskyed mchod dang bum pa bzlas/ /ji skad bshad bzhin 'grub pa na/ /shin tu dad dang ldan pa yi/ /slob ma rjes su gzung 4bar bya/ /khrus sogs sngon 'gro bgegs bskrad la/ /thun mong pa dang khyad par gyi/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i sdom pa sbyin/ /rang snying la gnas dbyug pa dkar/ /rdo jes mtshan pa bsgom par bya/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i yid 'di nyid/ /spros dang bral bar gdod nas grub/ /spros dang spros med gzhan min phyir/ /zung du 'jug pa'i sems bskyed bya/ /oṃ badzra yo ga tsitta utyā 5da yā mi su ra ta sa ma 24—1023

ya ṭwāṃ ho // de nas 'jam dpal 'dus pa yi2/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga la gsungs ltar/ /'byung ba lnga dang phung lnga la/ /gnas pa'i nyon mongs lnga sbyangs nas/ /bde gshegs lnga dang ye shes lnga/ /dbang bar byed pa dbang lnga sbyin / /de nas bsrub dang bsrubs pa yi/ /bde ba thig le'i man ngag bya/ /rdo rjes rnam rtog gzhom pa yi/ /g.yo 'dzin rlung gi man ngag dbab/ /de yi 'og tu zab mo ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi gsang / /mkha' 'gro'i bka' yis gdams gyur pa/ /rnam rtog 'od gsal zhal las gzung / /de ni —nam zhig rtogs gyur pas/ /skad cig nyid la ye shes 'char/ /grol dang grol ba ma yin pa'i/ /'ching ba kun ni spangs par 'gyur/ /nor dang go 'phang mnyam pa dang / /mkha' la 'gro dang kun mthong dang / /mkha' 'gro bran du bya la sogs/ /ci 'dod pa yi bsam pa 'grub/ /de ltar shin tu gsang ba bla ma dam pa'i drin las byung gyur pa/ /gsal bar byas pa gang yin des ni srid pa gsum po'i 7'ching ba kun/ /spangs nas srid gsum bde chen ro gcig dpal ldan las 'bras kun gzigs pa/ /zhi las 'jam dbyangs shin tu khros pa gshin rje gshed dpal thob gyur cig /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i byin gyis brlab ཿ pa'i man ngag 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa slob dpon mthu stobs kyi mgon po dpal bi rū pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta pa rend+ra pa'i zhal snga nas dang / chag lo tsā —dge slong chos rje dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //24—/02

༄/ /shin tu spros pa rjad pa de go na nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ su ni pra pañtsa tadhwa u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ shin tu spros pa med pa de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje gcig pa'i sku/ /srid gsum bde chen ngo bo nyid/ /spros pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud/ / 'jig rten gsum na rnyed dka' ba/ /bla ma mchog gi bka' drin gyis/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba ni/ /bla ma nye bar bsten nga/ra bshad/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod du/ /'jig rten chos la ltos sngarnged nga/'i/ /rnam rtog kun spangs dpa' bos ni/ /dogs pa med par bsgrub par bya/ /blo gros mchog ldan sgrub nga/ pos/ /gza' skar tshes grangs 'dir med de/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lha rnams dang / /phyi rol bkod pa 'dir mi dgos/ /bsam gtan bzlas pa yod ma yin/ /sreg blugs dang ni 21—/026

—gtor ma med/ /phyag rgya bcings dang 'khrul 'khor sogs/ /phyi rol g.yeng ba kun spangs te/ /brtse ldan gzhan gyi don sems pa/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ /skad cig nyid la dngos grub 'gyur/ /thog mar bla ma lhar bcas la/ /maṇḍal dbul zhing mchod gsol gdab/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rjes dran nas/ /sems ni dag cing las rung 'gyur/ /bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems / /tha dad par ni mi bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /de bzhin dge 'dun bla ma ste/ /dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pas/ /kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang / /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du/ /kun dang mthun par ston mdzad pa/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyis/ /bsten bya dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub rgya chen snod du 'gyur/ /srid pa'i rtsa ba nyon mongs dang / /bdag 'dzin la sogs ma lus pa/ /zhen pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ltos pa med par gtang bar bya/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la/ /bsam pa thag pas skyabs song bas/ /lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa gang / /bag la nyal dang bcas pas grol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /rdo rje rnams dang dbyer med 'gyur/ /'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang / /rig pa de nyid ma 'gags la/ /rang rig ye shes skad cig la/ /'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' sked—/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /bdag med gzhan yang rnged pa ste//'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa nyid/ /'di las mtshon te shes par bya/ /'di ni rang bzhin sgu gsum dang / /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ / sangs rgyas 27—/027

gzhan du bstan pa med/ /1sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku/ /gzhan du btsal bas rnyed 2ma yin/ /chos kun stong pa nyid rtogs pas/ /'go la snying rje rgyun mi 'chad/ /thabs mkhas spyod pas mtha' yas pa/ /yul dang dngos po gred pa'o/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dzin med pa/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la 'bad / /rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor nub byed yin/ /rtog pa'i 'ching ba las gol ba/ /de tshe mchog gi lam rnyed do/ /phyi rol yul gyi 'ching byed rnams/ /bu ga dgu nas snying gar basbu/ /nang 4gi rnam rtog zug rngu yang / /spyi gtsug nas ni rkang mthil bar/ /me shel tsam du snying gar dgug /snying gi bu ga gsal por phye/ /skar mda' 'pho ba ji lta bar/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar thug gaspro bar bya/ /rtog pa dang ni bral ba ni/ /lus kyi bde ba can der son/ /yi ge gsum gyi gsang sngags brjod/ /mkha' dang rang rig stong pa nyid/ /ro gcig nam mkha' ye shes bsgom/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi gsang chen bla na rnged/ /'di ni srid dang zhi las grol / /blang dang dor ba ci yang rnged/ /bde ba dang ni sdug bsngal dang / /bdud dang nyon mongs yod ma yin/ /lha dang srin po 'dir med de/ /nad dang sdug bsngal gyis mi gos/ /'dis ni bdud dang nyon mongs 'joms/ /'joms byed bcom ldan 'das zhes 6bya/ /de las gzhan pa gang yin pa/ /chos kun gnyen 7por mi 'gyur te/ /thams cad rtog pa yin phyir ro/ /rtog pa'i 'ching bas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas shes nas/ /phyi dang nang dang gzhan rnams kyi9/ /spros pa'i dra ba rnam par bcad/ /yul gyi 'dzin pa rnam par bshig /stong pa nyid la gtang legs na/ /rtog pa'i dra 24—/028

ba spong bar 'gyur/ /rten dang brten pa rnam par dbye/ /mnyam par gzhag pa goms par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems bskyed pa'i/ /bla ma'i 1man ngag bshad par bya/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ /'og min bde chen der bsgoms te/ /mi phyed bsams napas gsol ba gdab/ /mthar phyin tshe na rang la bstim/ /thog med brtse bas bskyangs gapa yi/ /drin can rnams la snying rje bsam/ /gnod byed 'di rnams bdag gi ma/ /sngon tshe yang yang phan btags kyang / /byon pa bzhin du rang dbang med/ /mi dge'i las kyis 4 mnar med 'gyur/ /de ltar dran pas srid gsum la/ /snying rje mthar phyin 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi nang spyod pa mi srun 5pas/ /blo gros shin tu 'khrugs pa'i tshe / /bdag dang gzhan du brje ba yi6/ /byang chub sems ni 7dran par bya/ /des ni bdud dang nyon mongs tshogs/ /'joms shing khros med nyid du 'gyur/ /srog 'gag pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /goms par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /ji ltar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /lus 'di rnam dag sbyang bar bya/ /dgang ba'i spyor bas spyi gtsug nas/ /rkang mthil bar du dgang byas la/ /rngub pa'i sbyor bas zhi bar bya/ /dang por srub cing bsrub par bya/ /gnyis pa rgya mtsho bskyod pa ste/ /gsum pa bsad pa nor lha gnyis/ /bzhi pa yan lag brkyang bsgum 'di/ /phyogs bzhi g.yo zhing srid gsum bsgrags/ /'di yi spyor bas 9goms byas na/ /nad kun las ni grol 'gyur zhing / /'di ltar rgud dang rgas pa dang / /'chi bdag thag ring kun rtog 'joms/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las gol zhing / /spros med ye shes go 'phang 'thob/ /dag pa'i bzhi mnyam blang byas te/ /gla rtsi 7yis ni dug med 'gyur/ /gañdzi dang ni ba ru ra/ /sga 24—1029

skya dang ni lhan cig byas/ /bu ram mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas/ /gsang sngags bzlas shing zhag bdun bsgrub/ /dam tshig brtan ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /nang par dus su bsnyen pa 1bya/ /skra dkar gnyer ma la sogs spang 2/ /dbang po rnams ni mchog tu gsal/ /lus kyi mdog rgyas zo mdog bde/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byen gyis rlobs / /bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin dang / /spros med ye shes go 'phang 'thob/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sbyor ba yis/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs su mnyes byas te/ /snying gi kun rdzob sna rtse nas/ /sor bzhi bcal nas dbu mar gzhug /nor bu'i bar du srog 4'dzin pa/ /steng gi dag pas zin pa yin/ /phyag na rdo rje gzung bya ste/ /g.yas pa'i mthil gyis bum pa spyor/ /tsakṣu gyen du blta bar bya/ /cig shos g.yo bar mi byed de/ /ba thag tsam yang mi 'byung ngo / /gal te phyi rol byung ba na/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis tshar gcod 5do/ /'og rlung bsdams pas dgra tshogs zhi/ /steng rlung mnan pas bdud rnams 'joms/ /dbus rlung dkrugs pas bar chod sel / /rnal 'byor 'di la sgrub pa pos/ /du ba la sogs mngon shes so/ /rnam rtog dra ba ma lus gcod7/ /shin tu spros med go 'phang thob / /sgrub po'i lam gyi gegs byed pa/ /bar du gcod / pa de sel ba/ /phyi rol bdud kyis dkrugs pa dang / /lus la sems dang rang rig dang / /nad dang sdug bsngal rengs pa yis/ /bar du gcod pa phal cher la/ /sngar gyi man ngag bsgoms pa yis/ /mkha' la sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa la/ /mi bzad rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /gzhan yang bdud kyi bar chad gang / /spros med de nyid dbyengs su bstem/ /rten rkadang brten pa so sor bya/ /'dzin pa nyid la tsho(—/030

gtad par bya/ /de ltar goms pas spros med 'gyur/ /dga' dang bde ba dang ba yis/ /phyi dang gsang ba mtshon par bya/ /blo yi rtog pa ma zhi na/ /sems can lam gye 1dpa' bskyed la/ /til mar ngar btags ral gri bzhin/ /thogs pa med par gzhom par bya/ /shin tu spros rnged bla ma'i gsung / /blo yi yul du goms na yang / /spros pa rtsub mos bskyod pa'i tshe/ /blo la spros med kyis la reg /blo ni phal par brtan par gnas/ /de tshe spros pa spros med du//ro gcig mnyam pa nyid du thim/ /'dre dang srin po 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /dur khrod ro langs la sogs pa/ /'khun dung rang ba bshugs pa 'bod/ /'jigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan rnged pas/ /rang sems skar mda' 'pho ba ltar/ /de yi snying la thim pa yis/ /blo dang gzhan dang spros med rnams/ /spros med ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /yang na blo de nyid la gtad/ /bdag gi gces de 4mchod sbyin bya/ /mi bzad gdon dang 'go ba'i nad/ /sdig pa'i rmi lam 'pho ba sogs/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gdon la sogs/ /nad dang mya ngan sdug bsngal dang / /dgra dang 'byung ba'i gnod pa dang / /mi dang mi ma yin pa yis5/ /nye bar 'tshe ba sna tshogs pa/ /thag pa'i sbrul ni sangs pa bzhin/ /sgyug bro ba dang gtsang sbra dang / /'dzem bag dang ni ngo tsha dang / /spros med ye shes kyis gzhom bya/ /bla ma 'dod ltar bsgrub bya ste/ /dga' dang bde dang rangs pa dang / /tshim dang nga rgyal dregs pa dang / /sgeg dang tshul 'chos rgyan la sogs/ /spros rnged ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /zhum dang sgyid lug mi mthun phyogs/ /thams cad spros rnged nyid du 'gyur / /mi bzad nyon mongs gang yin pa/ /spros med de nyid las gzhan 21—— /03/

min / /de ltar bgod dang bgrod min pa/ /yid du 'ong dang mi 'ong ba /shin tu spros med sems kyis ni/ /zhen pa nyid du mi bya'o/ /'jig rten rnams dang mthun pa yi/ /rnam gzhag hrul po bshigs 1nas kyang / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /de las yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /e ma zhi ba chen po'i chos/ /e ma khro bo 'jigs mdzad pa/ /e ma mya ngan 'das pa mchog /e ma 'khor ba zhi ba nyid/ /e ma 'di ni rab tu mtshar/ /skyon ni gang yin yon tan 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni 2mngon rtogs byed / /dngos po min zhing sgom pa min/ /khams kyang min zhing rnam shes min/ /nam mkha'i dkyil dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po'o/ /sa yang ma yin chu yang min/ /mee min rlung min nam mkha' min/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i spyor ba yis/ /skye ba 'di la rab tu gnas / /dngos po thams cad dngos med bshad/ /dngos po med ces ma bsgrags pa/ /rnal 'byor spyor ba dang bral zhing 4/ /chad pa ma yin rtag pa min / /yan lag med cing kha dog med/ /thog ma dbus dang mtha' yang spangs / /dngos po thams cad med par 'gyur/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /bsod nams sdig pa dag dang ma 'byel ba/ /mchog tu dga' ba dri med dag pa 5yi/ /mgon po de nyid gter chen gcig pu ste/ /kun kyang snying rje'i sems nyid mgon 'di yod/ /chos rnams ngo bo bde ba chen po'i mchog /mchog tu lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo ni/ /gzugs med bsod nams med cing sdig pa med/ /skye dang 'gag pa yod pa ma yin no/ /de ltar 24—/032

bla ma'i drin gyis rang nyid yid ches dran phyir gsal byas la1/ /de la nongs gyur dpal ldan bla ma lha mo rnams la bzod par gsol/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs kyi gsang 'di legs par bkod pa yis/ /bsod nams gang skyes de yis 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ slob dpon dpal ldan mthu stobs kyi 2mgon po thugs spros pa med pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du/ sku'i spros pa dpag tu meed pas gdug pa can tshar gcod cing / bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bi rū 4pas mdzad pa rdzogs (〈 5bstan pa srung 6ba'i lha rnams kyis bu gcig pa ltar bskyangs pas rgyal po gzhan gyi 7rgol bas glags lta bar mi nus pa'i ljongs chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mkhar nyi ma gzugs su rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta dngos grub brnyes pa dpal darban ā tsārya dang / slo bo lo tsā 9ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //24—/033

0928༄ / /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga 1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ rakta ya mā ri sā dha na bi dhi/ bod skad du/gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sthāḥbyeḥcha kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ na maḥlha sbyin 2bdag gi shākṣiṃ ku ru na maḥswā hā/ 'di ni zhi ba'o/ /rgya skags sam/ tsandan dmar po la ming med kyi khrag dang bsres pas bri bar bya'o/ /oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hoḥ/ lha sbyin 4bdag gi ba bye ku ru ho/ /ba bye ku ru bo ṣaṭa5/ dbang du bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /ras la rgya skags kyi khu bas/ oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dza dī6ཿche ge mo bdag la ā 7karṣa ya dī8ཿdzaḥ/ rkang pa dgug 9 pa'o/ /24—1036

ras la ba bla'am/ yung ba'i khu bas/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ waṃ a de ba lha sbyin 1swasgranā ta stambha ya stambha ya lo/ rengs pa'i cho ga'o / /oṃ dīḥbyeḥli kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa baṃ/ lha sbyin 2gyi mu khaṃ bandha ma no baddhā mu khaṃ/ ku ru baṃ mo hā ya bya ba ha ra bitya baṃ/ ras la dug dang ske tshe dang tsha ba'i mar nag dang / nags kyi nim pa'i 'dab ma dang / da du ra'i 'dab ma'i khu ba dang / ro bsregs pa'i sol ba dang thal ba dang khrag gis bya rog gi sgro'i smyu gus/ oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lha sbyin 4mā ra ya hūṃ/ oṃ dhīḥsgoḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ha ra che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/gsad pa'i cho ga'o/ /de kho na bzhin du/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lha sbyin 5dang mchod sbyin dag /bi de 6ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa che ge mo nyid kyi / oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ che ge mo'i ye na ke na tsi dza gri na yant+ra mant+ra bi ṣa tsūrṇa /pra yo ga ti ta ta sasba uta ghā 7ṭa ya swā hā/ dang por 'khor lo btu bar bya ste/ rtsibs brgyad pa'am/ rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i dbus su ya/ shar du kṣe / lhor ma/ nub tu me/ byang du yi ge da/ yi ge ya dang por byas pa'i / rā dza ya sas do ru ṇa yo ni ra yatstsha ni 'dab ma bcu gnyis su bri'o/ /rtsibs bcu drug tu re re'i bar du bcug pa'i re'u mig la/ oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na 21—1037

na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /re'u mig gzhan brgyad du/ oṃ sthāḥsgoḥl sogs pa rdzogs pa dang / swā hā mthar bri ste lha sbyin 1gyi shārnyi ku ru pusto 2ku ru ba bye ku ru/ stambha ya mo ha ya/ bi dre ṣa ya/ utstsha ṭa ya/ mā ra yā mu shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya ba bri bar bya'o/ /phyogs bral du lha sbyin gyi ming ngo / /gshin rje gshed dmar sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bris la dge ba gang bsags pa/ /de yis myur du sems can rnams/ / bde ba byemyur du mchog thob shog /dpal dpa' bo'i rgyal pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas dang / chag lo tsā phyab dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o6// //bsdur mchan/1༷36 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga /garshan rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs dpa' bo'i rgyal pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byen/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ril/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzas byin/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṣata/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mos/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodagu/1༷37 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8 ba lhas byin/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lhas byin/ ༷〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sreg zu 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lhas byin/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ )〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7)sa/ spri〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag na tsi ta kri na/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉(ra na/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉misbosgyu/ nyu1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sto/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkaya/1༷38 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khyen/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ṣṭi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa ra ya// sngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngar bas/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsha/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/24dod1038

0929༄khya/ /gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba/ 1rakṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya mā 2ri yant+ra a ba li/ bod skad du/gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmar po dang ser po dang / nag po dang ljang gu dang dkar po'i mdog gi dbye bas phrin las kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bsgom par bya'o / /de nas bzlas pa rjes su dran pa ni/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa na maḥche ge mo shādhi ku ru na maḥswā hā/ rgyas pa la bo ṣaṭa/ dgug pa la dzaḥbaskrad 4pa la baṃ/ dbang du bsnyu ba la hoḥ rengs pa la lo/ bskul ba la hūṃ/gsad pa la hūṃ phaṭa/ 5de ltar nges pa la sogs pa'i phrin las rnams la gdags par bya'o/ /oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ya da yo ni/ ra yakṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha/ ni rā ma ya hūṃ phaṭa 6swā hā/ 'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po'i phrin las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /24dod/0/0

bud med rnams kyi srung 1ba dang zhi ba la gi wang gis dar dkar po'am/gro ga'am smyug ma'i shun 2pa'am/ ras dkar po la 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te/ na mā ཿyi ge ming la btags la nag nog la sogs pa med pa'i rdza phor kha spyor gyi nang 4du bcug ste/ mar dang sbrang rtsi'i nang du bcug nas skud pa dkar pos dril 5te thun gsum du me tog dkar pos mchod/ shar phyogs su bltas la gshin rje gshed dkar po bsgom zhing mdun du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bsgrub bya dmigs nas rang gi snying ga nas khug pa lta bu'i 'od zer las byung ba'i gshin rje gshed dkar po rnams kyis 6bum pa dkar po zla ba'i bdud rtsi'i chus yongs su gang bas dbang bsgur bar bsams la sngags bzlas pa ni / oṃ trīḥdzdzaḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa na maḥche ge mo shādzhai ku ru na maḥswā hā/zhi ba'i cho ga'o/ /skyes pa rnams kyis zhi ba dang / rgyas pa 7la gur gum gyi 'khor lo gnyis bo ṣaṭa dang bcas pa mngon par bris te/ swā hā yi ge ming la btags la mar dang sbrang rtsi'i nang du bcug nas/ sgud pa ser pos dril te/ thun gsum du me tog ser pos mchod/ byang du kha bltas pas gshin rje gshed ser po bsgoms te/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ser po la gnas pa'i bsgrub bya bsam zhing dmigs nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer ser po las byung ba'i gshin rje gshed ser po dpag tu med pa rnams kyis gser gyi bum pa ser po/ bdud rtsi ser pos gang bas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ 24dod/01/

dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bo 1ṣaṭa che ge mo puṣṭi ku ru bo 2ṣaṭa swā hā/rgyas pa'i cho ga'o/ /gro ga'am ras dkar po la rgya skyegs kyi khu ba'am tsandan dmar pos ming med kyi khrag dang bsres pas 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te hoḥ'i yi ge ming la btags la nag nog la sogs pa med pa'i/ so legs par btang ba'i rja phor dmar po kha spyor 4du bcug la/ mar dang sbrang rtsi'i nang du bcug nas skud pa dmar pos dril te me tog dmar pos mchod/ nub tu bltas la bdag nyid gshin rje gshed dmar po bsgoms te/ mdun du zla ba dmar po'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bsgrub bya bsams te/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer dmar pos lus kun tu gang bas myos par gyur te/ rkang pa gnyis la mdud 5par bsam zhing / spobs pas sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hoḥche ge mo lha sbyin gyi ched du ba bye ku ru hoḥswā hā/ gal te dbang du ma gyur na mar dang sbrang rtsi med pa'i 'khor lo nyid du ba med pa'i seng sdeng gi me la bdug byung / rang gi rnal 'byor gyis ji skad bshad pa'i sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /yang na/ oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa bo ṣaṭa che ge mo bdag gi dbang du kyis shig /bo ṣaṭa swā hā/ dbang du bsnyu ba'i cho ga'o/ /dur khrod kyi ras sam zla mtshan gyi ras la tshos kyi khu bas 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris la yi ge dzaḥ'am dhīḥ'am yang na gnyis ka ming la btags la rdza phor kha sbyar ram bud med kyi thod pa kha spyor du bcug la/ me tog dmar bos 21—/042

mchod / sgud pa dmar pos dril te dgongs 1thun nyi ma lta bur 2gshin rje gshed du bdag nyid bsgoms te/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer las byung ba'i gshin rje gshed dmar po zhags pa dang beegs kyu 'dzin pa bsgoms te/ bsgrub bya'i snying la lcags kyus bkug /zhags pas rke la btags nas 'gugs par bsams nas/ sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥche ge mo'i ched du mchod sbyin ā 4karṣa ya dzaḥswā hā/ yang na dhī5ཿyang na gnyis ka'o/ /gal te 'ong bar ma gyur na 'khor lo de nyid du ba med pa'i seng ldeng gi me la bdug cing sngags bzla bar 6bya'o/ /dgug pa'i cho ga'o/ /dur khrod kyi ras la zla ba'am7/ yung bas 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te/ bsgrub bya'i ming la yi ge lo btags te/ nag nog la sogs med pa'i rdza phor kha sbyor du gzhug /rdza phor de'i steng du re khā ser po gru bzhi pa bdun bris te / de'i steng du hūṃ baṃ hūṃ gi peyi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i ri rab/ de'i steng du dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor lo gyis mtshan pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan par 1 bris te/ me tog ser pos mchod/ skud pa ser pos dril te/ bdag nyid kha sgor bltas la gshin rje gshed ser po bsgoms te/mdun du dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bsgrub bya ser po bsams la/bsgrub bya'i mgo'i steng du sa'i 1 dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ri rab sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram kyis mnan par bsams la sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ paṃ che ge mo stambha ya lo mnan pa'i cho ga'o/ /24dod/013

ngag mnan par 'dod pas de bzhin du 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te/bsgrub bya'i ming la yi ge lo btags nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa lo lha sbyin gyi 1ji ltar sems pa'i don la 'gag pa byed pa'am/mi snyan par smra ba'i mchod sbyin ngag mnan par gyis shig /lo zhes sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /ngag mnan pa'i cho ga'o/ /lkugs par 'dod par 4dur khrod kyi ras la 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te/ yi ge baṃ bsgrub bya'i ming la btags nas gshin rje gshed ser po'i rnal 'byor gyi cho gas bsgrub bya de lug gi snying gar rab tu bkug nas/ dbang chen gyi 'khor lo bzhis za ma tog bzhin du kha spyor byas te rengs pa'i kha 5sbyor gyi cho ga bzlas par 6bya ba ni/ oṃ dhīḥbyeḥblu kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa baṃ/ lha sbyin 7gyi kha chings shig /yid chings shig /lkugs par gyis shig baṃ/ yul chos la sogs pa la rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi ras la dug dang ske tshe dang tsha dang mar nag dang / nim pa'i lo ma dang / da du ra'i lo ma'i khu ba dang / ro bsregs 9pa'i sol ba dang rang gi 7sdigs mdzub kyi khrag gis snag tsha byas te 1/ bya rog gi sgro rkang gis smyu gu byas la 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te/ yi ge hūṃ bsgrub bya'i ming la btags la thod pa kha spyor gyi nang du bcug nas sgud pa sngon pos dril te/nyi ma gung la dur khrod du sbas nas kha lhor bltas te/ gshin rje gshed nag po g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ bzhin mi sdug 24—/04/

cing mche ba gcigs pa/ glog ltar ljags 'gyu ba shin tu mi bzad pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar shin tu 'bar ba/ phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phyar ba/ dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur gsus pa 'phyang ba/ me 'bar ba ltar skra dang sma ra gyen du 'bar ba/ 'brug gi sgra lta bu'i hūṃ gis mgrin pa'i sbubs gang bar bdag nyid bsams te/ mdun du bsgrub bya gos hrul po dri ma can gyon pa lus la dri ma chags pa/ de'i spyi bo dang / mtshog 1ma dang / snying ga dang / dpung pa dang pus mo rnams la sngags kyi cho gas 2byas pa'i cho ga dang srung ba rnams bshigs nas de'i lus la gnas pa'i lha rnams nye bar bsdus te/ rang gi lus la rab tu bcug 4nas bsgrub bya'i lus khang stong lta bur bsams la khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams pa sprul nas nga rgyal dang bcas pas bsgrub bya dum bu dum bur byas la khrag dang zhun mar dang / tshil dang rkang mar dang /sha rnams 'thung 5zhing zos la/ rus pa yang bsregs pas thal bar byed cing mdun du char sprin kyi mdog lta bu ma te la gnas pa/ thod dbyug dang zhags pa 'dzin pa gsus pa 'phyang ba mche ba gcigs pa des za bar gyur pa de'i snying la gnas par bsams te sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa / hūṃ lha sbyin 6mā ra ya hūṃ/ yang na cho ga 'dis 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te/ hūṃ phaṭa yi ge bsgrub 7bya'i ming la btags la/ de bzhin du bsam gtan la gnas pa'i cho gas bsgrub bya lha dang bral zhing lus la dri ma chags pa ske'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bsgrub bya bzhin mi sdug pa/ khro bo sna tshogs kyis ral gri dang / dbyug pa dang gtun shing dang sta re dang mtshon ka ṇa pa dang / gzhu dang mda' dang / 'khor lo dang tri shul 9dang rtse gsum pa dang 24dod/045

mdung dang / ral gri dang /1 mtshon pa ṇi ḍi 2pa la dang ldan pa'i phyag mtshan rnams kyis brgyab pas dum bu brgyar bcad cing / bya rog dang 'ug pa dang bya rgod dang spyang ki dang srin po dang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyis za bar bsam zhing / spobs pas sngags bzlas pa ni4/ oṃ byāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ phaṭa lha sbyin 5mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gsad 6pa'i cho ga'o / /gal te grub par ma gyur na sngar bshad pa'i sngags bzlog nas bzlas na 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /sdang ba la de bzhin du 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te bsgrub bya'i ming la phaṭa yig btags la thod pa kha spyor gyi nang du bcug nas skud pa nag pos dkris te nyi ma gung la dur khrod du sbas te/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas gnas pa'i mdun du rta dang / ma te la zhon pa'i bsgrub bya gnyis mtshon ston pa rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs sprul pa phyogs gnyis la gnas pas/ phan tshun za zhing 'khrug 7par byed par bsam zhing bzlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ phaṭa/ lha sbyin mchod sbyin dang rnam par dbye bar gyis shig phaṭa/ rnam par ldang 9ba'i cho ga'o/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyi 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te 7bsgrub bya'i ming la hūṃ phaṭa yi ge btags la thod pa kha spyor du bcug nas sgud pa nag pos dril te dur khrod du sbas la/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor gyi mdun du yo las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bsgrub bya rnga mong 1la zhon pa/ lho 27—/046

phyogs su rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams kyis 1rdeg cing 'gro bar bsams nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ sthāḥ:ཿwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/hūṃ phaṭa lha sbyin sgod par gyis shig /hūṃ phaṭa sgod pa'i cho ga'o/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi 4bdag srung 5ba'i cho ga ni/ oṃ ya mā 6rā dza sa do me 7ya na maḥ/ snying la'o/ /oṃ ya ske do 8ru swā hā/ mtshog ma la'o oṃ ṇa yo da ya hūṃ/ spyi bor ro/ /oṃ yo ni rā ba kha ṭa yakṣe 7ya/ mig g.yas pa la'o / /oṃ yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/ mig g.yon pa'o/ /oṃ da ya phaṭa/ rgyu ma la'o/ / de ltar bskyed tshul drug byas nas/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ bsam mo/ /11 rnal 'byor pa khros pas rang gi khrag dang / ro bsregs pa'i thal ba dang dug dang tshwa dang / ske tshe dang mar nag dang da du ra'i lo ma'i khu bas dur khrod kyi ras la 'khor lo gnyis rim pas bri bar bya'o/ /gsod pa gshin rje'i sgu la gnas/ /sdang ba rta dang ma te la/ /bskrad pa rnga mo rgyab na gnas/ /zhi ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang snyud —bud sked snying la'o/ /rgyas pa rta yi rgyab tu ste/ /lkugs sapa lug gi snying la gnas / /rengs pa ri rab dbus su ste/ /'gugs pa seng ge sha ra bha/ /gi waṃ gur gum dag gis kyang / /gro ga la sogs dag la bri/ /rdza phor kha sbyor nang du gzhug /yongs su 'dud de dag sems kyis/ /bya rog chen po'i smyu gu ste/ /nyin gung ro bsregs thab tu sba/ /thod pa kha spyor nang bcug nas/ /bzhin mi sdug gi 'du shes can/ /gshin 24—/047

rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor ldan/ /lho phyogs bltas pas chad pas 1bcad/ /zhi bar mtha' yi g.yas bsub bya/ /ni yig gnyis kyang de bzhin du/ /rjes la dbus kyi ya yig bsub/ /lhag ma 'bru rnams ci bder 4gnas/ /'di yi bsnyen pa khri phrag gcig /yang dag dngos grub 'dod pas bzlas/ /gang la bris nas gzhag pa yi/ /khyim der rtag tu 'thab mo 'byung / /zlum po gsum ni byas nas su/ /brgyad dang bcu gnyis bcu drug pa/ /re'u mig de la 'di ltar dgod/ /btags pa'i sngags ni bri bar bya/ /ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra yakṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/dbus su yang 'byung ngo / /nang gi 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi re'u mig la/ kṣe ma me da 'byung ngo / /phyogs bral stong pa la bsgrub bya hūṃ gnyis kyi bar du gzhug go//yakṣe ma me da yatstsha ni rā dza sa do ru ṇa yo — rā/ 'khor lo gnyis pa la g.yon nas brtsams nas g.yas skor gyis bri'o/ /'khor lo gsum pa la 5shar phyogs nas brtsams nas bar bar gyi re'u mig la/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bri bar bya'o/ /de'i bar bar gyi re'u mig rnams la che ge mo bskrad par gyis shig /sod cig /dbang du gyis shig /sdang bar gyis shig/rgyas par gyis shig /zhi bar gyis shig swā hā/ zhes de la sogs pa las kyi rjes su 'brang ba bri bar bya'o/ /dang por oṃ/ tha ma la na maḥdang ba ṣaṭa dang bo ṣaṭa dang / hūṃ phaṭa yi ge dang 6ldan pa'i sa bon rnams zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang du basbu ba 7dang / gsod par byed par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag thams cad bdag nyid bsgoms pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dpal u rgyan nas 'byung ba gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud chen 'bum phrag gsum pa las 24dod/0 8

0930༄/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī 2rakta ya mā sā dha dzwa/ bod skad du/dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma de rjes rdo rje gshin rje 4gshed dmar po/ /rang snang lus 'khyud bde bas gang zhig gzhan don 'jug /rdo rjes mtshan 5pa'i dbyug pa mi mgor ldan pa'i phyag /zhal gcig 'jigs pa sel la gus pas mgos phyag 'tshal/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims la sogs ldan/ /blo bzangs 6sems can don rtse gcig /byams sogs yon tan yongs su rdzogs/ /dad dang thos pas rnam par brgyan/ /snga bar brtse ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /dang por kha sogs dag byas nas/ /skye bos dbeen sogs dur khrod sogs/ /bde ba'i stan la brtsam par bya/ /rang gi snying gar padma bkod/ /shin tu gsal ba'i nyi ma blta/ /yi yig dbus su hūṃ yig ni/ /dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba'o /21—105/

de yi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i/ /rang lhag lha yi dkyil 'khor dang / /rdo rje 'chang bdag rnam pa can/ /bla ma sangs rgyas de yi sras/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can yang / /dkyil 'khor pa yi rang bzhin can/ /dmigs nas de dag rnams la phyag /lus kyi tshogs kyis rnam par brtson/ /tsartsi kā 1la sogs pa yis/ /mchod pa byas la sdig pa bshags/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sdig /bgyid dang de bzhin bgyid stsal gang / /gang yang rjes su yi 2rang ba/ /de dag dus gsum mgon la bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /'phags rnams dge tshogs rjes yi rang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs kyi mchog bcas skyabs su mchi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /rang gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi/ /dam pa'i chos kun ston pa yi/ /sgra dbyangs mdzes pas bzhugs su gsol/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul/ /sgu gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dang bas bsten par bgyi/ /sems can rnams kyi don bsgrub phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /bsod nams kun nas gang bsags pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed du/ /gyur nas bdag gis 'gro phan bgyi/ /smon lam 'di ni byas nas su/ /blo yis de rnams gshegs de nas/ /brtse bas cho ga bzhin bltas te/ /sna tshogs stong par rnam par bsam rang bzhin dang bral stong pa ste/ /rgyu yis kyang ni mtshan ma med/ /rnam par rtog dang bral nyid kyis/ /smon pa rnam par spangs pa'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma kolha4haṃ/ brtan par byas nas sems de ni/ /saṃ yig las byung 24—1052

nyi ma der/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje ste/ /kun nas sngon po rtse lnga pa/ /'od zer 'phro bas kun nas 'khrigs/ /bsrung ba'i don du bsgom par bya/ /rdo jes sa gzhi khor yug dang / /ra ba gur ni de bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam dag phyir/ /slar yang bsam gtan brtsam par bya/ /der ni sna tshogs pad zla la/ /saṃ byung rdo rje bzang po yi/ /yan lag chos 'byung zur gsum dkar / /sna tshogs padma rdo rje dang / /son cing gyen du gnas bsgom de'i/ /dbus su slar yang dkyil 'khor ni/ /rgyu yig 'khor lo las byes pa/ /rtag pa'i yan lag yang dag byung / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed kyis spras shing / /stegs bu lha mos mdzes byas pa/ /sna tshogs rtse mo rlung gis bskyod/ /ba dan dril bu dang ldan pa/ /sna tshogs rdo rje mnyam par mnan/ /zla ba nyi ma rgyal ba'i gdan/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar po che/ /lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /byang ni ljang gu yang dag mtshungs/ /dbang sngon 'od 'bar rnam par ni/ /dbus kyi sa gzhi rnam bsgom bya/ /phyogs kyi kha dog dbye ba 'dis / /sna tshogs rdo rje'ang bsgom par bya/ /thog kyang de bzhin bsam bya zhing / /rtsig pa so so go rims 1bzhin/ /rnam pa lnga ni rnam bsgoms nas/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rnam par bsgom/ /rnam pa lnga des dpal ldan ni/ /rdo rje gshin rje 'joms mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas sku zhes bya bar grags/ /de yang dbye bas brjod par bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la/ /padma nyi ma dbyangs zung dgod/ /de yis zla ba ka yig sogs/ /ḍa bhā da dha ya la yang / /spel te zung des rdzogs pa yi/ /zla ba dmar po bsgom par bya/ /'di dag kho na 24—/053

rdzogs pa ni/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes brjod/ /mnyam pa nyid ni de gcig nyid / /so sor kun rtog de byung hūṃ/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /de las byung ba'i rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje dbyug pa dbyug pa che/ /mi mgo ser pos rnam par brgyan/ /nor bu me shel lta bu yi/ /'od zer 'khrug pa'i sa bon bcas / /oṃ badzra daṇḍa ātma kophohaṃ1/ zhes pas nga rgyal bya'o/ /de las byung ba dkar po'i nyi 'od snang ba thub mchog 'od 'phro rang snang gis sku 'khyud/ /sgeg pa'i khro bo'i tshul can mchog tu bde ba'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang gi mtshan 'chang ba/ /g.yon brkyang gdan bzhugs 'bar ba'i rdo rje dang ldan mi mgo so sor mtshan pa'i dbyug pa thogs/ /gtum po bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi khu bas yongs su gang ba'i padma'i snod ni bsnams pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /ye shes rdo rje 'dzin bdag nyid/ /rnam pa lnga yi rang bzhin gang //rnal 'byor zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ro/ /'dod chags chen po'i gdul bya ni/ /'go ba gsum po mnyam bltas nas//rang snying ye shes 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba sangs rgyas gzugs can byas/ /rang gi lus la mnyam par gzhug /bde ba dam pa'i rang bzhin du/ /bdag nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa bsgom/ /kun du rtog pa thams cad spongs / /'di ni de nyid gsum sngags mchog /ho dmar gnyis kyi dbus gnas pa/ /ji ltar skar mda' 'pho ba ltar/ /de nas byang chub sems la gzhug /snying rje chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid zhu/ /byams sogs tsartsi ka sogs kyis/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pas bskul bar bya/ /thugs rje'i khro 27(—/05 /

—bo rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /sa gsum mtha' dag rmongs pa sol mdzod cig/jo bo bdud bzhi po 'di las rgyal ba/ /sems ni g.yengs so rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /'jig rten mgron gnyer stong nyid bzhugs sam ci/ /rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams nyid kyis bzhengs/ /byang chub rang bzhin 'jig rten mgron gnyer nas/ /khyod ni stong nyid sems shing ci la bzhugs/ /khu ba de bskul zhu bar ni/ /gyur cing bcud de'i rjes su zhugs/ /glu 'di dag gi rjes mthun ngor/ /de rnams rgud bzhin 'bod pa'i phyir/ /khu ba yongs gyur paṃ las skyes/ /sna tshogs padma nyi 1dkyil du/ /khros shing dregs bcas dmar po ni/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /smin ma rno zhing rab 'bar ba/ /rmig pa brdabs pas 'jigs par byed/ /baṃ yig sa bon las byung ba/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par byed/ /ma he de yi rgyab gnas pa/ /mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa yi / /rdo rje'i dbyug pa 'od zer can//dkar po gdul dka' 'dul byed bsgom/ /beer yang sa bon de dbus son/ /nyi ma dang bcas me long gi/ /gzugs brnyan ltar bsams 4de 'od kyis/ /sna tshogs dus dgra'i gzugs can byas/ /de la yang dag bcug nas ni/ /rdo rje'i dbyug pa las byung ba'i/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'od gsal 'bar /bdag nyid 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /khams gsum bdud kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /'od zer 'bar ba drag tu 'phro/ /drag shul bskal pa'i me 'bar sgu/ /khro gnyer 'khyog po 'jigs su rung / /mgrin par hūṃ gi rnam pa gang / /ljags ni 'gyur zhing 'od zer 'phro/ /nyi ma'i gzugs la 'gran pa yi/ /spyan gsum 'phro ba dang ldan pa/ /mche ba 'bar zhing gcigs 5pa'i zhal/ /smin ma sma ra 27(—/055

mgo skyes gyen/ /nya phyis lta bu'i mgo bo lngas/ /dbu la rnam par brgyan pa ste//zhabs g.yon brkyang bas mnan pa yi/ /dus ni rgyal bar byed pa po/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba dmar po yis/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag khyab/ /dpa' bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed dmar/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa ni/ /dkar po mi mgo ser pos mtshan/ /g.yon na padma'i sgod mchog ni/ /dkar po bdud rtsi lnga yis gang / /sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang / /mgo bo'i do shal rnam 'phyang ba/ /zhal nas khrag 'dzag mgul par ni/ /rang snang shes rab ma yis 1'khyud/ /stag gi pags pa'i na bza' can/ /gdengs can dbang po khros pas brgyan/ /mtha' yas sngon po klu dbang gis/ /dbu skra bcings mdzes 'jigs par byed/ /klu rgyal 'jog po dmar po yi2/ /rnam par drag po'i rna rgyan byas/ /sna tshogs rigs ldan dpung pa'i rgyan/ /klu rgyal dung skyong ser po ni/ /lag gdub dag tu 'dzin pa'o/ /padma dkar po mgul pa'i rgyan/ /ljang gu stobs kyi rgyu yis kyang //mchod phyir thogs pa shin tu mdzes/ /gdengs can nor rgyas bdud rtsi yi/ /kha dog lta bus ska rags byas/ /pad rtsa lta bur dkar ba'i mdog /padma chen pos rkang gdub byas/ /thams cad phaṭa kyi sgra drag pos/ /lce gnyis mche ba'i phreng ba can/ /de nas rang nyid pad nyi la/ /sa bon hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar/ /mgo bo ser pos rnam par brgyan/ /ji ltar dngas pa'i 4shel dag la/ /dza ba'i me tog drug tu gzhag /dza ba'i me tog des mtshungs pa/ /rab tu gsal bar snang bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin de dbus nyi mar gnas/ /gsal bar der son gdan dag la/ /mar me 'bar 2((—/056

ba'i rtse mo lta'i/ /hūṃ gi rnam pa rab tu bsam/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ci 'dra ba/ /sgu mdog phyag mtshan la sogs pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'ang de dang 'dra/ /'on kyang mgo phreng skam po can/ /de mtshan rdo rje ro langs ma/ /kha cig rdo rje gshin rje yi/ /gshed ma zhes grags rig pa yi/ /dga' ba'i tshogs rgyun 'bab 1pa mo/ /phyi nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba/ /hūṃ yig las byung rdo rje dang / /bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsang ba yang / /āḥyig las byung padma ru/ /bltas nas gsang sngags oṃ sadzee/ /la sogs brjod cing mdun gnas ma/ /bde chags thugs ma rang snang gi/ /shes rab ma yis gtso bo 'khyud/ /rdo rje padma snyoms 'jug pas/ /bde ba 'bebs pa'i don du gnyer / /lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin du/ /de yi mjug thogs bsgom par bya/ /shes rab lte 'og mtsho skyes ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa dmar po de'i/ /lte bar gnas pa'i hūṃ yig dmar/ /de yi steng du gnas pa yi/ /padma'i snal ma'i gzugs can ni/ /spyi bo'i bdud rtsi las 'thon pa/ /ri mo dkar po gsal bar bya/ /shes rab 'phel ba nyer gnas gang / /'di ni 'khor ba myang 'das kyi/ /gzugs can gshin rje 'joms byed du/ /rtogs nas rnam rtog zhi bya'i phyir/ /sngags kyis kun nas byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ dhadzre dhā tu swa bhā ba ātma ko34haṃ/ 'di ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /rang snying 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /mkha' khyab rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun / /spyan drangs zhal nas rnam kun gzhug /bde ba zhugs pa snying ga ru/ /zhu 5byas blo ldan de dbyung bya/ /rdo rje'i lam nas zhu ba de/ /rang snang padma'i 2(—/057

dkyil gnas pa'i/ /sa bon rang bzhin can du blta/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs 'bar ba/ /cho ga bzhin du mkhas pas bsgom/ /dbus su ya yig las byung ba'i/ /gtso bo bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /shar du kṣe dang 'khor lo las / /byung ba'i rtag pa phyag gnyis pa/ /dkar po g.yas na 'khor lo g.yon / /de bzhin thod pa bsnams par 3bsgom/ /lhor ni ma yig rin chen las / /skyes pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan ni/ /btso 2sna/ma gser gyi mdog lta bus༄ —//g.yas na rin chen 4che mchog bsnams/ /g.yas pa min na thod pa'o/ /nub tu chags pa rdo rje can/ /me 5yi sa bon padmas khuskyes/ /padma 7rā ga'i 'od mtshungs pa/ /padma dmar dang thod pa ni/ /phyag g.yas cig shos dag tu dgod / /byang du da yig ral gris bskyed/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu / /g.yas na ral gri mchog bsnams shing / /g.yon na rumi yi thod pa'o/ /'di rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /zhabs ni g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs / /thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ /mtshan nyid dag gi khro bo'i gzugs/ /'on kyang de rnams phyag g.yas na/ /rang rang sku mdog rang phyag mtshan/ /gnyug ma'i shes rab gnyis med gyur/ /sku ni bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la gnas/ /rtag pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra ḍartsar gnas/ /sems can don mdzad bsgom par bya/ /shar du ya yig tho ba las/ /byung ba'i tho ba gshin rje gshed//ces grags sgu mdog sngon po'i tshul/ /phyag g.yas na ni tho ba ste/ /g.yon na padma'i snod bsnams pa/ /lhor ni tsa yig dbyug pa las/ /byung ba'i dbyug pa gshin rje gshed/ /dkar po dbyug mchog mi thod can/ /nub tu padma gshin 27(—/058

—rje gshed/ /ni skyes chags pa mthar byed tshul/ /byang du ral gri gshin rje gshed / /ra las phrag dog mthar byed 'dra/ /cung zad sngo ba bye brag tu/ /mdzes shing rab tu 'jigs par byed/ /thams cad gdug pa sbrul gyis brgyan/ /mche ba gcigs shing gad rgyangs can/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang dag bzhugs/ /rang snang shes rab yan lag spyor/ /gnyes med ye shes rang bzhin can/ /mche ba rnam gcigs 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /rang rang phyag mtshan thod pa can/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i grwa bzhi ru/ /de bzhin lha mo zla bar bzhugs/ /shar lhor 1dza dang 'khor lo las/ /lha mo rdo rje tsartsi 2ka /dkar mo skem zhing drag mo che/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed gzugs ma/ /lho nub dag tu rdo rje sa/ /las skyes rdo rje phag mo ste/ /drag mo phag gi gdong can nyid/ /zar ma'i me tog dang mtshungs ma/ /nub byang zur du dbyangs can ma/ /dmar mo de dang padmas bskyed/ /rab tu zhi ma phun sum tshogs/ /'dod chags gshin rje mthar byed gzugs/ /byang shar mtshams su dkar mo ste//ljang gu 'jigs byed ra 4las skyes/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed 5byed kyi/ /tshul dang phyag mtshan 'dzin par brtson/ /thams cad g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs//rang rang mtshan ma thod pa can/ /'on kyang rdo rje phag mo dang / /dkar mo bong thung sto 6ba 'phyang / /ṇa yo ni rā las byung ba'i/ /thod pa bzhi ni zur bzhi ru/ /bskyed de ji ltar rang rang sngags/ /gsungs pas blo dang ldan pas dbyung / / tīḥbye7ཿla sogs gsang sngags sgras/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po la bsgul 8nas/ /sprul pa dpag med spro bar bya/ /bla meed sems can don byas nas / /dngos po kun gyi rang lus la/ /khro bo dpa' bo dgod par bya/ /277—/059

dzi na dzika ces bya ba 'dis/ /shar gyi rmongs pa mthar byed ni/ /ra 1yi rtsa bar gnas sna tshogs/ /padma zla ba dag la dgod/ /ratna dhrika ces bya ba 'dis / / lho ra chu skyes nyi ma la/ /phra ma zhes grags spyan drangs nas/ /cho ga yis ni dgod par bya/ /ā ro loka —ces gsang sngags kyis/ /'dod chags gshin rje 'joms pa po/ /nub ra 5chu skyes nyi ma la/ /cho ga ji bzhin dgod par bya/ /pradzñā j-ika gi de nyid kyis/ /phrag dog gshin rje rnam 'jig pa/ /byang gi chu skyes 'od rno bar/ /cho ga bzhin du dgod par bya/ /muṅga dhrika gi 7 de nyid kyis/ /shar sgor chu skyes nyi ma la/ /tho ba gshin rje mthar byed dag/mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bsam/ / daṇḍa dhrika gi gsang sngags kyis/ /lho sgor yang dag bzhugs pa yi/ /dbyug pa dus dgra gdul dka' 'dul/ /sna tshogs padma nyi mar dgod/ /padma dhrika 9nyid 'di yis ni/ /padma gshin rje 'joms mdzad pa/ /nub sgor padma nyi ma la/ /stobs po che ni bsam par bya/ /khaṅga byeka gi de nyid kyis/ /ral gri gshin rje zad mdzad ma—/ /byang du bdud rnams sel ba po/ /sna tshogs padma nyi mar dgod/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i grwa bzhi ru / /de bzhin gzhan yang lha mo bsgom/ /shar lhor lha mo tsartsi ka /drag mo rab tu 'od 'phro ma/ /mo ha ra ti'i gsang sngags kyis/ /sna tshogs chu skyes zla bar bzhugs/ /de nas lho nub rigs kyi yum/ /rdo rje phag mo mkhas pa yis / /dre ṣa ra ti de nyid kyis/ /padma zla bar dgod par bya/ /de nas nub byang mtshams su ni/ / padma zla bar dbyangs can ma/ /rā ga ra ti'i sngags kyis dgod/ /de nas byang shar dkar mo ste/ /badzra ra ti'i gsang sngags kyis/ /zla bar 'di rnams shis pa mtshan—/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni grwa 2 (——/060

bzhi ru/ /de nyid gsum gyi thod pa'o/ /'di ltar 'khor lo dam pa spros/ /bde ba ldan pa brten 1byas nas/ /sngar gyi 'khor lo de nyid du/ /thim par mnyam par gzhag par blta/ /'di ni shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /gshin rje gshed po dmar po yi/ /dkyil 'khor pa yi rang bzhin can/ /mig dang sgu sogs ngo bo ni/ /lha yi mngon par byin gyis brlab/ /kṣiṃ dang 'khor los gti mug bzhin/ /cung zad khro bo'i 2mig dag la/ /blo ldan rdo rje'i mig dgod bya/ /rna bar ddhi dang rdo rje bskyed/ /rdo rje'i snang ba nag por snang / /snar khaṃ 4rin chen las byung ba'i/ /ser sna zhes bya zla ba la/ /rdo rje sna yang de bzhin gzhan/ /lce la re las padma bskyed/ /rdo rje lce ni zla bar gnas/ /'dod chags dang mtshungs rdo rje lus/ /ske skyes ral gri las byung ba/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed ngo bo/ /lus ming bral ba'i zla bar gnas//bhe ba'i steng du saṃ rdo rjes/ /sems kyi rdo rje de bzhin gshegs5/ /sgeg pa'i khro bo'i gzugs can de/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam par dgod/ /'di ni yan lag drug dgod pa/ /mngon shes don bsgrub ched du bshad/ /snying gar rdo rje'i dkyil gnas 6hūṃ/ /rdo rje hūṃ las thugs rdo rje/ /dus dgra'i sku mdog phyag mtshan ldan/ /sngon po 'od zer gsal ba'o/ /mgrin par āḥyig padma'i dbus / /slar yang āḥyig padma las/ /'dod chags dus dgra lta bu'i sgu/ /dpal gsum 7rdo rje rnam par bsam/ /spyi bor oṃ yig 'khor lo'i dbus/ /i yig 'khor los 'od bzang dkar/ /sgu yi rdo rje sgu dbang phyug /sku mdog dag dang phyag mtshan mchog /'di ni de nyid gsung rdo rje/ /mchog bskyed 2tsho(dod/06/

nam mkhar gnas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas mchod la gsang sngags kyis/ /de dag byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ sattha 1ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā ba ātma kolhahaṃ2/oṃ sattha ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā ba ātma kolhahaṃ / oṃ sattha ta thā ga ta kā 4ya badzra swa bhā ba ātma kolha5haṃ/ rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sras bcas spyan drangs mdun bltas nas/ /gang zhig de rnams kyis spros pa'i/ /tsartsi ka sogs kyis gzung 6ba'i/ /zla ba lta bu'i bum pas ni/ /de rnams bkra shis glu la sogs/ /slar yang ca co'i sgra rnams kyis/ /thams cad dang ni bdag nyid la/ /dbang bskur bar ni bsam par bya/ /spyi bor gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bdag nyid spyi bor rdo rje can/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ /bdag nyid mdun bltas khro bo yis/ /bgegs tshar bcad cing bsrungs nas ni//mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs phul nas/ /oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags kyis bkug nas/ oṃ daṇḍa hūṃ zhes pa 'dis bcug la/ oṃ padma baṃ zhes pa 'dis bcings te/ oṃ khaṅga hoḥ zhes pa 'dis dbang du bya'o/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas spyan drangs 'dir bzhugs par/ /bltas te thugs kar zhu byas par/ /rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon —gyur pa/ /rang gi rig ma'i padma yi8/ /ze 'brur zla bas bskyed lha mo'i/ /'khor lo phyag na sna tshogs pa'i / /me tog nyer spyod sogs bzung bas/ /bltas te thugs kar zhu byas pa/ /rdo rje'i / lam nas 'thon —gyur pa/ /sgeg bcas mchod byed de rnams kyis/ /mchod pa glu dbyangs yid 'ong dang / /sna tshogs gar gyi rang bzhin dag /bde ba chen po ster bas mchod/ /a ye kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla 277—/062

ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ / kho bo khyod 1mthong rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spangs2/ /khyod kyis gar mdzad sa stengs dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo/ /chags pas brgyan pa'i khro bo'i 'od/ /gar mdzad khyod nyid ro langs lags/ /sku lus sbom thung dmar po ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sku sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis btud/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ /dhīḥbyeḥgasang sngags dag gis ni/ /khyod ni sa gsum 'khrul pa sel / /rje btsun snying rje'i khro bo lags/ /gar mdzad khyod ni 'jig rten gzigs / /oṃ sattha ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā ba ātma kolha4haṃ/ sgra yi tshogs rnams thams cad ni/ /brag ca lta bur rnam blta zhing / /'khor lo can gyi 'khor lo'i gtso/ /bstod bya de rnams de bzhin nges/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal / /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /khyab bdag chags pa'i chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod / /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mgo bo gsum kyi steng gnas pa/ /āḥyi yi ge las byung dag /padma'i snod ni bskyed nas su/ /27—/063

de 'og me yi dkyil 'khor te/ /gru gsum re 1yig las byung ba/ /de 'og rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ /g.yo zhing sngo ba gzhu lta bu/ /ba dan gyis mtshan yo las byung / /der ni rnam snang la sogs te/ /ming yig dang po las skyes pa/ /rgyu yig la sogs byung ba yi/ /glang chen sha la sogs pa lnga/ /hūṃ skyes rdo rje'i kha chod kyis/ /bkab la de nas bsgom par bya/ /hūṃ skyes rdo rje'i dbyug pa yis / /yang dang yang du dkrugs —bya zhing / /rlung gis bskyod par 'gyur ba'i gre/ /'jig dus bskal pa'i me lta bus/ /bi ra ma sogs go ku sogs/ /de dag zhu bar gyur par bsam/ /de dang reg pa'i khol ba yi/ /khu bar 'di nyid yongs su zhu/ /rdo rje 5rdo rje'i dbyug pa yang / /rang nyid zhun mar lta bu ste / /thams cad dag cing ro gcig 'gyur/ /shin tu dri ma med par blta/ /der ni oṃ yig 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas ye shes tshul can bkug /gsang sngags gzugs kyis bcug nas su/ /bdud rtsi lnga po mchog bltas la/ /de nyid gsum gyis byin brlabs te/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po tshim par bya/ / ljags kyi hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje dkar po bltas nas su/ /de 'od 7sbu gu'i rnam pa yis/ /mnyam par drangs nas de yis kyang / /sna tshogs gnas dang sangs rgyas kun/ /dkyil 'khor pa dang de bzhin gzhan/ /snying gar ye shes 'od zer dgod/ /kun du rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /thog mtha' dbus kyi dbye ba yis/ /'dir yang gcig tu yod min te/ /rdul phran la ni cha med phyir/ /du mar yang ni grub pa min/ /gabyug dang du ma'i rang bzhin du / /gang zhig bral te de bzhin no/ /'khrul pa'i ngo bo de nyid yin/ /gang phyir 'khrul pa gnyis la gnas/ /sems ni rtag tu 'khrul pa med/ /spro 27—/06 /

ba dag ni sdud pa'i lus/ /sems can don du ro gcig byung / /'di las gzhan du de nyid min/ /ye shes zhabs sogs dpa' bo yis/ /'di nyid kho na gsal bar gsungs/ /dpal ldan gsang 'dus las gsungs pa/ /'dir ni cung zad rab tu bstan/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /dngos po med cing bsgom pa med/ /khams med rnam par shes pa'ang rnged/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid kyi gzhi1/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po ste/ /sa med chu dang me med la/ /rlung med nam mkha' yod ma yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'di dag skye zhing rab tu gnas / /dngos po thams cad dngos min zhes/ /des na dngos po med par grags/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor pa nyid 'byel/ /rtag pa ma yin chad pa'ang min/ /phyag min zhal dang sku mdog min/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /dngos kun nges par bden pa min/ /thog ma dbus mtha' spangs pa nyid/ /'di ltar rig bcas 'khor lo mchog /kun du rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /phung po khams su bdag med ma/ /bde ba dam pa'i gzugs can bsgom/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /'gro rnams gshin je mthar byed byas2/ /bkug nas de ru gnas bltas te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje dang ba dang ni chos/ /ye shes pa ni ya skyes dgod/ /de la de rnams rang sa bon/ /ye shes dhīḥbyeḥsogs 'od gsal/ /lta zhing kun rtog ma lus spangs/ /bde ba dam pa'i rnam pa ni/ /'phro zhing sdud pa yongs su rdzogs/ /bdag nyid mkhas pas bzlas par bya/ /sgu sogs spro zhing gzhug pa ni/ /rim pa bzhin nam cig car bya/ /khro bo'i tshogs rnams sprul pa ni/ /24—/065

nam mkha'i dkyil rnams ma lus khyab/ /sems can don ni phun sum byas/ /dīḥbyeḥl sogs 'gro la sgrogs/ /dīḥl sogs pa'i sngags zlos te/ /oṃ dang swā hās dang mthar brgyan/ /cho ga 'di dag kho na yis/ /rnam pa kun du bsgom zhing bzlas/ /gzhan yang zas kyi bya ba la1/ /sogs pa bya phyir ldang 'dod na/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas nas/ /sems can don la sems pa yis/ /de nyid gsum gyi cho ga bzhin/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs gsol te/ /cho ga ji bzhin bdag nyid la/ /bdag nyid 'khor lo bstems nas ni/ /rang gis bsags pa'i bsod nams dag /byang chub tu ni yongs bsngo zhing / /de nas smon lam gdab bya ste/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /'di ni rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /langs nas rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i/ /rnam pa nga rgyal yang dag ldan/ /rnam pa kun du dngos po kun/ /gsang sngags ngo bo de bzhin te/ /gti mug dus dgra'i ngo bor yang / /bsgom par bya zhing gnas par bya/ /thun gzhan du ni 4rnal 'byor bzhin/ /dang po'i rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /ye shes cung zad rjes spyor bas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor las rnal 'byor/ /chen po yang dag ye shes dbang / /gnas pas bshad bzhin cho ga yis/ /thun gcig la yang bsam gtan 'di/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rang bzhin gyi/ /rnal 'byor pa yi spro bsdu'i sku/ /ye shes de nyid gsum bdag tshul/ /rang nyid gshin rje mthar byed do/ /dbang bskur cho ga bsgom bya zhing / /khrus bya bza' ba'i dus su ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi cho ga yis / /mchod pa gzhan ni rnam brtags pa/ /bdag nyid dang ni gzhan 24—/066

nyid kyang / /cho ga bzhin du rtag tu mchod/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed kyi/ /rnam par blta bya byang chub brten1/ /bdag gzhan mnyam pa byang chub ste/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i rnal 'byor las/ /min na ji ltar rnal 'byor pa/ /dngos grub bla na med par 'gyur/ /ji ltar rnam pa sna tshogs su/ /brtags 2pas dngos po gcig nyid ni/ /grol ba sdug bsngal bde bar snang / /las kyi dbye bas skye bar 'gyur/ /rnam par mi rtog bdag nyid sems/ /bde ba dam pa'i mtha' yi gzugs/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin ni/ /dus dgra zhes bya gang las 'bras/ /'khor ba'i chu bo sin dhu skye 'chi rba klong dang bcas zab cing 'jigs pa chags sdang sogs/ /chu srin na kras 'khrugs shing shin tu mi brtan gnyid rmugs la sogs dbu ba can sgrol ba/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dmar bde ba'i rang bzhin srid bral sgrub —thabs skye bo kun phyir byas/ /bdag gi bsod nams gang thob des 'dir de yi go 'phang 'jig rten don kun grub par shog /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar bo'i sgrub thabs/ paṇḍi ta chen po rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug phyag rgya chen po grub pa/ grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i slob dpon 5dpal 'dzin gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta slob dpon chen po rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba chag 6dge slong chos rje dpal gyis gus pas mnyan nas/mang yul gyi bzo gnas chen por bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'opa // //24—/067

0931༄/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ya mā ri rakta maṇḍa lo pa yi kā/ bod skad du/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab thabs kyis bdag nyid dpal/ /gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor gtso/ /de la btud de dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga mdor bsdus dran phyir brjod/ /dang po tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang ldan zhing 'gro ba 'don pa'i bsam pa can gyi rnal 'byor pas bdag nyid grub pa'i phyir ram/ gzhan gyis lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa de rjes su gzung 2ba'i phyir/ gal te dkyil 'khor bri bar 'dod na/de'i tshe rnal 'byor bzhi sngon du 'gro bas sngon du bsnyen pa byas te/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sngags 'bum bzlas shing / gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i khri bzlas pa'am/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su gnang 24—/070

ba'i mtshan ma thob pa'am/ rang gi sems dag pas brtan par byas pas bri bar bya'o/ /de la cho ga bzhin du bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 1khang par dkyil 'khor gyi 'dus byas la/ gtor ma phul la/ mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dang grogs dang thuldan pas/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i bdag nyid kyis/ oṃ bhu /—khaṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis nam mkha'i rang bzhin du byas la/ hūṃ lo hūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis nor 'dzin rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ oṃ me di bee badzre bha ba badzra bandha hūṃ zhes pas byin kyis brlab bo/ /rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sa gzhi der gshin rje gshed dmar po'i ngo bo phyag na rdo rje dang / dril bu 'gying bas bsnams pa la slob ma gti mug 5gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa lag na rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pa bzhis gsol ba gdab par bya ste/gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rab gsal bas/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khrod/ /khyab bdag 'dod chags chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun kyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun 24—1071

rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /sdig pa thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /mgon po dkyil 'khor bri bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyis 1dbyangs gcig gis gsol ba btab par rig nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dag 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas gzir ba la bltas te/ nyon mongs pa la slar khro bas hūṃ badzra u tiṣṭha zhes pa'i sngags kyis rang gi 'khor lo bteg la/ rnal 'byor pas yi ge mas mig g.yon pa zla ba dang / yi ge ṭas mig g.yas pa nyi mar byas pas phyogs thams cad du gsal bar byas nas 'jig rten gsum la gsal bar blta zhing / rkang pa'i 'og tu rdo rje 'bar ba bsgoms la rdo rje gsor ba dang dril bu dkrol bar brtson pas rol pa'i rdo rje'i 4'gros kyi gar kyis 'khor lo'i sa gzhi 'ubaskor bar bya ste/ dhīḥsgoḥl sogs pa ngag tu sgrogs pas gdug pa'i lha la sogs pa mtha' dag dang /bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams bskrad par byas te/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo spyor ba po/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni 'bar ba yi/ /lus gsum las skyes dgas par byas/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'jig par 'gyur gyis gzhan du min/ /rdo rje'i gnas su 'khor lo dang / /rin chen 6dang padma dang / ral gri bcug la bklag hūṃpar bya'o/ /sa yongs su bzung ba'i mjug thogs su bgegs med par bya ba'i phyir phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /de la phur bus gdab pa'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sattha dubyen 9phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya sattha pā paṃ 7phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ 24—1072
