༄/ /gshin rje'i dgra dmar po'i grub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ rakta ya mā ri sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/gshin rje'i 2dgra dmar po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ yig dmar po 'bar ba las 4rnge 'bar bar blta 5ste/ de'i steng du aḥyig gis gser gyi bum pa'i snod chen po'o/ /de'i nang du go ku da ha na bee ra shu ma mu/ de rnams thams cad 'o ma'i rang bzhin ltar rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su snod kyi shar du glang po che 6la zhon pa'i dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'o/ /lhor ma te la zhon pa'i gshin rje dbyug pa 'chang ba'o/ /nub tu chu srin la zhon pa'i chu lha zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du gter la zhon pa'i lus ngan po 7phyag na na ku li dang bi dza pū ra can no/ /sker ra la zhon pa'i me lha phyag na phreng ba can no/ /bden bral du srin po ro la zhon pa ral gri 'debs pa'i phyag can no/ /rlung du ri dwags la zhon pa'i rlung 24dod1197

lha rlung dar 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du glang la zhon pa'i 1dbang phyug rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa can no/ /dbus su tshangs pa'o/ /de'i mdun du zla ba'i lha phyag na ku mu da 2can no/ /rgyab tu nyi ma phyag na padma can no/ /g.yas su sa'i lha mo dam bca' la mngon par phyogs pas bzhugs 4pa'o/ /g.yon du thags 5bzangs ris gzhon nu'o/ /de ltar yongs su bskor nas bzhugs pa'i 6'byung po'i tshogs ma lus pa skad cig gis stong pa nyid las sems can rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje'i dgra'i skur dmigs te de rnams kyi ljags la rdo rje nas 'bru tsam bsgoms te de rnams la gtor ma nye bar dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar sngon gyi sa bon las bskyed pa'i nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ yig dmar po las skyes pa'i mi mgo rlon pas 7mtshan pa'i dbyug tho nges par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig dmar po bsam par bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i rdo rje hūṃ yig yongs su gyur par bsams par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsang bar 'dab ma brgyad pa'i padma la i yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa'o/ /de'i rjes su sngags brjod par bya ste/ oṃ sasgo ta thā ga ta rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā 8ba ātma kolhahaṃ/de'i rjes su lte ba'i 'og der padma dmar bo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du sthāḥyig dmar po 'bar ba bsam par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das zhal gcig phyag gnyis9 / phyag g.yon gyis thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang / g.yas kyis mi mgos mtshan pa'i dbyug to dkar rkapo 'chang ba/ ma hirṣa'i — steng du sna tshogs padma la bzhugs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /shes rab ma dga' bas stsos pa thod pa skam pos mgul pa brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ bcom ldan 24dod/ /98

'das dang lhan cig spyor bas bzhugs pa/ de lta bur gyur pa'i gshin rje'i dgra thun gsum mam bzhir bsgom/ gtor ma sbyin no/ /bye māṃ bye 1khaṃ hūṃ zhes pas dam tshig byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ibye ya dhīḥ ya ma ya byeḥb ru ṇa ya bi/ ku be rā ya kṛ/ spyi sha 4nā ya ta / akta ye a/ nai ṛ bye na/bā ya bee na/ tsand+ra ya hūṃ/ a kā ya hūṃ5/ bradma khye ya phaṭa/ ba su dha 6rā ya phaṭa/ be ma tsi tra rte swā/ sarba bhū 7te bhyo hā/ ṭwāṃ hūṃ dīḥ8/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phe phe phe/ swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /gang cung zad za ba de thams cad gshin rje'i dgra la dbul bar bya'o/ /slob dpon chen po blo bzang snying po zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje'i dgra 9dmar po'i sgrub thabs sdogs so// //lha'i skad la legs par zhugs pa'i shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa dpal thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang du bsgrubs pa'o7/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po yon tan 'byung gnas sgrub thabs chos rgya gar dpe 'di bod kyis mi rtogs pas/ /dam pa se tsa'i rig 'dzin skad gnyis pa/ /chos kyi bzang po'i dpe las gus par 1 bsgyur/ /sa'i steng na nyi zla ltar gyur cig/ //24—/199

༄/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i byegs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/1༄rga/ /rgya gar skad du/ rakta ya mānta naka nibeen na yo nā ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la re zhig dang por bdag gis sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar po'i go 'phang la dgod pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po bsgom par bya'o snyam du bsams la/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyis basbus pa'i chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur stong pa nyid ro gcig par bltas te/ stong pa nyid la rab tu thim pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad bden brdzun gyi mtshan ma'i rnam pa thams cad dang bral zhing cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgo ma par bya'o/ /de'i ngang las skad cig gis ji ltar blos phyogs pa'i rgya chen por bar mtshams med cing snying po gcig tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi 'bar ba dang / de'i steng du rab 24—/201

tu mkhregs pa dum 1bu gcig tu gyur pa'i sra zhing 'bar ba'i rdo rje ra ba dang /de'i steng du bar mtshams med par gcig tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i mda'i dra ba dang /de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla re dang / de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gur 'bar ba dang /de'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa ser po g.yas su shin tu drag por 2'khor ba rtsibs kyi rtse mo la nye bar gnas pa'i shin tu 'jigs pa'i khro mo bcu dang bcas pa'i lte ba'i nang du/ rlung dang me dang / chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor 4dang /ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs mtsho skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i ma he dmar nag shin tu khros pa rus rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rgyab tu/gshin rje yab yum zhabs g.yas bskum pa/ g.yon brkyang bas mnan pa'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i 5'od can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na khams gsum rnam par 'joms pa'i dbyug to 6dkar po bsnams 7pa/ phyag g.yon na bdud ma lus pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i — rnam pa can/ mi mgo lnga'i phreng bas dpral bar brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang / klu brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan pa/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba mgul par 'phyang ba / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa/ sma ra dmar skya dbu skra dmar ser gyen la badzees / pa/ thung zhing sgom pa/ gsus pa che ba nyi ma lta bu'i spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal khro gnyer can mche ba gadzigs pa/zhal cung zad gdangs pa/ khro bo'i tshul gyis bzhad pa'i zhal/ ljags bsgyur ba/ yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud 1pa/ lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ phyag g.yon na gdug pa bdud 24—1202

kyi khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas na rdo rje gri gug 'dzin pa/mgo bo skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba mgul par 'phyang ba/ de las /gzhan yab nyid 'dra ba can bsgom par bya'o/ /de la sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar gyi 'dab ma la nyi ma la gnas pa'i gti mug gshin rje gshed sgu mdog dkar ngo/ / rdo rje tsartsi ka nag mo 3la 'khyud pa/ lho'i padma'i 'dab ma la nyi ma la gnas pa'i phra ma gshin rje gshed sku mdog ser po rdo rje phag mo ser mo la 'khyud nga/ / nub kyi padma'i 'dab ma la nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dbyangs can ma dkar mo la 'khyud pa/ byang gi padma'i 'dab ma la nyi ma la gnas pa'i phrag dog gshin rje gshed sgu mdog ljang gu lha mo go rī ljang gu la 'khyud pa'o/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i dpa' bo bzhi ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rnams na rim pa bzhin 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / padma dang / ral gri 'dzin pa/phyag g.yon thams cad khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de las gzhan thams cad gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /rdo rje tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i dpa' mo bzhi ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug /g.yon 4khag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan pa5/spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gatshigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /ske'i mtshams kyi padma'i 'dab ma la/ mu men gser chab kyi bum pa/ tsa tu ra sa ma yas gang ba/ bden bral gyi mtshams kyi padma'i 'dab ma la gser gyi bum pa ka to 6ris gang ba/ rlung gi mtshams kyi padma'i 'dab ma la byi ru'i bum pa si hlas gang ba/ dbang ldan kyi mtshams kyi padma'i 'dab ma la dngul gyi bum pa ga 24—/203

bur gyis gang ba/ bum pa bzhi ka'ang 1kha thod pas bcad pa bsgom par bya'o//bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang nyid lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i dbyug to dkar po'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge hūṃ dmar pos mtshan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de la bcom ldan 'das nyid la ni mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa bzhi la ni go rims bzhin du 4rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i snying po ni/ oṃ sthāḥbyeḥblu kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/zhes pa'o/ /de ltar bshad par gyur mod kyang / /phun tshogs sku ni dpag rnged de/ /chu yi gter las chu 'dzin gyis/ /chu blangs zad par mi 'gyur bzhin / /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 5rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/mkhas pa chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //34—/204

bsdur mchan/12༷1 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉non /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba baX/gas so// me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉parnya/12༷2 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar du 'khrigs pas bum/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngang ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa'akhor/ ge〈〈co 〉〉byed pa'i/ ༅〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tho/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snams/ tshonya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo'i/ (〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dzes/ /tshe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcung / ye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rimakhyud/12༷3 lha 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ tshoge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ri ljang / tshome〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ge 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapa/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto/12༷4 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayang / tshoge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tho/ ci ci 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyod/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wadu/ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/bsdur 'bras re'u migasgronirngad/ (81/༷)24wa 1205

༄/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i man ngagasi 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī rakta ya mā ri dzī baṃ tatta u pa de sha nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i man ngag /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag cing dri med bdud bzhi 'joms/ /dpa' bo gshin rje gshed btud de/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed rgyud las/ /sbas pa bla ma'i lung gis 2bshad/ /phyi dang nang dang gzhan rnams kyis/ /dus dgra'i tshul 'di shes bya ste/ /lho phyogs sa 'og rim pa bdun/ /sgo rnged mun khung bcu drug gnas / /chos kyi rgyal po'i las kyi 'khor/ /bye ba 'bum bcas gshin rje ste/ / grub pa'i 4dngos grub phun sum tshogs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis nyi ma'i mdog ltar gsal//ma te la bzhugs de yi gshed yin te/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi gtsug gis mchod/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i skye bo gang / /log par ltung ba gshin 27(—/206

rje yin/ /snying rjes bstan la gzhug pa'i phyir/ /tshar gcod pa ni gshed yin no / /kā 2li ya ste ā li ma/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa gshin rje ste/ /kun 'dar 2ma ni dbus gnas su/ /gang zhig gnyis su med de gshed/ /nyi ma zla ba'i lam gnyis por/ /'gro ba gang yin gshin rje ste/ /de yang dbus su gang gnas pa/ /ye shes de ni gshed yin no/ /mnan pa'i snying gi dbus song rtsa/ /nyon mongs ngo bo nyid yin no/ /srid pa'i rtsa ba gshin rjer bshad/ /rnal 'byor pa la tshul de nyid/ /yang dag ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /de ni de yi gshed yin no/ /gzung ba ya ste 'dzin rtog ma/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i kun rtog ni/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba gshin rje ste/ /a ni rnam par skye ba med/ /ri ni gang yin snying rje'o/ /stong nyid snying rje ro gcig pa/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das te gshed/ /gang zhig lus ngag sems kyi ni/ /snyigs ma gang yin gshin rje ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyis/ / dngos por 4gyur pa gshed yin no/ /mdor na srid pa'i kun rtog tshogs/ /gang yin gshin rje gshed po 5ste/ /rnam par dag pa'i ye shes sgu/ /kun mkhyen pa ni gshed du gsungs / /lte snying mgrin pa spyi bor ni/ /bdud bzhi gnas pa gshin rje ste//mthar byed bzhi ni gshed yin no/ /ya la sogs pa'i yi ge ni/ /ma dag las kyi gshin rje ni/ /mi bzad srid pa'i las kyis bzir6/ /dag pas dpal ldan dus kyi dgra/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol zhing / /dngos grub bde chen mchog ster yin/ /ya ma gnyis su 'dzin pa ste/ /spros sped 'od gsal antar brjod/ /ka yig bla mas bstan pa nyid/ /gshin rje mthar byed ces byar grags/ /'tsho ba zhes bya srog tu brjod/ /'tsho ba'i dbye ba zhes bya ba/ /21—1207

'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i srog /'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa/ /srog gi gsang 'di gang gis shes/ /thams cad grub cing rang dbang 'gyur/ /gzhan yang srid dang zhi ba las/ /srog ni de bzhin gnyis su brjod/ /dngas ma dang ni snyigs ma 1gnas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /bla ma'i thugs su shes bya ste/ /mi phyed brtan pa'i gus pa yis/ /ltos pa med pa'i bsnyen bkur bya/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas3/ /mi 'gyur ba ni srog gi mchog /de las gzhan pa'i bskyod pa yi/ /yig 'bru rnams dang phyag mtshan dang / /phyag rgya snying po la sogs pa/ /rgyal ba sras bcas srog yin te//dad pas thugs dam bskul bar bya/ /stong nyid snying po'i snying rje can/ /rnal 'byor lam pa rnams kyi srog /dngos grub chen po 'dod rnams kyi/ /srog ni dam tshig sdom pa yin/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsgrub bya ba/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das/ /yon tan 'byung gnas srog gcig tu/ /byang chub sems ni kun 'dar brjod/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /byen brlabs 4srog ni mi phyed pa'i/ /gus pas brtan pa med na min/ /de las gzhan pa 'jig rten pa'i/ /'byung po phal che'i srog gi gnas/ /srog dang 'tsho ba dang ni tshe/ /'di rnams dbye bas shes par bya/ /rtsa ba'i srog ni sngon bzhin no/ /sa steng 5'byung po kha cig gi/ /dbugs 5rlung srog tu nges pa yin/ /'byung bo rnams kyi 7rang rang gi/ /bod pa'i sngags dang sa bon dang / /ma ṇi rnams ni 8srog yin no/ /sde tshan bzhi pa'i dang po la/ /mes brgyan dbyangs kyi gsum pas brgyan/ /'byung po rnams kyi srog la gnas/ /de las gzhan pa 'byung po'i srog /kha cig gnas la gnas pa yod/ / zhug shang la sogs 24—/208

gnas pa ni/ /kha cig rdzas la brten te gnas/ /kha cig rang gi grib mar gnas / /kha cig phyi yi 'byung bar gnas/ /nor bu ri rab gos la sogs/ /kha cig sman dang kha cig dug /kha cig 'a1 ba gzhan gyi gzugs/ /sa steng rta'abyung po rnams kyi srog /bdag gi rtsa la gnas pa yin/ /de la sogs pa du ma yis/ /srog gi dbye ba sna tshogs pa/ /'di ru brjod par mi nus so/ /mi rnams kyi ni srog gyur pa/ /ming dang ming yin dang po dang / /rnam par shes pa tshe gzugs yin/ /gza' dang rgyu skar la sogs pa/ /mdor na brtan g.yo ma lus pa'i/ /srog ni phyi dang nang du gnas/ /rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste / /'khor bar gnas pa rnams kyi srog /stong nyid snying rje mi 'gyur bde/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i srog /srid pa dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtsa yi bdag nyid lus la gnas/ /lte ba mgrin snying spyi bo la/ /rlung me chu sa zhes bya ba / /phrag dog zhe sdang chags dang rmongs/ /lus ngag yid gsum mi phyed gnas / /bdud bzhi po ni rnam par gnas/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung lam dang 'gog /bden pa bzhi yi ngo bo nyid/ /rgyu mthun rnam smin skyes bu can/ /dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu bzhi/ /srid pa'i skye gnas bzhi po dang / /e waṃ ma ya 4yi ge bzhi/ /de bzhin ya ma rā dza bzhi/ /spyan dang mā ma gos dkar sgrol//yum bzhi pho ni 5rnam pa ste/ /gshin rje shes rab padma dang / /bgegs zhes bya ba mthar byed bzhi/ /tshad med bzhi dang mthar byed bzhi/ /dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig bzhi/ /dam tshig las chos phyag rgya che/ /phyag rgya che yi rang bzhin no/ /rigs 6bzhi ye shes bzhi yi dngos/ /sku bzhi ye shes bzhi dang ldan / /khams gsum la sogs thams cad kyi/ /bdag nyid chen po rdo rje 24—/209

'dzin / /bdud kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/ /de phyir gsang ba bshad par bya/ /ā li kā li'i sbyor ba yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum bsrung bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal bas/ /ā li kā li rab brjod pas/ /spyi gtsug nas ni rkang mthil bar/ /shes rab thabs kyis bskor 1phyogs su/ /mi phyed par ni bcing bar bya/ /ā li kā li rtsa gnyis po/ /thabs dang shes rab yi ges bsrung / /gnyis med rtsa ni rdo rjes 2bsrung / /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid do/ /rang gi gsang sngags rgyal po la/ /shes rab thabs kyi ye shes mchog /thog ma nas ni mtha' ru sbyar/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa spyor ba yi / /hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yis/ /rang gi gsang sngags brtan par 'gyur/ /rang ming rigs kyi yi ge dag /ya dang ma yi nang bcug ste/ /ā 4li kā li gnyis med pa'i/ /za ma tog gi nang son la/ /lto 5ba'i chu skyes 'og tu sba/ /brgya byin gyis kyang mi tshugs na/ /sha za phra mo smos ci dgos/ /thabs dang shes rab ro gcig pa/ /rnam par mi rtog bde ba che/ /'od gsal ting 'dzin mchog gi ni/ /lhag pa'i bsrung ba gzhan med do/ /sa bcu 6pas kyang mi phyed do / /a ā/ i yī/ u u/ ṛ dzā/ '-i lho/ e e/ o au/ saṃ a7ཿ / oṃ a ra pa tsa sum̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza pta nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bhā ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ8 /shes rab yi ges 'jig rten dang / /'das pa'i bsgrub bya dbang du 'gyur/ /rtag tu sgrub 9pa po rnams la/ /thabs kyi yi ge brtan par 'gyur/ /yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /lhag pa'i lha ni mnyes par bya/ /bla ma'i man ngag rjes 'brang 'di/ /blo ldan slob mas bsgul ba'i phyir/ /me long ltar gsal 7 27(—/210

byas pa la/ /bla ma lhar bcas bzod mdzad rigs/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal gyur cig /dpal gshin rje gshed kyi 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba/ rgya gar kyi paṇḍi ta darbaṇa ā tsārya'i 1zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dngos grub brnyes pa darbaṇa ā bye tsārya de nyid dang / glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mkhar nyi zungs 4su bsgyur byung zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/12༷6 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing/ 〈〈pe 〉〉to /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i man ngag bzhugs so/ / —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ras/ ༄〈〈snar 〉〉yi ba'i/12༷7 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodangs par/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rjer bshad pa/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazir/12༷8 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanar/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlab/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodabus/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhugs shing /12༷9 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stonas/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ga yi/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉reg121༷ rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpor/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgronas/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tog re〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsol/1211 1〈〈pe 〉〉dhar paṇa ā tsarya'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dhar pan ā tsarya'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhar paṇa a/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazungs/

༄/ /gshin rje mthar byed dmar po'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/1༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ rakta ya ma a ri de sha pa a byeṣṭha na/bod skad du/ gshin rje mthar byed dmar po'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/khams gsum po ni ma lus pa/ /snying rjes chags pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bde chen gshin rje gshed po la/ /btud de 'dir ni byin brlab bshad/ /de la 'dir ni rim pa 'dis/ /rnal 'byor byang chub 'dod pa yis/ /dad pa chen po brtan par byas / /bla ma'i kha las shes par bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gsang sngags dang / /bla ma bkur dang mkha' 'go bsnyen/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i rdo rje la/ /mchod sogs las su rung bar bya/ /maṇḍal la sogs yo byad dang / /bum pa dkyil 'khor gsang sngags bri/ /lha yi gzugs brnyan gsal ba dang / /bzlas dang mchod sogs sngon 4'gro bas/ /bgegs sbyang gsol ba gdab pa dang / /dam tshig gzung dang sems bskyed bya/ /oṃ badzra yo ga 24—12/3

tsitta utyā 1da yā mi su ra ta sa ma ya ste haṃ / siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nyid gsum gyi skad cig la/ /lus sogs ye shes gsum du bya/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i man ngag gis/ /rang nyid ye shes dran pa dang / /rdo rje sgra ni brjod par bya / /cho ga las byung chu sogs lnga'i/ /ji bzhin dbang ni sbyin byas la/ /'dod na rang snying pad 'dab la/ /yi ge lnga ni dgod par bya/ /hūṃ rgyu slo dzī khaṃ / kha dog lnga yi 'od zer gyis/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yi/ /sangs rgyas la sogs yon tan tshogs/ /'od ni gsal bas yang dang yang / /bkug nas spro dang brtan par bya/ /rdo rje rnams dang dbyer med pa/ /skad cig nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /oṃ dīḥbyeḥli kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags rgyal po bris pa yi4/ /maṇḍal byen la 'di skad do/ /gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag mchog /'od gsal srid gsum kun gyi gzhi/ /shin tu bde ba'i bde ba ste / /sems kyis yid ni de ltar blta/ /bsdus te dmar pos thig le bya/ /bla ma'i man ngag gi rjes 'go/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i bzlas pa'ang sbyin/ /bu ga'i spyor ba dam pa yis/ /yid ni bde ba can du 'phang / /de ltar rten dang brten red par/ /gang la gang gis bdag 'dzin med/ /gdod nas skye ba med pa yi/ /skye sogs spros las 'das pas na/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med pas/ /zung 'jug 'od gsal bde chen nyid/ /bde bas bde ba rtogs tshopa'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ye shes che/ /gang na btsal yang mi rnyed de/ /bla ma mnyes thabs kha las so/ /de ni rtogs pa tsam gyis ni/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'ching ba kun spangs rnam grol gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum na mnyam pa spangs/ /'di ni bla ma tsho(——/2/ /

—sashin rje'i dgrar gyur pas/ /bdag la rjes su bzung 1 bas dngos grub thob/ /nge don gzhan la'ang sbyin phyir yi ge ru/ /bris la bla ma mkha' 'gro bzod par rme/dzod / /phod la ma yin man ngag med la min/ /shin tu gces pas phangs nga sa/ phangs par bya/ /de ltar bla ma'i drin las zab mo gsal phye bas/ /'gro kun lhan byug skyes dga' bde ba'i gtso/ /kun khyab bde gsal mi rtog ye shes zung 'jug sku/ /thob nas bde bas bde la rnam rol dgyes par shog /sashin rje mthar byed dmar po'i 2byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa grub thob kyi 'khor 'o/sa/ sgyur ba bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po darbaṇa —ā tsārya dang / glo bo lo tsā 5 ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur ba'o// //kyi bsdur mchan/1212/ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma/tshan bod ska da du sgos nga/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /sashin rje ma/thar byed dmar po'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rim nga bzhugs so// 〈〈nge 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas te/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngog1 she14 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dzisto rpā/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ 〈〈pe 〉〉rja tsho dzi/ 〈〈sne ra 〉〉rgyu e dzing / ca 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dzra sa/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sde/ 6 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtog 8 〈〈pe 〉〉tsam /1215 rta 〈〈snar 〉thazung / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nga/sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgyur/ 4 〈〈nge 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhar nga/ṇa 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉7bod du 'gyur ba'i byin rlabs kyi bga' 'a 'di las zab pa tshang ba byin brlabs che ba/ mnyan pa/ brgyud pa dang ldan nga/ med nga/sa/ su thod thod la ma byin/ bsnyen pa yongs su ma rdzogs na mkha' 'gro ma'i bakha' chad 'ong bas shin tu ma/nyan/ rjenu sanang ma thob pa/ra dpe'ang ma ston a 'es bla ma/ rgya sar shar phyogs nga/ gsu/nga / sku sasu/nga thusas kyi rgya// //

༄/ /lha mo 'od 'dzin ma'i byin gyis brlab pa/te༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ de wi dha ra pra bhā a byeṣṭha 2na/ bod skad du/lha mo 'od 'dzin ma'i byin gyis brlab pa/ bcom ldan 'das gti mug dga' ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus srid pa'i gti mug rnams/ /mthar byed ma la rab btud nas/ /spros med bdud rtsi za ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis byin brlab bshad/ /maṇḍal la sogs sta gon te4/ /bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod gtor dang / /'khor lo tshogs kyis mnyes byas la/ /yon bcas dad pa'i slob ma la/ /sdom pa byen la dam la gzhag5 /de nas 'dun pa drag po yis / /bla ma la ni gsol ba gdab/ /padma'i dbus gnas zla ba la/ /oṃ skyes lha mo mnyam bzhengs dkar/ /chu shel gri gug padma'i snod/ /thugs kar 'dzin pa rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'od dkar 'phro 'du shel lta bu/ /de lta'i 6gnyis ka gsal byas nas/ /bla ma'i snying gar ji bzhin gyi/ /lha mo 'thon te 24—/217

snying gar gzhug /de yi brang dkyil oṃ skyes pa/ /gri gug as mtshan thod nang du / /phyed nub tsam du bsam par bya/ /de yi 'od kyis khams gsum gyi/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khri ba kun bcad do1/ /bdag med shes rab dam pa yis /sangs rgyas mchod de de rnams kyis/ /stong nyid ye shes bkug la bstem/ /thod pa'i 'od kyis srid gsum gyi2/ /'dzin pa'i duḥkha kun bsal te/ /zag med bde bar gshegs pa 4mchod/ /mi rtog bde chen ye shes mchog /bkug la gnyis su med par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bde stong gi/ /ye/ shes zung 'jug rmad byung gis/ /bdud rtsis lus gang brtan g.yo yi/ /bcud bsdus ngo bor bsam 5byas la/ /bla ma'i ting 'dzin nus pas dbab/ /oṃ dhīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ a mo ha ra ti ā gatstsha ya ā gatstsha ya hūṃ hūṃ dza dza tshodza ya/ a ā/ i khra/ u u/ ṛ dṛ/ lo shā7/ e i /o au/ i aḥ / 'phar dang g.ya' dang dgod pa dang / /bde stong nyams/ ni skye bar 'gyur/ /ji srid bran du khas blangs nas/ /yon phul mnyes pas/ dam tshig bzhin/ /bla ma bsten la rta0brtson par bya/ /bla ma blo mi bde ba yi / /slob ma'i dngos grub 'dod pa ni/ /chur shes smig rgyu ji bzhin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len gyi byen rlabs rka grub thob kyi bdag po mkhas pa chen po dpal 'dzin kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de ba ā ka ra dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos/ bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta darbaṇa ā tsārya rka5dang lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa zhe sdang rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te slar dag par byas so/ /snga 'gyur la 'di bas tshan che tsam gda'o gsung ngo // //2( —— /2/8

༄khya/ /'od 'dzeen ma sgrub pa'i thabs/she—༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra bha wa dha ri sā — dha dzwa/ bod skad du/'od 'dzin ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ bdud rtsi'i mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 4kha zas nyung ba yis 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis ngos 5na/ / som nyi bza' 6bar bya ba'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len bshad/ /gsum la skyabs song byang chub sems/ /gnas bzhi la sogs sngon song bas/ /skad cig nyid las yul rnams dang / /yul can stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /paṃ las mtsho skyes dbus son pa'i/ /nyi ma'i dbus su lha mo ni/ /chu shel lta bu gri gug dang / /bdud rtsi'i 7bum pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /dar dkar gos dang rin chen rgyan/ /lang tsho rgyas shing sha rgyas ma/ /li ba'i skra dang bung ba'i dri/ /mdzes ldan ma yi brang dbus su/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i lha mo ni/ /dngas pa'i shel drung mu tig ltar/ /dkar 24—1220

zhing 'tsher ba'i 'od can blta/ /de nas rang snying shing 'bras ltar/ /rtse mo gyen ltar rtsa lta hūṃdang / /bcas pa phyed nas mtshon kyis gcad/ /steng gi phyogs ni sangs rgyas lha'ikhye/ /rtsa dang bcas te ltos med dbul/ /nyon mongs lha yi 7 rtsa sbubs nas/ /dri ma ma lus bshang lam nas/ /'thon te rgya mtsho'i ngogs su bskur/ /rtsa stong bum pa'i bdud rtsis bkang / /lus dang rtsa dang khams bdud rtsi/ /ye shes rgyal po'i rlung rgyas te/ /phru hūṃm mar gyis gang ba ltar/ /rang gi lus dang de bzhin sems/ /zag med bde bas rab rgyas te//dmigs shing spros pa bcad pa yisasnye/ /ting nge 'dzin la gtad de gzhag /de ltar yang yang goms bye 7pa yis/ /ting 'dzin zas su mi 'gyur ba'i/ /srin bu kun yang 'dzag 'gyur bas/ /de don bya phyir gsang sngags dang / /smon lam che la 'bad par bya/ /de ltar brten 7na zag med kyi/ /ting 'dzin mchog ni skye ba dang / /gnyid rmugs la sogs byed pa'i zas/ /til tsam dgos par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /skra dkar gnyer ma spong ba dang / /lus rgyas dngas shing sha stobs rgyas/ /thig le rgyas shing 'dzag 3mi 'gyur/ /dus min 'chi bas mi gos te/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro bran du 'gyur/ /'dre sogs gnod par mi 'gyur zhing / /'gro kun dga' zhing dbang du 'gyur/ /ci 'dod dam pa'i mchog ster te/ /'dod sred ma lus rab bcad nas/ /dus kyi dgrar ni myur 'gro'o/ /de ltar bla mas gnang ba yi/ /man ngag gsal la nongs mchis rnams—/ /bzod par gnang zhing de yi ni/ /dge bas gshin rje gshed gyur cig9 /'od 'chang ma'i sgrub thabs ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len gyi man ngag nying nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pa dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—1221

༄/ /rang gi sems gong du 'pho ba'i man ngag byin brlab dang bcas pa 1༄7/ /rang gi sems gong du 'pho ba'i man ngag byin brlab dang bcas pa/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros pa chen po zhe sdang gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor gang la phyi dang ni/ /nang gi 'chi ltas brtag bya ste/ /nges par 'chi 'gyur rlung las te/ /gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs/ /g.yas g.yon rlung ni ma 'gyur na/ /nang gi rtsa dang rlung thig le/ /las mi rung bas 'chi /ltas su/ / rtogs nas slu 4ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ /g.yas nas lnga dang g.yon nas gcig /skyong 5dang sdud pa'i khyad par ro/ /glo g.yas sa la phab byas nas/ /brla g.yon steng du rkang g.yas gzhag /g.yon gye rkang mgo sgyid par sbrel/ /lag g.yon nu mnyes 6mchan khung gzhug /lus ljid 7dpung pa g.yas la bsgur/ /dpung pa g.yas pas kha gcus la/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pas bslu bar bya/ /des kyang 'pho bar ma gyur tshe/ /rngubs la mthe chung g.yas kyis bkag /g.yon nas 'gro 27 —/223

'ong bya ba deng / /rlung bcing man ngag dam lkupa'o/ /'khrul 'khor bzlog ste bya ba ni/ /g.yon nas 'pho bar ma 3bhe'adod na'o/ /de ltar phyi dus tshes grangs la / /brtags nas gal te mi 'pho na/ /dus la bab pas rnams shes 'phang / /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan la yang / /zhen pa'i rtsa ba rab bcad nas/ /longs spyod lus dang dge la sogs/ /lha dang bla ma 'gro drug la/ /ltos pa med par mchod sbyin bya/ /lus la chags dang zhen pa ni/ /skad cig tsam yang mi bya'o/ /gnas dang grogs sogs gzhan /med dang / /lhar ni yang dang yang dran pas/ /bla ma 'ba' zhig bsam par bya/ /drag ldan bsam pas skyabs song la/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /dmigs pa'i spyi bor bsgom 4byas nas/ /dbu ma gnyis ni sprad byas la/ /snying dbus hūṃ las sgo rnams bkag /sems rten hūṃ ni yar 'phangs te/ /bla ma'i hūṃ ni snying gar bsnyu/ /'dod tshe 'og tu mi dgug go/ /yang na sgo gzhan bkag rjes la/ /rtsa gnyis thabs shes yi ges dgag /snying dbus dbu mar zla gam hūṃ/ /de steng 5hūṃ ni skar mda' ltar / /'jug pa'i rlung dang sbyar bar bya/ /yang na 'od kyis 'pho ba ste/ /gzhu dbyibs 'khrul 'khor byas cerjes su/ /lte bar rlung bcas zla bar hūṃ/ /snying dbus gong bus bu ga dgag /stobs kyi yi ges sems drangs nas/ /lha yi thugs kar 'phongs 1te bsre/ /gnas gzhan gang du skye 'dod par/ /yi ge gsum gyis drangs te 'phang 7/ /yang na spros med rnal 'byor pa/ /sna tshogs stong pa'i gzugs 'di 9las/ /'od gsal ngang du 'pho ba ste/ /phyag rgya chen po nyid 'gyur ro/ /rang gi sems gong du 'pho ba'i man ngag slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi gdams pa de nyid kyis 7mdzad pa'o/ /24—1224

0949༄khya/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/ 1༄tsho/ /byen gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pas ri dang dur khrod du/ /rim pa gnyis dang bzlas pa dang / /mdun bskyed mchod dang gtor ma sogs/ /phul la bla ma las lung nod/ /rang nyid dpal ldan dmar po'i sgu/ /gong bu nyid du gsal ba yi//n+ya gro dha yi sdong po ni/ /brgya byin gnas su sleb pa'i rtser/ /bla ma lhar blta dbu ma yi/ /sgo ni rab tu dbye bar bya/ /snying gnas hūṃ ni skar mda' bzhin/ /steng gi sgo nas rab 'phangs te/ /rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med de/ /bsre ba gsum ni dran byas nas/ /spros med nyid la sems gzhag bya/ /ye shes chen pos byin rlob 'gyur/ /'pho ba'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa dpal 'dzin chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //2(——/226

rakṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ asne de wa pū dza nā ma/ bod skad du/me'i lha mchod pa zhes bya ba/ ma lus gdug pa'i sems ldan pa/ /bla ma la ni sdang ba sogs/ /gzhom phyir drag byin 4cho ga ni/ /gshin rje 'joms mdzad mchod phyir bshad/ /'bum ni yongs su rdzogs pa nas/ /dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong 'gyur ni5/ /lha dang bla ma mthong gyur na/ /'grub 'gyur gzhan du nyams par 'gyur/ /dus dang thab 7dang rdzas dang ni/ /cho gas bsgrub par bya ba ste/ /rnam dag bzhir ni shes par bya/ /sgrub po bsnyen pa mthar son dus/ /drag pa'i 9stobs dang mig mar 7sogs/ /drag po'i gza' skar rgyu ba'i dus/ /mar ngo'i zla ba'i bcu bzhi sogs/ /drag byed 'byung po rgyu ba'i dus/ /rgyu ni rlung ni rgyu ba'i dus/ /dgun smad mtshan phyed dbyar gyi smad/ /sna bug g.yon nas rlung rgyu'i dus/ /g.yul 'gyed la sogs 24—1228

—sgre bo rnams/ /rab tu 'khrugs tupa'i sems ldan dus/ /'di ni drag po me yi lha / /mchod pa'i rnam dag dus su bshad/ /de nas gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /byang du gnas dang mdog nag dang / /rtsub shing 2tsher ma skye ba dang / /drag po'i lha tshogs gnas pa'i phyogs/ /de ni drag byed rnge yi gnas/ /thab sogs cho ga bshad par bya/ /thab khung gru gsum sor nyi shu/ /zabs su sor bcu ldan pa ste/ /rdo rje dang ni rtse gsum bri/ /zla ba rdo rjes mtshan sna tshogs//rdzas kyi rim pa bshad bya ba/ /rnga mo'i rtug pa rdo thal dang / /me tog nag po tsher ma'i shing / /sor brgyad khrag sbags tsha ba gsum/ /dug khrag ske thutshe lan tshwa 6dang / /dgra yi dri ma la sogs dang / /mar til 'bras so nas sran go/ /drur 7ba ku sha thod par bsre/ /mdog nag gzugs dang rus sbal gzugs/ /zhe sdang so 'cha' rekhro gnyer ldan/ /gdong nag mig ni bgrad tsupa'o/ /dgra bo dgug —dang bral zhing dbye/ /hūṃ ldan ku shas bsang gtor bri11/ /oṃ badzra satwa a/ ku sha bkram la me ni sbar/ /shan pa'am ro bsregs me yis so /oṃ asne dzā la dzā mul ram̐/ me dbus ram̐ las byung ba yi/ /ra nag zhon pa khros pa'i gzugs/ /bgrang phreng ril ba dbyug pa can/ / drang srong 3 nag pos bskor zhing ⑫gnag /de nas dgug cing spyan drangs te/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ e bye hi ma hā bhū kyita de ba ṛ ṣi dī dza dzalteḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ asne kro dha de dza phaṭa/oṃ badzra ni ri muti khaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bye pe phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke phaṭa/ oṃ badzra nee bi bye 19phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shabhe phaṭa / mchod pa'o/ /dzi a ku ru ku ru/ puju/ dhū pa/ dī pa/ ganta/nee bi hye/ shasda / oṃ dang swā hās thog mthar brgyan/ /sbyang ba'o/ /mchu 24—1229

—gnyis ya ra de bzhin du/ /rnge lha'i kha la rab bkod la/ /pus mo'i bar bcug lag pa yi1/ /gsum mam bdun du g.yas nas dbul/ /asne/ sarba pā 2paṃ da ha na/ badzra ya/ badzra pu sha ya/ sarba pā paṃ bha wa te/ a pra ti ha ta ya/ ha bi ka ya/ ma hā ba la/ badzra ghasma ri/ bo bye dṛkṣa ziya/ oṃ dang swā hās thog mthar brgyan/ /oṃ asne de wa ṛ ṣi ma hā te dza gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa/ de nas snying gar lha yi gzugs/ /ji bzhin bskyed la de bzhin mchod / /oṃ ya mānta ka a 5mu ka ta mā ra ya phaṭa/ oṃ dīḥbyeḥwi kṛ tā 6na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ a mu ka mā ra ya phaṭa/7 oṃ badzra bee tā lī8/ a mu ka mā ra ya phaṭa/ dzi na dzika /ratna dhrika /ā ro loka7 /pradzñā j-ika1 /mo ha ra ti/ dzwa ṣa ra ti 2/ rā ga ra ti // badzra ra ti7/ muṅga 1swādhrika /daṇḍa dhrika /padma dhrika /khaṅga dhrika /a mu ka mā 7ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa ni khyad par ro/ /de nas mchod cing bstod de bsdu/ /slar yang lhag mas drang srong mchod / /tshangs mgon mchog gi sras po gzi dang ldan/ /me yi las ster 'jig rten me yi lha/ /'bar ba'i nang na sku brjid rgyan gyis bklubs1 8/ /phyag 'tshal 'dod don byen la khyed 1 brtson mdzod/ /bzod par gsol nas gshegs par bya/ /dngos grub zhu zhing lhag chad bskang / /gsad dang rengs pa la sogs pa/ /ji lta ba yi sbyor bas 'grub/ /de ltar gshin rje gshed dpal mchod pa yis/ /srid gsum nyon mongs bud shing kun bsregs nas/ /'gro ba'i mun sel ye shes lnga 'od 'bar/ /rdo rje me yi go 'phang la gnas shog/dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sreg byed me'i cho ga zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa dpal 'dzin gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //24—/230

༄/ /bdud rtsi byin gyis bachab pa zhes bya ba/1 ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a mṛ ta a byejo 2na nā ma/ bod skad du/bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor gnyis brten nas/ /gshin rje gshed dpal gnyer byed na//de yi bsten bya dam tshig ni/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bshad/ /de la rnal 'byor pas dbeen pa'i gnas ri'i phug gam dur khrod la sogs pa mi'i skye bos dbeen par byas la/ bcud ma nyams pa'i dri chen dang / ghañdzi dang /ba ru ra dang / a ru ra dang / bla ba dang / mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / bu ram dang / so ga'i dus ma yin pa'i dus su 'dus byas pa'i pa ra na dang / legs par sbyar ba'i ril bu u rin dha ba'i snod dang / lwa ba dmar po'i na bza' dang bcas pa sta gon du byas la/ ji skad bshad pa'i rim pa gnyis sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa dang gtor ma'ang phul zhing / slob dpon 24—/233

la yon phul nas 'khod la/ lhan cig skyes dga'i gnyug ma'i bde ba che/ /gnyis med mnyam spyor srid zhi dus kyi dgra/ /dpal ldan phyag 'tshal 'dir ni brtser dgongs nas/ /brtan g.yo 'jig 1mdzad dam tshig mchog stsol mdzod/ /ces lan gsum mo/ /de nas slob dpon gyis ji ltar snang ba'i 'jig rten thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bor shes te rang gi bu byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /snying gar dbu ma'i nang du hūṃ ngo / /phyogs bzhir rgyu dzee dzī 2khaṃ ngo //dbus dang mtshams bzhir mu bi shu ma ra'o/ /kha dog ni rigs dang mthun par ro / /de bzhin du lte ba dang mgrin par yang dgod par bya'o/ /de nas lus kyi 'dug stangs dang rlung ran par bya zhing / snying ga'i yi ge las so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i 'od zer byung nas ma lus pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang phrin las sku lnga'i rnam par bkug ste yi ge lnga la so sor bsdu'o/ /de lta bu'i rim pa kho na ye shes lngas 'byung ba lnga sbyangs shing slar yang yum lnga'i rnam pas bsdu'o/ /de bzhin du lte ba dang mgrin pa las kyang ste/ 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa sbyang ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i 4dus kyi dngos grub basbu ba'i phyir ro/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga ni bsdus te 5ye shes su byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang dus gsum du gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /slar yang 'og gi 'khor lo yi ge dang bcas pa snying ga'i hūṃ la basbu zhing yi ge brgyad kyang bsnyus te/ de'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bo hūṃ cha lnga pa'i rnam pas bstem zhing /oṃ dhīḥbyeḥli kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ pañtsa a mṛ ta yuttha 6ṭa sa ma yā 24—/234

— tibye ba badzra dza 1dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥmuṅga ra tri ha ha ha hūṃ/ spyi bor me tog dang bcas pas brtan par bya ste/ 'dod pa la sogs pa dus gsum gyi dngos grub rigs lnga dang / dpa' mo lnga dang / ye shes lnga la sogs pa'ang brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par shes pa hūṃ 'di'o/ /zhes nges par byas la/dag pa rjes su dran pas rnam par shes pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu'i ngo bo nyid rtag tu chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos shing g.yo ba med pa nyid la sems gnas par byas la4/ bla mas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas tshad med pa'i sems kyis bzlas pa dang gdug pa can rnams bzlog par bya'o/ /de nas yang ji skad gsungs pa'i ril bu'am/ thod pa chang gis bkang ba slob ma la sbyin zhing / dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi las byung ba / /sngags pa 5mchog gis rab bsngags pa/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod la sbyin/ /des kyang blangs te 'thungs pas lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis 6gang ste/zag pa med pa'i bde bas tshim ste/ 'dod pa'i sred pa ma lus pa zad nas bde ba dang rab tu mi rtog pa'i ye shes zung du 'jug pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas rgyun ma chad pas 7gsum mam/ bdun nam thun bzhi la sogs pa ji ltar nus pas brtan par bya ste phan yon ni dpal ldan 'das pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rim pa dang / mthar thug 1rkapa ni dam tshig 'dis bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po nyid mngon du byed pa nyid do zhes bcom ldan 'das nyid las thos so/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal bi rū pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po darbaṇa ā tsārya 5dang / lo tsā ྾ba zhe sdang rdo rjes 24—1235

dang phyir bzlog pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsakra rakṣa a 2byeṣṭha na priṣṭha ya u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ srung —ba'i 'khor lo'i byin brlab 5dang phyir bzlog pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum ro mnyam bde chen po/ /dpal ldan gshin rje 'joms mdzad la/ /btud de de yi phrin 6las ni/ /bsgrub phyir 'khrul 7'khor cho ga bshad/ /bsnyen pa byas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /ji lta'i spyor bas 'khrul 'khor rnams/ /sgrub na de yi byin kyis zlob8/ /blang bya de nas yang nai sgrub/ /dben par maṇḍal sogs byas la/ /rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mchog /mchod dang gtor ma bum pa bzlas/ /spyin sreg de bzhin chos 'byung la/ /phyogs skyong bkod la phyi rol du/ /rnal 'byor gtor ma byin la bsgo / /de nas dang bcas slob ma ni/ /khrus byas thal mo sbyar byas la/ /24—/237

bla ma la ni phyogs par gzhag /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la sogs dang / /sangs rgyas lnga yi sdom pa sbyin/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i las rab 'byams /bsgrub pa'i bsam pa nyer gzhag ste/ /paṃ las byung ba'i padma'i steng / /hūṃ byung dus dgra dmar po bsam/ /snying dang mgrin par ya bsgom pa/ /lte bar re'u mig dgu pa'o/ /oṃ che ge mo'i/ zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang / rengs shing bsad 1pa rnams 'dod pa ltar 'grub pa 2gyis shig swā hā/ dbus su'o/ /dī byeḥwi kṛ tā na na/ g.yas skor gyis phyogs bzhir ro/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ mtshams bzhi la'o/ /bcu gnyis rtsibs ni ser po la/ /kṣe dza ya yig dbus dang g.yas/ /g.yon du dgod 4par bya ba nyid / /lho ru ma yatstsha yig go/ /nub tu yi ge me do na5/ /byang gi gsum la do ru ṇa/ /rtsibs mtshams bkod 6pa'i yi ge ni/ /na yo ni ra lan gsum mo/ /de nas re'u mig phyi ma la/ /oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya rnge do ru ṇa yo da ya/ya da yo ni ra yakṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha ni ra 7ma ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor lo kha sbyar rab dmigs la/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i spyor ba yis/ /rgyal ba'i phrin 8las thams cad dang / /mthu dang yon tan tshogs 9bsdus la/ /snying dang mgrin pa'i 'khor lor —gzhug /slob dpon dmar po'i 'khor lo'ang / /ji ltar me ni me gcig la/ /mar me gcig chad ji bzhin du/ /ma nyams 'phel ba 'phangs pa bzhin/ /slob ma'i snying dang mgrin par glan/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bcu bzhi dang / /rtsa ba'i sngags ni sngon 'gro ba'i/ /yi ge bcu gnyis lung byen la/ /byis shing bsgrub pa byas pa yi/ /'khor lo'i rdzas ni lag byin la / /brtan phyir rdo rje spyi bor gzhag /tiṣṭha badzra tsakra rakṣa sa ma ya mu dra ho/24—/238

brtan dang g.yo ba'i bcud kun las/ /mi bskyod zhi dang dbang byed pa/ /mngon 1spyod dam pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /rab 'byams 27las rnams bsgrub phyir zung / /'di ni ding nas bzung byas te/ /mi 'bral bar ni bya ba'o/ /de ni rjes su gnang ba yi/ /las ni thogs 4med myur ba dang / /lha mnyes pa dang rim gnyis kyi/ /grogs 5kyi dam par 'gyur ba'o/ /gzhan du 'khor lo rtsom pa ni/ /mi mkhas 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /sngar byas dngos grub gang 'dod pa/ /bye phung chu la sogs bzhin no/ /'khrul 'khor gyi byin gyis brlab 6pa'i rim pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor kyi dbang phyug dpal 'dzin chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༈ /de nas yang dag bshad pa ni/ /gsad dang rengs dang bskrad la sogs/ /bya'am gzhan gyis byas kyang rung / /phyir bzlog rim pa'ang gsal bar bya/ /'jigs dang bar chod mtshan ma'am/ /rmi sogs ngan pa byung gyur tshe/ /bzlog pa drug tu bya ba ste/ /rdzas dang sngags dang ting nge 'dzin / /rlung dang mnyam med dag dang ni/ /srung ba med pa'i bsrung ba'o/ /de la re zhig rnal 'byor pas/ /seng ldeng dbyug pa gla rtsi dang / /gi waṃ shu dag gu gul dang / /garnyi 7til dang yungs kar dang / /mu men byi ru si la dang / /tsandan dmar sogs de bzhin du/ /li khri mtshal dkar 'dus byas la/ / srung ba me 8las bcu gsum ltar/ /bskyed la bcu gsum gnas su gzhag /hūṃ kṣe ma me da dza sa do ru yatstsha ni ra9/ snying ga mig dang rna ba sna/ /kha dang lte ba 'og sgo gnyis/ /brla gnyis phrag pa gnyis dang ni/ /de bzhin spyi 21—/239

bo'i gtsug la reg /ji ltar zhe sdang gshed sogs bsgom tsho/ /rdzas rnams brdungs ༄ snate lus la bcad/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug drang srong sogs/ /log par byed pa'i rig sngags kyis/ /nam yang tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ / phyi yo byad rdzas kyis phyir bzlog pa'o/ /shin tu ngan par byed pa yi/ /rig 'dzin la sogs med ④gyur na/ /de bzlog pa yi cho ga ni/ /tshad med sems sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /gsang sngags gsum gyis dag par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa pubhā ba ātma kolhadzihaṃ/ nam mkha'i dkyil du bsam bya ba/ /paṃ re las byung pad nyi'i steng / /sna tshogs rdo rje yongs gyur pa'i/ /srung )ba'i 'khor lo bsgom 8bya ste/ /rtsibs bcu mu khyud lte bar bcas/ /hūṃ 9las byung ba'i gnas bcu la/ /hūṃ byung rgyu dang bsre ba las/ /ji ltar 'byung ba'i khro bo bskyed/ /dbus su rang nyid gshin rje gshed / /mdog gnag khros —pa ma te'i steng / /de ltar bskyed nas cho ga bzhin / /rdo rje gsum du bya ba dang / /gzhug dang bcing sogs legs byas nas / /ṭakki rā dza grangs med pas/ /gnod byed gdung zhing dgug la gzhug/rdo rje'i go gon 1snying ga yi/ /sems dpa'i gnas su bsrung thubya ni/ /dmigs las bzlas te 'khor bas so/ /dus dus gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /gzir ba'i sbyin sreg mtshan phyed na/ /khro bo bcu la spyin par bya/ /phyi'i byad sngags kyis phyir bzlog pa'o/ /24—1240

gal te rnal 'byor lam pa la/ /rtog dang mtshan mas g.yengs tshopa'i byad//de bzlog pa yi rnal 'byor ni/ /rlung gi spyor ba brtsam bya ste/ /u pa tanta dha ra na/ / ḍi ma 1bya gra mu sa la/ /g.yo dang 'jug pa'i rlung bzung 4ste/ /dbu mar rgyu ba ye shes rlung / /kun byed rnam rtog 'joms pa'o/ /nyon mongs las kyi rlung shugs dag /ye shes chen por byed pa ste/ /su yi mthus kyang mi tshugs so/ /nang byad rlung gis phyir bzlog pa'o/ /gdon dang 'jigs dang byad dang nad/ /bar du gcod pa'i chos rnams kun / /phyi rol gyur pa la yin pas/ /phan tshun bsre ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /ji ltar dug la bdud rtsi bzhin/ /bar gcod ye shes chen por bya/ /'dzin 5 sogs rtog pa'i bdud byung na/ /'dzin mkhan rtog pa rang nyid kyang / /pha rol gdon du bsgyur byas la/ /gdon nyid gang yin gdon par 'ubya/ /de ltar rang nyid gnod byed ni/ /lhar blta 7pha rol de bzhin no/ /de nas bla ma dran byas nas/ /ji snyed brtan g.yo lha dang sngags/ /su yis su la gnod byed pa/ /'khrul pa'i mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /'dzin pa kun bshig spros sked kyi/ /ting 'dzin chen po skye bar 'gyur/ /nang gi byad ting nge 'dzin gyis phyir bzlog pa'o/ /mthar thug 9ye shes bdud gyur pa/ /srug bsngal 'khor ba 'dor 'dod dang / /blang bya mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /gnyis su rgyu ba nyid yin no/ /de nyid lam du bya ba yang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gsung bzhin bshad/ /dmyal 24—1241

sogs 'khor ba'ang legs shes na/ /sangs rgyas nyid las ma g.yos te/ /phung po lnga ru gnas phyir ro/ /ye shes lnga ni yin pa'i phyir/ /lus kyi dri chen la sogs lnga/ /bde gshegs lnga nyid bdud rtsi lnga/ /rig ma lngar ni gzhug 1phyir ro/ /rgyal sras brgyad du gnas phyir ro/ /lha mo drug tu gnas phyir ro/ /'jigs byed bcu ni yin phyir ro/ /de ltar thams cad sangs rgyas kyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig rang bzhin la/ /nad 'joms sman la dug bzhin du/ /'ga' zhig 'di la dor byar 'dzin/ /gal te 'khor ba nyid yin yang / /'khor ba thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /skye dang 'gag pa kun kyang spangs / /skad cig rdul gyi cha spangs la/ /yod min med min rnged pa'ang min/ /sgyu ma'i glang po ji bzhin du/ /skye la skye ba yod min pas/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bus sgyu ma yi/ /bud med 'dor ba dag dang mtshungs/ /de ltar bsgoms pas 'khor ba la/ /'dor 'dod ma spangs par yang grol/ /gal te rang nyid bde ba yi/ /zag med dbyings la sems dga' na/ /gnyis med snying rje lhan cig byes/ /zung du 'jug pa bsgom par bya/ /don gnyis 'byor ba'i sangs rgyas ni/ /bdag don kho na ma yin te/ /'bangs rnams bde la mi 'god par/ /rgyal srid rang bde'i phyir bzung na/ /gzhan phung 'jug 4tu bdag kyang phung / /bdag ni til tsam med pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi don gyis ci zhig bya/ /bdag med ye shes lhan skyes kyis/ /bdag sred ma lus rab bcad nas/ /gzhan don kho na'i blo yis ni/ /mi gnas lhan cig skyes dga'i mchog /brjod min cir yang snang ba nyid/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba ni/ /shel la tshon gyi kha dog ltar/ /sna tshogs stong pa'i gzugs nyid ni/ /bde stong gsal zhing mi 24—1242

rtog pa/ /brtan g.yo sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor nyid/ /yongs su khyab pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /spros med byang chub sems su gnas/ /gang du btsal yang mi rnyed de/ /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /lhan cig skyes 1dga' zung 'jug na2/ /gdod nas gnas pa yin phyir ro/ /de ltar shes pas 'khor 'das la/ /blang dor nam mkha'i sprin bzhin du/ /rang bzhin gyis ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /mthar thug ye shes kyi byad rnal 'byor gnyis kyis phyir bzlog pa'o / / //de ltar bla ma'i drin las thob par gang gyur pa/ /gshin rje gshed dpal gsang ba'i man ngag gsang ba 'di/ /dri med ji bzhin gsal bar byas la nongs pa kun/ /chos dbyings yin phyir ye shes che rnams bzod mdzad rigs/ /gnyug mar gnas pa bde chen snying rjes brlan gyur pa/ /bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dpal ldan dus dgra dmar po nyid/ /'di byas dge ba'i mthu yis srid gsum 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /chu la chu ltar rang gi ye shes chen po ro gcig rtogs gyur cig /phyir bzlog man ngag gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba/ /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i zhal gyi gdams pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dngos grub mchog brnyes pa'i dpal 'dzin gyis 4mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a nu pa ma rakṣi ta dang / lo tsā 5ba dar ma yon tan gyes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa6/ dus phyis chos kyi rgyal po'i sgu mkhar gnyis su lha rgya gar shar phyogs kyi mkhas pa chen po darbaṇa ā tsārya 8dang / lo tsā ba glo 9bo shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur cing zhus so/ /'di'i dpe skabs su rgya gar 24—/243

bal po thams cad du rgyun chad pa las phyis u snargyan du mkha' 'gro ma rgya mas gos can las rnal 'byor senta wa lentas zhus te byung ngo // //bsdur mchan/1237 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du khros pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga /sru nga ba'i 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dang / phyir zlog pa'i man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi.a/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉priṣṭha/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 srung / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phrin 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoraphrul/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da rlabs/1238 )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pa gang bas/ 4〈〈bee 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngagod/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'god/ 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉/ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉mngaphrin/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kun/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/1239 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesan/ 2〈〈snar 〉sngarabyam/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazung / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thog 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ /grog 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlabs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagand+ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gis bon sngags—/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 〈〈pe 〉〉 'og bsgo/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 'i 'og bsgo/124spyo 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesgom/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sdus/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyi'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mong /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipho/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staXm/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamakhros/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ting 'dzin ni// 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/1241 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayangs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thade/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ḍa mi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazung /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngajigs/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉ngadod par/ 〈〈snar 〉〉'dod byar/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ 8〈〈co 〉〉gdod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thugs/1242 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhugs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gsang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thad/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamajus1243 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skye/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zlog pa'i/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa'o// 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mnya gzungs su/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉dar phan ā tsarya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa ba blo/1244 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabu/24dod/244

༄ / /las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bsgrub thabs bzhugs/ kṣe༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya ma karna ṇa dza dharma sa dha na maḥ/ bod skad du/ las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bsgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi ba yid dwags rgyal po ni/ /'chi bdag ming gi rnam grangs ces bdud ces lhan cig skyes pa'i bya bas te/ /gang gis bdud na 'go ba kun kyi lus kyi bsdud/ /jiltar gnas na lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du/ /gang la yod na 'gro ba kun la snang bas te/ /phung po nying mtshams sbyor de kun gyi srog len par bya ba'o//srog 'jigs pa de'i gzugs mthong na/ /ya ma de'i dri stegashin rje ngad 'byung / /de nas rang gi srog gi lenapasabadud/ /ltag pa'i phyogs na rtsa gshin rje'i gdan lta bu ste gnas pas te/ /mchebabartsigs pa can la phyag 'cha la lo/ /de la gzugs brnyan rdo rje ste sgrub pa 'chi bdag skyes bu'i gzugs2/ /khru gang yi dwags gos rorasal bri/ /nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /'jigs surung ba pa ral pa mche bzhi brtsigs/ /24dod12‘ 6

—rgyan sbrul dang stag med rus pa'i phreng ba can lcags/ /g.yas pas ya ma'i dbyug pa can / /sdigs mdzub zhags pa g.yon na bsnams/ /ma he gdanadag la gnas pa bri/ /de nas bsgrubapo rnal 'byor chen po yis/ /yama'imadun du gnas la zhi gnas bya/ /yo 'am dbyug to'am gre gug yang na sa ti rnam gsum sa bon phyag mtshan lha sku las / /yang na hūṃ 1las nag po chen pos te/ /yi ge bcu gcig brjod byas la//ras la bris pa bzhin du bsgom/ /oṃ 2 ka la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas 'esabasnyen pa bya bar gsungs/ /dur khrod dmanags tshal song byas la/ / dajisas byed kyi bzlas brjod byas pa'i tshul dag gis/ /brtags ha ha bzhad cing dngapo rngi lam du 'ong bar rigs/ /sngon du gyur nas bha lo sbyin/ /de la bsnyen pa'i ༄'di'o / /bsnyen pa dang gtor ma gnyis 'ong ba la thog ma 'di'o/ /thog ma oṃ 5 ka la byu pa bhi ma yakṣa hūṃ6/ ma hā ro sha rgo/ bcubazhi na ra sid bye ya sarba bhu ta a bye pa ta ye tham/ya ma ra dza ye hūṃ 7phaṭa swā hā/ thog ma mtha' dang yang dag ldan/ /bcu bzhi phye ba bsnyen pa yin/ /rim pa bzhin du ma phye ba/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa yin par shes / /grub te mngon du gyur pa na/ /sha chen gtor ma chen po sbyin/ /oṃ ka la ru pa ya ma rā dzā hūṃ / i rda baṃ bo gritna kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tshogs la sogs pa sngon du sbyin/ /de ltar grub nas las byas te/ /ban dha mtshan ngan bzang po brtsal/ /dum bu gcig gam gnyis pa la/ /bral ba'i ngos nas rtag nga/ra drang / /ma thod dag la ro ras la/ /gnod sbyin bee ba sa ta'i gzugs/ /snag tsha bya rog khrag dang ni/ /dur khrod sol ba bong bu'i chus/ /mi rkang smyu gus legs par bri/ /spyi bo'i ngos kyis phyogs dag la/ /ras la 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /dgra bo ma ra ya phaṭa/ rim pa gsum bskor ldan pa la/ /rim pa 24—/2 7

gnyis pa dag la ni/ /rtsibs gnyis gnyis kyi tshad la bris/ /de la gsang sngags dgod pa ni/ /ma ma sha hūṃ a mu shaṃ/ /'khor lo lte ba'i dbus su bri/ /shar nas brtsams nas 'di ltar bri/ /tro sa ya/ tro sa ya1/ a gad ta yo1/a gatta ya2/ sho sha ya/ sho sha ya3/ ha na ha nashi da ha da ha5/ pa tsa pa tsa6/ ban dha ban dha7/ tsur na tsur na8/ rim pa tha ma dag la ni/ /shar nas brtsams nas 'di ltar bri/ /tsakṣa badzra na gho ra pa tra ya1/ kṣe tra bā la2 / tshin dha tshin dha3/ byen dha bhin dhashi ṭwāṃ shaṃ bha dzee pā ti5/ ru bye ra/arge pa6/ oṃ — byemā ra ya7/ badzra ye badzra ye rtse bha ya hūṃ phaṭa8/ bar du dgra'i ming rus bri/ /rgyab srubs dag la gsang sngags bri/ /skud pa sngon po nag po yis / /thod pa de ni bsdam par bya/ /ro shing me la ban dha sogs/ /de ltar zhag gsum byas nas kyang / /las kyi 'chi bdag khru gang ba/ /zhal gcig mche brtsigs phyag gnyis pa/ /grog mkhar bdun dang rnam snang dang / /dur khrod sol ba'i rgyu dag la/ /bong bu chu yis gzugs byas te/ /de'i snying khar thod pa gzhug /'khor lo la bris sngags bzlas te/ /mar tshes bzhi dang brgyad dag la/ /dur khrod lha khang dag du mnan/ /de ltar las 'di sgogs gyur na/ /gang la bya ba'i dngos po de/ /rang gi bdud kyi dbang du 'gyur/ /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po ni/ /ma dros mtsho'i 'bri dkyil la/ /ri nag dgu'i pha mtha' ste/ /spos ngad ri bo'i bar dag na/ /mchu dang zheng du cha mnyam mtsho/ /de 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po'i gnas/ /'gro ba ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas/ /de'i yum de tsa mun ti / /24—1248

rabs chad pho mo'i thod pa la/ /ya gnyis dag gi bar du yang / /ro ras dag la gzugs bri ba/ /zhal dang phyag zhabs sngon bzhin bri/ /de la 'chi bdag tsa mun ti① / /nag mo mig gsum khro gnyer can/ /kha gdangs skra rjes nu ma 'phyang / /gsus chen dud 'gro'i gos gyon la/ /g.yas na tri shul g.yon pa yang / /mi'i thod pa dag dang sbyar/ /mi'i rgyus pas bsdams pa yi bar du 'khor lo gzhug par bya/ /de nas 'chi bdag 'khor lo ni/ /snga ma bzhin du bri bar bya/ /de la ya ma pho mo'i 'khor lo ni/ /ras la 'chi bdag tshul bzhin du/ /rtsibs brgyad gnyis dang ldan pa'i/ /dbus nas brtsams nas 'di bzhin bri/ /ma ma sarba sha hūṃ/ lte ba'i dbus su bri bar bya/ /shar nas rim pas 'di bzhin bri/ /a myu ka spyi1/ du na du na2/ ban dha ban dha3/ma tha ma thag pra ma thā/ pra ma thā5/ hūṃ 2dzwa ra dza ra6/ dza re na byu7/bye ro ge māṃ8/ rim pa tha ma dag la ni/ /shar nas rim pas 'di lta ste/ /nyi ga na shi baṃ1/ yi re ri tshus ya2/ a bi sha ya3/ dzee baṃ tri da yi) tshin dha tshin dha5/ ma de pa shi baṃ6/ ma ra ya7/ na sha ya/ hūṃ phaṭa8/'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du yang / /gang la bya ba'i ming rus gnyug /bla mas 'chi bdag bsam byas te/ /srog gi snying po gdon par bya/ /gos sngon gyon pas de bzhin du/ /yum saṃ las mkhan dpa' bo ni/ /yum gyi srog snying bcug pa gdon/ /oṃ 5tri tsa mun ḍi baṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yab yum 'khor lo gang yin pa/ /gong gi thod par gzhug par bya/ /shi ba'i skra'i skud pa'am/ /mi rgyus dag gis mkhas pas bsdam/ /mi'i rgyus pas gzungs thag bya/ /gtso 24—1249

—4dang gzungs kyi bzung byas nas/ /maṇḍal steng bzhag bzlas pa bya/ /'khor lo steng 'og sngags bzla ba/ /gtso dang gzungs kyi 'bum phrag bzlas/ /de nas bzlas pa rdzogs pa dang / /dur khrod dam ni lha khang ngam/ /lha klu drag po'i gnas su mnan/ /lha la sogs pa shi bar bstan/ /de'i bsgrub pa'i gnas rnams kyang / /dbeen pa'i phyogs su byas nas ni/ /bla ma pha ma mchod pa'i gnas/ /de la gnod pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /gang byung yang ni bsgral bar bya / /de tshe bsgral bar ma byas na/ /rang nyid 'chi bar bstan pa yin/ /gsang bya gzhan la bstan mi bya/ /las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bsgrub thabs / /slob dpon la li ta badzras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po thugs rje chen po dang / bod kyi ban de ra lotstsha ba rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //24—1250

bsdur mchan/1246 tu/mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa mi bzhugs pas 〈〈pe 〉〉la gzhir gzung nas 〈〈snar 〉stanang dpe bsdur byas yod/ ②〈〈snar 〉sngagazug1247 tusna〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ rgya〈〈snar 〉stag du〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉〉snyingapo/ rgya〈〈snar 〉〉gi 'u41〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu / du〈〈snar 〉stago ⑨〈〈snar 〉sngani/1248 ①〈〈snar 〉stan/ ldu 〈〈snar 〉stago tshoge〈〈snar 〉〉dri/1249 ①〈〈snar 〉〉tri/ dzokhya〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ du〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ rgya〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ rgya〈〈snar 〉gzhibasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (88༷)24wa 1251

༄/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sngags btu ba zhes bya ba/7 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ rakta ya mā ri mant+ra saṃ gra nā 2ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sngags btu ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab tu dbeen par rab gtsang bas/ /mchod pa dang bcas sngags btu'o/ /bden pa tshad med pha rol phyin/ /'phags lam rnam thar phyogs rten 'byel/ /byang chub mchog rten 'khrul 'khor la/ /bden pa'i dang po ka nas bzung / /rten 'byel mtha' mar yi ge mchog /ā 4li kā li'i 5rim pa'o/ /dang por rnam thar drug pa sbyin/ /de nas rnam thar lnga pa'o/ /de nas rnam thar bdun pa la/ /phyogs kyi brgyad pas brgyan pa'o/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gnyis pa la/ /phyogs kyi brgyad pas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas phyogs kyi bzhi pa bya/ /'phags lam gyi ni drug pa la/ /rten 'byel gyi ni dgu pa sbyin/ /rnam thar gyi ni lnga pa la/ /rten 'byel kyi ni bdun pa sbyin/ /rnam 24—/252

thar gyi ni drug pa'o/ /yang ni de nyid sbyin par bya/ /rnam thar kyi ni lnga pa la/ /rten 'byel bdun pa sbyin par bya/ /'phags lam gyi ni drug pa la/ /rten 'brel dgu pas brgyan par bya/ /rnam thar gyi ni bdun pa la/ /rten 'byel dang pos brgyan pa'o/ /'phags lam gyi ni gsum pa dang / /rnam thar gyi rgo drug pa la/ /rten 'byel gyi ni dgu pas brgyan/ /de nas 'phags lam drug pa spyin/ /rnam thar drug pa de nas sbyin/ /yang ni de nyid sbyin par bya/ /de nas yang ni 'phags lam drug /rnam thar gyi ni drug pa la/ /rten 'brel dgu pas lkubargyan pa'o/ /'phags lam gyi ni brgyad pa la/ /rten 'byel ding sang gi cha/khas pa phal mo che'i ring lugs grags che ba rnams dang bstun na 'phags lam gyi brgyad pa la phyogs kyi dgu pas brgyan dbos par snang ba mkhyen ldan rnams kyis dbeed par 'tshal lo/ /3gsum pas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas rnam thar bdun pa sbyin/ /yang ni de nyid drug pa sbyin/ /de nas phyogs kyi drug pa la/ /rten 'brel gyi ni bdun pas brgyan/ /de nas rnam thar drug pa'o / /yang ni de nyid sbyin par bya/ /de nas phyogs kyi drug pa la/ /rten 'brel gyi ni bdun pas brgyan/ /rnam thar gyi ni drug pa sbyin/ /tshad med pa ni bzhi pa la/ /pha rol phyin pa'i dang pos brgyan/ /'phags lam gyi ni tha —ma la/ /rten 'byel 'di la yang phyogs kyi dgu pas brgyan zer dgos pa 'dra bas snga ma bzhin dpyad do// tshogasum pas brgyan pa'o/ /rnam thar gyi ni bdun pa la/ /phyogs kyi brgyad pas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas rnam thar lnga pa sbyin/ /yang ni de yi drug pa sbyin/ /yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ /las kyi sngags te nang rim gnyis/ /rang rang las kyis kha bsgyur bas/ /las rnams thams cad bde blag bsgrub/ /rten 'brel gyi ni dgu pa la/ /spyi bor rnam thar lnga pas brgyan/ /de nas phyogs kyi 24—1253

lnga pa la/ /rnam thar bdun pas 'og nas brgyan/ /de nas phyogs kyi bcu pa spyin / /de nas mnga' bdag bcu drug mtha'/ /de nas phyogs kyi gsum pa la / /phar phyin lnga pas 'og nas brgyan/ /de la rnam thar bdun pa sbyin/ /rten 'byel gsum pas spyi bor brgyan/ /de nas mnga' bdag bcu drug mtha'1/ /de nas phyogs kyi dang po la/ /rten 'byel da lta ngag 'don dang lag len grags che ba rnams ltar na phyosas kyi dgu pa'i rjes ma gtogs rten 'byel gsum pa mi byed pa'ang mkhas pas brtag go/ /2gsum pas brgyan pa'o/ /bden pa yi ni dang po la/ /rnam thar bdun pas 'og nas brgyan / /de nas rten 'brel gsum pas brgyan/ /de nas 'phags lam bzhi pa la/ /phyogs kyi brgyad pas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas 'phags lam tha ma ni/ /lan gnyis su ni sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sa bon ni/ /lan gnyis bar du spyin par bya/ /de nas rnam thar gnyis pa la/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lnga pa sbyar / /de'ang mkhas pas gnyis su'o/ /de nas phyogs kyi bzhi pa la/ /phyogs kyi dang po 'og tu brtags / /de la phyogs kyi brgyad pas brgyan/ /de nas phyogs kyi lnga pa la/ /phyogs kyi brgyad pas brgyan par bya/ /gdug pa'i yi ge bcu bzhi ni/ /'khrul 'khor gyi ni phyi rol la'o/ /bzlas pa dang ni 'khrul 'khor la/ /sngon du sngags btu dag par bya/ /gzhan du dbang po'i dgra bo bzhin/ /mchod pa chen po byas nas ni/ /slob ma la ni rjes gnang sbyin / /de ltar ma byas nus mthu med/ /de ltar byas na shin tu myur/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sngags btu ba slob dpon dpal 'dzin zhabs kyis 4mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta dā na shī 5la dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba bsod nams seng ges 37——/25

༄/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i las kyi phreng ba'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ gre sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ rakta ya mā ri 2a ba li sā dha dzee binta ma ṇi nā 4ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i las kyi phreng ba'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo lha dang lha min ma lus cod 5pan gyis btud pa'i/ /zhabs kyi padma dang ldan 'jam dbyangs rdo rje dang / /de nyid rang bzhin khro bo gshin rje gshed po la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs gsal bar bri/ /'gro ba'i dal 'byor g.yo ba dang //dam pa'i bshes 6gnyen rnyed dka' bas/ /'dod pa ma lus bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sngags pas 'bad pas 7mkhas pas kye/ /re zhig 'gro ba ma lus par gdon par bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi sems chen po bskyed pa dang / dad pa mchog dang ldan pa/ snying rje che ba/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu la sogs pa so sor rtogs 9 pa dang ldan pa cig 1 gis gshin rje gshed dmar po'i bzlas pa bya 11ba 271dod1256

—sngon du 'gro bas sam/ lha'i rjes su gnang ba thob pas gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa'i dngos grub bam/ sems la 'dod pa gang yin pa bsam gtan la gnas pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /de skad du yang gsungs pa ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dang / /bsam gtan 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'gugs pas tsho'agrub par 'gyur ba yin/ /rnam pa gzhan kyis mi 'grub bo/ /zhes so//nags tshal dbeen pa dag tu ni/ /yang na sngags 'di tha—mas cad kyis/ /sngags pa rnams kyis bye ba bzlas/ /las ni thams cad byed par gsungs/ /gang zhig phun sum tshogs pa yinakhya/ /bya ba thams cad 'dod pa des/ /nyon mongs dri ma thams cad dag /zla ba lta bur sems tsam nyid/ /bdag kyang de yi rang bzhin no/ /snod dang bcud kyi 'gro ba dang ༷ / /sems tsam nyid du sems can kun/ /yang dag sangs rgyas de sras rnams/ /bdag gi sems su gnyis med bya/ /de yi 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan ni/ /sa dang pha rol phyin la sogs/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsgom par bya/ /dkar po'i gzugs kyis bzhugs pa ni/ /rang phyogs 'o ma'i 'bab pyachu bzhin/ /rang sems de ltar bsgoms pa las/ /sngon kyi smon lam stobs kyis ni/ /snying rjes bskul nas 'di lta ste/ /sa 'og bar du bsgom par bya/ /e ma sems can snyug bsngal can/ /'khor bar yun du gnas pa dang / /thabs dang shes rab bral ba yis/ /yang dang yang du yun ring gnas/ /de rnams kun gyis 37rtogs bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed por bsgom/ /oṃ bo dhi tsitta utyā 5da yā mi/ zhes brjod do/ /de las byung ba'i 'od zer ldan/ /ka la sogs pa'i yi ges brgyan/ /rim gyis skyes pa'i sems nyid ni/ /sems can 24—1257

yongs su 'dzin par byed/ /kun kyang snying rje'i stobs las byung // //1gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa'i sgrub pa gang la yang khrus kyi cho ga bstan pa/de la chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa sgyu ma lta bu dang / rmi lam lta bu/thog ma nas ma skyes pa/ rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa/ thog ma nas zhi ba'i chos thams cad la sogs pa lhag mar mos pas bdag gi lus dang phyi dang nang thams cad rdul phra rab kyi rnam par dbye bar bya ba'i mi dmigs pa'i spyod pas myur du grub par byed pas/ nang gi khrus chen po la nan tan du bya'o/ /gang zhig phyi'i rdzas la chags pa rmongs pa'i blo can rnam par rtog pa'i dpyod pas the tshom sel bar mi nus pa des phyi'i khrus kyi cho ga 'di bya'o/ /thog mar re zhig hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ sku mdog sngon po 'bar ba chen po'i 'od zer 'khrug pa/ dang po'i rdo rje 'gying ba nga rgyal dang bcas pa rdo rje chen po 'od zer 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro ba/ dang por rdo rje gsor zhing bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba ltar 'bar ba/ rdo rje nyi ma me 'bar bar bdag nyid sprul nas/ oṃ dhu pi dhu pi kā ya dhu pi pra dzwa li ni swā hā/ zhes brjod cing /rdo rje bsdams pas nang du bstan te/ bar dang bcas pa mthe bo rdo rje rtse sprad nas phyir gyed pas rdo rje me'i dam tshig phyag rgya 4bcings nas bdag nyid 'bar bar bya'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bzod par dka' ba'o/ /de'i rjes su bskyed rim 5che bar bstan pa bzhin du rdo rje go cha ste/ de'i rjes su oṃ bhu ra dzwa 6la oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes sa bzung la/ cha gsum du byas la sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs nas khrus byed pa'i sar bzhag ste/ de nas bdud rtsi 277—/2pya8

'khyel pa'i phyag rgya bcings la chu'am chu'i snod gnas la bgegs thams cad bskrad pa'i ched du 'og dang steng bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ bhu dzwa li swa hūṃ swā hā/'es rig pa 'di brjod cing / gong du bshad pa'i sa cha gsum po las cha gcig rges bshang lam bkrus te/ lag pa gnyis bkrus la nye reg bya'o/ /cha gnyis la hūṃ zhes brjod cing lus po thams cad khrus byas te cha gsum pas mgo bkrus nas / oṃ byi dzwa la hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis nye bar reg nas rang gi mgo la sngags dang bcas pa'i chu gtor nas/ rang gi lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bdag byen gyis brlabs nas khrus byed sa nas ldang bar byed do/ /de'i rjes la bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i chus gos la gtor nas/ ji lta ba bzhin gyon nas yi ge brgya pa brjod cing / yid kyis 1chu'i gnas kyi srung 2ma gshegs nas/ga/da cig gis lha'i nga rgyal gyis de'i sngags yid kyis brjod cing /bsam gtan gyi 4khang pa'i drung du 'gro bar bya/ de nas rkang pa gnyis bkrus la rig ma des nye bar reg la/ hūṃ phaṭa ces pa lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bgegs thams cad bskrad nas/ bsam gtan gyi khang par zhugs te/ yang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis stan la sogs pa dang bsam gtan gyi 5khang pa la byug pa la sogs pa gtor nas nye bar reg par bya'o/ /sa ma ya ste zhes bsgod cing phyag g.yas pa bkan par byas 6la/ gung mo dang srin lag tsam bkug nas/ phyag rgya 'dis rkang pa gnyis kyi nang du bcug la/ tsog pur bsdad de smra ba bcad la/padma'i tshul gyis kha la yang yang reg par byas/ lan gnyis sam lan gsum du rna ba gnyis dang mig gnyis dang sna dang kha dang lag pa gnyis dang / lte ba dang mgo la reg par bya ba ni mgo bkru ba'i cho ga'o/ /277—/259

—de ltar khrus byas pa'am ma byas kyang rung / ri'i sul la sogs pa dbeen pa'i gnas su chags pa thams cad dang bral bas spyod lam yangs par ngag bcad la/ 'phags pa gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor gyis gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub par tso7nye bar bya ste/ de la hūṃ gi yi ges 'gro ba thams cad stong par byas la/bi ma lo dhe bye thuzhes pa brjod pas/ rgya mtsho chen po'i steng du oṃ a pa tsa la bi re swā hā/ zhes pas gser gyi rang bzhin gyi steng bye 7oṃ a pa tsa la hūṃ zhes pas rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi ri'i rgyal po tshad med pa/ me tog dang shing thog sna tshogs pa dang ④nags tshal gyis brgyan pa/ dpag bsam kyi shing gis brgyan pa/'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i longs spyod dang ldan pa lteyid du 'ong bar bsgoms te/der sthāḥ'i yi ge las padma dzi/ de'i steng du ā 3li dang po a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du kṣiṃ rnam par bsam mo/ /de'i sgra dang 'od zer gyi 3sprin gyi tshogs kyis —9nam mkha' thams cad khyab par bsam/'od zer de dag gnod sbyin mo'i gzugs su gyur te tshur 'dus nas kṣiṃ de nyid la thim par gyur/ kṣiṃ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las gnod spyin mo longs spyod can ma zhes bya ba lang tsho rgyas pa sgeg pa'i ro dang ldan pa/ mdzes ma lha mo'i gzugs lta bu 'dzin pa/ sku mdog ljang gu gos dkar pos smad g.yogs dang stod g.yogs byas pa/ phyag g.yon pa dpag bsam gyi shing la 'jug shā snapa/phyag g.yas pa me tog kha dog lnga dang ldan pas brgyan pa/ steng na gdugs dkar po rang bzhin gyis gnas panyu1/ 'gying ba'i tshul gyis 'gying zhing g.yo ba med pa rtade ltar rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas gong du bstan pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya des byin gyis brlabs te kha lta bu'i phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ ya mānta ka 24—1260

—hūṃ zhes pas rang gi thugs ka nas gshin rje'i lkugashed gong du bstan pa'i gzugs can rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ sku las bye'od zer rab tu 'bar ba/ nyi ma bye ba lta bu dang ldan pa/ bgegs ma lus pa 'jigs par byed pa/ 'jig rten gsum po bsdigs par byed pa'i khro bo cig spros la/ de la bka' bsgo ba byas pas zhe gnod sbyin mo bkug nas/ bdag gi sku la zhugs nas slar phyir spros te gnod sbyin mo'i mgo bdag gi zhabs kyis mnan nas gnas par bsgom mo/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas dgug pa la sogs pa dang mtshams bcad pa la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bzhin du gdan dang mchod yon dbul ba dang / mtheb mdzub gnyis skam 4pa ltar byas la sor mo gzhan rnams phyir babyed de zhabs bsil kyi sngags kyis snyezhabs bsil phul la dam tshig ma'i phyag rgya bstan te/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya gong du bstan to/ /'dir dam tshig ma la pya ni lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo rnams phan tshul bsnol te srin lag gnyis phyir bskyed 3 la tshigs gsum pa bkug ste phye ba 1'di ni gnod spyin mo thams cad kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ bha ga wa ti dṛ shesnashya ho/ de bzhin du lha mo rang rang gi rtog pa nas byung ba bzhin du bshad pa'i sngags gzung bar bya'o / /de nas oṃ badzra ratna a bhe ṣiñtsa zhes 11dbang bskur bar bya ste phyag rgya gong du bstan zin to/ /de nas mchod yon lngas mchod do/ /oṃ gyi muyi ge las byung ba'i me tog dang / dri dang / mar me dang / pi wang dang /gling bu dang / dung dang / rnga rings dang / rag dung la sogs pa'i sgra'i bye brag dang / glu dang / gar dang / sgeg mo dang / bzhad ma dang /rlung g.yab dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gdugs dang / rnga 24—1261

dang / gos dang / dpung rgyan dang / do shal dang / rkang gdub dang /bla re 1dang / dra ba dra phyed dang / g.yer kha'i 5dra ba dang / gzhal yas khang dang / ji lta ba bzhin du gnas la yod pa dang / gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs mthong ba dang thos pa la sogs pas nam mkha' khyab par khengs pas mchog — sbyin mo la mchod pa byas par bsam/ de nas gong bzhin du dril bu dgrol zhing byin rlabs kyi 1phyag rgyas mchod pa byin kyis brlabs te/ gong bzhin du gnod sbyin mo'i rin po che'i ri la gnas la/ sgrub pa'i dbang du gyur pa/rang gi gzugs kyi sprin gyis nam mkha' gang bar byed pa de nyid thun gsum mam bzhir 6bsgoms pas nges par 'grub bo/ /gang zhig bsgoms pas 'grub par mi nus pa des rtog pa las bshad pa'i sngags bzhin du thu/bzlas par bya ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ bha ga wa te swā hā/ zhes so/ /gnod sbyin bskyed pa dang /mchod pa thams cad kyi cho ga byas la/ gnod sbyin mo'i sngags rang gi snying las bskyed / rang gi sngags gnod sbyin mo'i snying la 3snathun gsum mam bzhi'i rim pas bzlas pa bya/ ngal na yang dag par mchod de yi ge brgya pa brjod la/oṃ muḥ/ zhes pa phyag rgya la sogs dgol ba'i bsam pas dam tshig gi phyag rgya kha steng du bstan pas dgol lo/ /de kho na ltar nyi ma re res yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum yongs su rdzogs par byas la 'phags pa gshin rje'i 1gshed kyi nyu snarnal 'byor gyis gos sar pa mis ma gyon pa'am shing leb bam gang yang rung ba skye bos dbeen pa yid 11dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ bla re dgram pa dang gdugs la sogs pa dang / me tog dri zhim po dang bdug spos dang mar me la sogs pas nye bar brgyan pa dang sa gzhi la dri'i byug pa byas pa'i steng du bzhag ste/ gnod 24—1262

sbyin mo gong du bstan pa'i gzugs su sprul nas/ dgug pa la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas 'phags pa gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgya sngon du bsams te/ rjes la ji ltar bde bas rang gis bri ba'i ri mo mkhan la gshin rje'i shegashed kyi rnal 'byor gye srung treb byas lasne/ de lta bu'i thang ka la skye bos dbeen pa'am/ tshal du rab gnas byas la/ nya la dkar gsum gyi gtor ma dang mar me bzhi phul nas gong du bstan pa'i tshogs thams cad la byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa chen po byas te/ dung la sogs pa'i thumachod yon gyi snod la me tog dkar po dri zhim ngo/'i chu la 5bsres pas gang bar byas la lag pas snod la reg la dgongs skumo nas brtsams 3smyung gnas byas la de srid bar du bzlas pa byas8// ji srid bar du 9longs spyod sbyin byed ma lha mo'i gzugs lta bu longs spyod can ma 'ongs nas bdag nyid kyi lag pa gnyis nas 'dzin te byung na cemig mi blta 1 bar bya'o/ /gal te bltas na sgrub pa po nyid rengs pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams bcad pa ni dra ba dang / gur dang / ba dan dang / khyed bde bar spyon la sogs par byas la/ bdud rtsi'i tso rgyun gyi phyag rgyas mchod yon phul la snyim pa sbyar la mje bong gnyis rtser bzhag la mchod yon dbul ⑩ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas / oṃ sarba de ba tā tsint+ra mṛ ta dhwa sar swā hā/ zhes sngags brjod cing /de nas mchod pa byas la/ dri dang me tog dang spos la sogs pa yang mchod yon phul nas snyim pa kha phye la chu gnyis bsnol mar byas la/ de'i nang mje bong gnyis bcug la mdzub mo gnyis kyis mthe bong 7mnan par byas te/ srin lag gnyis rtse sprad nas gung mo gnyis phyir bskyed 1 par bya ba ni zhi ba'i gtor ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ hi hi tu ru tu ru saṃ pu ra ya ma hā pa ya na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ a 24—1263

mṛ ta dhā kyir swā hā/ zhes so/ /gang gi tshe smra na/ khyed kyi bdag gis ci bgyi zhes zer na/ de'i tshe gong du gang 'dod pa de nyid blang bar bya'i gzhan ni mi smra'o / /oṃ tri — khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di snying po phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchog blangs pa de lta'i hūṃbar 'gyur ro/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la mthe bong phyir bskyed 4la bstan pa jesnying gi phyag rgya'o/ /'og tu kha blta 6na mchog blang bar bya'o/ /de ni sgrub pa pos a ma nyid du blangs na bu lta bur skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /grub thob dang lhan cig 'grogs par 'gyur ro/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho la gnas pa dang lhan cig 'grogs par 'gyur ro/ /shing thog kyang ster bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa po gang gis zos pa de tshe bskal pa tsam du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /srin hūṃmo gyis shig ces brjod na 'dis nor shebacu gnyis ster bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa po 'khor bcu gcig dang bcas pa la kha zas bsgrim pa med par ster bar 'gyur ro/ /'tsho ba bar mi 'chad par bye'agyur ro/ /pho nya mo byas na dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol nas kyang skyes pa'am bud med gang ༷ 'dod pa khugs par 'gyur ro/ /gong du bstan pa'i a ma'i don yang byed par 'gyur ro / /yang na khyim thab mar gyur pas ri rab la sogs pa la nye bar gnas pa'i brtul zhugs can gyi gnas ston 1par 'gyur ro/ /rig 'dzin grub pa rnams kyi 4 rtetshe bskal pa'i bar du thub par bya ba'i ro bro ba'i shing thog rnams ster zhing zhes pa la sogs pa rtogs 1)par bya'o/ /gang zhig gnod sbyin mo rtog pa las bshad pa'i dus la ⑫'gal nas 'ong bar ma gyur na/ de'i tshe rdo rje lcags sgog gi phyag rgyas gnod sbyin mo de dus la mum bab bar du bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra sgo ṭa hūṃ baṃ zhes pa'i phyag rgya gong du bstan zin to/ /gal te ci yang mi smra na/24—1264

de'i tshe rdo rje bzhad ma'i phyag rgyas smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin te / na mo badzra pā ṇi spa la 1ha se ha sa badzra ṇi ku ru ku ru/ shaṃ pa shaṃ pa tsa la tsa la kalpa kalpa swā hā/ zhes so/ /dngos grub ma byin par 'gro bar 'gyur na de nyid kyis bcing bar bya'o/ /phyag rgya ni thal mo sbyar nas sren lag gnyis nang du bsnol te mje bong gnyis kyis srin lag gnyis kyi snyertsa ba mnan par byas/gung mo gnyis rtse sprad nas de'i rtsa ru mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i rnam par rtse sprad de gzhag /mthe chung gnyis bsnol te phyir bskyed par bya zhes so/ /'byung po thams cad la —chu la bzlas la brjod par bya ba'i pyaphyag rgya'o/ /gnod sbyin mo dag5 /a pa rā dzi ta dang / gzhan yang yi dwags mo la sogs pa'i cho ga 'di ni ji ltar sbyor ba ji lta bar sbyar bar bya'o/ /longs spyod can ma'i rtog pa sdogs so// //24—1265

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ratna mā la/ bod skad du/ rin chen phreng ba ma/ oṃ hūṃ/ de'i sgrub thabs ni/ lha'i gnas su stong phrag brgyad bzlas pas/ de nas mtshan phyed na rkang gdub kyi sgra dang bcas pas 'ong ste 2 lha'i 'dod yon thams cad ster ba dang / de dang bcas pa'i lo stong 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /da gzhan gyi 4rjes su 'brangs nas kyang a pa tsha ra bsgrub par bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis padma'i phyag rgya bca' ba ni/ a pa tsha ri'i 5dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /a pa tsha ri'i 6sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //24dod1268

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā gi bhyo ra sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ klu mo'i sgrub thabs/ phuḥhaṃ phu2—/ zhes so/ /de nas klu mo zhal mtha' yas ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ klu'i gnas su gong bzhin du sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas bsnyen pa skyel ba'o/ /de nas tshes lnga la klu'i gnas su chu'i nang du zhugs la/ dri dang me tog dang bdug spos la sogs pa dang / 'o ma'i 'bras thug gis mchod pa byas nas sngags stong phrag brgyad bzlas pa'i rjes la klu'i mtsho nas klu'i bu mo rnams myur du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'bras thug gi mchod yon phul te khams bde'am zhes kyang 'dri'o/ /de nas khyed kyi bdag gis ci bgyi zhes zer na/ bdag gi chung ma gyis zhes brjod do/ /nyi ma re la 'dis nor brgyad brgyad ster ba dang / des dgra gang yin pa gsod 4pa dang slar gso nus par 5'gyur ro/ /klu mo zhal mtha' yas ma'i sgrub thabs 21—1270

༄7/ /dga' bas tshim ma'i sgrub pabee thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ra ti pra 2ye sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/dga' bas tshim ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ oṃ ra ti pri ye swā hā/ zhes so / /gro ga'am ras la gnod sbyin mo dga' bas tshim ma 4zhes bya ba sgu mdog ser mo gzhon nu'i gzugs can rgyan thams cad kyis 5brgyan pa/ me tog utpal bzung ba gong bzhin du dzre bar bya ste/ sna ma'i me tog gis yang dag par mchod cing gu gul gyis bdug ste6/ zla ba gcig gi bar du nyi ma re re la sngags stong phrag re re bzla bar 7bya'o/ /de nas ji ltar nus pas mchod pa bya ste mar gyi mar rnge byas la/ de ji srid ma byung gi bar du bzlas par rwabya'o/ /byung ba dang ngag bcad de 'dod pa spyad na bud med du 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa po'i 'khor rnams kyang rab tu skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i 'dod yon lnga'i bza' ba dang dngul chu dang / bcud len 'dis nor nyi shu rtsa lnga ster bar 2(—/276
