༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ yakṣa na ḍa na ḍi 2 shā dha rgo/ bod skad du/gnod sbyin na ḍa pho mo'i sgrub thabs/ na mo bai shra warṇa su ta ya na ṭa ku be rā ya dī bya mi 4mā na tsi ra ta ya ye 5ma mā la ku ṇa ra 6la sha ri ta ya/ yakṣa sa bandi ta ya hūṃ bha ga wān/ a warta 8ye 6 me/ tarya thā/ ma ṇi ma ṇi/kuṣṭa kuṣṭa/ ku ku ku ku/ pa ra pa ra/ pū ra pū ra/ ku pa ra ku pa ra/na ḍa ku be rā di bya bi mā na ku ṇa li ku bi ku bi swā hā/ byang chub kyi shing ngam gang yang rung ba'i shing leb bam 1/ gong gi cho gas gnod sbyin mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mdog ljang gu mi sdug pa mche ba gcigs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon gyis thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas pa/ byang chub kyi 1 shing gi sdong po la brten nas gnas pa bri 1 la bsam/ de'i mdun du sngar gyi cho gas rig pa stong phrag brgyad 271—/278

cung 1ma longs pa cig bzlas te/ de nas nya'i nub mo stong phrag brgyad rdzogs par byas pas gnod sbyin mo mdun du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de la dkar gyi mchod yon dbul lo/ /de nas mo 'di skad smra bar 'gyur te/ bdag gis ci bgyi zhes zer te/ de la bdag la rig pa 'dzin pa grub par gyis la/ khyod kyang nga'i bud med kyis shig ces brjod do/ /2mo na re de ltar bgyi'o zhes zer nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i rjes nas mtshan mo rgyan kun gyis brgyan nas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dang bcas pas bdag rig 'dzin du 'gyur zhing gnod sbyin gyi stobs dang ldan par yang 'gyur ro/ /gnod spyin mo de dang rtse zhing / rol pas gnas par yang 'gyur ro/ /rang gang du 'gro bar 'dod pa der 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lo stong phrag lnga 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /las stong tsho tsam byed pa'i rig pa 'di'o/ /gnod sbyin sgrub par 'dod na skyes pa'i gzugs su bris la sngar bzhin du dgug pa la sogs pa byas la bsgrub par bya'o/ /des grub nas gnod sbyin khol po lta bur 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na ḍi bi ṇa ḍi dha 4ṇi swā hā / zhes pa 'di la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas la/ de nas nya'i nyin par khang pa dbeen par mun pa shin tu gnag pa cig tu 'dug ste bzlas pa byas pas/ nam phyed dam tho rangs kyi dus su 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /ma'am sring mo'am chung mar gyur te/ gang yid la 'dod pa thams cad ster bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin na ḍa pho mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //24—1279

—ma' sgrub thabs/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ yakṣa mi thra thi bi lasmri sā na dha nai/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin mo sa'i bdag mo bkra shis ma'i sgrub thabs/ oṃ dza thi bi lasmro la bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes pa 'di la bsnyen pa khri phrag gcig bzlas la/de nas khru gang ngam mtho gang ba'i ras cig la gnod sbyin mo khri la gnas pa sgu mdog ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bris te/ shin tu dben pa'i sar thad ka la rab gnas byas la gcig pu 4bsrung ba byas la/ nya skam po dang sha dang til kyi phye ma'i spos btang nas/ mar sar pas rkang mthil la byugs la rang gi mal du 'dug ste/ ji ltar nus pas sngags bzla bar 5bya'o/ /nub dang po la rmi lam du rtags 'byung 6ngo / /gnyis pa la dgra 7'byung / gsum pa la sgo brdung 87bar 'gyur/ bzhi pa la nang du 'ong bar mtshon par bya/ lnga pa la mthong bar 'gyur/ drug pa la smra bar 'ong / bdun pa la bdag gis 24—128/

—rjod 1kyi ci bgyi zhes zer ba 'ong ngo / /de la 'dod yon lnga bdag la 2ster ba'i bud med du 'gyur te/ tshim par gyur nas grub pa'i rdzas rnams ster ro/ /khyad par du mtshan mo kho na bzlas pa bya/ gang zhig gnod sbyin mo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga yod de/ des sgrub thabs kyi rim pas sbyin sreg byas nas gnod sbyin mo bsgrub par bya'o/ /gzhan yang gong bzhin gnod sbyin mo rnams bsgom par bya'o//yang na rang rang gi rtog pa las gsungs pa'i bzlas pa'i grangs kyis bsgrub par bya'o / /khyad par 'phags pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i tshul gyis gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs kyi tshig mang pos bdag gis 'dir tha dad du byas pa'o/ /de rang la gnod sbyin mo rnams bsgrub 4par bya'o / /lte ba'i thad kar lag pa g.yon pa gan rkyal du byas nas/ gung mo dang srin lag gyen du bslangs 5la mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo phyir brkyangs 6la/de'i steng du lag pa g.yas pa kha sbub la 'dug pa ni gnod sbyin mo'i )phyag rgya'o/ /de kho na nyid la lag pa g.yon kyi gung mo phyir bskyed 8la mdzub mo nang du bkug 9pa ni gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid la mthe chung dang mthe bo gnyis sbyar ba ni gnod sbyin mo gzhan gyi phyag rgya'i khyad par ro/ /de nyid la srin lag phyir bskyed 1pa ni mi'am ci'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid rang la gung mo phyir bskyed 1 na 'dre'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid rang la gung mo bsgum nas gzhag pa ni 'dre mo rnams kyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di rnams kyi rtsa ba ni gong du bstan pa'i lag pa g.yon pas bcas pa'i phyag rgya de'o zhes so/ /ma dang sru mo sgyug mo dang / /chung ma bu mo a nee gnod sbyin mor/ /bsgyur te ma dang sru 1 mo sgyug mo gang / /de dag mchog ste nor bu rin chen ltar/ /de bzhin bu mo mdza' mo 'bring po ste/ /21—/282

snying sdug bud med snying mo tha mar shes/ /thun 1mtshams mchod pa me tog phreng ba dri/ /mar gyi mar me yang na mar nag ste/ /bdug spos dri zhim tsandan a ga 2 ru / /gtor ma sna tshogs mtshan mo rtag tu dbul/ /brtul zhugs gnas la mngon par 'jam pa yi/ /bud med shin tu chags pas zil gyis non/ /rnyed pa thob dang lus gzugs 4'dzag pa dag /dngos grub ster ba'i bdag pos 5byed par 'gyur/ /bud med chags pas non la mi 'gro zhing / /de bzhin rnyed pa chen po rab tu spang / /sngags pas mtshan mo shu kra rab tu bsrung //brtson 'grus 'bar ba mchog tu bsten 6par gyes/ /gang zhig log pas gnod spyin mo brtsams pa/ /rmongs pa de ni myur du 'jigs par 'gyur/ /srin mo 'dre mo rnams la gang 7bzhin du/ /cho ga lhag pa'i khyad par 'di nyid de/ /nya sha chang dang la phug khur ba dang / /bal sran nas sran dag dang 'bras zan sha /gtor ma 'di ni ku tu ru ka'i spos/ /gnas ni dur khrod skye bos dben pa'i khyem/ /shi ri ka dang bilba 9dang / /ma ḍa ru pa arka dang / /sha pa dza na dha du ra/ /a ga ti dang bṛ 11ha ti/ /ra dza ka dang ku sha dang / /e raṇḍa dang arka dang / /mya ngan med dang de rnams kyi/ /me tog rnams ni dbul bar bya/ /klu la 'bras thug bu ram ྾khur ba mar/ /dri zhim me tog bdug spos dri zhim dang / /phreng ba sna tshogs shing thog mo ka ta/ /zho yos tsandan a ka ru rnams dang / /bum pa dang ni ba dan nag po rnams/ /nag po'i gos dang gtor ma nag po dang / /me tog phreng ba gdugs dang byug pa rnams/ /ji ltar rnyed pa klu la dbul bar bya/ /cho ga rab tu bstan pa 'di/ /thun 7mong du ni ྾gsungs pa'o/ /sngags kyi nus pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /'dod pa 24—1283

༄/ /gnod sbyin dga' byed kyi sgrub thabs/khye༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ yakṣu nandi ka ri sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/gnod sbyin dga' byed kyi sgrub thabs/ gong du ṇa ḍa ku pa ra'i sngags kyi sgrub thabs su/ spyor ba 4gnod spyin thams cad kyi sgrub thabs ston to/ /'on kyang khyad par cung zad bstan par byas na/ na ma pri 5yo ka rā ya ra 6hi ti she swā hā/ zhes so/ /dga' byed ces bya ba'i 7gnod sbyin gzhon nu ma cig gis las thams cad byed par 'gyur bas/ de'i cho ga ni bsnyen 9pa 'bum phrag gsum bzlas nas de nas khye stan las byas pa'am/ shing ka tai pa las byas pa'i shing leb la dga' byed ces bya ba zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ gzhon nu'i gzugs can/ phyag g.yon dang po na shing thog 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ de'i mdun du rtswa 1 ku sha'i chun po la rang 'dug nas/ba'i sha dang gu gul bsres la stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg byas na grong khyer brgyad 24—/286

༄/ /gnod sprun gyi rgyal po phur 6sa 'debs pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ yakṣa tī li tī la rā dza sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po phur bus 'debs pa'i sgrub thabs/ yakṣa tī lo nā ma sa tya ba di triṣṭa 2 pra taḥta sha tya ha piṇḍa da di ma se me ka mā na pra yastso 4tu swā hā/zhes so/ /de nas zan za ba'i dus su/ zan gyi phud la sngags lan bdun bzlas la/ dben pa'i sar lci bas byugs pa'i maṇḍal byas la nyi ma re re zhing gnod sbyin la zan dbul lo/ /zla 5gcig song nas nyi ma re la 'dis nor 6re ster ro/ /zla ba gnyis pa la 'dis nor nyi shu ster ba'am 7yang na ston par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba gsum pa la nyi ma re la 'dis nor 8brgya tsho re ster ro/ /zla ba bzhi pa la 'dis nor 9stong ster ro/ /zla ba lnga pa la tī li tī 7la zhes bya ba'i gnod spyin gyi rgyal po mthong bar 'gyur zhing mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /'bru dang / nor dang gter shin tu mang ba ster bar 'gyur ro/ /nad med 2(dod/288

༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ pi shā 2bhetsa pi lu pa ya ——sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ sha za pi lu'i sgrub thabs/ na mo bha ga wa te pi lu pa zheya pi shā tse sa kha byuṅga cete sa me ka ma na pra yastso 7tu/ tarya thā/ hūṃ lu hūṃ lu pi shā —tsa ba ra ba ra/ ba ra da ba ra da/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsu ṭu tsu ṭu/ na maḥswā hā/ zhes so / /de nas tshes bcu bzhi la nyin mtshan du smyung / gnas byas la/ tshon rtsi 4 ma 'dres pa snod sar pa'i nang du bzhag la pir gyis 1bri bar bya ba ni/ byang chub kyi shing gi 'og tu skra gyen du langs pa/ cer 1 bu mdog ljang gu mi sdug pa mig dmar po/ lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas pa/ g.yon pas byang chub kyi shing la 'jus pa/ de'i mig gnyis rang gi khrag gis phye la/de'i mdun du 5rtswa ku sha'i mdun du brjod sapa'am/ yang na gzhan yang rung ste gcer bur byas la/ 'bum phrag gcig bsnyen pa bskyal te/ de nas yungs 24— /317

kar stong phrag brgyad la rdog po re la sngags lan re bzlas pas 1snying gar brgyab pas stong tsho brgyad rdzogs pa'i rjes la tshes bcu bzhi la gtor ma chen po dbul zhing mchod pa chen po bya'o/ /de nas mi sdug pa'i gzugs can nam/ yang na dri zhim pos byugs 4nas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /pi lu pa la zhes pa'i spyo gogs po khams bde'am zhes dris te/ me tog dkar po dang tsandan dkar po bsres ④ pas mchod yon dbul lo/ /de nas kho na re bdag gis ci bgyi zhes zer na/ nga ci zer na kyis rgyashig ces smra'o/ /de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes zer nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gang bsgo ba byed pa dang /mtshan mo dpag tshad brgya nas kyang bud med 'gugs pa dang / phar skyel ba dang / grub pa'i dngul chu dang / bcud len dang / 'dod pa'i rdzas dang /brgyags 9kyang ster ro/ /sdug pa'i dus su dran par byas na phrag pa la khur nas gar 'dod pa der skyel lo/ /phan pa dang gnod pa yang bshad do/ /khyad par du lan gnyis lan gsum du ④bsgrubs na bram ze bsad byekyang nges par 'grub bo/ /pi lu pa 7zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //24—1318

༄khya/ /sha za kha nag ma'i sgrub thabs/ hūṃ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi shā pi kṛṣṭa mu kha sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/sha za kha nag ma'i nasgrub thabs/ oṃ ta ti le ta ti le kṛṣṭa mu khe ma hā pi shā tsi de hi da bā hi swā hā/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas te/ de nas tshes bcu bzhi nas zan lhag ma'i chang bu la sngags lan bdun bzlas shing zla ba gcig gi bar du sbyin no/ /nam phyed la bzlas pa mang du bya/ de nas tshes bcu bzhi'i mtshan mo thog thag bzlas pa bya/ nam phyed dam yang na tho rangs ka 'grub par byed do/ /nyi ma re re di na ra bcu bcu ster ro/ /'dre mo kha nag ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //2tsho1—13/2

༄/ /gshin rje gshed kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i sgub thabs/ 1༄go/ /gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa de rnams kyi mthus/ nyi ma re la ji tsam lag tu blangs pa de thams cad gsog 'jog mi bya bar longs spyad cing zad par bya'o/ /gzhan la yang mi bshad 2do/ /de ltar ma byas na 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad kyi dam tshig phyag rgya so sor gsungs pa'o/ /yang na de dag thams cad rdo rje'i rigs kho nas 'dug 4pas/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi phyag rgya kho na bya ba ni thams cad la khyad med pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje bsdams pa byas nas ni/ /khros pa'i bsam pas bcing bar bya/ /mje bo rdo rje brtan pas mnan/ /'di ni khro bo'i phyag rgyar dran/ /zhes so/ /'di rnams kyi rim pa ji 5lta bas lan bdun tshun chad kyis gal te ma grub na de'i tshe khro bo'i rgyal po'i sngags sbyar te/stong phrag tsam rtog pa las gsungs pa'i grangs kyis nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /24dod13 1

de la sbyar ba ni/ oṃ ya mānta ka oṃ sgo ga ba ti 1swā hā hūṃ/ de bzhin du gzhan gyi yang sngags rnams sbyar la bzlas par bya'o/ /de ltar byas kyang ma grub thun/bdag gis byas pa'i zhe gnod sbyin ma'i mngon rtogs kyi tshul gyis 'dir bsgrub par bya'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan gyi rjayang bya ba dang spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor gye rgyud las bstan pa'i sgrub thabs thams cad/ dpal gshin rje'i 5gshed kyi rnal 'byor pas bsnyen pa bskyal ba dang / dgug pa la sogs pa 6dang mchod pa rnams cho ga bzhin du byas te/ bsgom )pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /de las skyo na bzlas pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di rnams rnal 'byor chen po'i nang nas gsungs pa'i sgrub thabs thams cad bsgrub par bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir na theg pa gzhan la yang gnas pa'i sgrub thabs sgrub par byed pa la the tshom du mi bya'o/ /sngags rnams yid bzhin nor bu ltar bsgrubs 9pa'i 'bras bu gcig tu ma nges pas so zhes so / / bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor rnams/ /de rnams don la khyad rnged kyang / /sems can bsam pa tha dad phyir/ /de bzhin phye nas bstan pa'o/ /'gro la phan pa de nyid kyis//'gro kun sgyu ma ltar gsungs kyang / /khrus la sogs pa dag 'dod pa/ /de la ci phyir bdag med bshad/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi rgyan rnams ni/ /snying rje'i ro dang ldan pas ni1 / /de phyir byang chub semanu/ dpa' yis/ /sgyu ma'i gdan ni bstan pa'o/ /bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor la/ /gang zhig blo ni chags gyur pas/ /des ni tshogs bsag khyad par du1 / /de las gsungs pa'i las bya'o1 / /dpa' bo'i 'khrugs —pas gzhan 'joms sam/ /yang na 'bros pa legs pa yin / /gnyis po spangs pa'i spyod pa de/ /dgos sapa med par ltung ba'i phyir/ /24—1345

rgyud rgyal rgya mtsho'i nang nas shin tu rin chen cho ga 'di/ /'gro la phan phyir dpal ldan gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs bton/ /de phyir 'di las rang gzhan don du rab tu sgrub par 3gyis/ /skabs don phan pa 'dod pa 'di las thos par mi 'gyur ram/ /'di nyid byed pa sems kyi rnam pa thams cad kyis/ /lus can rnams kyi sems ni rang dbang spros pa la/ /srid pa de srid thar pa 4rab tu khyad 5pa'i phyir/ /blo yi nor ldan bla ma dag la thogs dzi'agyur ram/ /skye shi nad kyi 7chu rlabs 'khrugs pa'i phreng ba can/ /srid chu'i ster 8las skye bo'i bsod nams 'dir thob shog /bdag kyang 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgur ni rab gyur te/ /srid pa gsum la phan byed 9ji srid nam mkha'i dbyings / /bzang ngan rnam par dpyod khupa'i rang bzhin grub mtha' dang / /'jam dpal zhabs kyi padma'i rdul tshogs mgos len cing / /sdig pa phra zhing chung la'ang 'jigs pa 1rtarab tu 'dzem/ /thos dang snying rje sbyin dang bzod pa des tshim pa'i/ /shes rab skyong gis dpal ldan gshin rje gshed tshogs tshabastan/ /gshin rje gshed kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so / / //rgya gar shar phyogs bhaṅga la'i paṇḍi ta dā na shī 1 la zhes bya bas gnas byin gyis brlabs pa drang srong srin po rir rang 'gyur du byas pa'o// //7 24—1346

0992༄/ /dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 2༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī rakta ya mā ri sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du / dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis dang por bdud bzhi bcom nas/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don du/ /mkha' la sprin bral nyi shar ji bzhin/ /phrin las g.yel ba rnged des skyongs shing 4/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'dam gyis gos pa'i/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha mthar 'phen byed/ /bskyed rdzogs 7zung 'jug gru 'dir 'jug la/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis 'bad par byed do/ /de nyid nyams su len par 'dod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor gang des dbeen pa'i gnas su/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du byas nas/ /kun rdzob chos kyis 6stong pa'i ngang las/ /srung 7ba'i 'khor lo chos 'byung dbus su/ /bzhi bcas drug cu'i 'dab ldan chu skyes/ /steng du 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i rdo rje/ /rgya gram lte ba la 24dod1348

gnas zlo 1las/ /byung ba rnam par thar pa'i khang pa/ /steng 'og phyogs su mnyam pa'i gru bzhi/ /sgo bzhi sgo khyud sgo 'gram logs ldan/ /bcu drug ka ba'i steng na mdzes pa'i/ /rta babs snam bu'i bang rim rnams la/ /mi'am ci sogs bu mo sgeg cing / /mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan rnams kyis glu len/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i nyi zla dang bcas/ /rin chen phreng ldan du ma — rnams dang / /bla re ba dan glang seng ka rgyan/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ri dwags dang ldan/ /'khor lo sogs kyis logs la mjes shing / /'khor lo'i rtse nas rin chen sna tshogs / /pha gu sogs kyis khor yug brgyan pa/ /'dod pa'i snam bu lha mor bcas shing / /ka ba brgyad ldan rdo rje'i gdung bzhis/ /bteg pa'i thog la nyi zla rdo rjes/ /kun nas mdzes pa'i 'og gi gzhi der/ /sna tshogs pad nyi ma te'i gdan la/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das ni/ /rā ga'i mdangs ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na dbyug pa mi mgo/ /rdo rje bsnams la oṃ sogs yi ges/ /rim par mtshan pa mkha' la 'phyar zhing / /g.yon pa 4bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pas/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud nga/ / /g.yas brkyang thal ba'i rgya spangs thod pa/ /skam po'i 5do shal 'phyang zhing 'khyud pa/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ma he'i rwa dang / /tshang ra brdzis nas bdud dpung zil gnon/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs khrag gi thigs pa/ /'dzag cing spyan gsum dmar po 'khrug pa/ /skra dang sma ra smin ma gyen brdzes/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan rgyan kun dmar po/ /dar dang stag sogs gos kyis 6g.yogs pa/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na/ /sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis med bzhugs pa/ /de yi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 7'phro 'dus/ /ye shes spyan 24—1349

drangs dgug gzhug byas la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur/ /lhag pa'i chu la mi bskyod rdo rje/ /rang lus las byung lha mo rnams kyis/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsis tshim par byas nas/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i spro bsdu'i bzlas pas/ /sems can don kun rdzogs par byas la/ /beer yang thams cad hūṃ la bsdus te/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhis rgyas gdab/ /chu la dzonya ldang ji bzhin tshul du/ /zung 'jug skur langs thun mtshams bya ba/ /ma lus byed pa sangs rgyas lam yin/ /dge ba 'di dang dge gzhan ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdus nas zung du 'jug pa'i sku/ /gshin rje byegashed dpal go 'phang thob gyur nas/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa la 'god par shog /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs lam gyi zhe snying po zhes bya ba mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor chen po budhe dzñā na pā das u ga ya na 'bar ba'i phug tu ḍa tī shwa 4ri badzra wā rā tī nyid las dngos su chothob nas lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas yi ger byas pa rdzogs so// //yul dbus kyi paṇḍi ta ā nanda 6bha dra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba se tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan kyis grong khyer chen po ti ra ha te'i lho phyogs rang byung gi mchod rten rnam par dag pa'i drung du yul dbus kyi dpe dang mthun par bsgyur cing bcos te gtan la phab pa7/ slar yang grub thob karṇa shrī'i zhal snga 8nas gnas brtan nyi ma rgyal mtshan kyis shrī na lend+ra'i 9gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //724—1350

༄ga /lus ngag yid gsubee byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ sna ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tre kā ya wāka tsiṭwā byeṣṭha no snyede sha nā ma/bod skad du/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag ces bya ba /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i 4gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon dam tshig sdom ldan pas/ /legs bshams 7mdun du maṇḍal la/ /lhag pa'i lha bsam phyi nang gi/ /mchod bstod gsol gdab byas 6rjes su/ /bdag mdun tha dad med par bya/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga dang / /nu ma'i bar du yi ge bzhi/ /de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu yi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes bsnyu/ /yon phul gsol gdab byas pa yis/ /slob ma rjes su gzung 7bar bya/ /yi ge bzhi las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /slob ma'i gnas bzhir rim gyis dbab/ /de yi mthu dang nus pa yis/ /snang gsal bde dang ro gcig pa/ /rim bzhin nyams su myong ba yis/ /lus ngag yid 24—/352

gsum bag chags bcas/ /ma lus spangs nas rdo rje bzhi'i/ /dngos grub sayo rnged thob pa nanya/ /bde chen 'di ni bde ba che/ /'di las gzhan pa'i bde ba gang / /gzhan du yod pa ma yin zhes/ /rdo rje'i dgra yis rnam par bsgrag /de rjes phyag rgyas maṇḍal dbul/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhi yis/ /gnyis su 'dzin pa'i 'khri 3shing bcad/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtha' dbus spang //'di ltar 'bad pa'i dge ba yis/ /thams cad phyag rgya chen por shog /slob ma rjes su gzung —ba lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //yul dbus kyi paṇḍi ta ā ngananda bha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba se tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis grong khyer chen po ti ra ha te'i lho phyogs rang byung gi mchod rten rnam par dag pa'i drung du yul dbus kyi dpe dang mthun 5par bsgyur cing bcos te gtan la phab pa'o// //beer yang grub thob 6karṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas mnyan te thar pa lo tsā ba gnas brtan nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis shrī na lend+ra'i 1gtsug lag khang chen por dag par bsgyur ba'o// //24—1353

mnyam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ tre satwa sa mā bye sa mā padhi 2nā ma/ bod skad du/ sems dpa' gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams kyis/ /rim sanyis rnam par gnas nas ni/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /spyos dang khro sa sked ro mnyam blta/ /lam gyi snying por bsten 4pa ltar/ /gti mug dus dgra'i sgu sogs su/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas bsnyus rnal 'byor pas/ /gtso bo 'pho ba'i tshul du bsam/ /brtan nas 5ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /nyi 'od 'phros pa 6phyogs bcur khyab/ /dngos kun 7dus dgra'i skur thal nas/ /bsdus te bdag la thim gyur pas/ /bdag nyid yar thim thig ler gyur/ /thig ler ye shes 'khor lo dgod/ /de yi 'od kyi phreng ba yis/ /bdag 24dod/353

sogs lha rnams gsal bar blta/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa'i rnal 'byor rim/ /snying ga'i ya yig dbus kyi hūṃ/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /ji ltar dbugs rlung rnge long la/ /thim pa ji bzhin hūṃ yig bsam/ /chu skyes padma'i lte ba'i hūṃ/ /yungs kar tshad tsam a la thim/ /snang ba 'od gsal ngang du rdzogs / /dang ba'i chu las nya ldang bzhin/ /thams cad stong pa'i ting 'dzin las/ /mtha' drug dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni/ /rtag tsosnachad bdag gzhan ma yin la/ /'khor 'das dus gsum rnam par spangs/ /phyi rol gzugs sogs yul snang rnams/ /bu ga'i lha yi snying gar bsdu/ /nang gi rnam rtog lha sku rnams/ /me shel lta bur snying gar thim/ /'od zer steng 'og ma lus pa/ /skar mda' lta bur rab 'phros pas/ /nam mkha'i bu ga rab 'byams khyab/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa las/ /gang skyes ye shes phyag rgya che / /mkha' ltar rang rig stong pa nyid/ /ro gcig mkha' mnyam ye shes bsgom—/ /thog mtha' dbus kyi dbye ba yis/ /'dir yang gcig tu yod min te/ /rdul phran la ni cha med phyir/ /du mar yang ni grub pa yin / /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin du/ /gang zhig bral te chos nyid yin/ /'khrul pa gnyis 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'khrul pa med/ /bskyed rim spro bsdus sems rtogs don/ /ro gcig gyur pa chos kyi dbyengs/ /de la byang chub mngon rtogs med/ /dngos por ma grub bsgom pa min/ /khams kyang min zhing rnam shes min/ /nam mkha'i dkyil dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa'i/ /chos ni 4bde ba chen po'o/ /'byung bzhi ma yin nam mkha' min/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i spyor ba yin5/ /bskyed pa 24—13'i6

'di la rab tu gnas/ /kun rdzob dngos kun dngos po min/ /de phyir de la dngos med bsgrag /rnal 'byor sems kyi sems rig pa/ /rtag chad phyag zhal sku mdog dang / /gnyis 'dzin dngos kun bden mod kyang / /'gag dred nyams la sna tshogs snang / /de ltar rig byas dkyil 'khor mchog /phung po khams su bdag med pa/ /bde ba dam pa'i gzugs can bsgom/ /sems dpa' gsum gyi rnal 'byor bzhi/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i phyir / /mkha' 'gro'i man ngag 'dir brjod do/ /spros pa thams cad rab 'i nas/ /spros med ye shes mngon sum du/ /'go ba kun gyis myong gyur nas/ /dus dgra mngon du byed gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi babyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i man ngag sems dpa' gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin 'a/ mnyam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje phag mos dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa1/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //yul dbus kyi paṇḍi ta ā nanda bha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba se tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gong khyer chen po ti ra ha ti'i lho phyogs rang byung gi mchod byen rnam par dag pa'i drung du yul dbus kyi dpe dang mthun par bsgyur zhing bcos te gtan la phab pa / slar yang grub thob karṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas mnyan te thar pa lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis shrī na lend+ra'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur ba'o// //

༄/ /'phags pa dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya shrī ya ma ā yuḥkā la sā dha na 2nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po sgrub pa'i thabs 'es bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes sprul sku'i thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ /phrin las rnam bzhi lam la brod pa bskyed/ /bskyed rdzogs lam gyi phra rags rtog pa bzlog /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub thabs gsal ba nyid du brjod par bya/ /dad dang snying rjes 'gro ba'i don mos shing / /dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du ni dbang thob pas / /shing gcig dur khrod la sogs gnas su ni/ /so phag ro ras la sogs stan la 'dug /drag po'i mchod gtor la sogs gzhung bzhin bsham/ /snying rje la sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ /kun la sgyu ma'i sems kyis gnas par bya/ /stong pa'i ngang las snod gyur gzhal yas khang / /thod mkhar dur 24dod1309

khrod bcas pa bsgom par bya/ /bcud gyur ya las 'od 'phros gshin rje ni1/ /dbus su tshe bdag yum dang bcas/ /rtsa ba'i lha lnga gshed bzhi dang / /g.yas su 'chi bdag g.yon du ni/ /srog bdag dmar po bsgom par bya /sngags brjod pa las lha rnams bskyed/ /de nas mchod yon byin gyis brlab/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi argha 2dang / /tshil chen spos la dug me tog /til chen me mar khrag chen dri/ /sha chen bshos la thod pa'i rnga/ /'dod yon lnga ru rab tu brtag /gtor ma dpa' bo'i ston mo yang / /ci 'byor cho gas byin brlab 4bya / /de nas ye shes spyan drang ba5/ /ma lus sems can mgon gyur pa/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 6khro bdag gtso/ /'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol / /thugs dam dbang gis brtan par bzhugs/ /oṃ ya ma badzra kro dha i 7a ra li hri tri/ zhes pas mdun du spyan drangs la/ /yid kyis phyag bya bstod pa brtsam/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha/ /sbrul dang thod rlon sna tshogs 9'dzin/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ /zhes pas lha rnams rang la bstem//'dod yon phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ /phud dang dpa' bo'i ston mos —mnyes par bya/ /mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med nam mkha' la/ /mchod dang bstod pa byed par bsam par bya/ /sdig bshags smon lam la sogs rgyas par bya/ /de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa gsal btab ste/ /brtan pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /skyo na ngag gi bzlas pa brtsam/ /bcu gsum brgya dang bzhi la sogs/ /las mthun pa yi bzlas pa bya/ / phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom 'dod na/ /byang chub sems gnas dbu ma'i mgor྾/ /gdod nas dag pa 'i 27—/360

thig le la/ /a shad nā da 1bcas pa bsgom/ /ri bong can la bcu gsum 2sngags / /rab tu bskor bar bsgom par bya/ /khams gsum gzugs la rab tu rdul/ /'gro 'ong sngags kyis brjod pas 'gog /thun bzhi la sogs rim pa yis/ /ji ltar brtan gyi bar du bsgom/ /dud pa la sogs rtags zad nas / /sprin med nam mkha' dngas 4pa na/ /mthar thug 'od gsal zhes brjod do/ /bdag dang gzhan don mos pa yis/ /lam la brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir / /phrin las rnam bzhi brtsam par bya/ /bskyed 5pa'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya6/ /rang snying 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ /dbus su oṃ yig dkar po bsgom/ /rtsibs brgyad 'bru brgyad bsam par bya/ /oṃ las 'od zer dkar byung bas/ /'bru brgyad dag la phog par 'bar/ /'bru brgyad dag las 8'od 'phros pas/ /dbus kyi hūṃ yig gso bskyed bya/ /bzlas pa tshang nas rtags byung na/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ gyur 'od zer dmar nag 'phros/ /'bru brgyad sngags rgyal rab tu ༷phog /'od zer 'phros dang 'khor lo ni/ /dmigs pas drangs nas bsgral bar bsam/ /'tshig dang khro snying 'dod pa dang / /mngon sum nyid du khugs pa na/ /mnan dang sreg pa'i las bya'o/ /spyor ba byang chub sems kyis zin/ /dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin bar chod rnged/ /rjes la bdag rnged rnal 'byor bya/ /nam mkha'i ngang du gsad bya'oḥ/ /de rnams kun nas btus pa yis/ /rgyud dang 'dra ba'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /bla ma'i zhabs pad brten pas blang / /gzhan du 'khrul 'khor rtsom 5pa na/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /sgrub thabs spyor ba 'di brtsams pas/ /'gro kun 'jam rgyal nyid gyur 2/dod/36/

cig /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i 1gshed tshe bdag nag po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1359 dzomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /'phags pa dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snam yu ka la swa dha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas/136spyo 7〈〈pe 〉〉gini/ 〈〈snar 〉sngagashed/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉srasarghaṃ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byug 4〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉brlabs—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drangs pa/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasheg tshur gsheg 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigashed kyi/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sku la brgyan/ /phyag mtshan gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs / 7〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo/ nyu1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rem par/ mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga stan/ mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sgoms/ lo〈〈pe 〉〉tsa mo'i don gnad/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsag mo'i don gnad/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamago/1361 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra dha/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngarangs/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sten/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa ni/ dzwa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dgur/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rgya la rab phog 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zhi'i/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rtsom ྾〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsams/1362 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/24—/362

sngal/ /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub bsgrub dang bar chad bsal ba'i phyir/ /gtor ma'i las la rnal 'byor 'bad par bya/ /hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ /bar snang la gnas 1bsam par bya/ /a las byung ba'i thod pa ni/ /de yi 'og tu 4bsam par bya/ /bdud rtsi oṃ kyis mtshan pa ni/ /de yi nang du bsam par bya/ /go ku da 5ha na/bi 6shu ra ma mu/ hūṃ khaṃ dzī māṃ rgyu7/ re las me yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /thod pa'i 'og tu bsam par bya/ /yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /me yi 'og tu bsam par bya/ /go las shar du ba glang sha /ku las lho ru khye yi sha /da 8las nub tu rta yi sha /ha las byang du glang chen sha /na las dbus su sha chen bsam / /bi 9las shar du dri chen bsam/ /shu las lho ru byang chub sems/ /ra las nub tu rang byung mtshal / /ma las byang du dri chu bsam/ /mu las 24—1361

dbus su sman chen bsam/ /shar du rgyu la lho ru dzee1/ /nub tu bye la 2byang du khaṃ / /dbus su hūṃ yig rnam par bsam/ / steng du rdo rje rgya gram bsgom/ /yam̐ las rlung byung me sbar la/ /thod pa dros pas bdud rtsi khol/ /rlangs las 'od byung rigs lnga 4bskul/ /ye shes bdud rtsi phab la bstem/ /rdo rje yig 'bru bcas pa zhu/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ /gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa dbul/ /mchod bstod smon lam rgyas par bya/ /oṃ ya ma kā la sarba tu pa sata ma hā ba li i dam kṛṇḍa kṛtna kha kha dekhā hi khā hi/ gtor ma dbul 7ba6 / /bsdur mchan/1364 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde bstan dkar chag 〉rdzar bkod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snod/ 〈〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa'i/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkatu/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ 3〈〈pe 〉khe/ rdza/ e/bye / 〈〈snar 〉dza dzi/ i/ bye/ 〈〈bee 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bhi/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatshal/1365 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabrum las lho ru e/ 2〈〈pe 〉sngag la/ 〈〈snar 〉sngag las/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snod/4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gitna grisna kha khā/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'o/24—1365

bar chad bsal ba 1༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrib 2dang bar chad nye bar bsal ba'i phyir/ /khrus kyi snod dag mdun du brtan —par bya/ /lto ldir mgrin pa phra ba'i bum pa la/ /kha tshar ma nyams ras kyis mgul chings bya/ /'bras bu lo 'dab ma nyams kha rgyan can/ /lus ngag yid gsum dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum ldan pa'i chu yis dgang / /phung po lnga po dag par bya ba'i 5phyir/ /'bru sna lnga yi snying po ldan par bya/ /yan lag lnga po dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /sman sna lnga yi dri dang ldan par bya/ /ye shes lnga po rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /rin chen lnga yi snying po ldan par bya/ /bdag lus lha yi rnal 'byor 6ldan pa yis/ /rgyu 7las bum pa gzhal yas khang chen bsam/ /dbus su ya las bcom ldan 8gshin rje'i gshed/ /gshed bzhi 'khor dang phyi rol bcas pa bskyed/ /gzungs thag rang gi 1 snying 24—1367

gar bzung 1nas ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sngags kyi bzlas pa 2bya/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /skud pa'i lam nas yab kyi thugs kar zhugs / /tshur la 'phros pas rang gi hūṃ la thim/ /bcu gsum sngags la rten 'byel btags 4pa bzlas/ /'od dang du ba byung byung bsnyen pa bya/ /bsnyen pa thon nas gtsang ba'i dbus 'dus nas/ /5yab yum gnyis med snyoms par zhugs pa yis6/ /byang chub sems kyi chu yis khrus bya'o/ /khrus kyi cho ga sgrib pa spyong zhing bar chod bsal 7ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1267 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—dag —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharten/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa pa'i/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgod/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shaṃ/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'das/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkukhor bcad/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rirangagi/1268 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉rkazung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadzin snga gas kyi 'gro bzlog bsgom par/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7hūṃ rang bi snying ga'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartags/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snganas su 'dug nas ni/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉yi 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/tsho7 ——/368

0998༄/ /dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ya ma ā yu kā la maṇḍa la bi byeḥ2/ bod skad du/ dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das gsung gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyis mun pa gtan bcom zhing / /gsang ba'i 'od kyis bde ba skyed byed pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'jam rgyal rdo rje la/ /lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal 4nas/ /gsang sngags lam gyi sgron ma 'di nyid la/ /mos dang dad pa gang zhig yod pa yi/ /rnal 'byor brtson pa rnams la phan bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di nyid bshad par bya/ /bla ma mkhas shing rtogs ldan dam tshig ldan pa dang / /brtse dang bsam gtan bsgoms pas byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / /dman spangs dad pas 'gro ba yang dag 'dren pa ste/ /'di ni bla ma'i 'os te 'gro ba'i don byed pa'o/ /bla ma la gus rtog meed snying rje can/ /24—/370

rtag tu chos 'dod dad pa brtan 'gyur zhing / /bzod ldan btang shel spro ba'i gang zag ni/ /'di ni rjes su gzung —'os slob ma'i 'os/ /chu gling dur khrod la sogs dbeen gnas su/ /rdzas dang yo byad 'tshogs —snapar bsnyen pa brtsam /maṇḍal bye dor cime tog bkram byas la/ /mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma cha 5gsum bsham / /bla re 6la sogs rgyan byernams dgram par bya/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug pas rnal 'byor bya/ /byang chub sems bskyed tshad med bzhi po bsgom/ /yan lag bdun po yongs su rdzogs par bya/ /'gro don gsol gdab smon lam sdogs par bya/ /de rjes stong pa'i rnal 'byor rjes su dran par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ā kopho8haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba 9rim brtsegs bsgom/ /yi re baṃ lo/ rlung me chu dang gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng / /rgyu 7las gzhal yas khang chen rnam par bsam/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan/ /khyams stod khyams smad steng 'og bar dang bcas/ /ka ba brgyad dang thod 1chen zlum skor mdud1 / /dra ba dra phyed rnga yab chun 'phyang brgyan/ /'dod yon lha mo rnams dang bcas pa'i dbus/ /dur khrod brgyad ldan thod pa'i gzhal yas khang / /dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba la/ /7padma nyi ma'i sasteng du ru tra yab yum gdan7/ /ya dang ma las rab brjod yab yum gnyis / /gnyis med phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing khro bo'i zhal//sbyan dgu sdang mig gyen du bzlog sapas 'jigs/ /mche ba dkar po zla tshes srid pa sgrol/ /dbu skra kham pa gyen brdzes sma ra ser/ /sbrul dang thod pa skam zlon dbu rgyan can/ /zhing dang glang chen ko rlon stag sham gsol/ /g.yas pa 24—1371

'khor lo ral gri rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa thod dbyug gtun 1shing sdigs mdzub can/ /mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal phreng bas mdzes/ /yum ni khro mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /g.yas pa snying stobs g.yon pa thod khrag 'dren/ /'jigs pa'i cha byad chags pa'i spyan gyis blta/ /thugs kar hūṃ las gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang / /ljang nag gcer bu rdo rje sdigs mdzub can/ /khros pas klu za padma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /spyi gtsug khro las bya khyung ga ru ḍa/ /ser po gnam lcags mchu sder klu sbrul za/ /lto bar rus sbal ser po rngom pa'i zhal/ /sder mo gnam lcags kha gdangs spyan rtsa dmar/ /shar phyogs ya ma rā dza smug nag gzugs / /zhing dang stag sham sbrul gyi chun 'phyang brgyan/ /'khor lo'i 4rtsibs la zhing gi gdan can bsgom/ /lho ru myos byed 'bar ba ser nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /nub tu gshin rje dmar po dmar nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs / /byang du ral pa tshar dgu ljang nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /g.yas na 'khor lo g.yon na dbyug to bsnams/ /rgyan dang na bza' cha lugs 'dra ba bsgom/ /mtshams bzhir 5yum bzhi bsgom pa yab dang 'dra/ /skad cig chu las nya ldang tshul du babyed/ /bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' gsal ba dang / /grub pa'i gnas las ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /rang dang 'dra ba dur khrod brgyad dang bcas/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs 7spyan drangs gnyis med bstem/ /bstod pa rnams kyis bstod cing mchod pa dbul/ /sku gsung thugs byen gyis brlab dbang bsgur blang / /'phro 'du bsnyen 'dzin bya zhing bsnyen pa bgrang / /gtso bo la ni 'bum mam rtags sbyar bya/ /'khor la khri ste grangs kyi bsnyen pa yin/ /mtshan ma bzang po mthong na sgrub pa brtsam/ /2tsho7——/372

dus tshod tshes grangs bza' kyiskar bzang po la/ /sa chog sta gon gang rung rgyas bsdus bya/ /tshogs sog hūṃsgrib pa sbyang phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ /maṇḍal byi dor byas la mchod pa bsham/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed la sogs bya/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas pa yisacho / /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor gzhung dang mthun par bri/ /bskyed dang spyan drang sdo7mchod bstod rdzogs par bya/ /sngon du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga yang / /'og nas 'byung bzhin dbang bskur blang bar bya/ /slob ma 'jug pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ /yol ba'i mtha' nas yon dbul gsol gsum gdab/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sgu/ /bla ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung / /bla ma'i gsung la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi rang bzhin thugs/ /bla ma'i thugs la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /'jam rgyal rdo rje 'khor lo yis/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ /zhes brjod phyag 'tshal te khume tog gtor/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /mgon po chen po tshul bstan pa/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de nas bla mas gnang ba sbyin par bya7/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya//sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /24—1373

da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gye 1gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pa/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan 'di brnyes2/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med des/ /skyob pa dpal ldan 'jam rgyal gyis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu khyod kyis skyabs tshol cig /'jam rgyal rdo rje la sogs te/ /'khor lo bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /kun la rtag tu skyabs song cig /de nas slob mas 'di skad brjod/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo dang / /'jam rgyal rnam snang la sogs te/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung nas/ /tshangs spyod gnyis rnged sar gnas par/ /bdag gis sdom pa legs par gzung 4/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol/ /thub pa nyi ma ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /slob dpon dpang 5 du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol pa las byung ba'i/ /mi ldog pa yi 'khor lo spyor/ /thar pa'i rang bzhin grong mchog tu/ /slob dpon bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ /de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /rtog pa rnams ni legs par bsdus nas kyang / /shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems 6sogs kyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /dkon mchog gsum la 2(— /37 /

skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /khro mchog khyod kyis gzung nyabar gyis/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje / /rdo rje dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs mchog dag pa yi/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum / /dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar gyis/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar gyis/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /kha na ma tho sgom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad 4mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa log par mi spyod cing / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsar 'gyur ba'i5/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems gdul ‘phyir ni rtog 7pa yi/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang 8/ /dam tshig rnams ni nyer brten / cing / /rnal 'byor dbang po ༷bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su skyongs/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /'gro ba'i don la rgyab phyogs min//'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi phyogs / /lha dang lha min gsang ba la/ /khyod kyis brnyas pa mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin 27—/37pya

par gsungs/ /khyod kyis kyang ni srung bar gyis/ /de nas slob mas 'di skad brjod / /mgon po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ma lus bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dus 'di nyid nas sangs rgyas par/ /bla med bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgye/ /sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa tshodang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung 2bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu sde phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung 4 bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu spyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba 5theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung 6bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po yi7/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung (bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa'i/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bkyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma rgal 11ba rnams bdag gis sgrol1 / /ma grol ba ni grol bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 24—/376

'das la dgod/ /de ltar lan gsum khas blangs pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i slob ma la/ /me tog la sogs mchod par hūṃbya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yā tha su khaṃ su ra ta stesnye / zhes pas 1rdo rje gnas gsum gtug /'di ni phyi 'jug cho ga ste/ /nang 'jug rim pa bstan pa ni/ /las kyi bum pas khrus byas te/ /gdong g.yogs bcings la skal ldan bri / /yol ba'i nang du drang bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod su zhig yin/ /bdag ni skal ba bzang po'o/ /dzaḥzhes pas ni shar sgo nas/ /lha snam steng du phyin par bsam / /hoḥyis byang du baṃ kyis nub/ /hūṃ gis lho sgo nas zhugs nas/ /lha snam steng du phyin par bsam/ /lha yi dam tshig 5bsgrag pa ni/ /deng khyod lha rnams thams cad dang / /slob dpon gyis ni byin rlabs 6kyis/ /dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang rigs kyi khro bo rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / rigs kyi khro bo rnams kyi dngos grub kyang 'grub par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang 7ci dgos / de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya'i / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams dang / dad pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re zhes brjod la slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje gzhag/'jam rgyal rdo rje deng khyod kyis9/ /snying la yang dag zhugs pa ni/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral nas gshegs/ /de nas mna' chu drud pa ni/ /thod pa'i nang du dri chu la/ /bdud rtsi gtab pa 1 yi ge gsum/ /bzlas pa'i tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje 24—1377

bdud rtsi'i 1chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta ga thā/ zhes brjod pas ni blud par bya/ /de nas dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ /deng phan chad khyed kyi — 'jam pa'i rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba yang yin pa de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /byas na khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par che'i dus byas nas dmyal bar tring bar gyur ta re zhes brjod do/ /de nas ye shes dbab par bya ste maṇḍal la slob ma blang bar bya ste/ rkang pa gnyis brkyang la gzhu'i dbyibs dang 4/ lag pa brkyang la thal mo sbyar bar bya ste / yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor rkang 'og tu/ /gsang bar me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum gsal5/ /lte bar yi ge dzhai 6ni rab 'bar bsam yo las rlung byung rnge yi dkyil 'khor bskyed7/ /lte bar dzhai spros 'od kyis lus gang bsam / /dbugs kyang cung zhig nang du 'then par bya/ /shes pa gzhan du ma yengs rig pa nang du gzir/ /spos kyi dud pas sna sgor bdug par bya/ /rnga brdung dril bu gsel zhing sngags 'di bzlas/ /oṃ ra ra tsa la ya a bee sha ya a ā dzee7/ ye shes dbab par gyur pa la/ /de la tiṣṭha badzra brjod/ /de nas snang ba bstan pa ni/ /kye he ru ka myu gu rdo rje/ /rang gi dngos po ji ltar snang / /zhes brjod bltas 1 pas dkar ser sogs྾/ /snang bas zhi rgyas la sogs 'grub/ /de nas me tog dor ba ni/ /me tog thogs nas shar sgo nas / /pra tītstsha sabadzra ho/ zhes pas dal du 'thor du gzhug /gang la bab pa lha ru gzung / /rigs dang mthun pa'i gsang mtshan gdags/ /oṃ pra ti kṛṇḍi rka swa mi saṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes pas slob ma'i mgo la bcing / /de nas gdong g.yogs dgrol ba ni/ /mig gnyis oṃ las 'od zer bsam rdo 3(— /378

rje rtse mos mig la gtugahūṃ /'jam dpal 3rdo rje deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i —mig ni bla na med/ /de ring nyid du 'byed par shog /oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lam̐ hūṃ/ zhes pas gdong g.yogs dgrol bar bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /da shāni 'jam rgyal rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /dngos grub kun khyod mngon sum 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad skyong khyeb dang / /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /de nas lha rnams ngo yang bstan/ /'di ni 'jug pa'i yan lag go/ /de nas tshogs te 7yon phul nas/ /phyag btsal thal mo sbyar bas 'dug /de la bum pa'i dbang bsgur ba/ /bum pa thogs la spyi bor gzhag /bum pa yum gyi rang bzhin las/ /snying po rig 9sngags nyid du bsam/ /ji ltar bltams 7pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ1 / zhes pa dang / khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa 5sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /rnge long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /zhe sdang rnam dag mi bskyod pa/ /dpal ldan chu yis dbang bsgur ro/ /zhes pas chu sbyin no//de nas cod pan gyi dbang sbyin pa/ cod pan rigs lnga'i 2rang bzhin las/ /rin chen rigs bdag nyid du bsam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /24—/379

dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna mu gu ṭa ky-i.a bhe ṣiñtsa 2rma / tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pa'i — / /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis/ /nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan gyi/ /cod pan gyis nguni dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas cod pan sbyin/ de nas dril bu'i dbang sbyin pa/ /dril bu gsung gi rang bzhin las/ /gsung mchog rigs bdag nyid du bsam/ /'jam dbyangs rdo rje dril bu'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /'jam rgyal rdo rje rab bsgrub phyir/ /dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis long snye/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye khupa ti ste 7a bya ṣispyo (mi tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya ste/ 'du shes phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis/ /'dod chags snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /dril bu yis ni dbang bsgur ro/ /zhes pas dril bu gsil du gzhug /de nas rdo rje'i dbang sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje las kyi rang bzhin las/ /khong gseng kherigs bdag nyid du bsam/ /'jam dbyangs rdo rje las kyi dbang / /de ring khrod la bsgur bar bya/ /'jam rgyal rdo rje las bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra karma a bhe ṣispyo mi tiṣṭha badzra gaṇḍi —sa ma ya ste / 'du byed phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa yi/ /rdo rje yis ni dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas rdo rje rgya gram snying gar gzhag /de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba/ /slob ma'i spyi bor oṃ las ni/ /'khor lo de las rnam snang bskyed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab bsgrub phyir//rdo rje ming 'di khyod kyis long / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta na ma bi shudhe 1 dharma dhā tu dzñā 24dod/380

na a dzha ṣiñtsa 1rma/ kye rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya bas ming dbang sbyin/ spyi bor rdo rje dril bu bzung la/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /gti mug rnam par snang mdzad kyithu/ /dpal ldan ming gi dbang bsgur ro/ /rdo rje dril bu'i brtul zhugs dbang / /lag tu rdo rje dril bu gtad/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sibye badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa shaṃ dha jer ya mi badzra satwa /phyanyi nyi hi ti hūṃ/'gying ba'i tshul du 'dug nas ni/ /rdo rje gsor la dril bu gsilatre7/ /de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskur ba/ /'khor los log lta tsugacod par byed/ /dbyug tos gzung 'dzin rab spangs pa'i/ /phyag mtshan gyis ni dbang bskur ro//rgyan cha'i dbang yang bskur bar bya/ /mgul rgyan gdu bu ske rags dang / /do shal dang ni sna bdun te/ /rgyan cha yis ni dbang bskur ro/ /sku yi na bzas 9dbang bskur ba/ /glang chen zhing dang stag lpags gos/ /na bza' yis ni dbang bskur ro/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bsgur ro / /rdo rje dril bu lag tu gtad/ /thog mtha' rnged pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /zhes 11pas rdo rje g.yas su spyin/ /'di lha thams cad kyi bdag po kun du bzang po yin par kyis shig ces brjod do/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis 'gal srid byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa mchog tu grub par byed/ /zhes 2pas dril bu 24—/381

'khrol du gzhug /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam pa 1'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni de 2bzhin du/ /rang dang lha yi spyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /zhes brjod pas ni phyag rgya che/ /sku ru rgyun du bsgom du gzhug /mig —gnyis la ni rdo rje dkar/ /nas 'bras tsam pa bsam byas la/ /gser las byas pa'i thur ma yis/ /spyan 'byed tshul du dbye bar byed/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis//'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badzra nai tra a ba ha ra pa ta lo tri5/ zhes pas mig 'byed tshul du gzhug6 /sku'i dbang mda' dang gzhu yin te/ /ho yig lhag mthong mda' drug dang / /zhi gnas rang bzhin gzhu byin la/ /phyogs bzhi steng dang 'og tu 'phang / /khyod kyis zhi gnas lhag mthong gis/ /phyogs rnams thams cad dbang du kyis/ /gsung gi dbang phyug dril bu ni/ /chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' sems dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /thugs kyi dbang rnge long bstan 7pa yin te/ hūṃ zhes me long rab bstan la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa rnged/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos nyid shes nas ni/ /sems can don la mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la 2(— /382

zhugs / /zhes pa'o/ /kye bu khyod kyi gang lhag pa'i lha'i bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod do/ /bsgom pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pas lku/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje 'khor bcas rnams/ /bsgom pa dag la brtson par gyis/ /zhes pa'o/ /sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ /bcom ldan 'di la pal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pos gzung hūṃ/ /nam yang gtong ༄ bar ma byed cig /lan gsum brjod la gnang ba sbyin/ /slob ma'i lag tu phreng ba gtadari/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi phyed pa'i/ /gsang sngags bla na med pa ste/ /snying po yid bzhin nor bu yizhi/ /skyob pa sngags kyis dbang bskur ro/ /slob mas tshig tu 'di brjod blang / /bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi7/ /bdag la 'go —bar mdzad du gsol/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan po yis/ /nam du yang ni mi gtang ḍango / /zhes pa yis ni sngags bzlas so/ /gar gyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ /deng 7nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rje btsun lha dang dpa' bo la/ /shes rab thabs kyi 11bsnyems chen gyi/ /gar mchod bde bas mchod dga' bgyidasnya/ /zhes pas gar byed tshul du bya/ /glu yi rjes su gnang ba ni/ /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /khyod mukyis glu ni blang bar bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma de dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas chos don glu yang blang / /mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ /sangs rgyas sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang / /lha yi chu rgyun dag pa yis/ /rgyal ba rnams la sku khrus gsol / /sku gsung thugs la yon chab 'di gsol bas/ /rnam rtog nyon 24—1383

mongs dri ma dag gyur cig /sgeg dang bcas pa'i me tog phreng / /sangs rgyas kun sogs 'jam dbyangs la/ /nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan rmyeyin no/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim gyur cig /chos kyi mar me legs sbar 2bas/ /padma gar dbang bdag nyid de/ /sems can ma rig zuldongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron mes 4snang gyur cig /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam gol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /dri sked rgyal ba rnams kyi drisasnye/ /lus can byang chub thob gyur cig /zhal zas ro mchog 'di 5phul bas/ /ro drug sred pa dag gyur te/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin zas mchog ldan/ /gnyis su med pa'i ro rtogs shog/rol mo glu gar sgra snyan tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /khu byug gzhon nu'i skad 'dra 'di phul bas/ /bde gshegs sku yi mnyes dang ldan gyur cig /lha yi rna ba rnam dag thob gyur cig /ces pa'o/ /dngos grub rjes su gnang ba ni/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi po dang / /bskrad dang bcing ⑩dang rengs la sogs/ /las de rnams ni grub par gyis/ /spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ /dang po las kyi spyod pa dang / /nyon mongs gsang ba'i spyod pa dang / /kun du bzang po'i spyod pa la8/ /go rims 9bzhin du bslab ⑫par gyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon rjes gnang ni/ /sems can sdug bsngal bsal 1bya'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /khyod ni the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /24—/384

dri med kun du gang bar gyis/ /dung bud gdugs dang po ti sbyin/ /de nas lung bstan sbyin pa ni/ /rang nyid 'jam dpal ting 'dzin kyis/ /g.yon pa khu tshur bcang byas te/ /chos gos 'dzin pa'i tshul du bya/ /g.yas pa skyabs spyin phyag rgya bcas/ /oṃ nga yis 'di ltar lung bstan te/ /'jam dpal hūṃrdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu sgrub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro'i 2gnas nas bton/ /kye che ge mo myu gu rdo rje/ /gnas che ge mo zhes bya ba / /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /rdo rje 'chang chen por mngon par sdogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /siddhi bhur bhu wa swaḥ —7/ 'di ltar lung bstan dus dag tu/ /sngags pa bde gshegs kun lhan cig /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /mgrin gcig tu ni lung bstan mdzad/ /de ltar lung bstan gyur pa 'di/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu yin pas/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i nus pa la/ /yid ches pa ni dad par gyis/ /lung bstan thob nas sems bde ba/ /de ni gzengs bstod pa ru 5'dod/ /dbugs dbyung pa yi cho ga ni/ /mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol ba'i/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni legs par gnas/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi sod pa/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar kyis/ /dam tshig sdom pa grub par kyis / /rtag tu khyed 6kyis bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs / /dam pa rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /di 7ring bdud las rnam par rgyal / /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyed rnams kyis 8ni sangs rgyas sa / /di 9ring thob par the tshom med/ /de nas slob ma cho ga rdzogs pa 24—1385

de1 / /rgyal ba rnams kyis sras su 'dzin pa yin/ /mchod pa'i bye brag rnams kyang de la bya/ /slob mas bla ma dam pa'i drin dran phyir/ /tshogs dang gtor ma mchod pa'i bye brag dang / /'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams ni de la mchod / /rta dang glang po yul zhing bud med kyang / /bla ma dam pa de la mchod phyir dbul/ /de bzhin dbul ba'i — cho ga rgyas gyur pas/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur 'dod pas gsol ba gdab/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa bteg 4la bsod nams bsag5 /phyag 'tshal 6maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi7/ /spyan sngar slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /khyod zhabs padma spangs nas ni/ /bdag la gzhan nas skyabs ma mchis/ /ngag gi dri ma sbyang mdzad pa'i/ /dbang bskur mchog ni bdag la gsol/ /dzee ltar 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang bskur ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bsgur ro/ /de nas dbang bskur sbyin pa ni/ /mtshan ldan thod pa'i bdud rtsi la/ /sren lag g.yon pas blangs nas ni/ /slob ma'i lce la gzhag par bya/ /ye shes dbab pa dus kyi nyams/ /de nyid du ni dran par bya/ /nyams dang bdud rtsi ro myang bas/ /bde ba byes pa gang yin pa/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni thob pa yin9 / /de yi dam tshig dbog pa ni/ /sha chen byang sems myos pa'i chu/ /rakta dri chen rdo rje'i chu/ /'di drug khyod kyi dam tshig ste/ /skal ldan khyod kyis rtag tu skyongs/ /mchod dang gtor ma gtang 7ba dang / /yon phul zhabs pad spyi bos blang / /'di ni gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o 1/ /24—/386

shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ba/ /mchod dang gtor ma tshogs mchod sogs / /gzhung bzhin bteg la yon phul nas/ /gsum pa zhu ba'i gsol ba gdab/ /oṃ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /spyan sngar slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje la/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bstan nga/ ltar/ /yid kyi dri ma sbyang 1mdzad pa'i/ /dbang bskur mchog ni bdag la stsol / /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na pred / /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas/ /de nas dbang bskur sbyin pa ni/ /g.yon pa'i srin mjeb gnyis po yis /bdud rtsi blangs la spyi bo dang / /snying ga ste ba gsum la reg /lte bar hūṃ la dmigs pa gtad/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa gnyis srin mtheb kyis/ /dal gyis mnan la bde ba dang / /bla mas bde stong nyams dran pas/ /slob mas rgyud la gos par bsam/ /bde stong nyams de skyes pa na/ /mchod pa phul la dam tshig dbog /slob dpon dang ni rig ma la/ /phung po lnga la mnyes byed pa/ /dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /khyod kyis srog bzhin bsrung bar gyis/ /de nas phyag byas yon phul la/ /bde ba'i sems kyis gnas par bya/ /de nas bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /sngon du slob mas bla ma la/ /maṇḍal mchod dang yon phul la/ /bzhi pa bskur bar gsol ba gdab/ /oṃ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /spyan sngar slob dbon dgongs su gsol//dri ma rnam gsum spyong mdzad pa'i/ /dbang bsgur mchog ni bdag la spyod/ /de nas maṇḍal me tog bkram pa la/ /'dug 4ste rkang pa'i long bu gshibs5/ /rtse tog thogs te thal mo sbyar/ /drang por brkyang la lus po bsgrim6/ /sna rtser 27—/387

'khor lo 'khor ba la/ /rig pa gtad de bde ba gzung lku/ /'dar dang g.yo dang smra dang dgod/ /shes pa bde ba thob de lasathu/ /ye shes rnal du phebs pa na/ /me long bstan la don bstan bya/ /kye he ru ka myu gu che ge mo/ /chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid kyis skyes pa ste rkyen las skyes pa'o/ /de yang dper na me long gi rkyen gyis 4gzugs su snang ba bzhin du sngon gyi smon lam dang gdul bya las dag pa'i dbang gis chos nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba las yul rnam 'phrul du shar ba ste don chos nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /kye che ge mo khyed phyanyams gang shar ba de nga la sgos shig /de'i tshe shes pa gsal ba las / /mi rtog dziskye ba gang yin pa/ /des gzung med pa'i nyams shar ba/ /'di ltar byung zhes brjod du med/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po'i nyams/ /de la dam tshig bstan pa ni/ /dang 7bas bla ma gnyan dāpar bya/ /rgyud la shar ba'i phyag rgya che/ /nam yang rjed 9par mi bya'o/ /dman la mos pa'i gang zag dang / /nam yang mi 'grogs dbeen pa bsten/ /dbang bzhi thob par ma gyur pa'i/ /gang zag rnams la de yi don/ /tshig tu brjod par mi rkabya'o/ /de nas bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /phyag dang mchod dang gtor ma dang / /tshogs dang yon dbul bskur ste sabya/ /'di ni bzhi pa'i cho ga'o/ /gang zhig lus ngag dag pa yis1 / /bde ba 'dod pas zab mo'i don/ /bla ma'i zhabs pad brten sbyipas blang / /gzhan yang phyag rgya la brten pa'i/ /dbang bzhi 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ /man ngag las byung cho ga yis/ /dbeen pa'i gnas su yang dag brtsam5/ /bsod nams 'dod dang thar pa rab brtson pa'i/ /gang zag dam pa rnams kyi don bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga rdzo4—1388

rgyas dang bsdus 1pa las/ /dge ba gang yin sems can don du bsngo/ /dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dran pa gsal ba zhes bya ba / dpal nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta chen po nag po'i zhabs de nyid dang / lo tsā ba gnyan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/137༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ga /tshe bdag nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dran pa gsal ba zhes bya ba nag pos mdzad pa paṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ sde〈〈pe 〉ra ba'i/ je〈〈snar 〉〉phyags tsal/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodang ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibasgoms pas/1371 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatong / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshogs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 byas pas/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cags/ spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bye/ 7〈〈snar 〉rabargyan/ da 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—lha—/ 9 〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbye/ 1 〈〈snar 〉〉ngathod/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadung /nyu2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rgyas pa'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 phyogs bzhi gnag la mtshalas bzhi dmar// mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉skadan/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zlog1372 me 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartun/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gim/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 yab/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 nga / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 byin/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drang /1373 sna—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagaza'/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉sogs/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngadri/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yi/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang / khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7te/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkaparabya/1374 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyid mnyes/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodag je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / 5〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rnamang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dpa'/1375 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi bzung / 〈〈snar 〉〉rdo rje de/ 〈〈pe 〉sngagazung / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sad/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis rtsar gyur pa'i/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradul/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masags/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉24—1389

༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya mañdzu shrī na — ma sadhī ti nā ma ma hā ṭī kā/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgro dang skur pas stong pa yi / /ngo bo nyid kyis bde ba che/ /utpal dang ni ral gri 'dzin/ /gzhon nur gyur la phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshig rgyas pa yi rgyud dag las/ /zab mo glu yi le'u dag /'dir ni bdag gis dbye bar bya/ /de la 'dir bdag gis mgon po 'jig rten dbang phyug las ji ltar thos pa bzhin bri bar bya'o/ /de la rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag dag ni/dgos pa dag med na 'jug par mi 'gyur bas na / de'i phyir rgyud 'di brjod par bya ba ni gang / dgos pa ni gang / dgos pa'i dgos pa ni gang /'byel pa ni gang zhe na/ brjod par bya ba ni 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' 24—1392

kho na yin la/ dgos pa ni theg pa sna tshogs kyi don rtogs pa'o/ /dgos pa'i dgos pa ni sku gsum dang ye shes lnga thob par byed pa'o/ /'byel pa ni thabs she dang thabs las byung ba'i mtshan nyid kyis 'byel par gnas so/ /de la rgyud 'di rgo nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud yin te/ bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / gnyi ga dang / rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang / rgyud thams cad kyi bshad rgyud yin te/ rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /ces pas gsal lo/ /theg pa thams cad kyi gal 'gegs yin te/ jeg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /zhes pas gsal lo/ /gzhung mi mthun pa mang po dag rang gi 'dod pa'i ngos nas smra ste de dag gis ni rgyud 'di'i cha shas tsam las ma rtogs te/ rang rang gi rtog pa la bden par 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la re zhig bsdus pa'i don bshad par bya ste/ gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa dang / rgyud dngos dang / rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /gleng gzhi la gsum ste/ 'khor dang ston pa dang bstan pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /rgyud dngos ni/ yi ge gcig pa'i rgyud de —a yig gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /mu stegs ri dwags zhes pa dang / /kun don yon tan gsum gyi bdag /ces pas mu stegs kyi lta ba bstan te/ bden pa gnyis ni rtogs pa bo/ /phyir mi ldog pa phyir mi 'ong / /zhes pas nyan thos kyi lta ba bstan to/ /'dren pa rang rgyal bse ru'i tshul/ /nges 'byung sna tshogs las byung ba/ /zhes pas rang rgyal ba'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa bstan to/ /rnam rig sna tshogs gzugs don can / /rnam shes sna tshogs rgyud dang ldan/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid las skyes/ /zhes pas rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lta ba bstan to/ /gnyis med 24—1393

gnyis su med par ston/ /zhes pas zung 'jug gi ngo bo ste sgyu ma lta bu bstan to//bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas/ /yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas/ /zhes rtepas rab tu gnas pa'i don bstan to/ /yang dag mtha' ste yi ge med/ /ces pas gsang sngags bla na med pa'i mthar thug pa'i don bstan to/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po/ /zhes pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa bstan to/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes pas lha skad cig dran rdzogs kyis bskyed par bstan to/ /rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ zhes sgrogs/ /mtshon du rdo rje'i mda' thogs pa/ /rdo rje ral gris ma lus gcod/ /rdo rje sgu 'chang rdo rje can/ /zhes pas cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa bstan te/ rdo rje gdan ni ma lus ldan/ /zhes pas gdan skyed snyepa bstan to/ /ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /zhes pas dbang bskur ba'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa bstan to/ /ngan song thams cad rnam spyong ba/ /zhes pas ro sreg rgepa'i cho ga bstan to/ /ye shes me lce 'od 'bar gsal/ /zhes pas sbyin sreg 3gi cho ga bstan to/ /bsam gtan yan lag kun shes shing / /zhes pas grub mtha' de dag so so'i sgom hūṃpa bstan to/ /yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das/ /zhes pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi po'i pertse mo can/ /zhes pas mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs pa'i 8rim pa bstan to/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /ces pas mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim bstan to/ /da ni dkyil 'khor bstan par bya ste/ de la/ dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin / /zhes pas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi don 'dir rtogs par bya'o/ /khyad par gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /24—1394

—'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ 1395zhes pas rigs kyi gtso bo yin pas rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /gtsang gnas dam pa go ta ma/ /zhes pas shākya thub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces pas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ /zhes pas gzhon nu gdong drug gi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /ha la ha la gdong brgya pa/ /zhes pas 'jam dpal gdong brgya pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /zhes pas gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ /zhes pas 'jam dpal kun du zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor can/ /zhes pas dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /lha'i dbang po zhes pas khyab 'jug gi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /lha yi bla zhes pas tshangs pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /lha yi bdag po zhes pas brgya byin gyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /lha min bdag ces pas rā hu la'i dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /lha yi bla zhes pas gza' phur bu'i dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /'joms byed ces pas gza' thags zangs ris she/kyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /'joms byed phyi mas ni tresrin po'i rgyal po lang ka 1mgrin bcu'i dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /dbang phyug po zhes pas ma hā de ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs//zhes pas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /de las tshogs bsags zipa dag gis ni sa dang / lam dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo nas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la bstod pa bstan to/ /ting 'dzin lus can lus kyi mchog /longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal/ /sprul 24—1395

pa'i sku ste sku yi mchog /ces pas 'bras bu bstan to/ /de dag dang ye shes rnam pa lnga dang / 'dis bsdus rgyas kyi bstod pa shes par bya'o / /kṇide ltar bsdus pa'i don rab tu rtogs nas/ tshig gi don bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ de nas zhes bya ba ni sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i grele'u khri drug stong yod pa las/ le'u khri lnga stong dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu bshad pa de nas so/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang zhes pa la/'khor phun sum tshogs pa phyag na rdo rje'i bshad pa ste/ dpal ldan ni gzugs sku gnyis so/ /rdo rje ni stong pa nyid de chos sku'o/ /'chang zhes pa ni sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa ste ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o/ /gdul dka' zhes pa ni gdul bya ste dug gsum mo/ /'dul ba rnams zhes pa 'dul byed de sku rnam pa ldugasum mo/ /mchog ces pa ni phyag na rdo rje'o/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /zhes pa ni gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa la ni dpa' bo zhes bya'o/ /'jig rten gsum las rgyal ni sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum las rgyal ba'o/ /rdo rje dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal/ /zhes pa ni rdo rje ni stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid de'i don thugs su chud pa la ni dbang phyug ces bya'o/ /don de nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang thun mong ma yin pas na gsang ba'i rgyal lo/ /yang na gsang ba ni gsang sngags kyi theg pa'o/ /de'i rgyal po ni phyag na rdo rje'o/ /'o na phyag na rdo rje de'i cha lugs ci 'dra zhe na/ padma dkar po'i rgyas 'dra'i spyan/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ padma dkar po ni mdog dkar ba/ rtsa ba bzang ba dri zhim pa/ rtsi yod pa/ 'dab ma lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin du phyag na rdo 24—1396

rje de yang nyon mongs pas ma gos pa dang / tshogs gnyis las 1grub pa dang /gzhan 'dul ba dang / snying rje dang ldan pa dang / rigs lngas 'gro ba'i don byed pa'o/ /yang na/ padma dkar po'i rgyas 'dra'i spyan/ /zhes bya ba ni padma la 'dam gyi 3skyon gyis ma gos pa bzhin skyon med pa'i spyan lnga dang ldan zhes bya ba'i tshig go/ /padma rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes pa ni/ padma rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa yin la 'khor ba la gnas kyang nyes pas ma gos zhes pa'i don to/ /rang gi lag gis rdo rje mchog /ces pa ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thugs su chud pa'i rtags su rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan don mdzad pa'i rtags su yang dang yang du gsor bar byed pa'o/ /des ni thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor bstan to/ /da ni thun mong gi 'khor khro bo stong ④lnga brgya bshad par bya ste/ khro bo de dag gi cha lugs bstan pa ni/ khro gnyer rim par 4ldan la sogs/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ khro gnyer ni khro gnyer ro/ /rim par ldan la sogs zhes pa kyeni skra dang ag tshom ser la badzees pa dang / mig dmar ba dang / lce 'dril zhing ya 6sos ma mchu mnan pa dang / thung zhing gel ba dang / gsus pa che ba dang / yan lag rab tu bgrad klupa dang /nying lag rdo rje'i rtse mo lta bu dang / dur khrod dang gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / mtshon cha 'bar zhing 'phro ba dang / mgo'i do shal dang / me 'bar ba'i gnas ni rim par ldan pa ste sogs zhes bya'o/ /de lta bu su la ldan zhe na/ lag na rdo rje mtha' yas pa la'o/ /gdul dka' 'dul bas na dpa' bo'o / /khro bo'i cha lugs dang ldan pas na 'jigs su rung ba'o/ /stag gi sham bu dang ldan pas na dpa' byad can no/ /ba spu'i bu ga nas rdo rje'i rtse mo 24—1397

rab tu 'phro ba ni gzhan don no/ /rang gi lag gis snagasor bar byed pas na rang don no/ /snying rje chen po'i sgo nas gzhan don byed pa dang / shes rab chen po'i sgo nas rang gi don thugs su chud pas na/ thabs kyis 2'gro don byed pa'i mchog /'khor de dag thams cad kyang 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don la dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rangs pa'i bsam pa can no/ /khro bo'i lus kyi gzugs ldan pa ni bshad zinato/ /sangs ༷ 7pa ni spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyas pa ni ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /phrin las ni zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang drag po'o/ /byed pa'i mgon zhes pa ni phrin las bzhis 'gro ba'i mgon byed pa'i tha tshig go/ /lus btud rnams dang lhan cig ces bya ba ni phyag na rdo rje dang lhan cig tu gnas pa'o/ /gnas nas kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la zhes bya ba ni ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ste shākya thub pa'o/ /gnyis su med pa'i de bzhin nyid thugs su chud hūṃnas 'gro ba'i don la gshegs pas na de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bcom pa ni bdud bzhi'o/ /ldan pa ni ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /'das pa ni rtag chad gnyis las 'das pa'o/ /rdzogs pa ni stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i che ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /sangs rgyas ni sku gsum mo/ /phyag 'tshal nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa lus gus pa dang / ngag dang ba dang / yid mos pa dang bcas nas so/ /thal mo sbyar ba ni lus kyi bya ba'o/ /spyan sngar 'dug ste zhes bya ba ni ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ste shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar 'dug pa'o/ /'di skad gsol zhes pa ni mtshams sbyor gyi tshig ste ngag tu'o/ /khyab bdag ces bya ba ni 271—1398

thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba la khyab pas na khyab bdag go/ /bdag la sman pa dang zhes pa ni phyag na rdo rje la'o/ /bdag don bdag la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /zhes pa ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thob pa'i phyir ro/ /thabs khyad par can sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sgo nas mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ci nas bdag gis thob par bya ba'i phyir rgyud 'di bshad du gsol zhes pa'o/ /rang gi don du zhus pa bstan pa'o/ /da ni gzhan gyi don du zhus pa bstan pa ni/ nyon mongs pa ni dug lnga'am gsum mo/ /sems dkrugs zhes pa choni/ nyon mongs pa de dag gis rab tu sdug bsngal bar byas pa'o/ /ma rig pa ni ma rig pa'o/ /'dam du bying ba ni 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba'o/ /sems can kun zhes pa 'gro ba rigs drug go/ /sman pa dang zhes pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba thob pa'i phyir ro/ /bla med 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /zhes pa ni chos kyi sgu ste de thob pa'i phyir bshad du gsol ba'o/ /yul gang la gsol ba gdab snyam pa la/sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la'o/ /'gro ba ni rigs drug go/ /bla ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa'o/ /ma ni de ston pa'am 'byen pa'am skyed 1 par byed pa'o/ /ston pa po zhes pa ni ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtogs pa dang / the tshom za ba las byebazlog pa'o/ /dam tshig chen po ni de las mi 'da' ba'o/ /de nyid mkhyen zhes bya ba ni/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/de kho na nyid thugs su chud pa'o/ /dbang po bsam pa mkhyen mchog gis/ /zhes pa ni ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/ gdul bya'i dbang po dang bsam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /de lta bu'i ston pa khyed ④ni gsol ba gdab pa'i gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes sku/ /zhes 24—1399

pa ni 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' ste chos sku ste thugs so/ /gtsug tor chen po tshig gi bdag /ces pa ni sku'i rang bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' man chad kyis bltar mi mngon pa ste 'dra ba med cing zil gyis mi non pa'i rtags so/ /tshig gi bdag ces pa ni gsung phun sum tshogs pa ste/ mi zad pa'i gsung de lta bu su la mnga' ba la bdag ces bya'o/ /de lta bu de yang rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pas na༄khye/ ye shes sku ste rang 'byung ba/ /zhes bya'o/ /sku de lta bu dang ldan pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i ming ni yang dag brjod pa'i mchog /de'i don 3/bshad du gsol zhes pa'i tshig go/ /'jam pa ni tha dad kyi rtog pa'i zug rngus ma gos pa ste chos sku'o/ /dpal ni 'gro ba'i dpal du gyur pa ste gzugs sku'o/ /ye shes ye gnas pa'i don shes pas na ye shes so/ /sems dpa' ni 'gro ba'i don la sems dpa' ba'o )/ /ming ni zhes pas ni mtshan no/ /yang dag par brjod pa ni ma nor ba'o/ /mchog ces pa ni 'gran zla med pa'o/ /don zab ces pa ni/ blo'i yul ma yin pa ste lta ba'o/ /de lta bu'i don des ma khyab pa med pas na don rgya che ba zhes bya'o/ /don chen mtshungs rnged 4ces bya ba ni de lta bu'i don de goms pa las/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bas na don chen po zhes bya'o/ /mtshungs med ces bya ba ni/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba'i 'bras bu dang 'dra ba ma yin pa'o/ /rab zhi ba zhes bya ba ni/ sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba'i sku'o/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pas thog mar 7dge ba zhes bya'o/ /da ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pas bar du dge ba zhes bya'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i 24dod/7100

sangs rgyas rnams kyang gsung bar 'gyur bas na tha mar dge ba zhes bya'o/ /yang na thog mar dge ba ni lta ba'o/ /bar du dge ba ni sgom pa'o/ /tha mar dge ba ni 'bras bu'o/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang / /zhes pa ni nan tan du gsungs pa'o/ /rgyud chen zhes pa ni rgyud sde bzhi las khyad par 'phags pa'o—/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni rgyud kyi ming ngo / /las zhes lkupa ni le'u khri drug stong yod pa las/ da res klu'i 3le'u bshad du gsol zhes pa'o/ /rdo rje ni stong pa nyid do/ /'chang ba ni de'i don thugs su chud pa'o/ /chen po ni 'gran zla med pa ste longs sku'o/ /gsang sngags 'chang zhes pa ni zung 'jug gi ngo bo thugs su chud pa ste chos sku'o/ /dpag med rnams zhes pa ni sprul pa'i sgu grangs med pa'o/ /dga' bzhin du zhes pa ni sangs rgyas de dag dgyes bzhin du 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don glur blangs pa gang lags pa bshad du gsol zhes pa'o/ /'gro ba'i mgon byed pas na/ mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyis/ /zhes pa ni sku gsum mo/ /gsang 'dzin ni sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'o/ /ci nas bdag 'gyur phyir zhes pa ni dbyer mi phyed pa'i don te/bdag gis thob par mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i don to/ /nges par 'byung gi bar du 'di/ /zhes pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ma thob kyi bar du/bdag gi bsam pa brtan pos bzung / /zhes pa'i don to/ /gzhan don du zhus pa bstan pa ni/ nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang / /zhes pa ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'o/ /bsal ba dang zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs pa de dag par byed pa'i phyir zhes bya ba'i don to/ /mi shes pa ni shes bya'i sgrib pa'o/ /ma lus spang ba'i phyir zhes pa ni nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa mtha' dag 24—1101
